source_text: and the princes of pharaoh saw her, and praised her to pharaoh: and the woman was taken into pharaoh's house.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a dhèu aae sèra ladhe rèdhi ne, aa ra koa bhabhèni iia na ètu madha dhèu aae. ka rèti bhèni ne, asa èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: and he dealt well with abram for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he-asses, and men-servants, and maid-servants, and she-asses, and camels.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae be'a-be'a ka dènge abram, lula sarai. ka na parasee abram mèdha rupa-rupa. nuka badha sèmi: kahib'i-kalèbho, kahib'i-ka'ia, sapi, keled'ei, dènge onta. na parasee kahèi, ènu dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: and jehovah plagued pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of sarai, abram's wife.
target_text: lula na nare dhèu èmu dhèu asa d'ara èmu na, nèti èèna ka, lamatua hia huku rupa-rupa mi dhèu aae dènge isi èmu na.

source_text: and pharaoh called abram, and said, what is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
target_text: hèia dhèu aae masir paroa abram, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu ne tao tasamia mi ja'a ne? nga tao ka èu peka boe na, bhèni ne dhèu èmu èu?

source_text: why saidst thou, she is my sister, so that i took her to be my wife? now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
target_text: te ngaa aku èu na, nèngu ne ana hèni èu! nèti èèna ka, ja'a oe kore ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu ja'a! dhèu èmu èu ka ne'e! more hari ka, aa pakaj'èu ka nèti madha ja'a!

source_text: and pharaoh gave men charge concerning him: and they brought him on the way, and his wife, and all that he had.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae paredha dhèu sab'a na sèra, babège eele abram, dhèu èmu na, rèti dènge dhèu aa mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra, kalua nèti rai èèna.

source_text: and abram went up out of egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and lot with him, into the south.
target_text: ka abram si tèke eele masir, lasi asa rai negeb. la'e dènge dhèu èmu na, aa dènge dhèu aa mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra. ana ari na lot madhutu ra kahèi.

source_text: and abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
target_text: abram èèna, kaja ae titu kèna. badha-manu na, mèdha hualaa dènge mèdha hualaa-pudhi na, ae titu kèna.

source_text: and he went on his journeys from the south even to beth-el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between beth-el and ai,
target_text: nèti negeb, ra pidha-pidha era, ka d'ai hari talora rae betel dènge rae ai. dhu uru èèna, ra pea rèdhi le ètu era èèna.

source_text: unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there abram called on the name of jehovah.
target_text: aa dhu abram patitu le kahèi mei korban, ho na mangaj'i mi lamatua ètu era èèna.

source_text: and lot also, who went with abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
target_text: lot dhu madhutu abram èèna, unu badha-manu dènge dhèu sab'a ae kahèi.

source_text: and the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together. and there was a strife between the herdsmen of abram's cattle and the herdsmen of lot's cattle: and the canaanite and the perizzite dwelt then in the land.
target_text: te ngaa era èèna taleo boe, ho abram dènge lot aa dènge kakaja ra bisa pea pa'èci. nèti èèna ka, ana madhenge badha abram dènge lot sèra j'aj'i patao-palaha, lula j'u'u ètu era èèna d'ai boe hia badha rèngu. lod'o èèna, dhèu kana'an dènge dhèu feris, dhu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: and abram said unto lot, let there be no strife, i pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdsmen and thy herdsmen; for we are brethren.
target_text: ka abram peka dènge lot, aku nèngu na, èdhi se, pa'a'ari. mage dhoka èdhi, èci dènge èci be'a boe, lula dhèu sab'a èdhi se patao-palaha taruu.

source_text: is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, i pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then i will go to the right; or if thou take the right hand, then i will go to the left.
target_text: de hua iia dua ti pahag'a ka laa. rai ne, taleo. de ladhe èu d'èi rai ca bèka kariu na, ja'a abhu re ca bèka g'ana. te ngaa ladhe èu d'èi re ca bèka g'ana, na ja'a re ca bèka kariu.

source_text: and lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of the jordan, that it was well watered every where, before jehovah destroyed sodom and gomorrah, like the garden of jehovah, like the land of egypt, as thou goest unto zoar.
target_text: hèia lot ladhe palème. ka na ladhe nèdhi rai taleo ètu sebhe loko yarden dhu madha èi ae, toke d'ai rae soar. era ne, rai hèu mèngi sama sèmi oka lamatua, dènge rai masir kahèi. lod'o èèna, lamatua dhae huku mèka kota sodom dènge kota gomora. de rai èèna, be'a era.

source_text: so lot chose him all the plain of the jordan; and lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
target_text: hèia lot pili nare era sebhe loko yarden èèna. ka dua ra pahag'e ka. de lot la'e sa ca bèka dhimu.

source_text: abram dwelt in the land of canaan, and lot dwelt in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as sodom.
target_text: te ngaa abram pea taruu ètu rai kana'an. aa lot la'e pea ètu rae-rae dhu padètu dènge kota sodom ètu sebhe loko yarden.

source_text: now the men of sodom were wicked and sinners against jehovah exceedingly.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu-dhèu sodom sèra bhelu-katub'a titu kèna. rèngu ro'o boe nanene lamatua.

source_text: and jehovah said unto abram, after that lot was separated from him, lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art, northward and southward and eastward and westward:
target_text: ropa lot pacèri dènge abram, ka lamatua padhai lii dènge abram, peka na, èu ladhe palème aa'i ku, rai aa'i-aa'i nèti era titu èu èèna. ladhe paie re madha, re kabodho, re ca bèka g'ana, dènge ca bèka kariu mu.

source_text: for all the land which thou seest, to thee will i give it, and to thy seed for ever.
target_text: rai aa'i-aa'i dhu èu ladhe mèdhi sèi, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mi èu, dènge ana-èpu èu, sèna ka j'aj'i pusaka ra, toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and i will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then may thy seed also be numbered.
target_text: èèna na ja'a paj'aj'i ana-èpu èu ae sama sèmi salae dhasi, toke dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for unto thee will i give it.
target_text: de lamu kako palème madhutu madhera dènge bhabhèla na. te rai se aa'i-aa'i ra, ja'a hia mi èu.

source_text: and abram moved his tent, and came and dwelt by the oaks of mamre, which are in hebron, and built there an altar unto jehovah.
target_text: hèia abram si lèpa hari asa era pea ra, dhu dètu dènge aj'u-aj'u aae ètu mamre, dhu padètu dènge hebron. èle èèna ka, na pudhi hadhu tao mei korban ho na mangaj'i lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: and it came to pass in the days of amraphel king of shinar, arioch king of ellasar, chedorlaomer king of elam, and tidal king of goiim,
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae èpa dhu pa'èci. rèngu se ka: amrafel, dhèu aae rai sinear. ariok, dhèu aae rai elasar, kedarlaomer, dhèu aae rai elam. dènge tideal, dhèu aae rai goyim.

source_text: that they made war with bera king of sodom, and with birsha king of gomorrah, shinab king of admah, and shemeber king of zeboiim, and the king of bela the same is zoar.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae leo dhèu lèmi, pa'èci kahèi. nuka: bera, dhèu aae rai sodom. birsa, dhèu aae rai gomora. sinab, dhèu aae rai adema. semeber, dhèu aae rai seboim. dènge bela, dhèu aae rai soar. ka èpa dhèu aae se, lasi pamusu dènge lèmi dhèu aae sèra.

source_text: all these joined together in the vale of siddim the same is the salt sea.
target_text: dhèu aae, dhèu lèmi sèra pakaboko dènge sordad'u ra, ètu d'ara mamoo sidim, dhu limuri ne, ngara na dhasi madhe.

source_text: twelve years they served chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
target_text: j'aj'aj'i pamusu na, sèmi ne'e ka: uru èèna, dhèu aae, dhèu lèmi se dhu ta'alo mi dhèu aae kedarlaomer, canguru dua tèu kèna. te d'ai tèu ka canguru tèlu, ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra lab'a ne.

source_text: and in the fourteenth year came chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the rephaim in ashteroth-karnaim, and the zuzim in ham, and the emim in shaveh-kiriathaim,
target_text: ka maso tèu ka canguru èpa, kedarlaomer dènge angalai na dhèu aae dhèu tèlu sera, mai dènge sordad'u ra. hèia ra pamusu ka, ka ra segi pèri-pèri rai. nuka: dhèu refaim ètu rai asterot-karnaim; dhèu susim ètu rai ham; dhèu emim ètu rai sawe-kiryataim,

source_text: and the horites in their mount seir, unto el-paran, which is by the wilderness.
target_text: dènge dhèu hori dhu ètu ledhe seir, d'ai sebhe mamoo el paran.

source_text: and they returned, and came to en-mishpat the same is kadesh, and smote all the country of the amalekites, and also the amorites, that dwelt in hazazon-tamar.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lèpa hari asa en mispat dhu limuri ne ngara na kades. ka ra segi rai dhèu amalek, dènge dhèu amori dhu pea ètu rae haseson-tamar.

source_text: and there went out the king of sodom, and the king of gomorrah, and the king of admah, and the king of zeboiim, and the king of bela the same is zoar; and they set the battle in array against them in the vale of siddim; against chedorlaomer king of elam, and tidal king of goiim, and amraphel king of shinar, and arioch king of ellasar; four kings against the five.
target_text: hèia, lèmi dhèu aae se ator sordad'u ra ètu d'ara mamoo sidim, ka lasi pamusu dènge dhèu aae dhèu èpa sèra.

source_text: now the vale of siddim was full of slime pits; and the kings of sodom and gomorrah fled, and they fell there, and they that remained fled to the mountain.
target_text: ètu d'ara mamoo èèna, dhu abhu mananga èi dama pèri-pèri. ropa ra pamusu, dhèu aae sodom dènge dhèu aae gomora dènge sordad'u ra, rai. ka cahag'e manahu asa d'ara mananga èi dama se. aa cahag'e hari rai asa ledhe lasi.

source_text: and they took all the goods of sodom and gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
target_text: ka èpa dhèu aae dhu segi se, lasi parame rèti mèdha-panyau dènge nganga'a-nginu nèti sodom dènge gomora. èèna ka, ra lèpa dènge ka.

source_text: and they took lot, abram's brother's son, who dwelt in sodom, and his goods, and departed.
target_text: te ngaa lot, ana ari abram, dhu pea ètu sodom. ka èpa dhèu aae sèra, ère rèti lot si, dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and there came one that had escaped, and told abram the hebrew: now he dwelt by the oaks of mamre, the amorite, brother of eshcol, and brother of aner; and these were confederate with abram.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci rai nèti era èèna. ka la'e lolo dènge abram, dhèu ibrani èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu amori èci, ngara na mamre. aa abram pea dètu dènge aj'u-aj'u aae unu mamre. a'ari mamre dhèu dua, ngara na eskol dènge aner. rèngu se dhu pa'anga dènge abram.

source_text: and when abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he led forth his trained men, born in his house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued as far as dan.
target_text: ropa abram tadèngi na dhèu kèpe rèti le lot, ana ari na, ka abram pakaboko nare dhèu-dhèu sab'a na dhu re'a pamusu. aa'i-aa'i ra tèlu ngasu canguru aru dhèu. ka lasi magèla èpa dhèu aae sèra, asa badae aae lasi d'ai rae dan.

source_text: and he divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and smote them, and pursued them unto hobah, which is on the left hand of damascus.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abram hag'e dhèu na sèra, mi pèri-pèri kaboko. d'ara mèda èèna kahèi, lasi age si, dènge j'ara pa'oke. ka abram si lasi bate dhèu se d'ai rae hoba, ètu bèka badae kota damsik.

source_text: and he brought back all the goods, and also brought back his brother lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
target_text: hèia abram abhu hari lot, dènge dhèu-dhèu nèngu, aa dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i. na abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu leo.

source_text: and the king of sodom went out to meet him, after his return from the slaughter of chedorlaomer and the kings that were with him, at the vale of shaveh the same is the king's vale.
target_text: ropa abram segi nare dhèu aae èpa sèra, ka na lèpa. hèia dhèu aae sodom mai soru ne ètu d'ara mamoo sawe dhu dhèu biasa peka na, mamoo dhèu aae.

source_text: and melchizedek king of salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was priest of god most high.
target_text: tèu èèna, melkisedek, j'aj'i dhèu aae kota salem. aa nèngu ne j'aj'i kahèi ama agama nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. na mai soru abram, nèti roti dènge èi hua anggor.

source_text: and he blessed him, and said, blessed be abram of god most high, possessor of heaven and earth: and blessed be god most high, who hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. and he gave him a tenth of all.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho hia berkat mi abram, aku nèngu na, ja'a sanao sèna ka ama lamatua, dhu dedha risi eele èèna, dhu paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne, hia mèngi-nale mi dedha èu. koa-kio ama lamatua dhu hia le èu segi musu. èle èèna ka, abram bagi hia melkisedek ca pala nèti canguru pala mèdha-panyau dhu na abhu hari sèra.

source_text: and the king of sodom said unto abram, give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae sodom èèna pahaha iisi na mi abram, peka na, ama. mèdha-panyau dhu èu abhu hari nèti musu ja'a sèra, hud'i laa ama ku abhu aa'i si. te ngaa dhu ja'a manèngi hari, dhoka dhèu-dhèu ja'a sèra.

source_text: and abram said to the king of sodom, i have lifted up my hand unto jehovah, god most high, possessor of heaven and earth,
target_text: hèia abram b'ala ne, peka na, ja'a subha ètu madha ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele, dhu tao dedha-liru dènge rai-haha,

source_text: that i will not take a thread nor a shoe-latchet nor aught that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, i have made abram rich:
target_text: na, ja'a kore boe mèdha-panyau èu, masi ka ciki èèna ka. masi ka loa hèngu ca'èta sa, ja'a kore boe. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èu baku peka na, ‘kakaja abram sèra mai nèti ja'a. '

source_text: save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men that went with me, aner, eshcol, and mamre; let them take their portion.
target_text: ja'a parluu boe ngaa-ngaa. dhoka mia dhu dhèu ja'a se pake le, sèra èle le, ale ia ka. aa hud'i laa, angalai ja'a dhèu tèlu se: aner, eskol dènge mamre, hag'e rare unu rèngu di.

source_text: after these things the word of jehovah came unto abram in a vision, saying, fear not, abram: i am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi abram. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, abram! èu baku madha'u. lula ja'a ka dhu j'aj'i mi tami ho bhiri èu nèti musu. aa ja'a hia a'oto mi dedha èu.

source_text: and abram said, o lord jehovah, what wilt thou give me, seeing i go childless, and he that shall be possessor of my house is eliezer of damascus? and abram said, behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
target_text: te ngaa, aku abram na, masi ka ama lamatua hia ae-ae èèna ka, j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci. lula ja'a ne dènge boe ana matana, ho hia ja'a ana-èpu. de dhu neo unu ae-ae sèmi èèna, tao mi ngaa? neu-neu ka, noto mi ènu ja'a elieser, dhèu damsik èèna. nèngu ka dhu sèmi nare aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and, behold, the word of jehovah came unto him, saying, this man shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua dhaa na, j'ara na sèmi boe èèna! ana d'èlu èu ku, dhu unu pusaka sèra. ènu èu abhu boe.

source_text: and he brought him forth abroad, and said, look now toward heaven, and number the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, so shall thy seed be.
target_text: hèia nèti abram asa li'u, ka na peka, èu ladhe ku asa dedha-liru nèi. ladhe paie ku hua-hètu sèi. bisa iga more, do aad'o? bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu èu sama sèmi hua-hètu sèi!

source_text: and he believed in jehovah; and he reckoned it to him for righteousness.
target_text: ka abram sèmi nare lii padhai lamatua. aa lamatua tadhe ne, dhèu mola, lula abram lèka ne.

source_text: and he said unto him, i am jehovah that brought thee out of ur of the chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua tuhu hari lii na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua. ja'a ka dhu lere kèti èu nèti rae ur, ètu rai dhèu kasdim sèra. aa rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia èu, sèna ka j'aj'i pusaka mu.

source_text: and he said, o lord jehovah, whereby shall i know that i shall inherit it?
target_text: te ngaa abram karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia, lamatua? dènge j'ara sa mia ka ho ja'a ke'a na, rai ne j'aj'i pusaka ja'a?

source_text: and he said unto him, take me a heifer three years old, and a she-goat three years old, and a ram three years old, and a turtle-dove, and a young pigeon.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! mai ti tao madha j'ara èci, dhu pa'èki lii padhai lii ja'a deo na. de lamu more sapi rena ci'u, kahib'i rena ci'u, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho mone ci'u. aa'i-aa'i sèra hud'i dhu umur tèlu tèu. aa mèti kahèi koro iia ci'u, dènge koro j'aha ci'u.

source_text: and he took him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each half over against the other: but the birds divided he not.
target_text: ka abram la'e nare badha sèra. hèia na kacèb'e bagi mi dua, sapi, kahib'i, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho sèra. ka na pale sisi se mi rai, dhu èci patangara dènge èci, j'aj'i mi dua b'aris. te ngaa na kacèb'e boe manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: and the birds of prey came down upon the carcasses, and abram drove them away.
target_text: ka manu-bhui dhu tema ra'a sisi sèra, mai ho neo ra'a sisi se'e. te ngaa abram bhabhoo eele si.

source_text: and when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon abram; and, lo, a horror of great darkness fell upon him.
target_text: ropa lod'o cèna, abram bhèj'i luu. na nii, kuri na maroga mai sarimu nare nèngu, ka na madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: and he said unto abram, know of a surety that thy seed shall be sojourners in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years; and also that nation, whom they shall serve, will i judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance. but thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, abram! èèna na èu mamuri toke heka bhoro, aa madhe dènge be'a, ka ra padhane èu dènge be'a. te ngaa ana-èpu èu, èèna na j'aj'i dhèu tao mai ètu kabarai dhèu. ho èèna na, dhèu isi rai sèra, tao si sèmi ènu sa, ka ra ènyi aa paj'èra si, toke èpa ngasu tèu. te, ladhe èèna na, ja'a huku si. ho èèna na, ja'a kèti hari ana-èpu èu nèti era èèna, aa dènge mèdha-panyau ra ae-ae.

source_text: and in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the amorite is not yet full.
target_text: aa èèna na, ja'a ator ho ana-èpu èu dhu ka lèmi kèti hari si asa ne'e mai. limuri ne, dhèu amori dhu pea ètu rai ne'e. dhèu se'e dhèu bhelu, te ngaa dhae bhelu iia mèka. ladhe ana-èpu èu sèra lèpa hari asa era ne'e, ja'a neo pake si ho huku palaho dhèu amori sèra. lula d'ai taa èèna, bhabhelu ra asa hino.

source_text: and it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace, and a flaming torch that passed between these pieces.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda sa, cag'ag'a laa ètu era èèna, abhu èru rai èci dhu sèb'u poka-poka, dènge badhu ai èci dhu heo, kako re sasanga sisi dua baris se.

source_text: in that day jehovah made a covenant with abram, saying, unto thy seed have i given this land, from the river of egypt unto the great river, the river euphrates:
target_text: lod'o èèna, lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge abram. na peka na, ja'a jaji mema èu kèna, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pangèd'u mi ana-èpu èu rai ne'e ne, mulai nèti loko masir, d'ai loko efrat,

source_text: the kenite, and the kenizzite, and the kadmonite,
target_text: dènge rai dhèu keni, dhèu kenas, dhèu kadmon,

source_text: and the hittite, and the perizzite, and the rephaim,
target_text: dhèu het, dhèu feris, dhèu refaim,

source_text: and the amorite, and the canaanite, and the girgashite, and the jebusite.
target_text: dhèu amori, dhèu kana'an, dhèu girgasi, dènge dhèu yebus.

source_text: now sarai, abram's wife, bare him no children: and she had a handmaid, an egyptian, whose name was hagar. and sarai said unto abram, behold now, jehovah hath restrained me from bearing; go in, i pray thee, unto my handmaid; it may be that i shall obtain children by her. and abram hearkened to the voice of sarai. and sarai, abram's wife, took hagar the egyptian, her handmaid, after abram had dwelt ten years in the land of canaan, and gave her to abram her husband to be his wife.
target_text: tèu èèna, abram lèpa hari le nèti masir, ka na pea le canguru tèu ètu kana'an. dhèu èmu na sarai abhu mèka kolo. sarai dènge ènu bhèni ca dhèu nèti masir, ngara na hagar. ca lod'o, sarai peka dènge abram, aku nèngu na, a'a. lamatua hia boe ja'a ana. de hua iia, lamu j'unu dènge ènu ja'a, hagar, sèna ka na hia ja'a ana. ka abram madhutu lii dhèu èmu na. ka sarai hia hagar j'aj'i dhèu èmu ka dua abram.

source_text: and he went in unto hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
target_text: hèia abram j'unu dènge hagar, ka na dènge babia. ropa hagar ne'a nèngu dènge babia le, ka na padedha iisi na, aa na pahae heka sarai.

source_text: and sarai said unto abram, my wrong be upon thee: i gave my handmaid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, i was despised in her eyes: jehovah judge between me and thee.
target_text: ka sarai peka dènge abram, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka dhu hia nèngu mi èu j'aj'i dhèu èmu ka dua. te ngaa ropa na dènge babia, na pusi pahae heka ja'a! ne'e ne, sala èu! de hud'i laa, sèna ka lamatua ka dhu pama'ète lii èdhi dua ti! heka èu me'a kèna!

source_text: but abram said unto sarai, behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her that which is good in thine eyes. and sarai dealt hardly with her, and she fled from her face.
target_text: ka abram dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e, wee! èu ne, dhèu èmu uru. aa nèngu, dhèu èmu limuri. de èu ne dhu mèd'u paredha. de èu neo tao ne tasamia, èèna ètu èu na! ka sarai mulai tao sakaa hua dènge hagar, hèia na rai.

source_text: and the angel of jehovah found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to shur.
target_text: na rai d'ai d'ara mamoo. hèia ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga ca dhèu, rage ne dètu dènge madha èi, ètu j'ara la'e asa sur.

source_text: and he said, hagar, sarai's handmaid, whence camest thou? and whither goest thou? and she said, i am fleeing from the face of my mistress sarai.
target_text: ka na lii, aku nèngu na, èu ne hagar, ènu sarai. nga tao ka èu ètu ne'e? èu mai nèti mia, aa lamu mia? hèia hagar dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a rai nèti d'ara èmu lamatua ja'a.

source_text: and the angel of jehovah said unto her, return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
target_text: ka ana pajuu èèna pamako ne, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! be'a risi, èu lèpa hari asa adhe-aai sarai, lamatua èu. masi ka na tao èu tasamia èèna ka, sèmi la.

source_text: and the angel of jehovah said unto her, i will greatly multiply thy seed, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
target_text: baku madha'u. bèli-camèd'a, ja'a pabèba ana-èpu èu pa'ae-ae, toke dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: and the angel of jehovah said unto her, behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son; and thou shalt call his name ishmael, because jehovah hath heard thy affliction.
target_text: èu dhu dènge babia. nèbhu heka, èu mora iisi ana mone ca dhèu. èèna na mu pangare ne ismael dhu sasoa na ‘lamatua tadèngi', lula lamatua tadèngi le lii roma iisi èu.

source_text: and he shall be as a wild ass among men; his hand shall be against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell over against all his brethren.
target_text: ropa ana ne kapai, na mamuri pakaj'èu nèti a'ari na. lula nèngu ne, sama sèmi jara hui dhu d'èi boe nanene lii paredha. sad'i dhèu cee èèna ka, na sisu. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i lab'a ne kahèi.

source_text: and she called the name of jehovah that spake unto her, thou art a god that seeth: for she said, have i even here looked after him that seeth me?

source_text: behold now, i have two daughters that have not known man; let me, i pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing, forasmuch as they are come under the shadow of my roof.
target_text: mi nanene ku ja'a laa! ana bhèni ja'a, dhèu dua. dua ra dhu pa'èci mèka dènge dhèu mone. ja'a hia miu. mere, ho mi tao tasamia èèna ka, sad'i madhutu dad'èi miu. sad'i miu baku tao karehe mi tamu ja'a dhèu dua se. lula madhutu ad'a èdhi, ja'a ka dhu hud'i j'aga si.

source_text: and they said, stand back. and they said, this one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. and they pressed sore upon the man, even lot, and drew near to break the door.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu sodom se pa'oo ma'ète boe, aku rèngu na, èu ne, baku patabha! te èu ne, dhèu tao mai ètu kabarai ji'i ne! de èu dènge boe hak ho kai ji'i. hua iia, èu pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e. te, ladhe lamu boe, ji'i tao èu bia risi nèti dhèu dua se'e! ka ra tule eele lot, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra rai lasi j'èje babèdho èmu.

source_text: but the men put forth their hand, and brought lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dua se soro kacui-aai ra, ère pamaso lot, ka ra patèke èmu nèti d'ara.

source_text: and they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
target_text: dua ra tao pabèdhu ana madha dhèu sodom aa'i-aa'i ra, ka rèdhi heka ngaa-ngaa. ra gogo tenge babèdho, te ngaa abhu boe.

source_text: and the men said unto lot, hast thou here any besides? son-in-law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whomsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of the place: for we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxed great before jehovah; and jehovah hath sent us to destroy it.
target_text: hèia tamu dhèu dua se, peka dènge lot, aku rèngu na, lamatua ne'a le, bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu sodom se. nèti èèna ka, na paleha ji'i dua mi mai, sèna ka palaho eele kota ne. de èu dhu dènge a'ari leo dhu ètu d'ara kota ne, do aad'o? ladhe dènge ana mone, do ana bhèni, do dhèu èmu ana èu, do, sad'i cee èèna ka, lamu more si, ho rai ka nèti d'ara kota ne lai-lai!

source_text: and lot went out, and spake unto his sons-in-law, who married his daughters, and said, up, get you out of this place; for jehovah will destroy the city. but he seemed unto his sons-in-law as one that mocked.
target_text: hèia lot la'e paraga dènge ana mone dhèu dua, dhu lii d'ai ana bhèni na. ka na peka, dua mi nanene paie! rai ka nèti d'ara kota ne, te lamatua neo palaho eele ne! te ngaa ra pangee na, lot padhai lii paleko di.

source_text: and when the morning arose, then the angels hastened lot, saying, arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters that are here, lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae era, ana pajuu lamatua dhèu dua se, pakaseti lot si, ho lasi karohe asa era kaj'èu. ra peka na, lami ka! ère mèti dhèu èmu mu, dènge ana bhèni èu dhèu dua sèra, ho rai ka. tèke eele kota ne'e! mage dhoka miu madhe aa'i palere-lere dènge kota ne.

source_text: but he lingered; and the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters, jehovah being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
target_text: te ngaa lot neka-neka era, masi ka lamatua neo hia ne mamuri. nèti èèna ka, tamu dhèu dua se nuni lot, dhèu èmu na, dènge ana bhèni dhèu dua sèra, rèti asa li'u kota.

source_text: and it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
target_text: hèia ca dhèu nèti tamu dhèu dua sèra paredha si, peka na, rai palasa, sèna ka abhu sod'a! mage mi kabib'a kabodho! baku ae ètu d'ara mamoo! rai taruu, asa ledhe nèi, sèna ka miu baku madhe!

source_text: and lot said unto them, oh, not so, my lord:
target_text: te ngaa lot peka, aku nèngu na, iraa ee! baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: behold now, thy servant hath found favor in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy lovingkindness, which thou hast showed unto me in saving my life; and i cannot escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and i die:
target_text: mema ama si pamamuri le ji'i se. te ngaa ledhe nèi kaj'èu bia nèti ne'e! mage dhoka ji'i d'ai mèka nèi, j'aj'èra dhu magee nare le ji'i èèna, ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one. oh let me escape thither is it not a little one? , and my soul shall live.
target_text: ama ladhe ku laa. rae iiki cue dhu kaj'èu boe nèti era ne'e. rae nèi dhu kolongara aad'o. ladhe ama d'èi, ji'i la'a pasoru iisi asa nèi!

source_text: and he said unto him, see, i have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that i will not overthrow the city of which thou hast spoken.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, oo! lami ka! te èèna na, ja'a palaho boe rae nèi.

source_text: haste thee, escape thither; for i cannot do anything till thou be come thither. therefore the name of the city was called zoar.
target_text: de rai karohe ka, lami asa nèi! te ja'a tao mèka ngaa-ngaa, ladhe miu d'ai mèka era nèi. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu pangare rae ne soar, dhu sasoa na ‘ana iiki-iiki'.

source_text: the sun was risen upon the earth when lot came unto zoar.
target_text: ropa lod'o rea, lot si d'ai soar.

source_text: then jehovah rained upon sodom and upon gomorrah brimstone and fire from jehovah out of heaven;
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, lamatua sadutu ai dènge èi nasu nèti dedha-liru asa sodom dènge gomora.

source_text: and he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
target_text: lamatua pakèpu-ladhu ai kota dènge rae aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara rai èèna, dènge ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu èèna, nuka: dhèu, badha-manu, dènge ana aaj'u.

source_text: but his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
target_text: lod'o rèngu rai, dhèu èmu lot kabib'a kabodho. cag'ag'a laa, na j'aj'i agarii masi.

source_text: and abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before jehovah:
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhu mad'ae aae era, abraham la'e asa era dhu med'a na, na pamako lamatua.

source_text: and he looked toward sodom and gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.
target_text: hèia na ladhe sa haha asa sodom dènge gomora, aa asa d'ara mamoo èèna. na ladhe la'a na, sèb'u poka-poka sèna, dhu ca'e asa dedha-liru. aa ai na'e aa'i le ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and it came to pass, when god destroyed the cities of the plain, that god remembered abraham, and sent lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which lot dwelt.
target_text: ama lamatua patalale lot si nèti hahuku èèna, ropa na pakèpu-ladhu ai kota-kota sèra, lula na ngee nèdhi lii pajaji na dènge abraham.

source_text: and lot went up out of zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lot madha'u pea taruu ètu rae soar. nèti èèna ka, nèngu dènge ana bhèni na dhèu dua sèra, lasi asa ledhe ka ra pea ètu d'ara loe cue.

source_text: and the first-born said unto the younger, our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
target_text: ca lod'o, ana bhèni uru èèna, peka dènge ari na, aku nèngu na, ètu era ne'e ne, abhu boe dhèu mone ca dhèu sa, dhu bisa leo dènge èdhi se. aa ama èdhi asa heka, de ladhe èèna na, na bisa heka abhu ana.

source_text: come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
target_text: de be'a risi, ti hia ne ninu mahu, sèna ka èdhi dua ti j'unu dènge ne, ho ti abhu kolo hia ama èdhi.

source_text: and they made their father drink wine that night: and the first-born went in, and lay with her father; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
target_text: ka ropa d'ai mèda, dua ra hia ama ra ninu èi anggor toke mahu. hèia ana bhèni uru èèna, la'e j'unu dènge ama na. lula ama na dhu mahu ae, ka ne'a boe nèngu dhu j'unu dènge ana na.

source_text: and it came to pass on the morrow, that the first-born said unto the younger, behold, i lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
target_text: hèia asa bèli èèna, a'a na peka dènge ari na, aku nèngu na, mèda deo na, ja'a j'unu le dènge ama èdhi. de mèda ne'e, èu kèna. èdhi hia ne hari ninu mahu, ho lamu j'unu dènge ne. sèna ka èdhi dua ti abhu ana, ho hia ana-èpu mi ama èdhi.

source_text: and they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
target_text: ka d'ara mèda na, dua ra hia hari ama ra ninu mahu. ka ana bhèni limuri ne, la'e ka j'unu dènge ama na. te ngaa, lula ama ra dhu mahu titu kèna, nèti èèna ka, ne'a boe ngaa dhu nèngu tao mi dedha ana bhèni na.

source_text: thus were both the daughters of lot with child by their father.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ne ka, dua ra dènge babia nèti ama d'èlu rèngu.

source_text: and the first-born bare a son, and called his name moab: the same is the father of the moabites unto this day.
target_text: hèia ana bhèni uru èèna nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na pangare na moab dhu sasoa na ‘mai nèti ama'. ana ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu moab.

source_text: and the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name ben-ammi: the same is the father of the children of ammon unto this day.
target_text: ka ana bhèni limuri ne, nara iisi ana mone èci kahèi. na pangare na ben ami dhu sasoa na ‘mai nèti dhèu ja'a'. ana ne ka dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu amon.

source_text: and abraham journeyed from thence toward the land of the south, and dwelt between kadesh and shur; and he sojourned in gerar.
target_text: èle èèna, ka abraham nèti mamre, pidha asa rai negeb, dhu ètu re balèu, ka na pea ètu talora rae kades, dènge rae syur. te ngaa na pea nèbhu boe, ka pidha hari asa rae gerar.

source_text: and abraham said of sarah his wife, she is my sister: and abimelech king of gerar sent, and took sarah.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, sara ne, ana hèni ja'a. nèti èèna ka, abimelek dhèu aae gerar, pua dhèu lasi lii d'ai sara. ka nèti ne mai asa d'ara èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: but god came to abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, behold, thou art but a dead man, because of the woman whom thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.
target_text: d'ara ca mèda sa, ama lamatua pad'elo iisi na dènge dhèu aae ètu d'ara nii. na peka, mamadhe èu ne dètu kèna! lula èu more dhèu èmu dhèu.

source_text: now abimelech had not come near her: and he said, lord, wilt thou slay even a righteous nation? said he not himself unto me, she is my sister? and she, even she herself said, he is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and the innocency of my hands have i done this.
target_text: hèia abimelek dhaa, peka na, lamatua! ja'a dhae pa'èci mèka dènge bhèni na. aa ja'a sasala aad'o. abraham unu na ka dhu peka, bhèni na, ana hèni nèngu! aa bhèni na dhaa sèmi èèna kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a hia dhèu lasi lii d'ai ne, dènge d'ara mola. de lamatua baku pad'ui ja'a sasala!

source_text: and god said unto him in the dream, yea, i know that in the integrity of thy heart thou hast done this, and i also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered i thee not to touch her.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, tare'a. mema ja'a ke'a d'ara èu mola. nèti èèna ka, ja'a ka dhu taha èu, ho baku pa'èci dènge ne. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, èu tao boe sala mi ja'a hèi.

source_text: now therefore restore the man's wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
target_text: de èu mèti hari ka bhèni ne, lèpa sa dhèu èmu na. mone na ka dhu nèti lii padhue-padhai ja'a. de lamu manèngi ne, sèna ka na sabaj'a hia èu, ho èu baku madhe. sanèd'e paie! ladhe èu hia boe bhèni na lèpa, èu dènge kabarai èu madhe aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: and abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae èèna, dhèu aae pakaboko nare dhèu-dhèu kapai na aa'i-aa'i, ka na lolo lii nii na. hèia aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u.

source_text: then abimelech called abraham, and said unto him, what hast thou done unto us? and wherein have i sinned against thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
target_text: ka dhèu aae paroa abraham. na karèi, aku nèngu na, ja'a tao sala ngaa mi èu, ka èu neo paj'èra ja'a dènge kabarai ja'a? èu ne ele-ho'a ka dènge tao madha j'ara sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: and abimelech said unto abraham, what sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
target_text: ngangee èu tasamia ka, mu tao sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: and abraham said, because i thought, surely the fear of god is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
target_text: ka abraham dhaa, peka na, ama dhèu aae! ja'a pangee na, miu aa'i-aa'i mi, kabarai ne dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. de ele boe cahag'e neo pamadhe ja'a, sèna ka parame rare dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: and moreover she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife:
target_text: mema ja'a dhu peka tare'a, nèngu ne, ana hèni ja'a. lula ji'i dua mi ca ama, te ngaa ina baka-leo. nèti èèna ka, ji'i dua mi paleo.

source_text: and it came to pass, when god caused me to wander from my father's house, that i said unto her, this is thy kindness which thou shalt show unto me: at every place whither we shall come, say of me, he is my brother.
target_text: ka ropa ama lamatua pua ji'i ho tèke eele era paleo-palu'u ji'i, lod'o èèna ja'a peka dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, aku ja'a na, ‘ladhe èdhi lati asa era leo, ho dhèu karèi èu, dhu èdhi se dhèu èmu-kamali, ladhe èu dhu sue ja'a, na dhaa la, peka na èdhi se, dua ti pa'a'ari. '

source_text: and abimelech took sheep and oxen, and men-servants and women-servants, and gave them unto abraham, and restored him sarah his wife. and abimelech said, behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee. and unto sarah he said, behold, i have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, it is for thee a covering of the eyes to all that are with thee; and in respect of all thou art righted.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae abimelek pangèd'u hari sara la'e asa abraham. ka na peka dènge sara, èèna na, ja'a hia ana mone mu doi iia ca riho, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha ja'a tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa mi èu. ho hud'i sène, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a! hèia dhèu aae peka dènge abraham, aku nèngu na, kabarai ja'a ne, dhu bhoke tèke hia èu. èu neo pea mi era mia èèna ka, ja'a hia èu. ka abimelek hia abraham sapi, kahib'i-ka'ia, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho. na hia kahèi ènu dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: and abraham prayed unto god: and god healed abimelech, and his wife, and his maid-servants; and they bare children. for jehovah had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of abimelech, because of sarah, abraham's wife.
target_text: uru èèna, lula abimelek nare dhèu èmu abraham, ka lamatua hutu eele era ana nèti bhèni aa'i-aa'i dhu pea ètu kabarai dhèu aae èèna. te ngaa ropa abimelek hia sara lèpa hari sa dhèu èmu na, ka abraham sabaj'a ho lamatua bhoke hari era ana nèti bhèni se. ka ra abhu hari ana.

source_text: and jehovah visited sarah as he had said, and jehovah did unto sarah as he had spoken. and sarah conceived, and bare abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which god had spoken to him. and abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom sarah bare to him, isaac. and abraham circumcised his son isaac when he was eight days old, as god had commanded him. and abraham was a hundred years old, when his son isaac was born unto him. and sarah said, god hath made me to laugh; every one that heareth will laugh with me. and she said, who would have said unto abraham, that sarah should give children suck? for i have borne him a son in his old age.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua hia sara mèngi-nale madhutu lii pajaji na. lod'o sara dènge babia, abraham dhu heka le. ropa sara nara iisi, umur abraham d'ai cangasu tèu kèna. lod'o sara d'ai hèru, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka abraham pangare ne, isak dhu sasoa na ‘na mari'. sara peka hèi, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua tao ja'a mari, lula ja'a karej'e. dhèu ae ka dhu pangee na, ja'a ètu d'ara heka sèmi ne'e ne, abhu heka ana. masi ka dhèu èmu ja'a heka bhoro le, te ja'a bisa kora iisi ana hia ne. èèna na, ladhe dhèu tadèngi j'ara ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra mari kahèi dènge ja'a ne. ropa isak d'ai aru lod'o, abraham suna ne, madhutu paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: and the child grew, and was weaned: and abraham made a great feast on the day that isaac was weaned.
target_text: isak kapai ka noo-noo. ropa oe d'ai lod'o luri susu, abraham tao tatao aae.

source_text: and sarah saw the son of hagar the egyptian, whom she had borne unto abraham, mocking. wherefore she said unto abraham, cast out this handmaid and her son: for the son of this handmaid shall not be heir with my son, even with isaac.
target_text: ca tèke, sara ladhe nèdhi ismael, ana nèti dhèu èmu limuri abraham, padadisi dènge isak. ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, sara peka dènge dhèu èmu na, bège eele ènu masir nèi dènge ana na! te, ja'a ko'o boe ana ènu èèna unu pusaka, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka. dhoka ana ja'a isak di, dhu abhu sèra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and the thing was very grievous in abraham's sight on account of his son.
target_text: ropa abraham tadèngi lii padhai sara ne, ka d'ara na ako be'a boe, lula ismael ne, ana d'èlu na kahèi.

source_text: and god said unto abraham, let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy handmaid; in all that sarah saith unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in isaac shall thy seed be called.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua lii dènge abraham, peka na, abraham! èu baku ngee pa'ae dhèu èmu limuri èu, dènge ana na. madhutu la dad'èi sara ne, lula bèli-camèd'a, èu abhu ana-èpu dhu ja'a moa tèke èèna, nèti isak ne'e ka.

source_text: and also of the son of the handmaid will i make a nation, because he is thy seed.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a hia kahèi mèngi-nale mi ana nèti dhèu èmu limuri mu, lula nèngu ne, ana d'èlu èu kahèi. bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu na j'aj'i suku èci kahèi.

source_text: and abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a bottle of water, and gave it unto hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and gave her the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of beer-sheba.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae èèna, abraham tao gee j'ara hia hagar, aa na kadhoe èi d'ara babo'i cue mi kabela-kao na. hèia na patabuli ka bhèni ne dènge ana na ismael, ho lasi. ka ra kako palème d'ara mamoo dhu dètu dènge beer-syeba.

source_text: and the water in the bottle was spent, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
target_text: ropa èle èi rinu ra, hagar tèke eele ana na ètu d'ara mamaho aj'u iiki ca kapua.

source_text: and she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, let me not look upon the death of the child. and she sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.
target_text: ka na pangee ètu d'ara na, d'ara ja'a la'e boe, ladhe ja'a kèdhi mamadhe ana ja'a. ka na madhèdi ako kaj'èu nèti ana na, pe d'ai lèmi nguru meter sa. ka na tangi dènge lii roma iisi.

source_text: and god heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of god called to hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, what aileth thee, hagar? fear not; for god hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
target_text: lula ama lamatua dhu tadèngi lii tangi ismael, ka ana pajuu na mai nèti sorga, ka paroa hagar, aku nèngu na, hagar! nga tao ka, èu j'èra ae sèmi ne'e ne? baku madha'u ia ka, te lamatua tadèngi le lii tangi ana èu.

source_text: arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thy hand; for i will make him a great nation.
target_text: de kèd'i lamu more ana nèi. pa'èra d'ara na, te bèli-camèd'a ja'a paj'aj'i ana-èpu na, suku èci dhu kapai.

source_text: and god opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
target_text: ka ama lamatua pasaraa musi madha na. cag'ag'a laa nèdhi dènge, èi ca madha ètu era èèna. hèia la'e soli èi asa d'ara babo'i, ka na panginu ana na ismael.

source_text: and god was with the lad, and he grew; and he dwelt in the wilderness, and became, as he grew up, an archer. and he dwelt in the wilderness of paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of egypt.
target_text: ka ismael dènge ina na hagar pea dènge ka ètu d'ara mamoo paran. ismael asa na kapai, aa ne'a mèu kataki. ka ina na paleo ne dènge ana bhèni masir ca dhèu. se'e se j'aj'i, lula ama lamatua bera-bera dènge ismael.

source_text: and it came to pass at that time, that abimelech and phicol the captain of his host spake unto abraham, saying, god is with thee in all that thou doest:
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae abimelek dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na, fikol, mai pangad'o dènge abraham. hèia dhèu aae padhai lii, ka na peka, abraham! ji'i se nge'a ama lamatua bera-bera dènge èu. nèti èèna ka, sad'i èu ad'u ngaa sa èci, j'aj'i dènge be'a.

source_text: now therefore swear unto me here by god that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that i have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, sèna ka èu subha ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, dhu peka na, èu bisa boe kapod'e-kabèli ja'a, dènge ana-èpu ja'a aa'i-aa'i ra. sèmi dhu ja'a tao le be'a mi èu, na, èu hud'i tao be'a kahèi mi ja'a dènge kabarai ja'a.

source_text: and abraham said, i will swear.
target_text: ka aku abraham na, ooo! ja'a subha.

source_text: and abraham reproved abimelech because of the well of water, which abimelech's servants had violently taken away.
target_text: te ngaa èle èèna ka, abraham lapor dènge dhèu aae, aku nèngu na, dhèu-dhèu ama dhèu aae parame rare èi ja'a ca madha.

source_text: and abimelech said, i know not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard i of it, but to-day.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia na peka, waa! ja'a heka tadèngi kèna j'ara ne'e ne. tasamia ka karèi nèti ca hari ni, èu peka boe dènge ja'a? ja'a dhae ke'a mèka, ne'e ne tatao cee ka ne.

source_text: and abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto abimelech; and they two made a covenant. and abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abraham dènge abimelek pa'èki lii pajaji. ka abraham hia abimelek sapi dènge kahib'i-kalèbho. èle èèna ka, abraham hag'e nare hari kahib'i-kalèbho èni pidhu ngi'u.

source_text: and abimelech said unto abraham, what mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
target_text: hèia dhèu aae karèi ne, peka na, nga tao ka èu tao sèmi èèna?

source_text: and he said, these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that it may be a witness unto me, that i have digged this well.
target_text: ka abraham peka, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae. sèmi la kalèbho èni pidhu ngi'u se, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha dhu ama peka le na, ja'a ka dhu kèi èi na.

source_text: wherefore he called that place beer-sheba; because there they sware both of them.
target_text: lula dua ra dhu pa'èki le soo-subha ètu èèna, ka era na ra pangare na beer-syeba dhu sasoa na, ‘madha èi soo-subha'.

source_text: so they made a covenant at beer-sheba: and abimelech rose up, and phicol the captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the philistines.
target_text: ropa pasubha èle, ka dhèu aae dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na lèpa ka, asa era rèngu, rai dhèu pilistin.

source_text: and abraham planted a tamarisk tree in beer-sheba, and called there on the name of jehovah, the everlasting god.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abraham sèle aj'u tamareska ca kapua ètu beer syeba. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, aj'u ne pasanèd'e abraham, lula ètu era èèna ka, nèngu mangaj'i lamatua dhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and abraham sojourned in the land of the philistines many days.
target_text: ka abraham pea dènge ka ètu talora dhèu pilistin sèmi dhèu tao mai.

source_text: and it came to pass after these things, that god did prove abraham, and said unto him, abraham; and he said, here am i.
target_text: nèbhu boe, hèia lamatua sèku neo ne'a d'ara abraham. neo ne'a abraham madhutu lamatua, do aad'o. ka lamatua paroa ne, aku nèngu na, abraham! hèia na dhaa, peka na, ooo, lamatua.

source_text: and he said, take now thy son, thine only son, whom thou lovest, even isaac, and get thee into the land of moriah; and offer him there for a burnt-offering upon one of the mountains which i will tell thee of.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, mu nanene paie-iie! more ana pasue èu mone mesa na. mèti ne asa rai moria, ho tao ne j'aj'i korban tunu hia ja'a. pe d'ai nèi, ja'a heka paj'uj'u era dhu ètu ledhe èci.

source_text: and abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and isaac his son; and he clave the wood for the burnt-offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which god had told him.
target_text: d'ai bèli mad'ae aae na, abraham sèg'i aj'u sèna ka tao kadhèna. na èki, ka na hue asa dedha keled'ei. ka dua ra dènge isak, aa dènge dhèu sab'a na dhèu dua, pakèd'i asa era dhu lamatua peka dènge ne.

source_text: on the third day abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
target_text: ra kako taruu, ka d'ai camèd'a èèna, abraham nèdhi le era èèna nèti kaj'èu.

source_text: and abraham said unto his young men, abide ye here with the ass, and i and the lad will go yonder; and we will worship, and come again to you.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge dhèu dua sèra, aku nèngu na, dua mi mate taha mi ne'e dènge keled'ei ne. ja'a dènge ana ja'a la'a asa dedha nèi, ho mangaj'i ama lamatua. ladhe èle na, ji'i lèpa hari mai.

source_text: and abraham took the wood of the burnt-offering, and laid it upon isaac his son; and he took in his hand the fire and the knife; and they went both of them together.
target_text: ka abraham nare kadhèna dhu neo tunu korban, ka na tao mi kabela-kao isak. aa nèngu nèd'u tud'i, dènge suu ai. ropa dua ra palere lasi,

source_text: and isaac spake unto abraham his father, and said, my father: and he said, here am i, my son. and he said, behold, the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt-offering?
target_text: hèia isak paroa ama na, aku nèngu na, ama! ka abraham dhaa, aku nèngu na, nga tao, ana? hèia isak karèi, aku nèngu na, èdhi neo lati tunu korban. de ai dènge kadhèna ka se'e le. te ngaa ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu èdhi pake j'aj'i korban, ka mia?

source_text: and abraham said, god will provide himself the lamb for a burnt-offering, my son: so they went both of them together.
target_text: te ngaa, aku abraham na, pe ama lamatua unu na ka dhu hia ana kalèbho, sèna ka j'aj'i mi korban. ka dua ra ca'e lasi taruu.

source_text: and they came to the place which god had told him of; and abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, upon the wood.
target_text: ropa dua ra d'ai era dhu lamatua peka èèna, ka abraham pudhi hadhu ho tao mei korban. hèia na paloko kadhèna ètu dedha mei korban ne. ka kèpe ana na isak, èki patarenga ne ètu dedha kadhèna.

source_text: and abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
target_text: ka nare tud'i, ho neo kèj'i pamadhe ana na.

source_text: and the angel of jehovah called unto him out of heaven, and said, abraham, abraham: and he said, here am i.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu lamatua lii nèti dedha-liru, peka na, abraham! mata ku! ka abraham dhaa, aku nèngu na, nga tao, lamatua?

source_text: and he said, lay not thy hand upon the lad, neither do thou anything unto him; for now i know that thou fearest god, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son, from me.
target_text: ka na peka hari, na, baku pamadhe ana èèna! baku tao ngaa-ngaa mi nèngu. ja'a ke'a le, èu ne tare'a-re'a madhutu dad'èi lamatua. lula èu dènge d'ara kateme hia ana èu ca dhèu mesa èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi korban hia ne.

source_text: and abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, behind him a ram caught in the thicket by his horns: and abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son.
target_text: hèia abraham ladhe nèdhi kahib'i-kalèbho mone ci'u, dhu tadhu na pakai nare dadana aaj'u dhu karoki. ka na la'e kèpe nare, ho tunu j'aj'i mi korban hia ama lamatua, gati ana na.

source_text: and abraham called the name of that place jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, in the mount of jehovah it shall be provided.
target_text: ka abraham pangare era èèna, na, ‘lamatua sadia tèke ngaa dhu parluu. ' nèti èèna ka, d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu peka na, ètu ledhe lamatua èèna, na sadia tèke ngaa dhu parluu.

source_text: and the angel of jehovah called unto abraham a second time out of heaven,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu lamatua lii hari nèti dedha-liru, peka na,

source_text: and said, by myself have i sworn, saith jehovah, because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son,
target_text: lamatua unu na, peka, ‘ja'a subha dènge kolongara ja'a mesa ku, sèmi ne'e: èu sadia le hia ja'a ana mu ca dhèu mone mesa na ho j'aj'i mi korban. nèti èèna ka,

source_text: that in blessing i will bless thee, and in multiplying i will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heavens, and as the sand which is upon the sea-shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, ja'a pala-bagi èu dènge ana-èpu èu mèngi-nale ae-ae. èèna na, ra bèba-kacanga, toke dhèu ige rare boe, sèmi hua-hètu ètu dedha-liru, aa salae ètu sebhe dhasi. ana-èpu èu sèra, èèna na, segi aa'i musu rèngu sèra.

source_text: and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
target_text: nèti ana-èpu èu, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu mèngi-nale lula èu madhutu le lii paredha ja'a. '

source_text: so abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to beer-sheba; and abraham dwelt at beer-sheba.
target_text: èle hèia, abraham dènge isak, lèpa hari asa era dhu dhèu sab'a na sèra. ka lasi palere asa beer-syeba. d'ai nèi, abraham si pea dènge ka.

source_text: and it came to pass after these things, that it was told abraham, saying, behold, milcah, she also hath borne children unto thy brother nahor:
target_text: ca lod'o, abraham tadèngi na, dhèu èmu ari na nahor, dhu ngara na milka, nara iisi ana na.

source_text: uz his first-born, and buz his brother, and kemuel the father of aram,
target_text: ana uru, ngara na us. ari na, bus. èle ka, nara iisi hari kemuel dhu j'aj'i ama aram.

source_text: and chesed, and hazo, and pildash, and jidlaph, and bethuel.
target_text: ka na abhu hari kesed, haso, pildas, yidlaf, dènge betuel.

source_text: and bethuel begat rebekah: these eight did milcah bear to nahor, abraham's brother.
target_text: betuel èèna, ama nèti ribka.

source_text: and his concubine, whose name was reumah, she also bare tebah, and gaham, and tahash, and maacah.
target_text: nahor abhu ana kahèi nèti bhèni piara na, ngara na reuma. ana reuma, nuka: teba, gaham, tahas, dènge maaka.

source_text: and the life of sarah was a hundred and seven and twenty years: these were the years of the life of sarah. and sarah died in kiriath-arba the same is hebron, in the land of canaan: and abraham came to mourn for sarah, and to weep for her.
target_text: lod'o sara madhe, umur na ca ngasu dua nguru pidhu tèu le. lod'o na madhe èèna, abraham si pea ètu rae kiryat-arba nuka hebron, ètu rai kana'an. ka abraham beke aa tangi dhèu èmu na dènge d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: and abraham rose up from before his dead, and spake unto the children of heth, saying,
target_text: hèia abraham kèd'i la'e paraga dènge dhèu-dhèu het. ka na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na,

source_text: i am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that i may bury my dead out of my sight.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu tao mai ètu talora miu se. ja'a dhu dènge boe rai ca kasib'i sa, sèna ka padhane dhèu èmu ja'a. de ladhe miu sue ja'a, ja'a hèli kore rai miu d'ai ca kasib'i sa, ho tao era padhane ne.

source_text: and the children of heth answered abraham, saying unto him,
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na,

source_text: hear us, my lord; thou art a prince of god among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
target_text: sèmi ne'e, ama! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ji'i se tadhe le ama, dhu sama sèmi ca dhèu, dhèu heka dhu ji'i pakab'ua. de sad'i ama d'èi rai mia dhu be'a, dhu pamèci dènge dad'èi ama. ji'i se dhoka ngo'o di; dhèu èci sa dhu magee boe.

source_text: and abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of heth.
target_text: hèia abraham pacud'u iisi ho hia hormat mi lamatua rai, dhèu het sèra.

source_text: and he communed with them, saying, if it be your mind that i should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to ephron the son of zohar,
target_text: ka na padhai lii, peka na, ladhe miu sèmi lii ja'a na, ja'a manèngi ho peka dènge ana mone sohar, dhu ngara na efron.

source_text: that he may give me the cave of machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for the full price let him give it to me in the midst of you for a possession of a burying-place.
target_text: peka dènge ne, ladhe na d'èi, na pahia dènge ja'a loe na, makpela, dhu ètu karasa oka na. na manèngi ca ngaa èèna ka, ja'a tihe. ja'a neo tihe pama'ète kab'ua na, ètu madha miu aa'i-aa'i mi, sèna ka rai èèna j'aj'i unu ja'a. ja'a neo tao era èèna, j'aj'i mi ro'a dhèu madhe ji'i.

source_text: now ephron was sitting in the midst of the children of heth: and ephron the hittite answered abraham in the audience of the children of heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
target_text: lod'o èèna, efron madhèdi ètu era èèna kahèi, dènge dhèu-dhèu het sèra. ka na tadèngi kahèi lii padhai lii abraham deo na. hèia na kèd'i titu, ka na b'ala abraham ètu madha dhèu heka aa'i-aa'i ra ètu sèra, aku nèngu na,

source_text: nay, my lord, hear me: the field give i thee, and the cave that is therein, i give it thee; in the presence of the children of my people give i it thee: bury thy dead.
target_text: baku sèmi èèna, ama! sèmi ne'e ka laa! oka dènge loe makpela èèna, ja'a hia iia ama. sèna ka mu padhane dhèu èmu èu mi èèna. ja'a pangèd'u rai èèna mi ama, ètu madha dhèu-dhèu ja'a se. sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i sakasii!

source_text: and abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.
target_text: ka abraham pacud'u kètu hari mi dhèu het se.

source_text: and he spake unto ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, but if thou wilt, i pray thee, hear me: i will give the price of the field; take it of me, and i will bury my dead there.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge efron, aku nèngu na, sèmi èèna oo, be'a kahèi. te ngaa miu nanene lii ja'a, la ma. ja'a neo hèli pama'ète rai na, sèna ka j'aj'i era padhane dhèu-dhèu ja'a.

source_text: and ephron answered abraham, saying unto him, my lord, hearken unto me: a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver, what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.
target_text: hèia, aku efron na, rai èèna, kab'ua na, dhoka èpa ngasu doi pudhi di. guna ngaa èdhi dua ti padhue kab'ua rai ciki oo'e èèna, dhu sasoa na aad'o. de lamu ka, ho mèti dhèu madhe na, sèna ka padhane ne ètu nèi.

source_text: and abraham hearkened unto ephron; and abraham weighed to ephron the silver which he had named in the audience of the children of heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
target_text: ka abraham d'èi kahèi dènge kab'ua na sange èèna, madhutu sèmi lii efron. hèia ètu madha dhèu ae-ae sèra, na ige nare doi pudhi èpa ngasu, tihe kab'ua rai èèna mi efron.

source_text: so the field of ephron, which was in machpelah, which was before mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the border thereof round about, were made sure unto abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city. and after this, abraham buried sarah his wife in the cave of the field of machpelah before mamre the same is hebron, in the land of canaan.
target_text: de dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, abraham abhu dènge rai ne nèti efron, j'aj'i mi unu na. rai na nuka ètu makpela, padètu dènge mamre nuka hebron. na hèli pama'ète rai ne dènge oka na, dènge loe na, aa dènge aj'u aa'i-aa'i ra. dhèu-dhèu heka nèti suku het, aa'i-aa'i ra ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii, peka na, rai èèna dènge isi aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i le unu abraham. èle èèna ka, abraham la'e padhane sara ètu d'ara loe èèna, ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: and the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto abraham for a possession of a burying-place by the children of heth.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhu uru èèna oka dènge loe na unu dhèu het, limuri ne j'aj'i le rai unu abraham. ka na tao j'aj'i mi era udhu rui ra.

source_text: and abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and jehovah had blessed abraham in all things.
target_text: tèu-tèu mamuri abraham madhera titu kèna. lamatua ladhe-leru ne dènge be'a, aa hia ne mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: and abraham said unto his servant, the elder of his house, that ruled over all that he had, put, i pray thee, thy hand under my thigh: and i will make thee swear by jehovah, the god of heaven and the god of the earth, that thou wilt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the canaanites, among whom i dwell:
target_text: abraham dhu dènge dhèu èci dhu na lèka ho ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau na. ca lod'o, abraham paroa nare, ka peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, mu pasa dhilu èu paie-iie! ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu subha madhe dènge kolongara lamatua. nèngu ka, ama lamatua dhu tao dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne. dhu peka na, èu bisa boe more ana bhèni nèti dhèu kana'an, ho paleo dènge ana ja'a isak.

source_text: but thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son isaac.
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i lamu ku asa rai èta-èsu ja'a, asa a'ari ja'a. ho tenge ètu rèngu sèi, ana bhèni ca dhèu, ho mu paleo dènge ana ja'a ne.

source_text: and the servant said unto him, peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must i needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne karèi abraham, aku nèngu na, be'a, ama! te ngaa, sèmi ana bhèni na d'èi boe mai asa ne'e, na tasamia? ladhe sèmi èèna, hud'i ja'a kèti ana ama ku, ho hia ne leo-èmu ètu nèi, do tasamia?

source_text: and abraham said unto him, beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
target_text: hèia, aku abraham na, èu nanene paie! masi ka tasamia èèna ka, mage èu mèti ana ja'a ne, asa nèi kahèi!

source_text: jehovah, the god of heaven, who took me from my father's house, and from the land of my nativity, and who spake unto me, and who sware unto me, saying, unto thy seed will i give this land; he will send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife for my son from thence.
target_text: mu sanèd'e, te lamatua dhu nèd'u koasa ètu dedha-liru, ka dhu lere ja'a nèti rai èta-èsu ja'a, asa dedha-rai ne'e ne. aa dhu na pa'èki le lii pajaji dènge ja'a, dhu peka na, ‘èèna na, ja'a hia rai ne aa'i-aa'i mi ana-èpu èu. ' de èu baku madha'u. sad'i lamu. te èèna na, lamatua pua ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai bhoke j'ara hia èu, sèna ka èu paraga dènge ana bhèni, dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu ana ja'a.

source_text: and if the woman be not willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath; only thou shalt not bring my son thither again.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ana bhèni na d'èi boe mai asa ne'e, lii soo-subha ne lèke boe èu. masi ka tasamia na, èu bisa boe mèti ana ja'a asa nèi.

source_text: and the servant put his hand under the thigh of abraham his master, and sware to him concerning this matter.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne, ded'e subha dènge abraham, ka na peka, èèna na, nèngu tao madhutu dad'èi abraham aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and the servant took ten camels, of the camels of his master, and departed, having all goodly things of his master's in his hand: and he arose, and went to mesopotamia, unto the city of nahor.
target_text: ka dhèu èèna pili nare badha onta canguru ngi'u. hèia na hua rupa-rupa mèdha dhu kab'ua asa dedha onta se. hèia la'e ka asa kota nahor, ètu rai mesopotamia.

source_text: and he made the camels to kneel down without the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu ka mone ne d'ai kota èèna. hèia na ae kabhèsu dènge onta sèra ètu sebhe kota èèna, dètu dènge madha èi èci. na ae èèna d'ara lod'o nihia le, ropa ana bhèni-ana bhèni kota èèna mai rara èi ètu madha èi èèna.

source_text: and he said, o jehovah, the god of my master abraham, send me, i pray thee, good speed this day, and show kindness unto my master abraham.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne sabaj'a, peka na, lamatua, èu ka dhu j'aj'i ama lamatua nèti lamatua ja'a, abraham. bhoke j'ara hia ja'a, sèna ka kakako ja'a ne dènge kab'ua. pad'elo sasue èu mi lamatua ja'a, aa baku bhèlu lii pajaji ne dènge ja'a. de hia la ja'a paraga dènge ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak.

source_text: behold, i am standing by the fountain of water; and the daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water:
target_text: lamatua, ja'a ka titu ètu karasa madha èi ne. aa ana bhèni-ana bhèni nèti kota ne, mai rara èi ètu ne'e.

source_text: and let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom i shall say, let down thy pitcher, i pray thee, that i may drink; and she shall say, drink, and i will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant isaac; and thereby shall i know that thou hast showed kindness unto my master.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a padhai lii dènge ana bhèni èci, peka na, ‘ana, ee! papuru ku èru èi èu hia ja'a kinu. ' ho ladhe na dhaa, peka na, ‘ama, minu la! aa, pe ja'a hia dènge onta ama, rinu hèi! ' j'ara ne'e ne j'aj'i tadha dhu peka na, ana bhèni ne ka dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u, j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu isak! dènge tadha sèmi ne'e, ja'a ke'a na lamatua pad'elo le babe'a mi abraham, lamatua ja'a èèna.

source_text: and it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, rebekah came out, who was born to bethuel the son of milcah, the wife of nahor, abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder. and the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the fountain, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
target_text: dhu na sabaj'a nare mèka, ana bhèni ca dhèu mai. ngara na ribka. nèngu ne, èpu nèti ari abraham, nuka nahor, dènge dhèu èmu na, milka. ama ribka, ngara na betuel. ribka ne, bhèni iia nia boe, aa pa'èci nèdhi mèka dènge mone. d'ai era èèna, puru asa d'ara èi la'e, ka na isi èru èi na. nèbhu boe, ka ca'e mai sa dedha.

source_text: and the servant ran to meet her, and said, give me to drink, i pray thee, a little water from thy pitcher.
target_text: ropa nare dedha, ka dhèu sab'a abraham èèna, la'e padètu dènge ne. hèia na manèngi, peka na, ana. hia ku ja'a kinu ciki.

source_text: and she said, drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
target_text: ka na dhaa, minu la, ama! hèia na papuru ka èru èi na, ka na hia dhèu ne ninu.

source_text: and when she had done giving him drink, she said, i will draw for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
target_text: ropa ninu èle, ka ana bhèni ne peka na, pe ja'a laku dhui hari èi, sèna ka hia onta ama se, rinu toke bècu.

source_text: and she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.
target_text: ka la'e bhori èi dhu risi, asa d'ara karab'a badha. hèia na ca'e-la'e mai pèri-pèri hari, dhui èi, ho hia onta se rinu toke bècu.

source_text: and the man looked stedfastly on her, holding his peace, to know whether jehovah had made his journey prosperous or not.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a abraham, titu ka mau-mau, na taru kira ka ana bhèni ne sab'a. ka na pangee ètu d'ara na, aku nèngu na, ele boe nèngu èèna ka ne'e, dhu lamatua paj'uj'u.

source_text: and it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,
target_text: onta se rinu toke bècu. hèia dhèu ne nare kadheli sahènga, dènge kanau ca pasa. mèdha se dhu tao nèti hualaa. ka na pasa mi sahènga dènge pasaluu mi ai kariu dènge g'ana ana bhèni ne.

source_text: and said, whose daughter art thou? tell me, i pray thee. is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu ne karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ana, ama mu, ngara na cee? ladhe mo'o, na ja'a manubha taha ètu èmu ama mu.

source_text: and she said unto him, i am the daughter of bethuel the son of milcah, whom she bare unto nahor.
target_text: hèia na dhaa, ngara ama ku, na betuel. aa ngara baki ku, nahor. dènge ngara bèi ku, milka.

source_text: she said moreover unto him, we have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
target_text: ètu èmu ji'i, era j'unu ae, de d'ai miu j'unu. aa j'u'u ae kahèi, ho hia badha miu se ra'a.

source_text: and the man bowed his head, and worshipped jehovah.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne pahaha iisi ho mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and he said, blessed be jehovah, the god of my master abraham, who hath not forsaken his lovingkindness and his truth toward my master: as for me, jehovah hath led me in the way to the house of my master's brethren.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, koa-kio kolongara lamatua! ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia ja'a, ka ja'a paraga le dènge a'ari lamatua ja'a abraham ètu kabarai ne'e. dènge j'ara ne'e, lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi lamatua ja'a, abraham, aa tao madhutu sama sèmi lii pajaji na dènge ja'a.

source_text: and the damsel ran, and told her mother's house according to these words.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana bhèni ne rai la'e asa èmu, na lolo dènge isi èmu na ngaa dhu j'aj'i le èèna.

source_text: and rebekah had a brother, and his name was laban: and laban ran out unto the man, unto the fountain. and it came to pass, when he saw the ring, and the bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of rebekah his sister, saying, thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he was standing by the camels at the fountain.
target_text: ana mone ribka, ngara na laban. ropa laban ladhe nèdhi mèdha hualaa se, aa na tadèngi lii lolo ana hèni na, ka rai asa li'u la'e. la'e soru dhèu sab'a abraham dhu titu era dènge onta ra ètu madha èi.

source_text: and he said, come in, thou blessed of jehovah; wherefore standest thou without? for i have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
target_text: hèia laban peka, aku nèngu na, ama! lamatua ka dhu lere miu mai dènge karej'e-karae d'ai ne'e. de baku titu mi li'u ne! mai lati sa èmu ji'i, te ji'i lalau ngare le kama. nganga'a hia badha se, dhu tesa.

source_text: and the man came into the house, and he ungirded the camels; and he gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men that were with him.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a abraham ne, madhutu dènge ka laban, lasi èmu betuel. ka laban si papuru mèdha-panyau nèti dedha onta se. èle èèna ka, ra panga'a onta se. rèti èi, hia dhèu sab'a dènge anga na se, ho rase haga.

source_text: and there was set food before him to eat: but he said, i will not eat, until i have told mine errand. and he said, speak on.
target_text: ropa lalau rare nganga'a-nginu ètu dedha mei, dhèu sab'a ne padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ji'i neo nga'a ne, te ngaa ja'a lole uuru ku, mamai ja'a ne. ka laban dhaa, peka na, ama, mu padhai lii ngaa, na peka ka laa.

source_text: and he said, i am abraham's servant.
target_text: hèia dhèu èèna peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu sab'a nèti baki miu abraham.

source_text: and jehovah hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks and herds, and silver and gold, and men-servants and maid-servants, and camels and asses.
target_text: lamatua hia abraham, lamatua ja'a èèna, mèngi-nale ae titu kèna, ka na kaja-su'i. lamatua pala-bagi ne doi hualaa pudhi dènge hualaa iia; ènu dhèu bhèni dènge dhèu mone, dènge badha-manu ae-ae, sèmi: sapi, onta, keled'ei, kahib'i-ka'ia, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: and sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
target_text: lod'o lamatua ja'a se, bhèni-mone d'ai heka ku, ka sara nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. nèngu ka dhu bèli-camèd'a unu aa'i pusaka ama na.

source_text: and my master made me swear, saying, thou shalt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the canaanites, in whose land i dwell:
target_text: ka abraham pua ja'a subha, peka na, ‘mage èu more ana bhèni kana'an kahèi, ho paleo dènge ana ja'a, isak.

source_text: but thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son.
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i more ana bhèni nèti a'ari ja'a unu ku, ho sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. '

source_text: and i said unto my master, peradventure the woman will not follow me.
target_text: hèia ja'a karèi ne, aku ja'a na, ‘tasamia, ladhe ana bhèni ne, no'o boe madhutu ja'a mai sa ne'e? '

source_text: and he said unto me, jehovah, before whom i walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:
target_text: ka na peka, ‘lamatua dhu ja'a madhutu dad'èi na, pe na paleha ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai bhoke j'ara hia èu, sèna ka èu abhu ana bhèni ca dhèu nèti a'ari ja'a unu ku, ho j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu ana ja'a.

source_text: then shalt thou be clear from my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give her not to thee, thou shalt be clear from my oath.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe a'ari ja'a se'e ro'o boe ana bhèni na mai asa ne'e, lii subha na lèke boe mi dedha èu ne. '

source_text: and i came this day unto the fountain, and said, o jehovah, the god of my master abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which i go:
target_text: ka deo na, ropa ja'a d'ai madha èi èèna, ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara, peka na, ‘lamatua nèti lamatua ja'a abraham. bhoke ku j'ara hia ja'a, sèna ka mamai ja'a ne dènge kab'ua. ho sèna ka ja'a abhu ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak.

source_text: behold, i am standing by the fountain of water; and let it come to pass, that the maiden that cometh forth to draw, to whom i shall say, give me, i pray thee, a little water from thy pitcher to drink;
target_text: lamatua, ja'a titu ètu sebhe madha èi ne. aa ana bhèni-ana bhèni nèti d'ara kota ne mai rara èi ètu ne'e. de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a peka dènge ana bhèni èci, aku ja'a na, ana, ee! papuru ku èru èi èu, ho ja'a kinu èi ciki.

source_text: and she shall say to me, both drink thou, and i will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom jehovah hath appointed for my master's son.
target_text: ho ladhe na dhaa na, oo. minu! aa èle na, ja'a panginu badha ama se kahèi! ladhe j'aj'i madhutu sèmi lii ja'a ne, na èèna ka dhu j'aj'i tadha, ana bhèni ne ka dhu lamatua paj'uj'u nare hia ana lamatua ja'a. '

source_text: and before i had done speaking in my heart, behold, rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the fountain, and drew: and i said unto her, let me drink, i pray thee.
target_text: ja'a dhu dhae èle mèka manèngi-mangaj'i, te ribka dhu nare le era èèna nèti dènge èru èi na. ropa na ca'e mai nèti d'ara èi, ja'a lii dènge ne, aku ja'a na, ‘ana, ee! hia ku ja'a kinu èi ciki. '

source_text: and she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, drink, and i will give thy camels drink also: so i drank, and she made the camels drink also.
target_text: ka na papuru dènge ka èru èi na, ka na peka, ‘oo. minu! aa pe ja'a panginu onta ama se kahèi. ' hèia ja'a kinu, aa onta ja'a se oo rinu kahèi.

source_text: and i asked her, and said, whose daughter art thou? and she said, the daughter of bethuel, nahor's son, whom milcah bare unto him: and i put the ring upon her nose, and the bracelets upon her hands.
target_text: ka ja'a karèi ne, ‘ama mu, ngara na cee? ' ka na dhaa, peka na, ‘ama ku, ngara na betuel. aa baki ku, ngara na nahor. dènge ngara bèi ku, milka. ' hèia ja'a papake ne kadheli mi sahènga na, dènge pasaluu kanau hualaa ca pasa mi ai kariu dènge ai g'ana na.

source_text: and i bowed my head, and worshipped jehovah, and blessed jehovah, the god of my master abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter for his son.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a pacud'u kètu ho mangaj'i mi lamatua, ka ja'a peka na, ‘koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a paraga le dènge a'ari lamatua ja'a abraham ètu era ne'e ne. aa paraga le kahèi dènge ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak! '

source_text: and now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that i may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
target_text: de ne'e ne, ladhe ama si neo pad'elo sasue mi lamatua ja'a abraham, na mi peka pamèu dènge ja'a. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, peka la mola-mola dènge ja'a. ho ja'a ke'a, sèna ka tao hari ngaa.

source_text: then laban and bethuel answered and said, the thing proceedeth from jehovah: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a ne padhai lii nare, ka laban dènge betuel dhaa, aku rèngu na, ladhe lamatua dhu ad'u nare le madha j'ara ne, ji'i peka lii ngaa hari.

source_text: behold, rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as jehovah hath spoken.
target_text: ribka ka ne'e ne. more ho mèti, sèna ka na j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu ana abraham, madhutu sèmi dhu lamatua ator èèna.
