source_text: and it came to pass, that, when abraham's servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth unto jehovah.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, dhèu sab'a ne pacud'u kètu d'ai rai, ka na manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nare mèdha nèti hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi sèra, dènge mèdha-papake dhu saraga, ka na hia mi ribka. aa na hia kahèi mi ana mone na dènge ina na, mèdha-mèdha dhu kab'ua aae.

source_text: and they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, send me away unto my master.
target_text: èle aa'i ka, heka dhèu sab'a ne dènge anga na madhèdi ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra. ka ra j'unu ètu èèna. bèli mad'ae èèna, dhèu sab'a ne palangu lii dènge lamatua èmu se, aku nèngu na, hia ka ja'a ho lèpa la asa lamatua ja'a abraham.

source_text: and her brother and her mother said, let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.
target_text: te ngaa ana mone dènge ina ana bhèni na, peka na, te neo hari lèpa lai-lai, tao ngaa ne? hud'i ribka pea hari ku dènge ji'i d'ai canguru lod'o sa laa ma, heka lami kèna.

source_text: and he said unto them, hinder me not, seeing jehovah hath prospered my way; send me away that i may go to my master.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a èèna dhaa, peka na, waa! baku kai ja'a! te lamatua sue le ja'a, ka toke ja'a rage le bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak. de patabuli ka ji'i se, la'a peka ku dènge lamatua ji'i abraham.

source_text: and they said, we will call the damsel, and inquire at her mouth.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, sèmi ne'e ka laa! mai ti karèi ribka, sèna ka te'a dad'èi na tasa mera mia?

source_text: and they called rebekah, and said unto her, wilt thou go with this man? and she said, i will go.
target_text: hèia ra paroa ne, aku rèngu na, ribka! di aku èu kèna. èu neo lamu dènge ka dènge dhèu ne'e do, tasamia? ka ribka dhaa, peka na, ja'a ko'o.

source_text: and they sent away rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and abraham's servant, and his men. and they blessed rebekah, and said unto her, our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let thy seed possess the gate of those that hate them.
target_text: hèia ra hia ribka dènge bhèni dhu leru ne karèi nèti ana iiki ka, ho lasi palere dènge dhèu sab'a abraham sèra. ka ra hia ribka mèngi-nale, aku rèngu na, ji'i sanao-maena sèna ka ama lamatua hia èu mora iisi ana ae-ae, ho ana-èpu mu d'ai riho-kehi. aa ji'i sanao kahèi, sèna ka ana-èpu èu sèra segi aa'i musu rèngu sèra!

source_text: and rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took rebekah, and went his way.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ribka dènge bhèni dhu leru nèngu na lalau ka mèdha ra, ka ra ca'e onta, pakèd'i dènge ka, madhutu dhèu sab'a abraham sèra.

source_text: and isaac came from the way of beer-lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the land of the south.
target_text: isak pea ètu rai negeb. lod'o èèna, na heka lèpa kèna nèti madha èi beer lahai roi.

source_text: and isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, there were camels coming.
target_text: d'ara lod'o nihia ca lod'o, na kalua nèti d'ara paleo na, la'e pasiar ciki. ropa na boti kètu, na ladhe laa na onta-onta kako mai asa era nèngu na.

source_text: and rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw isaac, she alighted from the camel.
target_text: ropa ribka ladhe nèdhi isak, hèia na puru lai-lai nèti dedha onta.

source_text: and she said unto the servant, what man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? and the servant said, it is my master: and she took her veil, and covered herself.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu sab'a abraham, aku nèngu na, dhèu mone cee ka mai nèi? ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu na, ana lamatua ja'a kèna. hèia ribka nare salalu na, pa'abhe rèhu na.

source_text: and the servant told isaac all the things that he had done.
target_text: ka dhèu sab'a ne lolo dènge isak, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: and isaac brought her into his mother sarah's tent, and took rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her. and isaac was comforted after his mother's death.
target_text: hèia isak todhe nèti ka ribka lasi asa d'ara paleo ina na, ka dua ra paleo ka èmu. lula isak sue seli eele ribka, ka na susa heka dènge mamadhe ina na.

source_text: and abraham took another wife, and her name was keturah.
target_text: ka abraham leo hari èmu dènge bhèni èci, ngara na ketura.

source_text: and she bare him zimran, and jokshan, and medan, and midian, and ishbak, and shuah.
target_text: hèia ketura matana ana hia ne. ana se, ngara ra: simran, yoksan, medan, midian, isbak, dènge sua.

source_text: and jokshan begat sheba, and dedan. and the sons of dedan were asshurim, and letushim, and leummim.
target_text: ana yoksan ka: seba dènge dedan. ana-èpu dedan nuka, dhèu asyur, dhèu letus, dènge dhèu leum.

source_text: and the sons of midian: ephah, and epher, and hanoch, and abida, and eldaah. all these were the children of keturah.
target_text: ana midian ka: efa, efer, henok, abida dènge eldaa. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu ketura.

source_text: and abraham gave all that he had unto isaac. but unto the sons of the concubines, that abraham had, abraham gave gifts; and he sent them away from isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
target_text: lod'o dhu abraham mamuri era, na hag'e nare le mèdha-panyau hia ana hagar dènge ana-ana ketura, èci-èci ka dènge unu na. èle èèna ka, abraham pua si lasi pea re bèka dhimu rai kana'an, sèna ka ra pakaj'èu nèti ana na isak. ka pusaka na aa'i-aa'i, na pangèd'u mi ana na isak.

source_text: and these are the days of the years of abraham's life which he lived, a hundred threescore and fifteen years. and abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
target_text: lod'o umur abraham d'ai ca ngasu pidhu nguru lèmi tèu, na madhe.

source_text: and isaac and ishmael his sons buried him in the cave of machpelah, in the field of ephron the son of zohar the hittite, which is before mamre; the field which abraham purchased of the children of heth: there was abraham buried, and sarah his wife.
target_text: ka ana na, isak dènge ismael, padhane ne ètu d'ara loe makpela, dhu padètu dènge mamre. rai ne, dhu uru èèna, abraham hèli nare nèti efron, ana sohar, dhèu het. ka dhu uru èèna, ra padhane le sara ètu d'ara loe èèna.

source_text: and it came to pass after the death of abraham, that god blessed isaac his son: and isaac dwelt by beer-lahai-roi.
target_text: èle madha abraham, ka ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi isak, ka na mamuri mera-milu. lod'o èèna, isak pea dètu dènge madha èi beer lahai roi.

source_text: now these are the generations of ishmael, abraham's son, whom hagar the egyptian, sarah's handmaid, bare unto abraham:
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo nèti mamuri ismael. nèngu ne, ana abraham dènge dhèu èmu limuri na, hagar, dhu j'aj'i ènu sara nèti masir.

source_text: and these are the names of the sons of ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the first-born of ishmael, nebaioth; and kedar, and adbeel, and mibsam, and mishma, and dumah, and massa, hadad, and tema, jetur, naphish, and kedemah: these are the sons of ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments; twelve princes according to their nations.
target_text: ana-ana ismael, mone dhèu canguru dua. ngara ra dhu madhutu nèti dhu uru tèka d'ai ana limuri tèka, nuka: nebayot, kedar, adbeel, mibsam, misma, duma, masa, hadad, tema, yetur, nafis, dènge kedma. ana-ana sèra ka, j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti canguru dua suku, dhu èci-èci ka dènge kabarai ra. ra pangare kabarai ra èci-èci, madhutu ngara bèi-baki ra.

source_text: and these are the years of the life of ishmael, a hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died, and was gathered unto his people.
target_text: ropa umur ismael d'ai cangasu tèlu nguru pidhu tèu, ka na madhe.

source_text: and they dwelt from havilah unto shur that is before egypt, as thou goest toward assyria: he abode over against all his brethren.
target_text: te ngaa ana-èpu na sèra, èci pamusu dènge èci. ka ra pea pahag'a, mulai nèti rai hawila d'ai rai syur, dhu palane dènge rai masir, toke d'ai rai asyur.

source_text: and these are the generations of isaac, abraham's son: abraham begat isaac:
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo nèti mamuri isak, ana abraham.

source_text: and isaac was forty years old when he took rebekah, the daughter of bethuel the syrian of paddan-aram, the sister of laban the syrian, to be his wife.
target_text: lod'o isak madhèdi dènge ribka, umur na èpa nguru tèu le. ama ribka, ngara na betuel. ana mone ribka, ngara na laban. rèngu se, dhèu aram, nèti padan aram.

source_text: and isaac entreated jehovah for his wife, because she was barren: and jehovah was entreated of him, and rebekah his wife conceived.
target_text: ribka dhu dènge mèka ana. nèti èèna ka, isak manèngi-mangaj'i mi lamatua, sèna ka na bhoke era ana ribka. hèia lamatua tadèngi lii manèngi isak, ka ribka dènge babia.

source_text: and the children struggled together within her; and she said, if it be so, wherefore do i live? and she went to inquire of jehovah.
target_text: te ngaa ana dhu ribka kad'o ne, dhèu dua. aa ana se paliku taruu ètu d'ara kabake ina ra. ka ribka ngee ka ètu d'ara na, nga tao ka ana dua se, sèmi ne'e? hèia na pakarèi dènge lamatua.

source_text: and jehovah said unto her, two nations are in thy womb, and two peoples shall be separated from thy bowels: and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, ètu d'ara kabake èu na, abhu dua suku, dhu èèna na loe boe dènge pamusu. dhu limuri èra risi nèti dhu uru. ka a'a na, lalau-lalo'o ari na.

source_text: and when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
target_text: ropa lod'o d'ai, ribka nara iisi ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: and the first came forth red, all over like a hairy garment; and they called his name esau.
target_text: dhu a'a, isi na mea, dènge ngi'u na pènu dènge rèu. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare ne, esau dhu sasoa na ‘dènge rèu'.

source_text: and after that came forth his brother, and his hand had hold on esau's heel; and his name was called jacob: and isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ari na heka kalua kèna. te ngaa dhu na kèpe hui tèdhu a'a na. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare ne, yakob dhu sasoa na ‘hui tèdhu'. lod'o ribka nara iisi ana na se, umur isak èna nguru tèu kèna.

source_text: and the boys grew: and esau was a skilful hunter, a man of the field; and jacob was a quiet man, dwelling in tents.
target_text: lod'o ana dua se kapai, esau dhu ne'a mèu kasiro badha hui. ae ka dhu na pea ètu d'ara j'ami. te ngaa yakob dhu mau-mau, dhu d'èi dhoka pea ètu d'ara èmu di.

source_text: now isaac loved esau, because he did eat of his venison: and rebekah loved jacob.
target_text: isak d'èi na'a sisi badha hui. nèti èèna ka, na sue risi esau. te ngaa ribka sue risi yakob.

source_text: and jacob boiled pottage: and esau came in from the field, and he was faint:
target_text: ca lod'o, yakob dhu tao bubur kab'ui, aa esau heka lèpa nèti kasiro badha hui kèna. na lèpa dènge manganga, ka roe titu kèna.

source_text: and esau said to jacob, feed me, i pray thee, with that same red pottage; for i am faint: therefore was his name called edom.
target_text: ka na peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, ari, ee! hia ku ja'a bubur kab'ui mea ciki ètu d'ara èru èèna, ho ja'a ku'a! te ja'a manganga bia. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare na, edom, dhu sasoa na ‘mea'.

source_text: and jacob said, sell me first thy birthright.
target_text: ka, aku yakob na, be'a a'a. te ngaa pasilu ku dènge hak a'a èèna!

source_text: and esau said, behold, i am about to die: and what profit shall the birthright do to me?
target_text: hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, hak a'a ne, ngaa kèna, hud'i nèngu sèna! neo more, na more la. te ja'a manganga bia. sod'e mèti bubur èèna lai-lai mai, te ja'a taha heka.

source_text: and jacob said, swear to me first; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto jacob.
target_text: te ngaa, aku yakob hari na, mata ku a'a! èu subha uuru ku, dhu peka na, èu pangèd'u le hak a'a èèna mi ja'a ne. ka esau ded'e subha sèmi dhu yakob peka.

source_text: and jacob gave esau bread and pottage of lentils; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: so esau despised his birthright.
target_text: hèia yakob sod'e dènge ka hia ne bubur kab'ui deo na dènge roti. ropa na'a-ninu nare, ka la'e dènge ka. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, esau pusi boe dènge hak a'a na.

source_text: and there was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that was in the days of abraham. and isaac went unto abimelech king of the philistines, unto gerar.
target_text: ca tèka, ètu d'ara rai èèna, lèke tèu manganga, èci èèna ka dènge tèu abraham mamuri era. ka isak la'e manèngi abimelek, dhèu aae pilistin, sèna ka na pea ètu gerar.

source_text: and jehovah appeared unto him, and said, go not down into egypt; dwell in the land which i shall tell thee of:
target_text: na tao sèmi èèna, lula lamatua dhu pad'elo le iisi na mi nèngu, peka na, mage lamu ka asa masir hèi. pea la mi era dhu èèna na ja'a paj'uj'u hia èu.

source_text: sojourn in this land, and i will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, i will give all these lands, and i will establish the oath which i sware unto abraham thy father; and i will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these lands; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;
target_text: ladhe èu manubha ètu era èèna, ja'a sama-sama dènge èu, aa pala-bagi èu mèngi-nale rupa-rupa. èèna na, ja'a pabèba ana-èpu èu sama sèmi hua-hètu ètu dedha-liru. aa ja'a hia kateme rai ne mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu. nèti ana-èpu èu ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu mèngi-nale. dènge j'ara ne'e, ja'a tao madhutu lii pajaji dhu ja'a pa'èki le dènge ama mu abraham.

source_text: because that abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi ne'e ne, lula ama mu madhutu dad'èi ja'a, paredha ja'a, dènge atora ja'a.

source_text: and isaac dwelt in gerar:
target_text: ka isak pea taha ètu gerar.

source_text: and the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, she is my sister: for he feared to say, my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.
target_text: ribka ne, bhèni iia titu kèna. ka ropa dhèu ètu gerar ladhe rèdhi ne, ra pakarèi. te ngaa isak peka na, ribka ne, ana hèni ja'a. na madha'u, ladhe na peka na dhèu èmu nèngu, dhèu se pamadhe ne, aa ribka parame rare.

source_text: and it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that abimelech king of the philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, isaac was sporting with rebekah his wife.
target_text: isak dhu pea nèbhu le ètu nèi, hèia ca lod'o, dhèu aae nèdhi nèti ro'a jendela na, ladhe laa na isak dènge ribka dhu pa'ango.

source_text: and abimelech called isaac, and said, behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, she is my sister? and isaac said unto him, because i said, lest i die because of her.
target_text: ka na pua dhèu lasi paroa isak, hèia na peka, isak! ja'a dhu ke'a le, bhèni ne dhèu èmu èu! te ngaa tasamia ka, èu peka na, nèngu ne ana hèni èu? hèia isak dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e ama! ja'a ne madha'u, ladhe ja'a peka na nèngu ne dhèu èmu ja'a, mage dhoka dhèu pamadhe ja'a.

source_text: and abimelech said, what is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might easily have lain with thy wife, and thou wouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.
target_text: ka dhèu aae dhaa, peka na, sèmi dhèu ètu se'e j'unu dènge dhèu èmu èu, tatu èu pasala ji'i! tasamia ka, èu ad'u j'ara ne'e mi dedha ji'i se?

source_text: and abimelech charged all the people, saying, he that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae abimelek pasanèd'e ana kabarai na, aku nèngu na, miu nanene paie-iie! cee ka dhu bani gagu dhèu ne'e, do dhèu èmu na, èèna na ja'a huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: and isaac sowed in that land, and found in the same year a hundredfold: and jehovah blessed him.
target_text: tèu èèna, isak sèle hini ètu dedha rai dhèu se'e. lod'o d'ai puu-g'ètu, ka na abhu isi rai cangasu hari, lula lamatua hia ne mamèngi.

source_text: and the man waxed great, and grew more and more until he became very great:
target_text: lula mèdha-panyau na asa ae, ka na kaja titu kèna.

source_text: and he had possessions of flocks, and possessions of herds, and a great household: and the philistines envied him.
target_text: badha-manu na sèmi sapi, kahib'i-kalèbho asa tabha ae. dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, ae kahèi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu pilistin tèka d'ara dènge ne.

source_text: now all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of abraham his father, the philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.
target_text: uru èèna, abraham, ama isak, dhu kèi èi ae-ae. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu pilistin dhènu eele aa'i si dènge rai.

source_text: and abimelech said unto isaac, go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.
target_text: ka dhèu aae abimelek peka dènge isak, aku nèngu na, isak! be'a risi èu pakèd'i ka nèti kabarai ne'e. lula koasa èu, risi eele le nèti ji'i se.

source_text: and isaac departed thence, and encamped in the valley of gerar, and dwelt there.
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak pakèd'i nèti era èèna, ka lasi pea hari ètu d'ara mamoo gerar.

source_text: and isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of abraham his father; for the philistines had stopped them after the death of abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, ra kèi hari madha èi dhu uru èèna, dhèu pilistin dhènu eele aa'i si. ka na pangare madha èi se madhutu ngara dhu ama na pangare.

source_text: and isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a isak se kèi èi ètu d'ara mamoo gerar, hèi lèke èi madha dhu sabhoka mai.

source_text: and the herdsmen of gerar strove with isaac's herdsmen, saying, the water is ours: and he called the name of the well esek, because they contended with him.
target_text: lula madha èi ne'e ka, dhèu-dhèu madhenge badha nèti gerar, patao dènge dhèu madhenge badha isak. dhèu se peka na, ne'e ne, madha èi ji'i! nèti èèna ka, isak pangare madha èi na esek, dhu sasoa na ‘patao-palaha'.

source_text: and they digged another well, and they strove for that also: and he called the name of it sitnah.
target_text: hèia dhèu-dhèu isak se, kèi hari èi leo ca madha. te ngaa ra patao-palaha hari, lula èi èèna. nèti èèna ka, isak pangare na sitna, dhu sasoa na ‘palab'a'.

source_text: and he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it rehoboth; and he said, for now jehovah hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak tèke eele era èèna, la'e kèi hari èi èci. d'ai ne'e ne, ra patao-palaha heka. ka isak pangare madha èi ne rehobot, dhu sasoa na ‘era taleo'. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, limuri ne, lamatua hia le èdhi pea ètu era taleo. ho ètu era ne'e ne, èdhi asa bèba-kacanga.

source_text: and he went up from thence to beer-sheba.
target_text: ka nèti era ne'e, isak si lasi hari era pea asa beer syeba.

source_text: and jehovah appeared unto him the same night, and said, i am the god of abraham thy father: fear not, for i am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant abraham's sake.
target_text: ka mèda na, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi isak, hèia na peka, isak! ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti ama mu abraham. de mage mu madha'u, te ja'a ladhe-leru èu. èèna na, ja'a pala-bagi èu mèngi-nale. aa ana-èpu èu asa bèba-kacanga. ja'a ad'u madha j'ara ne'e, lula lii pajaji ja'a dènge ama mu.

source_text: and he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of jehovah, and pitched his tent there: and there isaac's servants digged a well.
target_text: hèia isak pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban ètu èèna. ka na manèngi makasi mi lamatua. hèia, na pea ètu era èèna, ka dhèu sab'a na kèi hari èi.

source_text: then abimelech went to him from gerar, and ahuzzath his friend, and phicol the captain of his host.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae abimelek mai nèti gerar. angalai na ahusat, dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na, fikol, mai dènge ne, ho paraga dènge isak.

source_text: and isaac said unto them, wherefore are ye come unto me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
target_text: ka isak karèi, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae! uru èèna, miu se dhu babège eele ja'a nèti kabarai miu. de ne'e ne, miu se mai tao ngaa hari?

source_text: and they said, we saw plainly that jehovah was with thee: and we said, let there now be an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee,
target_text: hèia ra peka na, sèmi ne'e. ji'i dhu nge'a le, lamatua dhu j'aga pa'ère èu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i pangee, hua iia èdhi dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji dhu peka sèmi ne'e: èu j'oka subha, peka na,

source_text: that thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of jehovah.
target_text: miu se baku tao karehe dènge ji'i, aa ji'i kahèi baku tao karehe dènge miu. mema ji'i se d'ara be'a dènge miu. nèti èèna ka, ca hari ni, miu se lami dènge mera-milu nèti kabarai ji'i ne. ji'i dhu nge'a le, lamatua ka dhu pala-bagi mèngi-nale mi miu.

source_text: and he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak tao pesta, ka ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
target_text: ka asa bèli mad'ae èèna, rèngu j'oka lii soo-subha. hèia isak patalala si lèpa dènge dame.

source_text: and it came to pass the same day, that isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, we have found water.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dhèu sab'a isak mai peka lula-nèti èi dhu rèngu kèi, na, ama! ji'i rage le èi.

source_text: and he called it shibah: therefore the name of the city is beer-sheba unto this day.
target_text: hèia isak pangare madha èi ne syeba dhu sasoa na ‘subha'. ka ra pangare kota èèna beer syeba, toke sange ne'e.

source_text: and when esau was forty years old he took to wife judith the daughter of beeri the hittite, and basemath the daughter of elon the hittite:
target_text: ropa umur esau d'ai èpa nguru tèu, na leo dènge bhèni dhèu dua nèti suku het. bhèni èci, ana nèti beeri, ngara na yudit. èci hari, ana elon, ngara na basmat.

source_text: and they were a grief of mind unto isaac and to rebekah.
target_text: bhèni dhèu dua se, papèd'a d'ara isak dènge ribka.

source_text: and it came to pass, that when isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called esau his elder son, and said unto him, my son: and he said unto him, here am i.
target_text: ropa isak manahu asa d'ara heka, nèdhi heka ngaa-ngaa, lula musi madha na ahu le. ka na paroa ana uuru èèna, dhu na sue risi èèna, peka na, esau. mai ku sa ne'e! hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ama?

source_text: and he said, behold now, i am old, i know not the day of my death.
target_text: ka isak peka hari, sèmi ne'e! ja'a ne, ètu d'ara heka le. ke'a boe, pèri lod'o ja'a ne madhe.

source_text: now therefore take, i pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me venison;
target_text: de more rèka èu, lamu kataki mèti badha hui ci'u hia ja'a.

source_text: and make me savory food, such as i love, and bring it to me, that i may eat; that my soul may bless thee before i die.
target_text: mu pananasu pabe'a-be'a, madhutu dad'èi ja'a, ho mèti mai hia ja'a. ladhe ku'a-kinu kora, ja'a hia mema èu mèngi-nale. sad'i èu unu le mèngi-nale èèna, ja'a madhe èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao heka.

source_text: and rebekah heard when isaac spake to esau his son. and esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
target_text: hèia esau la'e dènge ka, kataki badha hui. te ngaa ribka dhu tadèngi kahèi lii padhai isak deo na.

source_text: and rebekah spake unto jacob her son, saying, behold, i heard thy father speak unto esau thy brother, saying,
target_text: ka ribka la'e peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, yakob! èu nanene ku! deo na, ja'a tadèngi ama mu pua esau sèmi ne'e:

source_text: bring me venison, and make me savory food, that i may eat, and bless thee before jehovah before my death.
target_text: ‘lamu kataki more ku badha hui ci'u, mai mu pananasu pabe'a-be'a hia ja'a. ladhe ku'a-kinu kora, ja'a hia èu mèngi-nale ètu katanga madha lamatua. '

source_text: now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which i command thee.
target_text: de mu nanene paie-iie! mu madhutu mola-mola lii paredha ja'a ne.

source_text: go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and i will make them savory food for thy father, such as he loveth:
target_text: de lamu ka asa era badha èdhi sèi, ho kèpe more kalèbho èni dhu kabèb'u dua ngi'u. roro ho mèti sisi mai asa ja'a. pe ja'a pananasu madhutu dad'èi ama mu.

source_text: and thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, so that he may bless thee before his death.
target_text: ladhe panasu kore, mèti hia ama mu na'a. ho èle na, na hia èu mèngi-nale, heka na madhe kèna. dènge sèmi ne'e ka, èu ka dhu abhu mèngi-nale èèna. a'a mu abhu boe.

source_text: and jacob said to rebekah his mother, behold, esau my brother is a hairy man, and i am a smooth man.
target_text: te ngaa yakob peka dènge ina na, ina! a'a ku esau, ngi'u na dhu pènu dènge rèu, te ngaa ja'a ne, isi dhu milu aadha-aadha!

source_text: my father peradventure will feel me, and i shall seem to him as a deceiver; and i shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
target_text: mage dhoka ama ku g'ag'e isi ja'a, ladhe na ne'a na ja'a dhu leko-monya na. hèia na dhoo ja'a!

source_text: and his mother said unto him, upon me be thy curse, my son; only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.
target_text: ka ina na dhaa, aku nèngu na, èu baku cag'ag'a! hud'i laa ina ka dhu ator! ladhe ama mu dhoo èu, pe ina ka pasae! mu mate ia ka, la more ka kahib'i sèra.

source_text: and he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savory food, such as his father loved.
target_text: ka yakob la'e nare kahib'i dua ngi'u sèra, hèia na roro, ka nèti hia ina na. hèia ribka pananasu madhutu dad'èi isak.

source_text: and rebekah took the goodly garments of esau her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them upon jacob her younger son;
target_text: ka ribka la'e nare mèdha-papake esau dhu be'a, ho na papake mi yakob.

source_text: and she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
target_text: hèia na pahutu kahèi kacui-aai dènge ladhe goro yakob, pake ka'uri kahib'i deo sa.

source_text: and she gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son jacob.
target_text: ka na pangèd'u yakob nganga'a dhu pananasu nare deo na, dènge roti dhu tunu nare.

source_text: and he came unto his father, and said, my father: and he said, here am i; who art thou, my son?
target_text: hèia yakob ded'e nèti nganga'a se'e, hia ama na na'a. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, ama. ja'a mai hari le. hèia isak dhaa, peka na, hee! èu ne, cee?

source_text: and jacob said unto his father, i am esau thy first-born; i have done according as thou badest me: arise, i pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
target_text: ka yakob dhaa, peka na, ja'a, esau ana mone uuru ama ku! ja'a sab'e le, madhutu sèmi dhu ama pua deo na. kèd'i, ho mu'a-minu ka. lula ja'a pananasu kore le sisi badha hui dhu ja'a kèti nèti d'ara j'ami. mu'a, ho èle na, ama pala-bagi ja'a mèngi-nale.

source_text: and isaac said unto his son, how is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? and he said, because jehovah thy god sent me good speed.
target_text: hèia isak peka, aku nèngu na, èu ne, bia tai nga! abhu malai titu kèna, badha hui èèna! hèia yakob dhaa, ja'a abhu le, lula lamatua dhu èu mangaj'i èèna, ka dhu tulu ja'a.

source_text: and isaac said unto jacob, come near, i pray thee, that i may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son esau or not.
target_text: ka isak paroa yakob, aku nèngu na, padètu ku asa ne'e mai, sèna ka ja'a g'ag'e sèku èu. èu ne, tare'a ana ja'a esau, do aad'o?

source_text: and jacob went near unto isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, the voice is jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of esau.
target_text: hèia yakob la'e padètu-dètu dènge ama na, ka ama na g'ag'e ne. ka isak peka, lii ne, sèmi lii yakob! te ngaa kacui-aai na, kacui-aai esau.

source_text: and he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother esau's hands: so he blessed him.
target_text: te ngaa isak dhu tadhe iia boe yakob, lula kacui-aai na rèu sèmi esau. ka ropa na neo hia mèngi-nale mi yakob,

source_text: and he said, art thou my very son esau? and he said, i am.
target_text: na karèi hari era, aku nèngu na, èu ne, tare'a-re'a esau, do? hèia yakob dhaa, peka na, tare'a-re'a ama. ja'a ne, esau!

source_text: and he said, bring it near to me, and i will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. and he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.
target_text: ka isak peka na, na, j'ole ka sisina mai, sèna ka ja'a ku'a. èle ku, pe ja'a hia èu mèngi-nale. hèia yakob hia sisi dènge èi anggor hia ama na na'a-ninu.

source_text: and his father isaac said unto him, come near now, and kiss me, my son.
target_text: na'a nare ka, isak lii, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! mai padètu asa ne'e, ho mu uu ku ja'a laa.

source_text: and he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, see, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which jehovah hath blessed:
target_text: ka ropa yakob padètu dènge ne, ho uu ne, isak sangèd'u nare hèu mèdha-papake esau. hèia na padhai lii hia mèngi-nale mi yakob, aku nèngu na, hèu ana ja'a tare'a-re'a sèmi hèu j'u'u ètu d'ara pad'a, dhu abhu mamèngi nèti lamatua.

source_text: and god give thee of the dew of heaven, and of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine:
target_text: hud'i laa ama lamatua patiri èi paringi nèti dedha-liru, sèna ka oka-tedhe èu j'aj'i mi rai hèu mèngi. hud'i laa na hia èu are dhu udhu sobhu-sobhu, dènge hua anggor dhu pènu ako-pènu èru.

source_text: let peoples serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be every one that blesseth thee.
target_text: suku-suku j'aj'i mi ènu èu, aa dhèu-dhèu leo pahaha iisi mi dedha èu. èu j'aj'i mi lamatua nèti a'ari èu. aa rèngu patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha èu. dhèu cee dhu dhoo èu, rèngu abhu dhoo kahèi. aa dhèu cee dhu hia mèngi-nale mi èu, rèngu abhu mèngi-nale kahèi.

source_text: and it came to pass, as soon as isaac had made an end of blessing jacob, and jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of isaac his father, that esau his brother came in from his hunting.
target_text: ropa isak hia nare mèngi-nale mi yakob, ka heka bhodho li'u la'e tèke eele ama na, cag'ag'a laa esau lèpa nèti kataki badha hui.

source_text: and he also made savory food, and brought it unto his father; and he said unto his father, let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.
target_text: hèia la'e pananasu, ka sod'e nèti hia ama na. ka na parèi ama na, aku nèngu na, ama, kèd'i mu'a. ja'a lalau kore le sisi badha dhu ja'a kataki kore. mu'a more ku, pe hia ja'a berkat.

source_text: and isaac his father said unto him, who art thou? and he said, i am thy son, thy first-born, esau.
target_text: te ngaa isak malaa, ka na karèi, hee! te èu ne, cee hari ne? hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne'e, esau! ana uuru ama ku.

source_text: and isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, who then is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and i have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.
target_text: ka isak cag'ag'a, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, deo na cee ka dhu hia ja'a sisi, ka ja'a ku'a èèna? ka ja'a hia ne mèngi-nale. aa mèngi-nale èèna, bisa heka ère hari.

source_text: when esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceeding great and bitter cry, and said unto his father, bless me, even me also, o my father.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, esau roe ai ca palèpa, ka na tangi d'ara pèd'a dènge roma iisi, aku nèngu na, tasamia ne, ama, ee! bagi hia ja'a berkat hèi ma.

source_text: and he said, thy brother came with guile, and hath taken away thy blessing.
target_text: hèia isak peka, ari mu ka monya ja'a, ka parame nare berkat dhu pala èu di.

source_text: and he said, is not he rightly named jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. and he said, hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?
target_text: ka aku esau na, nèngu na leko-monya ja'a dua hari kèna. uru èèna, parame nare hak a'a. ka ne'e ne, parame nare hari berkat dhu madhutu iia-iia na unu ja'a. nèka na, ngara na ‘yakob' te ngaa ele boe ama dhu dènge berkat era, ho hia ja'a. do, aad'o heka? yakob sasoa na ‘kèpe hui tèdhu', te ngaa sasoa dhu leo ‘tuka leko-monya'.

source_text: and isaac answered and said unto esau, behold, i have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have i given to him for servants; and with grain and new wine have i sustained him: and what then shall i do for thee, my son?
target_text: hèia isak dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu ded'e le nèngu, j'aj'i lamatua èu. aa a'ari na aa'i-aa'i ra, j'aj'i mi ènu na. ja'a hia na le, unu are pènu soka-pènu karo, dènge hua anggor pènu ako-pènu èru. de ana, ee! mamèngi tasamia hari, dhu ja'a ne pala-bagi mi èu?

source_text: and esau said unto his father, hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, o my father. and esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
target_text: masi ka tadèngi nare le sèmi èèna, te ngaa esau loe boe dènge pamako ama na, peka na, mamèngi na dhodhoka èci di, do? tatu ama dènge hari mamèngi dhu leo hia ja'a. masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka, sad'i ja'a ne abhu! ka esau tangi hari dènge d'ara laho mae-mae.

source_text: and isaac his father answered and said unto him, behold, of the fatness of the earth shall be thy dwelling, and of the dew of heaven from above;
target_text: ka isak b'ala ne, peka na, mamuri èu ne, èèna na kaj'èu nèti oka-tedhe dhu hèu mèngi, lula èi paringi patiri boe nèti dedha-liru mai, ho pabasa rai èu.

source_text: and by thy sword shalt thou live, and thou shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass, when thou shalt break loose, that thou shalt shake his yoke from off thy neck.
target_text: èu ne, mamuri dhoka nèti samala èu di. aa tasa mera mia èèna ka, èu ne j'aj'i ènu ari mu. dhodhoka ladhe bèli-camèd'a, èu bani lab'a ne, èèna na èu heka rai eele nèti d'ara adhe-aai na.

source_text: and esau hated jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and esau said in his heart, the days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will i slay my brother jacob.
target_text: lula j'ara sèmi ne'e ne ka, esau tèke d'ara dènge ari na yakob, lula parame nare mamèngi na. ka esau pangee na, nèbhu heka, ama ku madhe. de hud'i laa, pe d'ai ku lod'o. ladhe èle beke, ja'a pamadhe ne!

source_text: and the words of esau her elder son were told to rebekah; and she sent and called jacob her younger son, and said unto him, behold, thy brother esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee. now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to laban my brother to haran;
target_text: ropa ribka tadèngi esau dhu neo ad'u j'ara karehe, ka na peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, èu nanene ku lii ne! a'a mu neo b'ala d'ara pèd'a na, de na neo pamadhe èu. de be'a risi, èu ne rai lai-lai asa to'o mu laban, ètu kota haran.

source_text: and tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;
target_text: lamu asa nèi, pea ako nèbhu, toke èle nanasa a'a mu.

source_text: until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then i will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should i be bereaved of you both in one day?
target_text: ladhe na bhèlu eele ku tatao èu ne, pe ja'a pua dhèu dhiu paroa èu, sèna ka èu lèpa hari mai. lula ja'a ko'o boe, sèna ka ana ja'a dua-dua mi ele parènga d'ara ca lod'o èèna ka.

source_text: and rebekah said to isaac, i am weary of my life because of the daughters of heth: if jacob take a wife of the daughters of heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?
target_text: hèia ribka roma iisi dènge isak, peka na, ja'a ru'a le dènge dhèu èmu esau, dhèu het se! de ladhe yakob todhe nare hari kahèi ana bhèni nèti dhèu het se, hua iia ja'a madhe ka laa.

source_text: and isaac called jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of canaan.
target_text: hèia isak paroa nare yakob, ka hia ne mèngi-nale aa holo ne, peka na, sanèd'e paie! èu mage leo ka dènge ana bhèni kana'an hèi.

source_text: arise, go to paddan-aram, to the house of bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of laban thy mother's brother.
target_text: de lamu ka asa padan aram, asa baki mu betuel. lamu madhèdi dènge ana bhèni to'o mu laban ca dhèu.

source_text: and god almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a company of peoples;
target_text: hud'i laa ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele na, hia èu mamèngi, sèna ka ana-èpu èu bèba-kacanga, ho nèti rèngu ka j'aj'i suku ae-ae dhu kapai.

source_text: and give thee the blessing of abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land of thy sojournings, which god gave unto abraham.
target_text: hud'i laa, lii pajaji ama lamatua dènge abraham èèna, noto mi dedha èu ne, dènge ana-èpu èu. sèna ka èu unu rai dhu ama lamatua jaji tèke le mi abraham.

source_text: and isaac sent away jacob: and he went to paddan-aram unto laban, son of bethuel the syrian, the brother of rebekah, jacob's and esau's mother.
target_text: padhai lii nare, ka isak hia yakob la'e asa padan aram, asa èmu to'o na laban, dènge baki na betuel.

source_text: now esau saw that isaac had blessed jacob and sent him away to paddan-aram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of canaan;
target_text: esau dhu tadèngi le kahèi, dhu peka na isak hia yakob mamèngi, aa kai ne sèna ka baku leo dènge bhèni kana'an. aa na tadèngi hèi, dhu isak hia yakob leo dènge ana bhèni to'o na laban ètu padan aram.

source_text: and that jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to paddan-aram:
target_text: ka yakob madhutu lii paredha ina dènge ama na, ka pakèd'i la'e asa padan aram.

source_text: and esau saw that the daughters of canaan pleased not isaac his father;
target_text: aa esau dhu ne'a le kahèi, ama na d'èi boe dhèu èmu na, bhèni kana'an dua sèra.

source_text: and esau went unto ishmael, and took, besides the wives that he had, mahalath the daughter of ishmael abraham's son, the sister of nebaioth, to be his wife.
target_text: hèia na la'e asa ama aae na ismael, ka leo hari èmu dènge ana bhèni ismael ca dhèu, ngara na mahalat. mahalat ne, ana mone na ka nebayot.

source_text: and jacob went out from beer-sheba, and went toward haran.
target_text: ka yakob tèke eele beer syeba, la'e asa haran.

source_text: and he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.
target_text: ropa lod'o cèna, yakob d'ai era èci, ka na j'unu ètu era èèna. na neo j'unu, nare hadhu cue, tao lalaka kètu na.

source_text: and he dreamed; and behold, a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven; and behold, the angels of god ascending and descending on it.
target_text: d'ara mèda èèna, na nii. na ladhe nèdhi langa èci dhu patitu ètu rai, suu na d'ai dedha-liru. ka ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, ca'e-puru ètu dedha langa èèna.

source_text: and, behold, jehovah stood above it, and said, i am jehovah, the god of abraham thy father, and the god of isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will i give it, and to thy seed;
target_text: ètu d'ara nii na, yakob ladhe nèdhi lamatua dhu titu ètu karasa nèngu, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne lamatua, ama lamatua nèti baki mu abraham, dènge ama mu isak. èèna na, ja'a hia rai ne mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu.

source_text: and thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu èu ae-ae, sama sèmi ahu rai ne. rèngu se, èèna na, pea palème era-era ètu rai-haha ne. nèti ana-èpu èu ka, suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, abhu mèngi-nale.

source_text: and, behold, i am with thee, and will keep thee whithersoever thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for i will not leave thee, until i have done that which i have spoken to thee of.
target_text: mage mu bhèlu! èu ne ètu mia èèna ka, ja'a bera-bera dènge èu. ladhe èèna na, ja'a lere kèti hari èu mai asa dedha-rai ne'e. ja'a bhera boe èu. aa èèna na, ja'a tao aa'i madhutu sèmi lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu.

source_text: and jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, surely jehovah is in this place; and i knew it not.
target_text: ropa yakob kèd'i nèti bhèj'i, na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a heka ke'a kèna, lamatua dhu ètu era ne'e kahèi.

source_text: and he was afraid, and said, how dreadful is this place! this is none other than the house of god, and this is the gate of heaven.
target_text: na madha'u, ka na pangee, na, boo! era ne'e ne pamadha'u ja'a, nga. tatu èmu ama lamatua ètu era ne'e ne! aa era ne'e ne, j'aj'i hèb'a babèdho sorga.

source_text: and jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
target_text: d'ara mad'ae aae era, yakob kèd'i le èèna. ka nare hadhu dhu na tao lalaka deo na. hèia na patitu j'aj'i mi tadha. ka na bhori èi mènyi asa dedha hadhu èèna, hèia na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and he called the name of that place beth-el: but the name of the city was luz at the first.
target_text: ka na pangare era ne betel, dhu sasoa na ‘èmu lamatua'. uru èèna, era ne ngara na lus.

source_text: and jacob vowed a vow, saying, if god will be with me, and will keep me in this way that i go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob ded'e subha, aku nèngu na, ladhe ama lamatua dhu dènge ja'a, aa j'aga ja'a ètu d'ara kakako ja'a ne, aa panga'e dènge papake ja'a,

source_text: so that i come again to my father's house in peace, and jehovah will be my god,
target_text: toke ja'a lèpa dènge sod'a, èèna na lamatua j'aj'i mi ama lamatua ja'a.

source_text: then this stone, which i have set up for a pillar, shall be god's house: and of all that thou shalt give me i will surely give the tenth unto thee.
target_text: hadhu dhu ja'a patitu ne, j'aj'i mi era sogo-tagu mi ama lamatua. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua pala-bagi mi ja'a, ja'a hia na ca pala nèti canguru pala.

source_text: then jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.
target_text: hèia yakob kako hari ka asa bèka dhimu.

source_text: and he looked, and, behold, a well in the field, and, lo, three flocks of sheep lying there by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and the stone upon the well's mouth was great.
target_text: ca lod'o, ladhe nèdhi èi ca madha, dètu dènge rae cue. padètu-dètu dènge madha èi èèna, abhu tèlu kaboko kahib'i-kalèbho, dhu mate rinu èi. te ngaa hadhu aae cue dhu ra pasaguru mi hèb'a èi na.

source_text: and thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in its place.
target_text: dhu tema le, ladhe kahib'i tesa aa'i-aa'i ra, ana-ana madhenga kahib'i se, lasi bhoke hadhu na, heka ra dhui kèna, panginu kahib'i si. panginu rare na, ra katange hari hadhu na la'e.

source_text: and jacob said unto them, my brethren, whence are ye? and they said, of haran are we.
target_text: ka yakob kako la'e asa madha dhèu madhenge kahib'i se, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu se, dhèu mia? hèia ra dhaa, ji'i se, nèti rae haran ne'e.

source_text: and he said unto them, know ye laban the son of nahor? and they said, we know him.
target_text: ka yakob karèi hari, aku nèngu na, miu tadhe to'o ja'a, laban, do? nèngu na, ana nahor. ka ra dhaa, ji'i tadhe ne.

source_text: and he said unto them, is it well with him? and they said, it is well: and, behold, rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.
target_text: hèia yakob karèi hari, aku nèngu na, na be'a-be'a, sina ma? ka ra peka, oo, na be'a-be'a. ladhe, ana bhèni na ka nèi. ngara na, rahel. nuka eo nèti kahib'i ama na mai sa ne'e, ho hia rinu ètu ne'e. mate ne.

source_text: and he said, lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.
target_text: hèia yakob peka hari, loo nètu era. de be'a risi, badha mia ètu se'e le, panginu ka si. sèna ka lere mèti hari asa d'ara pad'a, ho ra'a hari j'u'u.

source_text: and they said, we cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.
target_text: te ngaa ra peka, we, j'ara na aad'o sèmi èèna! ji'i mate toke tesa aa'i ku, heka ji'i pakeso hadhu ne, heka panginu badha se kèna.

source_text: while he was yet speaking with them, rachel came with her father's sheep; for she kept them.
target_text: yakob padhai lii era, rahel d'ai le era èèna dènge kahib'i ama na. nèngu ka dhu biasa ladhe-leru si.

source_text: and it came to pass, when jacob saw rachel the daughter of laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of laban his mother's brother, that jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of laban his mother's brother.
target_text: ropa yakob nèdhi rahel dènge kahib'i sèra, la'e dènge ka pa'eso eele hadhu dhu saguru hèb'a èi na. ka na panginu badha to'o na sèra.

source_text: and jacob kissed rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
target_text: èle ka, la'e uu rahel, dènge tangi.

source_text: and jacob told rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.
target_text: ka na lolo dènge rahel, aku nèngu na, ari! ja'a ne, ana nèti ribka, ana hèni ama mu. hèia rahel rai sa èmu la'e, peka dènge ama na.

source_text: and it came to pass, when laban heard the tidings of jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. and he told laban all these things.
target_text: ropa laban tadèngi lii lolo rahel, dhu peka na yakob ana nèti ana hèni na ribka, ka la'e dènge ka, soru nare yakob. ropa na d'ai, liku nare yakob, ka na uu, hèia gale nèti dènge ka, lasi asa èmu na. ka yakob lolo aa'i-aa'i dènge to'o na.

source_text: and laban said to him, surely thou art my bone and my flesh. and he abode with him the space of a month.
target_text: hèia laban lii, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! èdhi dua ti dhu pa'a'ari. ropa yakob pea dènge rèngu d'ai ca hèru,

source_text: and laban said unto jacob, because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?
target_text: laban padhai lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, yakob! ja'a ko'o boe, sèna ka èu sab'a hia ja'a dènge iia-iia d'ara, lula èdhi se dhu pa'a'ari. de èu neo sèna ka rui-j'aj'èra èu ja'a b'ae ca ngaa?

source_text: and laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was leah, and the name of the younger was rachel.
target_text: laban ne, dhu dènge ana bhèni dhèu dua. dhu uru, ngara na lea. aa ari na, ngara na rahel.

source_text: and leah's eyes were tender; but rachel was beautiful and well favored.
target_text: lea ne, musi madha na ako ahu. te ngaa rahel, rèhu na bhèni iia, aa ngi'u na saraga bia.

source_text: and jacob loved rachel; and he said, i will serve thee seven years for rachel thy younger daughter.
target_text: yakob d'èi risi rahel. ka na peka dènge laban, ladhe to'o ku mo'o, ja'a sab'a hia to'o ku pidhu tèu, sad'i to'o ku hia ja'a madhèdi dènge rahel.

source_text: and laban said, it is better that i give her to thee, than that i should give her to another man: abide with me.
target_text: hèia laban dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ko'o! be'a risi, ja'a paleo èu dènge rahel, lula èdhi dua ti dhu a'ari. mage dhoka na madhèdi dènge dhèu leo. de mu pea mi ne'e, sèna ka sab'a hia ja'a.

source_text: and jacob served seven years for rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.
target_text: ka yakob sab'a hia laban pidhu tèu, sèna ka na bisa madhèdi dènge rahel. lula na d'èi madhe-madhe rahel, nèti èèna ka, pidhu tèu èèna, na pangee nuka sèmi pèri-pèri lod'o di.

source_text: and jacob said unto laban, give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that i may go in unto her.
target_text: ropa risi nèti pidhu tèu, ka na pasanèd'e laban, aku nèngu na, to'o! ja'a sab'a le hia to'o ku pidhu tèu, de paleo ka ja'a dènge rahel.

source_text: and laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
target_text: hèia laban tao tatao, ka na nèru aa'i rae lesa ètu rae èèna.

source_text: and it came to pass in the evening, that he took leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her. and laban gave zilpah his handmaid unto his daughter leah for a handmaid. and it came to pass in the morning that, behold, it was leah: and he said to laban, what is this thou hast done unto me? did not i serve with thee for rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me? and laban said, it is not so done in our place, to give the younger before the first-born. fulfil the week of this one, and we will give thee the other also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda èèna, laban hia boe rahel, te ngaa na pua lea maso asa d'ara paleo yakob. ka yakob j'unu dènge ne. asa bèli èèna, yakob heka ne'a kèna, nèngu dhu leo dènge lea di. hèia yakob la'e patao dènge laban, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, to'o pasèru ja'a sèmi ne'e? ja'a sab'a sèmi ènu pidhu tèu kateme hia mi èu, sèna ka bisa abhu rahel! nga tao ka to'o pasilu dènge lea? ka laban dhaa, baku nasa ku! madhutu ad'a ji'i ètu rai ne'e, ari bisa boe leo uuru èmu nèti a'a. de be'a risi sèmi ne'e! èu mate hari ku pidhu lod'o, d'ai èle tatao ne, heka èu abhu rahel kèna. sad'i èu sab'a hari hia ja'a pidhu tèu. hèia laban pangèd'u dènge ènu bhèni èci, hia mi lea. ngara na silpa.

source_text: and jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him rachel his daughter to wife.
target_text: lii padhai laban deo na, yakob d'èi kahèi. nèti èèna ka, èle tatao ne pidhu lod'o, ka laban pamadhèdi hari yakob dènge rahel.

source_text: and laban gave to rachel his daughter bilhah his handmaid to be her handmaid.
target_text: ka laban hia ènu na dhèu bhèni èci, ngara na bilha, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ènu rahel.

source_text: and he went in also unto rachel, and he loved also rachel more than leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
target_text: hèia yakob pa'èci ka dènge rahel. na d'èi risi rahel nèti lea. ka yakob sab'a hari hia to'o na pidhu tèu.

source_text: and jehovah saw that leah was hated, and he opened her womb: but rachel was barren.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua ne'a le, yakob sue risi rahel nèti lea. nèti èèna ka, na hia lea nara iisi ana. te ngaa rahel abhu boe ana.

source_text: and leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name reuben: for she said, because jehovah hath looked upon my affliction; for now my husband will love me.
target_text: hèia lea dènge babia, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. na pangare ne, ruben dhu sasoa na ‘mèdhi si, abhu ana', lula na peka na, lamatua ladhe nèdhi le sasusa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne, dhèu èmu ja'a tao madha-dhilu mi ja'a.

source_text: and she conceived again, and bare a son: and said, because jehovah hath heard that i am hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name simeon.
target_text: ka lea dènge hari babia, hèia nara iisi hari ana mone èci. na pangare ne, simeon dhu sasoa na, ele boe ‘dhèu tadèngi le', lula na peka na, lamatua dhu ne'a na, dhèu èmu ja'a sue boe ja'a. tu d'ai èèna ka, na hia ja'a ana dhèu èci hari.

source_text: and she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because i have borne him three sons: therefore was his name called levi.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lea kad'o hari ana èci, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. na pangare na lewi, lula na peka na, dènge ana ne'e ne, èle dènge lii langu ja'a. d'ara dhèu èmu ja'a, pa'èki dènge ja'a, lula ja'a matana hia ne ana mone, dhèu tèlu kèna.

source_text: and she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, this time will i praise jehovah: therefore she called his name judah; and she left off bearing.
target_text: ka lea dènge hari babia ca tèka, hèia nara iisi ana mone èci. na pangare na, yahuda dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘koa-kio', lula na peka na, dènge j'ara ne'e ne, ja'a neo koa-kio lamatua! èle ka, lea dènge heka ana.

source_text: and when rachel saw that she bare jacob no children, rachel envied her sister; and she said unto jacob, give me children, or else i die.
target_text: te ngaa rahel dhu abhu mèka ana. nèti èèna ka, nèngu tèke d'ara dènge a'a na. hèia na peka dènge dhèu èmu na, a'a! hia ku ja'a ana laa, ma. ladhe aad'o, be'a risi ja'a madhe ka laa.

source_text: and jacob's anger was kindled against rachel: and he said, am i in god's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
target_text: te ngaa yakob jèke ne, aku nèngu na, èu ngee na, ja'a ne, lamatua, ho bisa hia èu ana! ?

source_text: and she said, behold, my maid bilhah, go in unto her; that she may bear upon my knees, and i also may obtain children by her.
target_text: ka rahel b'ala na, sèmi ne'e: hua iia èu more bilha, ènu ja'a na. j'unu dènge ne, sèna ka na matana hia ja'a ana.

source_text: and she gave him bilhah her handmaid to wife: and jacob went in unto her.
target_text: hèia na pangèd'u bilha mi dhèu èmu na. ka yakob j'unu dènge ne.

source_text: and bilhah conceived, and bare jacob a son.
target_text: ka bilha dènge babia, hèia nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and rachel said, god hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name dan.
target_text: hèia rahel padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua nanene le lii manèngi-mangaj'i ja'a. nèti èèna ka, na hia ja'a ana mone ca dhèu. ama lamatua pama'ète le, lii langu ja'a dènge mola-mola. ka na pangare ana ne, dan dhu sasoa na ‘pama'ète lii'.

source_text: and bilhah rachel's handmaid conceived again, and bare jacob a second son.
target_text: èle èèna ka, bilha dènge hari babia, ka nara iisi ana mone èci.

source_text: and rachel said, with mighty wrestlings have i wrestled with my sister, and have prevailed: and she called his name naphtali.
target_text: ka rahel peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a limuri ne pa'uji dènge a'a ku, ka ja'a segi. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana na, naftali dhu sasoa na ‘pa'uji', do ‘pa'ère'.

source_text: when leah saw that she had left off bearing, she took zilpah her handmaid, and gave her to jacob to wife.
target_text: ropa lea ne'a na nèngu ne dènge heka ana, ka na paleo ènu na silpa dènge yakob.

source_text: and zilpah leah's handmaid bare jacob a son.
target_text: ka silpa nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and leah said, fortunate! and she called his name gad.
target_text: hèia lea peka na, kalua ja'a, mèngi le. ka na pangare na, gad dhu sasoa na ‘kalua mèngi'.

source_text: and zilpah leah's handmaid bare jacob a second son.
target_text: ka silpa nara iisi hari ana mone èci.

source_text: and leah said, happy am i! for the daughters will call me happy: and she called his name asher.
target_text: hèia lea padhai lii, peka na, waa! limuri ne, ja'a heka karej'e kèna! mi laladhe ee, te bèli-camèd'a, dhèu bhèni aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na ja'a ne oto bia. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana ne, aser dhu sasoa na ‘karej'e'.

source_text: and reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother leah. then rachel said to leah, give me, i pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge hèru puu-g'ètu are, ruben la'e asa d'ara j'ami. na rage ana aaj'u ca kapua dhu j'aj'i sèmi èi na'i ho hia dhèu bhèni abhu kolo. ka ruben nèti hia ina na lea. ropa rahel nèdhi, ka na peka dènge lea, aku nèngu na, a'a! bagi ku ja'a ciki, èi na'i dhu ruben nèti èèna.

source_text: and she said unto her, is it a small matter that thou hast taken away my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? and rachel said, therefore he shall lie with thee to-night for thy son's mandrakes.
target_text: te ngaa lea b'ala, aku nèngu na, wee! èu ne seli-kolane! parame more le dhèu èmu ja'a. te ngaa roca mèka na. mu neo hari unu aj'u èi na'i èèna nèti ana ja'a? me'a heka makae d'ara! te ngaa rahel dhaa, sèmi ne'e, a'a! ladhe ja'a abhu èi na'i na, mèda ne'e èu pa'èci dènge yakob. ka lea d'èi kahèi.

source_text: and jacob came from the field in the evening, and leah went out to meet him, and said, thou must come in unto me; for i have surely hired thee with my son's mandrakes. and he lay with her that night.
target_text: ka pe d'ai loo nihia sa, yakob lèpa nèti d'ara oka. lea la'e soru nare ne, ka na peka, a'a! mèda ne, èu j'unu dènge ja'a! lula ja'a dhu hèli kore le èu, dènge kab'ua èi na'i ana ja'a! ka mèda na, yakob j'unu dènge lea.

source_text: and god hearkened unto leah, and she conceived, and bare jacob a fifth son.
target_text: ka ama lamatua tadèngi lii manèngi-mangaj'i lea. nèti èèna ka, na dènge babia, hèia nara iisi ana mone ka lèmi.

source_text: and leah said, god hath given me my hire, because i gave my handmaid to my husband: and she called his name issachar.
target_text: hèia lea pangare ana na, isaskar, dhu sasoa na, ‘b'ae j'aj'èra', lula na peka na, ama lamatua b'ae-baj'a le j'aj'èra ja'a, lula ja'a hia le silpa madhèdi dènge dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: and leah conceived again, and bare a sixth son to jacob.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lea dènge babia hari, hèia nara iisi ana mone ka èna.

source_text: and leah said, god hath endowed me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because i have borne him six sons: and she called his name zebulun.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua parasee ja'a mèdha dhu be'a. ka limuri ne, dhèu èmu ja'a hud'i pakab'ua ku ja'a, lula ja'a matana hia ne ana mone dhèu èna. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana ne, sebulon dhu sasoa na ‘pakab'ua'.

source_text: and afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name dinah.
target_text: ka lea nara iisi hari, te ngaa ana bhèni, ka na pangare na, dina.

source_text: and god remembered rachel, and god hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua dhu bhèlu boe rahel, ka sèmi lii manèngi-mangaj'i na. nèti èèna ka, na bhoke era ana na.

source_text: and she conceived, and bare a son: and said, god hath taken away my reproach:
target_text: hèia rahel dènge babia, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na peka, ama lamatua saku eele le d'ara makae ja'a.

source_text: and she called his name joseph, saying, jehovah add to me another son.
target_text: hèia na pangare ana na yusuf dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘hud'i laa na hia tabha hari', lula aku nèngu na, ja'a manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua hia ja'a ana mone ca dhèu hari.

source_text: and it came to pass, when rachel had borne joseph, that jacob said unto laban, send me away, that i may go unto mine own place, and to my country.
target_text: lod'o rahel nara iisi yusuf, yakob peka dènge laban, aku nèngu na, to'o! ladhe mo'o, ja'a neo lèpa asa rai ètu-èsu ja'a.

source_text: give me my wives and my children for whom i have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service wherewith i have served thee.
target_text: ja'a neo laku dènge ana-dhèu èmu ja'a. to'o, èu dhu me'a le, ja'a ne sab'a tèu-tèu nèti mad'ae d'ai loo nihia. de ja'a b'ae pama'ète le rèngu se. nèti èèna ka, rèngu se, j'aj'i le unu ja'a ka teme aae.

source_text: and laban said unto him, if now i have found favor in thine eyes, tarry: for i have divined that jehovah hath blessed me for thy sake.
target_text: hèia, aku to'o na, ana, ee! èu nanene ku lii ja'a laa! madhutu lii malare dhu ja'a abhu, lamatua hia ja'a mamèngi lula èu.

source_text: and he said, appoint me thy wages, and i will give it.
target_text: de èu neo manèngi ca ngaa, peka, sèna ka ja'a b'ae! sad'i èu baku tèke eele ja'a, te ngaa sab'a taruu hia ja'a.

source_text: and he said unto him, thou knowest how i have served thee, and how thy cattle have fared with me.
target_text: ka yakob peka, to'o! èu mèdhi unu mu le, sasab'a-la'a ja'a. nèti èèna ka, badha-manu to'o se, bèba-kacanga.

source_text: for it was little which thou hadst before i came, and it hath increased unto a multitude; and jehovah hath blessed thee whithersoever i turned: and now when shall i provide for mine own house also?
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a dhae mai mèka, mèdha-panyau to'o ku ae èèna mèka. te ngaa limuri ne, to'o kaja le. lamatua pala-bagi le to'o ku mamèngi, lula sasab'a-la'a ja'a ka. te d'ai le lod'o na, sèna ka ja'a sab'a hia ana-dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: and he said, what shall i give thee? and jacob said, thou shalt not give me aught: if thou wilt do this thing for me, i will again feed thy flock and keep it.
target_text: hèia laban karèi ne, aku nèngu na, de sèmi èèna na, ja'a b'ae èu tasamia? ka yakob dhaa, peka na, to'o ku, hia ia ka ja'a ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa badha-manu to'o ku, ja'a ladhe-leru taruu, sad'i mu tao ku j'ara èci.

source_text: i will pass through all thy flock to-day, removing from thence every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.
target_text: ladhe mo'o, deo ne'e kahèi, ja'a laku asa badha-manu to'o sèi, ho hag'e si. mia dhu dènge boe katèd'a aa dènge boe karata, sèra sa unu to'o ku taruu. te ngaa mia dhu dènge katèd'a aa dhu karata, hia mi ja'a. dènge kahib'i-kalèbho dhu mèdhi, ja'a kora aa'i si. se'e se, hud'i laa j'aj'i mi bab'ae rui-j'aj'èra ja'a.

source_text: so shall my righteousness answer for me hereafter, when thou shalt come concerning my hire that is before thee: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that, if found with me, shall be counted stolen.
target_text: d'ai lod'o limuri, pe to'o me'a ja'a ne sab'a dènge mola, do aad'o. sad'i lake more, mai ho mu parisa badha-manu ja'a. ladhe mu abhu kahib'i-ka'ia dhu dènge boe katèd'a, aa dhu karata boe, do, kahib'i-kalèbho dhu pudhi, èèna na, dhu me'a le èèna, ja'a mana'u badha-manu to'o.

source_text: and laban said, behold, i would it might be according to thy word.
target_text: ka laban d'èi kahèi, aku nèngu na, oo! j'ara na sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: and he removed that day the he-goats that were ringstreaked and spotted, and all the she-goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons;
target_text: te ngaa ètu d'ara lod'o èèna kahèi, laban hag'e dènge badha dhu katèd'a, dhu karata, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho dhu mèdhi. ka na pangèd'u mi ana na si, ho ladhe-leru.

source_text: and he set three days' journey betwixt himself and jacob: and jacob fed the rest of laban's flocks.
target_text: hèia eo rèti ka badha se asa era èci dhu kaj'èu na tèlu lod'o kako haga nèti era yakob si. ka yakob madhenge ka badha dhu ata se.

source_text: and jacob took him rods of fresh poplar, and of the almond and of the plane-tree; and peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
target_text: èla èèna ka, yakob poro nare dadana aaj'u nèti aj'u tèlu rupa. ka na caci pakarata ka'uri aj'u sèra, tao strep-strep.

source_text: and he set the rods which he had peeled over against the flocks in the gutters in the watering-troughs where the flocks came to drink; and they conceived when they came to drink.
target_text: hèia aj'u dhu strep-strep se, na tèke asa d'ara karab'a kahib'i. badha se dhu tema le pa'ango aa paleo ètu era èèna.

source_text: and the flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks brought forth ringstreaked, speckled, and spotted.
target_text: de ladhe badha se paleo ètu madha aj'u strep-strep se, ra matana ana dhu rèu ra katèd'a dènge karata.

source_text: and jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstreaked and all the black in the flock of laban: and he put his own droves apart, and put them not unto laban's flock.
target_text: ka ladhe badha laban se neo paleo, yakob patangare si asa kahib'i dhu katèd'a dènge karata sèra. hèia ana dhu ra matana sa rèu ra katèd'a dènge karata kahèi. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, badha na asa ae. ka na pacèri eele si nèti badha laban sèra.

source_text: and it came to pass, whensoever the stronger of the flock did conceive, that jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the flock in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods;
target_text: ropa badha dhu èra neo paleo, yakob nare kadhèli aj'u dhu strep-strep sèra, tao mi d'ara karab'a ètu madha si.

source_text: but when the flock were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were laban's, and the stronger jacob's.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe kahib'i dhu roe dènge malaka-god'a neo paleo, yakob soro tèke si. ka badha dhu roe, sèra unu to'o na laban. aa mia dhu èra, sèra unu nèngu.

source_text: and the man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, and maid-servants and men-servants, and camels and asses.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ne, yakob j'aj'i dhèu kaja-su'i. ka kahib'i-ka'ia na, kahib'i-kalèbho na, onta na, keled'ei na, dènge ènu na bhèni-mone, udhu sobhu-sobhu.

source_text: and he heard the words of laban's sons, saying, jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.
target_text: ca tèka, yakob tadèngi lii padhai ana-ana laban se, aku rèngu na, kakaja-sasu'i yakob sèra, lula na kao nare aa'i mèdha-panyau ama èdhi.

source_text: and jacob beheld the countenance of laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as beforetime.
target_text: yakob nèdhi kahèi rèhu to'o laban mare heka, aa be'a heka dènge ne, sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: and jehovah said unto jacob, return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and i will be with thee.
target_text: hèia lamatua peka dènge yakob, d'ai le lod'o, ho èu lèpa asa ina dènge ama mu. ja'a palere-lere dènge èu.

source_text: and jacob sent and called rachel and leah to the field unto his flock,
target_text: ka yakob hia dhèu lasi paroa rahel dènge lea, sèna ka mai paraga dènge ne ètu era ani badha, ètu d'ara mamoo.

source_text: and said unto them, i see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as beforetime; but the god of my father hath been with me.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, limuri ne, ja'a ladhe-ladhe na, ama miu na rèhu na mare heka dènge ja'a. aa babe'a na mi ja'a, sèmi heka uru èèna. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu ama ku sogo-tagu èèna, palere-lere dènge ja'a.

source_text: and ye know that with all my power i have served your father.
target_text: miu dua mi se me'a le, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a j'aj'i kuli ètu ama miu!

source_text: and your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but god suffered him not to hurt me.
target_text: te ngaa sèmi èèna, d'ara na la'e kahèi, ka na kapod'e-kabèli taruu ja'a. ka na ub'a rui-j'aj'èra ja'a, canguru hari kèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, ama lamatua j'aga pa'èra ja'a.

source_text: if he said thus, the speckled shall be thy wages; then all the flock bare speckled: and if he said thus, the ringstreaked shall be thy wages; then bare all the flock ringstreaked.
target_text: lod'o ama miu peka na, ‘badha dhu rèu ra katèd'a sèra j'aj'i mi unu èu, ' ho ladhe lod'o badha se matana, ana dhu katèd'a hua-hua. lod'o leo hari, na peka, ‘badha dhu karata sèra, j'aj'i mi unu èu, ' ka badha se matana ana karata aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: thus god hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.
target_text: ama lamatua ad'u sèmi èèna na, sèna ka nare aa'i badha-manu ama miu èèna, ho hia mi ja'a.

source_text: and it came to pass at the time that the flock conceive, that i lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the he-goats which leaped upon the flock were ringstreaked, speckled, and grizzled.
target_text: ca tèka, ropa badha se paleo, ja'a kèdhi ètu d'ara nii, dhu peka na, badha mone aa'i-aa'i dhu paleo, abhu dhu katèd'a aa dhu karata hèi.

source_text: and the angel of god said unto me in the dream, jacob: and i said, here am i.
target_text: ka ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga paroa ja'a, peka na, ‘yakob! ' hèia ja'a dhaa, ‘tasamia, lamatua? '

source_text: and he said, lift up now thine eyes, and see: all the he-goats which leap upon the flock are ringstreaked, speckled, and grizzled: for i have seen all that laban doeth unto thee.
target_text: ka na lii, ‘ladhe ku laa! badha mone dhu paleo sèra, dhodhoka dhu karata dènge katèd'a di. ja'a ka ad'u sèra sa, lula ja'a dhu kèdhi le, ngaa dhu laban tao mi dedha èu.

source_text: i am the god of beth-el, where thou anointedst a pillar, where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy nativity.
target_text: ja'a ne, ama lamatua, dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu ètu betel èèna. ètu era nèi, èu patitu hadhu, ka mu bhori èi mènyi ètu dedha na, ka èu sogo-tagu ja'a. ka èu pa'èki lii pajaji dènge ja'a ètu nèi. de kèd'i ka, tèke eele ka rai ne'e ne, lamu ka asa kabarai ina-ama èu. '

source_text: and rachel and leah answered and said unto him, is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
target_text: hèia rahel dènge lea b'ala lii na, aku rèngu na, la'a ma! ji'i dènge heka pusaka ngaa-ngaa nèti ama ji'i laban.

source_text: are we not accounted by him as foreigners? for he hath sold us, and hath also quite devoured our money.
target_text: nèbhu nare sange ne'e, mone heka ne tao ji'i sèmi dhèu leo kara sa. na pahie eele le ji'i se. ka na'e aa'i le kab'ua-kadheli ji'i se.

source_text: for all the riches which god hath taken away from our father, that is ours and our children's: now then, whatsoever god hath said unto thee, do.
target_text: de mèdha-panyau dhu ama lamatua nare sèra nèti ama ji'i laban, aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i le unu èdhi dènge ana-ana èdhi se. de ladhe aku lamatua tasa mera mia, te'a dhoka madhutu di!

source_text: then jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon the camels; and he carried away all his cattle, and all his substance which he had gathered, the cattle of his getting, which he had gathered in paddan-aram, to go to isaac his father unto the land of canaan.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob lalau mèdha-panyau na. hèia na paca'e ana-dhèu èmu na asa dedha onta lasi, aa na eo nèti badha-manu na aa'i-aa'i, dènge mèdha-panyau dhu na abhu ètu padan aram, ho lasi asa rai kana'an.

source_text: now laban was gone to shear his sheep: and rachel stole the teraphim that were her father's.
target_text: lod'o èèna, laban dhu la'e g'ute rèu kahib'i-kalèbho na. ka rahel mana'u nare patung mèdha sogo-tagu ama na.

source_text: and jacob stole away unawares to laban the syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
target_text: aa yakob si lasi palangu boe lii dènge to'o na.

source_text: so he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mountain of gilead.
target_text: na bau nèti aa'i mèdha-panyau na, ka ra kako pamèri-mèri, lasi re loko efrat, asa ledhe gilead.

source_text: and it was told laban on the third day that jacob was fled.
target_text: rarai yakob si èèna d'ai tèlu lod'o ku, heka laban ne'a kèna.

source_text: and he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and he overtook him in the mountain of gilead.
target_text: hèia laban oru nare ka dhèu-dhèu na, lasi bate yakob si. d'ai pidhu lod'o ku, heka ra paraga dènge si ètu ledhe gilead.

source_text: and god came to laban the syrian in a dream of the night, and said unto him, take heed to thyself that thou speak not to jacob either good or bad.
target_text: ka d'ara mèda èèna, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi laban ètu d'ara nii. na peka na, laban! ladhe èu padhai lii dènge yakob, j'aga paie hèb'a èu na.

source_text: and laban came up with jacob. now jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain: and laban with his brethren encamped in the mountain of gilead.
target_text: mèda èèna, yakob si dhu patitu paleo ètu ledhe gilead. aa laban si patitu unu ra kaj'èu boe nèti era èèna kahèi.

source_text: and laban said to jacob, what hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters as captives of the sword?
target_text: èle ka, laban mai paraga dènge yakob. hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, èu rai mèti ana bhèni ja'a se, dènge boe lii ugu-ge'e sa hèi? mu tao si sèmi dhèu dhu èu segi ètu d'ara papara-pakèj'i.

source_text: wherefore didst thou flee secretly, and steal away from me, and didst not tell me, that i might have sent thee away with mirth and with songs, with tabret and with harp;
target_text: èu ne ad'a aad'o, palangu boe sa hèi dènge ja'a! ladhe èu peka dènge ja'a be'a-be'a, ele boe ja'a tao sisi-kau, ho ta'a-tinu boko-boko, ho lere miu dènge lii sod'a, heka ji'i patabuli miu kèna.

source_text: and didst not suffer me to kiss my sons and my daughters? now hast thou done foolishly.
target_text: sasala èu èci hari ka, èu hia boe ja'a uu ana-èpu ja'a hèi. tatao èu ne goa titu kèna!

source_text: it is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the god of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, take heed to thyself that thou speak not to jacob either good or bad.
target_text: carui boe, ladhe ja'a ne neo paj'èra èu! te ngaa malo-malo ka mèda-mèda na, ama lamatua dhu ama mu sogo-tagu èèna, kai ja'a peka na, ladhe ja'a padhai lii dènge èu, ja'a hud'i j'aga paie-iie ku hèb'a ja'a.

source_text: and now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
target_text: mema, ja'a dhu ke'a le, èu pakèd'i lula èu dhu neo le lèpa. te ngaa tasamia ka, èu mana'u mèti patung mèdha sogo-tagu ja'a?

source_text: and jacob answered and said to laban, because i was afraid: for i said, lest thou shouldest take thy daughters from me by force.
target_text: hèia yakob b'ala, aku nèngu na, to'o baku nasa ku dènge ja'a! ja'a pakèd'i mau-mau èèna, lula ja'a mage dhoka mo'o boe ja'a kèti ana-ana se!

source_text: with whomsoever thou findest thy gods, he shall not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. for jacob knew not that rachel had stolen them.
target_text: te ngaa yakob dhu ne'a nare boe, na dhèu èmu na rahel ka dhu mana'u nèti. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, to'o! mèdha sogo-tagu èèna, mu tenge ne! ladhe mèdhi ètu cee, huku pamadhe ne. parisa aa'i mèu-mèu. ladhe abhu kahèi pusaka to'o dhu leo, more aa'i si. hud'i laa, dhèu se'e se j'aj'i sakasii.

source_text: and laban went into jacob's tent, and into leah's tent, and into the tent of the two maid-servants; but he found them not. and he went out of leah's tent, and entered into rachel's tent.
target_text: hèia laban la'e parisa ka asa d'ara paleo se èci-èci. na la'e uru asa d'ara paleo yakob. èle ka, la'e asa d'ara paleo lea. èle ka, la'e asa d'ara paleo ènu se dua ra. te ngaa abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. paleo rahel limuri tèka.

source_text: now rachel had taken the teraphim, and put them in the camel's saddle, and sat upon them. and laban felt about all the tent, but found them not.
target_text: te ngaa rahel dhu huni le mèdha sogo-tagu sèra ètu d'ara lalaka onta. ka na madhèdi ètu dedha. d'ai d'ara paleo ne, laban tenge paie-iie, te ngaa na rage boe.

source_text: and she said to her father, let not my lord be angry that i cannot rise up before thee; for the manner of women is upon me. and he searched, but found not the teraphim.
target_text: hèia rahel peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ama mage mu nasa kahèi. te ja'a bisa boe titu, lula ja'a abhu hèru. masi ka sèmi èèna, laban tenge taruu, te ngaa abhu boe mèdha sogo-tagu sèra.

source_text: and jacob was wroth, and chode with laban: and jacob answered and said to laban, what is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast hotly pursued after me?
target_text: ka yakob nasa, hèia na pajèka dènge laban, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne tao bhelu ngaa mi to'o? ka to'o mai bate ja'a, sèmi dhu ja'a ne, dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa!

source_text: whereas thou hast felt about all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us two.
target_text: mèdha-panyau ja'a, to'o ceb'e eele si. de mu abhu ngaa? more ka mai tèke mi madha ne, sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ti tèdhi. aa hud'i laa, dhèu se'e ka dhu pama'ète mèdha èèna unu cee.

source_text: these twenty years have i been with thee; thy ewes and thy she-goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flocks have i not eaten.
target_text: dua nguru tèu kèna, ja'a sab'a kuli mi to'o. lod'o ja'a madhenga badha-manu to'o, ci'u sa legu boe. aa ku'a kèdhi boe ci'u sa hèi!

source_text: that which was torn of beasts i brought not unto thee; i bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
target_text: ladhe badha hui-hahi hui, kadhi pamadhe badha to'o ci'u, ja'a peka boe, te ngaa ja'a gati. aa ladhe dhèu mana'u, to'o pua ja'a gati, masi ka ja'a sala boe.

source_text: thus i was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from mine eyes.
target_text: ladhe re mèu, madha lod'o ai pamango ja'a. aa ladhe mèda, ja'a maringi rig'i-rig'i. ja'a pasaruru boe ciki sa, toke mèu rai, lula madhenge badha-manu to'o.

source_text: these twenty years have i been in thy house; i served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy flock: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
