target_text: mema tare'a, dua nguru tèu èèna! ja'a sab'a canguru èpa tèu, sèna ka abhu ana bhèni to'o, dhèu dua se. ka ja'a sab'a hari èna tèu, sèna ka ja'a unu badha-manu se'e. j'aj'i kuli nèbhu nare sange èèna, te ngaa to'o pakura rui-j'aj'èra ja'a d'ai canguru hari.

source_text: except the god of my father, the god of abraham, and the fear of isaac, had been with me, surely now hadst thou sent me away empty. god hath seen mine affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.
target_text: malo-malo ka, dènge ama lamatua, dhu baki ku abraham, dènge ama ku isak, dhu sogo-tagu ne. ladhe na leru boe ja'a ne, ele boe to'o hia ja'a lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu pa'abhe boe musi madha na mi j'aj'èra ja'a, aa na tao madha-dhilu mi sasab'a-la'a ja'a aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, mèda deo na, na mai kai to'o, sèna ka baku lii sakaa dènge ja'a.

source_text: and laban answered and said unto jacob, the daughters are my daughters, and the children are my children, and the flocks are my flocks, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can i do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children whom they have borne?
target_text: ropa nanene nare lii padhai yakob, ka laban dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! bhèni dua se, ana ja'a. ana dhu ra matana se, aa'i-aa'i ra èpu ja'a. badha-manu aa'i-aa'i se, unu ja'a. aa'i-aa'i dhu èu ladhe mèdhi ètu se'e se, unu ja'a. te ngaa ja'a neo tao si, tasamia? ja'a bisa boe magee si.

source_text: and now come, let us make a covenant, i and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
target_text: de be'a risi, èdhi dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji. sèna ka lii pajaji èèna ka dhu èki èdhi dua ti.

source_text: and jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
target_text: hèia yakob nare ka hadhu aae cue, na patitu ètu èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha.

source_text: and jacob said unto his brethren, gather stones; and they took stones, and made a heap: and they did eat there by the heap.
target_text: hèia yakob pua dhèu sab'a na, lasi udhu hadhu. ka ra madhèdi ra'a-rinu ètu era èèna, padètu dènge hadhu sèra.

source_text: and laban called it jegar-saha-dutha: but jacob called it galeed.
target_text: hèia laban pangare hadhu udhu sèra, yegar sahaduta. te ngaa yakob pangare na, galeed.

source_text: and laban said, this heap is witness between me and thee this day. therefore was the name of it called galeed:
target_text: ka laban padhai lii, aku nèngu na, hadhu udhu se, j'aj'i sakasii mi èdhi dua ti. nèti èèna ka, era èèna ngara na, galeed.

source_text: and mizpah, for he said, jehovah watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
target_text: laban pangare kahèi era èèna, mispa dhu sasoa na ‘era j'aga dhu dedha', lula na peka na, pe èèna na, lamatua ka dhu j'aga èdhi dua ti, ho masi ka dua ti pakaj'èu, baku kako eele lii pajaji ne.

source_text: if thou shalt afflict my daughters, and if thou shalt take wives besides my daughters, no man is with us; see, god is witness betwixt me and thee.
target_text: ladhe èu tao karehe ana ja'a se, do leo-èmu dènge bhèni leo hari, tatu ja'a ke'a boe. te ngaa mu sanèd'e! ama lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii mi èdhi dua ti.

source_text: and laban said to jacob, behold this heap, and behold the pillar, which i have set betwixt me and thee. this heap be witness, and the pillar be witness, that i will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
target_text: èu ladhe ku hadhu dhu patitu ne, dènge hadhu dhu udhu se. sanèd'e, hadhu se'e ka dhu j'aj'i mi too dènge lane. èu bisa boe kako seli hadhu se, ho tao bhelu mi ja'a. aa ja'a kahèi bisa boe kako seli hadhu se, ho tao bhelu mi èu.

source_text: the god of abraham, and the god of nahor, the god of their father, judge betwixt us. and jacob sware by the fear of his father isaac.
target_text: dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji ne, dènge kolongara ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èdhi. nuka ama lamatua nèti baki mu abraham dènge baki ja'a nahor. nèngu èèna ka, dhu j'aj'i hakim, sèna ka pama'ète lii èdhi dua ti. ropa nanene nare, hèia yakob j'oka soo-subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua, dhu ama na isak sogo-tagu.

source_text: and jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mountain.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob roro badha, ho j'aj'i mi korban hia mi lamatua ètu ledhe èèna. hèia na paroa dhèu aa'i-aa'i mai ra'a-rinu pa'èci, ka ra beke d'ai lod'o rea.

source_text: and jacob went on his way, and the angels of god met him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si kako taruu. hèia ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga sèra mai paraga dènge ne.

source_text: and jacob said when he saw them, this is god's host: and he called the name of that place mahanaim.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi si, na lii, aku nèngu na, era ne'e ne, sèmi era ae sordad'u lamatua! nèti èèna ka, era èèna na pangare na, mahanaim dhu sasoa na ‘dua era ae iisi'.

source_text: and jacob sent messengers before him to esau his brother unto the land of seir, the field of edom.
target_text: ka yakob pua dhèu na pèri-pèri lasi uuru asa rai edom nuka seir, sèna ka lasi peka dènge a'a na esau, ho ne'a mamai na.

source_text: and he commanded them, saying, thus shall ye say unto my lord esau: thus saith thy servant jacob, i have sojourned with laban, and stayed until now:
target_text: hèia yakob peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, lami peka dènge a'a ku esau, sèmi ne'e: ‘lamatua esau! ènu mu yakob, hia ji'i ngèti lii karej'e-karae mi a'a na. peka na, karèi nèti ja'a pakèd'i, toke sange ne'e ne, ja'a pea ètu d'ara èmu to'o laban.

source_text: and i have oxen, and asses, and flocks, and men-servants, and maid-servants: and i have sent to tell my lord, that i may find favor in thy sight.
target_text: limuri ne, ènu lamatua na dènge le unu sapi, keled'ei, rupa-rupa kahib'i, dènge ènu bhèni-mone. ja'a hia uru dhèu se'e dhiu, ho peka dènge a'a ku, mamai ja'a ne. ja'a sanao sèna ka a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara kateme. ' èle ka dhèu se lasi.

source_text: and the messengers returned to jacob, saying, we came to thy brother esau, and moreover he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
target_text: ropa dhèu se lèpa hari mai, ra lolo dènge yakob, aku rèngu na, ji'i paraga le dènge a'a mu esau. nuka na mai re limuri nèi, dènge dhèu na èpa ngasu dhèu mone, neo mai paraga dènge èu.

source_text: then jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed: and he divided the people that were with him, and the flocks, and the herds, and the camels, into two companies;
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, sangasa yakob rèbha-rèbha, aa na madha'u ae. ka na hag'e eele dhèu na dènge badha-manu j'aj'i mi dua kaboko.

source_text: and he said, if esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the company which is left shall escape.
target_text: na pangee, ladhe esau mai, ho na age kaboko dhu uru, na kaboko dhu limuri bisa rai, tenge sod'a.

source_text: and jacob said, o god of my father abraham, and god of my father isaac, o jehovah, who saidst unto me, return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and i will do thee good:
target_text: hèia yakob manèngi-mangaj'i, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua! èu j'aj'i lamatua nèti baki ja'a abraham, aa nèti ama ku isak. nanene ku lii manèngi ja'a la! uru èèna, lamatua ka dhu hia ja'a lèpa asa a'ari ja'a, ètu kabarai ne'e. lamatua ka dhu moa tèke, peka na pe lamatua uri pamola j'ara.

source_text: i am not worthy of the least of all the lovingkindnesses, and of all the truth, which thou hast showed unto thy servant; for with my staff i passed over this jordan; and now i am become two companies.
target_text: ja'a ne madhutu mola-mola na, bisa boe abhu sasue dènge mamako lamatua. uru èèna, lod'o ja'a pège loko yarden, ja'a kèti dhoka tatea di. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a lèpa kèti dènge dhèu dua nau, aa dènge badha-manu ae.

source_text: deliver me, i pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of esau: for i fear him, lest he come and smite me, the mother with the children.
target_text: ja'a mangingi, mage dhoka a'a ja'a esau, mai pare pamadhe ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia mamuri mi ja'a, dènge ana-dhèu èmu-kamali aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: and thou saidst, i will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
target_text: lamatua dhu jaji tèke, èèna na pala-bagi mi dedha ja'a mamèngi ae-ae, aa hia ana-èpu ja'a bèba-kacanga, sama sèmi salae ètu nebhe dhasi, dhu dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: and he lodged there that night, and took of that which he had with him a present for esau his brother:
target_text: èle ka, yakob si j'unu ètu era èèna. asa bèli èèna, na hag'e badha pèri-pèri ngi'u ho rèti hia a'a na.

source_text: two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
target_text: na pili nare kahib'i rena dua ngasu ngi'u, kahib'i mone dua nguru ngi'u, kahib'i-kalèbho rena dua ngasu ngi'u, kahib'i-kalèbho mone dua nguru ngi'u,

source_text: thirty milch camels and their colts, forty cows and ten bulls, twenty she-asses and ten foals.
target_text: onta rena tèlu nguru ngi'u dènge ana susu, sapi rena èpa nguru ngi'u, canguru ngi'u sapi mone, keled'ei rena dua nguru ngi'u, dènge canguru ngi'u keled'ei mone.

source_text: and he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by itself, and said unto his servants, pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
target_text: ka na hag'e ka badha se, èci-èci ka dènge anga na. hèia na papala ka, èci-èci dènge ana madhenge na. ka na peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, miu kako uuru. pe ja'a dhiu. te ngaa mi palaladha ho kaboko èci pakaj'èu nèti kaboko dhu leo sèra.

source_text: and he commanded the foremost, saying, when esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?
target_text: ka na peka dènge kaboko dhu uuru tèka, aku nèngu na, ladhe a'a ku esau paraga dènge èu, aa na karèi, peka na, ‘èu lamu mia? èu ne, ènu nèti cee? badha-manu se, unu cee? '

source_text: then thou shalt say, they are thy servant jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord esau: and, behold, he also is behind us.
target_text: na mi dhaa, peka na, ‘badha-manu se, unu ènu mu, yakob. na pa'adhu hia a'a na, esau. te ngaa nèngu nuka nèti limuri nèi. '

source_text: and he commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, on this manner shall ye speak unto esau, when ye find him; and ye shall say, moreover, behold, thy servant jacob is behind us. for he said, i will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward i will see his face; peradventure he will accept me.
target_text: lii sèmi èèna, na peka kahèi dènge dhèu madhenga badha cahag'e sèra hèi, aku nèngu na, ladhe mi paraga dènge a'a ku esau, mi hia ne badha-manu se. aa mi peka dènge ne, ja'a re limuri. lula madhutu a'abhu yakob, na hia badha se aa'i-aa'i mi esau, èèna na esau sèmi nèngu dènge be'a.

source_text: so the present passed over before him: and he himself lodged that night in the company.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na hia uuru rèti badha se. te ngaa mèda èèna, nèngu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: and he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two handmaids, and his eleven children, and passed over the ford of the jabbok.
target_text: mèda na, yakob kèd'i, ka na pua dhèu èmu na dhèu dua, dènge dhèu èmu piara dhèu dua, dènge ana na dhèu canguru èci sèra, lasi uuru pège asa cabèka loko yabok.

source_text: and he took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai ca bèka loko, ka na hia aa'i mèdha-panyau na asa nèi.

source_text: and jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
target_text: te ngaa yakob pea ka mesa-mesa ètu èèna. hèia dhèu mone èci mai, ka dua ra palèka d'ai oe mèu.

source_text: and when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of jacob's thigh was strained, as he wrestled with him.
target_text: ropa mone ne ne'a na nèngu segi boe yakob, ka na kalabhe mi kolo keja yakob, ka gage na tabod'a eele nèti era na.

source_text: and he said, let me go, for the day breaketh. and he said, i will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
target_text: hèia mone ne lii, aku nèngu na, patabuli ja'a, te ciki hari, lod'o rea kèna. te ngaa, aku yakob na, èu hia ja'a mèngi-nale, heka ja'a patabuli èu kèna!

source_text: and he said unto him, what is thy name? and he said, jacob.
target_text: ka mone ne karèi ne, ngara èu ne, cee? na dhaa, peka na, yakob.

source_text: and he said, thy name shall be called no more jacob, but israel: for thou hast striven with god and with men, and hast prevailed.
target_text: hèia mone ne lii hari, aku nèngu na, èu ngara heka yakob. te ngaa mulai nèti deo ne'e ne, dhèu paroa èu, isra'el, lula èu lab'a le dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua, ka èu segi. ngara isra'el sasoa na ‘dhu palèka dènge ama lamatua'.

source_text: and jacob asked him, and said, tell me, i pray thee, thy name. and he said, wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? and he blessed him there.
target_text: ka yakob karèi ne, èu peka ku ngara èu la. te ngaa mone ne peka na, èu neo me'a ngara ja'a, tao ngaa? hèia na hia mèngi-nale mi yakob ètu era èèna.

source_text: and jacob called the name of the place peniel: for, said he, i have seen god face to face, and my life is preserved.
target_text: ka yakob padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a kèdhi le ama lamatua madha dènge madha, te ngaa ja'a mamuri era. nèti èèna ka, yakob pangare era èèna, peniel, dhu sasoa na, ‘rèhu lamatua'.

source_text: and the sun rose upon him as he passed over penuel, and he limped upon his thigh.
target_text: ropa yakob tèke eele era èèna, lod'o dhu rea le. te ngaa na kako ged'a, lula gage na tabod'a.

source_text: therefore the children of israel eat not the sinew of the hip which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of jacob's thigh in the sinew of the hip.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu isra'el ra'a boe sisi isi lasona, lula lamatua kalabhe patabod'a eele gage bèi-baki ra yakob.

source_text: and jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. and he divided the children unto leah, and unto rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
target_text: ètu d'ara lod'o èèna kahèi, yakob ladhe nèdhi esau, dènge dhèu na èpa ngasu sèra, mai asa rèngu. ka na papala ana na mi ina ra èci-èci.

source_text: and he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and leah and her children after, and rachel and joseph hindermost.
target_text: na hia dhèu èmu piara sèra dènge ana ra kako uuru. èle ka, lea dènge ana-ana na, heka rahel dènge ana na yusuf limuri tèka.

source_text: and he himself passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
target_text: te ngaa yakob kako uuru nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. ropa na padètu dènge a'a na, na patitu kètu urutuu, ka na pacud'u d'ai rai pidhu hari.

source_text: and esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o esau ladhe nèdhi ari na, rai dènge ka, la'e liku nare yakob. dua ra paliku dènge pa'uu. hèia dua ra tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, who are these with thee? and he said, the children whom god hath graciously given thy servant.
target_text: ropa esau nèdhi bhèni dènge ana-ana si, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, se'e se, cee ka se'e? ka yakob peka, rèngu se'e se, dhu ama lamatua pala-bagi hia ja'a, ènu a'a ku ne.

source_text: then the handmaids came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
target_text: hèia dhèu èmu piara na, dènge ana niki ra lasi pahaha iisi ètu madha esau.

source_text: and leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came joseph near and rachel, and they bowed themselves.
target_text: èle ka, lea dènge ana-ana na, lasi pahaha iisi mi esau kahèi. dhu lasi limuri, yusuf dènge ina na rahel lasi pahaha iisi mi esau kahèi.

source_text: and he said, what meanest thou by all this company which i met? and he said, to find favor in the sight of my lord.
target_text: èle èèna ka, esau karèi, aku nèngu na, èu pa'adhu badha pèri nau sèi, èu neo tao ngaa? hèia yakob dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, a'a! ja'a hia mi a'a ku, sèna ka a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara taleo.

source_text: and esau said, i have enough, my brother; let that which thou hast be thine.
target_text: te ngaa esau peka, ja'a dènge mèdha-panyau ae kahèi. de hia ia ka ja'a ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and jacob said, nay, i pray thee, if now i have found favor in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand; forasmuch as i have seen thy face, as one seeth the face of god, and thou wast pleased with me.
target_text: te ngaa yakob b'ala, peka na, baku, a'a. a'a ku hud'i sèmi la mèdha se, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara taleo. te ropa a'a ku b'ui mari, ka ja'a sèmi dhu kèdhi b'ui mari nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: take, i pray thee, my gift that is brought to thee; because god hath dealt graciously with me, and because i have enough. and he urged him, and he took it.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, a'a ku sèmi la mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua aad'o se. lula ama lamatua be'a titu kèna dènge ja'a ne. nèti èèna ka, na hia ja'a unu ngaa-ngaa se aa'i-aa'i. lula yakob pamako taruu, no'o do no'o boe èèna ka, esau sèmi nare kahèi.

source_text: and he said, let us take our journey, and let us go, and i will go before thee.
target_text: hèia esau peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, miu pa'èra ho lati palere. ja'a lere miu.

source_text: and he said unto him, my lord knoweth that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young: and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.
target_text: te ngaa aku yakob na, hud'i laa, a'a! a'a ku ladhe mèdhi unu mu. ana mu se, ana iiki ae era. rèngu se dhae èra èèna mèka. aa badha ae ka dhu heka matana. ladhe ta pakaseti si kako pamèri, ètu d'ara ca lod'o, èèna na madhe aa'i si.

source_text: let my lord, i pray thee, pass over before his servant: and i will lead on gently, according to the pace of the cattle that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until i come unto my lord unto seir.
target_text: de be'a risi, a'a ku si kako uuru. pe ji'i kako mau-mau dhiu. ladhe èèna na, ja'a dhiu ngad'o a'a ku ètu seir.

source_text: and esau said, let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. and he said, what needeth it? let me find favor in the sight of my lord.
target_text: hèia esau lii hari, na peka, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a tèke eele dhèu ja'a se cahag'e, sèna ka pad'elo j'ara hia miu. te ngaa, aku yakob na, hud'i laa, a'a, ee! sad'i ja'a ke'a le, a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge be'a.

source_text: so esau returned that day on his way unto seir.
target_text: tadèngi nare, esau pakèd'i ka, tèke eele si, lèpa asa seir.

source_text: and jacob journeyed to succoth, and built him a house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called succoth.
target_text: te ngaa nèti era èèna, yakob la'e asa sukot. d'ai nèi, na tao èmu dènge oka hia badha aa'i-aa'i ra. nèti èèna ka, era èèna ra pangare na sukot dhu sasoa na ‘èmu pea taha'.

source_text: and jacob came in peace to the city of shechem, which is in the land of canaan, when he came from paddan-aram; and encamped before the city.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu boe ka, yakob si kako nèti padan aram, lasi d'ai rae sikem ètu rai kana'an dènge sod'a-mole. hèia ra patitu paleo, sèna ka ra pea padètu dènge rae èèna.

source_text: and he bought the parcel of ground, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of hamor, shechem's father, for a hundred pieces of money.
target_text: rai dhu yakob patitu paleo ne, hèli nare nèti hemor, ana sikem. kab'ua rai ne, ca ngasu doi iia.

source_text: and he erected there an altar, and called it el-elohe-israel.
target_text: ètu era ne, na pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban. ka na pangare era ne'e, el-elohe-isra'el, dhu sasoa na ‘ama lamatua nèti isra'el'.

source_text: and dinah the daughter of leah, whom she bare unto jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
target_text: ca lod'o, dina, ana bhèni yakob dènge lea, la'e pangad'o dènge bhèni anga-aangalai na ètu rae èèna.

source_text: and shechem the son of hamor the hivite, the prince of the land, saw her; and he took her, and lay with her, and humbled her.
target_text: dhèu aae kabarai ne, ngara na hemor, nèti suku hewi. ngara ana mone na, sikem. ca tèka, sikem ladhe nèdhi dina, ka rai nèti ne, hèia na tao pakarehe ne.

source_text: and his soul clave unto dinah the daughter of jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.
target_text: sikem d'èi madhe-madhe dina ne. ka na solo mako, sèna ka dina no'o dènge ne.

source_text: and shechem spake unto his father hamor, saying, get me this damsel to wife.
target_text: hèia sikem peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ama! lamu karèi dina hia ja'a, sèna ka ja'a madhèdi dènge ne.

source_text: now jacob heard that he had defiled dinah his daughter; and his sons were with his cattle in the field: and jacob held his peace until they came.
target_text: tatao sikem ne, yakob dhu tadèngi le, te ngaa na mau-mau, aa tao boe ngaa-ngaa. te lod'o èèna, ana mone na sèra, ètu d'ara pad'a madhenge badha rèngu. ka na mate si mai ku.

source_text: and hamor the father of shechem went out unto jacob to commune with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, hemor, ama sikem, mai padhai lii dènge yakob, ho neo karèi dina hia sikem.

source_text: and the sons of jacob came in from the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in israel in lying with jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.
target_text: ètu talora dua ra padhue-padhai era, ana-ana yakob lèpa nèti d'ara pad'a. ropa ra tadèngi sikem dhu tao pakarehe le ana hèni ra, ka d'ara ra pèd'a, ka ra nasa bia. ka ra peka, madha j'ara dhu sèmi ne'e ne, lèke boe ètu isra'el. de ji'i se sèmi boe dhèu tao bhelu-katub'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: and hamor communed with them, saying, the soul of my son shechem longeth for your daughter: i pray you, give her unto him to wife.
target_text: ka hemor pamako yakob, aku nèngu na, ana ja'a sikem d'èi tare'a-re'a ana èu dina. de ja'a manèngi d'ara èu, sèna ka mo'o la, paleo ana bhèni èu dènge ne.

source_text: and make ye marriages with us; give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
target_text: ladhe mo'o ana-ana èdhi se paleo iisi-aanga ra. ana-ana mone nèti miu, madhèdi dènge ana-ana bhèni nèti ji'i. sèmi èèna kahèi, ana-ana mone ji'i madhèdi dènge ana-ana bhèni miu.

source_text: and ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
target_text: sèna ka èdhi pea pa'oru pa'èci ètu d'ara rai ne'e. sad'i miu d'èi era mia èèna ka, mi pea la dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. mi d'aga, sèna ka abhu kakaja ètu ne'e.

source_text: and shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, let me find favor in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me i will give. ask me never so much dowry and gift, and i will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
target_text: hèia sikem peka dènge ama dina dènge a'a na sèra, peka na, miu se, sad'i manèngi ngaa, ja'a dhoka madhutu di. masi ka miu manèngi doi pamèu madha, dènge kab'ua pèri-pèri èèna ka, ja'a hia. sad'i mo'o ja'a leo dènge ana hèni miu.

source_text: and the sons of jacob answered shechem and hamor his father with guile, and spake, because he had defiled dinah their sister,
target_text: te ngaa ana-ana yakob se re'a le, sikem dhu tao pakarehe ana hèni ra dina. hèia ra karihu-kahadhu, ka ra bèle, peka mi sikem dènge ama na hemor,

source_text: and said unto them, we cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us.
target_text: aku rèngu na, ji'i bisa boe hia ana hèni ji'i leo dènge dhèu dhu suna boe. te èèna na, era makae ji'i èèna!

source_text: only on this condition will we consent unto you: if ye will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised;
target_text: te ngaa j'ara na sèmi ne'e: miu se, hud'i sama ku sèmi ji'i, mone aa'i-aa'i ra, ana iiki, dhèu kapai, hud'i suna ku.

source_text: then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
target_text: ladhe miu madhutu j'ara ne'e, èdhi heka paleo kèna. aa ji'i pea ètu rai ne'e hèi, sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: but if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu madhutu boe dad'èi ji'i, aa mo'o boe suna, ji'i ngare hari ana hèni ji'i, ho kèd'i eele rai ne'e.

source_text: and their words pleased hamor, and shechem hamor's son.
target_text: hèia hemor dènge ana na sikem ro'o kahèi.

source_text: and the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in jacob's daughter: and he was honored above all the house of his father.
target_text: te ngaa sikem no'o heka mate, lula d'ara na d'èi ae dina. dhèu isi rai ètu èèna pakab'ua sikem ne titu kèna.

source_text: and hamor and shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,
target_text: ka hemor dènge sikem lasi asa era pama'ète lii, ètu hèb'a tedhe rae èèna, hèia ra padhue lii ne dènge kabarai sèra. ra peka, aku rèngu na,

source_text: these men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for, behold, the land is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dhèu isra'el se, d'èi mamuri mera-milu dènge èdhi. de hud'i laa ta pea pa'èci dènge rèngu ètu dedha-rai ne'e. rai ne taleo, de èdhi bisa pea pa'èci aa'i-aa'i ti. èdhi se bisa leo dènge ana bhèni rèngu. aa rèngu bisa madhèdi dènge ana bhèni èdhi kahèi.

source_text: only on this condition will the men consent unto us to dwell with us, to become one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
target_text: lii manèngi rèngu dhoka èci di, nèti èdhi se. ra manèngi, èdhi mone se aa'i-aa'i hud'i suna ku, madhutu ad'a rèngu.

source_text: shall not their cattle and their substance and all their beasts be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.
target_text: ladhe èdhi se pab'ali le dènge rèngu, èèna na badha-manu dènge mèdha-panyau ra j'aj'i unu èdhi. de be'a risi èdhi to'o la madhutu dad'èi ra. mai sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ti suna! mo'o, sina ma?

source_text: and unto hamor and unto shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra sa, sèmi lii padhai lii hemor dènge ana na sikem. hèia dhèu mone aa'i-aa'i ètu rai èèna suna palere-lere.

source_text: and it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of jacob, simeon and levi, dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city unawares, and slew all the males.
target_text: d'ara lod'o ka tèlu, ropa rèngu dhu suna se, nu'a ra dhu pèd'a era, ka ana mone dina, simeon dènge lewi, rare samala ra, kako mau-mau, lasi asa d'ara kota. ka dua ra pare pamadhe aa'i-aa'i dhèu mone sèra.

source_text: and they slew hamor and shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took dinah out of shechem's house, and went forth.
target_text: hemor dènge sikem, ra pare pamadhe kahèi. hèia ra rèti dènge ka dina nèti d'ara èmu sikem, lèpa èmu rèngu.

source_text: the sons of jacob came upon the slain, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.
target_text: aa ana yakob dhu cahag'e sèra, maso asa d'ara kota èèna, ra parama rèti aa'i mèu-mèu isi kabarai èèna. ra nasa, lula dhèu tao pakarehe ana hèni ra ètu èèna.

source_text: they took their flocks and their herds and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field;
target_text: ra parama rèti mèdha-panyau dhèu nèti d'ara èmu ra, dènge eo rèti badha-manu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara pad'a.

source_text: and all their wealth, and all their little ones and their wives, took they captive and made a prey, even all that was in the house.
target_text: rèti aa'i bhèni dènge ana-ana, aa parame rare aa'i mèdha dhu kab'ua nèti kabarai ne.

source_text: and jacob said to simeon and levi, ye have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the canaanites and the perizzites: and, i being few in number, they will gather themselves together against me and smite me; and i shall be destroyed, i and my house.
target_text: ropa yakob ne'a j'ara dhu j'aj'i èèna, na peka dènge simeon dènge lewi, miu dua mi se, goa ngaa ka ne'e? miu paj'èra ja'a! èèna na, dhèu kana'an dènge dhèu peris dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu dedha rai ne'e, tèka d'ara dènge èdhi se. rèngu se, dhèu ae-ae. te ngaa èdhi se, dhèu ciki di. ladhe rèngu se mai age èdhi, na, ra palaho aa'i èdhi.

source_text: and they said, should he deal with our sister as with a harlot?
target_text: te ngaa ana se dhaa dènge lii nasa, peka na, ama! ama pangee na hud'i laa ji'i soro tèke si, sèna ka ra tao ana hèni ji'i ne, bhèni kajeo!

source_text: and god said unto jacob, arise, go up to beth-el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto god, who appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of esau thy brother.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua padhai lii dènge yakob, peka na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu, lod'o èu rai nèti madha a'a mu esau. kèd'i, lamu dènge ka asa betel. ladhe d'ai nèi, mu patitu mei korban hia ja'a. aa pea dènge ka ètu èèna.

source_text: then jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, put away the foreign gods that are among you, and purify yourselves, and change your garments: and let us arise, and go up to beth-el; and i will make there an altar unto god, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which i went.
target_text: ka yakob peka dènge isi èmu na aa'i-aa'i, aku nèngu na, aa'i-aa'i ti lati dènge ka asa betel. uru èèna, lod'o ja'a ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, ama lamatua ka dhu ladhe-leru ja'a ètu èèna. ja'a neo tao mei korban ètu nèi. de mi core eele mèdha sogo-tagu miu. aa mi pamèu iisi mi, ho mi gati mèdha-papake leo, te èdhi neo pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: and they gave unto jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hand, and the rings which were in their ears; and jacob hid them under the oak which was by shechem.
target_text: ka ra oru mèdha sogo-tagu, dènge ate-ate ra aa'i-aa'i ra. hèia yakob dhènu mèdha se aa'i-aa'i ra ètu kapua aj'u aae ca kapua dhu padètu dènge rae sikem.

source_text: and they journeyed: and a terror of god was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of jacob.
target_text: ropa yakob dènge dhèu na aa'i-aa'i pakèd'i nèti sikem, ama lamatua hia d'ara madha'u mi dhèu-dhèu dhu pea ètu d'ara rae-rae dhu padètu dènge rae sikem, ka ra bani boe tao karehe mi yakob si.

source_text: so jacob came to luz, which is in the land of canaan the same is beth-el, he and all the people that were with him.
target_text: ka yakob si d'ai dènge sod'a ètu betel dhu uru èèna, ngara na lus, ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: and he built there an altar, and called the place el-beth-el; because there god was revealed unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
target_text: ètu ne'e, yakob pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban. ka na pangare era ne, el betel, sasoa na ‘betel unu ama lamatua', lula uru èèna ama lamatua pad'elo iisi mi yakob ètu era èèna, lod'o nèngu rai nèti madha a'a na.

source_text: and deborah rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried below beth-el under the oak: and the name of it was called allon-bacuth.
target_text: padètu dènge rae betel, abhu aj'u aae ca kapua, ngara na alon bakut. sasoa na ‘aj'u tangi dhèu madhe'. pake ngara ne, lod'o debora, ina dhu lalau-lalo'o ribka, madhe, ka padhane ètu karasa aj'u èèna.

source_text: and god appeared unto jacob again, when he came from paddan-aram, and blessed him.
target_text: lod'o yakob lèpa nèti padan aram, ama lamatua pad'elo hari iisi na, ka hia na berkat.

source_text: and god said unto him, thy name is jacob: thy name shall not be called any more jacob, but israel shall be thy name: and he called his name israel.
target_text: hèia lamatua peka dènge ne, nèti deo ne'e ne, èu ngara heka yakob, te ngaa isra'el.

source_text: and god said unto him, i am god almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
target_text: ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele. de èu matana pa'ae-ae, aa ana-èpu èu sèmi èèna kahèi. bèli-camèd'a, suku-suku mai nèti ana-èpu èu. aa nèti ana-èpu èu sèra, cèu dhèu aae-dhèu aae.

source_text: and the land which i gave unto abraham and isaac, to thee i will give it, and to thy seed after thee will i give the land.
target_text: rai dhu pangèd'u mi baki mu abraham, dènge ama mu isak, ja'a hia mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu.

source_text: and god went up from him in the place where he spake with him. and jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spake with him, a pillar of stone: and he poured out a drink-offering thereon, and poured oil thereon.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua peka nare, yakob patitu dènge hadhu ètu era èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha ho na baku bhèlu eele lii lamatua. ka na bhori èi anggor dènge èi mènyi mi dedha hadhu na, hèia na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and jacob called the name of the place where god spake with him, beth-el.
target_text: era èèna, na pangare ‘betel'.

source_text: and they journeyed from beth-el; and there was still some distance to come to ephrath: and rachel travailed, and she had hard labor.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si pakèd'i nèti betel. ropa rèngu kaj'èu èèna mèka nèti rae efrata nuka betlehem èèna, rahel dhu d'ai le lod'o nara iisi na. te ngaa nara iisi carui, hèia na roe titu kèna.

source_text: and it came to pass, when she was in hard labor, that the midwife said unto her, fear not; for now thou shalt have another son.
target_text: ka ropa na pèngu stenga madhe, dhèu ai tadha peka dènge ne, pa'èra d'ara èu, te mora iisi hari ana mone ca dhèu! de baku paroe iisi.

source_text: and it came to pass, as her soul was departing for she died, that she called his name ben-oni: but his father called him benjamin.
target_text: lod'o rahel oe ma'ète a'ae, na pangare ana ne, ben-oni, dhu sasoa na ‘ana nèti j'aj'èra ja'a'. ka heka na madhe kèna. te ngaa yakob hia ana ne ngara benyamin, dhu sasoa na ‘ana ai g'ana'.

source_text: and rachel died, and was buried in the way to ephrath the same is beth-lehem.
target_text: ka ra padhane rahel ètu sebhe j'ara dhu la'e asa efrata, dhu limuri ne, ngara na betlehem.

source_text: and jacob set up a pillar upon her grave: the same is the pillar of rachel's grave unto this day.
target_text: hèia yakob pudhi lutu bhatu ètu ro'a dhèu èmu na èèna. d'ai sange ne'e, ro'a rahel ne era.

source_text: and israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of eder.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob pea boe mi ca era sa. ca tèka, na patitu paleo ètu sebhe manara eder.

source_text: and it came to pass, while israel dwelt in that land, that reuben went and lay with bilhah his father's concubine: and israel heard of it. now the sons of jacob were twelve:
target_text: lod'o rèngu ètu era èèna, ruben j'unu dènge bilha, dhèu èmu piara ama na. èèna ka, yakob ne'a j'ara ne'e kahèi. ana mone yakob, canguru dua dhèu.

source_text: the sons of leah: reuben, jacob's first-born, and simeon, and levi, and judah, and issachar, and zebulun;
target_text: ana-ana nèti lea, nuka: ruben ana uuru yakob, simeon, lewi, yahuda, isaskar, dènge sebulon.

source_text: the sons of rachel: joseph and benjamin;
target_text: ana-ana rahel, nuka: yusuf dènge benyamin.

source_text: and the sons of bilhah, rachel's handmaid: dan and naphtali;
target_text: ana-ana nèti bilha, ènu rahel: dan dènge naftali.

source_text: and the sons of zilpah, leah's handmaid: gad and asher: these are the sons of jacob, that were born to him in paddan-aram.
target_text: aa ana-ana nèti silpa, ènu lea, nuka: gad dènge aser. rara iisi ana se ètu padan aram.

source_text: and jacob came unto isaac his father to mamre, to kiriath-arba the same is hebron, where abraham and isaac sojourned.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob la'e ngad'o ama na isak asa mamre, dhu dètu dènge kiryat-arba dhu limuri ne, ngara na hebron. uru èèna, baki na abraham pea ètu èèna.

source_text: and the days of isaac were a hundred and fourscore years. and isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, old and full of days: and esau and jacob his sons buried him.
target_text: umur isak d'ai ca ngasu aru nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna. ka ana na esau dènge yakob padhane ne.

source_text: now these are the generations of esau the same is edom.
target_text: ne'e ne, ana-èpu esau. ngara esau dhu leo, edom.

source_text: esau took his wives of the daughters of canaan: adah the daughter of elon the hittite, and oholibamah the daughter of anah, the daughter of zibeon the hivite,
target_text: esau leo dènge ana bhèni kana'an dhèu dua. èci dhèu het, ana bhèni nèti elon, ngara na ada. dhèu èmu na èci hari, dhèu hewi, ngara na oholibama. ama na, ngara na anah, aa baki na sibeon.

source_text: and basemath ishmael's daughter, sister of nebaioth.
target_text: esau leo kahèi dènge ana ismael, ngara na basmat. ana mone basmat, ngara na nebayot.

source_text: and adah bare to esau eliphaz; and basemath bare reuel;
target_text: ada, dhèu èmu uuru esau, nara iisi elifas. basmat matana rahuel.

source_text: and oholibamah bare jeush, and jalam, and korah: these are the sons of esau, that were born unto him in the land of canaan.
target_text: aa oholibama matana yeus, yalam dènge kora. ana esau aa'i-aa'i ra sèra rara iisi si ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: and esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the souls of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of canaan; and went into a land away from his brother jacob.
target_text: ca tèka, esau pidha asa rai leo cue dhu kaj'èu nèti yakob. la'e nèti aa'i bhèni-ana niki, dhèu-dhèu sab'a, badha-manu, dènge mèdha-panyau na.

source_text: for their substance was too great for them to dwell together; and the land of their sojournings could not bear them because of their cattle.
target_text: esau pacèri dènge yakob, lula badha-manu ra dènge mèdha-panyau ra ae d'ai seli. nèti èèna ka, era pea rèngu katata ètu rai èèna.

source_text: and esau dwelt in mount seir: esau is edom.
target_text: hèia esau nuka edom la'e pea ètu ledhe ètu seir.

source_text: and these are the generations of esau the father of the edomites in mount seir:
target_text: se'e se, ana-èpu esau dhu ra peka na ‘dhèu edom'. rèngu pea ètu era ledhe seir.

source_text: these are the names of esau's sons: eliphaz the son of adah the wife of esau, reuel the son of basemath the wife of esau. and the sons of eliphaz were teman, omar, zepho, and gatam, and kenaz. and timna was concubine to eliphaz esau's son; and she bare to eliphaz amalek: these are the sons of adah, esau's wife. and these are the sons of reuel: nahath, and zerah, shammah, and mizzah: these were the sons of basemath, esau's wife.
target_text: ada, dhèu èmu esau, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na elifas. elifas ne, ana mone na, dhèu lèmi, nuka: teman, omar, sefo, gatam dènge kenas. dhèu èmu piara elifas, ngara na timna. nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na amalek. dhèu èmu esau, basmat, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na rehuel. rehuel abhu ana mone dhèu èpa, nuka: nahat, sera, syama, dènge misa.

source_text: and these were the sons of oholibamah the daughter of anah, the daughter of zibeon, esau's wife: and she bare to esau jeush, and jalam, and korah.
target_text: dhèu èmu esau, oholibama, ana nèti anah, aa èpu nèti sibeon, nara iisi ana mone dhèu tèlu, nuka: yeus, yalam, dènge kora.

source_text: these are the chiefs of the sons of esau: the sons of eliphaz the first-born of esau: chief teman, chief omar, chief zepho, chief kenaz, chief korah, chief gatam, chief amalek: these are the chiefs that came of eliphaz in the land of edom; these are the sons of adah.
target_text: ana-èpu esau se pahag'a lème, ka j'aj'i mi suku ae-ae. èci-èci ka dènge kapala suku ra. ana-ana elifas, dhu ana uuru nèti esau, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku teman, suku omar, suku sefo, suku kenas, suku kora, suku gatam dènge suku amalek. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se'e, ana-èpu nèti esau dènge dhèu èmu na ada.

source_text: and these are the sons of reuel, esau's son: chief nahath, chief zerah, chief shammah, chief mizzah: these are the chiefs that came of reuel in the land of edom; these are the sons of basemath, esau's wife.
target_text: ana-ana rehuel, dhu ana nèti esau, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku nahat, suku sera, suku syama, dènge suku misa. aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu esau dènge dhèu èmu na, basmat.

source_text: and these are the sons of oholibamah, esau's wife: chief jeush, chief jalam, chief korah: these are the chiefs that came of oholibamah the daughter of anah, esau's wife.
target_text: ana-ana nèti esau dènge dhèu èmu na, oholibama, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku yeus, suku yalam, dènge suku kora.

source_text: these are the sons of esau, and these are their chiefs: the same is edom.
target_text: suku se'e aa'i-aa'i ra nèti ana-èpu esau.

source_text: these are the sons of seir the horite, the inhabitants of the land: lotan and shobal and zibeon and anah, and dishon and ezer and dishan: these are the chiefs that came of the horites, the children of seir in the land of edom.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu hori èci, ngara na seir. ana-ana na pahag'a palème rai, ka j'aj'i suku ae-ae. èci-èci ka dènge kapala suku na. èle èèna ka, ana-ana na se j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku lotan, suku sobal, suku sibeon, suku anah, suku dison, suku eser, dènge suku disan.

source_text: and the children of lotan were hori and heman; and lotan's sister was timna.
target_text: ana lotan nuka: hori dènge heman. ana hèni lotan, nuka timna.

source_text: and these are the children of shobal: alvan and manahath and ebal, shepho and onam.
target_text: ana-ana sobal, nuka: alwan, manahat, ebal, sefo, dènge onam.

source_text: and these are the children of zibeon: aiah and anah; this is anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of zibeon his father.
target_text: ana-ana nèti sibeon, nuka: aya, dènge anah. anah ne'e ka dhu rage madha èi pana ètu d'ara mamoo, lod'o na madhenga keled'ei ama na.

source_text: and these are the children of anah: dishon and oholibamah the daughter of anah. and these are the children of dishon: hemdan and eshban and ithran and cheran.
target_text: ana bhèni nèti anah, nuka oholibama. aa ana mone na, nuka, dison. ana-ana dison, nuka: hemdan, esban, yitran, dènge keran.

source_text: these are the children of ezer: bilhan and zaavan and akan.
target_text: ana-ana eser, nuka: bilhan, saawan, dènge akan.

source_text: these are the children of dishan: uz and aran.
target_text: ana-ana disan, nuka: us, dènge aran.

source_text: these are the chiefs that came of the horites: chief lotan, chief shobal, chief zibeon, chief anah, chief dishon, chief ezer, chief dishan: these are the chiefs that came of the horites, according to their chiefs in the land of seir.
target_text: de kapala-kapala suku nèti dhèu hori sèra, nuka: lotan, sobal, sibeon, anah, dison, eser, dènge disan. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se pea ètu rai seir.

source_text: and these are the kings that reigned in the land of edom, before there reigned any king over the children of israel.
target_text: lod'o dhu kabarai isra'el dènge mèka dhèu aae, te ngaa ètu rai edom dènge le dhèu aae. ngara dhèu aae se, dhutu-dhutu, nuka:

source_text: and bela the son of beor reigned in edom; and the name of his city was dinhabah.
target_text: ra ded'e bela, ana nèti beor, j'aj'i dhèu aae ètu kota dinhaba.

source_text: and bela died, and jobab the son of zerah of bozrah reigned in his stead.
target_text: ropa bela madhe, ra ded'e yobab ho gati ne, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na sera, nèti rae bosra.

source_text: and jobab died, and husham of the land of the temanites reigned in his stead.
target_text: ropa yobab madhe, ra ded'e husam ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. husam ne, nèti rai dhèu teman.

source_text: and husham died, and hadad the son of bedad, who smote midian in the field of moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was avith.
target_text: ropa husam madhe, ra ded'e hadad ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na bedad, nèti rae awit. nèngu ka dhu segi dhèu midian, lod'o ra pamusu ètu moab.

source_text: and hadad died, and samlah of masrekah reigned in his stead.
target_text: ropa hadad madhe, ra ded'e samla ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. nèngu ne, nèti rae masreka.

source_text: and samlah died, and shaul of rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
target_text: ropa samla madhe, ra ded'e saul ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. saul èèna, nèti rae rehobot, dhu ètu sebhe loko.

source_text: and shaul died, and baal-hanan the son of achbor reigned in his stead.
target_text: ropa saul madhe, ra ded'e baal-hanan ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na akbor.

source_text: and baal-hanan the son of achbor died, and hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was pau; and his wife's name was mehetabel, the daughter of matred, the daughter of me-zahab.
target_text: ropa baal-hanan madhe, ra ded'e hadar ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. hadar ne, nèti rae pau. aa dhèu èmu na, ngara mehetabel. ama mehetabel, ngara na matret. aa baki na, mesahab.

source_text: and these are the names of the chiefs that came of esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names: chief timna, chief alvah, chief jetheth, chief oholibamah, chief elah, chief pinon, chief kenaz, chief teman, chief mibzar, chief magdiel, chief iram: these are the chiefs of edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. this is esau, the father of the edomites.
target_text: de kapala-kapala suku dhu j'aj'i nèti ana-èpu esau, nuka: timna, alwa, yetet, oholibama, ela, pinon, kenas, teman, mibsar, magdiel, dènge iram. rèngu se èci-èci pangare rai ra madhutu ngara rèngu unu ra. de aa'i-aa'i se'e, lii lolo nèti ana-èpu esau, dhèu edom èèna.

source_text: and jacob dwelt in the land of his father's sojournings, in the land of canaan.
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lole nèti yakob si. ca tèka ka, yakob la'e pea hari asa rai kana'an. èèna, era pea ama na isak nèti uru ka.

source_text: these are the generations of jacob. joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and he was a lad with the sons of bilhah, and with the sons of zilpah, his father's wives: and joseph brought the evil report of them unto their father.
target_text: tèu èèna, ana yakob èci, nèti dhèu èmu na rahel, ngara na yusuf. yusuf ne'e, ropa umur na d'ai canguru pidhu tèu, nèngu dènge a'a na si, tema le j'aga kahib'i-kalèbho rèngu. a'a na sèra, ana nèti ina leo hari, ngara na bilha dènge silpa. te ngaa yusuf ne'e tuka tenge lii mi dedha a'a na si, ho la'e pana'e ama na.

source_text: now israel loved joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colors.
target_text: lod'o dhu rara iisi yusuf na, ama na dhu heka le. nèti èèna ka, na sue yusuf ne risi eele nèti ana-ana na leo sèra. ca lod'o ka, yakob j'au kodho madhera èci dhu saraga bia hia yusuf.

source_text: and his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren; and they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
target_text: ropa a'a na si ladhe-ladhe la'a na ama na sue risi yusuf, hèia ra mulai tèka d'ara dènge ne, ro'o boe padhai lii dènge ne.

source_text: and joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brethren: and they hated him yet the more. and he said unto them, hear, i pray you, this dream which i have dreamed: for, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves came round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka yusuf nii. kèd'i nèti bhèj'i ka, na lolo dènge a'a na si lii nii deo na, aku nèngu na, we! mi nanene ku la! ja'a nii, na èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, èki are ètu d'ara oka. kabèdhi laa, are dhu ja'a èki titu dhoo-dhoo. te ngaa are miu, oke mere are ja'a deo na, ka pacud'u mi unu ja'a. ra nanene rare sèmi èèna, hèia a'a na se'e tabha nasa hari dènge ne.

source_text: and his brethren said to him, shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? and they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
target_text: hèia ra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, we! èu ngee na, èu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai kèna, ho neo paredha ji'i, do? taga na lolo lii nii ne'e, hèia asa ra nasa dènge ne.

source_text: and he dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brethren, and said, behold, i have dreamed yet a dream; and, behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars made obeisance to me.
target_text: nèbhu boe, yusuf nii hari ca tèka. na lolo hari dènge a'a na si, aku nèngu na, we! ja'a nii hari, sèmi ne'e ka. ja'a kèdhi madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua-hètu canguru èci. aa'i-aa'i sèra, pahaha iisi mi ja'a.

source_text: and he told it to his father, and to his brethren; and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, what is this dream that thou hast dreamed? shall i and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
target_text: hèia yusuf lolo hari lii nii deo na dènge ama na, aa dènge a'a na sèra. ka ama na jèke ne, aku nèngu na, lii nii ngaa, kèna! èu ngee na, ja'a dènge ina mu, dènge a'ari èu sèra, mai uu kabaj'èla èu, do? èu nia ae le èèna, nga!

source_text: and his brethren envied him; but his father kept the saying in mind.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, a'a na sèra tèka d'ara bia dènge ne. te ngaa ama na pangee taruu lii nii èèna ètu d'ara na.

source_text: and his brethren went to feed their father's flock in shechem.
target_text: ca tèka ka, a'a yusuf sèra rèti kahib'i-kalèbho ama na, asa era j'u'u dètu dènge rae sikem.

source_text: and israel said unto joseph, are not thy brethren feeding the flock in shechem? come, and i will send thee unto them. and he said to him, here am i.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ama na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, a'a mu si j'aga kahib'i-kalèbho dètu dènge sikem. de èu pa'èra, ho lamu ladhe ku si la. ka yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a laku, ama.

source_text: and he said to him, go now, see whether it is well with thy brethren, and well with the flock; and bring me word again. so he sent him out of the vale of hebron, and he came to shechem.
target_text: hèia ama na peka hari, aku nèngu na, èu lamu ladhe a'a mu si, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho èdhi. ladhe ra samia na, mai peka dènge ja'a. ka yusuf pakèd'i ka nèti d'ara pad'a hebron, la'e taruu d'ai sikem.

source_text: and a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, what seekest thou?
target_text: d'ai nèi, na tenge a'a na si, palème d'ara pad'a èèna. na paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, ka dhèu èèna karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu tenge ngaa?

source_text: and he said, i am seeking my brethren: tell me, i pray thee, where they are feeding the flock.
target_text: yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a tenge a'a ja'a. rèngu eo kahib'i-kalèbho dètu ètu era ne'e. de ama, èu paraga dènge si, do aad'o?

source_text: and the man said, they are departed hence; for i heard them say, let us go to dothan. and joseph went after his brethren, and found them in dothan.
target_text: hèia, dhèu deo na peka, aku nèngu na, ra aad'o heka ètu ne'e. te ja'a tadèngi, ra peka na lasi padètu dènge rae dotan. hèia yusuf la'e taruu, ka paraga dènge si ètu rae dotan.

source_text: and they saw him afar off, and before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi yusuf nèti kaj'èu, ra padhue rare lii èci neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: and they said one to another, behold, this dreamer cometh.
target_text: èci peka dènge èci, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe ku la! mone eele tuka nii na, nuka mai nèi!

source_text: come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, an evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.
target_text: de mai ho ti pamadhe ne. ho èèna na, ti core eele ne asa d'ara madha èi madhe èèna. ladhe d'ai èmu na, ti peka dènge ama peka na, badha hui ra'e ne. ho èèna na, ti ladhe sèku, lii nii na sèra sa mia!

source_text: and reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, let us not take his life.
target_text: ropa nanene èèna, hèia a'a na ruben tenge j'ara ho patabuli eele yusuf. hèia na kai ari na si, aku nèngu na, we! èdhi baku pamadhe ne!

source_text: and reuben said unto them, shed no blood; cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand upon him: that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.
target_text: be'a risi èdhi kèpe ne, ti tao asa d'ara madha èi madhe nèi. ètu èèna, era dhu dhèu aad'o, de èci sa rèdhi boe ne. sad'i baku pasuti raa na. na peka sèmi èèna, lula na tenge j'ara ho patalale yusuf, ho hia na lèpa hari èmu.

source_text: and it came to pass, when joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stripped joseph of his coat, the coat of many colors that was on him;
target_text: ropa yusuf d'ai madha a'a na si, ra kèpe ne, ka ra rèbhi eele kodho dhu saraga aae ètu ua na.

source_text: and they took him, and cast him into the pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.
target_text: ka ra nuni pa'oro ne, hèia ra tule ne asa d'ara madha èi madhe èèna.

source_text: and they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a caravan of ishmaelites was coming from gilead, with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lèpa, lasi ra'a-rinu. ètu talora ra'a-rinu, kabèdhi la ra ladhe rèdhi dhèu canau mai re èèna. dhèu sèra kako rèti dènge badha onta ra, hue dènge mèdha d'aga, sèmi raa aj'u hèu mèngi, bubhu-bubhu dènge èi na'i rupa-rupa. dhèu sèra sa, dhèu ismael, dhu mai nèti rae gilead neo lasi kaj'èu d'ai masir.

source_text: and judah said unto his brethren, what profit is it if we slay our brother and conceal his blood?
target_text: èle èèna hèia, yahuda peka dènge a'ari na sèra, aku nèngu na, ee! be'a risi sèmi ne'e. èdhi baku pamadhe ne. a'oto na ngaa? tasa mera mia èèna ka, èdhi bisa boe pahuni raa na.

source_text: come, and let us sell him to the ishmaelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother, our flesh. and his brethren hearkened unto him.
target_text: be'a risi èdhi pahie ne dènge dhèu ismael sèi. èdhi tao ne samia èèna ka oo, nèngu ne'e ari d'èlu èdhi. nèti èèna ka, baku èdhi pamadhe ne! aa'i-aa'i ra d'èi kahèi dènge lii yahuda èèna.

source_text: and there passed by midianites, merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up joseph out of the pit, and sold joseph to the ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. and they brought joseph into egypt.
target_text: ropa dhèu d'aga sèra d'ai era èèna, hèia a'a yusuf sèra lasi ère rare ne, nèti d'ara madha èi madhe deo na. ka ra pahie ne mi dhèu ismael sèra dènge kab'ua dua nguru bua doi pudhi. ka dhèu ismael sèra rèti yusuf asa rai masir.

source_text: and reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
target_text: lod'o ra pahie yusuf ne, ruben ne'a boe. ropa na la'e patigi sa d'ara madha èi madhe na, capa na kabèdhi, ladhe la'a na yusuf aad'o heka ètu d'ara. nèti èèna ka, na ciu pamae kodho ètu ngi'u na, lula d'ara na pèd'a ae titu kèna.

source_text: and he returned unto his brethren, and said, the child is not; and i, whither shall i go?
target_text: hèia na la'e sa ari na si, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ari èdhi aad'o heka ètu era èèna! ja'a tao samia hari?

source_text: and they took joseph's coat, and killed a he-goat, and dipped the coat in the blood;
target_text: hèia ra roro kahib'i ci'u, ka rare kodho yusuf dhu saraga aae èèna, cèb'u sa d'ara raa kahib'i deo na.

source_text: and they sent the coat of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, this have we found: know now whether it is thy son's coat or not.
target_text: hèia ra lèpa ka rèti dènge kodho deo na, pad'elo dènge ama na, ka ra peka, aku rèngu na, ama! ji'i pili ngare kodho ne'e. ama ku ladhe sèku la. tao-tao ne'e kodho ari ji'i yusuf.

source_text: and he knew it, and said, it is my son's coat: an evil beast hath devoured him; joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.
target_text: ropa nèdhi kodho deo na, yakob tadhe dènge. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ne'e kodho ana ja'a. èle boe badha hui ra'e ana ja'a. ira iiii! ana ja'a madhe le!

source_text: and jacob rent his garments, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yakob ciu pamae kodho ètu ngi'u na, ka na pake karo, taga nèti d'ara na susa titu kèna. na tangi lii ooi-ooi sène nare lod'o nèbhu aae.

source_text: and all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, for i will go down to sheol to my son mourning. and his father wept for him.
target_text: ana na, ana mone dènge ana bhèni sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, mai padhai lii pakarej'e d'ara ama ra, te ngaa tao rare boe ne. aku nèngu na, aad'o! sasusa ja'a ne bisa d'ai madhe kèti. te ja'a bisa boe bhèlu ana èci ne'e. mema d'ara yakob j'èra taruu, lula na ngee nèdhi ana na yusuf dhu madhe èèna.

source_text: and the midianites sold him into egypt unto potiphar, an officer of pharaoh's, the captain of the guard.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o dhu yakob ètu d'ara susa era, dhèu d'aga sèra d'ai le masir. d'ai nèi, ka lasi pahie eele yusuf dènge dhèu kapai èci ètu nèi, ngara na potifar. dhèu ne'e komedhaa j'aga nèti dhèu aae masir.

source_text: and it came to pass at that time, that judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain adullamite, whose name was hirah.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yahuda tèke eele a'ari na, ka la'e pea dènge angalai na èci, ngara na hira, ètu rae adulam.

source_text: and judah saw there a daughter of a certain canaanite whose name was shua; and he took her, and went in unto her.
target_text: ètu èèna, dhèu mone èci, dhèu kana'an, ngara na sua. yahuda d'èi ana bhèni na èci, ka nare j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. dhèu èmu yahuda ne'e nara iisi ana mone pagod'o-pagod'o dhèu pèri-pèri.

source_text: and she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name er.
target_text: ana uuru èèna, ngara na er.

source_text: and she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name onan.
target_text: ana ka dua, ngara na onan.

source_text: and she yet again bare a son, and called his name shelah: and he was at chezib, when she bare him.
target_text: aa ana ka tèlu, ngara na sela. lod'o ina na nara iisi sela na, yahuda si pidha le asa rae kesib.

source_text: and judah took a wife for er his first-born, and her name was tamar.
target_text: ropa ana mone uuru, dhu ngara na er èèna kapai, ka ama na la'e tenge dhèu hia ne. ngara ana bhèni na tamar. ka dua ra j'aj'i paleo èmu.

source_text: and er, judah's first-born, was wicked in the sight of jehovah; and jehovah slew him.
target_text: lula er ne, bhelu-katub'a, ka ama lamatua huku pamadhe ne. nèti èèna ka, nèngu dènge boe kolo.

source_text: and judah said unto onan, go in unto thy brother's wife, and perform the duty of a husband's brother unto her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
target_text: hèia yahuda paroe nare ana mone ka dua na, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, onan! a'a mu er madhe, dènge boe ana. madhutu ad'a èdhi na, èu hud'i leo hari ku dènge dhèu èmu a'a mu ne. sèna ka èu bisa hia kolo hia a'a mu.

source_text: and onan knew that the seed would not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest he should give seed to his brother.
target_text: mema onan ne'a le ad'a sèmi ne'e. te ngaa na no'o boe hia kolo mi a'a na er. nèti èèna ka, ladhe rèngu j'unu pa'èci, na pasuti eele hua hini nèngu asa li'u, sèna ka tamar baku dènge babia.

source_text: and the thing which he did was evil in the sight of jehovah: and he slew him also.
target_text: taga tatao onan sèmi ne'e ka, lamatua nasa bia dènge ne. nèti èèna ka, lamatua huku pamadhe ne kahèi.

source_text: then said judah to tamar his daughter-in-law, remain a widow in thy father's house, till shelah my son be grown up; for he said, lest he also die, like his brethren. and tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.
target_text: ropa yahuda nèdhi ana mone na dua sèra dhu leo dènge tamar madhe sèmi èèna, hèia yahuda madha'u. ka na pangee mage dhoka ana mone ka tèlu èèna, leo hari dènge tamar na madhe kahèi. nèti èèna ka, la'e peka dènge tamar, aku nèngu na, be'a risi èu lèpa hari asa d'ara adhe-aai ina dènge ama mu. ladhe ana ja'a sela kapai, na èu lèpa hari mai ho leo dènge ne. hèia tamar lèpa dènge ka.

source_text: and in process of time shua's daughter, the wife of judah, died; and judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheep-shearers to timnah, he and his friend hirah the adullamite.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu hèia, dhèu èmu yahuda madhe. na j'èra toke d'ai pa'èle lod'o sasusa na. ka na la'e gale nare angalai na hira, ka lasi asa rae timna. ètu èèna, dhèu rame-rame g'ute rèu kahib'i-kalèbho ho pahia.

source_text: and it was told tamar, saying, behold, thy father-in-law goeth up to timnah to shear his sheep.
target_text: dhèu lolo dènge tamar, peka na, to'o mu la'e leru dhèu g'ute rèu kahib'i-kalèbho ètu rae timna.

source_text: and she put off from her the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of enaim, which is by the way to timnah; for she saw that shelah was grown up, and she was not given unto him to wife.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana limuri yahuda, ngara na sela, kapai le. te ngaa tamar ne'a le, na, to'o na no'o boe paleo sela dènge ne. nèti èèna ka, tamar tenge j'ara neo katèju hak nèngu. na bhoke eele mèdha-papake bhèni balu ètu ngi'u na, ka na silu mèdha-papake dhu be'a. na pake salalu pahutu kètu dènge rèhu na. ka la'e madhèdi ètu hèb'a tedhe sebhe j'ara rae enaim, dhu biasa dhèu kako re èèna lasi rae timna.

source_text: when judah saw her, he thought her to be a harlot; for she had covered her face.
target_text: ropa yahuda kako re èèna, na ladhe nèdhi dhèu bhèni èci madhèdi ètu èèna. na neo laa na dhèu bhèni kajeo, te tamar dhu lalau iisi dènge mèdha-papake saraga, aa pahutu rèhu na kahèi.

source_text: and he turned unto her by the way, and said, come, i pray thee, let me come in unto thee: for he knew not that she was his daughter-in-law. and she said, what wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
target_text: yahuda ne'a nare boe na dhèu bhèni na, dhèu èmu ana na dhu madhe sèra. hèia na kako la'e padètu dènge bhèni deo na ka, na peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ee! sèmi ja'a dènge èu na, èu manèngi ca ngaa? hèia tamar dhaa, aku nèngu na, èèna nèti d'ara d'èi ama.

source_text: and he said, i will send thee a kid of the goats from the flock. and she said, wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?
target_text: aku yahuda na, sa mia! sèmi ja'a hia èu kahib'i ci'u? hèia tamar dhaa hari, aku nèngu na, bisa ama. sad'i ama hia ku ja'a mèdha èci ho ja'a kèd'u. pe pèri lod'o ho ama pa'adhu kahib'i èèna mai oo, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: and he said, what pledge shall i give thee? and she said, thy signet and thy cord, and thy staff that is in thy hand. and he gave them to her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him. and she arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
target_text: hèia yahuda karèi hari, aku nèngu na, de ja'a tèka mèdha ngaa mi èu? tamar dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama tèke eele cap, dènge dhari dhu ama inu, dènge tatea dhu ama kèpe èèna hèi. nanene nare ka, yahuda hia mèdha sèra la'e. hèia dua ra lasi bhèj'i ka. èle èèna ka, tamar lèpa la'e èmu. d'ai èmu ka, na bhoke mèdha-papake saraga dènge salalu, ka gati dènge mèdha-papake bhèni balu. nèti èèna ka, tamar dènge babia.

source_text: and judah sent the kid of the goats by the hand of his friend the adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.
target_text: nèbhu boe hèia, yahuda manèngi tolong angalai na hira, aku nèngu na, èu mèti kahib'i ne'e hia dhèu bhèni kajeo dhu ètu enaim èèna, ho mèti hari mèdha ja'a dhu ètu nèngu sèra. lod'o hira la'e d'ai nèi, na karèi palème, te ngaa paraga boe dènge bhèni èèna.

source_text: then he asked the men of her place, saying, where is the prostitute, that was at enaim by the wayside? and they said, there hath been no prostitute here.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, eee! miu mèdhi dhèu bhèni kajeo dhu biasa madhèdi ètu hèb'a tedhe èèna, do? na ètu mia, ee? dhèu sèra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama, ètu ne'e bhèni kajeo aad'o!

source_text: and he returned to judah, and said, i have not found her; and also the men of the place said, there hath been no prostitute here.
target_text: hèia hira lèpa hari peka dènge yahuda, aku nèngu na, ja'a paraga boe dènge bhèni èèna. ja'a tenge palème, te ngaa dhèu ètu sèra peka aku rèngu na, ètu rae èèna bhèni kajeo aad'o.

source_text: and judah said, let her take it to her, lest we be put to shame: behold, i sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.
target_text: yahuda dhaa, aku nèngu na, hud'i ka la, nèngu abhu mèdha sèra! sad'i dhèu baku pamakae èdhi! ja'a neo b'ae, te ngaa èdhi paraga boe dènge bhèni èèna na.

source_text: and it came to pass about three months after, that it was told judah, saying, tamar thy daughter-in-law hath played the harlot; and moreover, behold, she is with child by whoredom. and judah said, bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
target_text: ropa d'ai tèlu hèru hèia, dhèu lasi lolo dènge yahuda, peka na, dhèu èmu ana èu na tao ngi'u na sèmi dhèu bhèni kajeo. ka na dènge babia le. nanene nare èèna hèia, yahuda nasa bia. hèia na pua dhèu, aku nèngu na, lami nuni pa'oro ne mai, ho labhu asa d'ara ai la'e!

source_text: when she was brought forth, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, by the man, whose these are, am i with child: and she said, discern, i pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and the cords, and the staff.
target_text: ka dhèu lasi ka nuni rèti tamar mai. te ngaa na pad'elo cap dènge tatea èèna. ka na pua dhèu lasi peka dènge to'o na, aku nèngu na, parisa ku mèdha se'e. dhèu dhu unu cap dènge tatea ne'e ka dhu ad'u-ue tatao ne'e, ka ja'a dènge babia ne.

source_text: and judah acknowledged them, and said, she is more righteous than i, forasmuch as i gave her not to shelah my son. and he knew her again no more.
target_text: ropa nèdhi mèdha se'e, yahuda tadhe dènge, na mèdha sèra unu nèngu. hèia na padhai lii dènge ka, aku nèngu na, mema dhèu bhèni ne'e sala boe. ja'a ka dhu sala. madhutu iia na, ja'a ka dhu paleo bhèni ne'e dènge ana ja'a sela. te ngaa ja'a ka ko'o boe. karèi nèti èèna ka, yahuda pa'èci heka dènge tamar.

source_text: and it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
target_text: d'ai hèru ka tamar nara iisi ana dhèu dua.

source_text: and it came to pass, when she travailed, that one put out a hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, this came out first.
target_text: lod'o tamar nara iisi na, kabèdhi laa ana èci pacèu uuru kacui-aai èci sa li'u mai. ka dhèu ai tadha dhu panara iisi na nare loa hèngu mea, ka èki mi kanau riti na. bhèni na peka, aku nèngu na, ana uuru ka ne'e.

source_text: and it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, wherefore hast thou made a breach for thyself? therefore his name was called perez.
target_text: te ngaa ana èèna ère hari kacui-aai na sa d'ara. hèia, ana èci na kalua uuru hari. nèdhi sèmi èèna hèia, bhèni ai tadha èèna peka, aku nèngu na, waa! èu èra titu kèna! nèti èèna ka, èu paseti ho kalua uuru sa li'u. bhèni na pangare ne, peres, dhu sasoa na, ‘paseti sa li'u'.

source_text: and afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called zerah.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhu èki dènge loa hèngu mea deo na kalua. ra pangare ne sera sasoa na ‘mea gèu-gèu'.

source_text: and joseph was brought down to egypt; and potiphar, an officer of pharaoh's, the captain of the guard, an egyptian, bought him of the hand of the ishmaelites, that had brought him down thither. and jehovah was with joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the egyptian.
target_text: dhèu ismael sèra rèti yusuf d'ai masir, hèia ra pahie eele ne dènge dhèu kapai èci ètu nèi, ngara na potifar. dhèu ne'e komedhaa sordad'u dhu j'aga ètu dhèu aae masir. yusuf j'aj'i ènu ètu èmu potifar. ètu èèna, lamatua dènge yusuf, ka sasab'a ngaa dhu na tao, nèti babe'a hua-hua.

source_text: and his master saw that jehovah was with him, and that jehovah made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
target_text: dhèu kapai ne'e ladhe-ladhe na, sasab'a yusuf nèti babe'a hua, ka na ngee ètu d'ara na, lamatua tare'a-re'a dènge yusuf.

source_text: and joseph found favor in his sight, and he ministered unto him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, komedhaa ne'e d'èi yusuf, ka na lèka ne. hèia na ded'e ne j'aj'i madho ètu èmu na. aa, na hia ne paredha d'ara èmu nèngu, sèmi èèna kahèi, mèdha-panyau na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and it came to pass from the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that jehovah blessed the egyptian's house for joseph's sake; and the blessing of jehovah was upon all that he had, in the house and in the field.
target_text: lula yusuf pea ètu èèna, ka lamatua hia mamuri hua iia mi lamatua èmu, dhèu masir èèna. isi èmu na, mèdha-panyau na, oka-tedhe na, aa sasab'a-la'a na, j'aj'i dènge be'a.

source_text: and he left all that he had in joseph's hand; and he knew not aught that was with him, save the bread which he did eat. and joseph was comely, and well-favored.
target_text: lula potifar ladhe-ladhe la'a na yusuf sab'a dènge be'a, ka na pangee heka ngaa-ngaa, dhoka na'a-ninu di. yusuf ne, mone iia.

source_text: and it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon joseph; and she said, lie with me.
target_text: na pea ètu èèna nèbhu mèka. te ngaa dhèu èmu potifar na, d'èi yusuf. ka na mai pamako ne ho dua ra j'unu pa'èci.

source_text: but he refused, and said unto his master's wife, behold, my master knoweth not what is with me in the house, and he hath put all that he hath into my hand:
target_text: te ngaa yusuf no'o boe. ka na peka sèmi ne'e ka, baku ina ee! ja'a ne, ènu potifar, dhu na pangèd'u le koasa ho ja'a tao ai-hèb'a mi sasab'a nèngu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: he is not greater in this house than i; neither hath he kept back anything from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can i do this great wickedness, and sin against god?
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu ne'e, abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu koasa risi nèti ja'a. aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu d'ara èmu ne'e, na saraka mi kacui-aai ja'a. dhodhoka ina ku di, aad'o. tasamia ka, ja'a bisa tao j'ara karehe ne'e. èèna lèke boe dènge dad'èi ama lamatua!

source_text: and it came to pass, as she spake to joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu èmu potifar ne pakaseti taruu bèli-bèli. te ngaa yusuf ne tao boe madha-dhilu dènge ne.

source_text: and it came to pass about this time, that he went into the house to do his work; and there was none of the men of the house there within.
target_text: ca tèka, yusuf kako la'e asa d'ara èmu, ho sab'a sasab'a nèngu. lod'o èèna, dhèu leo aad'o èci sa ètu èmu.

source_text: and she caught him by his garment, saying, lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
target_text: ka dhèu èmu potifar na raga mai ka, na kèpe kodho yusuf, ka na ère ne, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, mai! ata dhodhoka èdhi dua ti. de mai ho ti j'unu. te ngaa yusuf d'èi boe. ka na parui, hèia kodho na bhoke eele nèti ua na, ka na rai asa li'u. aa kodho deo na ètu kacui-aai bhèni èèna era.

source_text: and it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,
target_text: ropa dhèu èmu potifar ladhe laa, na, yusuf rai li'u le la'e, aa kodho na tèke eele,

source_text: that she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, see, he hath brought in a hebrew unto us to mock us: he came in unto me to lie with me, and i cried with a loud voice: and it came to pass, when he heard that i lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled, and got him out.
target_text: hèia na paroa dhèu sab'a sèra, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, we! miu mai ladhe ku laa! deo na, ana mone dhèu ibrani na, maso sa d'ara kama ja'a. na neo pamakae ja'a. malo ka ja'a pa'oo, ka na rai, tèke eele kodho na ètu ja'a ne. dhèu èmu ja'a ne, nèti dhèu bhelu asa d'ara èmu, ho hia èdhi ta'e makae!

source_text: and she laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.
target_text: bhèni na kèpe pa'ère kodho èèna, toke d'ai dhèu èmu na lèpa.

source_text: and she spake unto him according to these words, saying, the hebrew servant, whom thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:
target_text: ropa dhèu èmu na nare d'ara èmu, na lolo peka na, a'a! dhèu ibrani dhu mèti mai sa èmu ne'e, deo na maso asa d'ara kama ja'a, neo pakarehe ja'a!

source_text: and it came to pass, as i lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled out.
target_text: malo ka ja'a pa'oo, paroa ana sab'a se'e. hèia na rai tèke eele kodho na, ka ne'e.

source_text: and it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, after this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.
target_text: tadèngi nare lii lolo dhèu èmu na, potifar nasa bia.

source_text: and joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king's prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.
target_text: hèia na paredha ka dhèu lasi kèpe yusuf. ka ra pamaso asa d'ara bèdho dhèu aae.

source_text: but jehovah was with joseph, and showed kindness unto him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua bhèlu boe yusuf. nèti èèna ka, lamatua ladhe-leru ne taruu, ka kapala ètu d'ara bèdho èèna, sue yusuf ae titu kèna.

source_text: and the keeper of the prison committed to joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.
target_text: na lèka yusuf, ka hia ne j'aj'i madho ho laladhe ana bèdho sèra aa'i-aa'i ra. aa, hia na lalau sasab'a ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: the keeper of the prison looked not to anything that was under his hand, because jehovah was with him; and that which he did, jehovah made it to prosper.
target_text: lula lèka ne, ka kapala èmu bèdho na, tao heka ai-hèb'a mi ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho èèna. lamatua ladhe-leru taruu yusuf, nèti èèna ka, sasab'a ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho na kako dènge be'a.

source_text: and it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of egypt and his baker offended their lord the king of egypt. and pharaoh was wroth against his two officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers. and he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where joseph was bound.
target_text: ètu d'ara bèdho èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu dua, dhu uru na j'aj'i kapala urusan ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae masir. èci lalau dhua èi dhèu aae. aa èci hari lalau roti dhèu aae. dua ra tao pasala dhèu aae. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aae nasa, ka na pamaso si asa d'ara bèdho. dua ra pea ètu era èci dènge yusuf.

source_text: and the captain of the guard charged joseph with them, and he ministered unto them: and they continued a season in ward.
target_text: kapala èmu bèdho na, paredha yusuf lalau dhèu dua se'e. ra ètu d'ara bèdho na, ele boe ca tèu do dua tèu le.

source_text: and they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of egypt, who were bound in the prison.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka, dua ra nii. ca dhèu ka dènge nii na. aa, lii nii dua sèra, èci-èci ka dènge sasoa na.

source_text: and joseph came in unto them in the morning, and saw them, and, behold, they were sad.
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, yusuf ladhe na dua ra rèhu susa.

source_text: and he asked pharaoh's officers that were with him in ward in his master's house, saying, wherefore look ye so sad to-day?
target_text: ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka mad'ae ne'e, miu dua mi roe-roe?

source_text: and they said unto him, we have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it. and joseph said unto them, do not interpretations belong to god? tell it me, i pray you.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, peka na, mèda deo na, ji'i nii. te ngaa ji'i nge'a boe sasoa na samia! hèia yusuf peka dènge dua ra, aku nèngu na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne'e, èci sa re'a boe sasoa nii, dhodhoka ama lamatua di. de miu lolo ku laa. pe èèna ho ja'a karèi sasoa nèti lamatua.

source_text: and the chief butler told his dream to joseph, and said to him, in my dream, behold, a vine was before me;
target_text: hèia dhèu dhu lalau dhua èi hia dhèu aae èèna, lolo uuru peka na, ètu d'ara nii, ja'a ladhe kèdhi aj'u anggor ca kapua.

source_text: and in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and its blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
target_text: aj'u anggor ne dadana nèngu tèlu di. aj'u na muri mai ka dènge rèu, hela, dènge hua giru-gari dhu madhasa.

source_text: and pharaoh's cup was in my hand; and i took the grapes, and pressed them into pharaoh's cup, and i gave the cup into pharaoh's hand.
target_text: aa ja'a kèd'u galaa dhu dhèu aae biasa pake ninu. ja'a puu hua anggor, ka pacèli èi sa d'ara galaa deo na. hèia kèti asa dhèu aae, hia na ninu.

source_text: and joseph said unto him, this is the interpretation of it: the three branches are three days;
target_text: tadèngi nare hèia, yusuf peka dènge ne sèmi ne'e ka, ama, ee. sasoa nii na sèmi ne'e ka: dadana tèlu, sasoa na di tèlu lod'o ka.

source_text: within yet three days shall pharaoh lift up thy head, and restore thee unto thine office: and thou shalt give pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.
target_text: ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o ne, dhèu aae kalua eele ama nèti d'ara bèdho ne'e. ho na hia hari, ama lalau dhua èi hia dhèu aae sèmi uru na.
