source_text: but have me in thy remembrance when it shall be well with thee, and show kindness, i pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:
target_text: ladhe ama abhu babe'a sèmi èèna, baku bhèlu ja'a, ee? ladhe ama sue ja'a, peka dènge dhèu aae kalua eele ja'a nèti era ne'e.

source_text: for indeed i was stolen away out of the land of the hebrews: and here also have i done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.
target_text: te ja'a ne, madhutu madha j'ara na dhu mola, rèngu se rare ja'a dènge laka-seti, nèti rae dhèu ibrani. d'ai era ne'e, ja'a tao boe sasala ngaa èci sa. te ngaa rèngu pamaso ja'a asa d'ara bèdho ne'e. rèngu tao ja'a sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa.

source_text: when the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto joseph, i also was in my dream, and, behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head:
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sasoa nii ne'e be'a mi dedha angalai na, hèia dhèu èci dhu lalau roti na, lolo hari nii nèngu, peka na, ari yusuf. nii ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a tèd'u soe pagod'o-god'o tèlu.

source_text: and in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of baked food for pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.
target_text: ètu d'ara soe re dedha tèka na, pènu dènge koki dhèu aae, dhu rupa ae titu kèna. te ngaa manu-bhui lela mai ka ra'e aa'i koki d'ara soe dhu ètu kètu ja'a na.

source_text: and joseph answered and said, this is the interpretation thereof: the three baskets are three days;
target_text: ropa yusuf tadèngi nare, ka na dhaa, peka na, sasoa lii nii ama, sèmi ne'e ka: soe tèlu sèra, sama kahèi dènge tèlu lod'o.

source_text: within yet three days shall pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.
target_text: d'ara tèlu lod'o ne, mu ladhe, te dhèu aae pua dhèu mai poro rare kètu èu. ho èèna na, ra kadhoe ngi'u aae èu ètu agarii. hèia manu-bhui tutu ra'e aa'i sisi èu.

source_text: and it came to pass the third day, which was pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and the head of the chief baker among his servants.
target_text: ropa d'ai tèlu lod'o, dhu lèke dènge lod'o hari jadi dhèu aae, na tao tatao dhu kapai hia dhèu kapai na aa'i-aa'i sèra. na paredha ho dhèu lasi kalua eele dhèu dua sèra nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into pharaoh's hand:
target_text: ka na hia hari mone dhu lalau dhua èi na, sab'e sasab'a nèngu uru na.

source_text: but he hanged the chief baker: as joseph had interpreted to them.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu lalau roti dhèu aae èèna, ra poro eele kètu na, ka ra kadhoe ngi'u na, sama sèmi ngaa dhu yusuf peka dènge rèngu dua ra.

source_text: yet did not the chief butler remember joseph, but forgat him.
target_text: te ngaa mone dhu lalau dhua èi dhèu aae ne, sanèd'e heka yusuf. na bhèlu eele lii moa yusuf.

source_text: and it came to pass at the end of two full years, that pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
target_text: pe d'ai dua tèu risi sa, hèia dhèu aae masir nii. na nii na, nèngu dhu titu ètu sebhe loko nil.

source_text: and, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, well-favored and fat-fleshed; and they fed in the reed-grass.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, nèngu nèdhi sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu kabèb'u bia. ka'uri ra kale'e. ra kalua nèti d'ara loko, ka ra'a j'u'u ètu sebhe loko èèna.

source_text: and, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill-favored and lean-fleshed, and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.
target_text: nèbhu boe, sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu leo hari, kalua nèti d'ara loko deo na. ngi'u sapi sèra malaka-god'a. ra titu padètu dènge sapi kabèb'u sèra.

source_text: and the ill-favored and lean-fleshed kine did eat up the seven well-favored and fat kine. so pharaoh awoke.
target_text: hèia sapi malaka pidhu ngi'u sèra, dhèle aa'i pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u sèra. hèia dhèu aae kabèdhi, ka na marèi dènge.

source_text: and he slept and dreamed a second time: and, behold, seven ears of grain came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu aae bhèj'i luu hari. ka na nii hari ca tèka. lii nii na sèmi ne'e ka: nèngu ladhe nèdhi are pidhu huri dhu isi pènu, bhodho nèti laa are dhu sub'u.

source_text: and, behold, seven ears, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nèdhi hari are pidhu huri dhu isi aad'o, aa dhu kamale dhae-dhae sène, lèke lai ngèlu dhu pana.

source_text: and the thin ears swallowed up the seven rank and full ears. and pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
target_text: ka pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o sèra, dhèle aa'i pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu deo sa. hèia dhèu aae kabèdhi ka nèti bhèj'i. heka nèngu ne'a kèna, nèngu dhu nii hari di.

source_text: and it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto pharaoh.
target_text: mad'ae aae èèna, d'ara isi na be'a boe. hèia, na paredha dhèu lasi paroa aa'i dhèu ai tadha dènge dhèu d'èlu-mèu, ètu rai masir mai paraga dènge ne. ka na lolo lii nii na sèra dènge si. te ngaa dhèu èci sa bisa boe peka sasoa lii nii deo sa mi dhèu aae.

source_text: then spake the chief butler unto pharaoh, saying, i do remember my faults this day:
target_text: ka mone dhu lalau dhua èi dhèu aae èèna, heka sanèd'e nèdhi yusuf kèna. hèia la'e peka dènge dhèu aae, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a mangaku sala.

source_text: pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, me and the chief baker:
target_text: uru èèna, dhu ama ku nasa dènge ja'a, dènge angalai ku èci na, ka pamaso ji'i asa d'ara bèdho,

source_text: and we dreamed a dream in one night, i and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka, ji'i dua mi nii. èci-èci ka dènge nii na. aa sasoa nii se'e, sama boe kahèi.

source_text: and there was with us there a young man, a hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
target_text: ètu d'ara bèdho na, abhu ana mone ibrani èci. kapala èmu bèdho nedhe ana mone ne, j'aj'i kapala urusan ho lalau ji'i. ji'i lolo lii nii ji'i dènge ne, ka na peka sasoa lii nii sèra dènge ji'i.

source_text: and it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama dhèu aae ded'e hari ja'a. aa angalai ja'a na, abhu huku madhe. se'e se j'aj'i sama sèmi ngaa dhu ana mone ibrani na peka.

source_text: then pharaoh sent and called joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto pharaoh.
target_text: nanene nare lii ne'e hèia, dhèu aae pua dhèu lasi lai-lai rare yusuf nèti d'ara bèdho mai. ka yusuf pamèu iisi na, aa na gati mèdha-papake na, ka na la'e paraga dènge dhèu aae.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto joseph, i have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and i have heard say of thee, that when thou hearest a dream thou canst interpret it.
target_text: ropa na d'ai madha hèia, dhèu aae peka, ja'a nii, te ngaa dhèu èci sa re'a boe sasoa lii nii sèra. te ngaa dhèu peka na èu me'a.

source_text: and joseph answered pharaoh, saying, it is not in me: god will give pharaoh an answer of peace.
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae. ja'a èèna ka oo, ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa kahèi. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu ne'a, ho na peka sasoa lii nii sa, dènge lèke. na neo peka lii dhu be'a mi ama dhèu aae.

source_text: and pharaoh spake unto joseph, in my dream, behold, i stood upon the brink of the river:
target_text: hèia dhèu aae lolo ka, lii nii sèra dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ètu d'ara nii èèna, ja'a titu ètu sebhe loko nil.

source_text: and, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fat-fleshed and well-favored: and they fed in the reed-grass:
target_text: ja'a ladhe la'a na sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu kabèb'u bia, dènge ka'uri dhu kale'e. ra kalua nèti d'ara loko mai, ka ra'a j'u'u ètu sebhe loko èèna.

source_text: and, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill-favored and lean-fleshed, such as i never saw in all the land of egypt for badness:
target_text: hèia sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu leo mai hari. rèngu se'e dhu malaka-god'a. ètu rai masir ne'e, ja'a kèdhi mèka sapi dhu malaka-god'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: and the lean and ill-favored kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
target_text: dhu pamalaa ja'a, pidhu sapi dhu malaka-god'a sèra, kabèdhi laa dhèle aa'i pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u se.

source_text: and when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill-favored, as at the beginning. so i awoke.
target_text: sapi dhu malaka sèra dhèle aa'i, te ngaa ngi'u ra malaka taruu sèmi èèna ka. hèia ja'a kabèdhi dènge ka.

source_text: and i saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up upon one stalk, full and good:
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a bhèj'i luu hari, ka nii hari ca tèka. ja'a kèdhi pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu, kalua nèti laa are ca kapua dhu sub'u.

source_text: and, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi hari, pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o, aa dhu kamale dhae-dhae, lèke lai ngèlu pana.

source_text: and the thin ears swallowed up the seven good ears: and i told it unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
target_text: ka pidhu huri are dhu bèdhu sèra dhèle aa'i pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu sèra. èle èèna ka, ja'a kèd'i nèti bhèj'i. ka ja'a lolo lii nii se'e mi dhèu d'èlu-mèu se'e, te ngaa èci sa bisa boe peka sasoa lii nii sèra.

source_text: and joseph said unto pharaoh, the dream of pharaoh is one: what god is about to do he hath declared unto pharaoh.
target_text: hèia yusuf padhai lii, peka na, ama dhèu aae! lii nii dua sèra, sasoa na dhoka èci di. ama lamatua peka le, mi ama dhèu aae, ngaa dhu na neo tao.

source_text: the seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
target_text: sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u, dènge pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu sèra, sasoa na, tèu dhu bècu-manèsa pidhu tèu. sasoa ra dhoka èci di.

source_text: and the seven lean and ill-favored kine that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind; they shall be seven years of famine.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, pidhu sapi dhu malaka-god'a, dènge pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o, sasoa na, tèu manganga pidhu tèu.

source_text: that is the thing which i spake unto pharaoh: what god is about to do he hath showed unto pharaoh.
target_text: de lamatua dhu peka mema le, ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. èèna sama kahèi, dènge ngaa dhu ja'a peka deo na.

source_text: behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of egypt:
target_text: ladhe bèli-camèd'a, ètu rai masir ne'e, d'ara pidhu tèu, èdhi abhu bècu-manèsa palème rae.

source_text: and there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of egypt; and the famine shall consume the land; and the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine which followeth; for it shall be very grievous.
target_text: èle èèna na, heka èdhi abhu manganga d'ara pidhu tèu. d'ara pidhu tèu na, manganga madèu aae. toke èdhi abhu boe nganga'a calamusi sa, ètu dedha rai masir ne'e. dhèu aa'i-aa'i manganga ae titu kèna, ka ra bhèlu eele uru na dhu rèngu abhu le babècu pidhu tèu.

source_text: and for that the dream was doubled unto pharaoh, it is because the thing is established by god, and god will shortly bring it to pass.
target_text: de ladhe ama dhèu aae abhu nii dua hari, sasoa na, ama lamatua ka dhu ator tèke. nèbhu heka, ngaa dhu na ator ne, j'aj'i kèna.

source_text: now therefore let pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of egypt.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: be'a risi ama dhèu aae tenge dhèu d'èlu-mèu èci, dhu bisa tao ai-hèb'a la'a dènge be'a. aa ded'e ne, ho ladhe-leru kabarai ne'e dènge be'a.

source_text: let pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of egypt in the seven plenteous years.
target_text: d'ara pidhu tèu dhu bècu èèna, be'a risi ama dhèu aae ded'e hari dhèu, ho ra oru-pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele. nganga'a dhu risi sèra, bagi mi lèmi ho tèke ca pala.

source_text: and let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and lay up grain under the hand of pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.
target_text: ana kabarai ne'e, hud'i madhutu dènge be'a paredha ama dhèu aae, ho pakaboko are-are dhu risi eele, nèti rae-rae ètu rai masir ne'e. aa ra soli sa d'ara soka ho j'aga paie.

source_text: and the food shall be for a store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
target_text: sèna ka pidhu tèu dhu manganga nèi mai te, èdhi dhu sadia le nganga'a. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èci sa madhe boe manganga.

source_text: and the thing was good in the eyes of pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai lii yusuf ne, dhèu aae dènge dhèu kapai sèra, sèmi ngaa dhu na peka dènge dhèu aae èèna.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto his servants, can we find such a one as this, a man in whom the spirit of god is?
target_text: ka dhèu aae padhai lii, peka na, roh ama lamatua hia le koasa mi yusuf ne'e. nèti èèna ka, èdhi abhu heka dhèu dhu risi nèti nèngu.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto joseph, forasmuch as god hath showed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou:
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, ama lamatua peka dènge èu, ngaa-ngaa se'e aa'i-aa'i. nèti sèmi ne'e ka, heka ji'i nge'a kèna èu ne'e tare'a-re'a dhèu mèu. aa mamèu èu ne, risi eele dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will i be greater than thou.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo ne'e kahèi ja'a ded'e èu j'aj'i ai g'ana ja'a. sèna ka èu j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu d'ara èmu ja'a. aa ana kabarai ja'a nanene lii paredha èu. dhoka ja'a di dhu risi nèti èu.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto joseph, see, i have set thee over all the land of egypt. and pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it upon joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae puru eele kadheli dhu dènge cap nèti ai na, ka na pasaluu mi ai yusuf. ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, dènge ne'e ne, ja'a ded'e èu, j'aj'i ai g'ana ja'a ètu rai masir. hèia na papake kodho madhera dhu milu èci mi yusuf, aa na pa'inu rate hualaa cakoko mi ladha-goro na.

source_text: and he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, bow the knee: and he set him over all the land of egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae hia hari yusuf kareta ka dua nèngu. ka na hia dhèu lasi uuru, ho pa'oo peka na, we! patalele j'ara oo! pahaha iisi mliu! dhèu kapai neo re ne'e! dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aae ded'e le yusuf, j'aj'i ai g'ana na ètu rai masir.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto joseph, i am pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of egypt.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, sèmi ne'e. èu dhu me'a le ja'a ne dhèu aae. te ngaa ja'a peka le dènge ana kabarai masir aa'i-aa'i, peka na, ladhe èu hia boe ijin, rèngu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa.

source_text: and pharaoh called joseph's name zaphenath-paneah; and he gave him to wife asenath, the daughter of poti-phera priest of on. and joseph went out over the land of egypt.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu aae pangare yusuf madhutu ngara masir, na safnat panea. aa, na hia yusuf madhèdi dènge ana bhèni èci, ngara na asnat. ama dhèu èmu na, ngara na potifera. nèngu ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i ama agama ètu d'ara kota on. dènge j'ara ne'e, yusuf j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu rai masir.

source_text: and joseph was thirty years old when he stood before pharaoh king of egypt. and joseph went out from the presence of pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of egypt.
target_text: lod'o na j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu rai masir, umur nèngu tèlu nguru tèu le. hèia na kako palème rai masir.

source_text: and in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
target_text: ètu d'ara pidhu tèu dhu bècu-manèsa ne'e, oka-tedhe pènu dènge nganga'a.

source_text: and he gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
target_text: hèia yusuf kaboko nganga'a dhu risi, ka na tèka paia si. ètu era mia dhu na pakaboko nganga'a, ètu èèna kahèi na soli asa d'ara soka.

source_text: and joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left off numbering; for it was without number.
target_text: are dhu pakaboko nare, ae titu kèna. èci èèna ka, dènge salae ètu nebhe dhasi, ka dhèu uku rare heka.

source_text: and unto joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom asenath, the daughter of poti-phera priest of on, bare unto him.
target_text: d'ai mèka tèu manganga, dhèu èmu yusuf, asnat nara iisi le ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: and joseph called the name of the first-born manasseh: for, said he, god hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.
target_text: ka yusuf padhai lii, peka na, ama lamatua tao j'ara ne'e, sèna ka pabhèlu ja'a nèti j'aj'èra dhu lod'o ja'a kalua nèti d'ara èmu ama ku. nèti èèna ka, ana uuru, na pangare ne manase dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘bhèlu'.

source_text: and the name of the second called he ephraim: for god hath made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.
target_text: lod'o na abhu ana ka dua, na padhai lii hari, peka na, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae d'ai seli ètu era ne'e. te ngaa sasue dènge ladhe-leru ama lamatua ka, ja'a abhu ana ètu ne'e. ka na pangare ana ne'e efraim.

source_text: and the seven years of plenty, that was in the land of egypt, came to an end.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, èle pidhu tèu dhu bècu-manèsa na.

source_text: and the seven years of famine began to come, according as joseph had said: and there was famine in all lands; but in all the land of egypt there was bread.
target_text: aa pidhu tèu manganga madèu d'ai kèna, sama sèmi dhu uru èèna yusuf peka le. ètu era leo, dhèu manganga le. te ngaa rae-rae ètu masir nganga'a ae era.

source_text: and when all the land of egypt was famished, the people cried to pharaoh for bread: and pharaoh said unto all the egyptians, go unto joseph; what he saith to you, do.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, kabarai masir manganga kahèi. ka lasi asa dhèu aae ho ra manèngi nganga'a. aa dhèu aae pua si lasi asa yusuf, sèna ka ra madhutu paredha yusuf.

source_text: and the famine was over all the face of the earth: and joseph opened all the store-houses, and sold unto the egyptians; and the famine was sore in the land of egypt.
target_text: te ngaa rai manganga ètu mia-mia asa tabha, toke d'ai rae-rae ètu rai masir. nèti èèna ka, yusuf bhoke aa'i soka nganga'a sèna ka pahie dènge dhèu masir.

source_text: and all countries came into egypt to joseph to buy grain, because the famine was sore in all the earth.
target_text: lula manganga ae titu kèna, ka dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli nganga'a ètu yusuf ètu rai masir.

source_text: now jacob saw that there was grain in egypt, and jacob said unto his sons, why do ye look one upon another?
target_text: tèu èèna, yakob tadèngi dhèu palolo na abhu are ètu masir. ka na peka dènge ana na si, aku nèngu na, ana ee! miu nga tao madhèdi mau-mau ka laa?

source_text: and he said, behold, i have heard that there is grain in egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi na ètu masir pahia nganga'a. hua iia lami hèli, sèna ka èdhi baku madhe manganga.

source_text: and joseph's ten brethren went down to buy grain from egypt.
target_text: ka a'a yusuf canguru dhèu se'e pa'èra ka, lasi hèli nganga'a asa masir.

source_text: but benjamin, joseph's brother, jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, lest peradventure harm befall him.
target_text: te ngaa yakob hia boe ari yusuf dhu ngara na benyamin, la'e dènge a'a na si. te, na pangee, mage dhoka, ana ne'e abhu hari j'aj'èra ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: and the sons of israel came to buy among those that came: for the famine was in the land of canaan.
target_text: lula dhèu ae nèti mia-mia tadèngi le abhu nganga'a ètu masir, ka ra lasi hèli asa nèi. manganga ne d'ai le rai kana'an kahèi. ka ana-ana yakob se, lasi hèli kahèi asa masir.

source_text: and joseph was the governor over the land; he it was that sold to all the people of the land. and joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves to him with their faces to the earth.
target_text: tèu èèna, yusuf j'aj'i ai g'ana dhèu aae masir. ladhe dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli are, yusuf ka dhu pahia. nèti èèna ka, lod'o a'a na si d'ai nèi, rèngu patitu kètu urutuu, ho tab'e yusuf toke rèhu rèngu oe d'ai rai.

source_text: and joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly with them; and he said unto them, whence come ye? and they said, from the land of canaan to buy food. and joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
target_text: ropa yusuf ladhe nèdhi a'a na si, na tadhe le èèna. te ngaa yusuf tao iisi sèmi dhèu masir. nèti èèna ka, rèngu tadhe boe ne hèi. hèia na jèka si, aku nèngu na, ee! miu se nèti mia? hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ji'i se nèti kana'an. ji'i mai hèli nganga'a sa ama wakil.

source_text: and joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
target_text: hèia yusuf sanèd'e lii nii na uru na. ka na pamadha'u si, aku nèngu na, ja'a lèka boe! miu se'e dhèu mata-mata. miu mai tenge rahasia rai masir, ho èèna na mai musu rai ji'i!

source_text: and they said unto him, nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.
target_text: te ngaa ra dhaa peka na, aad'o, ama! ji'i se'e dhoka ana pua-paleha nèti ama di. tare'a-re'a ji'i mai sa ne'e ne, neo hèli nganga'a di. leo nèti èèna, aad'o.

source_text: we are all one man's sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.
target_text: ji'i aa'i-aa'i se'e, ana nèti ca ama di. ji'i mai mata-mata boe rai ama ku si ne'e. ji'i se'e dhèu be'a.

source_text: and he said unto them, nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
target_text: te ngaa yusuf jèka si dènge lii mèdhu hari, peka na, he! omo koso! baku kapod'e-kabèli ja'a. miu se'e tare'a-re'a dhèu bhelu. miu mai tenge rahasia rai ne'e!

source_text: and they said, we thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.
target_text: ka ra peka, aad'o ama! ji'i se'e ana pua-paleha ama ku di. ji'i mai nèti rai kana'an. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi nèti ca ama, canguru dua dhèu. ari ji'i dhu limuri tèka, pea dènge ama ji'i. aa ari ji'i èci aad'o heka!

source_text: and joseph said unto them, that is it that i spake unto you, saying, ye are spies:
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o! lèke sèmi lii ja'a deo na! miu se'e dhèu mata-mata.

source_text: hereby ye shall be proved: by the life of pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.
target_text: na! karèi sèmi èèna, na miu hia ku tadha èci, sèna ka ja'a ke'a lii padhai lii miu deo sa, tare'a, do aad'o. ja'a subha ee! ladhe ari miu dhu limuri na, d'ai boe ne'e, miu èci sa bisa boe kalua nèti rai ne'e!

source_text: send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be bound, that your words may be proved, whether there be truth in you: or else by the life of pharaoh surely ye are spies.
target_text: de hua iia miu pua dhèu èci la'e, ho nèti ari miu dhu limuri èèna asa ne'e mai. aa miu dhu leo se, ja'a taha. ja'a neo ke'a miu se'e peka tare'a, do aad'o. ladhe aad'o, miu se'e tare'a-re'a mata-mata.

source_text: and he put them all together into ward three days.
target_text: ka yusuf pua taha si d'ara bèdho tèlu lod'o.

source_text: and joseph said unto them the third day, this do, and live; for i fear god:
target_text: d'ai lod'o ka tèlu, yusuf la'e padhai lii dènge ra ètu d'ara bèdho, peka na, ja'a ne'e, ca dhèu dhu madha'u dènge lamatua. aa ja'a madhutu dad'èi na taruu. sèna ka miu mamuri, ja'a neo patabuli miu. te ngaa hud'i dènge ku lii pajaji.

source_text: if ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in your prison-house; but go ye, carry grain for the famine of your houses:
target_text: ladhe miu se'e tare'a padhai lii dhu mola, miu pad'elo ku ngaa èci j'aj'i mi tadha. j'ara na sèmi ne'e: ja'a taha ca dhèu ètu d'ara bèdho ne'e. dhèu leo lèpa ho mèti nganga'a hia a'ari miu, te ra tatae miu lami mèti nganga'a.

source_text: and bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. and they did so.
target_text: d'ai nèi, miu mèti ari miu dhu limuri èèna mai asa ne'e, ho j'aj'i bukti, tare'a miu se'e dhèu be'a. sèna ka ja'a baku huku pamadhe miu. ropa ra tadèngi rare ne'e, ra d'èi kahèi sèmi èèna.

source_text: and they said one to another, we are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
target_text: ka ra padhue-padhai ka èci dènge èci, peka na, waa! ne'e ne, èdhi heka abhu b'ala kèna, lula sala dhu èdhi ad'u-ue mi dedha ari èdhi uru na. èdhi ladhe tèdhi nèngu j'èra titu kèna, d'ai na manèngi sasue èdhi, te ngaa èdhi pusi boe ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi abhu j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: and reuben answered them, saying, spake i not unto you, saying, do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore also, behold, his blood is required.
target_text: hèia ruben pasanèd'e si, peka na, we! ari-ari ja'a, ee! uru na ja'a kai le miu, ho baku paj'èra ana èèna, si? te ngaa miu-miu se'e ka dhu mo'o boe nanene lii ja'a. nèti èèna ka, lod'o ne'e èdhi dui tare raa ari èdhi yusuf èèna.

source_text: and they knew not that joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.
target_text: rèngu padhai lii ae-ae sèmi èèna, re'a boe na yusuf ne'a lii rèngu kahèi. lod'o yusuf padhai lii dènge rèngu, na pake lii masir, ho èèna na dhèu leo lole hari pake lii ibrani.

source_text: and he turned himself about from them, and wept; and he returned to them, and spake to them, and took simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.
target_text: tadèngi ra padhai lii sèmi èèna hèia, yusuf kèd'i eele si, la'e tangi asa era leo. tangi nare, la'e hari pa'èci dènge si. ka na pua dhèu èki simeon ètu madha a'ari na sèra.

source_text: then joseph commanded to fill their vessels with grain, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus was it done unto them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf paredha dhèu sab'a sèra, ho soli are asa d'ara karo a'a na si. aa tao hari doi kab'ua are sèra, asa d'ara karo ra èci-èci. ra tèke ètu hèb'a karo sèra. na pua dhèu sab'a se'e, ho hia si dènge gee. ka dhèu sab'a se'e lalau ka, madhutu ngaa dhu yusuf paredha.

source_text: and they laded their asses with their grain, and departed thence.
target_text: èle ka, a'a na si hua karo nganga'a sèra asa dedha badha keled'ei. ka ra pakèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: and as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the lodging-place, he espied his money; and, behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.
target_text: ropa d'ai talora j'ara, ra ae. dhèu èci bhoke karo na, ho neo ani keled'ei na. na ladhe la'a na, doi na ètu dedha are, ètu d'ara karo èèna.

source_text: and he said unto his brethren, my money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they turned trembling one to another, saying, what is this that god hath done unto us?
target_text: capa na cag'ag'a! hèia na paroa a'a na si, peka na, irii! miu mai ladhe ku laa! madhe èdhi kèna. ra tao hari doi ja'a asa d'ara karo ne. ladhe rèdhi èèna ka, ra ele ngangee, aa madha'u bia. ka ra papeka ka, aku rèngu na, ama lamatua tao èdhi samia ka ne?

source_text: and they came unto jacob their father unto the land of canaan, and told him all that had befallen them, saying,
target_text: hèia ra kako taruu ka, lasi d'ai kana'an. d'ai nèi ka, ra lolo dènge ama ra, ngaa dhu rèngu paraga ètu rai masir.

source_text: the man, the lord of the land, spake roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.
target_text: ra lolo, peka na, ama, ee! ai g'ana dhèu aae masir èèna, bhelu titu kèna. na jèka taruu ji'i. na peka na ji'i la'a j'aj'i mata-mata ho neo pa'ele iie rai masir.

source_text: and we said unto him, we are true men; we are no spies:
target_text: ka ji'i dhaa, peka na, ‘aad'o! ji'i se'e padhai lii mola-mola. ji'i mata-mata boe.

source_text: we are twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of canaan.
target_text: ji'i se'e, dhèu be'a-be'a. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi, j'aj'i nèti ca ama, dhèu canguru dua. te ngaa èci madhe le. aa ari dhu limuri èèna, dènge ama ji'i ètu kana'an. '

source_text: and the man, the lord of the land, said unto us, hereby shall i know that ye are true men: leave one of your brethren with me, and take grain for the famine of your houses, and go your way;

source_text: and thou saidst unto thy servants, bring him down unto me, that i may set mine eyes upon him.
target_text: ka ama pua ho ji'i ngèti ari ji'i na mai, sèna ka ama nèdhi ne.

source_text: and we said unto my lord, the lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
target_text: ka ji'i dhaa na, ‘ana èèna, bisa boe tèke eele ama na mesa na. ladhe na tèke eele, na ama ji'i na tatu madhe dènge kèna. '

source_text: and thou saidst unto thy servants, except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
target_text: hèia ama dhaa na, ‘ladhe miu mèti boe ari miu na, baku mi pad'elo hari rèhu mi sa ne'e. '

source_text: and it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ji'i lèpa. d'ai nèi ka, ji'i lolo lii dhu mu moa sèra dènge ama ji'i.

source_text: and our father said, go again, buy us a little food.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu, nganga'a ji'i èla. hèia ama ji'i pua hari ji'i mai hèli nganga'a sa masir ne'e.

source_text: and we said, we cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down; for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother be with us.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i dhaa na, ‘ama, ee! ji'i la'a heka sa nèi. te ai g'ana dhèu aae na dhu moa le, aku nèngu na, ladhe ji'i ngèti boe ari ji'i dhu limuri na, bisa heka ji'i pad'elo rèhu sa nèi. de ladhe ari ji'i la'e hèi, na heka ji'i la'a kèna. '

source_text: and thy servant my father said unto us, ye know that my wife bare me two sons:
target_text: ama ji'i peka hari, aku nèngu na, ‘miu me'a kahèi, si ma? dhèu èmu ja'a rahel èèna, ana na dhoka dua di.

source_text: and the one went out from me, and i said, surely he is torn in pieces; and i have not seen him since:
target_text: ana uuru èèna, aad'o heka. ele boe badha hui na'e aa'i le. nèti èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi heka rèhu na toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: and if ye take this one also from me, and harm befall him, ye will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to sheol.
target_text: ladhe miu mèti hari ana limuri ne, ho sèmi na abhu j'aj'èra, èèna miu paj'èra ja'a dhèu heka ne'e. ladhe sèmi èèna na, ja'a madhe dènge kèna. '

source_text: now therefore when i come to thy servant my father, and the lad is not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life; it will come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants will bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to sheol.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama, ladhe ja'a lèpa kèti boe dènge ari ji'i ne, ama ji'i madhe dènge kèna. te samanga na dhu pa'èki dènge ana ne'e di. dènge ètu d'ara haheka na ne'e, ladhe ji'i tao ne tabha j'èra, tatu na madhe dènge kèna.

source_text: for thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, if i bring him not unto thee, then shall i bear the blame to my father for ever.
target_text: ngaa hari, ja'a moa le mi ama ku, peka na, ‘ja'a ka dhu tago ana ne'e. ladhe ja'a kèti heka ana ne'e mai sa madha ama, ja'a ka tago sasala na, toke d'ai ja'a madhe. '

source_text: now therefore, let thy servant, i pray thee, abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e, ama wakil: hud'i laa ja'a ka pea mi ne'e gati nèngu, sèna ka ja'a j'aj'i ènu ama wakil. hia ne lèpa dènge a'a na si.

source_text: for how shall i go up to my father, if the lad be not with me? lest i see the evil that shall come on my father.
target_text: ladhe ana ne'e la'e boe, ja'a bisa boe lèpa kahèi. d'ara ja'a la'e boe ladhe j'aj'èra ama ji'i toke madhe.

source_text: then joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, cause every man to go out from me. and there stood no man with him, while joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii yahuda na, d'ara yusuf roe bhilu, toke taha nare boe ètu madha dhèu sab'a na sèra. nèti èèna ka, na hia ra lasi asa li'u, sèna ka mesa na di, dènge a'ari na ètu d'ara èmu. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu bisa patadhe iisi na, mi a'ari na sèra.

source_text: and he wept aloud: and the egyptians heard, and the house of pharaoh heard.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a se'e kalua asa li'u, ka yusuf tangi dènge d'ara pèd'a. lii tangi na mèdhu, ka dhèu-dhèu masir ètu li'u sèra tadèngi kahèi. mesa boe dhèu ètu li'u sèra, te dhèu ètu èmu dhèu aae tadèngi kahèi.

source_text: and joseph said unto his brethren, i am joseph; doth my father yet live? and his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
target_text: ka yusuf peka mola-mola dènge a'ari na si, aku nèngu na, a'ari, ee! ja'a ne'e ka yusuf èèna! ama ku mamuri era, do? ropa tadèngi rare, a'a na sèra madha'u titu kèna. ra bisa heka bhoke hèb'a padhai lii ngaa èci sa.

source_text: and joseph said unto his brethren, come near to me, i pray you. and they came near. and he said, i am joseph your brother, whom ye sold into egypt.
target_text: hèia yusuf paroa si, peka na, mai ku padètu-dètu dènge ja'a. ka ara lasi padètu sa madha yusuf. ka na peka hari, ja'a ne, yusuf, dhu uru èèna, miu pahia eele asa masir ne'e.

source_text: and now be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for god did send me before you to preserve life.
target_text: miu se tare'a pahie eele ja'a. te ngaa mage miu madha'u, aa baku peka cee ka dhu sala. lula ama lamatua ka dhu hia uuru ja'a mai sa ne'e. ho dènge j'ara ne'e, na pake ja'a ho hia mamuri mi dhèu ae. sèna ka baku madhe manganga.

source_text: for these two years hath the famine been in the land: and there are yet five years, in which there shall be neither plowing nor harvest.
target_text: rai manganga ne heka dua tèu kèna. lèmi tèu era. bèli-camèd'a dhèu tao heka oka-tedhe, sèla heka, aa abhu heka nganga'a hèru èj'i lai.

source_text: and god sent me before you to preserve you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.
target_text: dènge j'ara dhu èdhi te'a boe ne, ama lamatua hia ja'a mai asa ne'e uru nèti miu. sèna ka, miu dènge ana-èpu miu abhu mamuri.

source_text: so now it was not you that sent me hither, but god: and he hath made me a father to pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of egypt.
target_text: de dhu lèke, nèti boe tatao miu ka ja'a d'ai era ne'e, te ngaa tatao ama lamatua di. nèngu ka dhu hia ja'a j'aj'i ai g'ana dhèu aae masir. ka ja'a j'aj'i mi kapala urusan ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae. abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a.

source_text: haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, thus saith thy son joseph, god hath made me lord of all egypt: come down unto me, tarry not;
target_text: de miu lami ka lai-lai ne, ho peka lii padhai lii ja'a ne dènge ama ku, sèmi ne'e: ‘yusuf, ana ama ku, mamuri era! nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu kapai ètu rai masir. na manèngi ama ku la'e lai-lai asa nèi.

source_text: and thou shalt dwell in the land of goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
target_text: ho èèna na, ama pea ètu rai gosen padètu dènge nèngu. era na be'a aa taleo. sèna ka ama bisa piara kahib'i-kalèbho, kahib'i-ka'ia dènge sapi aa'i-aa'i ra. aa na manèngi kahèi ho ama la'e dènge ana-èpu, dènge isi èmu, dènge mèdha-panyau, ho pea taruu mi nèi.

source_text: and there will i nourish thee; for there are yet five years of famine; lest thou come to poverty, thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast.
target_text: ladhe ama pea ètu gosen, nèngu ladhe-leru ama ètu nèi. te rai manganga lèmi tèu era. sèna ka na tenge j'ara ho ama dènge ana-èpu, aa dènge badha-manu bisa mamuri dènge be'a. '

source_text: and, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
target_text: yusuf peka nare hèia, na padhai lii hari, peka na, miu unu mi mèdhi le, si? aa èu kahèi, benyamin. ja'a ne'e, tare'a-re'a yusuf.

source_text: and ye shall tell my father of all my glory in egypt, and of all that ye have seen: and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.
target_text: de miu peka dènge ama èdhi, na, ja'a ne'e dènge koasa kapai titu kèna, ètu kabarai masir ne'e. aa lolo dènge ama, ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu miu mèdhi le ètu ne'e. ho èèna na, karohe mèti ama sa ne'e mai!

source_text: and he fell upon his brother benjamin's neck, and wept; and benjamin wept upon his neck.
target_text: èle èèna ka, liku nare ari na benyamin, hèia dua ra tangi.

source_text: and he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, na liku nare a'a na si èci-èci, ka na uu si. ka heka ra bani padhai lii dènge ne kèna.

source_text: and the report thereof was heard in pharaoh's house, saying, joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased pharaoh well, and his servants.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae dènge dhèu-dhèu kapai na sèra, tadèngi rare a'ari yusuf mai asa masir, ra karej'e kahèi.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto joseph, say unto thy brethren, this do ye: lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of canaan;
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ari! peka dènge a'ari èu sèra, ho hua ka nganga'a asa dedha keled'ei rèngu, sèna ka rèti sa kana'an.

source_text: and take your father and your households, and come unto me: and i will give you the good of the land of egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
target_text: aa peka dènge si, rèti ama mu dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i, mai pea sa ne'e. d'ai ne'e, pe ja'a hia rèngu rai, era dhu hèu mèngi risi, sèna ka rèngu bisa mamuri nèti isi rai èèna.

source_text: now thou art commanded, this do ye: take you wagons out of the land of egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
target_text: aa hia rèti mema dènge kareta pèri-pèri nèti ne'e, ho sèna ka hua ana iiki-ana iiki dènge ama mu.

source_text: also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of egypt is yours.
target_text: baku ra pangee mèdha-panyau dhu rèngu bisa boe nedhe rèti, te, ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a ètu rai masir ne, èèna na j'aj'i unu rèngu.

source_text: and the sons of israel did so: and joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yusuf hia si kareta pèri-pèri bua, dènge parèko ra'a j'ara, sama sèmi lii paredha dhèu aae. aa a'ari na pa'èra ka, ho lèpa madhutu lii paredha dhèu aae.

source_text: to all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
target_text: ka yusuf hia si mèdha-papake dhu hiu, ca dhèu ca pasa. te ngaa benyamin, na hia doi iia tèlu ngasu, dènge mèdha-papake dhu hiu, lèmi pasa.

source_text: and to his father he sent after this manner: ten asses laden with the good things of egypt, and ten she-asses laden with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.
target_text: yusuf pa'adhu mèdha-panyau dhu be'a risi nèti masir hia ama na. rèngu hua mi dedha keled'ei canguru ngi'u. sèmi èèna kahèi, na hia are, roti, dènge nganga'a ae-ae, dhu j'aj'i parèko j'ara, lod'o dhu rèngu mulai pakèd'i nèti kana'an asa masir. nganga'a se, ra hua ètu dedha keled'ei dhu leo hari canguru ngi'u.

source_text: so he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, see that ye fall not out by the way.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na hia si lèpa, aa na moa si, aku nèngu na, miu baku patao-palaha ètu talora j'ara, ee!

source_text: and they went up out of egypt, and came into the land of canaan unto jacob their father.
target_text: hèia ra pakèd'i ka lasi sa ama ra ètu kana'an.

source_text: and they told him, saying, joseph is yet alive, and he is ruler over all the land of egypt. and his heart fainted, for he believed them not.
target_text: d'ai nèi ka, ra lolo dènge ama ra, peka na, ama! ana mu yusuf na, dhu mamuri era di. na j'aj'i le dhèu kapai, ka na paredha ètu rai masir! yakob tadèngi hiu-hiu na, loo-loo sène, te na lèka boe.

source_text: and they told him all the words of joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of jacob their father revived:
target_text: te ngaa ropa na tadèngi nare lii lolo rèngu sèra, aa na ladhe nèdhi kareta dhu yusuf pa'adhu mai ho hua ne asa masir, heka na lèka kèna.

source_text: and israel said, it is enough; joseph my son is yet alive: i will go and see him before i die.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, hea! de ana ja'a dhu mamuri era di! ja'a heka karej'e kèna. ja'a hud'i laku kèdhi ku ne, heka ja'a madhe dènge karej'e kèna.

source_text: and israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the god of his father isaac.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si pa'èra ka mèdha ra, ka ra pakèd'i nèti kana'an. ropa ra d'ai rae barseba, ka na roro badha tao korban hia lamatua, dhu uru na ama na isak mangaj'i.

source_text: and god spake unto israel in the visions of the night, and said, jacob, jacob. and he said, here am i.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka na nii. ètu d'ara nii ne'e, na tadèngi na ama lamatua paroa ne, peka na, yakob! yakob! èu kèd'i ho nanene ku la! hèia na dhaa, peka na, nga tao, ama?

source_text: and he said, i am god, the god of thy father: fear not to go down into egypt; for i will there make of thee a great nation:
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu ama mu mangaj'i nèti uru ka. mage èu madha'u kahèi lamu masir. te èèna na, ja'a tao ana-èpu èu j'aj'i suku kapai ètu rai nèi.

source_text: i will go down with thee into egypt; and i will also surely bring thee up again: and joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
target_text: ja'a laku hèi masir sama-sama dènge èu. ho ladhe èèna na, ja'a kahèi dhu kèti hari ana-èpu èu lèpa asa rai kana'an ne'e. ropa èu madhe, na, ana mu yusuf madhèdi ètu baboa èu.

source_text: and jacob rose up from beer-sheba: and the sons of israel carried jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which pharaoh had sent to carry him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob dènge ana-ana na sèra, lasi taruu tèke eele rae barseba. ra paca'e ne dènge bhèni-ana iiki na asa kareta sèra dhu dhèu aae masir pa'adhu hia si.

source_text: and they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of canaan, and came into egypt, jacob, and all his seed with him: his sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into egypt.
target_text: rèti aa'i mèu-mèu mèdha-panyau dènge badha-manu dhu j'aj'i kakaja rèngu ètu rai kana'an. hèia yakob dènge ana-èpu na, bhèni-mone aa'i-aa'i ra pakèd'i ka lasi rai masir.

source_text: and these are the names of the children of israel, who came into egypt, jacob and his sons: reuben, jacob's first-born.
target_text: ana-èpu yakob dhu madhutu lasi asa masir, nuka se'e: ruben, ana uuru na.

source_text: and the sons of reuben: hanoch, and pallu, and hezron, and carmi.
target_text: ana-ana na ka: henok, palu, hesron dènge karmi.

source_text: and the sons of simeon: jemuel, and jamin, and ohad, and jachin, and zohar, and shaul the son of a canaanitish woman.
target_text: simeon, dènge ana-ana na: yemuel, yamin, ohat, yakin, dènge sohar. dènge saul kahèi, ana na nèti dhèu èmu na bhèni kana'an.

source_text: and the sons of levi: gershon, kohath, and merari.
target_text: lewi, dènge ana-ana na: gerson, kehat, dènge merari.

source_text: and the sons of judah: er, and onan, and shelah, and perez, and zerah; but er and onan died in the land of canaan. and the sons of perez were hezron and hamul.
target_text: yahuda, dènge ana-ana na: sela, peres, dènge sera. ana yahuda dhu leo, er dènge onan, madhe le ètu kana'an. na nèti dènge ana-ana peres, hesron dènge hamul.

source_text: and the sons of issachar: tola, and puvah, and iob, and shimron.
target_text: isaskar, dènge ana-ana na: tola, pua, ayub, dènge simron.

source_text: and the sons of zebulun: sered, and elon, and jahleel.
target_text: sebulon, dènge ana-ana na: seret, elon, dènge jahleel.

source_text: these are the sons of leah, whom she bare unto jacob in paddan-aram, with his daughter dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
target_text: rèngu se'e, ana-ana nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na lea, lod'o rèngu pea ètu mesopotamia. ana bhèni rèngu èci, ngara na dina. ana-èpu nèti yakob dènge lea, aa'i-aa'i ra tèlu nguru tèlu dhèu.

source_text: and the sons of gad: ziphion, and haggi, shuni, and ezbon, eri, and arodi, and areli.
target_text: aa yakob abhu ana-ana dènge dhèu èmu dhu leo hari. nuka: gad, dènge ana-ana na: sifion, hagi, suni, esbon, eri, arodi dènge areli.

source_text: and the sons of asher: imnah, and ishvah, and ishvi, and beriah, and serah their sister; and the sons of beriah: heber, and malchiel.
target_text: aser, dènge ana-ana na: yimna, yiswa, yiswi, beria, dènge ana hèni ra èci, ngara na sera. beria, dènge ana le kahèi: heber dènge malkiel.

source_text: these are the sons of zilpah, whom laban gave to leah his daughter; and these she bare unto jacob, even sixteen souls.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, canguru èna dhèu. ana-èpu nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na silpa. silpa ne'e ka dhu laban hia j'aj'i ènu nèti lea, dhèu èmu uru yakob na.

source_text: the sons of rachel jacob's wife: joseph and benjamin.
target_text: aa ana-ana nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na bhèni leo hari, ngara na rahel, nuka: yusuf dènge benyamin.

source_text: and unto joseph in the land of egypt were born manasseh and ephraim, whom asenath, the daughter of poti-phera priest of on, bare unto him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf leo le dènge asnat ètu masir. ama asnat èèna, ama agama ètu kota on. ngara na, potifera. ana-ana yusuf dènge asnat: efraim dènge manase.

source_text: and the sons of benjamin: bela, and becher, and ashbel, gera, and naaman, ehi, and rosh, muppim, and huppim, and ard.
target_text: benyamin madhutu hèi lasi masir dènge ana-ana na: bela, beker, asibel, gera, naaman, ehi, ros, mupim, hupim dènge aret.

source_text: these are the sons of rachel, who were born to jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
target_text: ana-èpu yakob dènge dhèu èmu na rahel, canguru èpa dhèu.

source_text: and the sons of dan: hushim.
target_text: dhèu èmu yakob èci hari, ngara na bilha. ana-ana ra, dan, dènge naftali. ana dan, ngara na husim.

source_text: and the sons of naphtali: jahzeel, and guni, and jezer, and shillem.
target_text: ana nèti naftali: yasel, guni, yeser dènge silem.

source_text: these are the sons of bilhah, whom laban gave unto rachel his daughter, and these she bare unto jacob: all the souls were seven.
target_text: yakob dènge dhèu èmu na bilha, ana-èpu rèngu dhèu pidhu. bilha ne, ènu nèti rahel, dhu na abhu nèti ama na laban.

source_text: all the souls that came with jacob into egypt, that came out of his loins, besides jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
target_text: de ana-èpu yakob dhu lasi masir, aa'i-aa'i ra dhèu èna nguru èna dhèu. se'e se, ige mèka dènge dhèu èmu nèti ana-ana nèngu sèra.

source_text: and the sons of joseph, who were born to him in egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of jacob, that came into egypt, were threescore and ten.
target_text: ladhe tabha dènge ana-ana yusuf dhu ina na nara iisi ètu masir dhèu dua, na yakob dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i ra si, pidhu nguru dhèu.

source_text: and he sent judah before him unto joseph, to show the way before him unto goshen; and they came into the land of goshen.
target_text: ropa ra dètu dènge masir, yakob pua yahuda la'e uuru, paroa yusuf ho mai paraga dènge ne ètu gosen. ropa ra d'ai gosen,

source_text: and joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet israel his father, to goshen; and he presented himself unto him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
target_text: yusuf ca'e nare kareta na, mai paraga dènge ama na. ropa ra paraga, liku nare ama na, ka na tangi nèbhu bia.

source_text: and israel said unto joseph, now let me die, since i have seen thy face, that thou art yet alive.
target_text: hèia yakob padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a unu ku kèdhi le èu. aa ja'a ke'a le èu mamuri era. de ladhe ja'a madhe èèna ka oo, ngaa-ngaa tao heka.

source_text: and joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, i will go up, and tell pharaoh, and will say unto him, my brethren, and my father's house, who were in the land of canaan, are come unto me;
target_text: ka yusuf peka dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i, peka na, ja'a laku peka ku dènge dhèu aae, sèna ka ne'a na a'ari ja'a mai le nèti kana'an.

source_text: and the men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
target_text: aa, pe ja'a peka kahèi dènge ne, miu biasa ani kahib'i-kalèbho dènge sapi. nèti èèna ka, miu mèti dènge badha-manu dènge mèdha-panyau miu nèti kana'an.

source_text: and it shall come to pass, when pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, what is your occupation?
target_text: de ladhe dhèu aae paroa miu, ho na karèi miu biasa sab'a ngaa,

source_text: that ye shall say, thy servants have been keepers of cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the egyptians.
target_text: na, miu dhaa ne peka na, miu se aa'i-aa'i mi nèti ana iiki ka mai piara badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i. sèna ka na pua miu pea ètu rai gosen. yusuf peka sèmi èèna, lula dhèu masir madenge pea pa'èci dènge ana madhutu badha.

source_text: then joseph went in and told pharaoh, and said, my father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of goshen. and from among his brethren he took five men, and presented them unto pharaoh.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf dènge a'ari na dhèu lèmi, lasi paraga dènge dhèu aae. d'ai madha dhèu aae, ka yusuf patadha si dènge dhèu aae, ka na peka na, ama dhèu aae! ama ku dènge a'ari ku mai le nèti kana'an. rèngu mai dènge kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra. nuka ra ètu rai gosen nèi.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto his brethren, what is your occupation? and they said unto pharaoh, thy servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.
target_text: dhèu aae karèi si, aku nèngu na, sasab'a miu ngaa? ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i se, ana madhutu badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i sèra.

source_text: and they said unto pharaoh, to sojourn in the land are we come; for there is no pasture for thy servants' flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of goshen.
target_text: limuri ne'e, ètu rai ji'i kana'an, hèru hadhu madhera, ka nganga'a dènge j'u'u tèdhi heka. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai taha asa kabarai ne'e. ngèti dènge badha-manu ji'i. de ji'i manèngi ama dhèu aae, ho hia ji'i pea ètu rai gosen, sèna ka ji'i piara badha ji'i ètu nèi.

source_text: and pharaoh spake unto joseph, saying, thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf sèmi ne'e: ama mu dènge a'ari mu ètu ne'e le.

source_text: the land of egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and thy brethren to dwell; in the land of goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any able men among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.
target_text: de hud'i laa rèngu tao kabarai ne'e, sama sèmi kabarai rèngu. madhutu kake'a ja'a, gosen èèna era dhu be'a risi nèti era leo ètu rai masir ne'e. de be'a risi rèngu pea ètu èèna ka la. aa ladhe rèngu cee dhu ladhe-leru badha dènge hua iia, na ja'a hia badha ja'a ho na piara si ètu èèna.

source_text: and joseph brought in jacob his father, and set him before pharaoh: and jacob blessed pharaoh.
target_text: èle èèna hèia, yusuf patadhe ama na dènge dhèu aae. ka yakob manèngi mi ama lamatua, sèna ka hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu aae.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto jacob, how many are the days of the years of thy life?
target_text: dhèu aae karèi yakob, aku nèngu na, ama umur pèri tèu kèna?

source_text: and jacob said unto pharaoh, the days of the years of my pilgrimage are a hundred and thirty years: few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and they have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
target_text: yakob dhaa, umur ja'a cangasu tèlu nguru tèu kèna, te ngaa ja'a pea boe mi ca era sa. bèi-baki ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe pakasame dènge rèngu, na umur ja'a kura nèti rèngu. te ngaa mamuri ja'a pènu dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: and jacob blessed pharaoh, and went out from the presence of pharaoh.
target_text: hèia yakob manèngi parmisi neo lèpa. te ngaa kalua mèka nèti d'ara èmu, na manèngi hari ca tèka mi lamatua ho sèna ka hia berkat mi dhèu aae.

source_text: and joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of rameses, as pharaoh had commanded.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf pad'elo era pea hia a'ari na si ètu gosen, madhutu lii pua dhèu aae deo na. era èèna be'a titu kèna. ra pangare era èèna ‘rameses'. ka ama na dènge a'ari na sèra pea taruu ètu èèna.

source_text: and joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to their families.
target_text: hèia yusuf sadia nganga'a hia ama na, a'ari na, dènge ana dhèu èmu ra, aa'i-aa'i ra, nèti dhèu kapai toke d'ai ana susu.

source_text: and there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of egypt and the land of canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
target_text: taa èèna, rai manganga titu kèna, tèdhi boe nganga'a ca lamusi sa ètu mia-mia. nèti masir toke kana'an, dhèu-dhèu manganga roe ca palèpa, taga nèti ra'a-rinu heka. dhèu bisa heka sab'a ngaa-ngaa, lula manganga titu kèna.

source_text: and joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of egypt, and in the land of canaan, for the grain which they bought: and joseph brought the money into pharaoh's house.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu nèti d'ara rae-rae ètu masir, sèmi èèna kahèi dhèu-dhèu nèti d'ara rae-rae ètu kana'an, mai hèli nganga'a ètu yusuf. doi-doi dhu na sèmi sèra, na pakaboko aa'i ka, la'e tèke asa èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: and when the money was all spent in the land of egypt, and in the land of canaan, all the egyptians came unto joseph, and said, give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for our money faileth.
target_text: tèu èèna, èla aa'i doi dhèu masir dènge dhèu kana'an ka ra bisa heka hèli nganga'a. hèia ra mai roma iisi mi yusuf, aku rèngu na, ama wakil! hia ku ji'i nganga'a ciki la, sèna ka ji'i baku madhe manganga. te doi ji'i, èla aa'i mèu-mèu le.

source_text: and joseph said, give your cattle; and i will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, peka na, ladhe tare'a doi miu aad'o heka, na sèmi ne'e ka la! mèti badha miu, ho pasilu dènge nganga'a.

source_text: and they brought their cattle unto joseph; and joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their cattle for that year.
target_text: ka dhèu se'e mai pasilu badha ra dènge nganga'a. badha-badha sèmi jara, kahib'i-ka'ia, kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge keled'ei. lula tèu èèna, yusuf dhu moa tèke le.

source_text: and when that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, we will not hide from my lord, how that our money is all spent; and the herds of cattle are my lord's; there is nought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
target_text: tèu mai na, rèngu mai hari sa madha yusuf, ka ra peka, ama wakil, ee! ji'i peka tare'a-re'a kèna. doi ji'i dènge badha ji'i ama pasilu aa'i-aa'i le. limuri ne'e, ji'i dènge heka ngaa-ngaa. dhu ètu ji'i dhodhoka ngi'u dènge rai ji'i di.

source_text: wherefore should we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land be not desolate.
target_text: baku tèke eele ji'i madhe manganga. te ladhe ji'i madhe na, cee ka dhu sab'a oka-tedhe se'e? de hua iia, ama wakil more ji'i, ho j'aj'i ènu mu. aa more aa'i rai ji'i kahèi. pe, èèna na, ama hia hini ho ji'i sèla hia ama. gaji dènge kab'ua rai ji'i, ama pasilu dènge nganga'a. sad'i ji'i baku madhe manganga.

source_text: so joseph bought all the land of egypt for pharaoh; for the egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine was sore upon them: and the land became pharaoh's.
target_text: lula rai manganga ae, ka dhèu masir pahie aa'i rai rèngu. nèti èèna ka, yusuf hèli nara aa'i rai ètu masir j'aj'i mi pusaka dhèu aae.

source_text: and as for the people, he removed them to the cities from one end of the border of egypt even to the other end thereof.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, dhèu masir aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i ènu nèti dhèu aae.

source_text: only the land of the priests bought he not: for the priests had a portion from pharaoh, and did eat their portion which pharaoh gave them; wherefore they sold not their land.
target_text: dhoka rai unu ama agama sèra di, yusuf hèli nare boe, te dhèu aae hia taruu dhèu se nganga'a na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se pahie boe rai rèngu.

source_text: then joseph said unto the people, behold, i have bought you this day and your land for pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf peka dènge ana kabarai sèra, aku nèngu na, naa! miu j'aj'i le ènu nèti dhèu aae. ja'a hèli kore aa'i le, rai miu hia dhèu aae. de mere hini se'e ho lami sèla ka mi dedha rai sèra.

source_text: and it shall come to pass at the ingatherings, that ye shall give a fifth unto pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.
target_text: ladhe miu puu-g'ètu na, bagi mi lèmi. ho ca pala hia dhèu aae. aa èpa pala sèra, miu tao hini dènge mi pake mi'a-minu dènge a'ari miu.

source_text: and they said, thou hast saved our lives: let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be pharaoh's servants.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama pamamuri ji'i le, de ji'i manèngi tarima kasi. ji'i neo j'aj'i ènu nèti dhèu aae.

source_text: and joseph made it a statute concerning the land of egypt unto this day, that pharaoh should have the fifth; only the land of the priests alone became not pharaoh's.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yusuf tao madha j'ara ne'e, j'aj'i ad'a kabarai ètu masir. ladhe ra puru rare are na, ra bagi mi lèmi pala. ho ca pala rèngu hia mi dhèu aae. aa èpa pala rèngu abhu. te ngaa rai ama agama sèra, dhèu aae hèli boe. ad'a èèna, ra pake taruu.

source_text: and israel dwelt in the land of egypt, in the land of goshen; and they gat them possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu isra'el pea taruu ka ètu masir, ètu rai gosen. ra j'aj'i dhèu kaja, aa ana-èpu rèngu asa tabha ae.

source_text: and jacob lived in the land of egypt seventeen years: so the days of jacob, the years of his life, were a hundred forty and seven years.
target_text: ètu masir, yakob mamuri hari canguru pidhu tèu era. j'aj'i umur yakob aa'i-aa'i ra, cangasu èpa nguru pidhu tèu.

source_text: and the time drew near that israel must die: and he called his son joseph, and said unto him, if now i have found favor in thy sight, put, i pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me: bury me not, i pray thee, in egypt;
target_text: lod'o dètu na madhe èèna, na paroa yusuf, ka na padhai lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf! ja'a rasa na, mamuri ja'a madhera heka. nèbhu heka, lamatua paroa ja'a lèpa kèna. èèna ka ja'a manèngi sèna ka ladhe èu sue ja'a, èu subha sèna ka baku padhane ja'a ètu rai masir ne'e.

source_text: but when i sleep with my fathers, thou shalt carry me out of egypt, and bury me in their burying-place. and he said, i will do as thou hast said.
target_text: èu hud'i mèti ngi'u aae ja'a, ho padhane asa era ro'a bèi-baki èdhi. ho èu padhane ja'a ètu èèna. ne'e ne, dad'èi d'ara ama. ka yusuf dhaa ne, aku nèngu na, be'a ama! ladhe dad'èi ama ku kèna, na ja'a madhutu.

source_text: and he said, swear unto me: and he sware unto him. and israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.
target_text: ka yakob padhai lii hari, peka na, de ladhe sèmi èèna, èu hud'i subha uuru ku, ho ke'a na èu madhutu dad'èi ama. hèia yusuf subha madhutu dad'èi yakob. ka yakob patitu kètu urutuu ètu dedha era j'unu na, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: and it came to pass after these things, that one said to joseph, behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, manasseh and ephraim.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu lasi peka dènge yusuf na, ama na pèd'a aae. hèia la'e nèti dènge ana na, efraim dènge manase, sèna ka lasi ladhe baki ra yakob.

source_text: and one told jacob, and said, behold, thy son joseph cometh unto thee: and israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
target_text: ropa yakob tadèngi yusuf si mai le, ka na pakaseti madhèdi.

source_text: and jacob said unto joseph, god almighty appeared unto me at luz in the land of canaan, and blessed me,
target_text: hèia na padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf, ee! ama lamatua dhu dènge koasa kapai risi na, uru èèna, na pad'elo le iisi na dènge ja'a ètu rae lus, ètu rai kana'an. ètu nèi, na moa tèke mi ja'a.

source_text: and said unto me, behold, i will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and i will make of thee a company of peoples, and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.
target_text: na padhai lii, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia ana-èpu èu j'aj'i ae, ho rèngu j'aj'i suku dhu kapai. rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia j'aj'i unu rèngu, ho j'aj'i pusaka ra toke d'ai rai-haha èle. '

source_text: and now thy two sons, who were born unto thee in the land of egypt before i came unto thee into egypt, are mine; ephraim and manasseh, even as reuben and simeon, shall be mine.
target_text: aa ana èu efraim dènge manase èèna, hak rèngu sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o dhu ja'a d'ai masir na, mere iisi le rèngu dua ra. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a tao rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a, sama sèmi ruben dènge simeon.

source_text: and thy issue, that thou begettest after them, shall be thine; they shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.
target_text: aa ladhe bèli-camèd'a èu abhu hari ana, na èèna di unu èu kèna. ja'a tao boe rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a. pe pusaka ra, rèngu abhu nèti a'a ra, efraim dènge manase.

source_text: and as for me, when i came from paddan, rachel died by me in the land of canaan in the way, when there was still some distance to come unto ephrath: and i buried her there in the way to ephrath the same is beth-lehem.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka èdhi sanèd'e ina mu rahel. lod'o ji'i mai nèti mesopotamia asa kana'an, d'ai talora j'ara, ina mu madhe ropa nara iisi aa'i. èèna na, ji'i dètu rae efrata ètu rai kana'an. lod'o èèna, ja'a susa d'ai seli. ka ja'a padhane ne ètu sebhe j'ara la'e asa rae efrata. limuri ne, rae èèna ra gati ngara na betlehem.

source_text: and israel beheld joseph's sons, and said, who are these?
target_text: ropa yakob padhai lii nare sèmi èèna hèia, na boti kètu na, ladhe nèdhi ana-ana yusuf ètu èèna. hèia na karèi yusuf, aku nèngu na, se'e se, ana cee?

source_text: and joseph said unto his father, they are my sons, whom god hath given me here. and he said, bring them, i pray thee, unto me, and i will bless them.
target_text: ka yusuf dhaa, se'e, ana dhu ama lamatua hia ja'a ètu masir. yakob peka hari, ladhe sèmi èèna, na hia ra mai padètu dènge ja'a, ho ja'a manèngi ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale.

source_text: now the eyes of israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. and he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
target_text: yakob heka le, aa musi madha na ahu le. na ladhe nèdhi be'a heka. hèia yusuf nèti ana na sèra padètu asa madha yakob, ka na liku nare si, aa na uu si dua ra.

source_text: and israel said unto joseph, i had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, god hath let me see thy seed also.
target_text: ka na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a pangee na, ja'a bisa heka kèdhi rèhu èu. te ngaa ama lamatua, tao risi eele nèti ngaa dhu ja'a ngee, toke ja'a bisa kèdhi ana-ana èu kahèi.

source_text: and joseph brought them out from between his knees; and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
target_text: hèia yusuf hari eele ana na dhèu dua sèra nèti madha yakob, ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, aa na pacud'u rèhu na d'ai rai, ètu madha ama na.

source_text: and joseph took them both, ephraim in his right hand toward israel's left hand, and manasseh in his left hand toward israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf kèd'i. na nare ana na dhèu dua sèra, ka na hia ra titu padètu-dètu dènge ama na. na patitu ana uuru na manase, re bèka g'ana yakob. aa ana ka dua, efraim, re bèka kariu yakob.

source_text: and israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for manasseh was the first-born.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yakob soro ai na neo manèngi mèngi-nale hia ana dua sèra, na soro ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, aa ai kariu mi kètu manase.

source_text: and he blessed joseph, and said, the god before whom my fathers abraham and isaac did walk, the god who hath fed me all my life long unto this day,
target_text: ka na manèngi ama lamatua hia berkat mi yusuf, peka na, baki mu isak, dènge ama na abraham, dua ra madhutu taruu dad'èi ama lamatua. ama lamatua ladhe-leru ja'a kahèi, nèti ana ngèru toke d'ai deo ne'e ne.

source_text: the angel who hath redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers abraham and isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
target_text: na pakaj'èu ja'a nèti rupa-rupa sasusa. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka na hia mèngi-nale mi ana èu se'e, dènge ana-èpu ra. aa ladhe ra manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, ra bhèlu boe ale kolongara baki abraham, kolongara isak, aa kolongara ja'a, sèna ka ana-èpu rèngu asa bèba-kacanga, ho j'aj'i kapai ètu rai-haha ne'e.

source_text: and when joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from ephraim's head unto manasseh's head.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yusuf ladhe nèdhi ama na tao ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, hèia kèpe nare ai ama na, ho tao sa kètu a'a na manase.

source_text: and joseph said unto his father, not so, my father; for this is the first-born; put thy right hand upon his head.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ama na, ama, ee! baku tao sèmi èèna. nèngu ne, ari efraim. nèngu ana limuri. de ai g'ana ama hud'i tao sa kètu a'a na manase. lula èèna hak ana uuru.

source_text: and his father refused, and said, i know it, my son, i know it; he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: howbeit his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
target_text: te ngaa ama na yakob d'èi boe. ka na peka na, ana, ee! ja'a ke'a. ladhe èèna na, manase j'aj'i èra, aa ana-èpu na tabha ae, ho j'aj'i suku kapai. te ngaa ari na efraim èèna, bèli-camèd'a kapai risi hari nèti nèngu. sèmi èèna kahèi ana-èpu na ae risi eele hari, ho ladhe èèna na, rèngu j'aj'i suku-suku dhu kapai aae.

source_text: and he blessed them that day, saying, in thee will israel bless, saying, god make thee as ephraim and as manasseh: and he set ephraim before manasseh.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ana se dua ra, ladhe dhèu isra'el manèngi ama lamatua ho hia mamèngi-nale mi dhèu, rèngu ale ngara miu dua mi hèi. ladhe èèna na, ra peka sèmi ne'e: ‘ji'i sanao sèna ka ama lamatua hia mamèngi-nale mi èu, sama sèmi na hia mi efraim dènge manase. ' dènge j'ara ne'e, yakob ale uuru ngara efraim nèti ngara a'a na manase.

source_text: and israel said unto joseph, behold, i die: but god will be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yakob padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, ana, ee! ja'a nèbhu heka madhe. te ngaa ama lamatua dènge miu, ho èèna na nèti hari miu asa era pea-palu'u bèi-baki miu.

source_text: moreover i have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which i took out of the hand of the amorite with my sword and with my bow.
target_text: te ngaa ne'e ne, ja'a hia èu risi eele nèti a'ari èu. aa ja'a hia tabha èu, ledhe ètu rai kana'an èèna, dhu uru na ja'a kore nèti dhèu amori, lod'o ja'a segi rèngu ètu d'ara pamusu.

source_text: and jacob called unto his sons, and said: gather yourselves together, that i may tell you that which shall befall you in the latter days.
target_text: hèia yakob pua ana na aa'i-aa'i ra pakaboko. ropa ra kaboko aa'i, na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ana ja'a aa'i-aa'i! mai padètu dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo peka dènge miu j'ara mamuri mi èci-èci lod'o limuri.

source_text: assemble yourselves, and hear, ye sons of jacob; and hearken unto israel your father.
target_text: ka na peka mema dènge ana-ana na si, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, ana-ana yakob! mai titu lingu mere ja'a. mi nanene, ama miu isra'el ne, neo padhai lii.

source_text: reuben, thou art my first-born, my might, and the beginning of my strength; the pre-eminence of dignity, and the pre-eminence of power.
target_text: ruben! èu ne, ana ja'a dhu uru tèka! èu ne'e tatea ja'a, dènge ai g'ana ja'a. dhèu pakab'ua risi èu.

source_text: boiling over as water, thou shalt not have the pre-eminence; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.
target_text: te ngaa d'ara èu èra boe, sama sèmi rii dhasi dhu la'e-mai la'e-mai. cag'ag'a laa, èu lamu j'unu dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, ka pakaj'alu era j'unu ama èu. tatao èu èèna ka, pamanahu eele kolongara ca dhèu a'a.

source_text: simeon and levi are brethren; weapons of violence are their swords.
target_text: simeon dènge lewi! miu dua mi ca rupa. miu dua mi, malai titu kèna ded'e samala, ho paj'èra dhèu.

source_text: o my soul, come not thou into their council; unto their assembly, my glory, be not thou united; for in their anger they slew a man, and in their self-will they hocked an ox.
target_text: ladhe miu pare pama'ète kalua haga sapi, ho ra kapod'e reo-reo ètu era, na lèke dad'èi miu kèna. aa bhabhelu miu hari, ladhe miu kadhi ngutu, na mi pamadhe dhèu. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pahae boe lii padhai lii miu. aa ja'a d'èi boe tao madha-dhilu mi lii langu miu.

source_text: cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: i will divide them in jacob, and scatter them in israel.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a dhoo bhelu-katub'a miu ne, te seli-kolane nga! dènge nanasa miu dhu dènge boe sasue ciki sa hèi. ladhe èèna na, miu pasae unu mi, bhelu-katub'a miu sèra. ho èèna na, lamatua ceb'e ana-èpu miu, asa g'ana asa kariu. ka ra paceb'a asa mia-mia, ètu dedha rai isra'el.

source_text: judah, thee shall thy brethren praise: thy hand shall be on the neck of thine enemies; thy father's sons shall bow down before thee.
target_text: yahuda! ngara èu ne, sasoa na, ‘koa-kio'. a'ari èu èèna na ra koa èu, aa ra pacud'u kètu ho pakab'ua èu. èu ne, j'èli musu èu, toke ra bisa heka doa kètu.

source_text: judah is a lion's whelp; from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as a lioness; who shall rouse him up?
target_text: èu ne, sama sèmi singa ngèru dhu èra, ho tenge nganga'a unu mu. aa èu ne, sama sèmi singa mone, dhu tèku iisi neo bhèj'i; èci sa bani boe pagagai dènge èu. èu kahèi sèmi singa rena, dhu madhenge ana; èci sa bani boe gagu. èci èèna ka dènge èu. dhèu èci sa bani boe padadisi, aa bani boe tao macam-macam mi dedha èu.

source_text: the sceptre shall not depart from judah, nor the ruler's staff from between his feet, until shiloh come; and unto him shall the obedience of the peoples be.
target_text: èèna na èu mèd'u paredha. ana-èpu èu oo rèd'u paredha padhutu-dhutu, toke abhu èci dhu hak nèngu risi eele nèti cahag'e, ho nèd'u paredha na. ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne'e, pahaha iisi ho nanene lii paredha nèngu hèi.

source_text: binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass's colt unto the choice vine; he hath washed his garments in wine, and his vesture in the blood of grapes:
target_text: èèna na, èu ne mamuri dènge karej'e-karae. èu neo ngaa, na abhu. èu neo tao ngaa, na j'aj'i! aa ladhe èèna na, badha-manu, dènge isi rai nèti oka-tedhe èu, asa ae d'ai ceb'e lebhe eele hèi.

source_text: his eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
target_text: nganga'a-nginu èu, dhu be'a hua, aa dhu èle boe.

source_text: zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for a haven of ships; and his border shall be upon sidon.
target_text: sebolon! rai pusaka dhu èu unu, kapai seli, nèti nebhe dhasi toke d'ai too dènge kota sidon. kapa-kapa mai nèti mia-mia ho panahu dènge be'a ètu d'ara hèb'a-namo dhasi èu.

source_text: issachar is a strong ass, couching down between the sheepfolds: and he saw a resting-place that it was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and he bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant under taskwork.
target_text: isaskar! èu ne, sama sèmi keled'ei dhu èra, te ngaa èu kètu hadhu papake na aad'o. ladhe èu j'unu ètu talora j'ara, dhèu èci sa bisa boe pakèd'i èu ho kako taruu. te ngaa ladhe èu mèdhi rae ètu ca bèka nèi be'a, èci sa dhae pua mèka èèna ka, mu pasae mèti le mèdha-panyau èu ho lamu. tatu èu sama sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of israel.
target_text: dan! ngara èu ne, sasoa na, ‘dhèu pama'ète lii'. aa èu ne, dènge ana-èpu èu, ladhe bèli-camèd'a pama'ète lii nèti dhèu èu isra'el sèra, dènge boe bia ca bèka.

source_text: dan shall be a serpent in the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse's heels, so that his rider falleth backward.
target_text: aa èu ne, sama èci èèna ka dènge mege kaisao dhu j'unu ètu sebhe j'ara. dhèu ca'e jara ho èèna na, èu kadhi haga jara èèna nèti kabodho, toke dhèu manahu sa rai.

source_text: i have waited for thy salvation, o jehovah.
target_text: o lamatua! ja'a ke'a na èu hia mamuri mi ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: gad, a troop shall press upon him; but he shall press upon their heel.
target_text: gad! ngara èu, lii na oe èci èèna ka dènge, ‘age'. ladhe èèna na, dhèu parapo mai age èu, te ngaa èu kabèli hari age si, ka mu segi si.

source_text: out of asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
target_text: aser! ladhe èèna isi rai nèti oka-tedhe èu be'a risi, d'ai èu tao koki dhu be'a bia, ka dhèu aae-dhèu kapai mai hèli ètu èu.

source_text: naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
target_text: naftali! èu ne sama sèmi rusa hui, dhu dhèu èci sa ator rare boe èu. ana-ana matana èu, bhèni iia dènge mone iia.

source_text: joseph is a fruitful bough, a fruitful bough by a fountain; his branches run over the wall.
target_text: yusuf! èu ne, sama sèmi aj'u loro dhu dètu dènge madha èi. dadana na loro asa tembok dhu dedha aae.

source_text: the archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and persecuted him:
target_text: abhu kahèi dhèu tèka d'ara dènge èu, sama èci èèna ka, dènge musu dhu neo kataki èu.

source_text: but his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the mighty one of jacob from thence is the shepherd, the stone of israel,
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua dhu ja'a mangaj'i na, bera-bera dènge èu. ho na pa'èra ai èu, ka èu kataki si hari, masi ka nèti kaj'èu èèna ka. èu segi si, lula ama lamatua dhu tolong èu. mema koasa na risi aa'i ngaa-ngaa! nèti èèna ka, nèngu j'aj'i era sarai ja'a, lula nèngu na ka dhu madhenge ja'a.

source_text: even by the god of thy father, who shall help thee, and by the almighty, who shall bless thee, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that coucheth beneath, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.
target_text: aa nèngu madhenge èu kahèi. dènge na pala-bagi hia èu mèngi-nale nèti dedha-liru, nèti rai-haha, dènge berkat ho matana ana ae-ae dhu ngi'u èra.

source_text: the blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
target_text: ledhe-ledhe ra ele boe. aa mamèngi-nale dhu ja'a peka mi èu ne, dedha risi nèti ledhe aa'i-aa'i ra. sèna ka hud'i laa berkat se aa'i-aa'i sabhori asa èu, lula èu ne risi nèti a'ari èu se aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: benjamin is a wolf that raveneth: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at even he shall divide the spoil.
target_text: benyamin! babani èu sama sèmi busa hui dhu manganga. mad'ae aae era, na kèd'i le èèna, ho bata-magèla badha hui, ho j'aj'i mi nganga'a na. aa, ladhe d'ai ka mèda, la'e papala dhu sisa hia mi ana-ana nèngu. babe'a ana-èpu èu sèmi èèna kahèi.
