source_text: all these are the twelve tribes of israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
target_text: sange ne'e ka, yakob peka dènge ana-ana na, tasa mera mia mamuri rèngu pala lod'o limuri, èci-èci ka dènge ana-èpu rèngu. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se'e ka, j'aj'i mi bèi-baki nèti canguru dua suku dhèu isra'el.

source_text: and he charged them, and said unto them, i am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of ephron the hittite, in the cave that is in the field of machpelah, which is before mamre, in the land of canaan, which abraham bought with the field from ephron the hittite for a possession of a burying-place.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob manèngi sèna ka ana-ana na pajaji mema, peka na, nèbhu heka, ja'a madhe. ladhe bèli-camèd'a ja'a madhe, na miu hud'i padhane ku ja'a asa d'ara ro'a baki ku abraham. ro'a ne, ètu d'ara loe padètu dènge rae makpela, dènge mamre ètu rai kana'an. uru na baki abraham ka dhu hèli loe dènge oka na, ho j'aj'i mi era ro'a nèngu. na hèli pama'ète nèti dhèu suku het, ngara na efron.

source_text: there they buried abraham and sarah his wife; there they buried isaac and rebekah his wife; and there i buried leah-
target_text: ètu era èèna, ra padhane baki èdhi abraham dènge bèi èdhi sara; ama ja'a isak dènge ina ku ribka ètu èèna kahèi. de èèna na, miu hud'i padhane ja'a mi era èèna, ètu sebhe ro'a dhèu èmu ja'a lea.

source_text: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of heth.
target_text: de mage mi bhèlu, padhane ja'a ètu d'ara loe dhu baki abraham ku hèli nare èèna.

source_text: and when jacob made an end of charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
target_text: yakob padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, na bhèj'i dènge ka ètu dedha koi na, hèia na madhe dènge ka.

source_text: and joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
target_text: hèia yusuf liku nare ama na, ka na tangi. na uu ama na pèri-pèri hari.

source_text: and joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed israel.
target_text: ka na paredha dhèu dhu tuka urus dhèu madhe mai lalau ngi'u aae ama na dènge bubhu-bubhu, sèna ka baku ele iie.

source_text: and forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of embalming: and the egyptians wept for him threescore and ten days.
target_text: sasab'a tuka lalau ngi'u aae ama na, d'ai èpa nguru lod'o, madhutu j'ara sasab'a rèngu. dhèu masir aa'i-aa'i madhutu tangi kahèi mamadhe yakob ne'e. ra beke pidhu nguru lod'o, tao sèmi dhèu kapai rèngu madhe.

source_text: and when the days of weeping for him were past, joseph spake unto the house of pharaoh, saying, if now i have found favor in your eyes, speak, i pray you, in the ears of pharaoh, saying,
target_text: èle beke pidhu nguru lod'o, hèia yusuf peka dènge dhèu sab'a na sèra, mi nanene! mèti ku lii ja'a ne asa dhèu aae, peka sèmi ne'e:

source_text: my father made me swear, saying, lo, i die: in my grave which i have digged for me in the land of canaan, there shalt thou bury me. now therefore let me go up, i pray thee, and bury my father, and i will come again.
target_text: ‘lod'o ama ku oe madhe, na moa sèna ka ja'a laku padhane ne asa rai kana'an. de ja'a manèngi ho ama dhèu aae hia ja'a ijin laku padhane ama ku. ladhe èle na, ja'a lèpa hari mai. '

source_text: and pharaoh said, go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
target_text: ropa tadèngi, hèia dhèu aae dhaa, peka na, ladhe èu dhu moa le mi ama mu sèmi èèna na, lamu ho padhane ne ètu nèi.

source_text: and joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of egypt,
target_text: ka yusuf pakèd'i ka, la'e padhane ama na. dhèu ae madhutu lasi dènge ne kahèi. sèmi kapala urusan nèti dhèu aae, dènge dhèu kapai aa'i-aa'i nèti masir.

source_text: and all the house of joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of goshen.
target_text: a'ari yusuf dènge dhèu-dhèu sab'a ra aa'i-aa'i, lasi padhane yakob. dhu ata ètu gosen dhoka dhèu èmu ra, ana iiki, dènge badha-manu ra di.

source_text: and there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
target_text: sordad'u ae madhutu kahèi. cahag'e ca'e kareta, aa cahag'e hari ca'e jara. taga dhèu dhu madhutu na, ae d'ai seli, nèti èèna ka, rombongan dhu rèti dhèu madhe ne, madhera titu kèna.

source_text: and they came to the threshing-floor of atad, which is beyond the jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
target_text: rèngu lasi, ka ra pège loko yarden ètu era èci, ngara na atad. era ne'e, dhèu biasa mai j'èli are. d'ai era ne'e, yusuf si tangi mamadhe ama na. aa ra beke hari pidhu mèda.

source_text: and when the inhabitants of the land, the canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of atad, they said, this is a grievous mourning to the egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called abel-mizraim, which is beyond the jordan.
target_text: ropa dhèu kana'an ètu sèra, ladhe na ra j'èra ae titu kèna, hèia ra papeka, aku rèngu na, we! miu laladhe ku laa! babeke mamadhe dhèu masir se, ra susa bia nga! j'ara tatangi rèngu sèmi nèi ni ka. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare era èèna, ngara na abel-misraim. sasoa na, ‘sasusa dhèu masir'.

source_text: and his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
target_text: hèia ana-ana yakob se, tao madhutu sèmi lii moa rèngu uru na.

source_text: for his sons carried him into the land of canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of machpelah, which abraham bought with the field, for a possession of a burying-place, of ephron the hittite, before mamre.
target_text: ka nedhe rèti ngi'u aae yakob na, lasi padhane asa d'ara loe dhu padètu dènge rae makpela dènge mamre. abraham hèli nare era ne'e nèti dhèu suku het, ngara na efron, ho j'aj'i mi era udhu rui rèngu.

source_text: and joseph returned into egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
target_text: yusuf padhane nare ama na, hèia nèngu dènge a'ari na lèpa hari asa masir. sama-sama dènge dhèu leo dhu madhutu sèra.

source_text: and when joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, it may be that joseph will hate us, and will fully requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai masir, a'a yusuf se mulai madha'u. lula ama rèngu aad'o heka, ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, we! ta pangee ku la! sèmi yusuf tèka d'ara dènge èdhi era, ho na b'ala tatao karehe èdhi mi nèngu uru èèna, na èdhi tasamia?

source_text: and they sent a message unto joseph, saying, thy father did command before he died, saying,
target_text: hèia rare lii èci, ka ra hia lii la'e asa yusuf, peka na, ama wakil. ji'i sanèd'e era, lod'o ama èdhi mamuri era, na pua ji'i

source_text: so shall ye say unto joseph, forgive, i pray thee now, the transgression of thy brethren, and their sin, for that they did unto thee evil. and now, we pray thee, forgive the transgression of the servants of the god of thy father. and joseph wept when they spake unto him.
target_text: ho padhai lii dènge ama wakil, peka na, ‘yusuf hud'i bhabhèlu eele ka sasala a'a na si. lula uru na ra paj'èra ne. ' ji'i nge'a kahèi ama èdhi ne, karèi nèti uru ka mai, na mangaj'i dhoka mi ama lamatua di. ji'i kahèi j'aj'i ana pajuu lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai manèngi abho, lula uru na ji'i paj'èra le, ama wakil. ropa tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia yusuf tangi.

source_text: and his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, behold, we are thy servants.
target_text: èle èèna ka, a'a na si mai unu ra, ka patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na. hèia ra padhai lii, peka na, hud'i laa ama tao ji'i j'aj'i ènu ama.

source_text: and joseph said unto them, fear not: for am i in the place of god?
target_text: te ngaa yusuf padhai lii dènge ra, miu se a'a ja'a! miu baku madha'u ia ka! dhoka ama lamatua di, dhu dènge hak hia huku mi dhèu. te ja'a ne, aad'o.

source_text: and as for you, ye meant evil against me; but god meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
target_text: mema tare'a, uru na miu mere lii èci, ho neo paj'èra ja'a. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu ub'a eele tatao miu dhu karehe èèna, j'aj'i mi babe'a. nèti èèna ka, na ded'e ja'a j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu ne'e, sèna ka dhèu ae abhu mamuri dènge karej'e.

source_text: now therefore fear ye not: i will nourish you, and your little ones. and he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu kèna! baku madha'u ia ka. ja'a pamoa dènge miu se, èèna na, ladhe-leru miu, dènge ana-èpu miu aa'i-aa'i ra. dènge lii padhai lii sèmi ne'e ne, yusuf pa'èra hari d'ara a'a na si.

source_text: and joseph dwelt in egypt, he, and his father's house: and joseph lived a hundred and ten years.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf pea taruu ètu rai masir, dènge a'ari na si, aa'i-aa'i ra. nèngu mamuri d'ai cangasu canguru tèu.

source_text: and joseph saw ephraim's children of the third generation: the children also of machir the son of manasseh were born upon joseph's knees.
target_text: nèngu d'ai hari nèdhi ana-èpu efraim kahèi. aa na leru èpu manase, nuka ana-ana nèti makir.

source_text: and joseph said unto his brethren, i die; but god will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land unto the land which he sware to abraham, to isaac, and to jacob.
target_text: yusuf peka mi a'a na si, aku nèngu na, a'a ku si ee! ja'a rasa na mamadhe ja'a dètu le! te ngaa ja'a parcaya, ama lamatua tatu ladhe-leru miu. bèli-camèd'a nèngu ka dhu lere miu kalua nèti rai ne'e. nèngu kahèi dhu nèti hari miu lèpa asa rai dhu na padhadha le pake lii subha, ho hia mi baki èdhi abraham, isak dènge ama èdhi yakob.

source_text: and joseph took an oath of the children of israel, saying, god will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
target_text: ka yusuf manèngi mi a'ari na si, sèna ka ra subha, peka na, miu hud'i jaji ku mi dedha ja'a. ladhe lod'o d'ai ama lamatua nèti hari miu asa rai kana'an, miu hud'i mèti ngi'u aae ja'a asa nèi.

source_text: so joseph died, being a hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf madhe ètu masir, dènge umur nèngu cangasu canguru tèu. hèia ra tao bubhu mi ngi'u aae na. ka ra tao asa d'ara kopa.

source_text: the book of the generation of jesus christ, the son of david, the son of abraham. abraham begat isaac; and isaac begat jacob; and jacob begat judah and his brethren;
target_text: sasuri ne, lole j'ara mamuri nèti yesus kristus, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua padhadha mema ho neo pua mai. yesus ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud dènge abraham. karèi nèti abraham toke dhèu aae daud, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki. kabhia na sèmi ne'e: abraham matana isak, isak matana yakob, yakob matana yahuda dènge a'ari na,

source_text: and judah begat perez and zerah of tamar; and perez begat hezron; and hezron begat ram;
target_text: yahuda matana peres dènge sera ina ra, ngara na tamar peres matana herson, herson matana ram,

source_text: and ram begat amminadab; and amminadab begat nahshon; and nahshon begat salmon;
target_text: ram matana aminadab, aminadab matana nahason, nahason matana salmon,

source_text: and salmon begat boaz of rahab; and boaz begat obed of ruth; and obed begat jesse;
target_text: salmon matana boas ina na, ngara na rahab boas matana obet ina na, ngara na rut, obet matana isai,

source_text: and jesse begat david the king. and david begat solomon of her that had been the wife of uriah;
target_text: isai matana daud.

source_text: and solomon begat rehoboam; and rehoboam begat abijah; and abijah begat asa; and asa begat jehoshaphat; and jehoshaphat begat joram; and joram begat uzziah; and uzziah begat jotham; and jotham begat ahaz; and ahaz begat hezekiah; and hezekiah begat manasseh; and manasseh begat amon; and amon begat josiah; and josiah begat jechoniah and his brethren, at the time of the carrying away to babylon.
target_text: nèti daud toke lod'o dhu ra babège suku isra'el asa babel, abhu hari canguru èpa bèi-baki, nuka: daud matana soleman ina na, uru èèna dhèu èmu uria. soleman matana rehabeam, rehabeam matana abia, abia matana asaf, asaf matana yosafat, yosafat matana yoram, yoram matana usia, usia matana yotam, yotam matana ahas, ahas matana heskia, heskia matana manase, manase matana amos, amos matana yosias, yosias matana yekonya dènge ari na, lod'o babège si asa babel.

source_text: and after the carrying away to babylon, jechoniah begat shealtiel; and shealtiel begat zerubbabel; and zerubbabel begat abiud; and abiud begat eliakim; and eliakim begat azor; and azor begat sadoc; and sadoc begat achim; and achim begat eliud; and eliud begat eleazar; and eleazar begat matthan; and matthan begat jacob; and jacob begat joseph the husband of mary, of whom was born jesus, who is called christ.
target_text: lod'o babège si asa babel, toke d'ai rara iisi yesus, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki, nuka: yekonya matana saltiel, saltiel matana serubabel, serubabel matana abihut, abihut matana elyakim, elyakim matana asor, asor matana sadok, sadok matana akim, akim matana eliut, eliut matana eliasar, eliasar matana matan, matan matana yakob, yakob matana yusuf, yusuf ne, dhèu èmu maria. maria ne ka dhu nara iisi yesus kristus.

source_text: so all the generations from abraham unto david are fourteen generations; and from david unto the carrying away to babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to babylon unto the christ fourteen generations.
target_text: de karèi nèti abraham toke daud, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki; nèti daud toke lod'o ra babège si asa babel abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki; aa nèti lod'o ra babège si asa babel d'ai maria nara iisi yesus, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki.

source_text: now the birth of jesus christ was on this wise: when his mother mary had been betrothed to joseph, before they came together she was found with child of the holy spirit.
target_text: lii lolo maria nara iisi yesus sèmi ne'e ka: maria dhu tunanga le dènge yusuf. dua ra pa'èci rèdhi mèka sama sèmi dhèu èmu-kamali, te ngaa te'a boe na, maria dhu dènge le babia nèti roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: and joseph her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.
target_text: ropa yusuf ne'a, ka na neo pama'ète lii rèngu dua ra. te ngaa na d'èi boe pamakae maria ètu madha dhèu ae, lula nèngu ne ca dhèu dhu d'ara mola. nèti èèna ka, na neo pamau eele lii rèngu ne.

source_text: but when he thought on these things, behold, an angel of the lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, joseph, thou son of david, fear not to take unto thee mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the holy spirit.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o dhu na pangee era, d'ara ca mèda sa, ka nèngu nii. ètu d'ara nii ne, ladhe nèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga mai peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, yusuf! èu ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. èu mage makae leo dènge maria. te ana dhu na kad'o èèna, j'aj'i nèti roh ama lamatua.

source_text: and she shall bring forth a son; and thou shalt call his name jesus; for it is he that shall save his people from their sins.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a maria nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. aa èu hud'i pangare ne, yesus, te nèngu ka dhu patabuli dhèu unu ama lamatua nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: now all this is come to pass, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the lord through the prophet, saying,
target_text: j'ara ne j'aj'i sèmi èèna, lula ama lamatua dhu peka mema nèti uru ka, re dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na yesaya, dhu suri, peka na,

source_text: behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name immanuel; which is, being interpreted, god with us.
target_text: mi nanene! bèli-camèd'a abhu ana bhèni ca dhèu dhu kalora iisi, te'a boe na, nèngu dhu dènge babia le. èèna na nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka ra pangare ne, imanuel. lii ibrani, ‘imanuel' sasoa na: ama lamatua bera-bera dènge èdhi.

source_text: and joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the lord commanded him, and took unto him his wife;
target_text: ropa nii èle, yusuf kèd'i nèti bhèj'i na. ka na madhutu ka lii padhai ama lamatua dhu na tadèngi ètu d'ara nii deo na. ka nare maria j'aj'i dhèu èmu na.

source_text: and knew her not till she had brought forth a son: and he called his name jesus.
target_text: te ngaa na j'unu pa'èci boe dènge maria, toke maria nara iisi aa'i. nara iisi nare ka, yusuf pangare ana ne, yesus.

source_text: now when jesus was born in bethlehem of judæa in the days of herod the king, behold, wise-men from the east came to jerusalem, saying,
target_text: lod'o rara iisi yesus ètu rae betlehem, ètu propensi yudea, dhèu aae herodes dhu nèd'u paredha ètu èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu pèri-pèri nèti era kaj'èu, mai nèti bèka dhimu asa kota yerusalem. rèngu se, dhu re'a mèu ladhe hua-hètu.

source_text: where is he that is born king of the jews? for we saw his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai yerusalem dhèu se pakarèi, aku rèngu na, dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi, dhu heka rara iisi hiu èèna, era na buli mia, ee? ji'i ngèdhi hua-hètu cue ètu bèka dhimu, dhu j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, rara iisi le nèngu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai neo pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: and when herod the king heard it, he was troubled, and all jerusalem with him.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia d'ara na susa. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu yerusalem sèra, d'ara ra susa kahèi.

source_text: and gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired of them where the christ should be born.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae herodes paroa nare kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama aa'i-aa'i sèra, ka na karèi si, peka na, miu peka sèku dènge ja'a la! kristus, dhu ama lamatua padhadha tèke èèna, rara iisi ne ètu mia?

source_text: and they said unto him, in bethlehem of judæa: for thus it is written through the prophet,
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ètu rae betlehem, propensi yudea. te ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na mika, dhu suri tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, na:

source_text: and thou bethlehem, land of judah, art in no wise least among the princes of judah: for out of thee shall come forth a governor, who shall be shepherd of my people israel.
target_text: ‘wee! miu dhèu betlehem ètu propensi yudea sèra. baku pangee na, rae miu ne, ca rae iiki dhu dhèu ige boe. te bèli-camèd'a dhèu kapai ca dhèu cèu mai nèti rae ne'e. èèna na nèngu j'aj'i dhèu madhenga mi dhèu ja'a, dhèu isra'el. '

source_text: then herod privily called the wise-men, and learned of them exactly what time the star appeared.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu aae herodes paroa mau-mau dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu ladhe hua-hètu sèra. ka na karèi, na, lod'o mia miu ladhe mèdhi hua-hètu ne cèu ètu dedha-liru? hèia ra peka dènge ne.

source_text: and he sent them to bethlehem, and said, go and search out exactly concerning the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word, that i also may come and worship him.
target_text: èle ka, na hia si lasi asa betlehem. na moa dènge ra, peka na, lami ho tenge palème era, ètu mia ana ne. ladhe miu rage, na, lèpa hari mai sèna ka peka dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo laku pahaha iisi mi nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and they, having heard the king, went their way; and lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai dhèu aae, hèia lasi dènge ka. kaca'a laa, rèngu rèdhi hari hua-hètu dhu uru èèna rèdhi ètu bèka dhimu. hua-hètu ne cèu ètu madha rèngu, na kako uru nèti rèngu, hèia tèja ètu dedha era ana ne pea.

source_text: and when they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
target_text: ropa rèdhi, hèia ra karej'e titu kèna.

source_text: and they came into the house and saw the young child with mary his mother; and they fell down and worshipped him; and opening their treasures they offered unto him gifts, gold and frankincense and myrrh.
target_text: èle ka lasi asa d'ara èmu, hèia ladhe rèdhi ana ne dènge ina na maria. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu ho pahaha iisi mi ana ne. ka dhèu se bhoke mèdha dhu kab'ua rèti hia ana ne. ra hia hualaa, kemenyan dènge raa aj'u hèu mèngi.

source_text: and being warned of god in a dream that they should not return to herod, they departed into their own country another way.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka dhèu se abhu nii nèti ama lamatua, peka na, lami ia ka asa dhèu aae herodes. nèti èèna ka, ra lèpa hari asa rai rèngu re j'ara leo.

source_text: now when they were departed, behold, an angel of the lord appeareth to joseph in a dream, saying, arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into egypt, and be thou there until i tell thee: for herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
target_text: lod'o dhèu d'èlu-mèu ladhe hua-hètu se lèpa, hèia ana pajuu lamatua èci nèti sorga, mai peka dènge yusuf ètu d'ara nii, aku nèngu na, yusuf! pakèd'i dènge ka d'ara lai-lai ne! mèti ana ne dènge ina na lami asa masir. pea ètu nèi, toke ja'a peka d'ai lod'o mia miu lèpa hari. te dhèu aae herodes tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ana ne!

source_text: and he arose and took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into egypt;
target_text: hèia yusuf kèd'i nèti bhèj'i. ka mèda èèna kahèi, nèti dhèu èmu na dènge ana ne, rai lasi asa masir.

source_text: and was there until the death of herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the lord through the prophet, saying, out of egypt did i call my son.
target_text: ra pea ètu nèi toke dhèu aae herodes madhe. j'ara èèna, nuka sèmi ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na hosea, suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka, na, ja'a paroa hari ana ku, ho lèpa ka nèti masir.

source_text: then herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise-men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the male children that were in bethlehem, and in all the borders thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had exactly learned of the wise-men.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes ne'a nare, na, dhèu d'èlu-mèu ladhe hua-hètu sèra leko-monya ne, hèia na nasa titu kèna. na paredha sordad'u na sèra, aku nèngu na, lami asa rae betlehem nèi, aa asa rae-rae leo dhu padètu ètu èèna. pamadhe aa'i ana mone iiki dhu dua tèu asa haha mai. herodes hia paredha ne, lula na sanèd'e lii lolo nèti dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra. na ige karèi nèti rèngu rèdhi hiu-hiu hua-hètu cèu ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: then was fulfilled that which was spoken through jeremiah the prophet, saying,
target_text: j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yermia, suri tèke, peka na,

source_text: a voice was heard in ramah, weeping and great mourning, rachel weeping for her children; and she would not be comforted, because they are not.
target_text: abhu lii tangi dènge lii roma iisi dhèu nèti kota rama. rahel tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula ana-ana na madhe aa'i. na d'èi boe ca dhèu sa mai pamako ne, lula ana-ana na, aad'o heka ca dhèu sa.

source_text: but when herod was dead, behold, an angel of the lord appeareth in a dream to joseph in egypt, saying,
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu ka, dhèu aae herodes madhe. lod'o èèna, yusuf si ètu masir era. hèia ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na ca dhèu mai nèti sorga, pad'elo rèhu na mi nèngu ètu d'ara nii.

source_text: arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of israel: for they are dead that sought the young child's life.
target_text: ana pajuu ne lii, aku nèngu na, yusuf! kèd'i ka! mèti ka ana ne dènge ina na asa isra'el. te dhèu dhu neo pamadhe ana ne, madhe le.

source_text: and he arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of israel.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yusuf kèd'i. èle ka nèti si asa rai isra'el.

source_text: but when he heard that archelaus was reigning over judæa in the room of his father herod, he was afraid to go thither; and being warned of god in a dream, he withdrew into the parts of galilee,
target_text: te ngaa ropa yusuf tadèngi na, arkalaus, ana dhèu aae herodes, dhu j'aj'i dhèu aae limuri ne ètu propensi yudea, ka na madha'u la'e asa yudea. èle èèna ka, ama lamatua peka hari dènge ne ètu d'ara nii, na, yusuf, èu baku pea ètu yudea. nèti èèna ka, lasi pea asa propensi galilea,

source_text: and came and dwelt in a city called nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets, that he should be called a nazarene.
target_text: ètu rae nasaret. dènge j'ara ne lii padhai ama lamatua lèke tare'a, nuka sèmi ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai na suri tèke, na bèli-camèd'a dhèu paroa ne, dhèu nasaret.

source_text: and in those days cometh john the baptist, preaching in the wilderness of judæa, saying,
target_text: lod'o yesus dhu kapai le, hèia yohanis tuka sarani mulai aj'a-nori dhèu ètu era dhu dhèu pea boe ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: repent ye; for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
target_text: na aj'a peka na, a'ari pasue! miu hud'i mangaku aa tèke eele ku sasala-sasigo miu, ho lèpa asa ama lamatua. te limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: for this is he that was spoken of through isaiah the prophet, saying, the voice of one crying in the wilderness, make ye ready the way of the lord, make his paths straight.
target_text: uru èèna, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri le lula-nèti yohanis ne, aku nèngu na, bèli-camèd'a abhu dhèu pa'oo-parodha ètu d'ara mamoo, peka na, ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i pa'èra sèna ka tao pabe'a j'ara, ho sèmi mamai ama lamatua! tao pamola j'ara hia ne! '

source_text: now john himself had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his food was locusts and wild honey.
target_text: j'ara mamuri yohanis ne, ca ropa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru sèra. mèdha-papake na tao nèti rèu badha onta. dhari hake na nèti ka'uri badha. nganga'a na, kabara dènge dhua nasu oni.

source_text: then went out unto him jerusalem, and all judæa, and all the region round about the jordan;
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai neo paraga dènge yohanis. rèngu mai nèti kota yerusalem, nèti kabarai propensi yudea aa'i-aa'i, dènge nèti rae-rae dhu dètu loko yarden.

source_text: and they were baptized of him in the river jordan, confessing their sins.
target_text: ra bhoka d'ara ra, aa mangaku sasala-sasigo aa'i-aa'i, èle ka yohanis sarani si ètu d'ara loko yarden.

source_text: but when he saw many of the pharisees and sadducees coming to his baptism, he said unto them, ye offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae nèti partei agama parisi dènge dhèu partei agama saduki, lasi asa era èèna kahèi, manèngi yohanis sarani si. te ngaa ropa yohanis ladhe nèdhi si, hèia na jèke si, peka na, heeh! miu se cakaraa mege dhu kapod'e-kabèli. bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua huku mi, lula tatao miu dhu bhelu-katub'a sèra. mage mi pangee na, miu bisa rai nèti hahuku na.

source_text: bring forth therefore fruit worthy of repentance:
target_text: de be'a risi miu lèpa sa ama lamatua, aa tèke eele sasala miu sèra. èle na, tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, sèmi aj'u dhu hua be'a.

source_text: and think not to say within yourselves, we have abraham to our father: for i say unto you, that god is able of these stones to raise up children unto abraham.
target_text: mage mi pangee na, miu se abhu mamuri, lula j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham. mi sanèd'e lii ja'a, ee! te ama lamatua bisa tao hadhu se j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham kahèi.

source_text: and even now the axe lieth at the root of the trees: every tree therefore that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
target_text: baku pamud'e! te abhu dhu kèpe mema kataka, pa'èra patue aa'i-aa'i aj'u dhu hua be'a boe, sèna ka core asa d'ara ai.

source_text: i indeed baptize you in water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than i, whose shoes i am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you in the holy spirit and in fire:
target_text: limuri ne, ja'a sarani miu pake èi, ho j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, miu se tèke eele sasala-sasala miu. te ngaa pe abhu ca dhèu dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a, bèli-camèd'a mai. masi ka j'aj'i ana pua-paleha na, ja'a nia boe sa hèi. èèna na, nèngu papènu d'ara miu dènge roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci. nèngu tao miu j'aj'i mola-mèci kahèi, sama sèmi dhèu pake ai ho bhubhu maruru.

source_text: whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing-floor; and he will gather his wheat into the garner, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.
target_text: te nèngu dhu nèd'u kokotai dènge laludhu ètu d'ara, ho neo tatai eele èto na. èle èèna, na bhori laludhu asa d'ara soka. te ngaa èto sèra, na dutu asa d'ara ai dhu heo robhe-robhe dhu madhe boe.

source_text: then cometh jesus from galilee to the jordan unto john, to be baptized of him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus puru mai nèti galilea, la'e asa loko yarden. na mai sèna ka manèngi yohanis sarani ne.

source_text: but john would have hindered him, saying, i have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
target_text: te ngaa yohanis no'o boe. na pab'ala peka na, tasamia ka ja'a sarani èu? sale ne, sina ma? hud'i èu ku dhu sarani ja'a. te èèna ka dhu ja'a parluu!

source_text: but jesus answering said unto him, suffer it now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. then he suffereth him.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, pangee ia ka. te ngaa doe ne'e, hud'i laa èu di dhu sarani ja'a. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èdhi tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. ropa tadèngi nare, ka yohanis b'ala, aku nèngu na, sad'i aku èu hèia yohanis sarani yesus.

source_text: and jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway from the water: and lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the spirit of god descending as a dove, and coming upon him;
target_text: ropa sarani èle, ka yesus kalua nèti d'ara loko. cag'ag'a laa, liru bhoke eele. hèia ladhe nèdhi roh ama lamatua puru mai, nuka sèmi koro j'aha dhu mai tèka mi nèngu.

source_text: and lo, a voice out of the heavens, saying, this is my beloved son, in whom i am well pleased.
target_text: hèia ra tadèngi lii ama lamatua nèti dedha-liru, peka na, nèngu ne, ana pasue ja'a. nèngu pakarej'e taruu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: then was jesus led up of the spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
target_text: èle ka, roh ama lamatua nèti yesus asa d'ara mamoo, sèna ka dhèu aae nidhu sèku ne.

source_text: and when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he afterward hungered.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, yesus na'a-ninu boe èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda. hèia na manganga titu kèna.

source_text: and the tempter came and said unto him, if thou art the son of god, command that these stones become bread.
target_text: ropa na manganga sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu aae nidhu mai sèku ne, peka na, èu ne tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, do? ladhe tare'a, na, paredha hadhu se, ho j'aj'i nganga'a.

source_text: but he answered and said, it is written, man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, na, dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na: ‘dhèu rai-haha mamuri mesa boe nèti nganga'a di. te ngaa rèngu hud'i nanene ku lii holo-nori ama lamatua, aa tao madhutu dad'èi na kahèi. '

source_text: then the devil taketh him into the holy city; and he set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
target_text: ka dhèu aae nidhu nèti yesus asa kota yerusalem, kota lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna. èle ka, na nèti yesus asa era dhu dedha risi ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and saith unto him, if thou art the son of god, cast thyself down: for it is written, he shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and, on their hands they shall bear thee up, lest haply thou dash thy foot against a stone.
target_text: hèia nidhu ne, peka, ladhe èu ne tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, èu ridhu sèku asa haha nèi. te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, ‘pe ama lamatua pua ana pajuu nèti sorga, sèna ka j'aga èu. ' aa ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri kahèi, ‘pe ra kanata ai ra, ho sibhe èu, sèna ka ngi'u èu pèd'a boe, aa haga èu goi lèke boe hadhu sa hèi. '

source_text: jesus said unto him, again it is written, thou shalt not make trial of the lord thy god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, abhu kahèi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ‘ama lamatua èèna, lamatua èu. de èu baku pua ne pake koasa na, sèna ka pad'elo bukti, peka na, nèngu èèna, tare'a-re'a ama lamatua. '

source_text: again, the devil taketh him unto an exceeding high mountain, and showeth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae nidhu ne nèti hari yesus asa kolo ledhe dhu dedha aae. hèia na pad'elo aa'i saraga dènge babe'a negara aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and he said unto him, all these things will i give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
target_text: ropa na pad'elo nare, hèia dhèu aae nidhu ne peka, aku nèngu na, sad'i èu patitu kètu urutuu, sèna ka pahaha iisi mi ja'a, pe ja'a hia aa'i se'e se mi èu.

source_text: then saith jesus unto him, get thee hence, satan: for it is written, thou shalt worship the lord thy god, and him only shalt thou serve.
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke ne, peka na, he, nidhu! pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e ne! te sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, suri na, ‘èu hud'i pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, aa èu ne hud'i sab'a ku dhoka hia nèngu di. '

source_text: then the devil leaveth him; and behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae nidhu tadèngi lii ne, hèia na tèke eele yesus. te ngaa ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga mai uri ne.

source_text: now when he heard that john was delivered up, he withdrew into galilee;
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae herodes pamaso yohanis tuka sarani asa d'ara èmu bèdho. ropa yesus tadèngi, hèia na lèpa asa galilea.

source_text: and leaving nazareth, he came and dwelt in capernaum, which is by the sea, in the borders of zebulun and naphtali:
target_text: la'e asa rae na nasaret, èle ka la'e taruu pea ètu rae kapernaum. rae èèna ètu sebhe dano galilea, ètu rai sebulon dènge naftali.

source_text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through isaiah the prophet, saying,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, na tao madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, peka na,

source_text: the land of zebulun and the land of naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the jordan, galilee of the gentiles,
target_text: rai sebulon dènge rai naftali dhu padètu dènge dano galilea ètu sebhe haa loko yarden. dhèu yahudi boe pea ètu era sèra kahèi.

source_text: the people that sat in darkness saw a great light, and to them that sat in the region and shadow of death, to them did light spring up.
target_text: rèngu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, te ngaa limuri ne, rèdhi le saraa. aa saraa ne heo le palème mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadhe mèka ama lamatua.

source_text: from that time began jesus to preach, and to say, repent ye; for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, yesus mulai aj'a-nori dhèu, peka na, miu hud'i soro kabodho aa tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu, ho mamuri ka dènge mola-mèci! te limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa le j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: and walking by the sea of galilee, he saw two brethren, simon who is called peter, and andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishers.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus kako re sebhe dano galilea. na paraga dènge dhèu dua dhu pa'a'ari. èci ngara na simon, dhu tema paroa ne, petrus. aa ari na, anderias. dua ra dhu pèku i'a ètu dano galilea, lula dua ra dhèu sab'a dhasi.

source_text: and he saith unto them, come ye after me, and i will make you fishers of men.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa si, aku nèngu na, mai ku madhutu ja'a! miu biasa tenge i'a, te ngaa limuri ne ja'a neo aj'a miu ho j'aj'i tuka tenge dhèu.

source_text: and they straightway left the nets, and followed him.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia dua ra tèke eele dènge ka pèku ra, lasi madhutu yesus.

source_text: and going on from thence he saw two other brethren, james the son of zebedee, and john his brother, in the boat with zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
target_text: èle ka, yesus kako hari ciki, hèia ladhe nèdhi ana sabadeus, dhèu dua. a'a, ngara na yakobis, aa ari na, yohanis. dua ra dhu lalau paie pèku ètu dedha koha sama-sama dènge ama ra. hèia yesus paroa dua ra, sèna ka madhutu ne.

source_text: and they straightway left the boat and their father, and followed him.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia ra tèke eele ama dènge koha ra, lasi madhutu ne.

source_text: and jesus went about in all galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of disease and all manner of sickness among the people.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si kako palème propensi galilea, ho na aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. na aj'a lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, aa na peka j'ara-j'ara tasamia, sèna ka dhèu bisa madhutu paredha ama lamatua. aa na puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu nèti rupa-rupa papèd'a-tarègu.

source_text: and the report of him went forth into all syria: and they brought unto him all that were sick, holden with divers diseases and torments, possessed with demons, and epileptic, and palsied; and he healed them.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, tatao yesus ne dhèu lolo palème toke d'ai propensi siria aa'i-aa'i. hèia dhèu rèti dhèu ra dhu lèke rupa-rupa papèd'a asa yesus. dhèu se rèti kahèi dhèu dhu nidhu tao, dhu huj'u kahib'i, dènge dhu karuku. ka na puri-pa'èle aa'i si.

source_text: and there followed him great multitudes from galilee and decapolis and jerusalem and judæa and from beyond the jordan.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae-ae mai madhutu ne. dhèu se mai nèti propensi galilea, aa nèti rai canguru kota, dhu ra peka na, dekapolis. dhèu cahag'e mai nèti kota yerusalem, nèti propensi yudea, aa nèti cabèka dhimu loko yarden.

source_text: and seeing the multitudes, he went up into the mountain: and when he had sat down, his disciples came unto him:
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ae-ae mai madhutu ne, hèia na ca'e la'e asa ledhe iiki cue, ka na madhèdi ètu èèna. ana-ana madhutu dhu na hag'e nare sèra, mai padètu sèna ka nanene ne.

source_text: and he opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
target_text: hèia na aj'a-nori si, peka na,

source_text: blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: dhèu kasia, rèngu oto, lula ama lamatua mesa na, ka dhèu aae rèngu dhu hua iia.

source_text: blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
target_text: dhèu dhu ètu d'ara sasusa, rèngu oto, lula ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu pamaho'o d'ara si.

source_text: blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
target_text: dhèu haha oto, lula rèngu ka dhu bèli-camèd'a sèmi rare mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua moa tèke.

source_text: blessed are they that hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'ara kateme dènge ama lamatua, rèngu oto, lula èèna na, nèngu ka dhu hia si ngaa dhu ra neo.

source_text: blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
target_text: dhèu dhu pad'elo rasa kasia mi dhèu leo, rèngu oto, lula èèna na, ama lamatua kasia rèngu kahèi.

source_text: blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see god.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, rèngu oto, lula èèna na, rèngu unu ra ladhe rèdhi ama lamatua.

source_text: blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called sons of god.
target_text: dhèu dhu tema padame dhèu, rèngu oto, lula èèna na ama lamatua ka dhu peka na, ‘rèngu se'e ka, ana ja'a. '

source_text: blessed are they that have been persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: dhèu dhu pasae j'aj'èra, lula ra madhutu ama lamatua, rèngu oto, lula lamatua mesa na ka, dhèu aae rèngu dhu hua iia.

source_text: blessed are ye when men shall reproach you, and persecute you, and say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
target_text: ladhe dhèu leo paj'èra miu, lula miu madhutu ja'a, miu oto kahèi. ladhe dhèu padhai kaked'u miu, aa lole pa'ele iie kolongara miu, miu oto kahèi.

source_text: rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets that were before you.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu hud'i pakasee iisi aa pakarej'e d'ara, lula ama lamatua dhu sadia nare le pala dhu ae hia miu ètu sorga. te ngaa sanèd'e! mesa boe miu di dhu dui j'aj'èra sèmi èèna, te lod'o uru sèra dhèu dhu paj'èra le kahèi dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost its savor, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under foot of men.
target_text: ladhe èdhi d'èi sèna ka nganga'a j'aj'i be'a, na, èdhi tao ku masi. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, rèngu parluu miu. te ngaa ladhe masi sèro heka, gaguna na, ngaa? dhoka core eele di ètu j'ara, ho dhèu j'èli ne.

source_text: ye are the light of the world. a city set on a hill cannot be hid.
target_text: miu hud'i mamuri ku sèmi labhu kahèi, sèna ka dhèu ae bisa ladhe rèdhi miu dènge be'a. miu hud'i heo lo'a-lo'a ku, nuka sèmi kota ètu kolo ledhe, dhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi ne.

source_text: neither do men light a lamp, and put it under the bushel, but on the stand; and it shineth unto all that are in the house.
target_text: ladhe dhèu paheo labhu iiki, ra saguru boe ne dènge èru rai, te ngaa ra padhèdi labhu ne ètu era dedha, ho pasaraa aa'i d'ara èmu.

source_text: even so let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your father who is in heaven.
target_text: miu hud'i mamuri ku sèmi èèna. mamuri miu hud'i saraa ku, sèna ka dhèu leo ladhe rèdhi mamuri miu dhu be'a. ropa dhèu ladhe rèdhi mamuri miu sèmi èèna, ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua, peka na, ‘ira ii! ama miu ètu sorga, kapai titu kèna, nga! '

source_text: think not that i came to destroy the law or the prophets: i came not to destroy, but to fulfil.
target_text: mage miu pangee na, mamai ja'a asa rai-haha ne, sèna ka tao eele atora ama lamatua dhu pangèd'u mi musa. aa baku pangee na, ja'a pusi-pahae boe dènge ngaa dhu uru èèna, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua peka tèke le. te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka pamèci j'ara aa'i-aa'i, nuka sèmi mia dhu ra peka tèke.

source_text: for verily i say unto you, till heaven and earth pass away, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass away from the law, till all things be accomplished.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, nanene paie-iie! liru dènge rai-haha bisa mèka laho aa'i, ladhe aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i mèka madhutu atora ama lamatua. masi ka ca katèd'a èèna ka, bisa boe ele nèti atora se.

source_text: whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, shall be called least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, he shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: nèti dhèu unu ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i, ladhe abhu dhu sisu atora ama lamatua, lula na pangee, na, ‘atora ne, ana iiki-iiki di, de gaguna na aad'o! ' hèia na aj'a sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu leo, pe ama lamatua ètu sorga, tao ne j'aj'i mi ca dhèu ana iiki. te ngaa bagi mi dhèu dhu tao madhutu aa'i atora ama lamatua, hèia na aj'a-nori dhèu leo sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua pakab'ua ne.

source_text: for i say unto you, that except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and pharisees, ye shall in no wise enter into the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: parcaya la ja'a! miu hud'i mamuri mola, risi nèti mese agama dènge dhèu partei agama parisi sèra. ladhe aad'o, na, miu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: ye have heard that it was said to them of old time, thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa dhu hia mi bèi-baki èdhi, peka na, ‘baku pamadhe dhèu, te dhèu cee dhu pamadhe dhèu nèngu lèke huku. '

source_text: but i say unto you, that every one who is angry with his brother shall be in danger of the judgment; and whosoever shall say to his brother, raca, shall be in danger of the council; and whosoever shall say, thou fool, shall be in danger of the hell of fire.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku panasa, te dhèu cee dhu nasa dènge a'ari na, èèna na nèngu lèke huku. dhèu dhu jèke a'ari na, ka peka na, ‘èu bod'o kabao! ' pe nèngu la'e dhaa asa dhèu heka-dhèu heka agama. aa dhèu cee dhu jèke a'ari na, ‘goa, ee! ' nèngu lèke huku ètu ai naraka.

source_text: if therefore thou art offering thy gift at the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath aught against thee,
target_text: de ladhe èu dhu mèti mèdha persembahan hia ama lamatua, te ngaa èu sanèd'e, na, abhu a'ari dhu nasa era dènge èu,

source_text: leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way, first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
target_text: tèke eele uuru ku mèdha persembahan sèra. hèia lamu padame ku dènge a'ari mu, èle, na heka mai hia persembahan se asa ama lamatua kèna.

source_text: agree with thine adversary quickly, while thou art with him in the way; lest haply the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
target_text: ladhe ca dhèu neo tao lii langu dènge èu, be'a risi lamu lai-lai ho padame dènge ne. ladhe aad'o, dhèu ne nèti èu asa hakim. hèia hakim saraka èu sa polisi, ka ra pamaso èu asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: verily i say unto thee, thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou have paid the last farthing.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e tare'a-re'a mi èu ne! èèna na èu pea taruu ètu d'ara bèdho, toke b'ae aa'i mèu-mèu kèlu-g'ètu èu sèra.

source_text: ye have heard that it was said, thou shalt not commit adultery:
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, dhu peka na, ‘baku bersina. '

source_text: but i say unto you, that every one that looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a neo peka na, sèmi ne'e: dhèu dhu ladhe nèdhi dhèu bhèni èci, hèia d'ara na neo j'unu pa'èci dènge ne, na, dhèu mone ne bersina le dènge bhèni ne ètu d'ara na.

source_text: and if thy right eye causeth thee to stumble, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not thy whole body be cast into hell.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake musi madha g'ana èu, na, ed'o eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge musi madha cabèka di, aa baku ra pèci mu asa d'ara ai naraka dènge musi madha dua-dua.

source_text: and if thy right hand causeth thee to stumble, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not thy whole body go into hell.
target_text: aa ladhe èu tao sala dènge kacui-aai g'ana èu, poro eele kacui-aai ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge kacui-aai cabèka di, aa baku ra pèci mu asa d'ara ai naraka dènge kacui-aai dhu kateme iisi.

source_text: it was said also, whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, na, ‘dhèu dhu pa'ia dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, nèngu hud'i hia ku sasuri pa'ia mi bhèni èèna. '

source_text: but i say unto you, that every one that putteth away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, maketh her an adulteress: and whosoever shall marry her when she is put away committeth adultery.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ia eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa bhèni ne tao nèdhi boe j'ara makae, hèia bhèni ne leo hari èmu, na, dhèu èmu uuru èèna ka dhu tao nèngu j'aj'i bersina. aa ladhe abhu dhèu mone dhu leo nare bhèni dhu dhèu èmu na ia eele, na, rèngu dua ra bersina kahèi.

source_text: again, ye have heard that it was said to them of old time, thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the lord thine oaths:
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa dhu na hia mi bèi-baki èdhi, peka na, ‘ladhe èu pajaji pake lii soo-subha, dhu ale kolongara ama lamatua, na, èu dhu pa'èki le dènge soo-subha èèna. '

source_text: but i say unto you, swear not at all; neither by the heaven, for it is the throne of god;
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe èu neo pajaji, na, mage mu j'oka subha. baku subha dènge ngara sorga, lula sorga èèna era pea ama lamatua.

source_text: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by jerusalem, for it is the city of the great king.
target_text: mage subha pake ngara rai-haha, lula rai-haha ne, era bane haga ama lamatua. aa mage subha pake ngara yerusalem, lula yerusalem èèna, kota nèti dhèu aae kapai.

source_text: neither shalt thou swear by thy head, for thou canst not make one hair white or black.
target_text: baku subha pake ngara kab'a kètu miu. te miu dènge boe koasa ho paredha rèu kètu miu, sèna ka ca loa sa j'aj'i mèdhi do j'aj'i pudhi.

source_text: but let your speech be, yea, yea; nay, nay: and whatsoever is more than these is of the evil one.
target_text: de ladhe miu neo pajaji, dhu peka oo, na, peka la ‘oo' di. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, na, peka la, ‘aad'o' di. ladhe miu peka risi nèti èèna, sèra sa j'aj'aj'i nèti nidhu.

source_text: ye have heard that it was said, an eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, dhu peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu cee dhu pa'ele iie musi madha miu, na, pa'ele iie kahèi musi madha na. aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pakabhui eele ngutu èu, na, pakabhui eele ngutu na kahèi. '

source_text: but i say unto you, resist not him that is evil: but whosoever smiteth thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku b'ala bhabhelu dènge bhabhelu. ladhe dhèu tèb'e ripi èu cabèka, na hud'i laa, na tèb'e hari ripi dhu leo.

source_text: and if any man would go to law with thee, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo tenge lii langu dènge èu, ho neo nare kodho èu, na, hia ne kodho pana èu kahèi.

source_text: and whosoever shall compel thee to go one mile, go with him two.
target_text: ladhe sordad'u ca dhèu laka-seti èu ho pasae mèdha na kako d'ai ca kilometer, na, èu pasae mèti kaj'èu na toke dua kilometer.

source_text: give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo manèngi nare mèdha èu èci, na, hia la. aa ladhe dhèu neo pija mèdha èu, na, hia la.

source_text: ye have heard that it was said, thou shalt love thy neighbor, and hate thine enemy:
target_text: miu tadèngi le, dhu peka na, ‘sue la a'ari èu, aa nasa la dènge dhèu dhu nasa dènge èu. '

source_text: but i say unto you, love your enemies, and pray for them that persecute you;
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: èu hud'i sue ku dhèu dhu nasa dènge èu, aa manèngi ho lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu paj'èra èu.

source_text: that ye may be sons of your father who is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sendeth rain on the just and the unjust.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sèmi èèna, èu pad'elo, na, èu ana ama ètu sorga. lula nèngu ka tao madha lod'o hia dhèu dhu be'a, dènge dhèu dhu bhelu. na papuru èj'i hia dhèu dhu tao madhutu paredha na, aa mi dhèu dhu lab'a paredha na kahèi.

source_text: for if ye love them that love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
target_text: de ladhe èu sue dhoka dhèu dhu sue èu, èu ngee na ama lamatua hud'i b'ala hia èu mèngi-nale, do? aad'o! te dhèu bhelu kahèi ne'a sue angalai na, dhu sue nèngu.

source_text: and if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the gentiles the same?
target_text: de ladhe èu me'a dhoka hia lii maho'o mi angalai èu, na, kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua, re'a ad'u-ue j'ara sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: ye therefore shall be perfect, as your heavenly father is perfect.
target_text: de sanèd'e, ee! ama mu ètu sorga sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i. de èu hud'i tao madhutu ku sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: take heed that ye do not your righteousness before men, to be seen of them: else ye have no reward with your father who is in heaven.
target_text: yesus aj'a taruu, peka na, sanèd'e! mage mi madhutu atora agama di, sèna ka dhèu pad'iri miu. te ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, ama miu ètu sorga b'ala boe rui-j'aj'èra miu.

source_text: when therefore thou doest alms, sound not a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. verily i say unto you, they have received their reward.
target_text: ladhe miu neo soru-bara dhèu kasia, mage lami palolo asa mia-mia. te ladhe miu se tao sèmi èèna, miu ca ropa dènge dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu sèmi sèra, d'èi lasi karihu asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ho dhèu koa si, peka na, ‘ira ii! dhèu ne maj'èni madhutu atora agama, nga! ' ja'a peka mola-mola kèna! dhèu dhu tema sèmi rare lii koa-kad'iri nèti dhèu, rèngu se abhu le pala ra.

source_text: but when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
target_text: de ladhe miu neo soru-bara dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, mage mi palolo kahèi!

source_text: that thine alms may be in secret: and thy father who seeth in secret shall recompense thee.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne re'a boe. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a ngaa dhu miu tao pahuni. pe nèngu ka dhu b'ala hia miu berkat ae-ae.

source_text: and when ye pray, ye shall not be as the hypocrites: for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. verily i say unto you, they have received their reward.
target_text: lod'o miu sabaj'a, miu baku tao nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu se d'èi lasi asa j'ara dhu dhèu ae-ae, aa titu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ho dhèu koa-kad'iri si, peka na, ‘dhèu se, dhèu mola-mèci! ' te ngaa nanene pabe'a-be'a! dènge rèngu abhu koa sèmi èèna, rèngu sèmi rare le pala ra.

source_text: but thou, when thou prayest, enter into thine inner chamber, and having shut thy door, pray to thy father who is in secret, and thy father who seeth in secret shall recompense thee.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku sèmi èèna. ladhe miu manèngi-mangaj'i, lami asa d'ara kama ho bèdho babèdho na. èle èèna, heka mi sabaj'a mau-mau hia ama mi ètu sorga. masi ka dhèu leo rèdhi boe, te ngaa ama miu ladhe nèdhi. bèli-camèd'a na b'ala hia miu berkat ae-ae.

source_text: and in praying use not vain repetitions, as the gentiles do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
target_text: ladhe miu sabaj'a, baku padhai lii dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. te dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua sabaj'a sèmi èèna ka. rèngu pangee, na, ama lamatua d'èi nanene lii manèngi ra dhu madhera lola-lola èèna.

source_text: be not therefore like unto them: for your father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
target_text: mage mi madhutu j'ara rèngu sèra! te masi ka miu dhae manèngi mèka ngaa-ngaa nèti ama mi ètu sorga, te ngaa nèngu dhu ne'a mema le, ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: after this manner therefore pray ye: our father who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name.
target_text: de ladhe sabaj'a, na, madhutu la conto sèmi ne'e: ‘ama ètu sorga! kolongara ama dhu mola-mèci. hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama dhu kapai èèna.

source_text: thy kingdom come. thy will be done, as in heaven, so on earth.
target_text: hud'i laa ama j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i! hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i, tao madhutu paredha ama ètu rai-haha ne, nuka sèmi ana pajuu ama, tao madhutu paredha ama ètu sorga.

source_text: give us this day our daily bread.
target_text: ama, hia la ji'i nganga'a-nganginu dhu d'ai bèli-bèli.

source_text: and forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
target_text: ji'i manèngi, ho ama saku eele aa'i sasala-sasigo ji'i, nuka sèmi ji'i kahèi pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu dhu ra tao mi ji'i.

source_text: and bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.
target_text: ama, j'aga la ji'i, sèna ka ji'i baku tao bhabhelu. aa pakaj'èu la ji'i nèti koasa nidhu, te ama ka dhèu aae dhu koasa kapai risi eele. aa ama ka dhu mèd'u paredha, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. sabaj'a ji'i d'ai sange ne'e ka, ama. amin. '

source_text: for if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly father will also forgive you.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e, ee! ladhe miu pabhèlu eele sasala dhu dhèu tao mi miu, èèna na ama mi ètu sorga saku eele sasala-sasigo miu kahèi.

source_text: but if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your father forgive your trespasses.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu mo'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala dhu dhèu tao mi miu, bèli-camèd'a ama mi bhèlu boe sasala miu kahèi.

source_text: moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may be seen of men to fast. verily i say unto you, they have received their reward.
target_text: ladhe miu manèngi-mangaj'i aa puasa, mage mi tao rèhu susa, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. te ra ad'u-ue j'ara èèna, ho dhèu pad'iri si, peka na, ‘dhèu se'e se, dhèu mola-mèci! ' te ngaa sanèd'e, ee! dènge sèmi rare koa-kad'iri sèmi èèna, na, rèngu abhu le pala ra.

source_text: but thou, when thou fastest, anoint thy head, and wash thy face;
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu puasa, lèu pamèu-mèu rèhu mi, aa sageri paie kètu miu!

source_text: that thou be not seen of men to fast, but of thy father who is in secret: and thy father, who seeth in secret, shall recompense thee.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu rèdhi miu, re'a boe na, miu dhu puasa. te ngaa ama miu ne'a. pe na pala hia miu mèngi-nale ae-ae.

source_text: lay not up for yourselves treasures upon the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal:
target_text: miu baku sab'a taruu, ho dhodhoka pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu rai-haha ne di. te hub'u dènge rutu pa'ele iie aa'i si. aa dhèu mana'u mai pa'ele iie era tatèka mèdha-panyau, aa mana'u rèti si.

source_text: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth consume, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
target_text: te ngaa be'a risi miu maj'èni sab'a, sèna ka pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu sorga. te ètu era nèi, abhu boe hub'u dènge rutu dhu pa'ele iie si, aa abhu boe dhèu mana'u, ho mai mana'u rèti.

source_text: for where thy treasure is, there will thy heart be also.
target_text: te ladhe miu tèka mèdha-panyau miu ètu era mia, na, tatu d'ara miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: the lamp of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
target_text: musi madha dhèu, nuka sèmi labhu dhu pasaraa d'ara ra. ladhe musi madha na mèu, nèngu madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu hua iia, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu kako ètu d'ara saraa.

source_text: but if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. if therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is the darkness!
target_text: te ngaa ladhe musi madha na ahu, nèngu bisa boe kako madhutu madha j'ara mola, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu gogo ai lae-lae ètu d'ara maroga. de ladhe saraa ètu d'ara miu j'aj'i maroga, na miu mamuri d'ara maroga kahèi.

source_text: no man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. ye cannot serve god and mammon.
target_text: dhèu bisa boe sab'a hia dua lamatua, lula èèna na nèngu d'èi risi ca dhèu di. bisa kahèi nèngu madhutu lamatua èci, aa pusi-pahae boe dhu leo. nèti èèna ka, èu bisa boe peka na, ‘ama lamatua èèna, lamatua ja'a, ' ladhe èu tao doi-dhari j'aj'i mi lamatua èu.

source_text: therefore i say unto you, be not anxious for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. is not the life more than the food, and the body than the raiment?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku bhute pangee, na, ja'a mamuri tasa mera mia, ku'a-kinu ngaa, pake ngaa? miu pangee na, mamuri ne dhoka ta'a-tinu, di? aa ngi'u ne, dhoka pake mèdha-papake, di? aad'o sèmi èèna.

source_text: behold the birds of the heaven, that they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; and your heavenly father feedeth them. are not ye of much more value than they?
target_text: ladhe ku manu-bhui dhu lela ètu talora liru. rèngu bhute rèdhi boe sèla hini, dènge puu-g'ètu, ho tèka nganga'a ètu d'ara soka. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga piara manu-bhui sèra taruu. tatu nèngu kab'oi miu risi eele nèti rèngu. de ngee pabe'a-be'a. te ama lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: and which of you by being anxious can add one cubit unto the measure of his life?
target_text: ladhe dhèu titu ètu madha tèru, ho na bhute dènge lalau ngi'u na, nèngu bisa pamadhera hari ngi'u na, do? bisa boe!

source_text: and why are ye anxious concerning raiment? consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
target_text: ladhe bisa boe, na, nga tao ka miu bhute dènge pangee hari mèdha-papake? lami ladhe ku hela bunga dhu muri tab'a ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a. rèngu manyèru boe hèngu, aa manènu boe sig'i sa hèi.

source_text: yet i say unto you, that even solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e ku la! mèdha-papake dhèu aae soleman dhu kab'ua risi, saraga na bisa boe segi saraga hela bunga ne.

source_text: but if god doth so clothe the grass of the field, which to-day is, and to-morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, o ye of little faith?
target_text: te ama lamatua taru kira mi bunga dhu muri dhoka doe ne'e, aa bèli madhe, ho dhèu core asa d'ara ai. ladhe na tao sèmi èèna, tatu nèngu papake miu risi eele nèti hela bunga sèra. de tasamia ka miu parcaya pa'èra boe mi nèngu?

source_text: be not therefore anxious, saying, what shall we eat? or, what shall we drink? or, wherewithal shall we be clothed?
target_text: de baku mi pangee na, ‘ji'i neo nga'a ngaa? ' do, ‘neo nginu ngaa? ' do, ‘neo pake ngaa? '

source_text: for after all these things do the gentiles seek; for your heavenly father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
target_text: dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua, rèngu sab'a loe boe ho neo abhu aa'i-aa'i se. te ngaa miu baku tao sèmi èèna, te ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a aa'i le, ngaa-ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: but seek ye first his kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i pakako uuru ku sasab'a na, aa hud'i madhutu ku paredha na, heka na hia miu aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu.

source_text: be not therefore anxious for the morrow: for the morrow will be anxious for itself. sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
target_text: de baku bhute pangee, na, bèli miu parluu ngaa. te bèli èèna dènge bhabhute unu na. sasusa lod'o doe ne'e, èle ètu doe ne'e kahèi.

source_text: judge not, that ye be not judged.
target_text: miu baku galaa dhèu, sèna ka ama lamatua baku pasala miu kahèi.

source_text: for with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured unto you.
target_text: ladhe miu nile dhèu sèmi mia, pe ama lamatua nile miu sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe miu ige sasala dhèu sèmi mia, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua ige sasala miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
target_text: masi ka sasala dhèu ciki oo'e èèna ka, èu bhèlu boe. te ngaa sasala èu dhu kapai, èu pame'a boe ciki sa. èci èèna ka dènge èu ladhe mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu d'ara madha angalai èu, te ngaa abhu agarii aae ca laa dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu, dhu èu me'a more boe.

source_text: or how wilt thou say to thy brother, let me cast out the mote out of thine eye; and lo, the beam is in thine own eye?
target_text: nga tao ka èu bani peka na, ‘angalai! mai ho ja'a tiu eele ahu nèti d'ara madha èu'. aa te ngaa èu mesa mu bisa boe mèdhi ngaa-ngaa, lula agarii aae dhu hutu nare musi madha mu.

source_text: thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.
target_text: heeh! èu ne, mema dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! tao eele uuru ku agarii nèti musi madha èu, heka ladhe mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu d'ara madha angalai mu, sèna ka èu bisa tiu eele ahu ne kèna.

source_text: give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast your pearls before the swine, lest haply they trample them under their feet, and turn and rend you.
target_text: baku aj'a j'ara lamatua dhu mola-mèci mi dhèu dhu d'èi pahahe dhèu. lula dhèu sèra nuka sèmi busa pakadhi, dhu ra kabèli mai kadhi hari miu. rèngu sèra goa sama sèmi hahi kahèi. ladhe dhèu hia ne mutiara dhu kab'ua, na pusi boe! te ne'a dhoka j'èli palaho di.

source_text: ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
target_text: ladhe miu sabaj'a, baku loe manèngi mi lamatua; te èèna na, na hia. ladhe patangi-tenge; pe na pad'elo j'ara. ladhe kad'eu taruu babèdho; pe na bhoke.

source_text: for every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu loe boe manèngi mi lamatua, èèna na ra sèmi rare. dhu patangi-tenge, pe ra abhu. dhu kad'eu taruu, pe na bhoke èmu.

source_text: or what man is there of you, who, if his son shall ask him for a loaf, will give him a stone;
target_text: miu pangee sèku! ladhe ana manèngi roti, tatu ama na hia boe ne hadhu, si?

source_text: or if he shall ask for a fish, will give him a serpent?
target_text: do, ladhe ana manèngi i'a, ama na hia boe mege, sina ma?

source_text: if ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your father who is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
target_text: ama mi ètu sorga, mema d'ara na hua iia titu kèna! de ladhe dhèu rai-haha dhu bhelu-katub'a sèmi miu, me'a hia mèdha dhu be'a mi ana miu, ngaa hari ama mi! tatu na bagi hia miu ngaa dhu miu manèngi.

source_text: all things therefore whatsoever ye would that men should do unto you, even so do ye also unto them: for this is the law and the prophets.
target_text: de, ngaa dhu èu neo dhèu leo tao mi èu, na, èu hud'i tao sèmi èèna kahèi hia nèngu. lula ne'e ne ka, j'aj'i mi kapua nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu musa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu peka-padhai karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: enter ye in by the narrow gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many are they that enter in thereby.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo maso sorga, nèngu hud'i maso ku re hèb'a kota dhu kob'o. te ngaa mage-mage, oo! abhu kahèi j'ara leo dhu mud'a, aa hèb'a dhu taleo, dhu dhèu ae-ae lasi re èèna. te j'ara sèmi èèna ka dhu lere dhèu asa naraka, ka ra cèri eele nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: for narrow is the gate, and straitened the way, that leadeth unto life, and few are they that find it.
target_text: dhèu dhu neo maso sorga, hud'i madhutu ku j'ara dhu susa, aa maso re hèb'a dhu kob'o. te, masi ka dhèu ciki di dhu kako re j'ara èèna, te ngaa j'ara dhu kob'o èèna ka, dhu nèti dhèu asa lamatua.

source_text: beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge dhèu dhu tema kapod'e-kabèli, dhu d'èi padedha iisi, peka na, rèngu se dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua. te rèngu tao ngi'u ra be'a nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho. te ngaa rèngu se dhèu bhelu-katub'a, èci èèna ka dènge busa hui dhu mai kadhi kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: by their fruits ye shall know them. do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
target_text: tasamia ho miu bisa tadhe dhèu dhu kapod'e sèmi sèra? ladhe la nèti tatao rèngu. èèna sèmi dhèu ladhe rèdhi hua, hèia tadhe dènge ana aaj'u ne. hua dhu be'a, mai boe nèti aj'u dhu karehe.

source_text: even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but the corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
target_text: te aj'u dhu be'a ladhe d'ai hua, hua na be'a kahèi. te ngaa aj'u dhu karehe ladhe na hua, hua na karehe kahèi.

source_text: a good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
target_text: abhu ètu mia, aj'u dhu be'a, hua na karehe, aa aj'u dhu karehe, hua na be'a?

source_text: every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
target_text: aj'u dhu hua na karehe, tatu ra patue eele, ho core asa d'ara ai.

source_text: therefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge rèngu dhu rèti lii padhai kapod'e-kabèli sèra. miu tadhe si nèti tatao ra.

source_text: not every one that saith unto me, lord, lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my father who is in heaven.
target_text: èèna na abhu dhèu dhu paroa ja'a, na, ‘lamatua! ' te ngaa rèngu dhoka ale ètu hèb'a di. bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua ètu sorga tule eele si. te dhodhoka dhèu dhu d'èi tao madhutu dad'èi nèngu di, dhu na sèmi nare rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: many will say to me in that day, lord, lord, did we not prophesy by thy name, and by thy name cast out demons, and by thy name do many mighty works?
target_text: pe ropa d'ai èle rai-haha ne, dhèu ae mangaku, peka na, ja'a ne lamatua rèngu. aa dènge lii solo-mako, ra peka na, ‘lamatua! ji'i se la'a pakako a'aj'a lamatua ètu mia-mia, babège nidhu dènge kolongara lamatua, aa tao tadha-tadha malaa pake koasa nèti lamatua. '

source_text: and then will i profess unto them, i never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
target_text: masi ka rèngu solo-mako ja'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa èèna na ja'a peka dènge rèngu, na, ‘miu se, cee? ja'a tadhe boe miu, te miu mamuri boe madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. de mi pakaj'èu ka nèti ne'e! '

source_text: every one therefore that heareth these words of mine, and doeth them, shall be likened unto a wise man, who built his house upon the rock:
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene ja'a, hèia ra tao madhutu lii padhai ja'a, rèngu se nuka sèmi dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu, dhu patitu èmu ra ètu dedha hadhu kapua.

source_text: and the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon the rock.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka èj'i aae mai toke èi lala, aa ngèlu aae lèke èmu ne. te ngaa èmu ne guri boe, lula patitu ètu dedha hadhu kapua.

source_text: and every one that heareth these words of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, who built his house upon the sand:
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene ja'a, te ngaa tao boe madhutu lii padhai ja'a, nèngu ne èci èèna ka dènge dhèu goa dhu patitu èmu na ètu dedha salae.

source_text: and the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and smote upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall thereof.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka èj'i aae mai toke èi lala. ngèlu aae lèke èmu ne kahèi. hèia èmu ne guri eele, toke laho teb'o-teb'o.

source_text: and it came to pass, when jesus had finished these words, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching:
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra malaa-maloha, lula nanene a'aj'a na,

source_text: for he taught them as one having authority, and not as their scribes.
target_text: te nèngu ne'a mèu isi nèti a'aj'a ne. na aj'a-nori sèmi boe mese agama sèra.

source_text: and when he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
target_text: lod'o yesus puru nèti ledhe, hèia dhèu ae-ae lasi madhutu ne.

source_text: and behold, there came to him a leper and worshipped him, saying, lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, ca dhèu dhu pèd'a kusta mai paraga dènge ne. hèia na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus, ho manèngi, aku nèngu na, lamatua! sue ku ja'a la! ladhe mo'o, na, puri ku papèd'a ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu madenge ia ka dènge ja'a, aa ja'a bisa hari sabaj'a ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and he stretched forth his hand, and touched him, saying, i will; be thou made clean. and straightway his leprosy was cleansed.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yesus j'ole kacui-aai na ka na g'ag'e dhèu ne, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a ko'o! èu èle kèna! kabèdhi la, èi papèd'a dhèu ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: and jesus saith unto him, see thou tell no man; but go, show thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ne, sanèd'e paie! èu èle le nèti papèd'a-tarègu, te ngaa baku èu lolo dènge dhèu èci sa. aa èu hud'i madhutu ku atora musa. de lamu asa ama agama ho na parisa ngi'u èu, sèna ka ne'a na èi papèd'a mu ele le, tare'a, do dhae. èle na, èu hia persembahan tadha makasi, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, èu ne èle tare'a-re'a le nèti papèd'a.

source_text: and when he was entered into capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yesus maso asa d'ara rae kapernaum. ètu era ne'e, komedhaa sordad'u roma ca dhèu, mai manèngi ho yesus soru-bara ne, aku nèngu na,

source_text: and saying, lord, my servant lieth in the house sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
target_text: ama! ana sab'a ja'a ca dhèu, pèd'a aae, ka na j'èra titu kèna ètu èmu. na bisa boe puru nèti era j'unu na.

source_text: and he saith unto him, i will come and heal him.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, oo! pe ja'a dhiu puri-pa'èle ne.

source_text: and the centurion answered and said, lord, i am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof; but only say the word, and my servant shall be healed.
target_text: te ngaa komedhaa ne b'ala, aku nèngu na, ama! ama roca ia ka mai asa èmu ja'a, lula ja'a nia boe sèmi ama asa d'ara èmu ja'a. sad'i ama ku peka dhoka lii ca hèb'a di nèti ne'e, tatu ana sab'a ja'a ne èle dènge nèti papèd'a.

source_text: for i also am a man under authority, having under myself soldiers: and i say to this one, go, and he goeth; and to another, come, and he cometh; and to my servant, do this, and he doeth it.
target_text: ja'a ke'a j'ara ne, lula ja'a dènge dhèu paredha dedha kahèi, dhu dènge koasa ho paredha ja'a. aa ja'a dènge koasa kahèi, sèna ka paredha sordad'u ja'a sèra. ladhe ja'a pua, peka na, ‘lamu sa nèi! ' tatu na la'e dènge. aa ladhe ja'a peka, ‘mai asa ne'e! ' tatu na mai. aa ladhe ja'a paleha dhèu sab'a ja'a, peka na, ‘sab'a ne'e! ' tatu na tao madhutu. de sad'i ama ku lii di, tatu ana sab'a ja'a èèna, èle dènge nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and when jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, verily i say unto you, i have not found so great faith, no, not in israel.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi nare, hèia na malaa. ka na padhai lii dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a dhae paraga kèdhi mèka dènge ca dhèu sa nèti dhèu yahudi dhu lèka èra sama sèmi dhèu roma ne!

source_text: and i say unto you, that many shall come from the east and the west, and shall sit down with abraham, and isaac, and jacob, in the kingdom of heaven:
target_text: nanene paie-iie! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu leo rai kara ae-ae, nuka sèmi dhèu roma ne, mai nèti haa, nèti dhimu, ho madhèdi ra'a-rinu mei èci dènge abraham, isak dènge yakob ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: but the sons of the kingdom shall be cast forth into the outer darkness: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
target_text: masi ka lamatua dhu hag'e nare le dhèu yahudi, sena ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, te ngaa ae ka dhu pusi-pahae boe ne. èèna na, lamatua tule eele si asa era dhu maroga kiu-kiu. ètu era ne'e, ra tangi roma iisi d'ara pèd'a, aa ra j'èra titu kèna.

source_text: and jesus said unto the centurion, go thy way; as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. and the servant was healed in that hour.
target_text: padhai lii nare, hèia yesus peka dènge komedhaa ne, lèpa ka. te ana sab'a èu èèna èle le, madhutu sèmi parcaya èu ne. ka lod'o dhu na padhai èèna, ana ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: and when jesus was come into peter's house, he saw his wife's mother lying sick of a fever.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus la'e asa èmu petrus. na ladhe nèdhi ina dhèu èmu petrus dhu j'unu ètu dedha koi, dhu pèd'a maringi-sagoro.

source_text: and he touched her hand, and the fever left her; and she arose, and ministered unto him.
target_text: ka yesus kèpe kacui-aai na, hèia ina ne èle nèti papèd'a na. hèia na kèd'i, ka la'e lalau nganga'a hia yesus si.

source_text: and when even was come, they brought unto him many possessed with demons: and he cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all that were sick:
target_text: ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia dhèu sèra mai rèti dhèu rèngu dhu nidhu tao. hèia na paredha nidhu se, peka na, eee, nidhu! rai pakaj'èu nèti ne'e! hèia nidhu se kalua dènge ka. na puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu aa'i-aa'i nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through isaiah the prophet, saying, himself took our infirmities, and bare our diseases.
target_text: na tao j'ara se, ho pamèci dènge lii dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, dhu suri tèke le, peka na, na puri-pa'èle papèd'a-tarègu èdhi. aa pasae nare j'aj'èra èdhi.

source_text: now when jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus nèdhi dhèu ae-ae mai kalibhu rare ne. hèia na peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, mai pakèd'i lati asa cabèka dano.

source_text: and there came a scribe, and said unto him, teacher, i will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
target_text: hèia mese agama ca dhèu mai, padhai lii dènge ne, peka na, ama mese! sad'i ama asa mia èèna ka, ja'a bera-bera dènge ama!

source_text: and jesus saith unto him, the foxes have holes, and the birds of the heaven have nests; but the son of man hath not where to lay his head.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, be'a kahèi do! te ngaa sanèd'e. dhèu rai-haha aa badha-manu aa'i-aa'i, dhu dènge era pea-palu'u. busa hui lèpa asa ro'a na. manu-bhui la'e asa rèd'a na. te ngaa ja'a dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne dènge boe era pea-palu'u. nanèlu ho bane kètu dènge boe kahèi.

source_text: and another of the disciples said unto him, lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu èci hari mai peka dènge yesus, na, ama! ja'a neo madhutu ama, te ngaa hud'i ja'a ladhe-leru ku ina-ama ja'a. ladhe ama ku madhe, ho padhane kore, heka ja'a madhutu kèna.

source_text: but jesus saith unto him, follow me; and leave the dead to bury their own dead.
