source_text: having heard the things concerning jesus, came in the crowd behind, and touched his garment. for she said, if i touch but his garments, i shall be made whole. and straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of her plague.
target_text: bhèni ne tadèngi ae le dhèu palolo ngaa dhu yesus tao. nèti èèna ka, na mai pasuki asa talora dhèu ae sèra, ho na padètu dènge yesus. na pangee, na, sad'i ja'a gai lèke sebhe kodho na di, tatu papèd'a ja'a èle. ropa na gai lèke sebhe kodho yesus, kabèdhi laa raa bhèni ne tèja eele dènge. hèia na rasa, na be'a le.

source_text: and straightway jesus, perceiving in himself that the power proceeding from him had gone forth, turned him about in the crowd, and said, who touched my garments?
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, yesus rasa a'èra kalua nèti d'ara ngi'u na. ka na kabib'a asa kabodho, ho ladhe asa dhèu ae sèra, ka na karèi, peka na, nèti miu se, cee ka dhu gai lèke kodho ja'a?

source_text: and his disciples said unto him, thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, who touched me?
target_text: ka ana madhutu na dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama, ladhe ku laa. dhèu ae paseti sèmi ne'e. nga tao ka ama karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu gai kodho ja'a? '

source_text: and he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ladhe pala-lème, neo ne'a cee ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho na.

source_text: but the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
target_text: ropa yesus karèi sèmi èèna, hèia bhèni èèna madha'u bia. èle èèna ka, na mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus, ka na mangaku, ama! ja'a ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho ama ku deo na.

source_text: and he said unto her, daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mi bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu parcaya ja'a dènge d'ara kateme, nèti èèna ka, èu èle le. lamu ka èmu, dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: while he yet spake, they come from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying, thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the teacher any further?
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, hèia dhèu èci mai nèti èmu yairus, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ana mu madhe le. de baku paj'èra ia ka ama mese. nèngu la'e ia ka sa nèi.

source_text: but jesus, not heeding the word spoken, saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, fear not, only believe.
target_text: te ngaa yesus pusi boe dènge lii padhai lii dhèu ne'e. ka na peka dènge yairus, èu baku madha'u, ee! parcaya mi ama lamatua di.

source_text: and he suffered no man to follow with him, save peter, and james, and john the brother of james.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e dènge ka, tèke eele ana madhutu na cahag'e. nèti dhoka petrus, yakobis dènge yohanis.

source_text: and they come to the house of the ruler of the synagogue; and he beholdeth a tumult, and many weeping and wailing greatly.
target_text: ropa d'ai èmu yairus, rèngu rèdhi dhèu jau oob'a-jau oob'a, aa tadèngi cahag'e tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: and when he was entered in, he saith unto them, why make ye a tumult, and weep? the child is not dead, but sleepeth.
target_text: yesus maso asa d'ara, ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu maruru dènge tangi sèmi ne'e? ana ne'e madhe boe! nèngu dhoka bhèj'i di.

source_text: and they laughed him to scorn. but he, having put them all forth, taketh the father of the child and her mother and them that were with him, and goeth in where the child was.
target_text: dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi yesus peka sèmi èèna, ka ra mari pakapengo hèb'a dènge ne. hèia na pua dhèu sèra kalua aa'i nèti d'ara kama ana dhu madhe èèna. ka na paroa ina-ama ana bhèni ne, dènge ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra, maso asa d'ara.

source_text: and taking the child by the hand, he saith unto her, talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, damsel, i say unto thee, arise.
target_text: hèia yesus kèpe kacui-aai ana dhu madhe ne, ka na padhai lii pake lii rèngu, lii aram, aku nèngu na, talita kum! sasoa na, ana bhèni! kèd'i ka!

source_text: and straightway the damsel rose up, and walked; for she was twelve years old. and they were amazed straightway with a great amazement. and he charged them much that no man should know this: and he commanded that something should be given her to eat.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, ana dhu madhe èèna mamuri hari. hèia na kèd'i titu, ka na kako. hèia yesus peka dènge ina na, aku nèngu na, hia ana ne'e na'a-ninu! dhèu ae ètu sèra dhu rèdhi j'ara dhu j'aj'i ne, ra malaa titu kèna. hèia yesus kai si, peka na, mage mi peka dènge dhèu èci sa, ja'a ka dhu pamamuri hari ana ne.

source_text: and he went out from thence; and he cometh into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, lèpa hari asa rae na, nasaret.

source_text: and when the sabbath was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, whence hath this man these things? and, what is the wisdom that is given unto this man, and what mean such mighty works wrought by his hands?
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. hèia yesus la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ho na aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae lasi manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa ra tadèngi yesus aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua, hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra malaa, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne mèu samia ne! na dènge koasa kahèi! tasamia ka na sèmi èèna, ee?

source_text: is not this the carpenter, the son of mary, and brother of james, and joses, and judas, and simon? and are not his sisters here with us? and they were offended in him.
target_text: nèngu ne'e dhoka tuka aj'u di. èdhi tadhe ina na, maria. sèmi èèna kahèi ari na, yakobis, yoses, yudas dènge simon, dènge ari na dhèu bhèni sèra. rèngu dènge èdhi pea ca rae. dhèu se'e ngee ètu d'ara rèngu na, rèngu mèu risi nèti yesus. nèti èèna ka, ra d'èi heka nanene ne.

source_text: and jesus said unto them, a prophet is not without honor, save in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
target_text: ka yesus peka, mema tare'a! dhèu pakab'ua risi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti rae leo. te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu nèti rae nèngu.

source_text: and he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
target_text: d'ara dhèu sèra adhu sèmi hadhu, ka ra parcaya boe lii padhai lii yesus. nèti èèna ka, na malaa, hèia na pake boe koasa na. ka na puri-pa'èle dhoka dhèu pèri di, ètu èèna.

source_text: and he marvelled because of their unbelief. and he went round about the villages teaching.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako palème asa rae-rae dhu padètu ètu sèra, ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: and he calleth unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits;
target_text: na paroa nare ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra, ka na pua rèngu lasi dua-dua ho lole lii lolo be'a nèti ama lamatua. na hia si koasa kahèi, ho babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: and he charged them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse; but to go shod with sandals: and, said he, put not on two coats.
target_text: na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu baku mèti mèdha ae ètu d'ara kakako miu. baku mèti nganga'a, doi, dènge tas. mèti dhoka tatea, salapa ètu haga, dènge kodho ètu ua di.

source_text: and he said unto them, wheresoever ye enter into a house, there abide till ye depart thence.
target_text: ladhe cee dhu sèmi rare miu ètu èmu ra, miu pea dhoka ètu èèna di, toke d'ai pakèd'i hari.

source_text: and whatsoever place shall not receive you, and they hear you not, as ye go forth thence, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony unto them.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu lami asa era èci, hèia dhèu ètu sèra sèmi rare boe miu, aa ra d'èi boe nanene lii padhai lii miu, tèke eele era èèna. aa peka mi dhèu sèra, na, ‘miu mo'o boe nanene, si! de bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere pala mi! '

source_text: and they went out, and preached that men should repent.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lasi lole lii lolo be'a. ra peka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i ele ho'a nèti sasala-sasigo ra, ka lèpa ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: and they cast out many demons, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
target_text: ka ra babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu. ra pasuti èi lèngi mi kètu dhèu pèd'a, aa sabaj'a ho pa'èle si nèti papèd'a. ka ra èle dènge.

source_text: and king herod heard thereof; for his name had become known: and he said, john the baptizer is risen from the dead, and therefore do these powers work in him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu mia-mia tadhe aa'i le yesus. dhèu aae herodes tadèngi le lii lolo lula-nèti koasa yesus kahèi. dhèu palolo ètu mia-mia, aku rèngu na, yohanis tuka sarani èèna, mamuri hari le ètu d'ara ngi'u yesus! nèti èèna ka, na bisa tao tadha malaa sèra.

source_text: but others said, it is elijah. and others said, it is a prophet, even as one of the prophets.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu cahag'e hari peka, aku rèngu na, aad'o! ne'e ne, elia dhu mamuri hari d'ara ngi'u yesus. aa dhèu cahag'e hari, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo hari nèti uru sèra.

source_text: but herod, when he heard thereof, said, john, whom i beheaded, he is risen.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes tadèngi nare lii lolo dhèu se'e lula-nèti yesus, ka na dhaa, peka na, èèna yohanis tuka sarani, dhu ca hari ni ja'a hia dhèu pare pamadhe le, te ngaa na mamuri hari!

source_text: for herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon john, and bound him in prison for the sake of herodias, his brother philip's wife; for he had married her. for john said unto herod, it is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes pua sèmi èèna, lula nèngu lii langu dènge yohanis. lii lolo na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu aae herodes leo nare dhèu èmu ari na, pelipus, ngara na herodias. aa te ngaa pelipus dènge herodias dhae pa'ia mèka. nèti èèna ka, yohanis kai pahari-pahari, peka na, ama dhèu aae baku leo dènge dhèu èmu ari mu. te èèna sisu ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa herodes leo nare bhèni ne'e kahèi. hèia na pua dhèu lasi kèpe rare yohanis, ho pamaso ne asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and herodias set herself against him, and desired to kill him; and she could not;
target_text: lula yohanis kai pèri hari le, hèia bhèni ne tèka d'ara dènge ne, ka na neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa lake nare mèka, te herodes dhu pamaso le yohanis asa d'ara bèdho la'e.

source_text: for herod feared john, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. and when he heard him, he was much perplexed; and he heard him gladly.
target_text: ka na pua sordad'u sèra madhenge paie ne ètu d'ara bèdho. herodes madha'u dènge yohanis. na ne'a tare'a, yohanis ne dhèu dhu ama lamatua pua mai. aa yohanis ne dhèu d'ara mola. herodes d'èi nanene lii padhai lii yohanis kahèi. te ngaa stèka-stèka, d'ara na pèd'a nanene lii padhai lii yohanis.

source_text: and when a convenient day was come, that herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, and the high captains, and the chief men of galilee;
target_text: ka ca tèka, herodias abhu lod'o dhu be'a, sèna ka na b'ala d'ara pèd'a na. lod'o èèna, lèke dènge hari jadi herodes. ka ra nèru dhèu aae-dhèu kapai mai ra'a-sisi hari jad'i. dhèu dhu mai sèra, ama-ama dhu paredha, ama-ama sordad'u, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a ètu galilea.

source_text: and when the daughter of herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased herod and them that sat at meat with him; and the king said unto the damsel, ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and i will give it thee.
target_text: ètu d'ara talora tatao èèna, ana bhèni herodias la'e roge. na roge be'a risi eele, ka d'ara herodes dènge dhèu dhu nèru sèra karej'e bia. nèti èèna ka, herodes paroa ne mai asa madha, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, èu neo manèngi ngaa? èu peka ho ja'a hia.

source_text: and he sware unto her, whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, i will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
target_text: èu manèngi era paredha ja'a ne bagi dua, hia èu cabèka èèna ka, ja'a ko'o kahèi. ja'a subha dènge ngara ama lamatua!

source_text: and she went out, and said unto her mother, what shall i ask? and she said, the head of john the baptizer.
target_text: ka ana bhèni èèna la'e karèi ina na, aku nèngu na, ina, ee! madhutu ngangee ina ku, na, ja'a manèngi ngaa dhu be'a risi nèti ama ku? ka ina na dhaa, aku nèngu na, lamu asa madha ama mu ho peka dènge ne, ja'a manèngi dhoka kètu yohanis di.

source_text: and she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, i will that thou forthwith give me on a platter the head of john the baptist.
target_text: ka ana bhèni ne la'e asa madha herodes, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a manèngi kètu yohanis, tao ètu d'ara dula èci hia ja'a. deo ne'e ne, kahèi!

source_text: and the king was exceeding sorry; but for the sake of his oaths, and of them that sat at meat, he would not reject her.
target_text: ropa herodes tadèngi nare lii manèngi ana bhèni na, ka d'ara na cag'ag'a. te ngaa nèngu bisa heka ère hari lii subha nèngu deo na, lula dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi aa'i le.

source_text: and straightway the king sent forth a soldier of his guard, and commanded to bring his head: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
target_text: èle èèna ka, herodes paredha komedhaa sordad'u lasi poro rare kètu yohanis nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the damsel; and the damsel gave it to her mother.
target_text: ropa ra poro rare, ra tao asa d'ara dula èci, ka rèti la'a asa ana bhèni èèna. na sèmi nare, hèia nèti asa ina na la'e.

source_text: and when his disciples heard thereof, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis sèra tadèngi ra poro rèti le kètu yohanis, rèngu mai nedhe rèti ngi'u nèngu lasi padhane. d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii lolo mamadhe yohanis.

source_text: and the apostles gather themselves together unto jesus; and they told him all things, whatsoever they had done, and whatsoever they had taught.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, ana madhutu yesus dhu na pua lasi asa rae-rae ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua sèra, lèpa hari mai, ka ra pakaboko hari dènge ne. ra lolo dènge yesus ngaa dhu rèngu tao dènge aj'a mi dhèu.

source_text: and he saith unto them, come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while. for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai patangi-tenge yesus. lula dhèu ae seli eele, ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na abhu boe tebho ra'a-rinu hèi. nèti èèna ka, yesus ale dènge ana madhutu sèra, peka na, be'a risi èdhi pakèd'i nèti era ne'e lati tenge era èci dhu mau, sèna ka èdhi ae tara ciki.

source_text: and they went away in the boat to a desert place apart.
target_text: ka ra ca'e koha cue lasi asa era dhu mau, kaj'èu nèti d'ara rae.

source_text: and the people saw them going, and many knew them, and they ran together there on foot from all the cities, and outwent them.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae ètu sèra sa, ladhe rèdhi koha rèngu kako re sebhe dano. hèia ra kalua nèti rae ka kako pamèri madhutu re dedha rai. nèti èèna ka, rèngu d'ai uuru yesus si.

source_text: and he came forth and saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
target_text: ropa yesus puru nèti dedha koha, ladhe laa, na, dhèu ae dhu mate ne. dhèu se'e re'a heka tao iisi ra tasamia. nèti èèna ka, d'ara yesus sue si, te rèngu sama sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dènge boe ana madhenga. èle èèna ka, na aj'a si j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: and when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, the place is desert, and the day is now far spent; send them away, that they may go into the country and villages round about, and buy themselves somewhat to eat.
target_text: na aj'a nèti loo nètu, toke d'ai nihia la'e. hèia ana madhutu na sèra mai padhue dènge ne, aku rèngu na, ama! hua iia ama ku pua si lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rae dhu dètu ètu era se'e. te oe mèda kèna, aa ètu era ne'e nganga'a aad'o.

source_text: but he answered and said unto them, give ye them to eat. and they say unto him, shall we go and buy two hundred shillings' worth of bread, and give them to eat?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, baku tao sèmi èèna! hud'i laa, pe miu panga'a si. hèia ra karèi hari ne, ira, ee! ladhe èdhi panga'a dhèu ae sèmi ne'e, èdhi kalua doi ae bia, nga. sama sèmi gaji tuka ca tèu kateme, nga! aa èdhi tare doi sèra, nèti mia hua kèna!

source_text: and he saith unto them, how many loaves have ye? go and see. and when they knew, they say, five, and two fishes.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu lami karèi sèku dhèu sèra, teko cee dhu nèti nganga'a mèra. hèia ra lasi karèi, ka mai peka dènge ne, abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u di.

source_text: and he commanded them that all should sit down by companies upon the green grass.
target_text: hèia yesus pua dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ho madhèdi cakaboko-cakaboko ètu dedha j'u'u.

source_text: and they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
target_text: dhèu se'e madhèdi sèmi dhu yesus pua. abhu kaboko dhu dhèu cangasu-cangasu, aa abhu kaboko dhu dhèu lèmi nguru-lèmi nguru.

source_text: and he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake the loaves; and he gave to the disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra, ka na ladhe asa dedha. na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. èle èèna ka, nare roti lèmi bua, ka na ku'u pamae ca'èta-'èta. hèia na hia mi ana madhutu na, ho lasi papala hia dhèu dhu madhèdi sèra. na pala-bagi i'a dua ngi'u sèra kahèi.

source_text: and they all ate, and were filled.
target_text: ka dhèu sèra ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: and they took up broken pieces, twelve basketfuls, and also of the fishes.
target_text: ra'a èle, hèia ana madhutu na sèra lasi pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele sèra, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: and they that ate the loaves were five thousand men.
target_text: dhèu dhu ra'a sèra, dhèu mone di, lèmi riho dhèu, ige mèka bhèni dènge ana iiki.

source_text: and straightway he constrained his disciples to enter into the boat, and to go before him unto the other side to bethsaida, while he himself sendeth the multitude away.
target_text: èle ka, yesus pua ana madhutu sèra pakèd'i uuru dènge koha asa rae betsaida ètu cabèka dano. te nèngu dhae la'e mèka, ho na pua dhèu ae sèra lèpa.

source_text: and after he had taken leave of them, he departed into the mountain to pray.
target_text: ropa dhèu sèra lèpa, na la'e asa ledhe èci ètu èèna, ho na manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and when even was come, the boat was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land. and seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary unto them, about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out; for they all saw him, and were troubled. but he straightway spake with them, and saith unto them, be of good cheer: it is i; be not afraid.
target_text: lod'o mèda le, ka yesus puru mai. na ladhe nèdhi ana madhutu na sèra dènge koha lasi d'ai talora dano le. lula ngèlu madha mèdhu ae, ka ra tuku koha d'ai madhe. d'ara oe mèu sa, yesus heka la'e madhutu si kèna. te ngaa na kako re dedha èi. ropa na kako oe seli koha ra, ana madhutu sèra ladhe rèdhi ne, ka ra madha'u titu kèna. hèia èci karèi èci, aku rèngu na, irii! ngaa nèi? nidhu, do? hèia yesus lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, we! miu baku madha'u! te ja'a ne!

source_text: and he went up unto them into the boat; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves;
target_text: ropa yesus ca'e la'e asa dedha koha, kabèdhi laa, ngèlu mau dènge. ana madhutu na sèra malaa bia.

source_text: for they understood not concerning the loaves, but their heart was hardened.
target_text: rèngu heka rèdhi kèna, yesus pake koasa na, lod'o panga'a lèmi riho dhèu èèna. te ngaa rèngu re'a iia boe koasa yesus, lula d'ara rèngu adhu sèmi hadhu.

source_text: and when they had crossed over, they came to the land unto gennesaret, and moored to the shore.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, ra panahu koha ètu dae genesaret.

source_text: and when they were come out of the boat, straightway the people knew him,
target_text: ropa ra puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi si. ka ra rodhe lème, aku rèngu na, ee! yesus mai le!

source_text: and ran round about that whole region, and began to carry about on their beds those that were sick, where they heard he was. and wheresoever he entered, into villages, or into cities, or into the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
target_text: dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra lasi peka palème rae, nèti èèna ka, dhèu mai nèti mia-mia, jèru rèti a'ari rèngu dhu pèd'a asa yesus. sad'i ra tadèngi yesus ètu era èci, na, rame-rame nedhe rèti dhèu pèd'a mai. ra paj'unu si ètu d'ara tana lapa ètu èèna. te ra pangee, na, sad'i dhèu pèd'a sèra goi lèke sebhe kodho yesus di, èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra. ka dhèu goi lèke kodho na, hèia èle nèti papèd'a ra.

source_text: and there are gathered together unto him the pharisees, and certain of the scribes, who had come from jerusalem,
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu partei agama parisi canau dènge mese-mese agama mai nèti kota yerusalem neo paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: and had seen that some of his disciples ate their bread with defiled, that is, unwashen, hands. for the pharisees, and all the jews, except they wash their hands diligently, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders; and when they come from the marketplace, except they bathe themselves, they eat not; and many other things there are, which they have received to hold, washings of cups, and pots, and brasen vessels. and the pharisees and the scribes ask him, why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with defiled hands?
target_text: dhèu parisi kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi. nuka sèmi, dhèu neo ra'a-rinu hud'i j'amo uuru ku kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe lèpa nèti d'ara pasa, hud'i diu uuru ku èi. toke mèdha dapu rèngu sèmi èru-pangala, pega, curu, galaa, cere, hud'i rase uuru ku madhutu atora ad'a, heka bisa pake ra'a-rinu kèna. ladhe dhèu yahudi cahag'e madhutu boe ad'a rèngu sèmi èèna, dhèu parisi nasa. nèti èèna ka, ra nasa ropa rèdhi ana madhutu yesus sèra ra'a-rinu j'amo boe kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a rèngu. ka rèngu mai pasala yesus, peka na, nga tao ka ana madhutu èu se ra'a-rinu j'amo uuru boe kacui-aai? sèra sa, pasala dènge ad'a nèti bèi-baki èdhi!

source_text: and he said unto them, well did isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, this people honoreth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me. but in vain do they worship me, teaching as their doctrines the precepts of men.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se mema padhai lii leo, tao leo! nèti uru nèka mai yesaya suri tèke le, lii padhai lii ama lamatua sèmi ne'e, ‘abhu dhèu dhu koa-kio kolongara ja'a, dhoka dènge hèb'a di, te ngaa nèti boe d'ara. tatao rèngu sèmi èèna na, lèke boe. rèngu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi ja'a, te ngaa rèngu madhutu dhoka atora dhèu rai-haha di. ' miu èci èèna kahèi.

source_text: ye leave the commandment of god, and hold fast the tradition of men. and he said unto them, full well do ye reject the commandment of god, that ye may keep your tradition.
target_text: miu tèke eele le paredha ama lamatua, ho madhutu atora dhèu rai-haha. tatao miu ne, d'èlu-mèu bia!

source_text: for moses said, honor thy father and thy mother; and, he that speaketh evil of father or mother, let him die the death:
target_text: karèi nèti uuru èèna, musa peka le lii paredha ama lamatua sèmi ne'e ka, ‘pakab'ua ina-ama miu. ' aa tabha hari, peka na, ‘ladhe ana èci padhèda ama na, do ina na, hud'i ra huku pamadhe ne. '

source_text: but ye say, if a man shall say to his father or his mother, that wherewith thou mightest have been profited by me is corban, that is to say, given to god; ye no longer suffer him to do aught for his father or his mother;
target_text: ama lamatua aj'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu aj'a leo. miu peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu èci pamoa le neo hia ngaa èci mi ama lamatua, masi ka ina dènge ama na j'èra oe madhe èèna ka, te ngaa pake boe mèdha èèna ho soru-bara si, lula nèngu moa le neo hia mi lamatua. '

source_text: making void the word of god by your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things ye do.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a peka le, miu pake heka dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa miu gati eele dènge atora miu dhu hiu. atora ae le dhu miu gati eele sèmi èèna.

source_text: and he called to him the multitude again, and said unto them, hear me all of you, and understand:
target_text: hèia yesus paroa hari dhèu leo ètu sèra, ka na peka na, pasa dhilu ho nanene paie, sèna ka miu me'a.

source_text: there is nothing from without the man, that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
target_text: ngaa dhu maso asa d'ara d'èlu, pakaj'alu boe. te ngaa dhu kalua mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu.

source_text: and when he was entered into the house from the multitude, his disciples asked of him the parable.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele dhèu sèra, ka lasi asa d'ara èmu èci. ka ana madhutu sèra karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: and he saith unto them, are ye so without understanding also? perceive ye not, that whatsoever from without goeth into the man, it cannot defile him; because it goeth not into his heart, but into his belly, and goeth out into the draught? this he said, making all meats clean.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, miu me'a boe kahèi? sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: ngaa dhu dhèu ra'a, èèna be'a. te ngaa dhu kalua mai, karehe. èèna be'a boe. ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, maso asa d'ara d'èlu, ho èèna na kalua hari asa li'u la'e. lii yesus èèna neo peka mi èdhi, nganga'a aa'i-aa'i, èci sa dhu luri boe.

source_text: and he said, that which proceedeth out of the man, that defileth the man.
target_text: ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pa'ele iie dhèu, nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua d'èi boe pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: for from within, out of the heart of men, evil thoughts proceed, fornications, thefts, murders, adulteries,
target_text: te j'ara bhelu-katub'a ae ka dhu kalua nèti d'ara dhèu! nuka sèmi: ngangee karehe, tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu boe nèngu, mana'u, pamadhe dhèu,

source_text: covetings, wickednesses, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, railing, pride, foolishness:
target_text: gagoo-gagehu, bersina, bhelu-katub'a, leko-monya, dhèu dhu taha nare boe d'ara, d'èi boe dhèu risi nèngu, padhai lii pamanahu dhèu, padedha iisi, tatao dhu lèke boe, dènge kètu hadhu.

source_text: all these evil things proceed from within, and defile the man.
target_text: j'ara karehe aa'i-aa'i sèra mai nèti d'ara dhèu. sèra ka dhu pa'ele iie dhèu. ama lamatua d'èi boe dènge dhèu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and from thence he arose, and went away into the borders of tyre and sidon. and he entered into a house, and would have no man know it; and he could not be hid.
target_text: èle ka, yesus tèke eele era èèna, ka la'e asa kota èci, ngara na tirus. d'ai nèi, lasi asa d'ara èmu èci, lula yesus d'èi boe dhèu re'a nèngu ètu èèna. te ngaa nèngu bisa boe pahuni ngi'u.

source_text: but straightway a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet. now the woman was a greek, a syrophoenician by race. and she besought him that he would cast forth the demon out of her daughter.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu bhèni dintiu èci dhu nèti rai finisia ètu propensi siria. ropa na tadèngi yesus ètu èèna, na mai manèngi yesus babège eele nidhu nèti ana bhèni na.

source_text: and he said unto her, let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread and cast it to the dogs.
target_text: te ngaa yesus core lii èci, peka na, ana-ana hud'i ra'a uuru ku, ho sisa na, ra core hia busa kèna. dènge lii pacele èèna, yesus hud'i soru-bara uuru ku dhèu yahudi nèngu, heka dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: but she answered and saith unto him, yea, lord; even the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni èèna b'ala, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a ama. te ngaa busa mate le ètu ro'a mei. nèngu abhu kahèi nganga'a dhu bèbhe nèti d'ara pega ana iiki sèra. madhutu bhèni èèna, lod'o ana ra'a, na, busa na'a kahèi. masi ka yesus soru-bara dhèu unu na, te ngaa nèngu hud'i soru-bara dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: and he said unto her, for this saying go thy way; the demon is gone out of thy daughter.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii dhaa bhèni ne, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, tare'a! lii padhai lii èu èèna, mola-mola na kèna! lèpa ka! te nidhu rai le nèti ana èu.

source_text: and she went away unto her house, and found the child laid upon the bed, and the demon gone out.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne la'e ka. na d'ai èmu, ana na dhu bhèj'i luu. nidhu kalua le.

source_text: and again he went out from the borders of tyre, and came through sidon unto the sea of galilee, through the midst of the borders of decapolis.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si pakèd'i nèti kota tirus, kako lasi madhutu nebhe dhasi re kota sidon. nèti era èèna, rèngu lasi taruu d'ai dano galilea. hèia ra lasi asa rai èci dhu dènge canguru kota, dhu ra biasa pangare na, ‘dekapolis'.

source_text: and they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to lay his hand upon him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu èci dhu lii aad'o aa katele-katipa. angalai na lere rèti ne asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus tao ai mi kètu na, sèna ka na èle.

source_text: and he took him aside from the multitude privately, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spat, and touched his tongue;
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele dhèu ae sèra, ka la'e mesa na dènge dhèu èèna. yesus pamaso kacui-aai na asa ro'a dhilu dhèu eèna dua-dua. èle èèna ka, na tao ilu ètu kacui-aai na, ka na g'ag'e he'o dhèu ne'e.

source_text: and looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, ephphatha, that is, be opened.
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe asa dedha, na ère a'ae madhera, ka na paredha, aku nèngu na, efata. sasoa na, bhoke ka!

source_text: and his ears were opened, and the bond of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
target_text: na peka dhoka sèmi èèna di, kabèdhi laa, dhilu dhèu èèna tadèngi dènge. sèmi èèna kahèi, he'o dhu sakaa èèna, mako ka na padhai lii dènge.

source_text: and he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dua ra lasi asa era dhèu ae sèra. ka yesus kai si, aku nèngu na, nanene, ee! baku lolo dènge dhèu, peka na, ja'a ka dhu pa'èle dhèu ne'e ne. masi ka na kai si, te ngaa dhèu se'e lasi lolo palème d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and they were beyond measure astonished, saying, he hath done all things well; he maketh even the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo èèna, malaa bia. ra papeka isi-aanga ra, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne'e, dhèu di, nga! nèngu tao pabe'a aa'i mèu-mèu. dhèu katele bisa tadèngi, aa dhèu lii aad'o bisa padhai lii.

source_text: in those days, when there was again a great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, i have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and if i send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way; and some of them are come from far.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, dhèu ae mai kamue rare yesus neo nanene lii holo-nori na. dhèu sèra tèlu lod'o kèna ètu era èèna dènge yesus. nèti èèna ka, gee ra èle aa'i le. hèia yesus paroa ana madhutu na, ka na peka, ja'a rasa kasia dènge dhèu ae se'e. cahag'e mai nèti rae kaj'èu, ètu era ne'e d'ai tèlu lod'o kèna, ka nganga'a rèngu aad'o heka ciki sa. baku hia ra lèpa dènge kabake manganga. mage dhoka ra mad'ea ho bèbha ètu j'ara.

source_text: and his disciples answered him, whence shall one be able to fill these men with bread here in a desert place?
target_text: ka ana madhutu yesus sèra dhaa, peka na, ama. era ne kaj'èu nèti rae. èdhi panga'a tare boe dhèu ae sèmi ne'e!

source_text: and he asked them, how many loaves have ye? and they said, seven.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, peka na, roti miu pèri bua era? ka ra dhaa peka na, ama. roti ji'i ate dhoka pidhu bua di.

source_text: and he commandeth the multitude to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and having given thanks, he brake, and gave to his disciples, to set before them; and they set them before the multitude.
target_text: ropa nanene nare, hèia na pua dhèu ae sèra madhèdi ètu rai. ka nare roti pidhu bua sèra, hèia na sabaj'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. sabaj'a nare, hèia na pamae roti pidhu bua sèra. ka na hia ana madhutu na papala mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: and they had a few small fishes: and having blessed them, he commanded to set these also before them.
target_text: rèngu dènge i'a pèri ngi'u kahèi. ka yesus sabaj'a hari manèngi makasi. èle èèna ka, na hia ana madhutu na papala hari mi dhèu ae sèra.

source_text: and they ate, and were filled: and they took up, of broken pieces that remained over, seven baskets. and they were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ele boe d'ai èpa riho sa. ra ra'a toke bècu. ra'a rare, hèia ana madhutu yesus pakaboko nganga'a sisa, ka ra ige pidhu soe hahake. èle èèna ka, yesus pua dhèu se lèpa.

source_text: and straightway he entered into the boat with his disciples, and came into the parts of dalmanutha.
target_text: ropa dhèu se lèpa, yesus dènge ana madhutu na ca'e koha pakèd'i asa rae èci, ngara na dalmanuta.

source_text: and the pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, trying him.
target_text: lod'o yesus si d'ai dalmanuta, dhèu partei parisi pèri-pèri mai paraga dènge yesus. ra tenge j'ara neo pamanahu ne. ra manèngi, peka na, ama. pad'elo tadha malaa, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, peka na, èu tare'a-re'a abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, why doth this generation seek a sign? verily i say unto you, there shall no sign be given unto this generation.
target_text: hèia yesus ère a'ae madhera, ka na dhaa si, peka na, ladhe ja'a madhutu lii padhai lii miu ne, ja'a manyasa! nga tao ka miu manèngi tadha malaa? baku sèmi èèna. ja'a bisa tao tadha malaa. te ngaa ja'a parluu boe pad'elo mi miu.

source_text: and he left them, and again entering into the boat departed to the other side.
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele dhèu parisi sèra, la'e hari asa dedha koha. ka na pakèd'i dènge ana madhutu na sèra asa cabèka dano.

source_text: and they forgot to take bread; and they had not in the boat with them more than one loaf.
target_text: ropa yesus si d'ai talora dano, hèia ana madhutu na sèra heka sanèd'e kèna, na, rèngu rèti boe nganga'a leo, dhoka roti cue di.

source_text: and he charged them, saying, take heed, beware of the leaven of the pharisees and the leaven of herod.
target_text: tadèngi ra ale roti, hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu mage-mage ku! baku lèke pangaru karehe nèti dhèu aae herodes dènge dhèu parisi. pangaru rèngu, sama sèmi ragi dhu dhèu pakihu tao roti.

source_text: and they reasoned one with another, saying, we have no bread.
target_text: ra tadèngi na padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka ana madhutu sèra malaa. ka ra papeka isi-aanga si, peka na, mone heka nèi, peka ngaa ne? tao-tao èdhi tèti boe roti, ka na lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: and jesus perceiving it saith unto them, why reason ye, because ye have no bread? do ye not yet perceive, neither understand? have ye your heart hardened?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a lii padhai rèngu. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu padhue dhoka roti di! miu me'a mere boe ngaa dhu ja'a peka na, do? mema kahadhu miu kateme.

source_text: having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
target_text: miu mèdhi dènge madha le, te ngaa mo'o boe me'a! èci èèna ka dènge miu mèdhi mèka. miu tadèngi dènge ro'a dhilu le, te ngaa mo'o boe nanene. èci èèna ka dènge miu tadèngi mèka. miu bhèlu le, do?

source_text: when i brake the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces took ye up? they say unto him, twelve.
target_text: roti lèmi bua dhu ja'a pamae kore ka hia dhèu lèmi riho sèra ra'a, si? ca hari ni, miu pakaboko mere roti dhu risi sèra pèri soe? ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, canguru dua soe, ama.

source_text: and when the seven among the four thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces took ye up? and they say unto him, seven.
target_text: ka na karèi hari, aku nèngu na, miu sanèd'e era lod'o ja'a pamae kore roti pèri bua sèra, ka hia dhèu èpa riho ra'a sa, do aad'o? miu pakaboko mere sisa pèri soe hahake? ka ra dhaa, na, pidhu, ama.

source_text: and he said unto them, do ye not yet understand?
target_text: hèia na peka, na, mema tare'a! miu mèdhi dènge madha le. te ngaa, nga tao ka miu me'a mèka koasa ja'a kapua nèti mia?

source_text: and they come unto bethsaida. and they bring to him a blind man, and beseech him to touch him.
target_text: ropa yesus si d'ai rae betsaida, dhèu rèti dhèu bèdhu èci mai asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus pa'èle musi madha dhèu bèdhu ne.

source_text: and he took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village; and when he had spit on his eyes, and laid his hands upon him, he asked him, seest thou aught?
target_text: ka yesus kadhèi nare kacui-aai dhèu ne, ka dua ra lasi asa li'u rae. èle èèna ka, yesus sabhuu ilu mi musi madha dhèu ne, hèia na g'ag'e. ka na karèi, peka na, samia? èu mèdhi le, do dhae?

source_text: and he looked up, and said, i see men; for i behold them as trees, walking.
target_text: ka dhèu èèna padoa kètu, ka na ladhe sa g'ana-kariu, hèia na dhaa, peka na, oo! ja'a kèdhi dhèu kako rango-rango era, nuka sèmi ana aaj'u dhu kako.

source_text: then again he laid his hands upon his eyes; and he looked stedfastly, and was restored, and saw all things clearly.
target_text: hèia yesus caro hari kacui-aai na ca tèka mi musi madha dhèu ne'e. ka na ladhe patae hari, ho neo ne'a, na, musi madha na be'a le, do dhae. ne'e ne, heka nèdhi dènge mèu kèna.

source_text: and he sent him away to his home, saying, do not even enter into the village.
target_text: ka yesus pua na lèpa, te ngaa pasanèd'e ne, aku nèngu na, èu lamu ka, te ngaa madhutu j'ara leo. re ia ka betsaida.

source_text: and jesus went forth, and his disciples, into the villages of cæsarea philippi: and on the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, who do men say that i am?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si kako palème rae-rae ètu kaisarea pilipi. ètu talora j'ara, yesus karèi ana madhutu na, peka na, madhutu lii lolo dhèu, na, ja'a ne, cee?

source_text: and they told him, saying, john the baptist; and others, elijah; but others, one of the prophets.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, dhèu cahag'e peka, na, èu ne, yohanis tuka sarani dhu madhe le, te ngaa mamuri hari. abhu cahag'e peka na, èu ne, elia, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru sèra. aa abhu cahag'e hari peka na, ama ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo.

source_text: and he asked them, but who say ye that i am? peter answereth and saith unto him, thou art the christ.
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari rèngu, madhutu a'abhu miu, ja'a ne, cee? petrus dhaa, peka na, ama ne, kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka.

source_text: and he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
target_text: hèia yesus pasanèd'e si, aku nèngu na, baku lolo mi cee-cee kahèi, ee!

source_text: and he began to teach them, that the son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, and the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus mulai peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae titu kèna, lula dhèu heka-dhèu heka yahudi, kètu agama yahudi, dènge mese agama sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra sèmi rare boe ja'a. ho èèna na, ra pamadhe ja'a, te ngaa d'ai camèd'a, na, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: and he spake the saying openly. and peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
target_text: yesus peka boe dènge pahuni, hèia petrus ère ne asa karasa na, ka na kai, aku nèngu na, ama, baku padhai lii sèmi èèna! ja'a ko'o boe dhèu tao ama ku sèmi èèna.

source_text: but he turning about, and seeing his disciples, rebuked peter, and saith, get thee behind me, satan; for thou mindest not the things of god, but the things of men.
target_text: lii padhai lii petrus èèna, madhutu boe dad'èi ama lamatua. hèia yesus kabib'a, ka ladhe asa ana madhutu dhu leo sèra. ka na nasa dènge petrus, aku nèngu na, weh! èèna lii dhèu aae nidhu! èu pakaj'èu nèti ne'e! èu madhutu dhoka dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di. madhutu boe dad'èi ama lamatua!

source_text: and he called unto him the multitude with his disciples, and said unto them, if any man would come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paroa dhèu ae sèra ho mai pakaboko dènge ana madhutu na. ka na aj'a si, peka na, dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, hud'i taha taruu bèli-bèli. nèngu hud'i tèke eele dad'èi na, ho madhutu dad'èi lamatua di. masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, te ngaa nèngu hud'i taha taruu kahèi, nuka sèmi dhèu pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha nèngu unu na ho la'e asa era ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: for whosoever would save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's shall save it.
target_text: te dhèu dhu mamuri dhoka lalau ngi'u aae na di, bèli-camèd'a mamuri nèngu ele iie d'ara! te ngaa dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula madhutu ja'a, aa lula na peka-padhai j'ara mamuri ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri dhu ma'ète boe dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for what doth it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
target_text: mi nanene, ee! ladhe èu abhu aa'i isi rai-haha ne, te ngaa ama lamatua core eele èu, a'oto na ngaa?

source_text: for what should a man give in exchange for his life?
target_text: masi ka èu bau mèti aa'i kakaja rai-haha ne, te ngaa bisa boe pasilu dènge samanga èu.

source_text: for whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the son of man also shall be ashamed of him, when he cometh in the glory of his father with the holy angels.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu ètu rai-haha limuri ne, bhelu-katub'a rupa-rupa. rèngu pusi-pahae boe madhutu ama lamatua. de cee dhu makae madhutu ja'a, do makae madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a makae kahèi mangaku nèngu ètu madha ama lamatua. te ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, bèli-camèd'a mai hari nèti sorga, palere dènge ana pajuu ama lamatua sèra. ji'i puru mai dènge dadedha ama ku, heka dhèu re'a mèu kèna, ja'a ne cee.

source_text: and he said unto them, verily i say unto you, there are some here of them that stand by, who shall in no wise taste of death, till they see the kingdom of god come with power.
target_text: miu baku bhèlu lii padhai lii ja'a ne. abhu nèti miu cahag'e dhu madhe mèka, pe mèdhi ama lamatua nèd'u paredha dènge koasa kapai.

source_text: and after six days jesus taketh with him peter, and james, and john, and bringeth them up into a high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them;
target_text: èle èna lod'o, hèia yesus gale nèti petrus, yakobis, yohanis, lasi asa ledhe èci dhu dhèu pea boe. ropa d'ai ledhe èèna, rèngu ladhe, na, yesus leko-leo.

source_text: and his garments became glistering, exceeding white, so as no fuller on earth can whiten them.
target_text: aa mèdha-papake na pudhi kale'e. abhu mèka mèdha dhu pudhi sèmi èèna ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and there appeared unto them elijah with moses: and they were talking with jesus.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, rèngu rèdhi yesus padhai lii dènge elia dènge musa.

source_text: and peter answereth and saith to jesus, rabbi, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for moses, and one for elijah. for he knew not what to answer; for they became sore afraid.
target_text: ka petrus si madha'u bia. hèia petrus malaa, ka na padhai lii ore leli. hèia na peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! èdhi ètu era ne'e, be'a titu kèna! hua iia risi, ji'i tao paleo tèlu bua, cue hia ama, cue hia musa, aa cue hari hia elia.

source_text: and there came a cloud overshadowing them: and there came a voice out of the cloud, this is my beloved son: hear ye him.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ra'i-liru puru mai sarimu nare si. hèia ra tadèngi lii èci nèti ra'i-liru èèna, peka na, mi nanene! yesus ne, ana pasue ja'a. miu nanene paie ne!

source_text: and suddenly looking round about, they saw no one any more, save jesus only with themselves.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii èèna, petrus si laladhe palème, te ngaa rèdhi heka dhèu leo ètu èèna. ate dhoka yesus mesa na.

source_text: and as they were coming down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, save when the son of man should have risen again from the dead.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra puru nèti ledhe èèna. ka yesus kai si, peka na, ngaa dhu miu mèdhi deo na, baku lolo dènge dhèu èci sa. ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe uuru ku. ho lod'o d'ai ja'a mamuri hari, na, miu heka lolo dènge dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: and they kept the saying, questioning among themselves what the rising again from the dead should mean.
target_text: rèngu tèke pa'èra lii moa èèna ètu d'ara ra. ra ale boe dènge dhèu èci sa. te ngaa tèlu ra pakarèi isi-aanga, na padhai lii ngaa ne, peka na, ‘nèngu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe'? tasamia, ee?

source_text: and they asked him, saying, how is it that the scribes say that elijah must first come?
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, peka na, mese agama sèra peka na, ‘elia hud'i mai uru ku, heka kristus mai kèna. ' te ngaa madhutu ama, tare'a, do aad'o?

source_text: and he said unto them, elijah indeed cometh first, and restoreth all things: and how is it written of the son of man, that he should suffer many things and be set at nought?
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, mema tare'a. elia hud'i mai uuru ku, ho bhoke j'ara hia kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka. te ngaa tasamia? miu me'a mèka ngaa dhu suri rare le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, lula-nèti dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a? dhu suri rare le, peka na, ladhe lod'o na mai, dhèu paj'èra ne, toke ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: but i say unto you, that elijah is come, and they have also done unto him whatsoever they would, even as it is written of him.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu pasa paie dhilu miu! elia mai le. te ngaa dhèu paj'èra ne madhutu dad'èi rèngu. èèna lèke dènge ngaa dhu baki-baki èdhi sèra suri tèke le karèi nèti uuru ka.

source_text: and when they came to the disciples, they saw a great multitude about them, and scribes questioning with them.
target_text: ropa yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dhèu tèlu sèra, paraga hari dènge ana madhutu leo sèra, ka ladhe rèdhi dhèu ae pakaboko ètu èèna. dhèu ae sèra mai ho ra neo nanene ana madhutu yesus dhu leo sèra pab'ala lii dènge mese agama ètu èèna.

source_text: and straightway all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae sèra ladhe rèdhi yesus, ka ra cag'ag'a, te rèngu neo laa, na, yesus ètu ledhe era. hèia ra rai mai soru ne.

source_text: and he asked them, what question ye with them?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, peka na, miu pab'ala lii ngaa na?

source_text: and one of the multitude answered him, teacher, i brought unto thee my son, who hath a dumb spirit;
target_text: dhèu èci nèti talora dhèu ae sèra ara sa madha, ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, mu nanene ku laa! ja'a mai kèti ana mone ja'a dhu pèd'a, ho ama ku puri-pa'èle ne. nèngu lii aad'o, bisa boe padhai lii, lula nidhu tao ne.

source_text: and wheresoever it taketh him, it dasheth him down: and he foameth, and grindeth his teeth, and pineth away: and i spake to thy disciples that they should cast it out; and they were not able.
target_text: ladhe nidhu maso asa d'ara ngi'u na, na hake ngi'u ana ne mi rai. ho hèb'a na horo karaka, na na'e ngutu na kico-kico sèna. ho ngi'u na patèku sèmi aj'u. ja'a manèngi le ana madhutu ama ku babège eele nidhu èèna. te ngaa ra bisa boe.

source_text: and he answereth them and saith, o faithless generation, how long shall i be with you? how long shall i bear with you? bring him unto me.
target_text: ropa na nanene nare, hèia yesus jèke si, peka na, heh! miu seli-kolane! ja'a aj'a miu pahari-pahari, te ngaa miu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa. miu parcaya èra boe mi ja'a! ja'a mate miu nèbhu sange mia hari ku? mèti ana èèna asa ne'e mai!

source_text: and they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him grievously; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
target_text: hèia ra sa'u rèti ana èèna asa madha yesus. te ngaa ropa nidhu ladhe nèdhi yesus, na kalabhe ana ne mi rai, ka ana ne bèbhe kapod'e ètu rai, aa hèb'a na horo karaka.

source_text: and he asked his father, how long time is it since this hath come unto him? and he said, from a child.
target_text: ka yesus karèi ama na, nèngu sèmi ne'e ne, pèri lod'o kèna? ka ama na dhaa, karèi nèti ana iiki ka mai.

source_text: and oft-times it hath cast him both into the fire and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do anything, have compassion on us, and help us.
target_text: nidhu èèna nèbhu ae le neo pamadhe ana ne'e. na tule ne pèri-pèri hari kèna asa d'ara ai, aa na pacène le kahèi asa d'ara èi. de ama ku sue ja'a. ladhe bisa, na, ama puri-pa'èle ku ana ja'a la.

source_text: and jesus said unto him, if thou canst! all things are possible to him that believeth.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka èu peka na ‘ladhe bisa'? ja'a bisa tao aa'i mèu-mèu, te ngaa hud'i èu parcaya uuru ku!

source_text: straightway the father of the child cried out, and said, i believe; help thou mine unbelief.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mone èèna dhaa dènge oe tangi, aku nèngu na, ama, mema ja'a parcaya, te ngaa pa'èra hari ku lalèka ja'a ne'e!

source_text: and when jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying unto him, thou dumb and deaf spirit, i command thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi dhèu ae mai lingu, ka na paredha nidhu èèna, aku nèngu na, heh! nidhu bhelu! kalua pakaj'èu ka nèti ana ne'e! sèna ka na bisa tadèngi aa na padhai lii kahèi. èu baku maso ia ka asa d'ara ana ne'e!

source_text: and having cried out, and torn him much, he came out: and the boy became as one dead; insomuch that the more part said, he is dead.
target_text: ropa nidhu tadèngi lii yesus, hèia na pakèce. ka na hake ana ne mi rai, ka na rèbha-rèbha sène, heka nidhu kalua nèti d'ara ana èèna kèna. ana èèna kalau heka, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le. ka dhèu ètu sèra sa peka, aku rèngu na, waa! ana ne madhe le!

source_text: but jesus took him by the hand, and raised him up; and he arose.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kèpe kacui-aai ana ne, ka na pakèd'i ne. hèia na kèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: and when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, how is it that we could not cast it out?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, tèke eele era èèna, lasi dhuli èmu cue. ètu èmu èèna, rèngu mesa ra, ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ji'i bisa boe babège eele nidhu èèna?

source_text: and he said unto them, this kind can come out by nothing, save by prayer.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, mi nanene paie! nidhu sèra mema bhelu. de ladhe miu manèngi boe a'èra nèti lamatua, na, miu bisa boe babège eele nidhu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and they went forth from thence, and passed through galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
target_text: èle ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele era èèna, lasi taruu asa propensi galilea. lod'o èèna, yesus d'èi boe dhèu re'a nèngu ètu èèna,

source_text: for he taught his disciples, and said unto them, the son of man is delivered up into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and when he is killed, after three days he shall rise again.
target_text: lula na neo aj'a ana madhutu na di. ka na lole dènge si, nèbhu heka dhèu pahie eele ja'a dènge dhèu leo. hèia ra pamadhe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. mema ja'a madhe, te ngaa d'ai camèd'a, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: but they understood not the saying, and were afraid to ask him.
target_text: yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, te ngaa ana madhutu na sèra malaa. rèngu bani heka karèi sasoa lii padhai lii nèngu.

source_text: and they came to capernaum: and when he was in the house he asked them, what were ye reasoning on the way?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi d'ai kapernaum. ropa ra maso asa d'ara èmu èci, yesus karèi si, peka na, deo na miu pasisu ngaa ètu talora j'ara?

source_text: but they held their peace: for they had disputed one with another on the way, who was the greatest.
target_text: èci sa bani boe dhaa, lula ètu talora j'ara deo na, rèngu ako pasala d'ara, nèti ra pasisu, cee ka dhu kapai risi ètu talora rèngu.

source_text: and he sat down, and called the twelve; and he saith unto them, if any man would be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.
target_text: hèia yesus madhèdi, ka na holo si, peka na, cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, mamuri nèngu hud'i sama sèmi dhèu haha dhu lalau-lalo'o dhèu.

source_text: and he took a little child, and set him in the midst of them: and taking him in his arms, he said unto them,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus sa'u nare ana iiki èci, ka la'e asa talora rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na,

source_text: whosoever shall receive one of such little children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever receiveth me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, ho na lalau-lalo'o dhèu sèmi ana iiki ne, èèna sama sèmi nèngu lalau-lalo'o ja'a kahèi. aa nèngu lalau-lalo'o ama ku kahèi, dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: john said unto him, teacher, we saw one casting out demons in thy name; and we forbade him, because he followed not us.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus dhu ngara na yohanis, peka na, ama! ca tèka ji'i ngèdhi ca dhèu pake kolongara ama ku, ho na babège eele nidhu. te ngaa ji'i kai ne, lula nèngu dhèu èdhi boe.

source_text: but jesus said, forbid him not: for there is no man who shall do a mighty work in my name, and be able quickly to speak evil of me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, baku mi kai ne! te dhèu dhu pake kolongara ja'a, ho na tao tadha malaa, nèngu pa'ele iie boe kolongara ja'a.

source_text: for he that is not against us is for us.
target_text: ladhe nèngu palab'a boe dènge èdhi, nèngu na dhèu èdhi.

source_text: for whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink, because ye are christ's, verily i say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
target_text: de mi sanèd'e paie! ladhe abhu dhèu ne'a, na, miu madhutu kristus, ka na soru-bara miu, tatu ama lamatua bhèlu boe rui-j'aj'èra nèngu. masi ka dhèu dhu hia miu èi iia ca galaa èèna ka, ama lamatua bhèlu boe tatao nèngu èèna.

source_text: and whosoever shall cause one of these little ones that believe on me to stumble, it were better for him if a great millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii hari dènge ra, peka na, mage-mage, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao ana iiki èci kako sala j'ara, toke ana ne parcaya heka ja'a! be'a risi hia dhèu èèna, rare hadhu aae cue, ho èki mi ladha goro ne, ho pacène ne asa talora dhasi.

source_text: and if thy hand cause thee to stumble, cut it off: it is good for thee to enter into life maimed, rather than having thy two hands to go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake kacui-aai èu, na, poro eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge kacui-aai cabèka di. baku d'ai ra core èu asa d'ara ai heo robhe-robhe dènge kacui-aai kateme.

source_text: and if thy foot cause thee to stumble, cut it off: it is good for thee to enter into life halt, rather than having thy two feet to be cast into hell.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake haga èu, na, poro eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge haga cabèka di. baku d'ai ra core èu asa d'ara ai heo robhe-robhe dènge haga kateme.

source_text: and if thine eye cause thee to stumble, cast it out: it is good for thee to enter into the kingdom of god with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell;
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake musi madha èu, na, ed'o eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge musi madha cabèka di. baku d'ai ra core èu asa d'ara ai heo robhe-robhe dènge musi madha kateme.

source_text: where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
target_text: ‘naraka èèna, mema era j'aj'èra. ai na, madhe boe. sèmi èèna kahèi, èru-èru kamoke dènge ra'a taruu ngaa-ngaa dhu hèu ètu èèna. '

source_text: for every one shall be salted with fire.
target_text: a'aj'a ja'a ne, mema bia. de ladhe cee dhu madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i taha taruu, sèmi dhèu dhu neo paga sisi hud'i masi uuru ku, sèna ka sisi paga èèna taha nèbhu.

source_text: salt is good: but if the salt have lost its saltness, wherewith will ye season it? have salt in yourselves, and be at peace one with another.
target_text: masi mema be'a. èdhi pake ho pasèro nganga'a. te ngaa ladhe masi sèro heka, guna na ngaa? dhoka bhori eele di. miu hud'i j'aj'i sèmi masi kahèi, sèna ka mamuri pasue dènge dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i. de mi pasisu ia ka, peka na, cee ka dhu kapai, aa cee ka dhu ana iiki.

source_text: and he arose from thence, and cometh into the borders of judæa and beyond the jordan: and multitudes come together unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi asa propensi yudea dènge era-era ètu cabèka dhimu loko yarden. ètu mia-mia, dhèu ae mai lingu rare yesus. hèia na aj'a si, sèmi biasa.

source_text: and there came unto him pharisees, and asked him, is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? trying him.
target_text: dhèu parisi pèri-pèri mai neo pamanahu ne. ra karèi ne sèmi ne'e ka, madhutu a'abhu agama èdhi, ladhe mone dhu dènge le d'ara èmu, bisa pa'ia hari, do aad'o?

source_text: and he answered and said unto them, what did moses command you?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu sanèd'e, do? atora dhèu èmu-kamali dhu musa hia èdhi uru èèna, tasamia?

source_text: and they said, moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, nanori musa peka, dhèu bisa pa'ia-pa'ela, sad'i dhèu mone tao uru ku sasuri pa'ia dènge dhèu èmu na.

source_text: but jesus said unto them, for your hardness of heart he wrote you this commandment.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala si, peka na, nanene, ee! musa suri sèmi èèna, lula miu kètu hadhu.

source_text: but from the beginning of the creation, male and female made he them.
target_text: baku bhèlu lii lolo dhu uru tèka, lod'o lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha! dhu suri tèke, peka na, ‘ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha, mone dènge bhèni.

source_text: for this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone tèke eele ina-ama na, ho mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu na,

source_text: and the two shall become one flesh: so that they are no more two, but one flesh.
target_text: sèna ka dua ra j'aj'i mi èci. '

source_text: what therefore god hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
target_text: ladhe lamatua pa'èci le rèngu dua ra, dhèu rai-haha baku pacèri eele si!

source_text: and in the house the disciples asked him again of this matter.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi mesa ra asa d'ara èmu cue. ètu èèna, rèngu karèi ne lii aj'a deo sa.

source_text: and he saith unto them, whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her:
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, dhèu mone cee dhu ia eele dhèu èmu na, ho na madhèdi hari dènge dhèu bhèni leo, nèngu bersina.

source_text: and if she herself shall put away her husband, and marry another, she committeth adultery.
target_text: èci èèna ka, dènge dhèu bhèni. ladhe nèngu ia eele dhèu èmu na, ho na leo hari dènge mone leo, nèngu bersina kahèi.

source_text: and they were bringing unto him little children, that he should touch them: and the disciples rebuked them.
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu rèti ana-ana rèngu asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus sabaj'a hia si, ho hia lii mèngi-nale. te ngaa ana madhutu yesus kai dhèu sèra.

source_text: but when jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation, and said unto them, suffer the little children to come unto me; forbid them not: for to such belongeth the kingdom of god.
target_text: yesus ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na nasa dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa ana iiki sèra mai asa ja'a. baku magee si. te dhèu sèmi sèra ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: verily i say unto you, whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of god as a little child, he shall in no wise enter therein.
target_text: miu sanèd'e paie! dhèu cee dhu neo mai asa katanga-madha lamatua, d'ara na kateme hud'i d'èi paraga dènge ne, èci èèna ka ana iiki dhu d'ara d'èi paraga dènge ina-ama ra. ladhe sèmi boe èèna, rèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: and he took them in his arms, and blessed them, laying his hands upon them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus liku nare ana iiki se, ka na tao kacui-aai na mi dedha kètu ana iiki se èci-èci, ho na hia si lii mamèngi.

source_text: and as he was going forth into the way, there ran one to him, and kneeled to him, and asked him, good teacher, what shall i do that i may inherit eternal life?
target_text: ropa yesus si neo pakèd'i, dhèu kaja èci rai mai neo paraga dènge ne. hèia na pacud'u ètu madha yesus, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ama mese dhu hua iia! ja'a neo karèi ciki. ja'a tao tasamia, sèna ka ja'a ke'a tare'a-re'a, na, ja'a ne maso sorga ho mamuri taruu pa'èci dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: and jesus said unto him, why callest thou me good? none is good save one, even god.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka èu ne peka na, ja'a ne ‘hua iia'? dhèu rai-haha ne èci sa dhu hua iia boe. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu hua iia.

source_text: thou knowest the commandments, do not kill, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness, do not defraud, honor thy father and mother.
target_text: èu me'a le, lii paredha ama lamatua sèra nèti uru ka, dhu peka na: ‘baku pamadhe dhèu; baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali boe èu; baku mana'u; baku j'aj'i sakasii kapod'e-kabèli; baku monya ho parame more mèdha-panyau dhèu; aa pakab'ua ina-ama èu. '

source_text: and he said unto him, teacher, all these things have i observed from my youth.
target_text: dhèu èèna dhaa, peka na, tare'a, ama mese! nèti ana ngèru ka mai, ja'a madhutu le lii paredha sèra aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: and jesus looking upon him loved him, and said unto him, one thing thou lackest: go, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
target_text: yesus rasa kasia dènge dhèu ne'e, hèia na peka, tare'a! te ngaa j'ara èci era. lèpa ka asa èmu èu, lamu pahia aa'i su'i-kakaja èu. kab'ua na lamu pala-bagi mi dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa. èle èèna, heka mai kèna, ho madhutu ja'a. pe bèli-camèd'a lamatua pala-bagi hia èu hari kakaja-sasu'i dhu leo ètu sorga.

source_text: but his countenance fell at the saying, and he went away sorrowful: for he was one that had great possessions.
target_text: ropa dhèu ne tadèngi nare lii padhai lii yesus èèna, d'ara na laho mae-mae. la'e ka èmu dènge d'ara dhu pèd'a bia, lula nèngu dhèu kaja tare'a.

source_text: and jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, how hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of god!
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe la'e-mai, aa peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mi nanene! dhèu kaja carui titu kèna maso sorga!

source_text: and the disciples were amazed at his words. but jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of god!
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai lii yesus èèna, ana madhutu na bingu. ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, mi nanene paie! mema carui ladhe dhèu neo j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. baku ngee èèna mud'a!

source_text: it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of god.
target_text: dhèu kaja maso sorga ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua, sama carui dènge badha onta ci'u dhu kapai maso asa oka na re ro'a j'aj'au.

source_text: and they were astonished exceedingly, saying unto him, then who can be saved?
target_text: lii padhai lii yesus ne asa pamalaa dhèu se'e aa'i-aa'i si. ka ra pakarèi, peka na, ladhe tare'a sèmi èèna, cee ka dhu bisa abhu mamuri dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: jesus looking upon them saith, with men it is impossible, but not with god: for all things are possible with god.
target_text: ka yesus ladhe si èci-èci, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, madhutu dhèu rai-haha, na, carui. te ngaa baku bhèlu, madhutu ama lamatua, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i.

source_text: peter began to say unto him, lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
target_text: èle èèna ka, petrus padhai lii, peka na, ama, ji'i tèke eele le ngaa-ngaa dhu j'aj'i unu ji'i, ho madhutu èu. de ji'i abhu bab'ala na ngaa?

source_text: jesus said, verily i say unto you, there is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or mother, or father, or children, or lands, for my sake, and for the gospel's sake, but he shall receive a hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, ja'a neo peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, aa tèke eele ina-ama na, a'ari na, ana-èpu na, oka-tedhe na, sasab'a-la'a na, dènge isi èmu aa'i-aa'i, ho la'e peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu ètu mia-mia, lèpa loo limuri, nèngu abhu hari ngaa-ngaa sèra, d'ai cangasu hari. aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu tèke eele sèra, èèna na nèngu abhu risi hari. aa nèngu abhu j'aj'èra kahèi, lula madhutu ja'a. te ngaa ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, nèngu mamuri taruu pa'èci dènge ama lamatua. bab'ala nèngu, sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: but many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu dhu padedha iisi, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, limuri mai nèngu j'aj'i dhèu haha d'ai seli. te ngaa dhèu dhu ngee, na, nèngu dhèu haha di, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, limuri mai nèngu j'aj'i dhèu kapai.

source_text: and they were on the way, going up to jerusalem; and jesus was going before them: and they were amazed; and they that followed were afraid. and he took again the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were to happen unto him,
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa kota yerusalem. yesus kako uuru. ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua dènge dhèu leo dhu kako pa'èci madhutu ne re limuri. rèngu sanèd'e lii padhai dhu yesus peka dènge rèngu uru èèna, peka na, dhèu neo pamadhe ne ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bingu dènge madha'u. hèia yesus paroa nare ana madhutu na sèra mesa ra, ho na peka hari dènge rèngu dhèu neo tao ngaa mi dedha nèngu ètu yerusalem.

source_text: saying, behold, we go up to jerusalem; and the son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests and the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him unto the gentiles:
target_text: yesus peka dènge si, mi nanene! èdhi neo lati asa yerusalem. ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ètu nèi, dhèu neo pahie eele ja'a asa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra. èle èèna, ra uku-ked'i pamadhe ja'a. ra tule eele ja'a asa dhèu leo dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: and they shall mock him, and shall spit upon him, and shall scourge him, and shall kill him; and after three days he shall rise again.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra padhai lii pamakae ja'a. ra paru'e ilu mi ja'a. aa ra dhedhe pamae iisi ja'a. èle èèna, heka ra pamadhe ja'a kèna. mema ja'a madhe tare'a. te ngaa d'ai camèda, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: and there come near unto him james and john, the sons of zebedee, saying unto him, teacher, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall ask of thee.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana sabadeus, nuka yakobis dènge yohanis, mai asa yesus. ka ra manèngi, peka na, ama mese! ji'i neo padhai lii dènge ama ciki.

source_text: and he said unto them, what would ye that i should do for you?
target_text: ka yesus karèi si, miu neo ngaa?

source_text: and they said unto him, grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and one on thy left hand, in thy glory.
target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama! bèli-camèd'a, ladhe ama mèd'u paredha, ji'i manèngi ama pamadhèdi ji'i dua mi, èci re sebhe g'ana, èci hari re kariu, sèna ka ji'i paredha hèi.

source_text: but jesus said unto them, ye know not what ye ask. are ye able to drink the cup that i drink? or to be baptized with the baptism that i am baptized with?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu dua mi se me'a boe lii manèngi miu èèna. èèna na, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae. de tasamia? miu ngee, na, miu se bisa pasae j'aj'èra dènge ja'a toke madhe, do?

source_text: and they said unto him, we are able. and jesus said unto them, the cup that i drink ye shall drink; and with the baptism that i am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i bisa, ama! ka yesus b'ala, peka na, mema, èèna na, miu pasae j'aj'èra kahèi, sama sèmi ja'a.

source_text: but to sit on my right hand or on my left hand is not mine to give; but it is for them for whom it hath been prepared.
target_text: te ngaa cee dhu madhèdi re sebhe g'ana, do sebhe kariu ja'a, èèna hak ja'a aad'o. te dhu hak ka ama lamatua dhu pama'ète mema le, na, cee-cee ka dhu madhèdi ètu era sèra.

source_text: and when the ten heard it, they began to be moved with indignation concerning james and john.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu dhu leo sèra tadèngi lii manèngi yakobis dènge yohanis sèmi èèna, ka ra nasa bia.

source_text: and jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, ye know that they who are accounted to rule over the gentiles lord it over them; and their great ones exercise authority over them.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa aa'i-aa'i si, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, miu me'a le, sina ma? dhèu-dhèu kapai dhu rèd'u paredha j'eli ana kabarai sèna ka rèngu bisa boe kalau-karèto. dhèu kapai kabarai dhu tadhe boe lamatua hia paredha risi eele, ka ana kabarai bisa heka doa kètu.

source_text: but it is not so among you: but whosoever would become great among you, shall be your minister;
target_text: te ngaa miu baku tao sèmi èèna! nèti talora miu, cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku ana pua-paleha ho lalau dhèu leo.

source_text: and whosoever would be first among you, shall be servant of all.
target_text: cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i tao ngi'u na sama sèmi ènu.

source_text: for the son of man also came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a mai hia boe dhèu lalau-lalo'o ja'a. te ngaa ja'a mai ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu ae, dènge hia mamuri ja'a ho sui kore dhèu ae nèti koasa sasala-sasigo rèngu.

source_text: and they come to jericho: and as he went out from jericho, with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of timæus, bartimæus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the way side.
target_text: yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dènge dhèu ae titu kèna kako lasi kota jeriko. ropa rèngu neo kako taruu, dhèu bèdhu èci madhèdi ètu sebhe j'ara, na kanata ai ho manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu dhu kako re èèna. ngara na bartimeos, ana nèti timeos.

source_text: and when he heard that it was jesus the nazarene, he began to cry out, and say, jesus, thou son of david, have mercy on me.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu dhu kako mai sèra, yesus nèti rae nasaret na kahèi, ka na rodhe, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu daud, ee! ji'i mate èu nèbhu ae le! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: and many rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried out the more a great deal, thou son of david, have mercy on me.
target_text: ropa ra nanene lii rodhe na, hèia dhèu sèra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, èu mau-mau ku laa! te ngaa na rodhe asa aae, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu daud, ee! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: and jesus stood still, and said, call ye him. and they call the blind man, saying unto him, be of good cheer: rise, he calleth thee.
target_text: hèia yesus titu taha, ka na peka, mèti ku na mai sa ne'e! ka ra lasi peka dènge dhèu bèdhu èèna, peka na, èu mau-mau ka laa! te ama mese paroa èu nèi. de mai lati ka!

source_text: and he, casting away his garment, sprang up, and came to jesus.
target_text: ropa nanene nare, ka bartimeos pèci eele sig'i kalolo na, hèia na kèd'i titu la'e paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: and jesus answered him, and said, what wilt thou that i should do unto thee? and the blind man said unto him, rabboni, that i may receive my sight.
target_text: ka yesus karèi ne, peka na, èu parluu ngaa? dhèu bèdhu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! ja'a manèngi ho ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: and jesus said unto him, go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. and straightway he received his sight, and followed him in the way.
target_text: yesus peka hari dènge ne, lula èu parcaya, ja'a bisa tao paie musi madha èu. ne'e ne kahèi musi madha èu èle dènge! de lamu ka! ka musi madha bartimeos èle dènge. èle ka la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: and when they draw nigh unto jerusalem, unto bethphage and bethany, at the mount of olives, he sendeth two of his disciples,
target_text: ropa ra dètu dènge kota yerusalem, ka ra dhuli uuru dua rae, ngara na betfage dènge betania, ètu sebhe ledhe saitun. ètu èèna, yesus si mate ciki oo'e di. ka na pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua lasi uuru.

source_text: and saith unto them, go your way into the village that is over against you: and straightway as ye enter into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon no man ever yet sat; loose him, and bring him.
target_text: na pua si, peka na, miu dua mi lami uuru asa d'ara rae nèi. ropa miu maso lami, miu mèdhi ana badha keled'ei ci'u, dhu ra èki ètu èèna, dhu dhèu dhae manya'e mèka. lami ho lècu eele dhari a'èki na, ho ère mèti mai asa ne'e.

source_text: and if any one say unto you, why do ye this? say ye, the lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him back hither.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu karèi miu, ‘nga tao ka miu ère mèti ana keled'ei ne? ' mi peka dènge si, ‘lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. ladhe pake nare, na, na hia hari mai. '

source_text: and they went away, and found a colt tied at the door without in the open street; and they loose him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu na dhèu dua sèra lasi, ka rèdhi ana keled'ei ci'u dhu èki tèke ètu madha èmu cue ètu sebhe j'ara. ra lècu eele dhari èki na, ka ra ère rèti mai.

source_text: and certain of them that stood there said unto them, what do ye, loosing the colt?
target_text: ka dhèu-dhèu dhu titu ètu èèna, peka na, we! nga tao ka miu pakako mèti keled'ei dhèu?

source_text: and they said unto them even as jesus had said: and they let them go.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. ho ladhe na pake nare, na, ji'i ngèti hari mai. ka dhèu sèra soro tèke si lasi pakako rèti ana keled'ei èèna.

source_text: and they bring the colt unto jesus, and cast on him their garments; and he sat upon him.
target_text: hèia ra rèti ana keled'ei èèna asa yesus. ka ra hèle sig'i-kalolo rèngu mi dedha keled'ei, ka yesus manya'e.

source_text: and many spread their garments upon the way; and others branches, which they had cut from the fields.
target_text: ropa oe maso d'ara kota, ka dhèu ae rare sig'i-kalolo, ka ra hèle mi dedha j'ara oka-hoo. dhèu cahag'e lasi para rèu palam ètu sebhe j'ara, ho ra tao mi talora j'ara oka-hoo. tatao sèmi èèna na, sama sèmi tadha èci dhu peka na, rèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: and they that went before, and they that followed, cried, hosanna; blessed is he that cometh in the name of the lord:
target_text: dhèu cahag'e kako uru ètu madha yesus; aa cahag'e kako limuri. ka ra pa'oo, peka na, hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu dhu mai pake kolongara na, lula ama lamatua hia ne mai!

source_text: blessed is the kingdom that cometh, the kingdom of our father david: hosanna in the highest.
target_text: hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua neo pakèd'i hari paredha dhèu aae daud! hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu era dedha risi eele!

source_text: and he entered into jerusalem, into the temple; and when he had looked round about upon all things, it being now eventide, he went out unto bethany with the twelve.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai d'ara kota, ka yesus si maso asa madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka yesus ladhe palème era èmu èèna. te ngaa, lula lod'o nihia ae le, ka ra lèpa hari asa rae betania.

source_text: and on the morrow, when they were come out from bethany, he hungered.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, ka rèngu kalua nèti betania lasi asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara ka yesus manganga.

source_text: and seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find anything thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for it was not the season of figs.
target_text: ka na ladhe nèdhi ana aaj'u èci ètu sebhe j'ara. hua aj'u na, dhu dhèu ra'a. yesus la'e padètu ho neo ne'a aj'u na, hua do aad'o. na ladhe aj'u èèna hua boe cue sa. te mema d'ai mèka hèru hua. rèu heka mare kèna.

source_text: and he answered and said unto it, no man eat fruit from thee henceforward for ever. and his disciples heard it.
target_text: ka yesus peka mi aj'u èèna, lula èu hia boe ja'a hua, mulai ti deo ne'e, èu bisa heka hia hua èu asa dhèu leo! ana madhutu yesus sèra tadèngi na padhai lii dènge nasa sèmi èèna.
