source_text: and they come to jerusalem: and he entered into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and them that bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money-changers, and the seats of them that sold the doves;
target_text: yesus si kako taruu asa yerusalem, d'ai nèi ka yesus maso asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu madha èmu èèna, dhèu tao pasa ho ra pahia koro j'aha dhu biasa dhèu pake tao korban ho ra sabaj'a. ropa yesus nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na lalèta si asa li'u. na tule eele mei dhu ra pake ho pasilu doi sèra, aa na tule paguri eele bagu dhu ra pake pahia manu-bhui sa.

source_text: and he would not suffer that any man should carry a vessel through the temple.
target_text: ka yesus kai si aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka ra rèti ia ka mèdha rèngu re d'ara madha èmu èèna.

source_text: and he taught, and said unto them, is it not written, my house shall be called a house of prayer for all the nations? but ye have made it a den of robbers.
target_text: ka na aj'a si, peka na, miu me'a le lii dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke le, peka na: ‘ja'a tao èmu ne'e, sèna ka suku aa'i-aa'i mai sabaj'a ètu ne'e. ' te ngaa miu tao èmu ne j'aj'i era pakaboko dhèu parapo.

source_text: and the chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, for all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.
target_text: ropa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra re'a rare tatao yesus sèmi èèna, ka ra nasa dènge ne. ka ra tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa ra madha'u, lula dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus.

source_text: and every evening he went forth out of the city.
target_text: d'ara lod'o cèna sa, yesus si kalua hari nèti kota yerusalem lèpa lasi j'unu asa rae betania.

source_text: and as they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots. and peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, rabbi, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, yesus si lasi hari asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara, ka ra rèdhi aj'u dhu yesus padhai lii med'a na. ka ana madhutu yesus sèra malaa, lula rèngu rèdhi aj'u èèna mango le d'ai amo. hèia petrus sanèd'e lii padhai lii yesus med'a na. ka na peka na, ama! ladhe ku! aj'u dhu ama dhoo med'a na, madhe le!

source_text: and jesus answering saith unto them, have faith in god.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a, we! sad'i miu parcaya ama lamatua sèmi èèna, na, j'aj'i kahèi.

source_text: verily i say unto you, whosoever shall say unto this mountain, be thou taken up and cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that what he saith cometh to pass; he shall have it.
target_text: ladhe miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, miu bisa pua ledhe hia na pidha asa d'ara dhasi. pe lamatua pidha eele ledhe èèna, sad'i miu baku parcaya dènge d'ara cabèka. miu parcaya mi ama lamatua, hud'i dènge d'ara kateme ku.

source_text: therefore i say unto you, all things whatsoever ye pray and ask for, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
target_text: baku bhèlu! sad'i miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, ngaa dhu miu manèngi, tatu ama lamatua bisa hia miu.

source_text: and whensoever ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have aught against any one; that your father also who is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sabaj'a, aa te ngaa na tèka d'ara era dènge dhèu leo, nèngu hud'i la'e pabe'a uuru ku dènge dhèu èèna. ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, ama miu ètu sorga heka saku eele sasala miu kèna.

source_text: and they come again to jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi taruu. ropa d'ai yerusalem, ka ra maso hari asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa maso asa madha èmu èèna, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka yahudi sèra mai,

source_text: and they said unto him, by what authority doest thou these things? or who gave thee this authority to do these things?
target_text: ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, cee ka dhu pua èu mai tao maruru ètu ne'e med'a na? cee ka hia èu hak!

source_text: and jesus said unto them, i will ask of you one question, and answer me, and i will tell you by what authority i do these things.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a, na, rèngu neo tenge j'ara ho pamanahu ne. ka na b'ala si, peka na, ja'a neo karèi miu kahèi. miu dhaa uuru ku ja'a, heka ja'a dhaa miu kèna.

source_text: the baptism of john, was it from heaven, or from men? answer me.
target_text: ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: miu aa'i-aa'i mi tadhe yohanis, tuka sarani èèna, sina ma? cee ka dhu pua nèngu la'e sarani dhèu? lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha?

source_text: and they reasoned with themselves, saying, if we shall say, from heaven; he will say, why then did ye not believe him?
target_text: ra pajiko la'e-mai, ka ra padhue, peka na, eea! nara èdhi le! ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka dhu pua yohanis, ' na b'ala hari, peka na, ‘nga tao ka miu parcaya boe yohanis! '

source_text: but should we say, from men-they feared the people: for all verily held john to be a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi bisa boe peka kahèi, na, ‘dhèu rai-haha dhu pua ne. ' te aad'o na, dhèu ae tao dènge èdhi. lula dhèu ae parcaya, yohanis èèna, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: and they answered jesus and say, we know not. and jesus saith unto them, neither tell i you by what authority i do these things.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i nge'a boe! ka yesus dhaa hari si, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ko'o boe peka kahèi, cee ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: and he began to speak unto them in parables. a man planted a vineyard, and set a hedge about it, and digged a pit for the winepress, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into another country.
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii hari dènge kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra. ka na lole pake lii upama èci, peka na, dhèu èci la'e tao oka ho neo sèla anggor ètu dedha rai na. ka na tao tedhe reo nare oka èèna, aa tao bak cue ho kanate èi anggor asa d'ara la'e kahèi. hèia na patitu èmu madhenga oka cue dhu dedha. èle èèna ka, na hia dhèu leo seb'a oka èèna, ho ra pabagi èi anggor. hèia na pakèd'i asa rai leo la'e.

source_text: and at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruits of the vineyard.
target_text: lod'o d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu hua anggor, ka lamatua oka pua ana paleha na èci la'e asa dhèu sab'a oka sèra, ho na manèngi pala na.

source_text: and they took him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
target_text: ropa d'ai nèi, ka dhèu seb'a sèra kèpe rare, ka game ne. hèia ra pua ne lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: and again he sent unto them another servant; and him they wounded in the head, and handled shamefully.
target_text: ka lamatua oka pua hari ana paleha leo èci. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra dhedhe panu'a kètu na. ka ra pamakae ne, dènge magèle eele ne.

source_text: and he sent another; and him they killed: and many others; beating some, and killing some.
target_text: hèia lamatua oka èèna pua hari ana paleha leo èci la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra hake pamadhe ne. ra tao samia èèna ka, lamatua oka pua taruu ana paleha na la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra game cahag'e, aa pamadhe cahag'e.

source_text: he had yet one, a beloved son: he sent him last unto them, saying, they will reverence my son.
target_text: ate eele dhodhoka ana mone mesa dhu pasue nèti lamatua oka. lula na abhu heka j'ara dhu leo, ka lamatua oka na pua ana d'èlu na la'e. na pajiko, peka na, ‘sèmi ja'a pua ana d'èlu ja'a la'e, na, rèngu sèmi rare dènge be'a, aa ra nanene ne. '

source_text: but those husbandmen said among themselves, this is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
target_text: hèia na pua ana na la'e. ropa dhèu seb'a sèra rèdhi ana na mai, ka ra papeka isi-aanga ra, peka na, ‘we! mi ladhe ku laa! mone heka nèi pua ana d'èlu na mai! ladhe ama na madhe, nèngu ne'e ka dhu sèmi nare aa'i-aa'i mèdha pusaka ama na. de mai ti pamadhe ne, sèna ka èdhi tare pusaka na! '

source_text: and they took him, and killed him, and cast him forth out of the vineyard.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra kèpe, ka ra pamadhe ne, hèia ra core eele ngi'u aae na asa li'u tedhe la'e. lii pakasame ne, d'ai sange ne'e ka.

source_text: what therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus karèi dhèu kapai sèra, peka na, madhutu ngangee miu, na, lamatua oka èèna tao dhèu seb'a sèra tasa mera mia? madhutu ngangee ja'a, tatu nèngu mai ho pamadhe aa'i dhèu seb'a sèra, sèna ka na hia dhèu leo hari seb'a oka anggor na.

source_text: have ye not read even this scripture: the stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner;
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti baca le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘abhu hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu sèra core eele le, te ngaa limuri ne, j'aj'i le hadhu padhèdi.

source_text: this was from the lord, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
target_text: ama lamatua mesa na dhu pili nare, ka na pamadhèdi hadhu ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi ladhe, na, be'a titu kèna! '

source_text: and they sought to lay hold on him; and they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spake the parable against them: and they left him, and went away.
target_text: dhèu kapai sèra re'a dènge, na, yesus padhai lii paraga, pake lii pakasame èèna. rèngu sèra sama sèmi dhèu seb'a oka anggor èèna. hèia ra tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe yesus. te ngaa ra madha'u dènge dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus. ka ra kako eele ne.

source_text: and they send unto him certain of the pharisees and of the herodians, that they might catch him in talk.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu kapai yahudi se pua pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dènge dhèu nèti partei herodes, lasi pakarèi dènge yesus, ho ra neo sahèdhe ne.

source_text: and when they were come, they say unto him, teacher, we know that thou art true, and carest not for any one; for thou regardest not the person of men, but of a truth teachest the way of god: is it lawful to give tribute unto cæsar, or not?
target_text: ka ra karèi ne, peka na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a, na, d'ara ama ku mola, aa d'èi boe kapod'e-kabèli. ama me'a d'ara dhèu. ama peka dad'èi lamatua dènge mola-mola, lula ama pili boe rèhu dhèu. de, ji'i neo karèi ama ku ca j'ara. madhutu atora agama yahudi, èdhi bisa b'ae bea asa dhèu aae kapai dhu paredha roma, do aad'o?

source_text: shall we give, or shall we not give? but he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, why make ye trial of me? bring me a denarius, that i may see it.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le, na, rèngu neo sahèdhe ne, sèna ka na padhai lii lab'a paredha roma. ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, nga tao ka miu neo sahèdhe ja'a dènge lii karèi sèmi èèna! cob'a pad'elo ku mi ja'a doi pudhi cue!

source_text: and they brought it. and he saith unto them, whose is this image and superscription? and they said unto him, cæsar's.
target_text: ka ra j'ole doi pudhi cue hia ne. hèia yesus nare, ka laladhe. ka na karèi si, peka na, rèhu dènge ngara cee ètu doi pudhi ne? ka ra dhaa, peka na, èèna dhèu aae kapai paredha roma!

source_text: and jesus said unto them, render unto cæsar the things that are cæsar's, and unto god the things that are god's. and they marvelled greatly at him.
target_text: ka yesus peka, naa, ladhe sèmi èèna, ngaa dhu unu dhèu paredha, hia asa dhèu paredha la'e. te ngaa dhu unu ama lamatua, hia asa ama lamatua la'e. ropa tadèngi rare, lii b'ala na, ka ra malaa, lula yesus peka dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, dhèu sèra bisa heka sahèdhe ne.

source_text: and there come unto him sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
target_text: abhu partei agama dhu leo èci, ngara na partei saduki. rèngu aj'a, peka na, dhèu madhe bisa heka mamuri. ca tèka, abhu dhèu saduki pèri-pèri mai neo sahèdhe yesus.

source_text: teacher, moses wrote unto us, if a man's brother die, and leave a wife behind him, and leave no child, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
target_text: ka ra padhai lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama mese! musa suri tèke le hia èdhi atora, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone èci madhe tèke eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa rèngu dènge boe kolo, na, ari dhèu mone na bisa leo nare hari bhèni balu èèna, sèna ka abhu kolo ho baku pa'ele kolongara a'a na dhu madhe èèna.

source_text: there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed;
target_text: mema musa aj'a sèmi èèna. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: abhu dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. mone uru leo uuru èmu, te ngaa madhe, abhu mèka kolo.

source_text: and the second took her, and died, leaving no seed behind him; and the third likewise:
target_text: ka ari na leo nare bhèni balu èèna. nèbhu boe ka ari na madhe, te ngaa abhu boe kolo kahèi. ari na ka tèlu, sèmi èèna kahèi; na leo nare bhèni balu èèna, te ngaa abhu mèka kolo, nèngu madhe.

source_text: and the seven left no seed. last of all the woman also died.
target_text: taruu-taruu sèmi èèna ka, d'ai ana limuri tèka madhe kahèi. nèbhu boe, hèia bhèni balu èèna madhe.

source_text: in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
target_text: naa! ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: dhèu bhèni èèna, leo le dènge mone dhèu pidhu! d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, bhèni ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu cee, nèti dhèu pidhu sèra?

source_text: jesus said unto them, is it not for this cause that ye err, that ye know not the scriptures, nor the power of god?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, lii karèi miu sèra, tadha, na, miu me'a iia mèka isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua! miu me'a boe koasa lamatua kahèi. de miu sala titu kèna!

source_text: for when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as angels in heaven.
target_text: mi nanene! sèmi ne'e: ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua pamamuri hari, ra paleo heka èmu. sèmi èèna kahèi, ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: but as touching the dead, that they are raised; have ye not read in the book of moses, in the place concerning the bush, how god spake unto him, saying, i am the god of abraham, and the god of isaac, and the god of jacob?
target_text: aa ja'a peka mi miu lula-nèti dhèu madhe mamuri hari, do aad'o. musa suri tèke lula-nèti ana aaj'u dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. miu sanèd'e lii lolo èèna, do aad'o? ropa ai na'e ana aaj'u èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu, nuka abraham, isak, dènge yakob. toke d'ai sange ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i manèngi-mangaj'i mi ja'a era. '

source_text: he is not the god of the dead, but of the living: ye do greatly err.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, bèi-baki èdhi sèra madhe nèbhu le. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua peka nare le, na, nèngu j'aj'i lamatua rèngu era. nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a, na, rèngu mamuri hari le. de masi ka dhèu madhe le, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. de dhèu mamuri dhu manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu madhe aad'o, sina ma? nèti èèna ka, ladhe miu kèpe taruu a'aj'a dhu peka na, dhèu madhe mamuri heka, èèna miu sala ae!

source_text: and one of the scribes came, and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, what commandment is the first of all?
target_text: ètu lod'o èèna, abhu mese agama èci dhu nanene yesus padhai lii dènge dhèu nèti partei saduki sèra. madhutu a'abhu mese agama èèna, na, yesus dhaa lèke le lii karèi rèngu. hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, ama! ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: atora ad'a dènge lii paredha agama èdhi ae titu kèna. madhutu a'abhu ama, nèti lii paredha dhu mai nèti musa, mia ka dhu hua iia risi?

source_text: jesus answered, the first is, hear, o israel; the lord our god, the lord is one:
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, lii paredha dhu hua iia risi, peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘miu dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi! mi nanene paie! ama lamatua èèna, mema lamatua èdhi, aa kètu èdhi kahèi. nèngu dhoka mesa na di, lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: and thou shalt love the lord thy god with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength.
target_text: de miu hud'i sue risi eele ne nèti aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i d'èi pa'èci dènge ne dènge d'ara kateme, aa tadhe mèu ne, dènge sab'a èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. '

source_text: the second is this, thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself. there is none other commandment greater than these.
target_text: aa lii paredha ka dua peka na: ‘èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. ' dua paredha se'e ka dhu hua iia risi. abhu heka lii paredha leo dhu risi eele nèti dua paredha se'e.

source_text: and the scribe said unto him, of a truth, teacher, thou hast well said that he is one; and there is none other but he:
target_text: ka mese agama èèna b'ala hari, peka na, tare'a! ama ku peka lèke kèna. te ama lamatua j'aj'i kètu èdhi. lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is much more than all whole burnt-offerings and sacrifices.
target_text: èdhi hud'i sue risi ne, toke d'ara d'èi ho pa'èci dènge ne, tadhe mèu ne, dènge sab'a èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. èdhi hud'i sue dhèu leo kahèi sama sèmi èdhi sue ngi'u èdhi unu ti. lamatua d'èi risi eele tatao sèmi èèna, nèti èdhi madhutu dhodhoka atora agama di. tatao sèmi èèna be'a risi, nèti èdhi tèti badha ho lati tunu hia lamatua, do tèti mèdha leo hia ne.

source_text: and when jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, thou art not far from the kingdom of god. and no man after that durst ask him any question.
target_text: ropa yesus nanene nare dhèu ne dhaa sèmi èèna, ka na pangee, na, mese agama ne ne'a dènge be'a le. hèia yesus peka na, èu oe j'aj'i unu ama lamatua kèna. èle èèna ka, dhèu leo sèra bani heka pakarèi dènge yesus, lula dhèu èci sa segi boe ne.

source_text: and jesus answered and said, as he taught in the temple, how say the scribes that the christ is the son of david?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus aj'a dhèu ae sèra ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i era. ka na karèi si, peka na, madhutu ngangee miu, na, tasamia? mese agama sèra aj'a, peka na, kristus èèna dhu lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai. madhutu ngangee rèngu, na, kristus èèna dhoka ana-èpu daud. te ngaa a'aj'a sèmi èèna d'ai lèke mèu mèka.

source_text: david himself said in the holy spirit, the lord said unto my lord, sit thou on my right hand, till i make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet.
target_text: lula, nèti uru ka mai, roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci pake daud ho suri, peka na, ‘ama lamatua peka le mi lamatua ja'a, na, mai ho madhèdi mi era dhu hua iia, re bab'oa g'ana ja'a. pe èèna na ja'a tao musu èu pahaha iisi, toke ra bisa boe ded'e kètu mi èu. '

source_text: david himself calleth him lord; and whence is he his son? and the common people heard him gladly.
target_text: de èdhi te'a, na, dhèu aae daud paroa kristus èèna, peka na, ‘lamatua' na. nèti èèna ka, ladhe dhèu sèra peka, na, kristus èèna dhoka ana-èpu daud di, èèna d'ai mèka. lula nèngu èèna j'aj'i lamatua nèti daud kahèi. ropa yesus peka nare sèmi èèna, dhèu ae sèra d'èi titu kèna nanene ne.

source_text: and in his teaching he said, beware of the scribes, who desire to walk in long robes, and to have salutations in the marketplaces,
target_text: ka yesus peka hari si, miu hud'i pajiko paie ku mese agama. rèngu d'èi pasia pake kodho madhera d'ai rai, lasi paraga dènge dhèu ae, sèna ka dhèu dhu rèdhi rèngu sèra, koa si, peka na, ‘ladhe ku laa! dhèu sèra, dhèu kapai! '

source_text: and chief seats in the synagogues, and chief places at feasts:
target_text: ladhe sèmi rèngu maso asa èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, do lasi ra'a-sisi, ra tenge era madhèdi dhu be'a risi, sèna ka dhèu ae rèdhi si.

source_text: they that devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers; these shall receive greater condemnation.
target_text: de hua iia mi pajiko paie! rèngu kapod'e-kabèli bhèni balu ho parame rare èmu bhèni balu sèra. te ngaa ètu madha dhèu ae, rèngu pahuni bhabhelu ra sèra dènge j'ara titu ho sabaj'a pamadhera aae, sèna ka dhèu peka na, rèngu se dhèu mola. te ngaa limuri mai, na, ama lamatua hia huku dhu bia risi asa rèngu.

source_text: and he sat down over against the treasury, and beheld how the multitude cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus la'e madhèdi patangara dènge boaraka derma ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. na ladhe dhèu mai pamaso doi kolete asa d'ara boaraka èèna. ka na ladhe dhèu kaja sèra parèu doi ae.

source_text: and there came a poor widow, and she cast in two mites, which make a farthing.
target_text: te ngaa abhu bhèni balu èci dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa mai manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na pamaso dua doi asa d'ara boaraka èèna. dua doi dhu na pamaso èèna, kab'ua ciki ood'e di.

source_text: and he called unto him his disciples, and said unto them, verily i say unto you, this poor widow cast in more than all they that are casting into the treasury:
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus gape ana madhutu na, ka na peka, mi ladhe ku bhèni balu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa nèi. na pamaso dhoka dua doi di, te ngaa nèngu hia risi eele nèti dhèu leo sèra.

source_text: for they all did cast in of their superfluity; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
target_text: dhèu leo sèra hia kolete nèti doi sisa rèngu. te ngaa bhèni balu ne hia aa'i mèu-mèu doi nèngu asa lamatua.

source_text: and as he went forth out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, teacher, behold, what manner of stones and what manner of buildings!
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra kalua nèti d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa rèngu d'ai li'u, hèia ana madhutu na èci paj'uj'u asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na peka, ama! ladhe ku èmu ne'e! ra tao rare, saraga bia. ra pagod'o rare hadhu sèra, mera titu kèna!

source_text: and jesus said unto him, seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left here one stone upon another, which shall not be thrown down.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, èmu ne mema saraga titu kèna! te nèbhu heka, dhèu paguri eele ne. ka hadhu-hadhu sèra, èci sa pamadhèdi heka ètu dedha èci.

source_text: and as he sat on the mount of olives over against the temple, peter and james and john and andrew asked him privately,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi asa ledhe saitun, ka na madhèdi ètu era dhu patangara dènge èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. hèia petrus, yakobis, yohanis dènge anderias mai padhai lii dènge yesus.

source_text: tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when these things are all about to be accomplished?
target_text: ra karèi, aku rèngu na, ama! lole hari ku, lii dhu ama ku peka dènge ji'i deo na. lod'o mia sèra sa j'aj'i? aa tadha-tadha na, samia?

source_text: and jesus began to say unto them, take heed that no man lead you astray.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sad'i miu pajiko paie-iie, sèna ka baku lèke tipu.

source_text: many shall come in my name, saying, i am he; and shall lead many astray.
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, dhèu ae mai tèb'a kakara, ho ra peka na, ‘ja'a ne kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua moa nèti uru ka mai. ' aa ra leko-monya dhèu ae.

source_text: and when ye shall hear of wars and rumors of wars, be not troubled: these things must needs come to pass; but the end is not yet.
target_text: ladhe miu mèdhi dhèu pamusu, do tadèngi lii lolo dhèu papara-pakèj'i dènge pakasiro ètu mia-mia, miu baku madha'u kahèi. sèra sa hud'i j'aj'i uuru ku. te ngaa lod'o èle rai-haha èèna dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: for nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; there shall be earthquakes in divers places; there shall be famines: these things are the beginning of travail.
target_text: dhèu nèti ca suku mai pamusu dènge suku leo, rai èci mai pamusu dènge rai leo. ètu mia-mia, j'aj'i rai opo dènge kabake-manganga. sèra sa j'aj'i tadha sama sèmi dhèu bhèni èci dhu kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi.

source_text: but take ye heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in synagogues shall ye be beaten; and before governors and kings shall ye stand for my sake, for a testimony unto them.
target_text: de hua iia, na, miu mage-mage! te èèna na dhèu mai kèpa miu, ho ra nuni asa dhèu paredha agama dhu pama'ète lii agama. aa ra game miu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ho èèna na rèti miu asa madha dhèu dhu dènge koasa, lula miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa be'a kahèi, ne'e ne miu abhu tebho ho peka kolongara ja'a mi rèngu.

source_text: and the gospel must first be preached unto all the nations.
target_text: te dhèu unu ama lamatua hud'i lasi uuru ku lole lii lolo be'a ja'a mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, heka lod'o èle rai-haha ne d'ai kèna.

source_text: and when they lead you to judgment, and deliver you up, be not anxious beforehand what ye shall speak: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye; for it is not ye that speak, but the holy spirit.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ladhe ra èki rèti miu asa era pama'ète lii langu, miu baku madha'u, peka na, ‘èèna na ja'a neo padhai lii ngaa? do, ja'a neo dhaa ngaa? ' ladhe d'ai lod'o èèna, miu padhai lii madhutu ngaa dhu roh mola-mèci ama lamatua peka dènge miu.

source_text: and brother shall deliver up brother to death, and the father his child; and children shall rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu cue, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na a'ari nèngu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu ana dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na ama d'èlu na tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu ina-ama dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na ana d'èlu rèngu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe si.

source_text: and ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end, the same shall be saved.
target_text: de èèna na, dhèu d'èi boe miu, taga miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa dhèu cee dhu bisa taha toke d'ai èle lod'o èèna, tatu ama lamatua hia mamuri mi nèngu.

source_text: but when ye see the abomination of desolation standing where he ought not let him that readeth understand, then let them that are in judæa flee unto the mountains:
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, èèna na, abhu dhèu èci dhu bhelu-katub'a risi eele mai. ho na mai maso ka titu ètu era laluri ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, dhu madhutu iia-iia na, nèngu bisa boe ètu era èèna, ho na pahera era èèna. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua tèke eele era èèna. ladhe miu mèdhi le sèmi èèna, na, mi pajiko paie-iie! cee dhu baca lii ne'e, pajiko paie kahèi! èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra, dètu ae le. ladhe mèdhi sèmi èèna, na, dhèu-dhèu ètu propensi yudea lega-rai asa kolo ledhe lasi.

source_text: and let him that is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house:
target_text: rèngu hud'i rai pamèri-mèri, sèna ka baku abhu j'aj'èra. ladhe dhèu mai le asa li'u, lèpa ia ka rare mèdha asa d'ara èmu.

source_text: and let him that is in the field not return back to take his cloak.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu ètu d'ara oka, baku lèpa èmu rare mèdha-papake.

source_text: but woe unto them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days!
target_text: dhu j'èra risi, dhèu bhèni dhu dènge babia, dènge ina dhu pasusu ana rara iisi hiu, lula rèngu rai rare boe.

source_text: and pray ye that it be not in the winter.
target_text: de hua iia risi miu sabaj'a, sèna ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra baku lèke dènge hèru èj'i lai.

source_text: for those days shall be tribulation, such as there hath not been the like from the beginning of the creation which god created until now, and never shall be.
target_text: te j'aj'èra lod'o èèna, bia titu kèna! mulai nèti ama lamatua tao rai-haha, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu rèdhi mèka j'aj'èra dhu bia sèmi èèna. j'aj'èra bia sèmi èèna, lod'o limuri, j'aj'i heka hari.

source_text: and except the lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the elect's sake, whom he chose, he shortened the days.
target_text: ladhe ama lamatua pab'ab'e boe lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu mamuri. te ngaa, taga ama lamatua sue dhèu dhu na hag'e nare sèra, ka na pab'ab'e lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra sèra.

source_text: and then if any man shall say unto you, lo, here is the christ; or, lo, there; believe it not:
target_text: ladhe lod'o d'ai na, miu tadèngi dhèu mai peka, aku rèngu na, ‘ladhe ku! kristus ètu ne'e! ' aa dhèu leo hari peka, aku rèngu na, ‘aad'o! kristus ètu nèi! ' miu baku nanene kahèi!

source_text: for there shall arise false christs and false prophets, and shall show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, the elect.
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, dhèu mai ho tèb'a kakara, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus! ' aa cahag'e hari peka na, ‘ja'a ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ' èèna na ra tao tadha malaa ae-ae dènge koasa nidhu, ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu. rèngu patangi-tenge j'ara sèna ka dhèu unu ama lamatua lèke tipu kahèi!

source_text: but take ye heed: behold, i have told you all things beforehand.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu pajiko paie-iie! mema lod'o j'aj'èra bia èèna d'ai mèka, te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e uuru miu!

source_text: but in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka hari dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe èle lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, na, ‘madha lod'o j'aj'i maroga, aa hèru heo heka.

source_text: and the stars shall be falling from heaven, and the powers that are in the heavens shall be shaken.
target_text: hua hètu-hua hètu bèbha nèti dedha-liru mai, aa koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru j'aj'i kaco-balo. '

source_text: and then shall they see the son of man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
target_text: èle èèna, heka dhèu ladhe rèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. èèna na ja'a mai dènge ra'i-liru nèti dedha. hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi a'èra dènge dadedha ja'a.

source_text: and then shall he send forth the angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
target_text: ka ja'a paredha ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, ho puru lasi oru-kaboko dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a hag'e kore nèti mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne; nèti suu haa d'ai suu dhimu, nèti suu badae toke d'ai suu balèu.

source_text: now from the fig tree learn her parable: when her branch is now become tender, and putteth forth its leaves, ye know that the summer is nigh;
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, ja'a kore upama nèti ana aaj'u. ladhe rèu na mulai karara, èèna tadha hèru hadhu dètu le!

source_text: even so ye also, when ye see these things coming to pass, know ye that he is nigh, even at the doors.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe miu mèdhi lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra sèra j'aj'i, sama sèmi lii peka ja'a deo na, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, mamai ja'a dètu ae le.

source_text: verily i say unto you, this generation shall not pass away, until all these things be accomplished.
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a peka dènge miu kèna! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri se, èèna na abhu cahag'e dhu dhae madhe mèka, te lod'o-lod'o dhu pènu dènge j'aj'èra na d'ai le.

source_text: heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
target_text: masi ka liru dènge rai-haha ne ele, te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a ele boe, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: but of that day or that hour knoweth no one, not even the angels in heaven, neither the son, but the father.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii, peka na, dhèu èci sa re'a boe lod'o do jam dhu ja'a mai hari. ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga sèra re'a boe kahèi. ja'a mesa ku, ke'a boe kahèi. dhoka ama ku mesa na di, dhu ne'a.

source_text: take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu aa'i-aa'i mi hud'i pajiko paie, lula miu me'a boe lod'o d'ai na.

source_text: it is as when a man, sojourning in another country, having left his house, and given authority to his servants, to each one his work, commanded also the porter to watch.
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a laku tèke eele miu kèna, te ngaa èèna na ja'a mai hari. sama sèmi dhèu dhu la'e tèke eele èmu nèngu, ho la'e asa rai kaj'èu. na pua ana-ana nèngu j'aga paie èmu. aa na bagi hia si sasab'a. ka na paredha ana madhenga èmu, sèna ka na j'aga paie, toke d'ai nèngu lèpa hari.

source_text: watch therefore: for ye know not when the lord of the house cometh, whether at even, or at midnight, or at cockcrowing, or in the morning;
target_text: miu hud'i j'aga mèda-mèu kahèi, lula miu me'a boe lod'o mia ja'a mai hari, sama sèmi ana madhenga èmu ne'a boe lod'o lamatua èmu na lèpa. lèpa lod'o nihia, talora mèda, oe mèu, lod'o rea, do lod'o nètu; miu me'a boe jam èèna.

source_text: lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
target_text: mage dhoka na mai sahèka, te abhu miu dhu bhèj'i luu era.

source_text: and what i say unto you i say unto all, watch.
target_text: de, ngaa dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne'e, ja'a peka lème dènge dhèu leo kahèi, ‘miu hud'i pajiko paie, ho mi soru mamai ja'a. ' d'ai sange ne'e ka, lamatua yesus padhai lii lula-nèti lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra dhèu rai-haha, dènge ana madhutu na sèra ètu ledhe saitun.

source_text: now after two days was the feast of the passover and the unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him with subtlety, and kill him: for they said, not during the feast, lest haply there shall be a tumult of the people.
target_text: èle èèna ka, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tenge j'ara neo kèpe yesus dènge mau-mau. te rèngu neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa ètu d'ara padhue èèna, ra peka na, taha ku! baku parai kèpe ne, lula lod'o kalela dètu le. mage dhoka dhèu ae sèra patao dènge èdhi. rèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, lula dii dua lod'o ka, d'ai lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi, dhu biasa ra peka na, ‘paska' dènge ‘pesta roti dhu pake boe ragi'. kalela se pasanèd'e rèngu lod'o bèi-baki ra kalua nèti rai masir.

source_text: and while he was in bethany in the house of simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster cruse of ointment of pure nard very costly; and she brake the cruse, and poured it over his head.
target_text: ètu rae betania, abhu ca dhèu ngara na simon. uru èèna, dhèu madenge dènge ne, lula nèngu pèd'a kusta. te ngaa limuri ne, èle le nèti papèd'a na. hèia lod'o kalela dhae d'ai mèka, na, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra lasi ra'a-rinu ètu èmu simon. ètu talora ra'a-rinu era, dhèu bhèni èci mai paraga yesus. nèd'u dènge boto èci dhu ra tao nèti hadhu. isi boto ne, èi hèu mèngi asli dhu kab'ua titu kèna, dhu ra tao nèti amo aaj'u hèu mèngi. hèia bhèni ne pamae hèb'a boto èèna, ka na pasuti èi hèu mèngi mi kètu yesus, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, nèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: but there were some that had indignation among themselves, saying, to what purpose hath this waste of the ointment been made?
target_text: te ngaa ètu èèna, abhu dhèu leo dhu ra'a-rinu pa'èci kahèi. ropa dhèu se rèdhi dhèu bhèni ne tao sèmi èèna, hèia ra nasa. ka ra padhai lii padedha iisi, peka na, ngaa ka unu bhèni nèi? na bhori eele èi hèu mèngi kab'ua aae èèna!

source_text: for this ointment might have been sold for above three hundred shillings, and given to the poor. and they murmured against her.
target_text: be'a risi nèngu pahie èi hèu mèngi èèna, ho la'e papala doi ae sèra, mi dhèu dhu dènge boe unu. te kab'ua èi hèu mèngi ne, èci èèna ka dènge gaji tuka d'ara ca tèu. hèia ra jèke bhèni ne.

source_text: but jesus said, let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu baku pasusa bhèni ne! hud'i laa! ja'a karej'e lula nèngu pasuti le ngi'u ja'a dènge èi hèu mèngi ne'e!

source_text: for ye have the poor always with you, and whensoever ye will ye can do them good: but me ye have not always.
target_text: dhèu kasia sèra, bèli-bèli ètu talora miu. de lod'o mia èèna ka dhu miu lake mere, na, miu bisa soru-bara si. te ngaa nèbhu heka, ja'a pa'èci heka dènge miu.

source_text: she hath done what she could; she hath anointed my body beforehand for the burying.
target_text: mamuri ja'a nèbhu heka ètu rai-haha ne. dènge tatao bhèni ne, nèngu lalau ngi'u ja'a, sama sèmi nèngu pahèu mèngi mema ngi'u aae ja'a, ho padhane.

source_text: and verily i say unto you, wheresoever the gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, that also which this woman hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
target_text: miu patadhe, ee! èèna na, ladhe dhèu lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua ètu mia-mia, na, ra palolo kahèi tatao be'a bhèni ne'e. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanèd'e nèngu.

source_text: and judas iscariot, he that was one of the twelve, went away unto the chief priests, that he might deliver him unto them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abhu ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu yesus dhèu canguru dua sèra, ngara na yudas iskariot. nèngu kalua la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi sèra ho neo pahie yesus mi rèngu. ropa na paraga dènge rèngu, ka na peka naneo na.

source_text: and they, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. and he sought how he might conveniently deliver him unto them.
target_text: lod'o kètu agama sèra tadèngi naneo yudas, ka ra karej'e titu kèna. hèia ra jaji, peka na, ladhe èu neo pahie yesus dènge ji'i, tatu ji'i b'ae. hèia yudas kalua, ka na mulai tenge j'ara ho pahie yesus.

source_text: and on the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the passover, his disciples say unto him, where wilt thou that we go and make ready that thou mayest eat the passover?
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge lod'o partama nèti lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi. de d'ara lod'o èèna, rèngu tema tunu roti dhu dènge boe ragi, aa roro kahib'i-kalèbho kahèi. hèia ana madhutu yesus sèra mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama! doe ne'e ne, lod'o kalela paska èdhi kèna. de ama neo ji'i lalau era kalela paska ètu mia?

source_text: and he sendeth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, go into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him;
target_text: hèia yesus pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua, aku nèngu na, miu lami uuru ku asa d'ara kota. ètu nèi, miu paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, dhu pasae èi d'ara g'ala iiki cue. lami madhutu ne nèti limuri.

source_text: and wheresoever he shall enter in, say to the master of the house, the teacher saith, where is my guest-chamber, where i shall eat the passover with my disciples?
target_text: ladhe na maso asa èmu mia èèna ka, na, miu madhutu ne asa d'ara. hèia miu peka mi lamatua èmu èèna, sèmi ne'e, ‘ama mese ji'i manèngi kama èci, ho na neo tao kalela paska dènge ana madhutu nèngu. '

source_text: and he will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready: and there make ready for us.
target_text: pe dhèu èèna paj'uj'u kama aae èci ètu èmu dedha na, dhu na sadia nare le. de miu dua mi dhoka lami lalau nganga'a di.

source_text: and the disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
target_text: hèia dua ra lasi ka asa d'ara kota. d'ai nèi, rèngu rèdhi tare'a, sama sèmi ngaa dhu yesus moa deo na. ka ra sadia aa'i-aa'i, ho yesus si ra'a kalela paska ètu era èèna. èle èèna ka, dua ra lasi paroa yesus si.

source_text: and when it was evening he cometh with the twelve.
target_text: ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia yesus dènge ana madhutu dhèu canguru dua sèra d'ai era èèna.

source_text: and as they sat and were eating, jesus said, verily i say unto you, one of you shall betray me, even he that eateth with me.
target_text: ka ra madhèdi ra'a sama-sama. ètu talora ra'a era, yesus padhai lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu nanene ku! èèna na dhèu èci nèti miu se pahie eele ja'a mi dhèu leo.

source_text: they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, is it i?
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii èèna, ana madhutu yesus sèra cag'ag'a dènge manyasa. ka rèngu èci-èci mulai karèi yesus, peka na, dhèu dhu ama peka èèna, ja'a aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: and he said unto them, it is one of the twelve, he that dippeth with me in the dish.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu cèb'u roti palere-lere dènge ja'a asa d'ara mago ne, nèngu ka dhu pahia ja'a.

source_text: for the son of man goeth, even as it is written of him: but woe unto that man through whom the son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had not been born.
target_text: mi sanèd'e! ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a hud'i madhe ku, sama sèmi dhu suri tèke le, ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. te ngaa kasia, dhèu dhu neo pahia ja'a èèna, bèli-camèd'a nèngu dui nare pala na! hua iia risi, ina na baku nara iisi ne!

source_text: and as they were eating, he took bread, and when he had blessed, he brake it, and gave to them, and said, take ye: this is my body.
target_text: ropa rèngu ètu talora ra'a era, yesus nare roti cue, hèia na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia na j'ole asa ana madhutu na sèra. ka na peka na, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u ja'a kèna. mere ho mi'a.

source_text: and he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them: and they all drank of it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na nare galaa dhu isi dènge èi hua anggor. na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua kahèi. ka na j'ole galaa èèna asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka rinu.

source_text: and he said unto them, this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.
target_text: hèia na peka, èi anggor ne'e ne, raa ja'a kèna, dhu suti sèna ka hia mamuri mi dhèu ae. raa ne, j'aj'i mi tadha ho pasanèd'e, peka na, ngaa dhu ama lamatua moa le èèna, limuri ne j'aj'i le tare'a. mere ho minu ka!

source_text: verily i say unto you, i shall no more drink of the fruit of the vine, until that day when i drink it new in the kingdom of god.
target_text: mi sanèd'e paie! nèti mèda ne'e ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. toke d'ai ja'a dènge ama ku ngèd'u paredha sama-sama ètu sorga, heka kinu hari kèna.

source_text: and when they had sung a hymn, they went out unto the mount of olives.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra sod'a lii sod'a èci, ho ra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. ka mèda èèna kahèi, lasi dènge asa ledhe saitun.

source_text: and jesus saith unto them, all ye shall be offended: for it is written, i will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered abroad.
target_text: ètu d'ara kakako rèngu èèna, yesus padhai lii, peka na, d'ara mèda ne'e ne, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai tèke eele ja'a mesa ku. sama sèmi dhu ra suri le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘èèna na ama lamatua pamadhe ana madhenga badha, ka kahib'i-kalèbho na rai paj'ala asa haa, asa dhimu. '

source_text: howbeit, after i am raised up, i will go before you into galilee.
target_text: èèna na ja'a madhe tare'a. te ngaa lod'o ja'a mamuri hari, ja'a laku uru nèti miu asa propensi galilea!

source_text: but peter said unto him, although all shall be offended, yet will not i.
target_text: ka petrus b'ala, peka na, ama! masi ka dhèu leo rai eele ama, te ngaa ja'a rai boe!

source_text: and jesus saith unto him, verily i say unto thee, that thou to-day, even this night, before the cock crow twice, shalt deny me thrice.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, petrus! mu patadhe! mèda ne'e kahèi, manu kokotoo d'ai mèka dua hari, te ngaa èu pasili le ja'a tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a!

source_text: but he spake exceeding vehemently, if i must die with thee, i will not deny thee. and in like manner also said they all.
target_text: ka petrus pajèka dènge ne, peka na, aad'o sèmi èèna, ama! ladhe ama madhe, ja'a madhe dènge ama kahèi. te ngaa ja'a pasili boe ama, aa rai eele boe! angalai petrus sèra lii èci èèna kahèi.

source_text: and they come unto a place which was named gethsemane: and he saith unto his disciples, sit ye here, while i pray.
target_text: hèia yesus si lasi d'ai d'ara oka cue ètu ledhe saitun, ngara na ‘getsemani'. d'ai èèna, hèia yesus peka dènge ra, miu madhèdi mate ja'a mi ne'e. ja'a neo laku manèngi-mangaj'i asa nèi.

source_text: and he taketh with him peter and james and john, and began to be greatly amazed, and sore troubled.
target_text: ka yesus gale nèti petrus, yakobis, dènge yohanis lasi dènge ne. mulai nèti èèna ka, na rasa d'ara nèngu ma'ète laho mae-mae.

source_text: and he saith unto them, my soul is exceeding sorrowful even unto death: abide ye here, and watch.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, d'ara ja'a pèd'a titu kèna! ja'a rasa sèmi oe madhe sa. miu madhèdi mate mi ne'e.

source_text: and he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him. and he said, abba, father, all things are possible unto thee; remove this cup from me: howbeit not what i will, but what thou wilt.
target_text: hèia la'e ako kaj'èu ciki nèti era èèna, ka na patitu kètu urutuu na ètu rai, ka na sabaj'a, peka na, ama pasue! ladhe sèmi ama d'èi, na, ja'a baku pasae j'aj'èra ne'e d'ai madhe. ja'a ke'a le, ètu madha ama, abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu ama bisa boe tao. de ladhe bisa, na, ama pakaj'èu eele babia ne'e nèti kabela-kao ja'a. masi ka sèmi èèna, baku madhutu dad'èi ja'a; te ngaa hud'i madhutu dad'èi ama ku ka laa.

source_text: and he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto peter, simon, sleepest thou? couldest thou not watch one hour?
target_text: èle èèna ka, na lèpa asa ana madhutu na, dhèu tèlu sèra, te ngaa ra bhèj'i luu. hèia na parèi si, ka na padhai lii dènge petrus, peka na, petrus! èu bhèj'i, do? ja'a nèbhu boe ètu nèi, te ngaa miu bisa boe beke mate ja'a ciki sa!

source_text: watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
target_text: kèd'i ho pamako musi madha èu. kèd'i ka, ho beke dènge ja'a! d'ara miu neo tao be'a kahèi, te ngaa ngi'u miu roe. de be'a risi miu sabaj'a, sèna ka ladhe miu lèke dadugu-rariu, miu baku manahu.

source_text: and again he went away, and prayed, saying the same words.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus la'e manèngi-mangaj'i ca tèka hari. nèngu manèngi hari mi ama lamatua, aku nèngu na, ama! ladhe bisa, na, ama pakaj'èu eele babia ne nèti ja'a. te ngaa hud'i madhutu dad'èi ama ku ka laa.

source_text: and again he came, and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they knew not what to answer him.
target_text: ka na lèpa hari asa era ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra. te ngaa rèngu bhèj'i hari le, lula musi madha ra sakaa titu kèna. hèia na parèi hari si, te ngaa rèngu re'a boe dhaa sèmi ngaa mi nèngu.

source_text: and he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough; the hour is come; behold, the son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele si, ka la'e manèngi-mangaj'i d'ai tèlu hari kèna. èle èèna ka, na lèpa la'e parèi ana madhutu na sèra. na peka, miu bhèj'i taruu era? sange èèna ka laa! kèd'i ka! te dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, nuka mai dènge angalai nèngu sèra. rèngu mai kèpe ja'a, ho saraka mi dhèu bhelu-katub'a si.

source_text: arise, let us be going: behold, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
target_text: kèd'i ka! pamako musi madha miu, ho ladhe ku asa nèi! dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a ne, nuka mai nèi. mai ho lati paraga dènge si!

source_text: and straightway, while he yet spake, cometh judas, one of the twelve, and with him a multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, hèia yudas d'ai madha yesus dènge dhèu ae titu kèna. rèngu mai rèti dènge hela dènge cèki, ho kèpe yesus. dhèu se tao sèmi èèna, lula ra madhutu lii paredha nèti kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: now he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, whomsoever i shall kiss, that is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
target_text: yudas hia mema tadha mi dhèu ae se, peka na, ladhe d'ai nèi, ja'a uu cee, na, nèngu kèna. de mi kèpe ne.

source_text: and when he was come, straightway he came to him, and saith, rabbi; and kissed him.
target_text: ropa yudas si d'ai era èèna, na la'e asa madha yesus. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, ama mese! hèia na liku nare yesus, ka na uu ne.

source_text: and they laid hands on him, and took him.
target_text: hèia dhèu ae sèra ara asa madha yesus, ka ra kèpe ne.

source_text: but a certain one of them that stood by drew his sword, and smote the servant of the high priest, and struck off his ear.
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu yesus èci bete hela na, ka na pare pama'ète rèu dhilu dhèu èci. dhèu dhu nu'a ne, ènu nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: and jesus answered and said unto them, are ye come out, as against a robber, with swords and staves to seize me?
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae dhu mai kèpe nèngu sèra, aku nèngu na, tasamia? miu ngee, na, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu, do? ka miu mai kèpe ja'a mèti hela dènge cèki?

source_text: i was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but this is done that the scriptures might be fulfilled.
target_text: bèli-bèli ja'a aj'a miu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, te ngaa miu èci sa kèpe boe ja'a. mai ka, kèpe ja'a! te j'ara ne j'aj'i sèmi dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua.

source_text: and they all left him, and fled.
target_text: ana madhutu yesus sèra madha'u titu kèna. hèia ra rai tèke eele yesus mesa na ètu èèna.

source_text: and a certain young man followed with him, having a linen cloth cast about him, over his naked body: and they lay hold on him; but he left the linen cloth, and fled naked.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu ana mone ngèru èci kahèi dhu madhutu yesus re limuri. ana ne pahutu isi na dènge sig'i ca bèla. dhèu sèra neo kèpe ne kahèi, ka na rai tèke eele sig'i na ètu kacui-aai dhèu sèra, lula na madha'u. hèia na rai dènge boe mèdha-papake ètu ua na.

source_text: and they led jesus away to the high priest: and there come together with him all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra rèti yesus asa èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. ètu èèna, dhèu kapai sèra pakaboko le. rèngu sèra, nuka: kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: and peter had followed him afar off, even within, into the court of the high priest; and he was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.
target_text: ropa ra kèpe rèti yesus, petrus madhutu mau-mau nèti limuri. hèia na maso kahèi d'ai madha èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, ka na madhèdi manyiru ai sama-sama dènge dhèu j'aga ètu sèra.

source_text: now the chief priests and the whole council sought witness against jesus to put him to death; and found it not.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu èèna, kètu agama yahudi sèra padhue dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi j'ue lii langu agama. ra patangi-tenge bukti ho pamanahu yesus, lula ra neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa rèngu abhu boe bukti èci sa.

source_text: for many bare false witness against him, and their witness agreed not together.
target_text: ka ra paroa dhèu ae asa madha ho j'aj'i sakasii, sèna ka neo pabèbhe yesus. te ngaa lii sakasii rèngu sèra, èci dènge èci pamèci boe.

source_text: and there stood up certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu sakasii leo dhu kèd'i titu, ka ra pakapod'e lii, peka na,

source_text: we heard him say, i will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days i will build another made without hands.
target_text: ji'i tadèngi dhèu ne'e peka na, ‘èèna na ja'a paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhu dhèu rai-haha tao dènge kacui-aai ra. te ngaa èle tèlu lod'o ka, ja'a patitu kore hari le èmu èèna, dènge boe pake kacui-aai dhèu. '

source_text: and not even so did their witness agree together.
target_text: te ngaa lii lolo rèngu sèra èci dènge èci baka-leo hua.

source_text: and the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked jesus, saying, answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
target_text: hèia kètu kapai risi agama yahudi èèna, kèd'i titu ètu talora dhèu ae dhu madhèdi ètu sèra. ka na karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae mai le galaa èu. nga tao ka èu mau-mau, mo'o boe dhaa lii galaa sèra?

source_text: but he held his peace, and answered nothing. again the high priest asked him, and saith unto him, art thou the christ, the son of the blessed?
target_text: te ngaa yesus mau-mau, lii boe ca hèb'a sa. èle èèna ka, kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ne, karèi hari ne ca tèka, èu peka ku laa! tare'a-re'a èu ne kristus, ana ama lamatua dhu na moa nèti uuru èèna, do?

source_text: and jesus said, i am: and ye shall see the son of man sitting at the right hand of power, and coming with the clouds of heaven.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a sèmi èèna! nèngu èèna ka, ja'a ne! bèli-camèd'a miu ladhe mèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, madhèdi re bab'oa g'ana ama lamatua ètu sorga. koasa nèngu kapai risi eele! ladhe èèna na, ja'a dènge nèngu, ngèd'u paredha sama-sama. èle èèna na, ja'a puru mai nèti sorga dènge ra'i-liru.

source_text: and the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, what further need have we of witnesses?
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii padhai yesus, kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ne nasa titu kèna, hèia na ciu pamae kodho madhera ètu ua na. ka na pajèka peka dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, èdhi parluu heka sakasii!

source_text: ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? and they all condemned him to be worthy of death.
target_text: miu tadèngi le dènge ro'a dhilu miu, si? nèngu unu na ka dhu peka sèmi èèna! nèngu padedha iisi na, j'aj'i ana ama lamatua. lii ne'e ne, lii dhu pa'ele iie kolongara ama lamatua! madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu dhu tao iisi na sama sèmi ama lamatua, dhèu èèna hud'i lèke huku madhe ku! de mi pama'ète tasamia? hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i pama'ète, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, tare'a-re'a sala! de nèngu ne hud'i lèke huku pamadhe!

source_text: and some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, prophesy: and the officers received him with blows of their hands.
target_text: hèia pèri-pèri dhèu kèd'i lasi sabhuu ilu mi rèhu yesus. ra hutu musi madha na, ka ra game ne. hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ladhe èu j'aj'i dhèu mèti lii padhai ama lamatua, na, èu peka sèku! cee ka dhu j'ubhu èu? èle èèna ka, ra pua dhèu dhu madhenge èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho mai pakako rèti yesus. ropa ra kako, ra tèb'e pa'oke ne nèti haa, nèti dhimu.

source_text: and as peter was beneath in the court, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest; and seeing peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and saith, thou also wast with the nazarene, even jesus.
target_text: mèda èèna, petrus madhèdi era ètu madha èmu èèna. hèia ènu dhèu bhèni èci nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, mai ka nèdhi petrus madhèdi manyiru ai. na ladhe kaloo ka rèhu petrus, ka karèi, aku nèngu na, deo na èu sama-sama dènge yesus, dhèu nasaret èèna, si?

source_text: but he denied, saying, i neither know, nor understand what thou sayest: and he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
target_text: te ngaa petrus dhaa, peka na, aad'o! nga tao ka èu karèi sèmi èèna! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu èèna. hèia petrus kalua, ka la'e titu ètu hèb'a tedhe. kabèdhi laa, manu kokotoo.

source_text: and the maid saw him, and began again to say to them that stood by, this is one of them.
target_text: hèia dhèu bhèni èèna ladhe nèdhi hari petrus. ka na peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, nèngu ne ca dhèu nèti rèngu kahèi!

source_text: but he again denied it. and after a little while again they that stood by said to peter, of a truth thou art one of them; for thou art a galilæan.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili hari, ka na peka, tao-tao èu huj'u! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne'e! nèbhu boe ka, dhèu èci ètu èèna kahèi, peka hari mi petrus, aku nèngu na, èu ne baku pasili, peka na, èu dènge boe dhèu se'e se! we! miu se aa'i-aa'i mi, dhèu galilea, si?

source_text: but he began to curse, and to swear, i know not this man of whom ye speak.
target_text: ka petrus pab'ala hari, aku nèngu na, ja'a bani subha! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu nèi!

source_text: and straightway the second time the cock crew. and peter called to mind the word, how that jesus said unto him, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. and when he thought thereon, he wept.
target_text: petrus dhu padhai lii nare mèka, kabèdhi laa, manu kokotoo ka dua hari kèna. hèia petrus sanèd'e lii dhu yesus peka dènge nèngu, ladhe manu kokotoo d'ai mèka dua hari, te èu pasili le ja'a tèlu hari peka na èu tadhe boe ja'a! ropa ngee nèdhi, hèia petrus tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: and straightway in the morning the chief priests with the elders and scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, and bound jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him up to pilate.
target_text: mad'ae aae era, dhèu-dhèu j'ue lii langu agama yahudi sèra pare'a lii ho pamadhe yesus. ka ra èki rèti ne, lasi asa madha gubernur pilatus.

source_text: and pilate asked him, art thou the king of the jews? and he answering saith unto him, thou sayest.
target_text: ropa d'ai madha gubernur, ka na karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, tasamia? èu ne tare'a dhèu aae yahudi, do? yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, tare'a. ama gubernur peka lèke kèna.

source_text: and the chief priests accused him of many things.
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra peka dènge gubernur, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne'e tao sala ae titu kèna! hèia ra lolo ka sasala na èci-èci.

source_text: and pilate again asked him, saying, answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they accuse thee of.
target_text: ka gubernur karèi hari yesus, èu tadèngi boe lii padhai dhèu se'e, do? dhèu se'e, pasala le èu ae-ae. èu b'ala ku laa!

source_text: but jesus no more answered anything; insomuch that pilate marvelled.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala boe ca hèb'a sa, ka gubernur malaa.

source_text: now at the feast he used to release unto them one prisoner, whom they asked of him.
target_text: tèu mai-tèu mai, dhu tema le, ladhe d'ai lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi, dhèu ae sèra paj'uj'u ana bèdho èci, ho gubernur patalale ne.

source_text: and there was one called barabbas, lying bound with them that had made insurrection, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana bèdho èci, ngara na barabas. uru èèna, ra kèpe ne, taga na palab'a dènge dhèu paredha roma, aa na pamadhe dhèu kahèi.

source_text: and the multitude went up and began to ask him to do as he was wont to do unto them.
target_text: lula lod'o tatao paska èèna oe dètu le, dhèu ae lasi manèngi gubernur pilatus, ka ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, ama gubernur! lod'o tatao paska dètu le! lod'o sèmi ne'e, ama gubernur patabuli ku ana bèdho èci, sama sèmi tèu-tèu uru sèra.

source_text: and pilate answered them, saying, will ye that i release unto you the king of the jews?
target_text: hèia gubernur b'ala lii rèngu, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a patabuli cee? tasamia, ladhe ja'a patabuli dhèu aae yahudi miu, do? miu mo'o, do aad'o?

source_text: for he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.
target_text: gubernur peka sèmi èèna, lula nèngu ne'a le, kètu agama yahudi ka rèti yesus mai asa nèngu, taga ra kacèki dènge yesus.

source_text: but the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should rather release barabbas unto them.
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi se dadugu dhèu ae sèra, ho manèngi gubernur, peka na, ji'i ngo'o boe nèngu! ji'i d'èi dhoka patabuli barabas di!

source_text: and pilate again answered and said unto them, what then shall i do unto him whom ye call the king of the jews?
target_text: ka gubernur karèi hari dhèu ae sèra, ladhe sèmi èèna, yesus, dhu ra pangare na ‘dhèu aae yahudi' èèna, ja'a tao ne, tasamia?

source_text: and they cried out again, crucify him.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo, peka na, pamadhe ne! paku ne mi aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: and pilate said unto them, why, what evil hath he done? but they cried out exceedingly, crucify him.
target_text: hèia gubernur karèi si, aku nèngu na, sasala na ngaa? ja'a parisa kore le. te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa, dhu nèngu tao! te ngaa dhèu se asa ka hino pa'oo-parodha, aku rèngu na, pamadhe ne! paku ne mi aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: and pilate, wishing to content the multitude, released unto them barabbas, and delivered jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
target_text: lula gubernur neo pakarej'e d'ara dhèu ae sèra, ka na patabuli barabas madhutu dad'èi rèngu. ka na paredha dhèu j'aga sèra lasi kalabhe yesus pake gui. game rare ne, hèia sordad'u sèra rèti ka yesus lasi neo paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: and the soldiers led him away within the court, which is the prætorium; and they call together the whole band.
target_text: èle èèna ka, sordad'u sèra ère rèti yesus asa era dhu taleo èci ètu madha èmu gubernur. ka ra paroa anga sordad'u dhu leo sèra ca batalion, ho pakaboko.

source_text: and they clothe him with purple, and platting a crown of thorns, they put it on him;
target_text: ra papake yesus kodho madhera aae èci, dhu mea oe sèmi mangèru sa, sama sèmi mèdha-papake dhèu aae-dhèu aae. ka rare loro aj'u dhu padhudhu, ho ènyu solo. hèia ra ènyi solo padhudhu èèna mi kètu yesus. ka ra tao ne, sèmi dhèu aae dhu ded'e hiu, dhu pake solo dhèu aae.

source_text: and they began to salute him, hail, king of the jews!
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sangaja pakab'ua yesus. ra peka, aku rèngu na, ama dhèu aae yahudi dhu hua iia!

source_text: and they smote his head with a reed, and spat upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
target_text: aa ra sangaja pacud'u kètu ho pakab'ua yesus. ka ra sabhuu ilu pèri-pèri hari mi rèhu yesus. sèmi èèna kahèi, ra d'eu kètu yesus dènge gui pahari-pahari.

source_text: and when they had mocked him, they took off from him the purple, and put on him his garments. and they lead him out to crucify him.
target_text: ropa ra tao rare sèmi èèna, ka ra bhoke eele kodho madhera nèti ua na. ka ra papake hari mèdha-papake na. èle ka, rèti yesus asa li'u yerusalem, ho neo paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha d'ai madhe.

source_text: and they compel one passing by, simon of cyrene, coming from the country, the father of alexander and rufus, to go with them, that he might bear his cross.
target_text: ropa rèngu kalua nèti yerusalem, d'ai talora j'ara paraga dènge dhèu kota kirene èci. ngara na simon, ama nèti aleksander dènge rufus. ropa na neo maso asa yerusalem, sordad'u sèra pakaseti ne pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus.

source_text: and they bring him unto the place golgotha, which is, being interpreted, the place of a skull.
target_text: ère rèti yesus asa era èci, ngara na golgota. sasoa na, ‘era rui kètu'.

source_text: and they offered him wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, ra neo hia yesus ninu èi hua anggor manyilu dhu pab'ali dènge èi na'i, sèna ka na taha rarii nèti nu'a-nu'a ètu ngi'u na sèra. te ngaa yesus no'o boe ninu.

source_text: and they crucify him, and part his garments among them, casting lots upon them, what each should take. and it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
target_text: hèia ra paku kacui-aai dènge haga yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. paku rare ka, ra patitu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna, ele boe d'ara hake ceo mad'ae sa. èle èèna ka, sordad'u sèra ère lot, ho re'a cee ka dhu abhu mèdha-papake yesus.

source_text: and the superscription of his accusation was written over, the king of the jews.
target_text: ka ra suri ètu papa èci dhu ra paku re dedha kètu yesus, peka na, ne'e ne, dhèu aae yahudi rèngu pake alasan èèna ka, ho huku pamadhe yesus.

source_text: and with him they crucify two robbers; one on his right hand, and one on his left.
target_text: ètu èèna, ra paku parapo dhèu dua kahèi pa'èci dènge yesus. èci re cabèka g'ana, aa èci hari re cabèka kariu yesus.

source_text: and they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, ha! thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu kako re èèna, ladhe rèdhi yesus dhu ra paku ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. ka ra pakareko kètu, aa ra padhai lii pamakae yesus, aku rèngu na, heh! èu ne peka na, èu bisa paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho d'ara tèlu lod'o, èu pakèd'i hari, si?

source_text: save thyself, and come down from the cross.
target_text: èu puru sèku nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna, ho patabuli ngi'u èu! ladhe sèmi èèna, heka ji'i parcaya, na, èu ne, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: in like manner also the chief priests mocking him among themselves with the scribes said, he saved others; himself he cannot save.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, kètu agama yahudi sèra, padhai lii pamakae yesus, aku rèngu na, nèngu ne, patabuli le dhèu leo nèti rupa-rupa j'aj'èra, te ngaa nèngu bisa boe patabuli ngi'u nèngu unu na nèti j'aj'èra ne'e.

source_text: let the christ, the king of israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe. and they that were crucified with him reproached him.
target_text: nèngu peka unu na, nèngu ne ‘kristus', dhu uru èèna ama lamatua moa tèke le. dhèu leo peka na, nèngu ne dhèu aae isra'el. ladhe tare'a sèmi èèna, hud'i laa na puru nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha ne, sèna ka ji'i ngèdhi ne. heka ji'i parcaya ne kèna. dhèu dua dhu ra paku sama-sama dènge yesus sèra, padhai lii pamakae yesus kahèi.

source_text: and when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
target_text: d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, era èèna maroga, toke d'ai hake tèlu loo nihia.

source_text: and at the ninth hour jesus cried with a loud voice, eloi, eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, my god, my god, why hast thou forsaken me?
target_text: d'ai hake tèlu nihia, hèia yesus pa'oo pake lii aram, peka na, eloi! eloi! lema sabaktani? dhu sasoa, peka na, lamatua ja'a! lamatua ja'a! nga tao ka, ama ku tèke eele ja'a sèmi ne'e?

source_text: and some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, behold, he calleth elijah.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu ètu èèna, tadèngi lii pa'oo yesus. ka ra peka, miu nanene ku laa! te na paroa elia, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru èèna.

source_text: and one ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, let be; let us see whether elijah cometh to take him down.
target_text: ka dhèu èci rai la'e nare ula dhasi, ka na cèb'u asa d'ara èi hua anggor manyilu. hèia nare ula èèna, èki ètu suu tatea èci, ka na soro asa panyoro yesus ho na camuci. dhèu èèna peka, èdhi tatae sèku. cee ne'a, tao-tao elia mai, ho papuru ne nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna.

source_text: and jesus uttered a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
target_text: hèia yesus pa'oo hari ca tèka, heka na madhe kèna.

source_text: and the veil of the temple was rent in two from the top to the bottom.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i abhu bèla dhu bhèla aae, ra kadhoe pa'abhe kama luri mola-mèci. ropa yesus ma'ète a'ae, bèla ne mae cèri bagi mi dua, nèti dedha toke d'ai haha.

source_text: and when the centurion, who stood by over against him, saw that he so gave up the ghost, he said, truly this man was the son of god.
target_text: ètu golgota abhu komedhaa sordad'u j'aga dhu titu dètu aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus. ropa ladhe nèdhi mamadhe yesus, na cag'ag'a. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ira ii! mema tare'a! dhèu ne'e ne, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: and there were also women beholding from afar: among whom were both mary magdalene, and mary the mother of james the less and of joses, and salome; who, when he was in galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him; and many other women that came up with him unto jerusalem.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu bhèni dhu madhutu lasi asa era èèna kahèi. ra titu nèti kaj'èu, ladhe rèdhi mamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna. rèngu se ka dhu uru èèna lalau-lalo'o yesus ètu galilea. rèngu sèra, nuka: salome, maria nèti rae magdala, dènge maria èci hari nuka ina yakobis dènge yoses, dènge dhèu bhèni leo hari dhu mai asa yerusalem, sama-sama dènge yesus.

source_text: and when even was now come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath, there came joseph of arimathæa, a councillor of honorable estate, who also himself was looking for the kingdom of god; and he boldly went in unto pilate, and asked for the body of jesus.
target_text: ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia dhèu èci tenge j'ara ho papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. dhèu èèna, ngara na yusuf, nèti kota arimatea. nèngu ne'e kahèi, ca dhèu dhu j'ue lii langu agama yahudi. nèngu dhèu d'ara be'a kahèi. aa nèngu mate nèbhu le paredha ama lamatua mai. lod'o yesus madhe èèna, lèke hari jumat. bèli na, lèke lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi. nèti èèna ka, yusuf neo papuru eele ngi'u aae yesus ètu d'ara lod'o hari jumat èèna. ka na pabani iisi na, la'e paraga dènge gubernur pilatus, manèngi ho papuru ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: and pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
target_text: ropa gubernur tadèngi lii manèngi yusuf ne, na malaa. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, eea! nga tao ka, dhèu ne madhe malai sa mia ne! ja'a ngee, na, dhae madhe mèka! hèia na pua dhèu lasi paroa komedhaa, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, sa mia? yesus madhe le, do dhae?

source_text: and when he learned it of the centurion, he granted the corpse to joseph.
target_text: komedhaa èèna b'ala, peka na, tare'a, ama! na madhe le karèi deo na. ropa gubernur tadèngi nare lii dhaa èèna, hèia na hia yusuf la'e nare ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: and he bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb which had been hewn out of a rock; and he rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
target_text: hèia yusuf la'e hèli bèla madhera dhu kab'ua èci, ka na la'e asa golgota. d'ai nèi, ka na papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. na pahutu ngi'u aae yesus dènge bèla hiu. tèu èèna, ra heka pae rare ro'a èci ètu d'ara hadhu aae. hèia ra nedhe rèti ngi'u aae yesus asa d'ara ro'a èèna. ka ra loli rare hadhu kabela dhu kapai èci, ho ra bèdho paie hèb'a ro'a èèna. èle èèna ka, yusuf si lèpa.

source_text: and mary magdalene and mary the mother of joses beheld where he was laid.
target_text: lod'o èèna, maria nèti rae magdala, dènge maria èci hari, ina yoses, madhutu d'ai era èèna kahèi. dua ra rèdhi era dhu ra padhane yesus, ka ra patadhe paie era èèna.

source_text: and when the sabbath was past, mary magdalene, and mary the mother of james, and salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
target_text: bèli èèna, lèke hari sabtu, nuka lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. ropa lod'o cèna la'e, maria nèti rae magdala, maria dhu leo hari ina yakobis, dènge salome, lasi hèli èi hèu mèngi, sèna ka bèli rèngu bisa lasi pasuti mi ngi'u aae yesus madhutu ad'a dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and very early on the first day of the week, they come to the tomb when the sun was risen.
target_text: ropa hari migu mad'ae aae èèna, tèlu ra lasi asa ro'a yesus.

source_text: and they were saying among themselves, who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the tomb? and looking up, they see that the stone is rolled back: for it was exceeding great.
target_text: ètu talora j'ara, tèlu ra padhue, aku rèngu na, waa! d'ai nèi, na, cee ka dhu bisa loli eele hadhu aae èèna nèti hèb'a ro'a? èdhi tèlu ti bisa boe, lula hadhu èèna kapai bia! te ngaa ropa rèngu d'ai ro'a èèna, rèdhi hadhu èèna dhu hari eele le nèti hèb'a ro'a.

source_text: and entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, arrayed in a white robe; and they were amazed.
target_text: hèia bhèni se maso asa d'ara. rèngu cag'ag'a titu kèna, lula ètu d'ara ro'a èèna, rèdhi ana mone ngèru èci madhèdi ètu sebhe g'ana rèngu, dhu pake mèdha pudhi lao-lao.

source_text: and he saith unto them, be not amazed: ye seek jesus, the nazarene, who hath been crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold, the place where they laid him!
target_text: hèia mone ngèru èèna, peka dènge rèngu, baku madha'u! ja'a ke'a, na, miu mai tenge yesus dhèu nasaret, dhu ra paku pamadhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. na aad'o heka ètu ne'e, lula na mamuri hari le! mai ho ladhe unu mi, te ngi'u yesus aad'o heka ètu era dhu ra paj'unu na.

source_text: but go, tell his disciples and peter, he goeth before you into galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
target_text: de lami ka lai-lai, ho lole dènge petrus si, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le! na la'e uuru le asa galilea. èèna na rèngu paraga dènge yesus ètu nèi, sèmi dhu uru èèna na peka mema le dènge rèngu. de lami ka!

source_text: and they went out, and fled from the tomb; for trembling and astonishment had come upon them: and they said nothing to any one; for they were afraid.
target_text: ropa bhèni se rèdhi heka ngi'u yesus ètu era dhu ra paj'unu na, rèngu cag'ag'a. ka rai asa li'u lasi. hèia rèngu lèpa dènge ka, ra peka boe dènge dhèu èci sa ètu j'ara, lula rèngu madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: now when he was risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to mary magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
target_text: hari migu mad'ae aae era, yesus pad'elo uuru ngi'u na mi maria nèti magdala, dhu uru èèna, yesus babège eele nidhu pidhu nèti nèngu.

source_text: she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
target_text: ropa na nèdhi nare yesus, hèia la'e dènge ka, peka dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu uru èèna madhutu yesus. dhèu sèra pakaboko taruu ètu era èci. rèngu ètu d'ara susa era, taga ra ngee mamadhe yesus.

source_text: and they, when they heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, disbelieved.
target_text: ka maria peka dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu susa era? susa ia ka, te yesus mamuri hari le! deo na, ja'a heka paraga dènge ne kèna! te ngaa rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhaa, aku rèngu na, èu ne, monya! ji'i lèka boe.

source_text: and after these things he was manifested in another form unto two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu madhutu yesus dhèu dua lasi asa rae èci. ropa d'ai talora j'ara, yesus pad'elo ngi'u dènge si. te ngaa nèngu ub'a le. nèbhu boe, heka ra tadhe ne.

source_text: and they went away and told it unto the rest: neither believed they them.
target_text: hèia dua ra lèpa hari, lasi peka dènge angalai ra sèra, aku rèngu na, wee! miu nanene ku laa! lai-lai deo na, ji'i paraga le dènge yesus ètu j'ara! te ngaa angalai ra aa'i-aa'i dhaa, aku rèngu na, eeh! miu baku monya sèmi èèna!

source_text: and afterward he was manifested unto the eleven themselves as they sat at meat; and he upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them that had seen him after he was risen.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paraga dènge ana madhutu na sèra, dhèu canguru èci, ropa ra madhèdi ra'a-rinu. ka na jèke si, aku nèngu na, wee! miu kètu hadhu pa'ae sa mia ne! dhèu peka le dènge miu, rèngu rèdhi le ja'a dènge musi madha rèngu, te ngaa miu parcaya boe! aku miu na, dhèu sèra monya! de ne'e ne, ja'a unu ku mai. mema tare'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa ja'a mamuri hari le! de mèdhi le, sina ma!

source_text: and he said unto them, go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to the whole creation.
target_text: de lami ka asa mia-mia palème rai-haha ne. peka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra lii lolo be'a ja'a ne.

source_text: he that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that disbelieveth shall be condemned.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu parcaya ja'a aa abhu sarani, èèna na ama lamatua hia ne mamuri sèna ka na bisa pea taruu dènge ne ètu sorga. te ngaa cee dhu parcaya boe ja'a, èèna na nèngu abhu huku nèti lamatua, ka lamatua core eele ne asa li'u la'e, ho na pea taruu ètu nèi.

source_text: and these signs shall accompany them that believe: in my name shall they cast out demons; they shall speak with new tongues;
target_text: aa dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a sèra, rèngu tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra re'a, peka na, koasa ra mema mai nèti ama lamatua! conto sèmi, èèna na rèngu bisa babège eele nidhu pake kolongara ja'a. ladhe èèna na, ama lamatua hia si padhai lii pake lii leo dhu rèngu mesa ra dhane rare boe.

source_text: they shall take up serpents, and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall in no wise hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
target_text: ladhe rèngu kèpe mege dhu dènge raco, do, rinu lèke raco, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. ladhe ra tao kacui-aai asa dhèu pèd'a, dhèu èèna èle nèti papèd'a-tarègu na.

source_text: so then the lord jesus, after he had spoken unto them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of god.
target_text: ropa padhai lii èle dènge ana madhutu na sèra, hèia ama lamatua paca'e yesus asa sorga. ètu nèi, nèngu j'aj'i ai g'ana ama na, ka rèd'u paredha sama-sama.

source_text: and they went forth, and preached everywhere, the lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. amen.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia ana madhutu na sèra madhutu paredha na. rèngu lasi asa mia-mia, ho lole mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i lii lolo be'a yesus. hèia ama lamatua hia si koasa ho ra tao tadha-tadha malaa dhu yesus peka le dènge rèngu. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae parcaya yesus, taga rèngu re'a le lii lolo be'a èèna, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: forasmuch as many have taken in hand to draw up a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us, even as they delivered them unto us, who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and ministers of the word, it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent theophilus;
target_text: ama teofilus dhu ja'a pakab'ua. lii maho'o nèti ja'a. dhèu ae dhu suri sèku le lii lolo nèti mamuri dènge sasab'a-la'a yesus dhu j'aj'i ètu talora aae ji'i. rèngu suri lii lolo sèra pake lii lolo dhu parai reo nèti ji'i asa ji'i karèi nèti uru ka, dhu ji'i nge'a nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu dètu dènge lamatua yesus, aa nèti dhèu leo dhu ladhe rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. lii lolo se'e, lèke mola-mola dènge mamoa ama lamatua karèi nèti uru kèna. de ja'a parisa kore le toke lutu dènge be'a, j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, mulai nèti j'aj'aj'i ra. hèia ja'a pama'ète ho sèna ka suri si paie-iie ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e karèi nèti j'aj'aj'i ra. dènge j'ara ne, ama bisa me'a mèu ngaa dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: that thou mightest know the certainty concerning the things wherein thou wast instructed.
target_text: aa ama bisa parcaya ngaa dhu dhèu lole sèra, lii dhu monya boe. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i tare'a!

source_text: there was in the days of herod, king of judæa, a certain priest named zacharias, of the course of abijah: and he had a wife of the daughters of aaron, and her name was elisabeth.
