target_text: j'aj'aj'i lii lolo ne sèmi ne'e: lod'o dhèu aae herodes nèd'u paredha ètu propensi yudea, abhu ca dhèu, dhu ngara na sakaria. nèngu ne, ca dhèu ama agama yahudi. aa nèngu kahèi, ca dhèu nèti kaboko ama agama abia. dhèu èmu sakaria, ngara na elisabet, ca dhèu ana-èpu nèti ama agama kahèi. te elisabet ne, ana-èpu nèti harun, a'a musa.

source_text: and they were both righteous before god, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the lord blameless.
target_text: dua ra mamuri mola madhutu paredha dènge atora aa'i-aa'i nèti ama lamatua. aa dhèu pakab'ua si kahèi.

source_text: and they had no child, because that elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
target_text: dua ra dhu heka le, te ngaa dhu abhu boe kolo, te era ana nèti elisabet dhu bèdho mèno.

source_text: now it came to pass, while he executed the priest's office before god in the order of his course,
target_text: ca tèka, sakaria dènge dhèu d'ara kaboko abia lèke lod'o rèngu sab'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ètu kota yerusalem.

source_text: according to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the lord and burn incense.
target_text: madhutu atora ama agama, hud'i ère lot, ho re'a cee ka dhu maso asa kama mola-mèci dhu ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu era èèna, dhèu ne hud'i pasèbu ai pake aj'u hèu mèngi ètu madha ama lamatua. lod'o èèna, sakaria lèke lot.

source_text: and the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the hour of incense.
target_text: hèia la'e dènge ka asa d'ara. nèngu dhu talora pasèbu ai ètu d'ara kama èèna, dhèu ae-ae dhu sabaj'a ètu madha èmu.

source_text: and there appeared unto him an angel of the lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ca dhèu nèti sorga titu re bèka g'ana era tunu aj'u hèu mèngi ne.

source_text: and zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi, sakaria madha'u titu kèna, ka ne'a heka tao sèmi ngaa.

source_text: but the angel said unto him, fear not, zacharias: because thy supplication is heard, and thy wife elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name john.
target_text: te ngaa ana pajuu ne lii, aku nèngu na, sakaria! baku madha'u! te ama lamatua tadèngi le lii manèngi-mangaj'i èu. de bèli-camèd'a, dhèu èmu èu nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. èu hud'i pangare ne, yohanis.

source_text: and thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
target_text: èèna na dhèu ae karej'e kahèi sama-sama dènge miu, lula miu abhu ana. bèli-camèd'a, ana ne pakarej'e d'ara èu.

source_text: for he shall be great in the sight of the lord, and he shall drink no wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the holy spirit, even from his mother's womb.
target_text: koasa nèti roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, bera-bera dènge ne, karèi nèti ina na kad'o nèngu era. nèngu ne hud'i luri ninu dhua ara-dhua pèd'u. ropa na kapai, ama lamatua pake ne j'aj'i dhèu dhu dènge kolongara.

source_text: and many of the children of israel shall he turn unto the lord their god.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a èèna pamako nare dhèu isra'el ae-ae, ho ra lèpa hari asa ama lamatua rèngu.

source_text: and he shall go before his face in the spirit and power of elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to walk in the wisdom of the just; to make ready for the lord a people prepared for him.
target_text: tatao dènge koasa na nuka sèmi elia, ca dhèu dhu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua karèi uru. nèngu ne mai uuru nèti lamatua èdhi. nèngu ne bisa kabèli d'ara ina-ama, ho sue hari ana-ana ra. aa dhèu dhu rai nèti madha lamatua, na ad'u si ho ra lèpa hari madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèti sèmi èèna, nèngu tao dhèu sèna ka sadia d'ara ra sèmi mamai lamatua.

source_text: and zacharias said unto the angel, whereby shall i know this? for i am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
target_text: te ngaa sakaria karèi ana pajuu ne, aku nèngu na, bisa boe, sina ma? ! ja'a dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, d'ara heka sèmi ne'e ne! tasamia ja'a bisa ke'a, na, j'ara se bisa j'aj'i?

source_text: and the angel answering said unto him, i am gabriel, that stand in the presence of god; and i was sent to speak unto thee, and to bring thee these good tidings.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ne dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! ja'a ne gabriel, dhèu pajuu ama lamatua. nèngu ka paleha ja'a mai, sèna ka peka dènge èu lii lolo dhu be'a ne.

source_text: and behold, thou shalt be silent and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall come to pass, because thou believedst not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
target_text: te ngaa èu mo'o boe lèka lii padhai ja'a ne. de tadha dhu èu manèngi, sèmi ne'e! he'o èu èèna na sakaa, ho èu bisa heka padhai lii, nèti deo ne'e ne, toke miu abhu ana. pe èu mèdhi unu mu. te ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne, bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i, lèke dènge lod'o na.

source_text: and the people were waiting for zacharias, and they marvelled while he tarried in the temple.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu sabaj'a ètu li'u sèra, bingu titu kèna, lula sakaria tao bhodho boe.

source_text: and when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: and he continued making signs unto them, and remained dumb.
target_text: ropa na kalua mai, nèngu bisa heka padhai lii. ka na hia tadha re kacui-aai na, heka dhèu se'e re'a, na, lamatua hia tanila ropa nèngu ètu d'ara kama mola-mèci èèna.

source_text: and it came to pass, when the days of his ministration were fulfilled, he departed unto his house.
target_text: ropa èle sasab'a ra, hèia sakaria lèpa asa èmu na.

source_text: and after these days elisabeth his wife conceived; and she hid herself five months, saying, thus hath the lord done unto me in the days wherein he looked upon me, to take away my reproach among men.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka elisabet dènge babia. ka na pea dhoka ètu d'ara èmu toke lèmi hèru. na peka, aku nèngu na, koa-kio lamatua! lod'o d'ai kèna, lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. ladhe ja'a ne dènge ka kolo, dhèu pamakae heka ja'a.

source_text: now in the sixth month the angel gabriel was sent from god unto a city of galilee, named nazareth,
target_text: ropa elisabet dènge babia d'ai èna hèru, hèia ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na nèti sorga, la'e asa rae cue ètu propensi galilea, ngara na nasaret. ngara ana pajuu ne, gabriel.

source_text: to a virgin betrothed to a man whose name was joseph, of the house of david; and the virgin's name was mary.
target_text: ètu nasaret, abhu ana bhèni ngèru ca dhèu, ngara na maria. nèngu ne dhèu dhu lii d'ai le, ngara na yusuf. yusuf ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. gabriel la'e paraga dènge maria.

source_text: and he came in unto her, and said, hail, thou that art highly favored, the lord is with thee.
target_text: ka na pad'elo iisi na mi ana bhèni ne, hèia na lii, peka na, salama, maria, ee! ama lamatua dhu hag'e nare le èu, ho neo ad'u j'ara hua iia èci hia èu. aa nèngu bera-bera dènge èu kahèi.

source_text: but she was greatly troubled at the saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this might be.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka maria bingu, lula ne'a boe sasoa nèti lii padhai ana pajuu ne.

source_text: and the angel said unto her, fear not, mary: for thou hast found favor with god.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ne tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, maria! baku madha'u. te ama lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èu.

source_text: and behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name jesus.
target_text: nèbhu heka, èu dènge babia, ho èèna na, èu mora iisi ana mone ca dhèu. èu hud'i pangare ne, yesus.

source_text: he shall be great, and shall be called the son of the most high: and the lord god shall give unto him the throne of his father david:
target_text: nèngu ne, bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i dhèu kapai. èèna na lamatua pangare ne, ‘nèngu ne, ana d'èlu ja'a. ' nuka, ana nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. pe ama lamatua ded'e ne, sèna ka nèd'u paredha, nuka sèmi baki na, dhèu aae daud.

source_text: and he shall reign over the house of jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
target_text: nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha taa-taa mi dhèu isra'el. te paredha na dhu dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: and mary said unto the angel, how shall this be, seeing i know not a man?
target_text: te ngaa maria karèi gabriel, peka na, ja'a ne j'unu kèdhi mèka dènge dhèu mone èci sa! tasa mera mia ka ja'a dènge babia?

source_text: and the angel answered and said unto her, the holy spirit shall come upon thee, and the power of the most high shall overshadow thee: wherefore also the holy thing which is begotten shall be called the son of god.
target_text: hèia gabriel dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci puru mai asa èu. aa koasa nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele, èèna na mai sarimu nare èu. dènge j'ara ne'e, ana dhu bèli-camèd'a èu more iisi èèna, tare'a-re'a mola-mèci, lula nèngu èèna, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: and behold, elisabeth thy kinswoman, she also hath conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her that was called barren.
target_text: baku malaa! te a'ari èu ca dhèu, ngara na elisabet, dènge le babia kahèi. dhèu peka na, nèngu èèna bisa heka nara iisi, lula nèngu dhu heka le. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu dènge babia èna hèru kèna.

source_text: for no word from god shall be void of power.
target_text: te bagi ama lamatua, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i!

source_text: and mary said, behold, the handmaid of the lord; be it unto me according to thy word. and the angel departed from her.
target_text: ka maria dhaa, peka na, be'a. ja'a ne ènu ama lamatua. hud'i laa aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i madhutu sèmi lii èu èèna ka. ja'a ke'a dhoka madhutu dad'èi lamatua di. èle ka ana pajuu nèti sorga ne lèpa, tèke eele maria.

source_text: and mary arose in these days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of judah; and entered into the house of zacharias and saluted elisabeth.
target_text: èle pèri-pèri lod'o, hèia maria pakèd'i nèti nasaret, la'e lai-lai asa rae sakaria, ètu ledhe-ledhe propensi yudea. d'ai nèi, la'e dènge ka asa d'ara èmu sakaria. ka na hia lii maho'o mi elisabet.

source_text: and it came to pass, when elisabeth heard the salutation of mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and elisabeth was filled with the holy spirit;
target_text: ropa elisabet tadèngi lii maho'o nèti maria, hèia ana ètu d'ara kabake elisabet pasèja. aa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, maso sa elisabet.

source_text: and she lifted up her voice with a loud cry, and said, blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
target_text: ka elisabet pa'oo, peka na, maria! bèli-camèd'a dhèu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara èu, risi nèti dhèu bhèni aa'i-aa'i ra ètu rai-haha ne! èèna na dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra j'oke padedha-dedha kahèi ana dhu èu kad'o èèna.

source_text: and whence is this to me, that the mother of my lord should come unto me?
target_text: ra pakab'ua ja'a kahèi, lula ina nèti lamatua ja'a mai pangad'o dènge ja'a.

source_text: for behold, when the voice of thy salutation came into mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
target_text: ropa èu mèti lii maho'o mi dedha ja'a, cag'ag'a laa ana dhu ja'a kad'o ne pasèja ètu d'ara kabake ja'a, lula karae.

source_text: and blessed is she that believed; for there shall be a fulfilment of the things which have been spoken to her from the lord.
target_text: ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi èu, lula èu ne parcaya, peka na, nèngu tao madhutu lii dhu na moa tèke.

source_text: and mary said, my soul doth magnify the lord,
target_text: maria bhoka hèb'a, peka na, nèti d'ara iiki ja'a, ja'a ded'e padedha-dedha lamatua!

source_text: and my spirit hath rejoiced in god my saviour.
target_text: d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae, lula ama lamatua hia ja'a mamuri!

source_text: for he hath looked upon the low estate of his handmaid: for behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
target_text: nèngu ne tao le madha-dhilu mi ja'a, nuka ana pua-paleha na dhu dènge boe kab'ua ne. karèi nèti deo ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ngee na, ja'a ne, bhèni dhu kalua mèngi titu kèna,

source_text: for he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
target_text: lula lamatua tao j'ara malaa mi dedha ja'a. nèngu ne, dhu koasa dedha risi aa dhu mola-mèci risi.

source_text: and his mercy is unto generations and generations on them that fear him.
target_text: ama lamatua loe boe pad'elo sasue na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakab'ua aa dhu pahaha iisi ra mi nèngu, nèti lai ana-lai èpu.

source_text: he hath showed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their heart.
target_text: na pake koasa na, sèna ka tao pakaco dhèu-dhèu dhu padedha iisi sèra.

source_text: he hath put down princes from their thrones, and hath exalted them of low degree.
target_text: na pamanahu dhèu aae-dhèu kapai dhu rèd'u koasa, lula ra padedha iisi. te ngaa na j'oka padedha-dedha dhèu-dhèu dhu pahaha iisi.

source_text: the hungry he hath filled with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
target_text: na panga'a dhèu dhu manganga toke bècu, te ngaa na babège-lalèta dhèu-dhèu kaja ho lasi dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: he hath given help to israel his servant, that he might remember mercy
target_text: na soru-bara dhèu isra'el na, dènge loe boe pad'elo sasue na mi rèngu.

source_text: as he spake unto our fathers toward abraham and his seed for ever.
target_text: uru èèna, na pa'èki tèke le lii pajaji dènge bèi-baki èdhi, nuka baki abraham dènge ana-èpu na aa'i-aa'i ra. d'ai sange ne'e, lii pajaji èèna pa'èki mèno.

source_text: and mary abode with her about three months, and returned unto her house.
target_text: hèia maria pea dènge elisabet toke tèlu hèru, heka lèpa asa èmu na ètu nasaret.

source_text: now elisabeth's time was fulfilled that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
target_text: ropa d'ai hèru, ka elisabet nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and her neighbors and her kinsfolk heard that the lord had magnified his mercy towards her; and they rejoiced with her.
target_text: lii ne'e, ra palolo d'ai a'ari na dènge rae lesa, aku rèngu na, ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na, ka na hia elisabet ana mone ca dhèu. hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e kahèi.

source_text: and it came to pass on the eighth day, that they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him zacharias, after the name of his father.
target_text: lod'o ana ne d'ai aru lod'o, ka ra suna ne, madhutu atora dhèu yahudi. ra neo pangare ana ne, sakaria, madhutu ngara ama na.

source_text: and his mother answered and said, not so; but he shall be called john.
target_text: te ngaa ina na b'ala ra, aku nèngu na, aad'o sèmi èèna! ngara na hud'i yohanis ku!

source_text: and they said unto her, there is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
target_text: te ngaa ra b'ala ne, nga tao ka pili ngara yohanis? nèti a'ari miu, ca dhèu sa dhu ngara dhae, sèmi mèka èèna!

source_text: and they made signs to his father, what he would have him called.
target_text: ka ra senen ho karèi sakaria, sèna ka neo pangare ana ne ngara na ngaa.

source_text: and he asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, saying, his name is john. and they marvelled all.
target_text: hèia sakaria senen ho manèngi lei. ra hia ne lei, ka na suri peka na, ngara na yohanis! ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i malaa titu kèna.

source_text: and his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, blessing god.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, he'o na dhu sakaa mèno èèna, mako dènge ka. ka na koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of judæa.
target_text: hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pea padètu ètu sèra sa, madha'u dènge malaa. ka lii ne'e mulai ra palolo nèti hèb'a sa hèb'a, toke dhèu-dhèu ètu ledhe-ledhe ètu propensi yudea re'a aa'i kahèi.

source_text: and all that heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, what then shall this child be? for the hand of the lord was with him.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo èèna, ra pangee, peka na, tatu koasa nèti lamatua bera-bera dènge ana ne. bèli-camèd'a, ladhe na kapai mai, na j'aj'i dhèu sèmi mia, oo?

source_text: and his father zacharias was filled with the holy spirit, and prophesied, saying,
target_text: èle ka, roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci maso asa sakaria. ka na padhai lii, peka na,

source_text: blessed be the lord, the god of israel; for he hath visited and wrought redemption for his people,
target_text: koa-kio ama lamatua dhèu isra'el! te na mai le ho sui nare dhèu unu na, sèna ka rèngu baku j'aj'i sèmi ènu sa.

source_text: and hath raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant david
target_text: lamatua ded'e le ca dhèu dhu koasa na kapai titu kèna, ho hia èdhi mamuri. nèngu ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud.

source_text: as he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets that have been from of old,
target_text: lamatua moa mema, karèi nèti uru ka, re dhèu dhu maj'èni rèti lii padhai na.

source_text: salvation from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
target_text: limuri ne na neo patabuli èdhi nèti musu-musu èdhi, aa nèti dhèu dhu d'ara pèd'a dènge èdhi.

source_text: to show mercy towards our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant; the oath which he sware unto abraham our father,
target_text: na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi bèi-baki èdhi, lula na sanèd'e taruu lii pajaji na mi rèngu, dhu na pa'èki dènge baki abraham.

source_text: to grant unto us that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies should serve him without fear,
target_text: na patabuli le èdhi nèti musu-musu èdhi, sèna ka ta pahaha iisi mi nèngu, dhu dènge heka d'ara madha'u.

source_text: in holiness and righteousness before him all our days.
target_text: na patalale le èdhi, sèna ka èdhi bisa mamuri mola-mèci dènge be'a taa-taa, ètu katanga madha na.

source_text: yea and thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the most high: for thou shalt go before the face of the lord to make ready his ways;
target_text: yohanis, ee! èu ne, ana ja'a. bèli-camèd'a dhèu tadhe èu, na, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu dedha risi aa'i. èèna na, lamu peka-padhai dènge dhèu, sèna ka ra pakabhèle kacui-aai ra ho soru mamai lamatua.

source_text: to give knowledge of salvation unto his people in the remission of their sins,
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, lamu paj'uj'u j'ara hia mi dhèu unu lamatua, sèna ka re'a, na, ama lamatua hia mamuri mi rèngu, lula nèngu ka dhu saku eele sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: because of the tender mercy of our god, whereby the dayspring from on high shall visit us, to shine upon them that sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.
target_text: lula d'ara lamatua taleo aa rasa kasia mi dedha èdhi, nèti èèna ka, na hia èdhi taa-tebho dhu hiu, nuka sèmi lod'o hiu nèti saraa dhu hiu. èdhi dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, aa èdhi dhu pea dènge d'ara madha'u ètu sanabhu mamadhe, lula pabe'a mèka dènge lamatua, bèli-camèd'a abhu saraa ho lere èdhi asa j'ara dhu nèti mera-milu.

source_text: and the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his showing unto israel.
target_text: ka yohanis asa kapai noo-noo. aa roh lamatua pa'èra ne. na kapai mai, hèia la'e pea ka ètu d'ara mamoo, toke d'ai lod'o na pakako sasab'a mi dhèu isra'el sèra.

source_text: now it came to pass in those days, there went out a decree from cæsar augustus, that all the world should be enrolled. this was the first enrolment made when quirinius was governor of syria.
target_text: ca tèka, ètu d'ara kirenius j'aj'i gubernur ètu siria, dhèu aae kapai agustus, hia paredha, dhu peka na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu paredha roma, hud'i lèpa asa rae èta-èsu ra ho madhutu sensus! èèna heka hiu-lai kèna, dhèu paredha roma ige ana kabarai na.

source_text: and all went to enrol themselves, every one to his own city.
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i lèpa asa rai èta-èsu ra, sèna ka madhutu sensus.

source_text: and joseph also went up from galilee, out of the city of nazareth, into judæa, to the city of david, which is called bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of david; to enrol himself with mary, who was betrothed to him, being great with child.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf pea ètu rae nasaret, ètu propensi galilea. nèngu dhu lii d'ai ana bhèni ca dhèu, ngara na maria, dhu dènge le babia. yusuf ne, ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud. ka nèngu hud'i lèpa ku asa kota daud, nuka betlehem ètu propensi yudea, sèna ka madhutu sensus. nèti èèna ka, dua ra lasi asa kota betlehem.

source_text: and it came to pass, while they were there, the days were fulfilled that she should be delivered.
target_text: ropa dua ra ètu nèi, maria d'ai lod'o nara iisi.

source_text: and she brought forth her firstborn son; and she wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.
target_text: te ngaa ètu èèna, dua ra abhu boe kama ètu d'ara losmen. nèti èèna ka, dua ra maso lasi asa d'ara oka badha. hèia maria nara iisi ana uuru, mone ca dhèu. ka pasig'i ne dènge kaha'i bèla, aa paj'unu ètu d'ara karab'a, era badha ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and there were shepherds in the same country abiding in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.
target_text: mèda èèna, abhu ana madhenga badha dhèu pèri-pèri dhu beke madhenge kahib'i-kalèbho ètu d'ara pad'a ètu li'u kota.

source_text: and an angel of the lord stood by them, and the glory of the lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
target_text: kaca'a laa, rèngu rèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga. hèia saraa lamatua rai-reo nare rèngu, ka ra madha'u bia.

source_text: and the angel said unto them, be not afraid; for behold, i bring you good tidings of great joy which shall be to all the people:
target_text: te ngaa ana pajuu ne peka, baku madha'u! nanene pabe'a-be'a! te ja'a ne mai ho peka lii lolo be'a èci hia miu. cee dhu tadèngi lii ne'e, tatu rèngu karej'e.

source_text: for there is born to you this day in the city of david a saviour, who is christ the lord.
target_text: lii lolo be'a ne, sèmi ne'e ka: deo ne'e, ca dhèu ina nara iisi le kristus ètu betlehem, nuka kota dhèu aae daud. kristus ne'e ka dhu ama lamatua pajaji tèke le karèi nèti uru ka. lamatua hia na mai, sèna ka na patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. nèngu ne'e, èèna na dhèu paroa na, ‘lamatua'!

source_text: and this is the sign unto you: ye shall find a babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, and lying in a manger.
target_text: pe miu tadhe ne sèmi ne'e ka: miu paraga dènge ana rara iisi hiu ca dhèu dhu pahutu dènge sig'i. ra paj'unu ne ètu d'ara karab'a.

source_text: and suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising god, and saying,
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare, hèia cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ae-ae mai nèti sorga. ka ra pa'èci dènge ne. hèia ra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua dènge lii sod'a, peka na,

source_text: glory to god in the highest, and on earth peace among men in whom he is well pleased.
target_text: ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua! nèngu dhu nèd'u paredha ètu dedha-liru dhu dedha risi. ama lamatua neo hia dame dènge mera-milu mi dhèu rai-haha, dhu pakarej'e d'ara na!

source_text: and it came to pass, when the angels went away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, let us now go even unto bethlehem, and see this thing that is come to pass, which the lord hath made known unto us.
target_text: èle ka, ana pajuu se lèpa hari asa sorga. hèia ana madhenga badha se padhai lii, peka na, mai lati ku asa betlehem, ho ladhe ku ana nèi! te lamatua pa'adhu le lii ne hia èdhi.

source_text: and they came with haste, and found both mary and joseph, and the babe lying in the manger.
target_text: hèia lasi ka lai-lai asa betlehem. ka rèngu paraga maria dènge yusuf. aa ladhe rèdhi kahèi ana dhu heka rara iisi, dhu bhèj'i ètu d'ara karab'a.

source_text: and when they saw it, they made known concerning the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
target_text: ropa rèngu rèdhi ana ne, hèia ra lolo, peka na, deo na ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu peka le dènge ji'i, lula-nèti ana ne'e ne! ka ra lolo aa'i-aa'i toke èle.

source_text: and all that heard it wondered at the things which were spoken unto them by the shepherds.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i malaa-maloha, tadèngi lii lolo ana madhenga badha se.

source_text: but mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
target_text: te ngaa maria tèke ka ètu d'ara na, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le. aa na pangee mau-mau, ho neo ne'a sasoa na tasa mera mia.

source_text: and the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising god for all the things that they had heard and seen, even as it was spoken unto them.
target_text: èle ka, ana madhenga badha se lèpa hari asa era kahib'i-kalèbho ra. hèia ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua. ra manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula dhu rèngu tadèngi aa rèdhi dènge musi madha ra, lèke tare'a-re'a sèmi ngaa dhu ana pajuu ama lamatua peka sèra.

source_text: and when eight days were fulfilled for circumcising him, his name was called jesus, which was so called by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
target_text: ropa ana iiki ne d'ai aru lod'o, ka ra suna ne madhutu atora musa. hèia ama dènge ina na pangare ne, ‘yesus'. ngara ne, ngara dhu ana pajuu nèti sorga peka le dènge rèngu, lod'o ina na dènge mèka babia.

source_text: and when the days of their purification according to the law of moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to jerusalem, to present him to the lord
target_text: atora èci nèti baki musa peka na, bhèni dhu rara iisi rare, d'ai èpa nguru lod'o hud'i madhutu ku ad'a, pamèu iisi ra ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa maso sèmi biasa asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a. nèti èèna ka, yusuf dènge maria lasi asa kota yerusalem, sèna ka tao madhutu ad'a. lasi rèti dènge ana iiki èèna asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho saraka ne, sèna ka j'aj'i unu lamatua.

source_text: as it is written in the law of the lord, every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the lord,
target_text: rèngu madhutu atora lamatua dhu peka na, bhèni dhu nara iisi ana mone uuru, nèngu hud'i saraka ana ne j'aj'i unu lamatua.

source_text: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the lord, a pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
target_text: madhutu atora lamatua, ladhe saraka ana èèna mi lamatua, ina-ama hud'i hia ku koro iia ca pasa, do koro j'aha ngèru dua ngi'u. nèti èèna ka, yusuf dènge maria tao madhutu atora èèna.

source_text: and behold, there was a man in jerusalem, whose name was simeon; and this man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of israel: and the holy spirit was upon him. and it had been revealed unto him by the holy spirit, that he should not see death, before he had seen the lord's christ.
target_text: taa èèna, abhu mone heka ca dhèu ngara na simeon, dhu pea ètu kota yerusalem. nèngu ne dhèu d'ara mola, aa d'èi lamatua. roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka le dènge ne, na, nèngu hud'i nèdhi ku kristus, heka na madhe kèna. kristus èèna ka, dhu bèli-camèd'a hia mamuri mi dhèu isra'el.

source_text: and he came in the spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child jesus, that they might do concerning him after the custom of the law,
target_text: lod'o èèna, roh lamatua lere simeon la'e asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. lod'o èèna kahèi, ina-ama yesus rèti ne, ho saraka j'aj'i unu lamatua.

source_text: then he received him into his arms, and blessed god, and said,
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi ana ne, ka simeon sa'u nare ne, hèia na koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua, aku nèngu na,

source_text: now lettest thou thy servant depart, lord, according to thy word, in peace;
target_text: koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lamatua tao le madhutu lii pajaji na mi dedha ja'a. de ne'e ne lamatua bisa le patabuli ja'a, sèna ka ja'a madhe dènge mera-milu,

source_text: for mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
target_text: te ja'a kèdhi le dhèu dhu lamatua pua mai, ho patabuli ji'i nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ji'i!

source_text: which thou hast prepared before the face of all peoples;
target_text: lamatua neo pake ana ne'e, sèna ka hia mamuri mi suku aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: a light for revelation to the gentiles, and the glory of thy people israel.
target_text: nèngu nuka sèmi saraa, dhu pakab'ua suku-suku isra'el, dhèu lamatua sèra. nèngu kahèi èci èèna ka dènge saraa, dhu pad'elo j'ara lamatua, pala mi suku-suku leo kahèi.

source_text: and his father and his mother were marvelling at the things which were spoken concerning him;
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia yusuf dènge maria malaa lula lii padhai dhu simeon peka lula-nèti ana rèngu ne.

source_text: and simeon blessed them, and said unto mary his mother, behold, this child is set for the falling and the rising of many in israel; and for a sign which is spoken against;
target_text: èle ka simeon padhai lii hia si mèngi-nale. hèia na peka dènge maria, aku nèngu na, ina yesus! bèli-camèd'a dhèu ae ètu isra'el tule eele ana èu ne. te ngaa tatao rèngu mi dedha nèngu ne, èèna na pamanahu hari rèngu. ana ne'e, bèli-camèd'a pakarej'e d'ara dhèu ae kahèi.

source_text: yea and a sword shall pierce through thine own soul; that thoughts out of many hearts may be revealed.
target_text: dènge j'ara èèna, lamatua bhoke patalele d'ara dhèu. te ngaa èu, maria, pe mu paraga dènge j'aj'èra ae-ae, nuka sèmi samala dhu lose adhe-usu èu.

source_text: and there was one anna, a prophetess, the daughter of phanuel, of the tribe of asher she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity, and she had been a widow even unto fourscore and four years, who departed not from the temple, worshipping with fastings and supplications night and day.
target_text: ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu kahèi bhèni heka ca dhèu, ngara na hana. umur na, aru nguru èpa tèu kèna. ngara ama na fanuel, nèti suku aser. na leo-èmu pidhu tèu, ka dhèu èmu na madhe. hana ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. nèngu loe boe sabaj'a dènge puasa ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua mèda-mèu.

source_text: and coming up at that very hour she gave thanks unto god, and spake of him to all them that were looking for the redemption of jerusalem.
target_text: lod'o simeon padhai lii dènge yusuf dènge maria era, hèia hana mai padètu-dètu. ka nanene si padhai lii, hèia na koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. ka na padhai lii lula-nèti yesus mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tatae mamai dhèu aae dhu lamatua lii dhu moa tèke neo pua mai, sèna ka patabuli dhèu isra'el.

source_text: and when they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the lord, they returned into galilee, to their own city nazareth.
target_text: ropa yusuf dènge maria tao le madhutu atora nèti baki musa ètu kota yerusalem, ka ra lèpa asa rae nasaret, ètu propensi galilea.

source_text: and the child grew, and waxed strong, filled with wisdom: and the grace of god was upon him.
target_text: ka yesus asa kapai, asa èra, asa d'èlu-mèu dènge ne'a madha j'ara ae-ae. aa ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi yesus kahèi.

source_text: and his parents went every year to jerusalem at the feast of the passover.
target_text: yusuf dènge maria dhu tema le, tèu mai-tèu mai lasi asa kota yerusalem ho madhutu kalela paska ètu nèi.

source_text: and when he was twelve years old, they went up after the custom of the feast;
target_text: ca tèka, ropa umur yesus canguru dua tèu, hèia la'e palere dènge ina-ama na asa yerusalem, lasi ra'a kalela paska sèmi biasa.

source_text: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy jesus tarried behind in jerusalem; and his parents knew it not; but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day's journey; and they sought for him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance:
target_text: lod'o èle paska, yusuf dènge maria mulai lèpa lasi asa nasaret palere-lere dènge dhèu ae dhu lèpa asa galilea. te ngaa rèngu re'a boe, na, yesus ètu yerusalem era. ra pangee, na, nèngu palere dènge mone aanga-angalai na. te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o nihia, yusuf dènge maria rèdhi boe ne. ka dua ra mulai patangi-tenge kèna. lasi pakarèi mi a'ari ra, aa mone aanga-angalai ra.

source_text: and when they found him not, they returned to jerusalem, seeking for him.
target_text: lula rage boe ne, hèia dua ra lèpa hari sa yerusalem, lasi tenge ne ètu nèi.

source_text: and it came to pass, after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both hearing them, and asking them questions:
target_text: d'ai nèi, ra patangi-tenge ne toke tèlu lod'o kateme, heka paraga dènge ne kèna, ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. nèngu dhu madhèdi padhue-padhai dènge mese agama yahudi sèra.

source_text: and all that heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu nanene lii dhaa na, malaa-maloha, lula nèngu tare'a-re'a ne'a mèu isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, aa na ne'a dhaa lii karèi dènge mola.

source_text: and when they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said unto him, son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and i sought thee sorrowing.
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna ka, ina-ama na malaa kahèi. hèia ina na lii, aku nèngu na, yesus! nga tao ka èu paj'èra ji'i sèmi ne'e? ama mu dènge ja'a patangi-tenge èu heo d'èlu!

source_text: and he said unto them, how is it that ye sought me? knew ye not that i must be in my father's house?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka ina dènge ama paj'èra iisi tenge ja'a? me'a, si? ja'a dènge urusan ètu èmu ama ku.

source_text: and they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
target_text: te ngaa rèngu re'a rare boe sasoa lii na.

source_text: and he went down with them, and came to nazareth; and he was subject unto them: and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
target_text: hèia aa'i-aa'i ra lèpa asa nasaret. ka yesus madhutu kahèi dad'èi ina dènge ama na. ka ina na tèke aa'i-aa'i se'e ètu d'ara na.

source_text: and jesus advanced in wisdom and stature, and in favor with god and men.
target_text: hèia yesus asa tabha kapai, asa tabha d'èlu-mèu, asa pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, dènge dhèu rai-haha asa tabha d'èi ne.

source_text: now in the fifteenth year of the reign of tiberius cæsar, pontius pilate being governor of judæa, and herod being tetrarch of galilee, and his brother philip tetrarch of the region of ituræa and trachonitis, and lysanias tetrarch of abilene, in the high-priesthood of annas and caiaphas, the word of god came unto john the son of zacharias in the wilderness.
target_text: taa èèna, tiberius j'aj'i dhèu aae kapai dhu nèd'u paredha ètu roma, canguru lèmi tèu kèna. pontius pilatus j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi yudea. herodes j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi galilea. a'a herodes ka pelipus, j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi iturea dènge propensi trakonitis. aa lisanias j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi abilene. taa èèna kahèi hanas dènge kayafas, dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ètu kota yerusalem. lod'o èèna, yohanis, ana sakaria, dhu pea ètu era kaj'èu nèti rae. ètu era ne'e, lamatua pangèd'u ne lii.

source_text: and he came into all the region round about the jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance unto remission of sins;
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yohanis la'e asa d'ara rae dhu dètu dènge loko yarden, ho peka dènge dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, miu hud'i ele-ho'a ku, aa tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala sèra. èle èèna, miu sarani uuru ku, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, miu pabe'a le dènge lamatua.

source_text: as it is written in the book of the words of isaiah the prophet, the voice of one crying in the wilderness, make ye ready the way of the lord, make his paths straight.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, baki yesaya, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua, suri tèke le lula-nèti yohanis ne, peka na, abhu dhèu dhu ètu d'ara mamoo, pa'oo, peka na: ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i pa'èra, sèna ka tao paie-iie j'ara, ho sèmi mamai lamatua! pamola j'ara sèna ka lami soru ne.

source_text: every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall become straight, and the rough ways smooth;
target_text: dhènu pamera era kajèlo aa'i-aa'i. tao pamera-mera ledhe aa'i-aa'i. tao pamola j'ara dhu koe-kalèko, tao pamilu j'ara dhu ako kabhuku.

source_text: and all flesh shall see the salvation of god.
target_text: sèna ka dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ra bisa re'a, na, ama lamatua neo pakaj'èu dhèu nèti sasala-sasigo ra. '

source_text: he said therefore to the multitudes that went out to be baptized of him, ye offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
target_text: dhèu ae mai nèti mia-mia, manèngi ho yohanis sarani si. te ngaa na jèke si, peka na, miu se dhèu kapod'e-kabèli! miu èci èèna ka mege dhu dènge raco! mage miu pangee na miu bisa pakaj'èu nèti hahuku lamatua, sad'i dhoka ele-ho'a di! aad'o! nèbhu heka lamatua huku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tare'a-re'a ele boe ho'a.

source_text: bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, we have abraham to our father: for i say unto you, that god is able of these stones to raise up children unto abraham.
target_text: mage miu pangee na, ‘ja'a ne lèke boe huku, lula ja'a ana-èpu baki abraham. ' abhu ètu mia sèmi èèna? j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham bisa boe tao miu j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci. lamatua bisa tao hadhu se, sèna ka j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham. ja'a peka kèna! pad'elo ètu d'ara mamuri miu, dhu peka na, miu tèke eele le sasala-sasigo miu, aa mai ho madhutu lamatua.

source_text: and even now the axe also lieth at the root of the trees: every tree therefore that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
target_text: miu hud'i tao ku j'ara be'a. ladhe aad'o, na, hahuku lamatua dhu bia, bèbhe mai lèke miu, nuka sèmi dhèu pake kataka ho patue aj'u nèti amo na. nuka sèmi èèna ka! aj'u dènge boe guna, ladhe hua-hela na nèti boe babe'a! de be'a risi patue ne, aa core eele asa d'ara ai la'e.

source_text: and the multitudes asked him, saying, what then must we do?
target_text: hèia dhèu ae karèi yohanis, ladhe sèmi èèna, ji'i se tasamia?

source_text: and he answered and said unto them, he that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath food, let him do likewise.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, ladhe èu dènge kodho dua bèla, hia èci sa dhèu dhu dènge boe kodho. aa ladhe èu dènge nganga'a, bagi hia dhèu dhu dènge boe nganga'a.

source_text: and there came also publicans to be baptized, and they said unto him, teacher, what must we do?
target_text: hèia dhèu roro bea mai manèngi kahèi, sèna ka yohanis sarani si. ka ra karèi, peka na, ama mese! ji'i se hud'i tao sèmi ngaa ku?

source_text: and he said unto them, extort no more than that which is appointed you.
target_text: ka na dhaa, miu se d'èi kapod'e-kabèli. de nèti deo ne'e, miu hud'i sab'a ku dènge mola. baku roro bea risi nèti atora paredha. hud'i laa kabarai b'ae madhutu atora na.

source_text: and soldiers also asked him, saying, and we, what must we do? and he said unto them, extort from no man by violence, neither accuse any one wrongfully; and be content with your wages.
target_text: abhu kahèi sordad'u pèri-pèri ètu sèra. ra karèi, na, ji'i se hud'i tao ku sèmi ngaa? hèia yohanis b'ala, peka na, baku parama doi-dhari dhèu madhutu dad'èi miu. aa baku galaa leli dhèu. ladhe sèmi mere gaji, miu hud'i manèngi makasi mi lamatua, aa rasa d'ai le dènge gaji èèna.

source_text: and as the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning john, whether haply he were the christ;
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, dhèu se mulai pagagai aa paka'uu èci dènge èci, peka na, eeh! tao-tao yohanis ne, kristus, dhu lamatua peka karèi nèti uru ka, neo hia mai èèna!

source_text: john answered, saying unto them all, i indeed baptize you with water; but there cometh he that is mightier than i, the latchet of whose shoes i am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you in the holy spirit and in fire:
target_text: te ngaa yohanis b'ala si, peka na, nanene paie! bèli-camèd'a, dhèu èci mai dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a. masi ka j'aj'i ana pua-paleha na, ja'a ne bisa boe sa hèi. ja'a ne sarani miu dhoka pake èi di, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a na tao risi eele nèti ja'a, te na papènu d'ara miu dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. aa na pamèu d'ara miu nuka sèmi dhèu pake ai ho tunu maruru.

source_text: whose fan is in his hand, thoroughly to cleanse his threshing-floor, and to gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.
target_text: na huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala, tao si cakaraa dhèu sab'a oka, dhu patiri are ho ngèlu tiu eele kètu na. èle ku, heka soli are dhu mèu asa d'ara soka, aa kètu dènge kaj'alu are sèra, tunu pakèpu si. nuka sèmi èèna kahèi, bèli-camèd'a kristus huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala, dènge j'ara pèci si asa d'ara ai dhu heo robhe-robhe dhu madhe nèdhi boe.

source_text: with many other exhortations therefore preached he good tidings unto the people;
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e yohanis pasanèd'e dhèu nèti rupa-rupa madha j'ara, aa lole dènge ra lii lolo be'a lamatua.

source_text: but herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for herodias his brother's wife, and for all the evil things which herod had done, added this also to them all, that he shut up john in prison.
target_text: taa èèna, yohanis padhai lii pahuni heka, j'ara-j'ara dhu herodes ad'u-ue. lii langu herodes nuka sèmi ne'e ka: herodes ne, gubernur ètu propensi galilea. sasala na udhu sèmi kadhèna hèru hadhu sa. sasala na èci ka, parame nare herodias, dhèu èmu ari na, masi ka ari na mamuri era, dhu dhae pa'ia mèka. j'ara mamuri herodes sèmi ne'e, ka yohanis kai dènge madha na, toke herodes nasa dènge ne. nèti èèna ka, herodes kèpe ne, hèia pamaso asa d'ara èmu bèdho.

source_text: now it came to pass, when all the people were baptized, that, jesus also having been baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o dhu ra kèpe mèka yohanis ne, nèngu sarani dhèu ae le. aa na sarani yesus kahèi. sarani èle, ka yesus sabaj'a, kabèdhi laa, liru bhoka eele.

source_text: and the holy spirit descended in a bodily form, as a dove, upon him, and a voice came out of heaven, thou art my beloved son; in thee i am well pleased.
target_text: hèia roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci puru mai sa yesus. roh ne rupa na sèmi koro j'aha sa. hèia lii nèti dedha-liru peka na, èu ne, ana pasue ja'a. èu ne, loe boe pakarej'e d'ara ja'a.

source_text: and jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years of age, being the son as was supposed of joseph, the son of heli,
target_text: lod'o yesus mulai lole dènge dhèu j'ara mamuri lamatua, umur na pe d'ai tèlu nguru tèu sa. dhèu tadhe yesus ne, ana nèti yusuf. bèi-baki yusuf sèmi ne'e: yusuf, ama na, eli.

source_text: and jesus, full of the holy spirit, returned from the jordan, and was led in the spirit in the wilderness
target_text: ropa yohanis sarani nare yesus, hèia yesus la'e, tèke eele loko yarden. roh ama lamatua bera-bera dènge ne, ka pakako ne asa d'ara mamoo èci.

source_text: during forty days, being tempted of the devil. and he did eat nothing in those days: and when they were completed, he hungered.
target_text: ka yesus pea ètu èèna toke èpa nguru lod'o. ètu era ne'e, na'a-ninu boe ngaa-ngaa, ka na manganga titu kèna. aa dhèu aae nidhu mai sèku ne.

source_text: and the devil said unto him, if thou art the son of god, command this stone that it become bread.
target_text: na peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ladhe èu ne tare'a ana ama lamatua, èu dènge koasa. de tao hadhu se j'aj'i roti, ho mu'a si.

source_text: and jesus answered unto him, it is written, man shall not live by bread alone.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala ne, peka na, èu hari! me'a boe, do? dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, ‘mamuri dhèu rai-haha, mesa boe dhoka nèti nganga'a-nganginu di! '

source_text: and he led him up, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time. and the devil said unto him, to thee will i give all this authority, and the glory of them: for it hath been delivered unto me; and to whomsoever i will i give it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae nidhu nèti hari yesus asa era èci dhu dedha aae, hèia na paj'uj'u dènge yesus a'èra dènge koasa paredha aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. hèia na pamako yesus, na, a'èra dènge koasa paredha aa'i-aa'i sèra, ètu d'ara kacui-aai ja'a. de ja'a dènge hak ho pangèd'u mi cee èèna ka, sad'i ja'a ko'o.

source_text: if thou therefore wilt worship before me, it shall all be thine.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, ja'a neo hia mi èu. te ngaa sad'i èu tao ku ca j'ara, heka ja'a hia èu kèna. mud'a iiki-iiki! èu pahaha iisi mi ja'a! dhoka èèna di.

source_text: and jesus answered and said unto him, it is written, thou shalt worship the lord thy god, and him only shalt thou serve.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, abhu ètu mia j'ara na sèmi èèna? te ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu suri, na, ‘èu dhoka pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua di. aa èu sogo-tagu dhoka mi nèngu di. '

source_text: and he led him to jerusalem, and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, if thou art the son of god, cast thyself down from hence:
target_text: èle ka, dhèu aae nidhu nèti hari yesus asa kota yerusalem. d'ai era ne'e, na paca'e yesus asa era dhu dedha risi ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka na peka, ladhe tare'a-re'a èu ne ana ama lamatua, na, ridhu asa haha nèi!

source_text: for it is written, he shall give his angels charge concerning thee, to guard thee:
target_text: te dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, ‘pe ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na nèti sorga, ho mai j'aga èu.

source_text: and, on their hands they shall bear thee up, lest haply thou dash thy foot against a stone.
target_text: èèna na ra sibhe èu, sèna ka haga èu goi lèke boe hadhu sa hèi. '

source_text: and jesus answering said unto him, it is said, thou shalt not make trial of the lord thy god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii nidhu ne, èu baku karihu kahadhu dènge ja'a ne. lula dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, na, ‘baku sèku ama lamatua. '

source_text: and when the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him for a season.
target_text: dhèu aae nidhu ne tenge j'ara rupa-rupa ho sèku yesus, te ngaa tao nare boe. ka la'e tèke eele yesus, na mate hari lod'o dhu be'a.

source_text: and jesus returned in the power of the spirit into galilee: and a fame went out concerning him through all the region round about.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lèpa hari asa propensi galilea, te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci hia ne koasa. nèbhu boe ka dhèu-dhèu ètu d'ara rai èèna, mulai tadhe kolongara na.

source_text: and he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
target_text: na aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi ètu mia-mia. ka dhèu koa-kio ne, peka na, yesus ne dhu ele madha, nga!

source_text: and he came to nazareth, where he had been brought up: and he entered, as his custom was, into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up to read.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus mai asa rae na nasaret. lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, dhu ra pangare na ‘sabat', hèia la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a sèmi dhu tema na tao. ka na kèd'i titu ho neo baca nèti sasuri ama lamatua.

source_text: and there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet isaiah. and he opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
target_text: ka ra j'ole hia ne sasuri nèti baki yesaya. hèia na bhoke tenge ayat, ka na baca, peka na,

source_text: the spirit of the lord is upon me, because he anointed me to preach good tidings to the poor: he hath sent me to proclaim release to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
target_text: koasa roh ama lamatua abhu ètu ja'a. nèti èèna ka, na paj'uj'u ja'a, ho peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu-dhèu dhu unu aad'o. nèngu pua le ja'a mai, ho lole, na, dhu ana bèdho, èèna na patalala si; dhu bèdhu, èèna na bisa rèdhi hari; dhu lèke ènyi nèti dhèu, èèna na patabuli eele.

source_text: to proclaim the acceptable year of the lord.
target_text: te limuri ne d'ai le lod'o lamatua, sèna ka pala mamuri mi dhèu unu na.

source_text: and he closed the book, and gave it back to the attendant, and sat down: and the eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.
target_text: baca nare sasuri ne, ka yesus lulu hari, hèia na j'ole asa ama dhu nèd'u kasasi, ka na madhèdi. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a èèna ladhe patae ne.

source_text: and he began to say unto them, to-day hath this scripture been fulfilled in your ears.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, dhu miu tadèngi nèti sasuri ama lamatua deo na, ne'e ne, j'aj'i le!

source_text: and all bare him witness, and wondered at the words of grace which proceeded out of his mouth: and they said, is not this joseph's son?
target_text: ka dhèu sèra mulai padhai lii padedha yesus, aku rèngu na, waa! ngaa dhu na padhai lii deo na, be'a titu kèna! te ngaa nèngu ne ana yusuf, si? tasamia ka na bisa sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: and he said unto them, doubtless ye will say unto me this parable, physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done at capernaum, do also here in thine own country.
target_text: hèia yesus lole dènge si, tatu miu tadèngi le lii dhu peka na, ‘wee, dote! puri uuru ku ngi'u èu! ' miu neo pake lii èèna, ho kabèli hari sa ja'a, peka na, ‘nga tao ka èu tao boe tadha malaa èci hia ji'i ètu ne'e, sèmi dhu èu tao le ètu kota kapernaum nèi? '

source_text: and he said, verily i say unto you, no prophet is acceptable in his own country.
target_text: mamola na sèmi ne'e: dhèu ro'o boe sèmi rare dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti d'ara rae unu na.

source_text: but of a truth i say unto you, there were many widows in israel in the days of elijah, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when there came a great famine over all the land; and unto none of them was elijah sent, but only to zarephath, in the land of sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
target_text: tare conto nuka sèmi baki elia, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ca tèka, èj'i mai boe tèlu tèu catenga. taa èèna, abhu bhèni balu ae ètu isra'el. te ngaa lamatua hia boe elia ho soru-bara si ètu isra'el sèra. lamatua dhoka pua la'e asa ca dhèu bhèni balu ètu rae sarfat, dhu dètu dènge kota sidon. masi ka bhèni ne dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa na parcaya koasa ama lamatua.

source_text: and there were many lepers in israel in the time of elisha the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, but only naaman the syrian.
target_text: tare hari conto leo nèti elisa, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. taa èèna, dhèu yahudi ae dhu lèke èi papèd'a kusta ètu isra'el. te ngaa lamatua pa'èle boe si nèti papèd'a ra. ama lamatua dhoka pua elisa la'e puri-pa'èle dhèu kusta èci, ngara na naaman, masi ka nèngu ne dhèu siria, dhèu yahudi boe. te ngaa na parcaya koasa ama lamatua.

source_text: and they were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things;
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii padhai lii yesus ne, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra nasa titu kèna dènge ne.

source_text: and they rose up, and cast him forth out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might throw him down headlong.
target_text: ka ra kèd'i aa'i-aa'i, ra babège eele ne nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a èèna. hèia ra nuni rèti ne asa karasa rae, ho neo tule ne nèti dedha tèbhi ètu èèna, asa haha la'e.

source_text: but he passing through the midst of them went his way.
target_text: te ngaa na kako asa li'u la'e re talora aae rèngu, ka tèke eele si ètu era èèna.

source_text: and he came down to capernaum, a city of galilee. and he was teaching them on the sabbath day:
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus puru la'e asa kota kapernaum ètu sebhe dano galilea. d'ai lod'o-lod'o sabaj'a, na aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and they were astonished at his teaching; for his word was with authority.
target_text: dhèu sèra malaa ladhe ra nanene lii padhai na, te ne'a mèu isi lii holo-nori sèra.

source_text: and in the synagogue there was a man, that had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,
target_text: ca tèka, ropa yesus aj'a-nori ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu ca dhèu dhu nidhu tao, na pa'oo-parodha, peka na,

source_text: ah! what have we to do with thee, jesus thou nazarene? art thou come to destroy us? i know thee who thou art, the holy one of god.
target_text: ee! yesus, dhèu nasaret! èu neo tao ngaa mi ji'i? èu mai sèna ka palaho ji'i, do? ji'i se tadhe èu. èu ne, dhèu mola, dhu uru èèna ama lamatua pajaji tèke ho hia mai.

source_text: and jesus rebuked him, saying, hold thy peace, and come out of him. and when the demon had thrown him down in the midst, he came out of him, having done him no hurt.
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke ne, peka na, rèno laa! hutu hèb'a èu na! kalua ka nèti dhèu ne'e! cag'ag'a laa, nidhu ded'e kalabhe dhèu ne asa rai, ètu talora aae dhèu sèra. ropa pabèbhe nare, hèia nidhu ne kalua tèke eele aa papèd'a boe isi dhèu ne hèi.

source_text: and amazement came upon all, and they spake together, one with another, saying, what is this word? for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i malaa-maloha, ka ra peka na, ira ii! lii padhai dhèu ne'e, dènge koasa kapai bia! toke nidhu madhutu paredha na kahèi, ka kalua nèti dhèu!

source_text: and there went forth a rumor concerning him into every place of the region round about.
target_text: hèia lii lolo lula-nèti yesus pale-lème rai èèna aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and he rose up from the synagogue, and entered into the house of simon. and simon's wife's mother was holden with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
target_text: lod'o rèngu kalua nèti èmu sabaj'a, yesus la'e asa èmu dhèu èci, ngara na simon. lod'o èèna, teto na dhu pèd'a maringi-sagoro isi pana bia. hèia ra manèngi yesus, peka na, ama! puri-pa'èle ku bhèni heka ne, laa!

source_text: and he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she rose up and ministered unto them.
target_text: ka yesus la'e titu ètu sebhe koi, ka puri papèd'a bhèni heka ne. cag'ag'a laa, èi papèd'a na ele dènge ka. hèia na kèd'i la'e lalau nganga'a hia si ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
target_text: ètu d'ara lod'o nihia èèna kahèi, ropa lod'o oe cèna, dhèu lere rèti dhèu pèd'a ae-ae mai asa yesus. èi papèd'a ra rupa-rupa. hèia na bane ai mi dhèu pèd'a se'e, ka aa'i-aa'i ra èle nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: and demons also came out from many, crying out, and saying, thou art the son of god. and rebuking them, he suffered them not to speak, because they knew that he was the christ.
target_text: nèti dhèu pèd'a se abhu kahèi dhu nidhu tao. hèia yesus paredha nidhu se, sèna ka kalua nèti dhèu sèra. ra rai kalua dènge lii taraa, peka na, èu ne, ana ama lamatua! te nidhu se re'a, na, nèngu ne kristus, dhu ama lamatua pajaji karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia mai. nèti èèna ka, yesus kai si sèna ka bisa boe ra padhai ca hèb'a sa, lula-nèti nèngu.

source_text: and when it was day, he came out and went into a desert place: and the multitudes sought after him, and came unto him, and would have stayed him, that he should not go from them.
target_text: asa bèli d'ara oe mèu sa, yesus kèd'i, ka la'e asa era dhu kaliu èci ètu li'u kota. hèia dhèu tenge ne asa mia-mia. ropa paraga dènge ne, ka ra pamako ne, aku rèngu na, ama pea ka dènge ji'i laa! lamu iia ka asa era leo!

source_text: but he said unto them, i must preach the good tidings of the kingdom of god to the other cities also: for therefore was i sent.
target_text: te ngaa na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a hud'i laku asa rae-rae leo, ho peka-padhai lii lolo be'a nèti paredha ama lamatua. te ama lamatua pua ja'a mai ne, sèna ka pakako sasab'a èèna.

source_text: and he was preaching in the synagogues of galilee.
target_text: hèia na kako nèti rae èci asa rae leo, ho aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: now it came to pass, while the multitude pressed upon him and heard the word of god, that he was standing by the lake of gennesaret;
target_text: ca tèka, yesus aj'a dhèu ètu sebhe dano galilea. dhèu ae mai sèna ka neo nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua. rèngu mai toke ra kalibhu rare yesus.

source_text: and he saw two boats standing by the lake: but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
target_text: padètu dènge era èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pamèu pèku ra ètu dedha nebhe. ka yesus nèdhi koha dua bua dhu panahu ètu era èèna.

source_text: and he entered into one of the boats, which was simon's, and asked him to put out a little from the land. and he sat down and taught the multitudes out of the boat.
target_text: cue nèti koha se, unu simon. èle ka, yesus ca'e asa dedha koha ne, ka na manèngi sèna ka simon tob'e asa era marèma ciki. hèia na madhèdi ho aj'a dhèu ae sèra.

source_text: and when he had left speaking, he said unto simon, put out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
target_text: aj'a nare, hèia na padhai lii dènge simon, peka na, simon! padedha hari ku asa d'ara marèma, ho core pèku la'a. te èèna na miu abhu i'a ae.

source_text: and simon answered and said, master, we toiled all night, and took nothing: but at thy word i will let down the nets.
target_text: ka simon dhaa, peka na, te ngaa, ama. ji'i sab'a d'ai madhe d'ara camèd'a kateme kèna, te abhu boe ci'u sa hèi! te ngaa lula ama ku peka le sèmi èèna, ja'a madhutu! ja'a papuru sèku.

source_text: and when they had done this, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes; and their nets were breaking;
target_text: hèia ra papuru pèku. ropa ra neo ère paca'e hari, re'a boe na pèku ne dhu pènu dènge i'a, ka mulai mae.

source_text: and they beckoned unto their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. and they came, and filled both the boats, so that they began to sink.
target_text: hèia simon rodhe angalai na ètu koha leo sèra, ho mai bara rèngu ère pèku. ka ra da'u i'a tao asa d'ara koha, toke koha dua bua se pènu dènge i'a, ka oe cène.

source_text: but simon peter, when he saw it, fell down at jesus' knees, saying, depart from me; for i am a sinful man, o lord. for he was amazed, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken; and so were also james and john, sons of zebedee, who were partners with simon. and jesus said unto simon, fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
target_text: angalai simon se, nuka yakobis dènge yohanis, ana nèti sabadeus, ètu era èèna kahèi. rèngu se malaa, lula ra abhu i'a ae titu kèna. ropa simon petrus ladhe nèdhi ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne, hèia na patitu dènge ka, kètu urutuu na ètu madha yesus, hèia na peka, ja'a ne, ca dhèu dhu ue le sasala ae-ae. de be'a risi, lamatua padètu ia ka dènge ja'a. te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, simon! pangee ia ka j'ara ne'e, te ja'a neo pake miu se. miu tema le tenge i'a. te ngaa deo ne'e ne, ja'a aj'a miu sèna ka tenge dhèu ho madhutu ja'a.

source_text: and when they had brought their boats to land, they left all, and followed him.
target_text: èle ka, rèngu nuni dènge ka koha ra asa dedha nebhe. ka lasi tèke eele ka ngaa-ngaa ra aa'i-aa'i, lasi madhutu yesus.

source_text: and it came to pass, while he was in one of the cities, behold, a man full of leprosy: and when he saw jesus, he fell on his face, and besought him, saying, lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
target_text: ètu rae èci, yesus paraga dènge ca dhèu dhu ngi'u na pènu dènge èi papèd'a kusta. ropa dhèu ne nèdhi yesus, ka la'e patitu kètu urutuu na, aa na pacud'u d'ai rai. hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ama! sue ku ja'a laa! te ja'a ke'a, na, ama bisa puri-pa'èle papèd'a ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu madenge ia ka dènge ja'a. sad'i ama mo'o.

source_text: and he stretched forth his hand, and touched him, saying, i will; be thou made clean. and straightway the leprosy departed from him.
target_text: ka yesus j'ole kacui-aai na ho g'ag'e ne. aa na peka, ja'a ko'o! èu èle dènge kèna! ropa na padhai lii nare, èi papèd'a dhèu ne èle dènge.

source_text: and he charged him to tell no man: but go thy way, and show thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
target_text: hèia yesus pasanèd'e ne, peka na, baku bhèlu, ee! èu èle le, te ngaa baku peka dènge dhèu èci sa! èu hud'i madhutu uuru ku paredha baki musa. de lamu asa ama agama, ho na parisa ngi'u èu, sèna ka ne'a èi papèd'a ne èle tare'a, do dhae. èle èèna na, èu hia mèdha èci sèmi tadha makasi, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, èu ne èle tare'a le nèti papèd'a.

source_text: but so much the more went abroad the report concerning him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed of their infirmities.
target_text: masi ka yesus kai, te ngaa lii lolo nèti koasa na, pale-lème nèti dhèu èci asa èci d'ai mia-mia. ka dhèu mai sèmi tao cèci sa, ho ra nanene na aj'a-nori. hèia na puri-pa'èle dhèu ae nèti rupa-rupa èi papèd'a ra.

source_text: but he withdrew himself in the deserts, and prayed.
target_text: te ngaa catèka-catèka, yesus d'èi kahèi patalele iisi, ho la'e manèngi-mangaj'i asa era dhu kaliu.

source_text: and it came to pass on one of those days, that he was teaching; and there were pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, who were come out of every village of galilee and judæa and jerusalem: and the power of the lord was with him to heal.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus aj'a dhèu ètu d'ara èmu cue. lod'o èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dènge pèri-pèri mese agama, mai ho nanene lii padhai na. dhèu se mai nèti rae-rae ètu propensi galilea, propensi yudea, dènge kota yerusalem. ama lamatua hia yesus koasa, sèna ka pa'èle dhèu-dhèu pèd'a.

source_text: and behold, men bring on a bed a man that was palsied: and they sought to bring him in, and to lay him before him. and not finding by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop, and let him down through the tiles with his couch into the midst before jesus.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu pèri-pèri ded'e rèti dhèu karuku èci ètu dedha karad'a. rèngu tenge-tenge j'ara, sèna ka yesus puri-pa'èle ne. te ngaa ètu d'ara èmu ne, dhèu sèmi tao cacèci sa, ka rèngu bisa boe pasuki asa d'ara. nèti èèna ka, ra ded'e dhèu ne asa kolo èmu. rare dedha, ka ra bèdi eele rèu èmu, sèna ka tao ro'a, ho dulu dhèu karuku ne dènge karad'a kateme asa haha la'e. ra dulu dhèu ne'e asa talora aae dhèu ae-ae se, lèke mola-mola ètu madha yesus.

source_text: and seeing their faith, he said, man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
target_text: ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus ne'a, na, rèngu se parcaya, na, nèngu bisa pa'èle angalai ra nèti karuku na. ka na lii dènge dhèu karuku ne, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a saku pamèu le sasala èu.

source_text: and the scribes and the pharisees began to reason, saying, who is this that speaketh blasphemies? who can forgive sins, but god alone?
target_text: ropa tadèngi yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka dhèu parisi dènge mese agama sèra, pakarèi, na, eeh! dhoka ama lamatua dhu dènge hak di, ho saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu. cee ka nèngu ne, ka na tao iisi na nuka sèmi ama lamatua! ne'e ne pa'ele iie kolongara lamatua!

source_text: but jesus perceiving their reasonings, answered and said unto them, why reason ye in your hearts?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a d'ai d'ara rèngu. hèia na peka, nga tao ka miu se ngee, na, ja'a ne padhai lii pa'ele iie kolongara lamatua?

source_text: which is easier, to say, thy sins are forgiven thee; or to say, arise and walk? but that ye may know that the son of man hath authority on earth to forgive sins he said unto him that was palsied, i say unto thee, arise, and take up thy couch, and go unto thy house.
target_text: ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. aa ja'a ne dènge hak kahèi, ho abho sasala-sasigo dhèu. ladhe ja'a lii dènge dhèu karuku ne, ‘ja'a abho le sasala èu, ' miu mèdhi boe koasa ja'a ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa ladhe ja'a peka na, ‘kèd'i ka! ded'e karad'a èu, ho lèpa ka. ' ladhe nèngu kèd'i dènge ka, na, miu heka mèdhi koasa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku ne, sèna ka miu me'a, na, ja'a dènge hak ho abho sasala-sasigo dhèu. ka na piku asa dhèu karuku ne, aa lii, peka na, titu ka! ded'e karad'a èu, ho lèpa ka!

source_text: and immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his house, glorifying god.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, dhèu ne kèd'i titu ètu madha dhèu ae sèra, ka kèpe nare karad'a na. hèia na lèpa ka dènge koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and amazement took hold on all, and they glorified god; and they were filled with fear, saying, we have seen strange things to-day.
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i se malaa. ka ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua, peka na, lamatua kapai risi eele! deo ne'e ne, èdhi tèdhi le dènge musi madha èdhi unu ti, tadha malaa dhu kapai!

source_text: and after these things he went forth, and beheld a publican, named levi, sitting at the place of toll, and said unto him, follow me.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka yesus kalua nèti d'ara èmu, hèia ladhe nèdhi dhèu roro bea ca dhèu, dhu madhèdi ètu era roro doi bea. ngara dhèu ne, lewi. ka yesus peka dènge ne, mai ka madhutu ja'a!

source_text: and he forsook all, and rose up and followed him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii paroa ne, hèia lewi kèd'i dènge ka, tèke eele aa'i-aa'i sèra, la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: and levi made him a great feast in his house: and there was a great multitude of publicans and of others that were sitting at meat with them.
target_text: èle ka, lewi tao tatao kapai ètu èmu na, ka na nèru yesus. aa na nèru kahèi angalai na dhèu roro bea sèra, dènge tamu-tamu dhu leo ho lasi ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and the pharisees and their scribes murmured against his disciples, saying, why do ye eat and drink with the publicans and sinners?
target_text: te ngaa pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dènge mese-mese agama, ka'uu-kamuki mi ana madhutu yesus, aku rèngu na, tasamia ka miu mi'a-minu pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu laku boe, nuka dhèu roro bea, dènge dhèu karehe sèra? dhèu be'a bisa boe pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra sa!

source_text: and jesus answering said unto them, they that are in health have no need of a physician; but they that are sick.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge rèngu, peka na, dhèu pèd'a parluu dote-matarii. te ngaa dhu pèd'a boe, parluu boe.

source_text: i am not come to call the righteous but sinners to repentance.
target_text: mamai ja'a ne, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu karehe sèra. te ngaa ja'a mai boe ho uri dhèu dhu ngee na, ngi'u ra mola le.

source_text: and they said unto him, the disciples of john fast often, and make supplications; likewise also the disciples of the pharisees; but thine eat and drink.
target_text: hèia dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dènge mese-mese agama ka'ugu mi yesus, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama! ana madhutu yohanis tuka sarani dhèu, rèngu tema puasa dènge sabaj'a. ana-ana madhutu dhèu parisi sèmi èèna kahèi. te ngaa tasamia ka, ana madhutu ama sèra, loe boe dènge ra'a-rinu? rèngu se re'a boe puasa, do?

source_text: and jesus said unto them, can ye make the sons of the bride-chamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
target_text: ka na dhaa pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, miu me'a le, ladhe dhèu tao pesta kab'i, dhèu-dhèu dhu ra nèru sèra, bisa boe puasa, te ngaa ra'a toke bècu. ladhe mone dhu kab'i èèna, dènge rèngu era, tatu rèngu ra'a palere aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: but the days will come; and when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, then will they fast in those days.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu leo rai rèti mone dhu kab'i ne, hèia angalai na susa, heka ra puasa kèna.

source_text: and he spake also a parable unto them: no man rendeth a piece from a new garment and putteth it upon an old garment; else he will rend the new, and also the piece from the new will not agree with the old.
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii pakasame èci hari, peka na, abhu mèka dhèu dhu rare bèla hiu ca'èta, ho kalape mi kodho dhui dhu mae. te ladhe base kodho ne, bèla hiu dhu kalape la'a èèna karuku, na kodho ne asa mae aae.

source_text: and no man putteth new wine into old wine-skins; else the new wine will burst the skins, and itself will be spilled, and the skins will perish. but new wine must be put into fresh wine-skins.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dhua dhu heka rèti nèti kapua, dhèu bhori boe asa sabha dhui. te aad'o na, sabha madhore eele, aa dhua èèna soli soo-soo asa rai la'e. de dhua dhu hiu, hud'i bhori ku asa d'ara sabha hiu. sèmi èèna ka, yesus aj'a si, peka na, lii aj'a na dhu hiu bisa boe pab'ali dènge lii aj'a dhu dhui nèti dhèu parisi.

source_text: and no man having drunk old wine desireth new; for he saith, the old is good.
target_text: dhèu dhu rinu rèdhi le èi anggor dhui, d'èi boe rinu dhu hiu. te dhu re'a na, ‘èi anggor dhu kee risi nuka èi anggor dhui! '

source_text: now it came to pass on a sabbath, that he was going through the grainfields; and his disciples plucked the ears, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, kako re j'ara ètu sebhe oka dhèu. ka ana madhutu na puru are-gandum dhu ètu madha rèngu sèra. hèia ra sarod'e d'ara kacui-aai, ka ra'a.

source_text: but certain of the pharisees said, why do ye that which it is not lawful to do on the sabbath day?
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dhu kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi ra. ropa ladhe rèdhi ana madhutu yesus tao sèmi èèna, ka ra kai ne, peka na, tasamia ka ana-ana èu se sisu atora agama èdhi? rèngu sab'a lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a! ladhe ku laa! rèngu puru are-gandum nèi. baku tao sèmi èèna!

source_text: and jesus answering them said, have ye not read even this, what david did, when he was hungry, he, and they that were with him; how he entered into the house of god, and took and ate the showbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat save for the priests alone?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, peka na, tasamia, ee? miu sanèd'e lii lolo baki daud? daud dènge dhèu madhutu na lula manganga ae, ka maso lasi asa d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. hèia ra'e roti dhu ama agama hia le lamatua. te ngaa roti se'e dhodhoka ama agama di dhu bisa ra'e. dhèu leo bisa boe. ka baki daud si ra'e, te ngaa ca dhèu sa peka boe, na, rèngu sale. miu se, sèmi baca mèdhi boe sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua!

source_text: and he said unto them, the son of man is lord of the sabbath.
target_text: pasa dhilu ho nanene paie-iie! ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a dènge hak ho pama'ète, na, dhèu bisa sab'a ngaa, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a.

source_text: and it came to pass on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man there, and his right hand was withered.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhu leo, yesus la'e aj'a ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu mone èci, dhu ai madhe cabèka.

source_text: and the scribes and the pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath; that they might find how to accuse him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri mese agama, dènge dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dhu tenge j'ara ho pamanahu yesus. ra tatae, tao-tao na neo puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa abhu j'ara ho galaa ne ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: but he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man that had his hand withered, rise up, and stand forth in the midst. and he arose and stood forth.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngangee rèngu. nèti èèna ka, na paroa dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, aku nèngu na, angalai! mai ku. titu ètu talora aae ne! hèia la'e titu dènge ka ètu talora èèna.

source_text: and jesus said unto them, i ask you, is it lawful on the sabbath to do good, or to do harm? to save a life, or to destroy it?
target_text: ka yesus karèi dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, ja'a karèi ku miu laa. madhutu atora agama èdhi, ngaa dhu èdhi bisa tao ètu lod'o a'ae sasab'a? èdhi tao dhu be'a, do, tao dhu karehe? hia mamuri mi dhèu, do, pa'ele iie mamuri na?

source_text: and he looked round about on them all, and said unto him, stretch forth thy hand. and he did so: and his hand was restored.
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe palème rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka na lii dènge dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, peka na, j'ole ai èu mai! ka na soro ai na, hèia èle dènge ka.

source_text: but they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to jesus.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka dhèu kapai se nasa titu kèna. hèia ra peka, na, èdhi tenge hari ku j'ara leo, sèna ka pamanahu ne!

source_text: and it came to pass in these days, that he went out into the mountain to pray; and he continued all night in prayer to god.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, yesus la'e sabaj'a asa ledhe èci. na sabaj'a ètu èèna camèd'a kateme.

source_text: and when it was day, he called his disciples; and he chose from them twelve, whom also he named apostles:
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae, yesus paroa ana madhutu na. ka nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, hag'e nare canguru dua dhèu ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na. dhèu dhu hag'e nare sèra, nuka:

source_text: simon, whom he also named peter, and andrew his brother, and james and john, and philip and bartholomew,
target_text: simon dhu yesus pangare ne, ‘petrus' anderias ari simon, yakobis, yohanis ari yakobis, pelipus, bertolomeos,

source_text: and matthew and thomas, and james the son of alphæus, and simon who was called the zealot,
target_text: mateos, tomas, yakobis ana alpius, simon nèti partei politik selot,

source_text: and judas the son of james, and judas iscariot, who became a traitor;
target_text: yudas ana yakobis, aa yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahia yesus.

source_text: and he came down with them, and stood on a level place, and a great multitude of his disciples, and a great number of the people from all judæa and jerusalem, and the sea coast of tyre and sidon, who came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
target_text: ropa puru mai nèti ledhe deo na, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, ae taha ètu era mera èci. ètu èèna, abhu dhèu ae dhu pakaboko. dhèu se mai nèti propensi yudea, nèti kota yerusalem, aa nèti tirus dènge sidon, nuka dua kota ètu sebhe dhasi.

source_text: and they that were troubled with unclean spirits were healed.
target_text: rèngu mai ho nanene lii padhai yesus, aa abhu kahèi dhu neo manèngi sèna ka na puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a. ka yesus pa'èle si. na pa'èle kahèi dhèu dhu nidhu tao, dènge magèle eele nidhu nèti dhèu sèra.

source_text: and all the multitude sought to touch him; for power came forth from him, and healed them all.
target_text: dhèu ae dhu neo goi ne. te ropa goi lèke ne, dhèu se èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra, lula abhu koasa dhu kalua nèti nèngu.

source_text: and he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, blessed are ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of god.
target_text: èle ka yesus kabib'a asa ana madhutu na, hèia na aj'a si, aku nèngu na, dhèu unu aad'o sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula ama lamatua mesa na, j'aj'i dhèu aae miu dhu be'a.

source_text: blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
target_text: dhèu dhu kabake manganga sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula lamatua ka dhu hia miu bècu-manèsa. dhèu dhu tangi dènge d'ara susa sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na d'ara mi karej'e.

source_text: blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the son of man's sake. rejoice in that day, and leap for joy: for behold, your reward is great in heaven; for in the same manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ka dhèu dhu abhu susa lula madhutu ja'a, miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na lamatua b'ala rui-j'aj'èra miu ètu sorga. masi ka dhèu tèka d'ara dènge miu, do pakarehe kolongara miu, do j'èli marèu miu, do bata eele miu, tao sèmi dhèu bhelu sa, miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na lamatua bhèlu boe miu ètu sorga. de ladhe dhèu paj'èra miu sèmi èèna, pakarej'e laa d'ara miu! aa karae laa dènge pasoa-pasoka! mage malaa kahèi, lula dhèu dhu paj'èra miu limuri ne, bèi-baki ra dhu uru èèna, paj'èra le dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra kahèi. de ladhe miu paraga dènge j'aj'èra sèmi sèra, pakarej'e laa d'ara miu, lula èèna na lamatua b'ala hia miu ae-ae ètu sorga!

source_text: but woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula mamuri karej'e miu, dhoka d'ai ne'e di.

source_text: woe unto you, ye that are full now! for ye shall hunger. woe unto you, ye that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
target_text: dhèu dhu bècu-manèsa! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula hèru manganga madèu dhu seli eele, mai salake nare miu. dhèu dhu kea rae-rae sèra! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula j'aj'èra mai, tao miu tangi ngob'i-ngob'i.

source_text: woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for in the same manner did their fathers to the false prophets.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi dhèu koa-kad'iri! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula uru sèra bèi-baki miu d'èi pad'iri kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu rèti lii leko-monya sèra!

source_text: but i say unto you that hear, love your enemies, do good to them that hate you,
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, pasa dhilu ho nanene paie-iie! èu hud'i sue ku musu èu, aa tao pabe'a laa mi dhèu dhu tèka d'ara dènge èu.

source_text: bless them that curse you, pray for them that despitefully use you.
target_text: sabaj'a ho manèngi ama lamatua, sèna ka hia babe'a mi dhèu dhu dhoo èu. aa manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu paj'èra èu rupa-rupa.

source_text: to him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and from him that taketh away thy cloak withhold not thy coat also.
target_text: ladhe dhèu tèb'e ripi èu cabèka, soro hari ripi cabèka ho na tèb'e. ladhe dhèu parame rare kodho pana èu, na, hia hari laa kodho èu dhu leo.

source_text: give to every one that asketh thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
target_text: ladhe dhèu manèngi mèdha èu èci, hia laa. aa ladhe dhèu ded'e rèti mèdha èu èci, soro tèke sène. mage mu manèngi hari!

source_text: and as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
target_text: èu hud'i tao ku dhèu leo, nuka sèmi èu neo dhèu tao mi ngi'u èu.

source_text: and if ye love them that love you, what thank have ye? for even sinners love those that love them.
target_text: èu d'èi pad'elo sasue mi dhèu èu mesa mu. èèna be'a. te ngaa kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu bhelu sue dhèu rèngu kahèi.
