source_text: and if ye do good to them that do good to you, what thank have ye? for even sinners do the same.
target_text: ladhe èu pabe'a dhoka dènge dhèu dhu be'a dènge èu di, kolo-karisi ètu mia? te dhèu bhelu sèra, re'a b'ala babe'a dhèu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? even sinners lend to sinners, to receive again as much.
target_text: ladhe èu dhodhoka hia pija mi dhèu dhu bisa pula hari doi èu, kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu bhelu kahèi re'a hia dhèu leo pija doi, sad'i bèli-camèd'a sèmi aa'i hari dhu kateme iisi.

source_text: but love your enemies, and do them good, and lend, never despairing; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be sons of the most high: for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.
target_text: te ngaa dhu lèke ka, sèmi ne'e: sue la musu èu sèra! aa tao la be'a mi rèngu. ngaa dhu ra parluu, hia si pija. baku pangee, na, ra pula hari do aad'o. dènge j'ara ne, èèna na ama lamatua b'ala èu. pe èu j'aj'i ana nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. lula mamuri èu sama sèmi ama mu, dhu d'èi ad'u-ue j'ara hua iia hia dhèu bhelu. nèngu d'èi kahèi tao j'ara hua iia hia dhèu dhu re'a boe manèngi makasi.

source_text: be ye merciful, even as your father is merciful.
target_text: de èu hud'i pad'elo ku kasia mi dhèu, nuka sèmi ama mu ètu sorga dhu pad'elo kasia na mi èu.

source_text: and judge not, and ye shall not be judged: and condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: release, and ye shall be released:
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii aj'a na, peka na, baku lee dhèu, sèna ka dhèu baku lee hari èu. baku kahèti leli lii padhai dhèu, te aad'o na dhèu tao hari èu sèmi èèna kahèi. pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, sèna ka rèngu baku nui sasala èu.

source_text: give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, shall they give into your bosom. for with what measure ye mete it shall be measured to you again.
target_text: ladhe èu hia dhèu ngaa dhu ra parluu, pe èu abhu hari. te bèli-camèd'a ra hia hari èu pènu ai. èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu isi kab'ui asa d'ara balee a'uku, ka ra karèko ne, aa cèci ne, toke bua lale eele. dhu èu abhu, sama èci èèna ka. ladhe èu hia ciki, èu abhu hari ciki kahèi. te ngaa ladhe èu hia ae, èu abhu hari ae-ae.

source_text: and he spake also a parable unto them, can the blind guide the blind? shall they not both fall into a pit?
target_text: yesus aj'a pake lii upama kahèi. na lole, peka na, dhèu bèdhu bisa boe pad'elo j'ara hia dhèu bèdhu dhu leo. te aad'o na, dua ra manahu asa d'ara ro'a lasi!

source_text: the disciple is not above his teacher: but every one when he is perfected shall be as his teacher.
target_text: ana sakola bisa boe mèu risi nèti mese na! te ngaa ladhe na madhutu dènge be'a lii a'aj'a mese na, nèngu bisa j'aj'i sama sèmi mese na.

source_text: and why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
target_text: èu pa'èki more sasala dhèu, masi ka ana iiki-iiki èèna ka. te ngaa sasala èu dhu kapai, èu sèmi pame'a boe sa. èèna, nuka sèmi èu mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu musi madha dhèu. masi ka agarii aae dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu, te ngaa èu oe sèmi pame'a boe sa!

source_text: or how canst thou say to thy brother, brother, let me cast out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
target_text: tasamia ka èu bani peka dènge angalai mu, na, ‘mai, ho ja'a tiu eele ahu nèti d'ara madha èu. ' te ngaa èu mesa mu bisa boe ladhe mèdhi ngaa-ngaa, te agarii dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu! weeh! èu ne, mema dhèu kapod'e-kabèli! tao eele uru ku agarii nèti d'ara madha èu, heka èu ladhe mèdhi, ho tiu eele ahu ca katèd'a èèna, nèti d'ara madha angalai mu.

source_text: for there is no good tree that bringeth forth corrupt fruit; nor again a corrupt tree that bringeth forth good fruit.
target_text: ka yesus tabha lii pakasame èci hari, peka na, abhu ètu mia, aj'u be'a, ladhe d'ai lod'o hua, hua na karehe. aa abhu boe ladhe aj'u karehe na hua, hua na be'a.

source_text: for each tree is known by its own fruit. for of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
target_text: dhèu bisa tadhe ladhe aj'u ca kapua, be'a do aad'o, mai nèti hua na. dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, peka na, ètu mia dhèu puu lolobhangi, do, hua anggor nèti aj'u padhudhu.

source_text: the good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and the evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth that which is evil: for out of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, ne'a tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. te ngaa dhèu dhu d'ara kaj'alu, tao j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu-katub'a. te nèti lii padhai na, èdhi bisa tadhe babe'a-karehe dhèu.

source_text: and why call ye me, lord, lord, and do not the things which i say?
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, miu se loe boe paroa ja'a, na, ‘lamatua'. te ngaa tasamia ka miu mo'o boe tao madhutu lii padhai ja'a?

source_text: every one that cometh unto me, and heareth my words, and doeth them, i will show you to whom he is like:
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene lii padhai ja'a, ho na tao madhutu, nèngu ne èci èèna ka

source_text: he is like a man building a house, who digged and went deep, and laid a foundation upon the rock: and when a flood arose, the stream brake against that house, and could not shake it: because it had been well builded.
target_text: dènge dhèu dhu neo patitu èmu dhu èra. na kèi ro'a fanderen toke abhu hadhu. hèia na padhèdi fanderen, heka na patitu èmu kèna. ladhe èi aae lala, èmu ne gaged'o boe sa hèi, lula era padhèdi na èra.

source_text: but he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that built a house upon the earth without a foundation; against which the stream brake, and straightway it fell in; and the ruin of that house was great.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu nanene dènge d'ara kajari, aa madhutu boe lii padhai ja'a, nèngu ne èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu neo patitu èmu sad'i j'aj'i di. na tao boe fanderen, te ngaa na patitu èmu na ètu dedha rai ètu sebhe loko. hèia ropa èi aae lala, èmu na guri laho mae-mae!

source_text: after he had ended all his sayings in the ears of the people, he entered into capernaum.
target_text: ropa aj'a nare, ka yesus lèpa asa kota kapernaum.

source_text: and a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick and at the point of death.
target_text: ca dhèu komedhaa sordad'u roma pea ètu ne'e. abhu dhèu sab'a na èci dhu nèngu parcaya. dhèu sab'a ne dhu pèd'a oe madhe.

source_text: and when he heard concerning jesus, he sent unto him elders of the jews, asking him that he would come and save his servant.
target_text: lod'o èèna, komedhaa tadèngi le tatao yesus, hèia na pua dhèu heka yahudi pèri-pèri lasi manèngi yesus mai puri dhèu sab'a ne.

source_text: and they, when they came to jesus, besought him earnestly, saying, he is worthy that thou shouldest do this for him;
target_text: d'ai nèi, ra pamako yesus, sèna ka na la'e palere dènge rèngu. ra manèngi, peka na, dhèu roma ne, dhèu be'a! ama hud'i tolong ne.

source_text: for he loveth our nation, and himself built us our synagogue.
target_text: te nèngu ka patitu èmu sabaj'a cue hia ji'i, lula na sue èdhi dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and jesus went with them. and when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, lord, trouble not thyself; for i am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof:
target_text: ka yesus madhutu dènge si. rèngu dhae rare mèka èmu, te ngaa komedhaa ne pua le angalai na la'e peka dènge yesus, na, ama roca ia ka mai asa d'ara èmu ja'a, te ja'a nia boe sèmi ama asa d'ara èmu ja'a.

source_text: wherefore neither thought i myself worthy to come unto thee: but say the word, and my servant shall be healed. for i also am a man set under authority, having under myself soldiers: and i say to this one, go, and he goeth; and to another, come, and he cometh; and to my servant, do this, and he doeth it.
target_text: aa ja'a nia boe kahèi ara dhiu asa katanga madha ama. ja'a ke'a ama dènge koasa. de sad'i ama padhai lii nèti èèna, tatu dhèu sab'a ja'a ne èle dènge nèti papèd'a na. ja'a ke'a j'ara ne'e ne, lula ja'a dènge dhèu paredha dedha kahèi, dhu dènge koasa ho paredha ja'a. aa ja'a dènge koasa kahèi ho paredha sordad'u ja'a. ladhe ja'a hia paredha mi sordad'u ja'a, peka na, ‘lamu sa nèi! ' tatu la'e dènge. aa ladhe ja'a peka, na, ‘mai sa ne'e' tatu na mai. aa ladhe ja'a pua dhèu sab'a ja'a, ‘sab'a ne'e' tatu na sab'a madhutu kahèi. de sad'i ama padhai lii di, dhèu sab'a ja'a ne, èle dènge.

source_text: and when jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned and said unto the multitude that followed him, i say unto you, i have not found so great faith, no, not in israel.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, yesus malaa. ka na kabib'a sa dhèu ae dhu madhutu na sèra, hèia na peka, nia kahèi nga! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a paraga kèdhi mèka dènge dhèu yahudi dhu lèka èra sama sèmi dhèu roma ne!

source_text: and they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole.
target_text: de yesus d'ai dhoka era èèna di. hèia angalai komedhaa se lèpa. ropa d'ai èmu komedhaa, ladhe na, dhèu sab'a ne èle le nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and it came to pass soon afterwards, that he went to a city called nain; and his disciples went with him, and a great multitude.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, pakèd'i lasi asa rae èci, ngara na nain. dhèu ae kako palere dènge ne.

source_text: now when he drew near to the gate of the city, behold, there was carried out one that was dead, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
target_text: ropa rèngu oe dètu dènge hèb'a tedhe maso asa rae ne, ra paraga dènge dhèu ca nau lasi padhane dhèu madhe. dhèu madhe ne, ana mone mesa nèti ca dhèu bhèni balu.

source_text: and when the lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, weep not.
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi bhèni balu ne, ka d'ara na roe. hèia na lii dènge bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, ina! tangi ia ka!

source_text: and he came nigh and touched the bier: and the bearers stood still. and he said, young man, i say unto thee, arise.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e padètu-dètu, ka na g'ag'e karad'a dhèu madhe ne. ka dhèu dhu pasae karad'a ne titu taha. hèia yesus lii dènge dhèu madhe, aku nèngu na, ana! kèd'i ka!

source_text: and he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. and he gave him to his mother.
target_text: ka ana ne mamuri hari, hèia na kèd'i madhèdi. èle èèna ka, na padhai lii dènge dhèu ae dhu titu reo rare ne. aa yesus peka dènge bhèni balu ne, aku nèngu na, ina! ana mu ka ne'e.

source_text: and fear took hold on all: and they glorified god, saying, a great prophet is arisen among us: and, god hath visited his people.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra madha'u titu kèna! ka ra koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ama lamatua pua le ca dhèu na dhu kapai risi, dhu nèti lii padhai na hia èdhi! abhu hari dhu leo, peka na, ama lamatua mai le ètu talora aae èdhi, ho pad'elo d'ara hua iia na!

source_text: and this report went forth concerning him in the whole of judæa, and all the region round about.
target_text: hèia lii lolo ne, ra palolo d'ai mia-mia ètu propensi yudea dènge era leo kahèi.

source_text: and the disciples of john told him of all these things. and john calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to the lord, saying, art thou he that cometh, or look we for another? and when the men were come unto him, they said, john the baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, art thou he that cometh, or look we for another?
target_text: ana madhutu yohanis tadèngi aa'i le ngaa-ngaa dhu yesus ad'u-ue. ka lasi lole dènge yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho. hèia na pua dhèu dua lasi, ho karèi ne, peka na, ama ne tare'a-re'a kristus dhu ji'i mate tae-tae, do? do, ji'i mate hari ku dhèu leo? èle ka ra paraga dènge yesus, ka ra karèi sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: in that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and on many that were blind he bestowed sight.
target_text: lod'o ana madhutu yohanis se ètu èèna, yesus puri-pa'èle dhèu ae nèti papèd'a ra. na bata eele nidhu nèti dhèu. aa na pa'èle dhèu bèdhu, ka rèdhi hari.

source_text: and he answered and said unto them, go and tell john the things which ye have seen and heard; the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, the poor have good tidings preached to them.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, lèpa ka ho mi peka dènge a'a ku yohanis, aa'i-aa'i dhu miu tadèngi dènge mèdhi unu mi, sèmi dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, ‘dhèu bèdhu rèdhi hari. dhèu karuku, kèd'i ho kako hari. dhèu pèd'a kusta, isi ra milu hari. dhèu katele-katipa, tadèngi hari. dhèu madhe, mamuri hari. dhèu dhu dènge boe unu, nanene lii lolo be'a. '

source_text: and blessed is he, whosoever shall find no occasion of stumbling in me.
target_text: lami ho peka kahèi dènge a'a ku yohanis, na, ‘dhèu dhu makae boe sèmi rare ja'a, rèngu abhu a'oto. '

source_text: and when the messengers of john were departed, he began to say unto the multitudes concerning john, what went ye out into the wilderness to behold? a reed shaken with the wind?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis se lèpa, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae sèra lula-nèti yohanis, na, lod'o miu lami tenge yohanis ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a èèna, miu pangee, na, paraga dènge dhèu dhu lalole na sèmi ngaa? tatu miu lami boe ho paraga dènge dhèu dhu roe aai-roe èèla, nuka sèmi kalai èèu dhu bhabheu madhutu lai ngèlu di!

source_text: but what went ye out to see? a man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.
target_text: tatu lami boe ho ladhe dhèu dhu pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae, te dhèu sèmi èèna, era pea na dhodhoka ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae di!

source_text: but what went ye out to see? a prophet? yea, i say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
target_text: de miu lami tenge dhèu cee ètu nèi? miu pangee na lami tenge dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, do? tare'a! te nèngu risi nèti ca dhèu nèti padhai lii lamatua.

source_text: this is he of whom it is written, behold, i send my messenger before thy face, who shall prepare thy way before thee.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci dhu suri tèke le, na, ‘nanene! ja'a pua dhèu ja'a, sèna ka bhoke j'ara hia èu. '

source_text: i say unto you, among them that are born of women there is none greater than john: yet he that is but little in the kingdom of god is greater than he.
target_text: ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis. te ngaa dhèu dhu ana iiki-iiki ètu talora aae dhèu unu ama lamatua, kapai risi nèti yohanis.

source_text: and all the people when they heard, and the publicans, justified god, being baptized with the baptism of john.
target_text: dhèu dhu tadèngi lii padhai yesus, rèngu re'a le, peka na, j'ara lamatua èèna, j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu roro bea sèra. lula rèngu uru èèna abhu sarani aa nanene kahèi lii aj'a-nori nèti yohanis.

source_text: but the pharisees and the lawyers rejected for themselves the counsel of god, being not baptized of him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dènge dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi sèra, ro'o boe madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ra manèngi boe yohanis sarani si.

source_text: whereunto then shall i liken the men of this generation, and to what are they like?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, ja'a pakasame dhèu-dhèu taa limuri se'e dènge ngaa? dhèu sèmi ngaa ka see?

source_text: they are like unto children that sit in the marketplace, and call one to another; who say, we piped unto you, and ye did not dance; we wailed, and ye did not weep.
target_text: rèngu se, èci èèna ka dènge ana-ana dhu madhèdi ètu d'ara pasa. ra re'a dhoka pa'oo-parodha dènge ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi tiu sakino, te ngaa miu roge boe dènge karej'e. aa ji'i sod'a lii beke dhèu madhe, te ngaa miu tangi boe. '

source_text: for john the baptist is come eating no bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, he hath a demon.
target_text: te, yohanis tuka sarani ninu boe èi anggor, aa na d'èi puasa, miu ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘nèngu ne nidhu tao! '

source_text: the son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, behold, a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, tema kinu èi anggor dènge ku'a roti. ka miu ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘dhèu ne, dhèu gagoo-gagehu! aa tema mahu! pa'angalai dènge dhèu roro bea! aa partei èci dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe! dhu ne'a heka ngi'u na! '

source_text: and wisdom is justified of all her children.
target_text: te ngaa mi patadhe lii ja'a ne! dhèu dhu re'a mèu, tatu rèngu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: and one of the pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. and he entered into the pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.
target_text: ètu d'ara kota ne, abhu dhèu parisi ca dhèu, ngara na simon. ca lod'o, na nèru yesus si mai ra'a asa èmu nèngu. hèia yesus si lasi madhèdi, ka neo ra'a.

source_text: and behold, a woman who was in the city, a sinner; and when she knew that he was sitting at meat in the pharisee's house, she brought an alabaster cruse of ointment,
target_text: lod'o èèna, bhèni kajeo ca dhèu tadèngi kahèi, na, yesus si neo ra'a-rinu ètu èèna. ka na maso la'e, nèd'u dènge èi hèu mèngi ca boto dhu kab'ua aae.

source_text: and standing behind at his feet, weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
target_text: na mai padètu dènge yesus re kabodho na. hèia na patitu kètu urutuu na ètu haga yesus. na tangi d'ara pèd'a dènge roma iisi, toke èi madha na hae lèke haga yesus. ka na seka haga yesus pake rèu kètu na, aa na loe boe uu haga yesus kahèi. èle ka, na pasuti èi hèu mèngi èèna mi haga yesus.

source_text: now when the pharisee that had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, this man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him, that she is a sinner.
target_text: simon ne'a mèu j'ara mamuri bhèni ne. nèti èèna ka, na pajiko ètu d'ara na, ne'e j'aj'i mi tadha, na, yesus ne, dhèu dhu nèti boe lii padhai ama lamatua! ladhe tare'a-re'a ama lamatua ka dhu pua ne mai, tatu nèngu ne'a, na, bhèni dhu g'ag'e nèngu ne, bhèni kajeo. dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, sèmi boe nèngu ne, lula dhèu mola-mèci bisa boe padètu dènge dhèu kaj'alu!

source_text: and jesus answering said unto him, simon, i have somewhat to say unto thee. and he saith, teacher, say on.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngaa dhu simon ngee. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, simon! sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo peka dènge èu ca j'ara. hèia simon dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama mese, peka laa.

source_text: a certain lender had two debtors: the one owed five hundred shillings, and the other fifty.
target_text: ka yesus core lii, peka na, abhu ca dhèu dhu tema hia dhèu pija doi na. uru èèna, na hia nèdhi dhèu dua pija doi na. dhèu èci, abhu lèmi ngasu doi iia, aa ca dhèu hari lèmi nguru di.

source_text: when they had not wherewith to pay, he forgave them both. which of them therefore will love him most?
target_text: te ngaa d'ai lod'o pula doi se'e, dua ra bisa boe b'ae rare. ka dhèu dhu hia pija, rasa kasia mi rèngu dua ra. nèti èèna ka, na peka mi dua ra, sèna ka b'ae ia ka kèlu ra sèra. de madhutu èu, nèti dhèu dua se, cee ka dhu sue risi dhèu tema hia dhèu pija doi ne?

source_text: simon answered and said, he, i suppose, to whom he forgave the most. and he said unto him, thou hast rightly judged.
target_text: ètu d'ara ciki oo'e na kahèi, simon dhaa, peka na, tatu dhèu dhu kèlu na ae risi! ka yesus dhaa, na, mema tare'a!

source_text: and turning to the woman, he said unto simon, seest thou this woman? i entered into thy house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath wetted my feet with her tears, and wiped them with her hair.
target_text: ka yesus ladhe bhèni ne, hèia na peka dènge simon, aku nèngu na, èu ladhe sèku bhèni ne. deo na ja'a maso asa d'ara èmu èu, èu tèke boe èi sèna ka rase haga ja'a, madhutu ad'a èdhi. te ngaa bhèni ne pabasa haga ja'a dènge èi madha na, ka na seka pake rèu kètu na.

source_text: thou gavest me no kiss: but she, since the time i came in, hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
target_text: aa ropa èu soru ja'a maso asa d'ara èmu èu, èu uu boe ja'a, madhutu ad'a èdhi. te ngaa karèi nèti ja'a ètu d'ara èmu èu, bhèni ne loe boe uu haga ja'a.

source_text: my head with oil thou didst not anoint: but she hath anointed my feet with ointment.
target_text: èu bhèlu eele ad'a dhu palona èi hèu mèngi mi kètu tamu, ropa ja'a mai deo na. te ngaa bhèni ne bhori le èi hèu mèngi dhu kab'ua titu kèna mi haga ja'a.

source_text: wherefore i say unto thee, her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
target_text: èu nanene paie! sasala bhèni ne, mema ae. te ngaa lamatua saku eele aa'i le, lula na pad'elo le sasue na dènge manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ja'a. te ngaa bagi dhèu dhu rasa na tao boe sasala ae, nèngu ngee na parluu boe abhu abho ae kahèi. nèti èèna ka, nèngu ne'a boe sue aa ne'a boe manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and he said unto her, thy sins are forgiven.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge bhèni ne, peka na, ja'a saku eele le sasala èu aa'i-aa'i ra!

source_text: and they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, who is this that even forgiveth sins?
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ra'a palere-lere, paka'uu, aku rèngu na, huuh! na ngee na, nèngu ne cee? ! na bani titu kèna saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu! j'ara ne'e ne dhodhoka ama lamatua mesa na, dhu dènge hak ho saku eele sasala dhèu!

source_text: and he said unto the woman, thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu lèka le ja'a, nèti èèna ka lamatua hia le èu mamuri. lèpa ka dènge mera-milu!

source_text: and it came to pass soon afterwards, that he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good tidings of the kingdom of god, and with him the twelve,
target_text: nèbhu boe ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dhèu canguru dua sèra, kako palème kota-kota dènge rae-rae ètu sèra. la'e lolo dènge dhèu dad'èi ama lamatua. èèna ka dhu j'aj'i lii lolo be'a hia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: mary that was called magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,
target_text: ètu d'ara kaboko rèngu, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu bhèni dhu madhutu. bhèni se dhu uru èèna abhu rupa-rupa papèd'a, aa cahag'e dhu nidhu tao. te ngaa yesus ka dhu puri-pa'èle aa'i si. nuka sèmi maria nèti rae magdala, dhu uru èèna, yesus bata eele pidhu nidhu nèti nèngu.

source_text: and joanna the wife of chuzas herod's steward, and susanna, and many others, who ministered unto them of their substance.
target_text: abhu kahèi susana, dènge mama yohana. yohana ne, dhèu èmu kusa. kusa ne, kapala urusan nèti èmu dhèu aae herodes. aa abhu ae kahèi bhèni leo dhu lasi palere-lere dènge yesus si. bhèni se pake doi-dhari rèngu mesa ra ho ogo yesus si ètu j'ara.

source_text: and when a great multitude came together, and they of every city resorted unto him, he spake by a parable:
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu mai nèti rae-rae ho tenge yesus. ropa dhèu ae se pakaboko, hèia na lolo dènge ra pake lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na,

source_text: the sower went forth to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden under foot, and the birds of the heaven devoured it.
target_text: abhu ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, dhu la'e ceb'e hini asa d'ara oka na. hini se cahag'e lèke ètu j'ara. ropa dhèu kako re èèna, j'èli lèke hini se. aa manu-bhui mai ka tutu ra'e aa'i.

source_text: and other fell on the rock; and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
target_text: hini cahag'e, lèke ètu dedha rai dhu pènu dènge hadhu. hini se muri, te ngaa nèbhu boe hèia kamale dhae-dhae, lula èi kura.

source_text: and other fell amidst the thorns; and the thorns grew with it, and choked it.
target_text: hini cahag'e hari lèke ètu era aj'u padhudhu. te ngaa ropa hini muri, aj'u padhudhu hèlu pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: and other fell into the good ground, and grew, and brought forth fruit a hundredfold. as he said these things, he cried, he that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
target_text: aa hini dhu leo lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi. hini se muri dènge sega, toke kapai ka hua. hua ae titu kèna, d'ai cangasu hari. lolo èle ka, yesus pa'èle lii pakasame ne, dènge lii dhu mèdhu, aku nèngu na, miu dhu pasa dhilu, na, ngee paie-iie!

source_text: and his disciples asked him what this parable might be.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: and he said, unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of god: but to the rest in parables; that seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.
target_text: na dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! lula miu se d'èi madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme, nèti èèna ka ja'a peka paled'a, ho miu me'a tasamia lamatua neo paredha dhèu unu na. te ngaa dhèu leo ro'o boe pare'a dènge dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ja'a aj'a-nori si pake lii pakasame di. te dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘rèngu se rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ro'o boe sèmi. '

source_text: now the parable is this: the seed is the word of god.
target_text: hèia yesus peka sasoa nèti lii pakasame ne, aku nèngu na, hini se, nuka lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: and those by the way side are they that have heard; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu j'ara, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu aae nidhu mai parame nare nèti d'ara rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu parcaya boe lamatua, aa abhu boe mamuri.

source_text: and those on the rock are they who, when they have heard, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, who for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
target_text: hini dhu lèke dedha hadhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge d'ara karej'e. te ngaa amo na marèma boe. rèngu parcaya, te ngaa ropa paraga dènge j'aj'èra, rèngu manahu.

source_text: and that which fell among the thorns, these are they that have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
target_text: hini dhu lèke era aj'u padhudhu, nuka dhèu dhu tadèngi, ka ra sèmi rare lii lolo be'a. te ngaa nare nèbhu boe, ka rèngu bhèlu eele lii lolo be'a, lula rèngu bhute dènge laladhe sasab'a-la'a rèngu, mèdha-panyau rèngu, aa dènge neo mamuri karej'e di. nèti èèna ka, parcaya rèngu dènge boe kab'ua ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and that in the good ground, these are such as in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it fast, and bring forth fruit with patience.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi, nuka dhèu dhu mamuri mola dènge d'ara hua iia. ropa rèngu tadèngi lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, rèngu sèle asa d'ara rèngu. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu parcaya taa-taa, aa ad'u-ue j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: and no man, when he hath lighted a lamp, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but putteth it on a stand, that they that enter in may see the light.
target_text: ka yesus peka hari, na, abhu ètu mia, dhèu paheo rare labhu iiki, ho èèna na saguru dènge èru rai. aa abhu ètu mia, dhèu tao labhu ètu ro'a koi. te ladhe tao sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa boe rèdhi heo na. labhu dhu guna, nuka padhèdi ètu era dedha, sèna ka heo na bisa pasaraa dhèu dhu maso mai.

source_text: for nothing is hid, that shall not be made manifest; nor anything secret, that shall not be known and come to light.
target_text: èci èèna kahèi dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu pahuni limuri ne, bèli-camèd'a pasabhoka. aa madha j'ara-madha j'ara dhu dhèu re'a boe limuri ne, èèna na dhèu bisa re'a mèu.

source_text: take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that which he thinketh he hath.
target_text: de miu hud'i pangee paie-iie ku j'ara se'e. dhèu dhu neo tenge tare'a-re'a dad'èi lamatua, nèngu asa d'èlu-mèu. te ngaa rèngu dhu pusi pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, rèngu asa goa.

source_text: and there came to him his mother and brethren, and they could not come at him for the crowd.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus bhute dènge dhèu ae. hèia ina dènge ari na mai neo paraga dènge ne. te ngaa ra bisa boe lasi padètu, lula dhèu se, ae titu kèna.

source_text: and it was told him, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
target_text: ka abhu dhèu la'e peka dènge yesus, na, ama! ina dènge ari ama, ètu li'u sèi. ra neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: but he answered and said unto them, my mother and my brethren are these that hear the word of god, and do it.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, oo! te ngaa sèmi ne'e. ina dènge a'ari ja'a, nuka rèngu dhu tare'a-re'a d'èi nanene lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, aa tao madhutu.

source_text: now it came to pass on one of those days, that he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples; and he said unto them, let us go over unto the other side of the lake: and they launched forth.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus gale dhèu pajuu-paleha na, aku nèngu na, mai lati ka asa cabèka dano. ka ra ca'e koha cue, hèia pakèd'i lasi.

source_text: but as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filling with water, and were in jeopardy.
target_text: ropa rèngu ètu talora dano, yesus bhèj'i. nèbhu boe cag'ag'a laa, ngèlu aae mai. naha tèb'e koha, hèia èi maso sa d'ara, ka oe molo.

source_text: and they came to him, and awoke him, saying, master, master, we perish. and he awoke, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ana madhutu se parèi ne, peka na, ama! ama! kèd'i ho tolong ku laa! te èdhi madhe aa'i kèna! ka yesus kèd'i. hèia na kai ngèlu dènge naha, peka na, mau ka! kaca'a laa, ngèlu dènge naha mau dènge ka.

source_text: and he said unto them, where is your faith? and being afraid they marvelled, saying one to another, who then is this, that he commandeth even the winds and the water, and they obey him?
target_text: hèia na pasanèd'e ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu parcaya mèka ja'a? rèngu madha'u dènge malaa, ka ra pakarèi èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, cee ka yesus ne? tasamia ka nèngu bisa paredha ngèlu dènge naha, ka ra madhutu dad'èi na?

source_text: and they arrived at the country of the gerasenes, which is over against galilee.
target_text: nèbhu boe rèngu d'ai rai garasa, ètu sebhe dano galilea.

source_text: and when he was come forth upon the land, there met him a certain man out of the city, who had demons; and for a long time he had worn no clothes, and abode not in any house, but in the tombs. and when he saw jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, what have i to do with thee, jesus, thou son of the most high god? i beseech thee, torment me not. for he was commanding the unclean spirit to come out from the man. for oftentimes it had seized him: and he was kept under guard, and bound with chains and fetters; and breaking the bands asunder, he was driven of the demon into the deserts.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, dhèu èci dhu nèbhu ae le, nidhu ae pahuj'u ne. dhèu ne dènge boe èmu, ka na pea ètu era ro'a dhèu madhe. bèli-bèli èèna kako la'e-mai, dhu pake boe mèdha-papake. te nidhu sèra loe boe paredha ne. dhèu dhu èki le pèri-pèri hari dènge rate aa pakanau ne dènge kanau bèsi, te ngaa na lèku èta si. ka nidhu se laka-seti ne ho la'e asa era dhu kaliu. ropa yesus si puru nèti dedha koha, ka dhèu huj'u ne mai asa yesus. hèia na pa'oo-parodha. ka na pabèbhe iisi, aa na patitu kètu urutuu ètu haga yesus. hèia yesus paredha nidhu sèra, aku nèngu na, ee, nidhu! rai eele nèti dhèu ne'e! hèia dhèu huj'u ne pa'oo, peka na, baku gagu ja'a! te ja'a ke'a èu ne yesus, ana nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele! èu baku paj'èra ja'a!

source_text: and jesus asked him, what is thy name? and he said, legion; for many demons were entered into him.
target_text: ka yesus karèi ne, ngara èu cee? hèia nidhu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, legion, te ji'i se ae, sèmi sordad'u riho-riho. na lii sèmi èèna, lula nidhu se ae-ae dhu maso ètu d'ara ngi'u dhèu èèna.

source_text: and they entreated him that he would not command them to depart into the abyss.
target_text: nidhu se loe boe pamako yesus, sèna ka baku pua rèngu lasi asa d'ara ro'a j'aj'èra, nuka era taha koasa bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: now there was there a herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they entreated him that he would give them leave to enter into them. and he gave them leave.
target_text: te ngaa dhu padètu ètu èèna, hahi canau kateme dhu nyuu rai ètu sebhe ledhe. ka nidhu se manèngi yesus, peka na, pua la ji'i maso asa d'ara hahi sèi! hèia yesus d'èi kahèi.

source_text: and the demons came out from the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd rushed down the steep into the lake, and were drowned.
target_text: ka nidhu se kalua ka nèti d'ara dhèu mone ne, lasi maso asa hahi. hahi se aa'i-aa'i ra huj'u, ka ra rai paj'ala puru nèti sebhe ledhe ne, hèia caroco asa d'ara dano. aa cène, ka madhe aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and when they that fed them saw what had come to pass, they fled, and told it in the city and in the country.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, dhèu madhenge hahi se, rai lasi palème rae-rae ètu sèra, lolo aa'i-aa'i ngaa dhu j'aj'i.

source_text: and they went out to see what had come to pass; and they came to jesus, and found the man, from whom the demons were gone out, sitting, clothed and in his right mind, at the feet of jesus: and they were afraid.
target_text: ropa dhèu ètu rae se tadèngi lii lolo se, ka lasi ae-ae sèna ka neo rèdhi unu ra tatao dhu j'aj'i le. d'ai era èèna, rèngu ladhe, na, dhèu dhu nidhu tao èèna, madhèdi mau-mau padètu ètu haga yesus. nèngu pake le mèdha-papake, aa na huj'u heka. ladhe rèdhi sèmi ne'e, ka aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i madha'u.

source_text: and they that saw it told them how he that was possessed with demons was made whole.
target_text: hèia dhèu-dhèu dhu ladhe rèdhi ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne, ra palolo dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu heka mai sèra, tasamia ka dhèu huj'u ne èle nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and all the people of the country of the gerasenes round about asked him to depart from them; for they were holden with great fear: and he entered into a boat, and returned.
target_text: ka dhèu garasa aa'i-aa'i ra manèngi yesus ho tèke eele rai rèngu, te rèngu madha'u titu kèna. hèia yesus si ca'e lasi asa dedha koha, sèna ka lèpa hari asa cabèka dano galilea.

source_text: but the man from whom the demons were gone out prayed him that he might be with him: but he sent him away, saying,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu deo na dhu nidhu tao, loe boe pamako yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! hud'i laa ja'a madhutu ama kahèi! te ngaa yesus dhaa ne, peka na,

source_text: return to thy house, and declare how great things god hath done for thee. and he went his way, publishing throughout the whole city how great things jesus had done for him.
target_text: sèmi ne'e ku laa! be'a risi èu lèpa ka asa a'ari èu. lamu lolo aa'i dènge ra, na, ama lamatua tao le j'ara dhu be'a hia èu. hèia dhèu ne kako palème d'ara kota ne, na palolo dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na, yesus ka dhu pa'èle nèngu.

source_text: and as jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him; for they were all waiting for him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi hari dènge koha asa cabèka dano galilea. lod'o rèngu puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae dhu mate mema le yesus. dhèu se mai ae-ae ho soru ne.

source_text: and behold, there came a man named jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at jesus' feet, and besought him to come into his house; for he had an only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. but as he went the multitudes thronged him.
target_text: ètu ne'e abhu ca dhèu, ngara na yairus. nèngu kapala èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara kota ne. ana na dhoka ca dhèu di; ana bhèni, umur na canguru dua tèu. ana bhèni ne dhu pèd'a aae, oe madhe. ropa yairus nèdhi yesus mai, hèia la'e patitu kètu urutuu na ètu madha yesus. na manèngi ho yesus dhuli èmu na, sèna ka puri-pa'èle ana na. dhaa nare ka, yesus madhutu dènge ne asa èmu na. aa dhèu ae madhutu rèngu. ka rèngu paseti èci dènge èci.

source_text: and a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, who had spent all her living upon physicians, and could not be healed of any,
target_text: abhu kahèi dhèu bhèni èci dhu kako dènge rèngu. bhèni ne dhu lèke papèd'a dhèu bhèni dhu loe boe canguru dua tèu kèna. doi-dhari dènge mèdha-panyau na èle aa'i le, ho b'ae dote-matarii. te ngaa abhu boe dhu bisa puri-pa'èle ne. papèd'a na asa na hoe.

source_text: came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately the issue of her blood stanched.
target_text: ka na ara padètu-dètu asa yesus nèti kabodho. hèia na gai lèke suu kodho yesus. ropa na gai lèke kodho yesus ne, hèia papèd'a na èle dènge ka.

source_text: and jesus said, who is it that touched me? and when all denied, peter said, and they that were with him, master, the multitudes press thee and crush thee.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, yesus titu taha. hèia na karèi, peka na, cee ka dhu goi lèke ja'a? te ngaa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu mangaku. ka petrus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ama! dhèu ae-ae ka dhu tao paseti aa patule-pajuku nèti kabodho. sèmi ne'e ne, te'a na cee ka dhu goi lèke ama!

source_text: but jesus said, some one did touch me; for i perceived that power had gone forth from me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ne, aad'o! deo na ja'a rasa abhu koasa dhu kalua nèti ngi'u ja'a. de ja'a ke'a, na, ca dhèu dhu sangaja gai ja'a.

source_text: and when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him declared in the presence of all the people for what cause she touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
target_text: ropa bhèni ne ne'a, na, nèngu bisa boe pasili, hèia na madha'u titu kèna. isi na rèbha-rèbha, ka la'e patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. hèia na lolo mi dhèu ae sèra, nga tao ka nèngu gai yesus. aa na lolo kahèi, na, ropa nèngu gai lèke yesus, nèngu èle dènge nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and he said unto her, daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, ana hèni! èu èle nèti papèd'a, lula èu parcaya ja'a. lèpa ka dènge mera-milu!

source_text: while he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying, thy daughter is dead; trouble not the teacher.
target_text: lod'o yesus padhai lii era dènge bhèni ne, ca dhèu nèti yairus mai peka dènge ne, ama, ee! ana ama aad'o heka. na madhe le, de paj'èra ia ka ama mese.

source_text: but jesus hearing it, answered him, fear not: only believe, and she shall be made whole.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yesus tadèngi nare lii peka dhèu èèna, hèia yesus lii dènge yairus, mau-mau! baku madha'u! parcaya mi ama lamatua di. nèngu ka dhu hia mamuri mi ana èu.

source_text: and when he came to the house, he suffered not any man to enter in with him, save peter, and john, and james, and the father of the maiden and her mother. and all were weeping, and bewailing her: but he said, weep not; for she is not dead, but sleepeth. and they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai èmu yairus, dhèu ae le. ra tangi dènge d'ara pèd'a. ka yesus kai si, peka na, ae eele ka tangi laa! ana ne madhe boe. dhoka na bhèj'i di! te ngaa dhèu se pahae boe, ra mari pakapengo hèb'a, te rèngu rèdhi unu ra ana ne ma'ète a'ae. hèia yesus manèngi sèna ka ina-ama nèti ana bhèni ne, petrus, yohanis dènge yakobis maso lasi palere-lere dènge ne. dhèu leo sèra, na hia si mate ètu li'u.

source_text: but he, taking her by the hand, called, saying, maiden, arise.
target_text: rare d'ara, ka yesus kèpe ai ana ne, hèia na paroa peka na, ana! kèd'i ka!

source_text: and her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately: and he commanded that something be given her to eat.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana ne mamuri hari, ka na kèd'i titu. hèia yesus lii dènge ina ana bhèni ne, na, hia ana ne na'a!

source_text: and her parents were amazed: but he charged them to tell no man what had been done.
target_text: ina-ama ana ne malaa-maloha. te ngaa yesus pasanèd'e si, baku palolo dènge dhèu, ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne.

source_text: and he called the twelve together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus pakaboko nare ana madhutu na, dhèu canguru dua sèra. ka na hia si koasa, ho babège eele nidhu, aa puri-pa'èle dhèu nèti rupa-rupa èi papèd'a.

source_text: and he sent them forth to preach the kingdom of god, and to heal the sick.
target_text: na pua si lasi lole j'ara-j'ara paredha ama lamatua, aa puri-pa'èle papèd'a dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: and he said unto them, take nothing for your journey, neither staff, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money; neither have two coats.
target_text: te ngaa na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e paie-iie! baku mèti kahèi ngaa-ngaa ètu j'ara. kako dhoka dènge kodho ètu ua di. baku mèti kodho silu. baku mèti kahèi tatea, tas, gee j'ara, do doi-dhari!

source_text: and into whatsoever house ye enter, there abide, and thence depart.
target_text: ladhe d'ai ka d'ara rae èci, abhu dhèu dhu soru miu, na lami pea dènge ne. mage mi hag'e-hag'e èmu kahèi. pea taruu ètu d'ara èmu èèna, toke miu pakèd'i, tèke eele rae èèna.

source_text: and as many as receive you not, when ye depart from that city, shake off the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara rae èci, hèia dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra ro'o boe sèmi miu, aa ro'o boe nanene lii padhai miu, na, pakèd'i tèke eele rae èèna. lod'o miu tèke eele rae èèna, tao madhutu ad'a ho caro eele ahu nèti haga miu. aa mi peka dènge ra, ‘miu se ladhe mo'o boe nanene lii ji'i, pe miu sèmi mere pala mi! '

source_text: and they departed, and went throughout the villages, preaching the gospel, and healing everywhere.
target_text: èle ka, ana madhutu se lasi ka asa rae-rae. ra lole dènge dhèu-dhèu lii lolo be'a ama lamatua. aa puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu nèti papèd'a ètu mia-mia.

source_text: now herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done: and he was much perplexed, because that it was said by some, that john was risen from the dead;
target_text: ca tèka, rupa-rupa lii lolo lula-nèti yesus ne d'ai le dhèu aae herodes antipas. ropa na tadèngi lii lolo se, hèia na bingu, lula dhèu cahag'e peka na, yesus ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani, dhu mamuri hari le.

source_text: and by some, that elijah had appeared; and by others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
target_text: aa cahag'e hari peka na, nèngu ne, baki elia dhu mamuri hari. abhu dhu leo hari, peka na, nèngu ne, ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua dhu uru-uru sèra.

source_text: and herod said, john i beheaded: but who is this, about whom i hear such things? and he sought to see him.
target_text: te ngaa herodes sanèd'e era, peka na, ca hari ni, ja'a pua le poro pama'ète kètu yohanis. de na mamuri hari, do? aa ca dhèu ne, cee hari? ka na tenge j'ara, sèna ka patoo madha dènge yesus.

source_text: and the apostles, when they were returned, declared unto him what things they had done. and he took them, and withdrew apart to a city called bethsaida.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana madhutu dhu yesus pua sèra, lèpa mai pa'èci hari dènge ne. ra lolo dènge ne aa'i-aa'i dhu rèngu tao. ka yesus si kako mesa-mesa ra asa era èci, dhu padètu dènge rae betsaida, ho ra ae ètu èèna.

source_text: but the multitudes perceiving it followed him: and he welcomed them, and spake to them of the kingdom of god, and them that had need of healing he cured.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae dhu re'a rare, na, yesus si neo lasi sa mia, ka ra paki'u re limuri. yesus sèmi si, hèia na pa'èle dhèu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i, aa na peka-padhai dènge ra, j'ara-j'ara ama lamatua nèd'u paredha.

source_text: and the day began to wear away; and the twelve came, and said unto him, send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages and country round about, and lodge, and get provisions: for we are here in a desert place.
target_text: ropa d'ai lod'o nihia, ka canguru dua ana madhutu yesus sèra, peka dènge ne, be'a risi ama pua dhèu se'e lasi asa rae-rae dhu padètu dènge era ne'e, sèna ka ra tenge nganga'a unu ra. aa hud'i laa ra lasi tenge era ho j'unu taha. te era dhu kaj'èu nèti rae sèmi ne'e, tasamia ka rèngu bisa abhu ra'a-rinu?

source_text: but he said unto them, give ye them to eat. and they said, we have no more than five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy food for all this people. for they were about five thousand men. and he said unto his disciples, make them sit down in companies, about fifty each.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, peka na, sèmi ne'e! miu ka dhu panga'a si! hèia ana madhutu se dhaa, peka na, ira ii! ama, ee! tasamia bisa sèmi èèna? dhèu se risi nèti lèmi riho dhèu! èèna dhèu mone di, ige mèka bhèni dènge ana niki! ètu d'ara adhe-aai ji'i, abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u di. ladhe ama neo sèna ka ji'i panga'e dhèu se'e, tasa mera mia ho ji'i hèli nganga'a ae-ae hia ra? ! ka yesus dhaa, pakaboko si madhèdi lèmi nguru-lèmi nguru dhèu, ca kaboko.

source_text: and they did so, and made them all sit down.
target_text: hèia lasi tao sèmi èèna.

source_text: and he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake; and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
target_text: ropa dhèu se madhèdi, ka yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra. ka na tangara sa dedha, ho na manèngi makasi. èle ka yesus pamae roti dènge i'a sèra. hèia na j'ole sa ana-ana madhutu na, ho papala mi dhèu-dhèu sèra.

source_text: and they ate, and were all filled: and there was taken up that which remained over to them of broken pieces, twelve baskets.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i se ra'a toke bècu. ka nganga'a dhu risi sèra, kaboko rare pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: and it came to pass, as he was praying apart, the disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, who do the multitudes say that i am?
target_text: ca tèka, yesus la'e mesa na ho sabaj'a ètu era èci. hèia ana madhutu na mai ka pa'èci dènge ne. sabaj'a nare, ka yesus karèi si, aku nèngu na, miu tadèngi-tadèngi dhèu palolo na ja'a ne, cee?

source_text: and they answering said, john the baptist; but others say, elijah; and others, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, cahag'e peka na, yohanis tuka sarani. aa cahag'e peka na, baki elia. ladhe aad'o, na, ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra dhu mamuri hari.

source_text: and he said unto them, but who say ye that i am? and peter answering said, the christ of god.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi hari si, peka na, madhutu a'abhu miu, na, ja'a ne, cee? ka petrus dhaa, ama ne, kristus, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka!

source_text: but he charged them, and commanded them to tell this to no man;
target_text: èle ka yesus kai si, sèna ka baku ale dènge dhèu èci sa, peka na, nèngu na, kristus.

source_text: saying, the son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a hud'i pasae ku rupa-rupa j'aj'èra dhu bia. bèli-camèd'a dhèu heka ad'a yahudi, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra, ro'o boe sèmi, ladhe peka, na, ja'a ne kristus. aa èèna na, ra pamadhe ja'a. mema tare'a-re'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa asa camèd'a èèna, ja'a mamuri hari!

source_text: and he said unto all, if any man would come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
target_text: èle ka na peka dènge dhèu ae se, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i madhutu dènge d'ara kateme ètu lod'o bèli-lod'o bèli. nèngu hud'i core eele ku dad'èi d'ara na. nèngu hud'i madhutu taruu, masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, nuka sèmi dhèu pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha na, ho la'e asa era ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: for whosoever would save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
target_text: te dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a nèngu unu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu neo dhoka mamuri hia ngi'u aae na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu pakaj'èu-j'èu nèti lamatua.

source_text: for what is a man profited, if he gain the whole world, and lose or forfeit his own self?
target_text: ladhe dhèu unu aa'i ngaa-ngaa ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa ama lamatua tule eele ne, a'oto na ngaa?

source_text: for whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in his own glory, and the glory of the father, and of the holy angels.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. de dhèu dhu makae madhutu ja'a, aa makae sèmi lii aj'a ja'a, ja'a kahèi makae mangaku nèngu ètu madha ama lamatua, lod'o ja'a lèpa mai nèti sorga. te bèli-camèd'a ja'a puru mai dènge dadedha ama ku, palere-lere dènge ana-ana pajuu na nèti sorga.

source_text: but i tell you of a truth, there are some of them that stand here, who shall in no wise taste of death, till they see the kingdom of god.
target_text: ja'a peka patare'a dènge miu. abhu pèri-pèri nèti miu ètu se'e se, bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèdhi unu ra lamatua nèd'u paredha, heka ra madhe kèna.

source_text: and it came to pass about eight days after these sayings, that he took with him peter and john and james, and went up into the mountain to pray.
target_text: èle aru lod'o, ka yesus nèti petrus, yohanis dènge yakobis, lasi ca'e asa ledhe èci, ho neo sabaj'a.

source_text: and as he was praying, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment became white and dazzling.
target_text: dhu na sabaj'a era, rèhu na j'aj'i leko-leo, aa mèdha-papake na pudhi lao-lao.

source_text: and behold, there talked with him two men, who were moses and elijah;
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, dhèu dua cèu mai. dhèu se, nuka baki musa dènge baki elia. ka ra padhai lii dènge yesus.

source_text: who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he was about to accomplish at jerusalem.
target_text: dua ra ladhe na le'e-le'e hèti-hèti. tèlu ra padhue-padhai lula-nèti mamadhe yesus bèli-camèd'a ètu yerusalem.

source_text: now peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, petrus dènge angalai na dhèu dua sèra musi madha sakaa titu kèna, ka ra bhèj'i luu. ropa ra kabèdhi, hèia rèdhi yesus titu dènge dhèu dua. aa rèdhi yesus dhu kaha'a kahèi.

source_text: and it came to pass, as they were parting from him, peter said unto jesus, master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for moses, and one for elijah: not knowing what he said.
target_text: ropa musa dènge elia neo lèpa, petrus bingu, ne'a heka tao tasamia. ka na padhai lii leli, na peka na, ama! ji'i ètu ne'e, be'a d'ai seli! de hua iia ji'i tao paleo tèlu bua. cue hia ama, cue hia baki musa, aa cue hari hia baki elia.

source_text: and while he said these things, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus padhai lii era, ra'i-liru puru mai, ka saguru rare rèngu. hèia petrus si madha'u bia.

source_text: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, this is my son, my chosen: hear ye him.
target_text: ka ra tadèngi lii nèti d'ara ra'i-liru èèna, peka na, ne'e ne, ana ja'a dhu ja'a hag'e kore le! ladhe na padhai lii, nanene ne paie-iie!

source_text: and when the voice came, jesus was found alone. and they held their peace, and told no man in those days any of the things which they had seen.
target_text: ropa lii na èle, petrus si ladhe rèdhi dhoka yesus mesa-mesa na. rèngu tèlu ra, peka boe dènge dhèu èci sa, ngaa dhu rèngu rèdhi le. d'ai nèbhu ku, heka ra palolo dènge dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: and it came to pass, on the next day, when they were come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, lod'o yesus dènge petrus si puru mai nèti ledhe, dhèu ae mai paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: and behold, a man from the multitude cried, saying, teacher, i beseech thee to look upon my son; for he is mine only child:
target_text: ka dhèu èci rodhe ne, peka na, ama mese! ladhe ku ana mone ja'a ca dhèu ne laa!

source_text: and behold, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth, and it hardly departeth from him, bruising him sorely.
target_text: te abhu nidhu dhu loe boe kèpe ne, ka na pakèce sahèka, aa nyanyoko ne, toke hèb'a na horo karaka. nidhu ne loe boe dhadhedhe ana ne, aa d'èi boe hia ana ne ae nare ciki sa.

source_text: and i besought thy disciples to cast it out; and they could not.
target_text: ja'a manèngi le kahèi ana madhutu ama se ho ra babège eele nidhu ne, te ngaa tao rare boe!

source_text: and jesus answered and said, o faithless and perverse generation, how long shall i be with you, and bear with you? bring hither thy son.
target_text: ka yesus jèke si, peka na, eeh! miu se parcaya boe, na, lamatua bisa pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a ra. miu mema dhèu dhu me'a boe mamuri madhutu j'ara mola! de ja'a hud'i tatae hari miu toke pèri lod'o? hèia na peka dènge ama ana ne, mèti ana mu sa ne'e mai!

source_text: and as he was yet a coming, the demon dashed him down, and tare him grievously. but jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
target_text: ropa pakako rèti ana ne asa yesus, hèia nidhu hake pabèbhe, aa rarumu ne. te ngaa yesus paredha nidhu ho kalua tèke eele ana ne, hèia na èle dènge. ka yesus hia ana ne asa ama na la'e.

source_text: and they were all astonished at the majesty of god. but while all were marvelling at all the things which he did, he said unto his disciples,
target_text: dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra dhu ladhe rèdhi koasa yesus, aa'i-aa'i ra malaa-maloha. ropa dhèu se padhue era tadha malaa dhu yesus tao, nèngu lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: let these words sink into your ears: for the son of man shall be delivered up into the hands of men.
target_text: miu patadhe paie lii padhai ja'a ne! nèbhu boe dhèu neo pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. ka ra soro ja'a asa d'ara adhe-aai dhèu leo.

source_text: but they understood not this saying, and it was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it; and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu na se bingu. masi ka rèngu dhane rare boe sasoa na, te ngaa ra madha'u karèi ne, sasoa na ngaa.

source_text: and there arose a reasoning among them, which of them was the greatest.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana madhutu yesus pasisu lula-nèti rèngu se, cee ka dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i dhèu re madha.

source_text: but when jesus saw the reasoning of their heart, he took a little child, and set him by his side,
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngaa dhu rèngu pasisu. ka na paroa nare ana iiki ca dhèu, hèia na patitu ètu karasa na.

source_text: and said unto them, whosoever shall receive this little child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same is great.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, nanene paie! dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, ho na ladhe-leru dhèu haha, dhu sama sèmi ana iiki ne, sasoa na nèngu ladhe-leru ja'a kahèi. aa na ladhe-leru kahèi ama ku ètu sorga dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. abhu dhèu ae dhu pusi-pahae boe dhèu sèmi se'e se. dhèu se'e, nuka: dhu unu aad'o, dhu susa, dhu laku-laku boe, dhu kalua aapa, aa dènge dhèu haha. de dhèu dhu d'èi lalau-lalo'o dhèu sèmi se'e se, madhutu ama lamatua, nèngu ka dhu dhèu re madha.

source_text: and john answered and said, master, we saw one casting out demons in thy name; and we forbade him, because he followeth not with us.
target_text: hèia yohanis peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! ca lod'o ji'i ngèdhi ca dhèu babège eele nidhu, dènge ale kolongara ama. ka ji'i kai ne, sèna ka na ale ia ka ngara ama, lula nèngu ne dhèu èdhi boe.

source_text: but jesus said unto him, forbid him not: for he that is not against you is for you.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, baku! te dhèu dhu lab'a boe èdhi, nèngu èèna angalai èdhi.

source_text: and it came to pass, when the days were well-nigh come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to jerusalem,
target_text: yesus ne'a le lod'o na ca'e asa sorga dètu le. ka na pama'ète nare, ho la'e asa kota yerusalem.

source_text: and sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the samaritans, to make ready for him.
target_text: na pua dhèu lasi uuru, sèna ka ra lalau nganga'a-nganginu. ka dhèu lasi uuru se, maso lasi asa d'ara rae cue ètu propensi samaria, ho lalau mema era rèngu manubha.

source_text: and they did not receive him, because his face was as though he were going to jerusalem.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ètu samaria se, ro'o boe sèmi rare yesus si, lula nèngu neo la'e sogo-tagu ama lamatua ètu kota yerusalem.

source_text: and when his disciples james and john saw this, they said, lord, wilt thou that we bid fire to come down from heaven, and consume them?
target_text: ropa yakobis dènge yohanis tadèngi lii ne'e, ka ra pamako yesus, aku rèngu na, ama! tasamia na ti manèngi ama lamatua papuru ai mai nèti dedha-liru, ho tunu pakèpu si?

source_text: but he turned, and rebuked them.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ladhe asa dua ra, hèia na kai si, peka na, baku pangee sèmi èèna.

source_text: and they went to another village.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lasi hari asa rae leo.

source_text: and as they went on the way, a certain man said unto him, i will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
target_text: ropa rèngu kako era, dhèu èci lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama! ama neo asa mia èèna ka, ja'a neo madhutu ama taruu!

source_text: and jesus said unto him, the foxes have holes, and the birds of the heaven have nests; but the son of man hath not where to lay his head.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, be'a kahèi! te ngaa pangee ku laa. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dènge era pea-palu'u. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge badha-manu. busa hui lèpa la'e asa d'ara ro'a na. manu-bhui lasi asa d'ara rèd'a ra. te ngaa ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a, dènge boe era pea-palu'u ho pasoru iisi ja'a ne. era lalaka kètu, aad'o kahèi.

source_text: and he said unto another, follow me. but he said, lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus paroa dhèu leo ca dhèu, ka na peka, mai madhutu ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. ka dhèu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, be'a kahèi, do! te ngaa sèmi ne'e, ama. hud'i ja'a lèpa ku ladhe-leru ina-ama ja'a. ladhe padhane kore ama ku, heka ja'a madhutu kèna.

source_text: but he said unto him, leave the dead to bury their own dead; but go thou and publish abroad the kingdom of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ne, sèmi ne'e! hud'i laa dhèu dhu parcaya boe lamatua, uri dhèu rèngu dhu madhe. te ngaa miu dhu lèka lamatua, sasab'a miu lami peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: and another also said, i will follow thee, lord; but first suffer me to bid farewell to them that are at my house.
target_text: abhu dhèu leo dhu peka na, be'a kahèi. ja'a neo madhutu ama taruu. te ngaa hud'i ja'a laku palangu ku lii dènge a'ari ja'a, heka ja'a mai madhutu ama.

source_text: but jesus said unto him, no man, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ne, sèmi ne'e. ladhe dhèu neo pare rai, te ngaa tao hari ngaa-ngaa dhu leo, toke bhèlu sèle, tatu oka na j'aj'i boe. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu pama'ète nare le neo madhutu ja'a, te ngaa pangee taruu mamuri na lod'o dhu uru sèra. dhèu sèmi èèna gaguna na aad'o j'aj'i dhèu sab'a ètu d'ara paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: now after these things the lord appointed seventy others, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself was about to come.
target_text: èle èèna, yesus hag'e nare ana madhutu na dhu leo, pidhu nguru dua dhèu. ka na hag'e si, dua-dua dhèu, sèna ka lasi uuru asa era-era dhu nèngu neo la'e.

source_text: and he said unto them, the harvest indeed is plenteous, but the laborers are few: pray ye therefore the lord of the harvest, that he send forth laborers into his harvest.
target_text: hèia na pua si, aku nèngu na, abhu dhèu ae dhu nuka sèmi are dhu karara le. ka lamatua oka pua dhèu sab'a na lasi g'ètu are se. de miu hud'i sabaj'a, sèna ka ama lamatua hia tabha dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, ho oru rare dhèu-dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a. lula dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, ae. te ngaa dhèu sab'a dhoka ciki oo'e di.

source_text: go your ways; behold, i send you forth as lambs in the midst of wolves.
target_text: de lami ka! ja'a pua miu lami asa dhèu ae. te ngaa sanèd'e sèmi ne'e. miu èci èèna ka dènge ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu lami asa talora aae busa hui dhu bhelu.

source_text: carry no purse, no wallet, no shoes; and salute no man on the way.
target_text: miu baku mèti doi-dhari, tas tao mèdha-papake, do salapa dhu risi ètu d'ara kakako miu. mage core eele ai lod'o dènge padhai lii iia d'ara dènge dhèu ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: and into whatsoever house ye shall enter, first say, peace be to this house. and if a son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon him: but if not, it shall turn to you again. and in that same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the laborer is worthy of his hire. go not from house to house. and into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara rae èci, miu baku pidha-pidha era pea. ladhe dhèu sèmi rare miu dènge be'a ètu d'ara èmu cue, pea dhoka ètu èèna toke miu pakèd'i tèke eele rae èèna. ladhe miu maso asa èmu cue, miu hud'i manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu isi èmu èèna. ladhe lamatua èmu ètu sèra sèmi nare miu dènge be'a, tatu lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi isi èmu èèna. te ngaa ladhe ro'o boe sèmi miu, na, hud'i laa lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu mesa mi. ladhe miu maso asa èmu cue, do, asa rae èci, ra hia miu nganga'a, mi'a-minu laa dènge karej'e. te ra hia èèna pamèci dènge èi kabhèsu miu dhu hae.

source_text: and heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, the kingdom of god is come nigh unto you.
target_text: puri-pa'èle dhèu rèngu dhu pèd'a. aa peka-padhai dènge dhèu sèra, na, ‘paredha ama lamatua ètu katanga madha miu le! '

source_text: but into whatsoever city ye shall enter, and they receive you not, go out into the streets thereof and say,
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi rae dhu dhèu ra ro'o boe sèmi rare miu. ladhe ra tao miu sèmi èèna, na, lami titu asa j'ara-j'ara ètu d'ara rae èèna, mi lii dènge ra, peka na,

source_text: even the dust from your city, that cleaveth to our feet, we wipe off against you: nevertheless know this, that the kingdom of god is come nigh.
target_text: ‘nanene paie! miu dhèu dhu ètu d'ara rae ne. ji'i mai le ngèti lii lolo be'a lamatua hia miu, te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe. de ji'i caro eele ahu rae ne'e nèti haga ji'i, ho j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, pe bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere pala mi! te ngaa sanèd'e paie-iie! paredha ama lamatua ètu katanga madha miu le. '

source_text: i say unto you, it shall be more tolerable in that day for sodom, than for that city.
target_text: miu me'a, sina ma, bhabhelu dhèu kota sodom? ja'a pasanèd'e miu! bèli-camèd'a, d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ama lamatua huku dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare miu, bia risi nèti dhèu sodom!

source_text: woe unto thee, chorazin! woe unto thee, bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in tyre and sidon, which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mate unu miu dhu pea ètu rae korasin dènge miu ètu rae betsaida! miu dui mere j'aj'èra! ja'a tao tadha-tadha malaa ètu katanga madha miu, te ngaa miu mo'o boe parcaya lamatua. ngaa hari miu dhèu yahudi dhu peka na, miu tadhe ne. ladhe sèmi tadha-tadha malaa se, dhu ja'a tao ètu rae miu, lèke ètu kota tirus dènge kota sidon, tatu nèbhu nare sange ne'e dhèu sèra ele-ho'a le, aa ra tèke eele sasala-sasigo ra, ho mai madhutu lamatua. aa rèngu tatu pake le mèdha sasusa, dènge tao ahu ètu kètu ra j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, rèngu manyasa nèti sasala-sasigo ra. te ngaa dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon sèra, dhèu yahudi boe. de ra peka boe, na, rèngu dhèu dhu tadhe lamatua.

source_text: but it shall be more tolerable for tyre and sidon in the judgment, than for you.
target_text: tare'a! miu ladhe ku laa! bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i, hahuku nèti lamatua mi dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon samaa risi nèti hahuku miu.

source_text: and thou, capernaum, shalt thou be exalted unto heaven? thou shalt be brought down unto hades.
target_text: mata unu miu, kabarai kapernaum! miu baku pangee, na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua nedhe miu pamaso asa d'ara sorga. aad'o! mola-mèu èi! èèna na lamatua pèci miu asa d'ara naraka lami!

source_text: he that heareth you heareth me; and he that rejecteth you rejecteth me; and he that rejecteth me rejecteth him that sent me.
target_text: sanèd'e pabe'a-be'a. dhèu dhu nanene lii miu, nuka sèmi rèngu nanene ja'a. aa dhèu dhu pusi boe nanene miu, èci èèna ka ra pahae boe ja'a. aa dhèu dhu ro'o boe nanene ja'a, èci èèna ka dènge rèngu dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua, dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: and the seventy returned with joy, saying, lord, even the demons are subject unto us in thy name.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu pidhu nguru dua sèra lèpa hari mai, d'ara ra karej'e bia. ka ra lole dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ira ii! kakako ji'i ne, be'a bia! ropa ji'i pake kolongara ama ho babège eele nidhu, na, nidhu sèra nanene lii ji'i, hèia ra rai bhalèta.

source_text: and he said unto them, i beheld satan fallen as lightning from heaven.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, peka na, mema tare'a! lod'o miu tao sèra sa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi ama lamatua pèci eele nidhu dènge dhèu aae ra nèti dedha-liru nèi, nuka sèmi bela dhu kaha'a nèti haa, nèti dhimu!

source_text: behold, i have given you authority to tread upon serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall in any wise hurt you.
target_text: sanèd'e! dhèu aae nidhu èèna, musu èdhi. aa nèngu dènge koasa kahèi. te ngaa ja'a pangèd'u le miu koasa, ho palaho koasa na. ladhe miu j'èli lèke kaisao, do karaka rai, miu ngaa-ngaa tao boe. ngaa èci sa bisa boe paj'èra miu.

source_text: nevertheless in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.
target_text: miu karej'e lula nidhu nanene miu. be'a kahèi, te ngaa sèra sa ana iiki era! dhu be'a risi, d'ara miu karej'e, lula lamatua suri nare le ngara miu, j'aj'i ana kabarai na ètu sorga.

source_text: in that same hour he rejoiced in the holy spirit, and said, i thank thee, o father, lord of heaven and earth, that thou didst hide these things from the wise and understanding, and didst reveal them unto babes: yea, father; for so it was well-pleasing in thy sight.
target_text: lod'o èèna, roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci tao d'ara yesus karej'e-karae. hèia na koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ama dhu j'aj'i lamatua ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae, lula ama pa'abhe j'ara-j'ara se'e nèti dhèu dhu tao iisi d'èlu-mèu dènge dhèu lela dedha. te ngaa ama bhoke patalele aa'i-aa'i se hia mi ana iiki-ana iiki dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu pahaha iisi. tare'a ama! lula èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama!

source_text: all things have been delivered unto me of my father: and no one knoweth who the son is, save the father; and who the father is, save the son, and he to whomsoever the son willeth to reveal him.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, nanene paie! ama ku ètu sorga pangèd'u aa'i le koasa mi ja'a. dhu tadhe mèu, ja'a ne cee, dhoka ama di. aa dhu tadhe mèu, ama èèna cee, dhoka ana nèti ama di, nuka ja'a ne. aa ja'a hag'e kore dhèu leo, sèna ka nori si, ho ra tadhe mèu nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and turning to the disciples, he said privately, blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
target_text: ka yesus kabib'a asa ana madhutu na, hèia na peka dènge rèngu mesa ra, aku nèngu na, miu se oto titu kèna, lula mèdhi le koasa lamatua.

source_text: for i say unto you, that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which ye see, and saw them not; and to hear the things which ye hear, and heard them not.
target_text: dhèu aae-dhèu aae dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua uru-uru sèra, d'èi titu kèna neo rèdhi ngaa dhu miu limuri ne mèdhi, te ngaa rèdhi boe. rèngu d'èi kahèi neo tadèngi ngaa dhu miu nanene ne, te ngaa ra tadèngi rèdhi boe.

source_text: and behold, a certain lawyer stood up and made trial of him, saying, teacher, what shall i do to inherit eternal life?
target_text: ca tèka, ca dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi, titu ho neo sèku pamanahu yesus. na karèi peka na, ama mese! mu peka ku laa! ja'a ad'u j'ara sèmi ngaa, sèna ka ja'a mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga?

source_text: and he said unto him, what is written in the law? how readest thou?
target_text: ka yesus b'ala ne, aku nèngu na, musa suri tasamia lula-nèti j'ara ne'e ne? aa madhutu mame'a èu, tasamia?

source_text: and he answering said, thou shalt love the lord thy god with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbor as thyself.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne dhaa peka na, na suri sèmi ne'e ka: ‘èu hud'i sue ku ama lamatua, risi nèti ngaa-ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra. nèti èèna ka, d'ara èu hud'i d'èi nèngu titu kèna, sab'a pa'èra ho madhutu dad'èi na, aa tadhe mèu ne. ' dhu suri kahèi, peka na, ‘èu hud'i sue ku dhèu èu, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu mesa mu. '

source_text: and he said unto him, thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala ne, dhu lèke kèna! ladhe èu tao madhutu sèmi sèra, na, èu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: but he, desiring to justify himself, said unto jesus, and who is my neighbor?
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ne, tao iisi na sèmi dhèu mola sa. ka na karèi hari yesus, aku nèngu na, te ngaa, ‘dhèu ja'a' èèna, ka cee?

source_text: jesus made answer and said, a certain man was going down from jerusalem to jericho; and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala ne, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo lolo dènge èu lii pakasame èci. pe èu mesa mu ka dhu peka, na, mia ka dhu tare'a-re'a ‘dhèu èu'. lii pakasame ne, sèmi ne'e ka: ca lod'o, abhu dhèu yahudi ca dhèu pakèd'i nèti kota yerusalem, puru la'e asa kota jeriko. te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, cag'ag'a laa parapo mai game paroe ne. ra game, aa parame rare aa'i doi-dhari dènge mèdha-papake dhèu ne. ka parapo se core ne asa sebhe j'ara la'e, aa ra rai tèke eele ne. dhèu ne, oe madhe.

source_text: and by chance a certain priest was going down that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu boe, ka ama agama yahudi ca dhèu puru mai re j'ara èèna. te ngaa ropa na ladhe nèdhi dhèu ne dhu diu raa, aa dhu tarenga ètu sebhe j'ara, ama agama ne titu boe sa hèi, ho uri dhèu ne. na kako paseli eele dhèu ne'e, la'e asa cabèka j'ara, ka na taruu.

source_text: and in like manner a levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka dhèu leo hari èci kako re èèna. nèngu ne nèti suku lewi dhu tema sab'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. ropa nèdhi dhèu ne dhu baa-baa ètu sebhe j'ara, hèia la'e padètu-dètu ho ladhe, te ngaa na bara boe ne kahèi. na sigo eele j'ara, ka la'e taruu.

source_text: but a certain samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he was moved with compassion, and came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on them oil and wine; and he set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu èci nèti rai samaria mai re j'ara èèna dènge badha keled'ei na. dhèu yahudi pahae boe dhèu samaria. te ngaa ropa dhèu samaria ne nèdhi dhèu dhu lèke rapo èèna, ka d'ara na mèke boe. na mai padètu-dètu ho neo sarad'e ne. ka pamèu nu'a dhèu ne dènge èi anggor, hèia na pana'i dènge èi mènyi. aa na parbaan nu'a na, èle ka na paca'e asa keled'ei na. hèia nèti ne la'e asa d'ara kota. na pamaso ne asa d'ara losmen, aa lalau pabe'a-be'a ne.

source_text: and on the morrow he took out two shillings, and gave them to the host, and said, take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, i, when i come back again, will repay thee.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae èèna, dhèu ne la'e b'ae uuru kètu, doi iia dua bua mi lamatua losmen ne, ka na peka, ‘pake uuru doi ne ho lalau dhèu ne toke èle. ladhe d'ai boe, pake uuru doi èu. pe ja'a lèpa, pula hari doi sèra. '

source_text: which of these three, thinkest thou, proved neighbor unto him that fell among the robbers?
target_text: lii pakasame yesus ne d'ai sange ne'e ka. hèia yesus karèi mi dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi ne, aku nèngu na, madhutu èu, mia ka dhu tare'a-re'a ‘dhèu nèngu, ' mi dhèu dhu lèke rapo ne?

source_text: and he said, he that showed mercy on him. and jesus said unto him, go, and do thou likewise.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, tatu dhèu dhu lalau ne toke èle. hèia yesus lii, peka na, tare'a! de lamu ka, tao madhutu sèmi èèna.

source_text: now as they went on their way, he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named martha received him into her house. and she had a sister called mary, who also sat at the lord's feet, and heard his word. but martha was cumbered about much serving; and she came up to him, and said, lord, dost thou not care that my sister did leave me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, lasi taruu asa yerusalem. hèia ra dhuli ètu rae èci. ètu era ne'e, dhèu dua dhu pa'a'ari, ngara ra, marta dènge maria. marta manèngi ho yesus si manubha ètu èmu rèngu. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna. ropa yesus madhèdi ho aj'a si, marta bhute dènge pananasu. te ngaa ari na maria, madhèdi padètu-dètu haga yesus, ho nanene lii padhai na. nèbhu boe ka marta mai ka'ugu ètu madha yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! tasamia, ee? ja'a d'ai madhe lalau nganga'a-nganginu mesa-mesa ku, te ngaa ari ja'a madhèdi mau-mau. peka ku dènge ne laa, sèna ka mai bara ja'a ètu dapu ne.

source_text: but the lord answered and said unto her, martha, martha, thou art anxious and troubled about many things:
target_text: te ngaa lamatua yesus dhaa, na, marta. èu ne bhute dènge ngangee rupa-rupa.

source_text: but one thing is needful: for mary hath chosen the good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
target_text: be'a kahèi do, te ngaa j'ara èci dhu be'a risi. maria pili nare dhu be'a risi le, nuka madhèdi ho nanene lii lolo be'a nèti ja'a. dhèu bisa boe parame rare nèti nèngu lii lolo be'a ne.

source_text: and it came to pass, as he was praying in a certain place, that when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, lord, teach us to pray, even as john also taught his disciples.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus la'e manèngi-mangaj'i. manèngi-mangaj'i nare, hèia ana madhutu na ca dhèu mai, ka na manèngi, aku nèngu na, ama! yohanis tuka sarani, aj'a ana madhutu na ka re'a sabaj'a. ji'i manèngi sèna ka ama aj'a ji'i sabaj'a kahèi.

source_text: and he said unto them, when ye pray, say, father, hallowed be thy name. thy kingdom come.
target_text: ka yesus peka, na, be'a! sabaj'a pake conto sèmi ne'e: ama! kolongara ama dhu mola-mèci. hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara ama dhu kapai na. hud'i laa ama j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: give us day by day our daily bread.
target_text: ama hia laa ji'i bèli-bèli, nganga'a dhu d'ai.

source_text: and forgive us our sins; for we ourselves also forgive every one that is indebted to us. and bring us not into temptation.
target_text: ji'i manèngi ama pabhèlu eele sasala-sasigo ji'i, nuka sèmi ji'i kahèi pabhèlu eele sasala-sasala dhèu dhu tao mi dedha ji'i. ama magee ji'i, sèna ka ji'i baku ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and he said unto them, which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say to him, friend, lend me three loaves; for a friend of mine is come to me from a journey, and i have nothing to set before him;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus nori hari si, j'ara-j'ara sabaj'a. na pake upama, peka na, sèmi d'ai talora mèda, angalai èu mai nèti kaj'èu, ho manubha ètu èmu èu. te ngaa èu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, sèna ka hia ne na'a. ka èu lamu asa èmu angalai dhu leo, ho pamako nèti li'u, peka na, ‘lai aae na, ee! hia taha ku ja'a roti d'ai tèlu bua sa! te ji'i abhu tamu ètu èmu, te ngaa ji'i dhu mola-mèu èi! de lai aae na, ee! dhoka tèlu bua di. pe ja'a g'ati hari! '

source_text: and he from within shall answer and say, trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; i cannot rise and give thee?
target_text: ladhe sèmi angalai èu dhaa, peka na, ‘te a'a, ee! dhèu bhèj'i luu, na, èu mai parèi! babèdho dhu patèke le! ana iiki se dhu bhèj'i aa'i le. de mage mu nasa kahèi! pe lod'o leo hari ku laa! '

source_text: i say unto you, though he will not rise and give him because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will arise and give him as many as he needeth.
target_text: te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, ngee paie-iie. masi ka dhèu ne kèd'i boe lula èu angalai nèngu, te ngaa ladhe èu loe boe pamako, tatu na kèd'i, ho hia èu roti sèra.

source_text: and i say unto you, ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge manèngi-mangaj'i. manèngi taruu mi lamatua; pe na hia. tenge taruu; pe na paj'uj'u j'ara. paroa taruu; pe na bhoke hèb'a èmu.

source_text: for every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu manèngi taruu mi ama lamatua, èèna na rèngu sèmi. dhu loe boe tenge, èèna na abhu. dhu ma'ète boe paroa, pe na bhoke babèdho.
