source_text: and of which of you that is a father shall his son ask a loaf, and he give him a stone? or a fish, and he for a fish give him a serpent?
target_text: miu pangee ku laa. abhu ètu mia ladhe ama, dhu ana na manèngi i'a, na hia mege?

source_text: or if he shall ask an egg, will he give him a scorpion?
target_text: do, ladhe ana manèngi kanadhu manu, na hia karaka rai? tatu aad'o, si?

source_text: if ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your heavenly father give the holy spirit to them that ask him?
target_text: dhèu rai-haha ne, mema bhelu. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga, nèngu ne mema be'a. de ladhe miu dhèu dhu bhelu, d'èi hia mèdha dhu be'a mi ana-ana miu, ngaa hari ama! nèngu ne hia, mesa boe ngaa dhu miu parluu, te ngaa risi nèti èèna. na pala-bagi roh na dhu mola-mèci mi dhèu dhu manèngi mi nèngu.

source_text: and he was casting out a demon that was dumb. and it came to pass, when the demon was gone out, the dumb man spake; and the multitudes marvelled.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus magèle eele nidhu nèti ca dhèu dhu lii aad'o. ka dhèu ne bisa padhai lii hari. dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra malaa.

source_text: but some of them said, by beelzebub the prince of the demons casteth he out demons.
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu peka na, mema, nèngu bisa magèle eele nidhu, lula nèngu abhu koasa nèti dhèu aae nidhu, nuka baalsebul.

source_text: and others, trying him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
target_text: abhu dhèu leo neo sèku yesus. ka ra manèngi ho yesus tao tadha malaa èci hari, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, koasa na nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: but he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a nare le kahadhu kaj'alu rèngu sèra. ka na lii, peka na, ladhe ètu rai cue, kabarai na pamusu, tatu rai ne laho mae-mae. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe ètu d'ara èmu cue, isi èmu loe boe patao-palaha, tatu èmu ne j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci!

source_text: and if satan also is divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that i cast out demons by beelzebub.
target_text: de ladhe nidhu se pamusu aa pabata èci dènge èci, tatu dhèu aae ra bisa boe rèd'u paredha dènge nèbhu. de maso boe asa d'ara kahadhu, ladhe miu peka, na, ja'a pake koasa nidhu ho bata eele hari nidhu.

source_text: and if i by beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu miu kahèi dhu re'a magèle eele nidhu. rèngu pake koasa nèti nidhu, do? aad'o, si! de miu baku sad'i padhai lii di, dhu peka na, ja'a ne pake koasa nidhu sèna ka bata eele si. pe dhèu miu ka dhu pama'ète, peka na, ngaa dhu miu galaa ne, lèke boe.

source_text: but if i by the finger of god cast out demons, then is the kingdom of god come upon you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ja'a tare'a-re'a bata nidhu pake koasa ama lamatua, èèna dhu peka na, paredha lamatua ètu katanga madha miu le. paredha ne abhu le, te ngaa miu oe sèmi pame'a boe sa.

source_text: when the strong man fully armed guardeth his own court, his goods are in peace:
target_text: ladhe dhèu èra èci dènge rèka, dhu bori tèke ètu keja g'ana-kariu madhenge èmu na, tatu mèdha-panyau na, dhèu bani boe lasi mana'u.

source_text: but when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him his whole armor wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu èra risi nèti nèngu mai segi ne, aa parame nèti rèka na. hèia na parame nèti mèdha-panyau na kahèi, ho papala mi dhèu-dhèu na. nèbhu nare sange ne'e lamatua èmu èèna maena dhoka mi rèka na. te ngaa limuri ne, na maena heka rèka na sèra.

source_text: he that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! dhèu dhu pa'èci boe dènge ja'a, nèngu musu ja'a. aa dhèu dhu soru-bara boe ètu d'ara sasab'a ja'a, nèngu ne'a dhoka ad'u-ue j'ara maruru di.

source_text: the unclean spirit when he is gone out of the man, passeth through waterless places, seeking rest, and finding none, he saith, i will turn back unto my house whence i came out.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, ladhe èdhi bata eele nidhu nèti ca dhèu, nidhu ne rai la'e asa era kaliu, ho tenge era ae iisi. lula na abhu boe era dhu pamèci dènge dad'èi na, hèia na pangee na, ‘aah! abhu boe era ae iisi, be'a risi ja'a lèpa hari asa dhèu dhu uru èèna ja'a pea. '

source_text: and when he is come, he findeth it swept and garnished.
target_text: ropa na lèpa, rage hari era uru èèna, dhu mèu le, aa dhu lalau pabe'a-be'a.

source_text: then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more evil than himself; and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man becometh worse than the first.
target_text: hèia nidhu ne la'e paroa angalai na pidhu dhu bhelu risi nèti nèngu. ka aa'i-aa'i ra lasi pea ètu dhèu èèna, ka ra madahu ne. de lèpa limuri, mamuri dhèu ne asa aae ka ele iie.

source_text: and it came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said unto him, blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the breasts which thou didst suck.
target_text: lod'o yesus padhai lii era dènge dhèu ae sèra, dhèu bhèni èci ètu èèna pa'oo, peka na, ina mu oto kapai, lula nara iisi èu, aa pasusu èu!

source_text: but he said, yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of god, and keep it.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala ne, peka na, tare'a ina! te ngaa dhu oto risi, nuka dhèu dhu pasa dhilu ho nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua aa tao madhutu!

source_text: and when the multitudes were gathering together unto him, he began to say, this generation is an evil generation: it seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it but the sign of jonah.
target_text: lod'o yesus padhai lii era, dhèu oke rare ne, hèia na peka, dhèu limuri ne re'a dhoka ad'u-ue bhabhelu di. rèngu loe boe manèngi ho ja'a tao tadha malaa hia rèngu, sèna ka re'a, na, ja'a ne tare'a-re'a dhèu unu lamatua. te ngaa lamatua dhu tao le tadha malaa uru èèna, re dhèu nèti lii padhai na, nuka yunus. èèna na d'ai le!

source_text: for even as jonah became a sign unto the ninevites, so shall also the son of man be to this generation.
target_text: ngaa dhu lèke mi dedha yunus èèna, j'aj'i tadha hia dhèu ètu kota niniwe, peka na, ama lamatua ka dhu paleha ne mai. èci èèna ka dènge dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. ngaa dhu lèke mi ja'a, èèna na j'aj'i mi tadha hia dhèu limuri ne, dhu peka na, mema ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: the queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and shall condemn them: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of solomon; and behold, a greater than solomon is here.
target_text: ladhe lod'o d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua j'aj'i ka hakim, pe bhèni aae nèti balèu mamuri hari ho na j'aj'i sakasii. na paj'uj'u ho galaa miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu mamuri taa limuri ne, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi se, goa! ' te uru èèna, bhèni aae mai nèti j'ara kaj'èu, ho nèdhi dènge madha na, mamèu dhèu aae soleman. te ngaa limuri ne abhu dhèu ètu talora aae miu, dhu kapai risi nèti dhèu aae soleman. te ngaa miu pusi boe ne!

source_text: the men of nineveh shall stand up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of jonah; and behold, a greater than jonah is here.
target_text: mesa boe nèngu di! èèna na dhèu-dhèu nèti niniwe kèd'i titu ho paj'uj'u ai asa miu dhu mamuri limuri ne, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi se, goa! ' ra peka sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna, ropa yunus la'e peka dad'èi lamatua dènge rèngu, hèia ra ele-ho'a dènge. masi ka dhèu dhu kapai risi nèti yunus ètu talora aae miu, te ngaa mo'o boe ele-ho'a sa hèi.

source_text: no man, when he hath lighted a lamp, putteth it in a cellar, neither under the bushel, but on the stand, that they which enter in may see the light.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, dhèu suru labhu, na padhèdi ètu era dhu dedha, sèna ka pasaraa d'ara kama hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu maso asa era èèna. abhu ètu mia dhèu suru labhu, ho saguru ne dènge soe, sèna ka pahuni ne! èèna guna boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: the lamp of thy body is thine eye: when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when it is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
target_text: musi madha miu èci èèna ka dènge labhu. nèngu ka dhu pasaraa d'ara miu. ladhe musi madha maroga, dhèu ladhe ngaa aa'i-aa'i dènge d'ara dhu maroga. te ngaa ladhe musi madha mèu, dhèu rèdhi dènge d'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: look therefore whether the light that is in thee be not darkness.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka saraa ètu d'ara miu, j'aj'i mèu aae sèmi saraa madha lod'o. saraa ètu d'ara miu, mage sèmi heo hèru, dhu pad'elo dhoka mamaho di.

source_text: if therefore thy whole body be full of light, having no part dark, it shall be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining doth give thee light.
target_text: ladhe d'ara miu saraa, abhu boe sasanga èci sa dhu maroga, tatu mamuri miu j'aj'i mèu, nuka sèmi labhu aae dhu d'elo mamuri miu.

source_text: now as he spake, a pharisee asketh him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
target_text: yesus padhai lii nare, ka dhèu èci nèti partei agama parisi nèru ne, lasi ra'a asa èmu na. d'ai d'ara èmu èèna, ka yesus madhèdi ètu mei ra'a.

source_text: and when the pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first bathed himself before dinner.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua èmu ne malaa ladhe yesus madhèdi na'a, dhu j'amo uru boe ai, madhutu atora dhèu parisi.

source_text: and the lord said unto him, now ye the pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter; but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, eeh! miu dhèu parisi se seli-kolane! miu kèpe pa'èra atora agama miu! miu bhèlu boe rase pega dènge galaa re li'u toke kale'e, te ngaa sanèd'e boe ho pamèu d'ara miu dhu kaj'alu, dhu bhelu-katub'a dènge manga'a dèu ngara!

source_text: ye foolish ones, did not he that made the outside make the inside also?
target_text: goa, ee! baku bhèlu. ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i re li'u, aa tao re d'ara kahèi.

source_text: but give for alms those things which are within; and behold, all things are clean unto you.
target_text: te ngaa dhu be'a risi eele, miu pala-bagi dhèu dènge boe unu sèra, nèti ngaa dhu miu unu, sèna ka miu mola ètu katanga madha lamatua.

source_text: but woe unto you pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and every herb, and pass over justice and the love of god: but these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
target_text: miu dhèu parisi! bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! ca pala nèti canguru pala dhu miu hia mi lamatua, miu pa'iga taruu nèti dhu ana iiki toke kapai. toke bubhu-lara dhu ana iiki-iiki d'ara oka, miu pa'iga hèi! te ngaa miu pusi boe dènge j'ara dhu kapai risi. j'ara-j'ara sasue mi ama lamatua, aa dènge boe bia cabèka, miu pabhèlu eele! mema tare'a, èdhi hud'i hia ku pala lamatua, te ngaa baku bhèlu kahèi dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi sèra.

source_text: woe unto you pharisees! for ye love the chief seats in the synagogues, and the salutations in the marketplaces.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu d'èi dhoka tenge era re madha ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, aa d'èi dhèu pakab'ua miu ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: woe unto you! for ye are as the tombs which appear not, and the men that walk over them know it not.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu nuka sèmi ro'a dhèu madhe dhu pamera le dènge rai. dhèu kako re dedha, te ngaa re'a boe, na, ètu èèna na abhu ro'a dhèu madhe, lula ro'a èèna ètu dedha na tèdhi na mèu, te ngaa d'ara na laho kao-kao. masi ka madhutu ad'a èdhi, ladhe dhèu j'èli lèke ro'a dhèu madhe, pakaj'alu ngi'u na, de nèngu nia boe maso asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a. miu dhèu parisi se, ca ropa dènge ro'a dhèu madhe èèna! re li'u, miu mèu titu kèna. te ngaa ètu d'ara miu pènu dènge kaj'alu. dhèu dhu padètu dènge miu, j'aj'i mi kaj'alu kahèi.

source_text: and one of the lawyers answering saith unto him, teacher, in saying this thou reproachest us also.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu ca dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi. ropa na tadèngi lii yesus, ka b'ala dènge, aku nèngu na, lii padhai ama deo na, lèke mi dedha ji'i!

source_text: and he said, woe unto you lawyers also! for ye load men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala lii na, peka na, tare'a! miu dhèu d'èlu-mèu agama yahudi, hud'i dui mamadhe-mamopo kahèi! miu soru boe dhèu ho pasamaa si, te ngaa miu asa pasusa si dènge j'ara pabia atora agama miu. ka miu pua dhèu sèra pasae rupa-rupa babia nèti atora miu sèra. te ngaa miu mesa mi, mo'o boe pasae babia ne dènge kacui-aai miu ca laa sa hèi!

source_text: woe unto you! for ye build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu bhute dhoka pudhi hadhu tao tugu hia dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu uru sèra, sèna ka pakab'ua si. te ngaa bèi-baki miu se'e ka dhu pamadhe si!

source_text: so ye are witnesses and consent unto the works of your fathers: for they killed them, and ye build their tombs.
target_text: miu èci èèna kahèi dènge bèi-baki miu sèra. rèngu tule eele dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, ka ra pamadhe si. hèia miu dame hadhu ro'a ho j'aj'i tadha, peka na, miu se mo'o kahèi dènge tatao bèi-baki miu.

source_text: therefore also said the wisdom of god, i will send unto them prophets and apostles; and some of them they shall kill and persecute;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua dhu ne'a aa'i, peka nèdhi le, na, ‘pe ja'a pua dhèu rèti lii padhai ja'a, dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu leo, sèna ka lasi asa dhèu sèra. hèia dhèu sèra kalabhe paj'èra cahag'e, aa cahag'e hari ra pamadhe si. '

source_text: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation; from the blood of abel unto the blood of zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary: yea, i say unto you, it shall be required of this generation.
target_text: dhèu taa limuri ne, hud'i tago rare tatao nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. sèra sa, mulai ige nèti lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, karèi nèti mamadhe habel, toke d'ai dhèu dhu limuri tèka, nuka sakaria. nèngu ne'e ka dhu ra pamadhe ne ètu talora aae mei korban dènge kama mola-mèci ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. miu se kahèi pasae mere hahuku ra!

source_text: woe unto you lawyers! for ye took away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
target_text: miu dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi! bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu dhu mèd'u gagoe ho bisa bhoke babèdho, sèna ka dhèu re'a mèu dad'èi ama lamatua. te ngaa miu mesa mi maso boe asa d'ara. dhu karehe risi hari, miu pahèb'e dhèu, ho baku ra lasi asa èèna!

source_text: and when he was come out from thence, the scribes and the pharisees began to press upon him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things; laying wait for him, to catch something out of his mouth.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, ka mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra jèke ne. karèi nèti lod'o èèna ka, rèngu karèi rupa-rupa j'ara, sèna ka neo pamanahu ne. ra loe boe tenge j'ara ho pabèbhe ne.

source_text: in the mean time, when the many thousands of the multitude were gathered together, insomuch that they trod one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, beware ye of the leaven of the pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu pèri-pèri riho dhu mai ho nanene lii padhai yesus. dhèu se mai pasuki, lingu rare ne. ka na peka uru dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, j'aga ngi'u ho baku madhutu j'ara mamuri dhèu parisi. te rèngu padhai lii leo, tao leo.

source_text: but there is nothing covered up, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
target_text: rèngu sangaja be'a, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a abhu hui. te aa'i-aa'i dhu pahuni ne, bèli-camèd'a sabhoka.

source_text: wherefore whatsoever ye have said in the darkness shall be heard in the light; and what ye have spoken in the ear in the inner chambers shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
target_text: ngaa dhu deo ne'e miu padhai pahuni, bèli-camèd'a dhèu tadèngi dènge mèu. ngaa dhu miu paholo ètu d'ara kama, èèna na dhèu peka paled'a ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: and i say unto you my friends, be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, ana-ana, ee! mage miu madha'u, ladhe dhèu neo pamadhe miu. te rèngu pamadhe dhoka ngi'u aae di, te ngaa ra bisa boe tao ngaa mi samanga miu.

source_text: but i will warn you whom ye shall fear: fear him, who after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, i say unto you, fear him.
target_text: de ja'a neo peka, na, miu hud'i madha'u mi cee ku. miu hud'i madha'u ku dènge ama lamatua. te nèngu ka dhu bisa pamadhe miu, aa pèci asa d'ara ai naraka. de miu hud'i madha'u tare'a-re'a mi nèngu.

source_text: are not five sparrows sold for two pence? and not one of them is forgotten in the sight of god.
target_text: miu pangee sèku, ana mangungu kab'ua ca ngaa? mura titu kèna! lèmi ngi'u, dua doi, si? masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua bhèlu boe ci'u sa hèi.

source_text: but the very hairs of your head are all numbered. fear not: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
target_text: aa sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua tao ai-hèb'a mi miu. lamatua ne'a mèu, abhu rèu kètu pèri loa ètu kaba kètu miu. de miu baku madha'u, te lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti ana mangungu ae-ae sèra.

source_text: and i say unto you, every one who shall confess me before men, him shall the son of man also confess before the angels of god:
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, pasa dhilu miu paie-iie! ladhe dhèu bani mangaku ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae ètu rai-haha ne, pe ja'a mangaku nèngu kahèi ètu madha ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga, peka na, nèngu ne dhèu ja'a.

source_text: but he that denieth me in the presence of men shall be denied in the presence of the angels of god.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu padhai lii ètu madha dhèu rai-haha, peka na, nèngu tadhe boe ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ètu madha ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga, ja'a tadhe boe nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and every one who shall speak a word against the son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the holy spirit it shall not be forgiven.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu padhai pakarehe kolongara ja'a, ama lamatua sadia ho pabhèlu eele sasala na era. te ngaa ladhe na padhai pakarehe kolongara roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, ama lamatua bhèlu boe sasala na.

source_text: and when they bring you before the synagogues, and the rulers, and the authorities, be not anxious how or what ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
target_text: ladhe dhèu ère rèti miu asa era uri lii langu agama, do, rèti miu asa dhèu paredha, lula miu parcaya ja'a, mage miu pangee, na, tasamia miu bisa siri iisi.

source_text: for the holy spirit shall teach you in that very hour what ye ought to say.
target_text: te ètu d'ara lai-lai èèna kahèi, roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, peka dènge miu lii dhu pamèci ho b'ala dhèu sèra.

source_text: and one out of the multitude said unto him, teacher, bid my brother divide the inheritance with me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ca dhèu nèti dhèu ae sèra, karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, ama mese! peka ku dènge a'a ku, ho pabagi dènge ja'a pusaka ama ji'i.

source_text: but he said unto him, man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala ne, waa! dhèu cee ka dhu ded'e ja'a j'aj'i hakim, sèna ka pama'ète lii langu miu sèmi èèna?

source_text: and he said unto them, take heed, and keep yourselves from all covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mi dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e, ee! miu baku j'aj'i dhèu manga'a. te kakaja-sasu'i bisa boe nèti mamuri dhu mera-milu.

source_text: and he spake a parable unto them, saying, the ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
target_text: èle ka, na padhai lii pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, dhèu kaja ca dhèu, isi oka na ae titu kèna.

source_text: and he reasoned within himself, saying, what shall i do, because i have not where to bestow my fruits?
target_text: ka èmu-èmu dhu tèka nganga'a na pènu tao cacèci, aa risi eele hèi, ka ne'a heka tao tasamia.

source_text: and he said, this will i do: i will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will i bestow all my grain and my goods.
target_text: ka na pama'ète, peka na, ‘ja'a neo tao sèmi ne'e ka! èmu era tèka nganga'a dhu dhui se, ja'a sag'e eele ho patitu hari dhu kapai risi, sèna ka tèke nganga'a nèti d'ara oka dènge mèdha-panyau ja'a aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and i will say to my soul, soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, be merry.
target_text: ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, ja'a pama'ète kore, na, gud'a pènu le! nganga'a tesa le, ku'a d'ai tèu-tèu. de ku'a-kinu pakarej'e iisi dènge pacapa haga! '

source_text: but god said unto him, thou foolish one, this night is thy soul required of thee; and the things which thou hast prepared, whose shall they be?
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka dènge ne, na, ‘heeh! dhèu goa! mèda ne'e kahèi, èu madhe. aa cee ka dhu abhu aa'i isi gud'a èu sèra? '

source_text: so is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward god.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e! bisa kahèi, dhèu pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu rai-haha ne hia ngi'u na, te ngaa ètu d'ara ngangee ama lamatua, nèngu ne, dhèu unu aad'o, lula pabe'a boe dènge lamatua.

source_text: and he said unto his disciples, therefore i say unto you, be not anxious for your life, what ye shall eat; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on.
target_text: ka yesus aj'a tabha hari ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, miu mage dhoka pangee mamuri miu bèli-bèli, nèti nganga'a-nganginu, do mèdha-papake.

source_text: for the life is more than the food, and the body than the raiment.
target_text: te mamuri èdhi ne risi nèti ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, aa ngaa dhu èdhi pake.

source_text: consider the ravens, that they sow not, neither reap; which have no store-chamber nor barn; and god feedeth them: of how much more value are ye than the birds!
target_text: ladhe sèku lakaa! rèngu sèra sèla boe, puu-g'ètu boe, dènge boe gud'a ho tèke nganga'a, te ngaa ama lamatua kab'oi si. ladhe sèmi èèna, tatu nèngu piara miu kahèi. lula na pakab'ua miu risi nèti manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: and which of you by being anxious can add a cubit unto the measure of his life?
target_text: sèmi dhèu titu ètu madha tèru, ho lalau iisi na, nèngu bisa pamadhera mamuri na, do? aad'o, sina ma!

source_text: if then ye are not able to do even that which is least, why are ye anxious concerning the rest?
target_text: de ladhe bhute dènge ngaa-ngaa dhu ana iiki sèra, dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, tasamia hari ka miu bhute dènge madha j'ara dhu kapai? a'oto na ngaa?

source_text: consider the lilies, how they grow: they toil not, neither do they spin; yet i say unto you, even solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
target_text: ladhe sèku bunga dhu muri tab'a ètu d'ara j'ami. rèngu sab'a boe oka-tedhe, aa ra manènu boe sig'i-rabhi. te ngaa mèdha-papake dhèu aae soleman dhu kab'ua aae, saraga risi boe hela bunga dhu muri tab'a ètu d'ara j'ami sèra.

source_text: but if god doth so clothe the grass in the field, which to-day is, and to-morrow is cast into the oven; how much more shall he clothe you, o ye of little faith?
target_text: te ama lamatua piara j'u'u dhu ana iiki-iiki dhu kab'ua aad'o, dhu dhoka mamuri deo ne'e, aa bèli madhe, ho dhèu core asa d'ara ai. ladhe sèmi èèna, na, nèngu bisa kab'oi miu dhu kab'ua risi eele nèti j'u'u sèra. de tasamia ka parcaya miu èra boe mi lamatua?

source_text: and seek not ye what ye shall eat, and what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, miu baku bhute dènge nganga'a-nganginu. te èèna na, lamatua uri hia miu.

source_text: for all these things do the nations of the world seek after: but your father knoweth that ye have need of these things.
target_text: dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua, rèngu sèra sab'a toke madhe, sèna ka tao j'ara sèra. te ngaa miu baku sèmi rèngu, te ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a aa'i le ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: yet seek ye his kingdom, and these things shall be added unto you.
target_text: te ngaa pakako uuru ku sasab'a ama lamatua, pe na uri j'ara se'e hia miu kahèi.

source_text: fear not, little flock; for it is your father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, miu nuka sèmi cakaboko iiki kahib'i-kalèbho dhu èra boe. te ngaa baku madha'u! te ama miu ètu sorga, dhèu aae kapai. ngaa dhu unu nèngu, na hia mi ana-ana na dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: sell that which ye have, and give alms; make for yourselves purses which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief draweth near, neither moth destroyeth.
target_text: de lami pahie mèdha-panyau miu, ho kab'ua na pabagi dènge dhèu dhu dènge boe unu. dènge sèmi èèna, miu tèke le mèdha-panyau miu ètu sorga ètu era dhu ele iie boe taa-taa. dhèu mana'u bisa boe lasi mana'u rare. ana cangèpi bisa boe pa'ele iie.

source_text: for where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! mèdha-panyau miu ètu mia, na, d'ara miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: let your loins be girded about, and your lamps burning; and be ye yourselves like unto men looking for their lord, when he shall return from the marriage feast; that, when he cometh and knocketh, they may straightway open unto him.
target_text: yesus padhai lii hari, peka na, mèda-mèu miu musti bori mema dhari ho lalau lamatua. nuka sèmi ènu dhu beke, mate lamatua èmu na lèpa nèti pesta kab'i. ropa lamatua na kad'eu babèdho èmu, nèngu bhoke dènge.

source_text: blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily i say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them sit down to meat, and shall come and serve them.
target_text: ladhe lamatua mai nèdhi dhèu sab'a se dhu mate tae-tae, tatu rèngu oto. pe lamatua ra pad'elo d'ara be'a na mi rèngu. na pake mèdha-papake dhèu sab'a, ho la'e lalau nganga'a be'a, sèna ka hia dhèu sab'a se'e ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and if he shall come in the second watch, and if in the third, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
target_text: dhèu sab'a se mema oto, lula rèngu ladhe-leru lamatua ra dènge be'a. masi ka lamatua ra lèpa èmu hake pèri èèna ka, d'ara talora mèda, do oe mèu, rèngu dhu bori mema dhari.

source_text: but know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched, and not have left his house to be broken through.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! ladhe abhu lamatua èmu dhu ne'a mema hake pèri dhèu mana'u mai mana'u, tatu na soro tèke boe ho dhèu mana'u huki èmu na.

source_text: be ye also ready: for in an hour that ye think not the son of man cometh.
target_text: de miu hud'i bori mema dhari, te ca dhèu sa dhu re'a boe pèri lod'o dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna mai hari.

source_text: and peter said, lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even unto all?
target_text: hèia petrus karèi yesus, peka na, ama mese! lii pakasame ama deo na, lèke dhoka mi ji'i do, lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i?

source_text: and the lord said, who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall set over his household, to give them their portion of food in due season? blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing. of a truth i say unto you, that he will set him over all that he hath.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, lii pakasame deo na lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao sèmi kapala urusan dhu satia. nèngu d'èlu-mèu uri j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia mi lamatua na. te èèna na, lamatua na ded'e ne, sèna ka papala nganga'a hia mi dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra. ladhe nèngu maj'èni sab'e madhutu sasab'a na sèmi èèna, masi ka lamatua na mai sange mera mia èèna ka, te ngaa nèngu ne dhu loe boe tao j'ara dhu lèke. hèia na oto, lula lamatua na ded'e ne ho ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but if that servant shall say in his heart, my lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
target_text: te ngaa carui bagi kapala urusan dhu pangee, na, ‘ele boe nèbhu ku, heka lamatua ne lèpa kèna. ' hèia na kalabhe dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra, mone dènge bhèni. ka na madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge kea rae-rae toke mahu.

source_text: the lord of that servant shall come in a day when he expecteth not, and in an hour when he knoweth not, and shall cut him asunder, and appoint his portion with the unfaithful.
target_text: te ngaa ca tèka kapala urusan ne ne'a nare boe, cag'ag'a laa, lamatua na lèpa. ka lamatua na kalabhe ne, hèia babège eele ne, sèna ka sèmi nare pala na ètu li'u, palere-lere dènge dhèu dhu satia boe, tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua ra.

source_text: and that servant, who knew his lord's will, and made not ready, nor did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes;
target_text: te dhèu sab'a dhu re'a dad'èi lamatua ra, te ngaa pa'èra boe tao madhutu, do, d'èi boe sab'e madhutu, bèli-camèd'a ra dui rare hahuku dhu bia.

source_text: but he that knew not, and did things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. and to whomsoever much is given, of him shall much be required: and to whom they commit much, of him will they ask the more.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a dhu sab'e sale, lula re'a boe dad'èi lamatua ra, rèngu abhu boe hahuku dhu bia. te dhèu dhu abhu ae, ra manèngi ae nèti nèngu kahèi. dhèu dhu abhu sasab'a kapai, dhadhaa na kapai kahèi.

source_text: i came to cast fire upon the earth; and what do i desire, if it is already kindled?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mamai ja'a ne ho cèri eele dhèu ja'a nèti dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne. ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu pake ai, ho tunu eele maruru. dad'èi ja'a ka ladhe ai ne mulai heo ètu mia-mia.

source_text: but i have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am i straitened till it be accomplished!
target_text: te ngaa uru nèti èèna, ja'a hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra dhu bia. ja'a bèli-camèd'a j'èra ae, toke d'ai èle sasab'a-la'a ja'a.

source_text: think ye that i am come to give peace in the earth? i tell you, nay; but rather division:
target_text: miu pangee, na, ja'a mai kèti dame ètu rai-haha, do? aad'o! ja'a mai sèna ka tao dhèu rai-haha ne patao-palaha dènge mae-manyèla, lula lii holo-nori ja'a.

source_text: for there shall be from henceforth five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
target_text: nèti deo ne'e, dhèu dhu pa'a'ari mae-manyèla. ètu d'ara èmu cue, dhèu tèlu lab'a dhèu dua, dua lab'a tèlu.

source_text: they shall be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother in law against her daughter in law, and daughter in law against her mother in law.
target_text: ama lab'a ana, ana lab'a ama. ina lab'a ana; ana lab'a ina. teto lab'a ana mantu; ana mantu lab'a teto na.

source_text: and he said to the multitudes also, when ye see a cloud rising in the west, straightway ye say, there cometh a shower; and so it cometh to pass.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu mèdhi ra'i-liru mèdhi aae cèu nèti haa, miu peka na, ‘ne'e, tadha èj'i oe mai kèna. ' mema lèke sèmi èèna.

source_text: and when ye see a south wind blowing, ye say, there will be a scorching heat; and it cometh to pass.
target_text: ladhe ngèlu balèu mai, miu peka na, ‘ne'e, tadha lod'o pana titu kèna. ' mema tare'a sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: ye hypocrites, ye know how to interpret the face of the earth and the heaven; but how is it that ye know not how to interpret this time?
target_text: weeh! miu dhèu leko-monya dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! miu d'èlu-mèu titu kèna me'a peka mia lod'o èj'i, aa mia lod'o pana aae. te ngaa tasamia ka mo'o boe me'a dènge dad'èi lamatua ètu taa limuri ne?

source_text: and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right? for as thou art going with thine adversary before the magistrate, on the way give diligence to be quit of him; lest haply he drag thee unto the judge, and the judge shall deliver thee to the officer, and the officer shall cast thee into prison.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu tao lii langu, nga tao ka miu bisa boe pama'ète unu mi, mia dhu lèke! be'a risi uri uuru ku dame! mage dhoka miu d'ai katanga madha hakim, ho na pama'ète, na, miu maso asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: i say unto thee, thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou have paid the very last mite.
target_text: te ladhe sèmi èèna, miu bisa boe kalua, ladhe miu b'ae mere mèka dedha dhu hakim pama'ète nare èèna.

source_text: now there were some present at that very season who told him of the galilæans, whose blood pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu mai peka dènge yesus, na, gubernur pilatus pamadhe le dhèu yahudi pèri-pèri nèti galilea, lod'o dhu mai asa yerusalem, rèti korban asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and he answered and said unto them, think ye that these galilæans were sinners above all the galilæans, because they have suffered these things?
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, ka yesus karèi si, madhutu miu, na, tasamia? dhèu dhu ra pamadhe sèra, sasala ra kapai risi nèti dhèu galilea dhu leo aa'i-aa'i ra, do? nèti èèna ka, ra huku pamadhe si, do?

source_text: i tell you, nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all in like manner perish.
target_text: aad'o! te ngaa ladhe miu tèke eele boe mamuri miu dhu bhelu, ho lèpa madhutu dad'èi lamatua, lod'o limuri miu laho nuka sèmi rèngu kahèi.

source_text: or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in siloam fell, and killed them, think ye that they were offenders above all the men that dwell in jerusalem?
target_text: aa tasa mera mia hari dènge canguru aru dhèu dhu madhe ca hari ni, ropa ètu siloam manara guri, hèia kabhie nare si, èèna? sasala si ae risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu yerusalem, do?

source_text: i tell you, nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
target_text: aad'o! te ngaa ladhe miu tèke eele boe mamuri miu dhu bhelu, ho lèpa asa j'ara lamatua dhu mola, miu èèna na laho sèmi rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and he spake this parable; a certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came seeking fruit thereon, and found none.
target_text: hèia yesus peka lii pakasame èci, na, abhu ca dhèu dhu dènge ana aaj'u ètu d'ara oka na. bèli-bèli, na la'e patigi, teko-teko ana aaj'u ne hua le, do dhae. te ngaa ana aaj'u ne dhae hua mèka.

source_text: and he said unto the vinedresser, behold, these three years i come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why doth it also cumber the ground?
target_text: ka na pua dhèu sab'a ètu d'ara oka, aku nèngu na, ‘tèlu tèu kèna, ja'a laku-mai ho ladhe ana aaj'u ne hua le, do dhae, te ngaa ja'a abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. de patue eele ne, te nèngu ne dhoka na'e era di. '

source_text: and he answering saith unto him, lord, let it alone this year also, till i shall dig about it, and dung it:
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ama baku pasori ku. hud'i nèbhu hari ku ciki laa d'ai ca tèu sa. pe ja'a kakèi rai reo kapua na, sèna ka tao pupuk, ho na sega.

source_text: and if it bear fruit thenceforth, well; but if not, thou shalt cut it down.
target_text: ladhe d'ai tèu mai nèi, aj'u ne hua, na be'a. ladhe aad'o, la'a sina ma, patue eele ka laa. '

source_text: and he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath day.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi, yesus la'e aj'a dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a.

source_text: and behold, a woman that had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years; and she was bowed together, and could in no wise lift herself up.
target_text: ètu ne'e abhu bhèni ca dhèu dhu kabodho kapo'o canguru aru tèu kèna, lula nidhu tao ne. bhèni ne bisa boe pamola kabodho na.

source_text: and when jesus saw her, he called her, and said to her, woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi, hèia na paroa ne, aku nèngu na, ina! lamatua patalale le j'aj'èra nèti èu.

source_text: and he laid his hands upon her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified god.
target_text: ka yesus tao ai mi bhèni ne. kaca'a laa, kabodho bhèni ne mola dènge kahèi. hèia bhèni ne manèngi makasi, aa koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and the ruler of the synagogue, being moved with indignation because jesus had healed on the sabbath, answered and said to the multitude, there are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the day of the sabbath.
target_text: te ngaa kapala èmu sabaj'a ne nasa, lula yesus puri-pa'èle dhèu lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a. ka na peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, d'ara ca migu, dhèu sab'a èna lod'o. de be'a risi dhèu pèd'a mai lèke dènge lod'o-lod'o sab'a sèra, sèna ka tenge dhèu puri-pa'èle si. baku mai lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a!

source_text: but the lord answered him, and said, ye hypocrites, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala ne, heeh! dhèu kapod'e-kabèli! ètu d'ara lod'o sabaj'a, miu sab'a kahèi, si? te miu lami patabuli sapi dènge keled'ei miu, sèna ka hia ra'a-rinu, si?

source_text: and ought not this woman, being a daughter of abraham, whom satan had bound, lo, these eighteen years, to have been loosed from this bond on the day of the sabbath?
target_text: bhèni ne, ana-èpu abraham sama sèmi èdhi. dhèu aae nidhu paj'èra ne canguru aru tèu kèna. ladhe ja'a patabuli ne nèti nidhu, lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, na èèna sala, do?

source_text: and as he said these things, all his adversaries were put to shame: and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, ka musu yesus sèra makae. te ngaa dhèu ae dhu leo sèra karej'e, lula sasab'a na sèra be'a titu kèna.

source_text: he said therefore, unto what is the kingdom of god like? and whereunto shall i liken it?
target_text: ka yesus peka hari, na, ja'a pasoro dhèu-dhèu lamatua sèmi ngaa hari?

source_text: it is like unto a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his own garden; and it grew, and became a tree; and the birds of the heaven lodged in the branches thereof.
target_text: hiu-hiu èèna rèngu ciki di, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka rèngu asa tabha ae. rèngu sèmi aj'u dhu lamusi na ana iiki-iiki. dhèu sèle ne ètu d'ara oka. ka muri mai, hèia j'aj'i ana aaj'u dhu kapai aae. èèna ka manu-bhui mai tao rèd'a ètu dadana na sèra.

source_text: and again he said, whereunto shall i liken the kingdom of god?
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii hari, peka na, ja'a pasoro dhèu unu lamatua sèmi ngaa hari?

source_text: it is like unto leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till it was all leavened.
target_text: nèngu ne nuka sèmi ragi dhu dhèu bhèni nare, ho na pab'ali dènge tarigu dua saku, sèna ka tao roti pa'ae. lula ragi dhu ciki oo'e èèna, pab'ali dènge tarigu ae-ae, hèia ca'e aa'i. dhèu unu lamatua pangaru ra asa tabha kapai sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and he went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and journeying on unto jerusalem.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si mulai kako lasi asa kota yerusalem. rèngu kako, lasi dhuli kota-kota dènge rae-rae, ho na aj'a dhèu.

source_text: and one said unto him, lord, are they few that are saved? and he said unto them,
target_text: d'ai era èci, ka ca dhèu karèi ne, ama mese! ele boe dhèu ciki di, dhu abhu sod'a, do?

source_text: strive to enter in by the narrow door: for many, i say unto you, shall seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, hèb'a maso asa sorga èèna, kob'o. de tenge j'ara paie-iie, sèna ka miu bisa maso re èèna. te abhu dhèu ae dhu sèku neo maso, te ngaa bisa boe.

source_text: when once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, lord, open to us; and he shall answer and say to you, i know you not whence ye are;
target_text: ladhe lamatua èmu patèke le babèdho, èèna na miu titu ètu li'u, ho kad'eu babèdho, dènge pa'oo manèngi, peka na, ‘ama! bhoke ku laa! ' te ngaa na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘miu sèra, cee? ja'a tadhe boe miu! '

source_text: then shall ye begin to say, we did eat and drink in thy presence, and thou didst teach in our streets;
target_text: hèia miu peka hari, na, ‘nga tao ka ama tadhe boe ji'i? ji'i se ka dhu tema madhèdi nga'a-nginu dènge ama. aa ama kahèi dhu tema aj'a-nori ji'i ètu j'ara oka-hoo ji'i. '

source_text: and he shall say, i tell you, i know not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
target_text: hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ‘deo na ja'a dhu peka le, na, ja'a tadhe boe miu! miu se, dhèu dhu tema ad'u-ue bhabhelu di. de pakaj'èu nèti ne'e ne! '

source_text: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see abraham, and isaac, and jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of god, and yourselves cast forth without.
target_text: ladhe d'ai lod'o ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, miu tangi roma iisi dènge kadhi ngutu lii kico-kico. te miu ladhe mèdhi baki abraham, isak dènge yakob, dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, madhèdi le ètu sorga. te ngaa miu lèke babège asa li'u.

source_text: and they shall come from the east and west, and from the north and south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of god.
target_text: pe dhèu mai nèti suu-suu rai-haha ne, nèti dhimu, nèti haa; nèti badae, nèti balèu, ho aa'i-aa'i ra madhèdi pa'èci, ra'a-rinu rame-rame ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua.

source_text: and behold, there are last who shall be first, and there are first who shall be last.
target_text: patadhe pabe'a-be'a j'ara ne'e: ladhe d'ai ka lod'o lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, abhu dhèu dhu uru èèna, pangee, na, nèngu ana iiki d'ai seli, aa te ngaa nèngu kab'ua titu kèna. aa abhu dhu uru èèna peka, na, nèngu dhèu kapai, te ngaa ètu madha lamatua, nèngu dhoka ana iiki di.

source_text: in that very hour there came certain pharisees, saying to him, get thee out, and go hence: for herod would fain kill thee.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri, mai paraga dènge yesus, ka ra peka, na, hua iia ama mese pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e, te dhèu aae herodes neo pamadhe ama.

source_text: and he said unto them, go and say to that fox, behold, i cast out demons and perform cures to-day and to-morrow, and the third day i am perfected. nevertheless i must go on my way to-day and to-morrow and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of jerusalem.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, herodes ne, cakaraa badha dhu d'èlu-mèu kapod'e-kabèli. lami peka dènge nèngu, na, ja'a bata eele nidhu dènge pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra, deo ne'e ne dènge bèli. camèd'a ku, sasab'a ja'a ne heka èle kèna. masi ka tasa mera mia èèna ka, nèti kakako ja'a asa yerusalem ne, ja'a neo sab'a hari ku ciki. te dhèu yerusalem sèra, dhu d'èi pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: o jerusalem, jerusalem, that killeth the prophets, and stoneth them that are sent unto her! how often would i have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her own brood under her wings, and ye would not!
target_text: waa, dhèu kabarai yerusalem, ee! miu dhu loe boe pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, aa pèci pamadhe dhèu pajuu-paleha sèra dhu mai pad'elo j'ara hia miu. pèri-pèri hari le, ja'a neo kaboko miu ho bhiri mi nèti bhelu-katub'a, nuka sèmi manu rena dhu sarimu nare ana na ètu d'ara èla na. te ngaa miu mo'o boe.

source_text: behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and i say unto you, ye shall not see me, until ye shall say, blessed is he that cometh in the name of the lord.
target_text: limuri ne, lamatua pusi-pahae heka èmu manèngi-mangaj'i miu. bèli-camèd'a nèngu j'aj'i èmu pa'ela. èèna na, miu mèdhi heka ja'a, toke miu dhaa, na, ‘ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu mai nèti kolongara ama lamatua, lula ama lamatua ka dhu hia na mai! '

source_text: and it came to pass, when he went into the house of one of the rulers of the pharisees on a sabbath to eat bread, that they were watching him.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, ca dhèu ama nèti partei agama parisi nèru yesus ho ra'a-sisi ètu èmu na. ropa yesus madhèdi na'a, abhu dhèu dhu ma'u, neo rèdhi ne tao ngaa lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and behold, there was before him a certain man that had the dropsy.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ca dhèu dhu pèd'a boho madhèdi ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and pharisees, saying, is it lawful to heal on the sabbath, or not?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora yahudi dènge dhèu parisi dhu madhèdi ra'a ètu sèra kahèi, aku nèngu na, madhutu atora nèti baki musa, bisa pa'èle dhèu pèd'a lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a, do aad'o?

source_text: but they held their peace. and he took him, and healed him, and let him go.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci sa bhoka boe hèb'a. hèia yesus gai dhèu pèd'a ne, ka na èle dènge nèti papèd'a na. ka yesus pua dhèu ne, sèna ka lèpa ka.

source_text: and he said unto them, which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a well, and will not straightway draw him up on a sabbath day?
target_text: èle ka yesus karèi hari si, peka na, ladhe ana èci manahu asa d'ara èi lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a, miu lami ère eele ana ne'e, do aad'o? ladhe sapi manahu asa d'ara èi la'e, miu soro tèke, do, lami kaso ne asa li'u? tatu miu kaso ne asa li'u. de èèna, sasoa na, miu sab'a le, sina ma?

source_text: and they could not answer again unto these things.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yesus ne, èci sa bisa boe dhaa.

source_text: and he spake a parable unto those that were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief seats; saying unto them,
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus taru kira mi dhèu mai ra'a-sisi ètu d'ara èmu ne. dhèu ae ka dhu d'èi era re madha, ho lasi madhèdi. ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, yesus peka,

source_text: when thou art bidden of any man to a marriage feast, sit not down in the chief seat; lest haply a more honorable man than thou be bidden of him,
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ladhe dhèu nèru miu asa pesta kab'i, mage lami madhèdi ka asa era dhèu aae-dhèu kapai. mage dhoka lamatua pesta ne nèru tamu dhu kapai risi.

source_text: and he that bade thee and him shall come and say to thee, give this man place; and then thou shalt begin with shame to take the lowest place.
target_text: ladhe sèmi èèna, lamatua pesta mai gai èu, peka na, ‘mage mu nasa kahèi, ama! ama pidha sa kabodho, ee. te ja'a tèke kadera ne hia dhèu kapai nèi. ' hèia èu kèd'i dènge makae, tèke eele kadera ne, ka lamu madhèdi asa kabodho.

source_text: but when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest place; that when he that hath bidden thee cometh, he may say to thee, friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have glory in the presence of all that sit at meat with thee.
target_text: de ladhe èu abhu nèru, lamu madhèdi ètu kadera re kabodho tèka. ropa lamatua pesta ladhe nèdhi èu, na mai peka, ‘ama! mai madhèdi asa madha ne. ' dènge j'ara ne, miu abhu pakab'ua ètu madha tamu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for every one that exalteth himself shall be humbled; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
target_text: te dhèu dhu padedha iisi ra, èèna na lamatua pahaha si. te ngaa dhèu dhu tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu haha, èèna na lamatua ded'e padedha si.

source_text: and he said to him also that had bidden him, when thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, nor thy kinsmen, nor rich neighbors; lest haply they also bid thee again, and a recompense be made thee.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge lamatua èmu ne, lod'o leo, ladhe ama neo tao tatao, mage nèru dhoka a'ari ama dènge dhèu kaja sèra mesa ra! te tatu rèngu bisa nèru hari ama.

source_text: but when thou makest a feast, bid the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ama tao tatao, nèru dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, dhèu haga roe cabèka, dhèu karuku, dènge dhèu bèdhu sèra.

source_text: and thou shalt be blessed; because they have not wherewith to recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed in the resurrection of the just.
target_text: tatu rèngu b'ala rare boe ama. te ngaa ladhe ama nèru si, ama lamatua ka dhu b'ala ama. ladhe d'ai lod'o ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu-dhèu parcaya dhu madhe le, na bhèlu boe babe'a ama.

source_text: and when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of god.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai lii yesus ne, ca dhèu dhu madhèdi ca mei dènge yesus, padhai lii, peka na, dhu karej'e risi ka, rèngu dhu madhutu ra'a pa'èci ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua!

source_text: but he said unto him, a certain man made a great supper; and he bade many:
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, ja'a lolo sèmi ne'e: abhu ca dhèu dhu tao tatao kapai. hèia na nèru dhèu ae titu kèna.

source_text: and he sent forth his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, come; for all things are now ready.
target_text: ropa d'ai tadha dhèu ra'a-rinu, ka na pua ènu na, la'e paroa dhèu dhu ra nèru sèra, peka na, ‘mai lati ka, te neo mulai pesta kèna. '

source_text: and they all with one consent began to make excuse. the first said unto him, i have bought a field, and i must needs go out and see it; i pray thee have me excused.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se'e padhai lii rupa-rupa, sèna ka lasi boe asa d'ara pesta. ca dhèu peka sèmi ne'e, ‘ja'a heka hèli kore oka cue, de neo laku ladhe sèku. de mage nasa, te ja'a lake kore boe. '

source_text: and another said, i have bought five yoke of oxen, and i go to prove them; i pray thee have me excused.
target_text: dhèu leo hari peka na, ‘ja'a heka hèli kore sapi maroo rai lèmi pasa. de ja'a neo laku cob'a si. baku nasa, te ja'a lake kore boe! '

source_text: and another said, i have married a wife, and therefore i cannot come.
target_text: dhèu leo hari peka na, ‘ja'a heka kab'i kèna, de bisa boe dhiu. '

source_text: and the servant came, and told his lord these things. then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor and maimed and blind and lame.
target_text: ka ènu ne, lèpa peka dènge lamatua na. ropa tadèngi nare, ka nasa titu kèna. hèia na paredha ènu na, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, èu lamu lai-lai! lamu asa j'ara-j'ara, dènge asa sasanga j'ara ètu kota ne'e, sèna ka nèru dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, dhèu kasia, dhu haga roe cabèka, dhu bèdhu, dènge dhèu-dhèu karuku sèra. '

source_text: and the servant said, lord, what thou didst command is done, and yet there is room.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, la'e dènge ka nèru dhèu-dhèu sèra. ka na lèpa hari, hèia na peka dènge lamatua na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! dhèu se, ka se'e le. te ngaa era madhèdi ae era. '

source_text: and the lord said unto the servant, go out into the highways and hedges, and constrain them to come in, that my house may be filled.
target_text: hèia lamatua na peka, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, lamu hari asa rae-rae ètu li'u kota, toke d'ai d'ara oka sèi. lamu pamako sad'i cee èèna ka, mèti si mai ho ra madhèdi papènu d'ara pesta ne.

source_text: for i say unto you, that none of those men that were bidden shall taste of my supper.
target_text: nanene, ee! dhèu dhu pahae boe dènge lii nèru ja'a ne, rèngu se re'a boe babe'a tatao ne ciki sa hèi! '

source_text: now there went with him great multitudes: and he turned, and said unto them,
target_text: ka yesus si lasi taruu asa yerusalem. dhèu ae madhutu ne. hèia na kabib'a ladhe sa rèngu, ka na peka, na,

source_text: if any man cometh unto me, and hateth not his own father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
target_text: dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a neo madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i sue ku ja'a risi nèti ngaa-ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra; risi nèti ina-ama na, risi nèti dhèu èmu-kamali na, risi nèti ana niki na, risi nèti a'ari na, aa risi-risi hari nèti ngi'u nèngu unu na. ladhe aad'o, dhèu ne nia boe j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: whosoever doth not bear his own cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
target_text: te dhèu dhu d'èi boe pasae j'aj'èra lula nèngu madhutu ja'a, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu ja'a, masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, te ngaa nèngu pasae j'aj'èra na taruu.

source_text: for which of you, desiring to build a tower, doth not first sit down and count the cost, whether he have wherewith to complete it?
target_text: de ladhe neo madhutu ja'a, ngee pabe'a-be'a ku. nuka sèmi dhèu neo tao èmu dhu dènge tad'a-tad'a. nèngu hud'i ige uuru ku, ogo d'ai lutu sela. mage dhoka doi d'ai boe.

source_text: lest haply, when he hath laid a foundation, and is not able to finish, all that behold begin to mock him,
target_text: ladhe ige boe paie-iie, ele boe d'ai fanderen di, doi dhu aad'o heka le. ladhe sèmi èèna, dhèu mari madhe aa pamakae ne hèi,

source_text: saying, this man began to build, and was not able to finish.
target_text: peka na, ‘miu ladhe ku dhèu ne'e laa! heka na sab'e fanderen kèna, te ngaa doi na saku aa'i le! '

source_text: or what king, as he goeth to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and take counsel whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
target_text: conto dhu leo, nuka sèmi dhèu lasi pamusu. dhèu aae dhu neo la'e pamusu hud'i madhèdi ku, sèna ka pare'a uuru ku dènge angalai na. ladhe sordad'u rèngu dhoka canguru riho dhèu di, bisa segi musu dua nguru riho dhèu, do aad'o?

source_text: or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and asketh conditions of peace.
target_text: ladhe ige rare, te ngaa rèngu bisa boe segi, be'a risi lod'o musu dhu kaj'èu era, ra pua dhèu lasi peka sèna ka uri padame.

source_text: so therefore whosoever he be of you that renounceth not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.
target_text: sama sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a. nèngu hud'i kali bagi ku la'e-mai, dhu peka na, nèngu dhu pa'èra le tèke eele aa'i ngaa-ngaa, do aad'o? te ladhe aad'o, na, dhèu ne'e nia boe j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: salt therefore is good: but if even the salt have lost its savor, wherewith shall it be seasoned? it is fit neither for the land nor for the dunghill: men cast it out. he that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
target_text: yesus tuhu lii padhai pake lii pakasame dhu leo hari, na, masi ne, be'a. èdhi pake ne ho pabe'a nganga'a. te ngaa ladhe na sèro heka, j'aj'i ngaa hari? bisa heka pake ne, ho pabe'a nganga'a. neo tao mi pupuk, bisa boe kahèi. dhodhoka core eele iia d'ara di. dhèu cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, nanene paie-iie!

source_text: now all the publicans and sinners were drawing near unto him to hear him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu roro bea dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe mai ae-ae asa yesus, sèna ka nanene lii padhai na. te ngaa dhèu yahudi peka, na, rèngu sèra dhèu karehe.

source_text: and both the pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, this man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu parisi dènge mese agama yahudi sèra ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, huuh! dhèu ne pa'angalai dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu laku boe se. ngaa hari na madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge si!

source_text: and he spake unto them this parable, saying,
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yesus lolo dènge ra lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na,

source_text: what man of you, having a hundred sheep, and having lost one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
target_text: ladhe nèti miu abhu ca dhèu dhu unu kahib'i-kalèbho cangasu ngi'u. ka ci'u ele. na tao tasamia? tatu na tèke eele dhu ceo nguru ceo se ètu era dhu be'a, aa la'e tenge dhu ele deo na, toke rage ne.

source_text: and when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
target_text: ropa nèdhi hari kahib'i-kalèbho ne, ka na pasae nèti, dènge karej'e-karae.

source_text: and when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and his neighbors, saying unto them, rejoice with me, for i have found my sheep which was lost.
target_text: d'ai èmu, ka na paroa angalai na aa'i-aa'i, hèia na peka dènge si, ‘mai, sèna ka karej'e dènge ja'a! te kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu ele èèna, kèdhi hari le. '

source_text: i say unto you, that even so there shall be joy in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine righteous persons, who need no repentance.
target_text: ètu sorga, sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe ca dhèu dhu tao sala, hèia ele-ho'a, ka na lèpa hari asa lamatua, ana kabarai sorga aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e-karae. rèngu karej'e risi lula ca dhèu dhu lèpa hari asa lamatua, nèti ceo nguru ceo dhèu dhu mamuri mola, dhu sala boe j'ara.

source_text: or what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a lamp, and sweep the house, and seek diligently until she find it?
target_text: ka yesus lolo hari lii pakasame dhu leo èci, peka na, abhu ca dhèu ina, dhu doi iia na canguru bua. ne'a na, dhu ele ca doi. ka na tao tasamia? tatu la'e suru labhu ho d'elo palème era, aa saku èmu ne d'ai ro'a kakilu, sèna ka tenge doi cue dhu ele ne.

source_text: and when she hath found it, she calleth together her friends and neighbors, saying, rejoice with me, for i have found the piece which i had lost.
target_text: ropa nèdhi hari doi ne, na paroa dènge dhèu dhu ètu baboa èmu na sèra, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ‘miu mai, ho karej'e sama-sama dènge ja'a. te doi ja'a cue dhu ele deo na, kèdhi hari le! '

source_text: even so, i say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of god over one sinner that repenteth.
target_text: ètu sorga sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu tao sala, ka na ele-ho'a, ho lèpa hari asa ama lamatua, tatu ana pajuu ètu sorga aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e-karae.

source_text: and he said, a certain man had two sons:
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na dènge lii pakasame kahèi, peka na, ama ca dhèu dènge ana mone na dhèu dua.

source_text: and the younger of them said to his father, father, give me the portion of thy substance that falleth to me. and he divided unto them his living.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana limuri peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! hia ka pala ja'a nèti pusaka sèra, deo ne'e ne kahèi! ' hèia ama na bagi hia dua ra pusaka na, sèna ka èci-èci dènge pala ra.

source_text: and not many days after, the younger son gathered all together and took his journey into a far country; and there he wasted his substance with riotous living.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka ana limuri ne pahie unu na. hèia na lalau mèdha na, ka la'e asa rae kaj'èu. ètu era nèi, ana limuri ne pasaku aa'i-aa'i doi-dhari na, ho pakarej'e iisi.

source_text: and when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that country; and he began to be in want.
target_text: ropa doi na èle aa'i mèu-mèu, rai ne dhu lèke manganga bia, ka mamuri ana ne j'èra d'ai seli.

source_text: and he went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
target_text: ka la'e tenge sasab'a. hèia ca dhèu nèti kabarai èèna hia na panga'a hahi.

source_text: and he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
target_text: lula ana ne manganga d'ai seli, ka neo na'a nganga'a hahi se. te abhu boe ca dhèu sa hia ne na'a.

source_text: but when he came to himself he said, how many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and i perish here with hunger!
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu, ka na pangee la'e-mai, aku nèngu na, ‘anga ee! ja'a ètu ne'e, oe madhe manganga kèna. te ngaa ètu d'ara èmu ama ku, dhèu sab'a ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: i will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, father, i have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight:
target_text: de be'a risi ja'a lèpa hari asa ama ku, ho peka dènge ne, ama! ja'a tao le sala dhu kapai titu kèna, mi lamatua dènge ama.

source_text: i am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.
target_text: ja'a nia boe j'aj'i ana ama ku. hud'i laa ama sèmi more ja'a ne j'aj'i mi kuli ètu d'ara èmu ama, ngaa-ngaa tao boe! '

source_text: and he arose, and came to his father. but while he was yet afar off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
target_text: ropa pangee nare sèmi èèna, hèia na kèd'i dènge ka, lèpa la'e asa èmu ama na. nèti kaj'èu era, ama na ladhe nèdhi le nèngu, ka ama na rasa kasia. ka na puru nèti èmu, rai la'e soru nare ana dhu lèpa hari ne. hèia na liku nare, ka uu ne.

source_text: and the son said unto him, father, i have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight: i am no more worthy to be called thy son.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana ne peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! ja'a ne tao le sala dhu kapai mi dedha lamatua dènge ama ku. ja'a nia heka j'aj'i hari ana ama. '

source_text: but the father said to his servants, bring forth quickly the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:
target_text: te ngaa ama na paredha dènge ka dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, peka na, ‘karohe! lami mere kodho madhera dhu be'a risi, ho papake ne. mere kadheli, ho pasaluu mi kacui-aai na. aa papake salapa mi haga na.

source_text: and bring the fatted calf, and kill it, and let us eat, and make merry:
target_text: lami ère mere sapi kab'oi èèna ho pare, te èdhi neo ta'a-tinu rame-rame.

source_text: for this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. and they began to be merry.
target_text: lula ana ja'a ne, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le, te ngaa na mamuri hari. nèngu dhu ele le, te ngaa ja'a abhu hari ne. ' na padhai lii èle sèmi èèna, ka mulai ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard music and dancing.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana uuru dhu aad'o ètu èmu, te na sab'a ètu d'ara oka. ropa na lèpa, nèti kaj'èu era, na tadèngi le dhèu karihu musiik dènge roge-ledho.

source_text: and he called to him one of the servants, and inquired what these things might be.
target_text: ka na paroa nare dhèu sab'a ca dhèu, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ee! tao rarame ngaa ètu ne'e?

source_text: and he said unto him, thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ari mu lèpa hari le. de ama mu pua pare sapi, sèna ka tao pesta kapai, te ana na lèpa hari dènge sod'a. '

source_text: but he was angry, and would not go in: and his father came out, and entreated him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia ana uuru ne pasaree. na no'o boe maso asa d'ara èmu. ka ama na la'e rarange ne.

source_text: but he answered and said to his father, lo, these many years do i serve thee, and i never transgressed a commandment of thine; and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that i might make merry with my friends:
target_text: te ngaa na ka'ugu, peka na, ‘ama! pangee ku laa! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a sab'a toke èi kabhèsu hae, nuka sèmi kuli sa, hia mi ama. ja'a ne ke'a boe sisu dad'èi ama. masi ka sèmi èèna, abhu mèka ama hia ana kahib'i ci'u, sèna ka ja'a pakarej'e dènge mone aanga-angalai ja'a.

source_text: but when this thy son came, who hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou killedst for him the fatted calf.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ana ama dhu bhera-lelu doi-dhari ama, ho la'e karihu dènge bhèni karehe, lèpa hari mai, ka ama pare sapi kab'oi na, tao pesta aae hia ne. '

source_text: and he said unto him, son, thou art ever with me, and all that is mine is thine.
target_text: te ngaa ama na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘ana pasue, ee! nanene paie-iie. nèbhu nare sange ne'e, èu ne bera-bera dènge ja'a. aa'i-aa'i dhu unu ja'a, sèra sa unu èu kahèi.

source_text: but it was meet to make merry and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi hud'i karej'e dènge karae ku, lula ari mu ca dhèu ne. uru èèna, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le, te ngaa limuri ne mamuri hari. nèngu dhu ele le, te ngaa abhu hari. '

source_text: and he said also unto the disciples, there was a certain rich man, who had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he was wasting his goods.
target_text: ka yesus hia lii upama èci mi ana madhutu na, peka na, dhèu kaja ca dhèu dhu ded'e dhèu sab'a na èci j'aj'i kapala urusan. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, na tadèngi dhèu palolo, peka na, kapala urusan ne mulai kapod'e-kabèli ka parugi nèngu.

source_text: and he called him, and said unto him, what is this that i hear of thee? render the account of thy stewardship; for thou canst be no longer steward.
target_text: hèia dhèu kaja ne paroa kapala urusan na, ka peka dènge ne, ‘èu ne, tasamia? ja'a tadèngi, na, èu kapod'e mèdha-panyau ja'a. de lamu suri ku ngaa dhu èu ad'u-ue ètu d'ara sasab'a èu, ho ja'a parisa ku. ladhe parisa kore, ja'a kalua eele èu. '

source_text: and the steward said within himself, what shall i do, seeing that my lord taketh away the stewardship from me? i have not strength to dig; to beg i am ashamed.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, hèia kapala urusan ne mulai pajiko, na, ‘ja'a ne j'èra kèna! ja'a neo sab'a ngaa hari? pare rai, ja'a èra boe. j'aj'i dhèu hèb'a mènyi, ja'a makae.

source_text: i am resolved what to do, that, when i am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
target_text: ladhe ja'a sab'a heka ètu ne'e, ja'a hud'i tenge j'ara ku, sèna ka dhèu leo bisa hari sèmi rare ja'a ho sab'a. '

source_text: and calling to him each one of his lord's debtors, he said to the first, how much owest thou unto my lord?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na paroa nare aa'i dhèu dhu pakèlu lamatua na. na karèi dhèu uru, aku nèngu na, ‘ee! kèlu èu ca ngaa ètu lamatua ja'a? '

source_text: and he said, a hundred measures of oil. and he said unto him, take thy bond, and sit down quickly and write fifty.
target_text: dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ja'a dhu pakèlu èi lèngi saitun èpa riho liter. ' hèia kapala urusan ne peka, na, ‘tare'a. sasuri pakèlu èu ka ne'e. ciu eele ka, madhèdi ho suri gati sasuri kèlu dhu hiu, peka na, kèlu èu dua riho liter di. '

source_text: then said he to another, and how much owest thou? and he said, a hundred measures of wheat. he saith unto him, take thy bond, and write fourscore.
target_text: ka karèi dhèu pakèlu ka dua, peka na, ‘aa èu hari, kèlu ca ngaa? ' ka dhèu ne dhaa, na, ‘ja'a pakèlu are, cariho karo. ' hèia kapala urusan ne peka, na, ‘ciu eele sasuri dhui èèna, ho suri dhu hiu hari, peka na, kèlu èu, aru ngasu karo di. '

source_text: and his lord commended the unrighteous steward because he had done wisely: for the sons of this world are for their own generation wiser than the sons of the light.
target_text: na tao sèmi ne'e ka, toke lamatua na ne'a tatao nèngu. te ngaa lamatua ne hud'i mangaku, na, dhèu kapala urusan dhu bhelu ne mema mèu kapod'e-kabèli. de ja'a lolo lii upama ne, sèna ka miu me'a, na, ladhe pasoro dènge dhèu parcaya, dhèu dhu parcaya boe d'èlu-mèu risi tenge j'ara ho pa'oto ngi'u ra ètu talora aae kabarai limuri ne.

source_text: and i say unto you, make to yourselves friends by means of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when it shall fail, they may receive you into the eternal tabernacles.
target_text: miu ngee sèku. masi ka dhèu rai-haha ne karihu kaj'alu re mèdha-panyau ra, te ngaa be'a risi miu pake mèdha-panyau miu sèra, ho soru-bara dhèu. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, miu abhu angalai ae. masi ka mèdha se èle, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a lamatua tao tèke era hia miu ètu sorga.

source_text: he that is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much: and he that is unrighteous in a very little is unrighteous also in much.
target_text: ladhe dhèu mola ètu j'ara dhu ana iiki, tatu na mola kahèi ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mèu kapod'e ètu j'ara dhu ana iiki, tatu na kapod'e kahèi ètu j'ara dhu kapai.

source_text: if therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
target_text: ladhe dhèu parcaya heka miu, ho uri mèdha-panyau ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu ana iiki ètu rai-haha ne, tasamia ka lamatua parcaya miu ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai?

source_text: and if ye have not been faithful in that which is another's, who will give you that which is your own?
target_text: ladhe miu bisa boe uri mèdha-panyau dhèu leo, na, dhèu cee ka dhu bani ho hia miu mèdha-panyau ra?

source_text: no servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. ye cannot serve god and mammon.
target_text: dhèu sab'a èci bisa boe nanene dua lamatua. te aad'o na, nèngu d'èi boe èci, aa sue èci. nèngu d'ara kateme dènge ca dhèu, te ngaa pusi boe dènge èci. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. te dhèu bisa boe sue ama lamatua palere dènge sue doi-dhari.

source_text: and the pharisees, who were lovers of money, heard all these things; and they scoffed at him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri dhu nanene lii padhai yesus deo na. ka ra sasei ne, lula rèngu se dhèu manga'a doi-dhari.

source_text: and he said unto them, ye are they that justify yourselves in the sight of men; but god knoweth your hearts: for that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge si, masi ka miu pamèu iisi ètu madha dhèu, te ngaa ama lamatua ne'a d'ara bhelu miu. abhu j'ara ae dhu dhèu rai-haha ded'e padedha-dedha, te ngaa ama lamatua peka na, j'ara sèra karehe, aa dhu madenge dènge rèngu.

source_text: the law and the prophets were until john: from that time the gospel of the kingdom of god is preached, and every man entereth violently into it.
target_text: toke mamai yohanis tuka sarani, èdhi dhèu yahudi muri madhutu atora nèti baki musa aa nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, lii lolo be'a nèti lamatua pale-lème le ètu mia-mia. dhèu ae dhu tenge le j'ara, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: but it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away, than for one tittle of the law to fall.
target_text: masi ka dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne ele, te ngaa atora nèti ama lamatua ciki sa, ele boe. ca katèd'a sa ele boe hèi!

source_text: every one that putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and he that marrieth one that is put away from a husband committeth adultery.
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu na, aa na madhèdi hari dènge bhèni leo, nèngu bersina. aa dhèu dhu leo dènge bhèni dhu pa'ia-pa'ela, nèngu bersina kahèi.

source_text: now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, faring sumptuously every day:
target_text: ka yesus lole tabha hari, peka na, abhu dhèu kaja ca dhèu. nèngu d'èi pake mèdha-papake dhu be'a-be'a, tao nèti bèla alus. mèu-mèda na'a-ninu nganga'a dhu be'a hua, aa karae taruu.

source_text: and a certain beggar named lazarus was laid at his gate, full of sores,
target_text: ètu kota ne'e, abhu kahèi ca dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. ngara na, lasarus. ngi'u na dhu pènu dènge kamèu. bèli-bèli angalai na rèti pamadhèdi ne ètu hèb'a tedhe dhèu kaja èèna.

source_text: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man's table; yea, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
target_text: na sanao teko-teko abhu kaha'i nganga'a nèti dhèu kaja ne, sèna ka bisa na'a, te ngaa na abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. dhoka busa di mai, ho j'ore nana kamèu na.

source_text: and it came to pass, that the beggar died, and that he was carried away by the angels into abraham's bosom: and the rich man also died, and was buried.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, lasarus madhe. hèia ana pajuu ama lamatua mai nèti sorga, ka rèti lasi pamadhèdi ne ètu baboa abraham. aa nèbhu boe ka, dhèu kaja ne madhe kahèi, ka dhèu ded'e lasi padhane.

source_text: and in hades he lifted up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth abraham afar off, and lazarus in his bosom.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja ne maso boe sorga. nèngu maso asa d'ara naraka, sama-sama dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu madhe le. ètu era nèi, dhèu kaja ne abhu j'aj'èra taa-taa. ca tèka na boti kètu, ka ladhe nèdhi lasarus madhèdi ètu baboa baki abraham.

source_text: and he cried and said, father abraham, have mercy on me, and send lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for i am in anguish in this flame.
target_text: hèia na pa'oo, peka na, ‘baki abraham, ee! sue ku ja'a laa! pua ku lasarus cèb'u kolo ai na asa d'ara èi, sèna ka mai pabasa ku kolo he'o ja'a ne. te ja'a j'èra titu kèna ètu d'ara ai naraka ne! '

source_text: but abraham said, son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and lazarus in like manner evil things: but now here he is comforted, and thou art in anguish.
target_text: te ngaa abraham dhaa, peka na, ‘ana, ee! sanèd'e ku! uru èèna lod'o èu mamuri era ètu rai-haha nèi, èu abhu le aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a. te ngaa lasarus ne, unu dhodhoka sasusa di. ka limuri ne, lamatua pakarej'e ne ètu ne'e, te ngaa èu pasae more j'aj'èra.

source_text: and besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that they that would pass from hence to you may not be able, and that none may cross over from thence to us.
target_text: risi-risi hari, ètu talora aae èu dènge ji'i, lamatua tao tèke loe aae èci dhu taleo dènge marèma. de dhèu nèti ne'e bisa boe dhiu asa era èèna, aa dhèu nèti èèna bisa boe pège sa ne'e mai. '

source_text: and he said, i pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house;
target_text: hèia dhèu kaja ne pamako hari, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, baki abraham pua lasarus la'e asa èmu ama ku.

source_text: for i have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
target_text: te ja'a ne dènge ari dhèu mone, dhèu lèmi era. sèna ka lasarus la'e pasanèd'e si, ho ra lèpa ka asa lamatua. masi ka lod'o d'ai ra madhe, rèngu maso ia ka asa era j'aj'èra ne. '

source_text: but abraham saith, they have moses and the prophets; let them hear them.
target_text: te ngaa abraham b'ala ne, ‘ama lamatua hia le rèngu sasuri nèti baki musa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai na. ari mu si, bisa baca pahari-pahari ho re'a dad'èi lamatua. '

source_text: and he said, nay, father abraham: but if one go to them from the dead, they will repent.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja ne pasisu, peka na, ‘baki abraham, ee! èèna dhae d'ai mèka. rèngu sèi pahae boe lii holo-nori ama lamatua! hud'i abhu ku ca dhèu nèti talora dhèu madhe la'e asa rèngu, heka rèngu ele-ho'a, aa neo nanene kèna. '

source_text: and he said unto him, if they hear not moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, if one rise from the dead.
target_text: te ngaa abraham dhaa, peka na, ‘ladhe rèngu sèi ro'o boe nanene lii holo-nori nèti musa dènge nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, na, masi ka dhèu madhe bhodho nèti d'ara ro'a ra, ho padhai lii dènge rèngu èèna ka, rèngu ro'o boe nanene. '

source_text: and he said unto his disciples, it is impossible but that occasions of stumbling should come; but woe unto him, through whom they come!
target_text: yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, ae ka dhèu manahu asa d'ara sasala, lula tatao dhèu leo. te ngaa dhèu dhu pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala èèna, pasae nare mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: it were well for him if a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ad'u-ue j'ara karehe, toke ana iiki parcaya boe ja'a, èèna na ama lamatua huku ne bia. dhu samaa risi, ladhe èki ladha goro dhèu ne'e dènge hadhu aae cue, ho parèu eele asa d'ara dhasi ètu talora lèu.

source_text: take heed to yourselves: if thy brother sin, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
target_text: de j'aga ngi'u pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka miu baku pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala! te ngaa ladhe a'ari mu tao sala, pasanèd'e ne. ladhe na ele-ho'a, hèia na mai manèngi abho, na pabhèlu eele sasala na.

source_text: and if he sin against thee seven times in the day, and seven times turn again to thee, saying, i repent; thou shalt forgive him.
target_text: ladhe a'ari èu tao sala pidhu hari d'ara ca lod'o, ka na ele-ho'a, hèia na mai pidhu hari ho manèngi abho, èu hud'i pabhèlu eele sasala na pidhu hari kahèi.

source_text: and the apostles said unto the lord, increase our faith.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana madhutu se mai asa yesus, ka ra manèngi, aku rèngu na, ama mese! parcaya ji'i se èra boe. de ama pa'èra ku parcaya ji'i.

source_text: and the lord said, if ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye would say unto this sycamine tree, be thou rooted up, and be thou planted in the sea; and it would obey you.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ladhe miu parcaya koasa nèti ama lamatua, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka, te ngaa miu bisa paredha aj'u aae ne, ‘tahoi eele, ho pidha asa d'ara dhasi! ' ka aj'u ne madhutu lii paredha miu.

source_text: but who is there of you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say unto him, when he is come in from the field, come straightway and sit down to meat;
target_text: èle ka yesus lii, aku nèngu na, tare conto èci. nuka sèmi ènu dhu pare rai ètu d'ara oka, do, ladhe kahib'i-kalèbho ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a. sab'a nare, ka lèpa sa èmu. tatu lamatua na peka boe dènge ne, ‘mai ho dua ti ta'a sama-sama! '

source_text: and will not rather say unto him, make ready wherewith i may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till i have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
target_text: aad'o, sina ma? dhu lèke ka, lamatua paredha ne, peka na, ‘lamu lalau mei hia ja'a. ku'a-kinu kore ku, pe èu mu'a-minu ètu kabodho nèi! '

source_text: doth he thank the servant because he did the things that were commanded?
target_text: ladhe ènu ne lalau nare madhutu dad'èi lamatua na, miu ngee, na, lamatua ne manèngi makasi mi ènu ne, do? aad'o!

source_text: even so ye also, when ye shall have done all the things that are commanded you, say, we are unprofitable servants; we have done that which it was our duty to do.
target_text: miu èci èèna kahèi. ladhe sab'a mere aa'i dhu lamatua paredha le, miu peka na, ‘ji'i dhoka ana pua-paleha di. ji'i tenge boe lii koa-kad'iri. ji'i dhoka pakako sasab'a-la'a ji'i di. '
