source_text: and it came to pass, as they were on the way to jerusalem, that he was passing along the borders of samaria and galilee.
target_text: lod'o yesus si lasi asa yerusalem, rèngu d'ai too propensi galilea dènge propensi samaria.

source_text: and as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, who stood afar off:
target_text: ropa rèngu neo maso asa d'ara rae cue ètu èèna, dhèu canguru dhu pèd'a kusta mai, neo paraga dènge yesus. rèngu se titu nèti kaj'èu.

source_text: and they lifted up their voices, saying, jesus, master, have mercy on us.
target_text: ka ra pa'oo palere-lere, peka na, yesus! mone kapai, ee! sue ku ji'i laa!

source_text: and when he saw them, he said unto them, go and show yourselves unto the priests. and it came to pass, as they went, they were cleansed.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii pa'oo ra, ka na ladhe si, hèia na pua, aku nèngu na, lami pad'elo uuru ku isi miu asa ama agama, sèna ka ra parisa papèd'a kusta miu sèra, èle le, do dhae! ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka lasi dènge. te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, cag'ag'a laa, rèngu dhu èle le nèti kusta.

source_text: and one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, with a loud voice glorifying god;
target_text: rèngu lasi taruu dènge karej'e-karae. te ngaa abhu ca dhèu di, dhu lèpa hari mai asa yesus. na pa'oo, peka na, koa-kio lamatua! te ja'a èle le nèti papèd'a!

source_text: and he fell upon his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a samaritan.
target_text: hèia na patitu kètu urutuu na, ho manèngi makasi ae-ae mi yesus. te'a boe, te nèngu ne dhèu yahudi boe. nèngu ne ca dhèu samaria dhu loe boe tao lii langu dènge dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and jesus answering said, were not the ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
target_text: ka yesus karèi dhèu sèra dhu madhutu dènge ne, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee? deo na ja'a pa'èle dhèu canguru si? dhu ceo, mia lasi?

source_text: were there none found that returned to give glory to god, save this stranger?
target_text: tasamia ka dhoka dhèu leo kara ne'e di, dhu lèpa mai ho manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, dènge koa-kio kolongara na?

source_text: and he said unto him, arise, and go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
target_text: hèia na peka mi dhèu ne, na, èu èle le, lula èu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a. de kèd'i, lèpa ka dènge sod'a-mole!

source_text: and being asked by the pharisees, when the kingdom of god cometh, he answered them and said, the kingdom of god cometh not with observation: neither shall they say, lo, here! or, there! for lo, the kingdom of god is within you.
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu parisi pèri-pèri mai karèi yesus, peka na, ama mese! peka ku dènge ji'i, lod'o mia ama lamatua neo pakako paredha na? ka yesus dhaa, sèmi ne'e. mage mi pangee, na, lamatua pakako paredha na dènge rupa-rupa tadha ètu rai-haha ne, dhu dhèu bisa rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. dhèu abhu boe tadha dhu peka na, ‘ladhe ku asa ne'e mai! te ama lamatua pakako paredha na ètu ne'e! ' do, ‘na pakako paredha na ètu nèi! ' aad'o! te na pakako paredha na ètu talora aae miu, ètu d'ara dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and he said unto the disciples, the days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the son of man, and ye shall not see it.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, nèbhu boe, na, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, pa'èci heka dènge miu. d'ai ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, miu d'èi titu kèna neo mèdhi mamai hari ja'a. te ngaa d'ai mèka lod'o mamai ja'a.

source_text: and they shall say to you, lo, there! lo, here! go not away, nor follow after them:
target_text: ladhe èèna na dhèu mai peka, na, ‘kristus ètu ne'e! ' do, ‘kristus ètu nèi! ' na, miu baku bhute ho patangi-tenge, te lii padhai rèngu sèra, kapod'e-kabèli.

source_text: for as the lightning, when it lighteneth out of the one part under the heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall the son of man be in his day.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, lèpa hari mai, tadha na dhu mèu aadha-aadha, nuka sèmi bela dhu heo kacèb'a ètu dedha-liru nèti suu asa suu.

source_text: but first must he suffer many things and be rejected of this generation.
target_text: te ngaa nèngu hud'i abhu uuru ku j'aj'èra rupa-rupa. ka dhèu rai-haha taa limuri ne, ro'o boe nanene, aa neo tule eele ne.

source_text: and as it came to pass in the days of noah, even so shall it be also in the days of the son of man.
target_text: te ngaa bèli-camèd'a, ladhe na neo mai hari, dhèu mamuri karehe sama biasa, èci èèna ka dènge lod'o noh mamuri era.

source_text: they ate, they drank, they married, they were given in marriage, until the day that noah entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
target_text: taa èèna, rèngu ra'a-rinu, tao pesta kab'i toke lod'o noh maso asa d'ara kapa na. te ngaa rèngu ro'o boe nanene kahèi. kaca'a laa, èi aae lala, ka pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: likewise even as it came to pass in the days of lot; they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lod'o lot mamuri era, dhèu mamuri karehe titu kèna. taa èèna, rèngu ra'a-rinu, bad'aga, sab'a oka-tedhe, patitu èmu, aa mamuri karehe sèmi biasa.

source_text: but in the day that lot went out from sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all:
target_text: te ngaa ro'o boe nanene kahèi. hèia mad'ae aae era, ropa lot rai eele nèti kota sodom, cag'ag'a laa, èj'i ai dènge èi nasu bhori mai nèti dedha-liru, aa labhu pakèpu rèngu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: after the same manner shall it be in the day that the son of man is revealed.
target_text: de miu baku pamud'e ku! mage dhoka bèli-camèd'a dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, lèpa hari mai, dhèu mamuri dhoka sèmi biasa di. te ngaa kaca'a laa, na cèu mai.

source_text: in that day, he that shall be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away: and let him that is in the field likewise not return back.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu madha èmu, maso ia ka asa d'ara ho lalau mèdha. dhèu dhu sab'a ètu d'ara oka, lèpa ia ka asa èmu ho rare mèdha ra.

source_text: remember lot's wife.
target_text: sanèd'e ku ngaa dhu uru èèna j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu lot. na madhe, lula nèngu ngee mèdha-panyau ètu èmu na.

source_text: whosoever shall seek to gain his life shall lose it: but whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi boe madhutu ja'a lula sue ngi'u na, èèna na mamuri na ele iia d'ara. te ngaa dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a toke soro mamuri na, lula sue ja'a, bèli-camèd'a abhu sod'a-mole, aa mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: i say unto you, in that night there shall be two men on one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e mema! ropa dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, lèpa hari mai, ladhe dhèu dua j'unu ètu era èci, kabèdhi laa lamatua ded'e paca'e ca dhèu, aa tèke eele ca dhèu.

source_text: there shall be two women grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu bhèni dhèu dua dhu maj'u are, èèna na lamatua ded'e paca'e ca dhèu, aa tèke eele ca dhèu.

source_text: and they answering say unto him, where, lord? and he said unto them, where the body is, thither will the eagles also be gathered together.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu tadèngi rare, hèia ra karèi yesus, ama mese! sèra sa bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i ètu mia? ka yesus core lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e! ladhe miu mèdhi ka manu-bhui dhu tema ra'a sisi badha madhe, ra lela pa'oru ètu mia, na, miu me'a èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, dhu peka na, tatu abhu sisi hèu ètu era èèna. dènge sasoa dhu pahuni, peka na, ladhe yesus kristus lèpa hari mai, tadha na dhu mèu aadha-aadha, sad'i dhèu re'a baca tadha sèra.

source_text: and he spake a parable unto them to the end that they ought always to pray, and not to faint;
target_text: ca tèka, yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, pake lii pakasame ho rèngu loe boe manèngi-mangaj'i, aa baku ma'ète sanao-maena. rèngu hud'i parcaya taa-taa lamatua.

source_text: saying, there was in a city a judge, who feared not god, and regarded not man:
target_text: lii lolo na sèmi ne'e ka: ètu d'ara kota cue, abhu ca dhèu ama pama'ète lii langu, dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua. na pahae boe ca dhèu sa hèi.

source_text: and there was a widow in that city; and she came oft unto him, saying, avenge me of mine adversary.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu kahèi bhèni balu èci, dhu loe boe mai sa dhèu pama'ète lii ne, ho manèngi, peka na, ‘ama hakim! j'ue ku lii langu ja'a dènge mola! '

source_text: and he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, though i fear not god, nor regard man;
target_text: hiu-hiu èèna, dhèu pama'ète lii ne pusi boe dènge bhèni balu ne. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka, na roca nanene ne. hèia na madhèdi pangee ka, ‘mema ja'a ne pusi boe dènge ama lamatua, risi-risi dènge dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: yet because this widow troubleth me, i will avenge her, lest she wear me out by her continual coming.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni ne pakabo'o kètu ja'a. de be'a risi ja'a pama'ète lii na dènge mola. te ladhe ja'a panena, na mai taruu paj'èra ja'a. '

source_text: and the lord said, hear what the unrighteous judge saith.
target_text: de miu pangee ku lii padhai dhèu pama'ète lii dhu bhelu ne.

source_text: and shall not god avenge his elect, that cry to him day and night, and yet he is longsuffering over them?
target_text: ladhe nèbhu-nèbhu dhèu pama'ète lii ne tao ai-hèb'a mi bhèni balu ne, tatu ama lamatua kahèi neo tao ai-hèb'a mi dhèu unu na dhu sabaj'a mèu-mèda mi nèngu ho manèngi sasue na. te ngaa lamatua mate heka panèbhu.

source_text: i say unto you, that he will avenge them speedily. nevertheless, when the son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
target_text: te nèngu uri lii langu rèngu dènge boe pamata. de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne mai hari, ja'a bisa paraga dènge dhèu parcaya ètu rai-haha ne era, do aad'o?

source_text: and he spake also this parable unto certain who trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and set all others at nought:
target_text: ka yesus lolo tabha hari pake lii pakasame lula-nèti dhèu dhu pangee na ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu, aa dhu d'èi pahaha dhèu leo. na peka na,

source_text: two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a pharisee, and the other a publican.
target_text: abhu ama dhèu dua dhu lasi sabaj'a asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ca dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, aa èci hari dhèu roro bea. dhèu yahudi peka na dhèu parisi sèra, dhèu dhu mola. te ngaa ra pangee, na, dhèu roro bea, dhèu karehe.

source_text: the pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, god, i thank thee, that i am not as the rest of men, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
target_text: d'ai èmu sabaj'a dhèu parisi ne titu mesa-mesa na, ka na manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, ‘makasi lamatua, te ja'a ne dhèu be'a. ja'a ne bhelu boe nuka sèmi dhèu leo sèra. ja'a mana'u boe. ja'a manga'a boe. ja'a dhèu dhu bersina boe. makasi lamatua, te ja'a ne bhelu boe nuka sèmi dhèu roro bea ne.

source_text: i fast twice in the week; i give tithes of all that i get.
target_text: ja'a ne maj'èni puasa ca migu dua hari. aa ja'a d'èi hia ca pala nèti canguru pala nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a abhu. ' dhèu parisi ne, sabaj'a sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: but the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote his breast, saying, god, be thou merciful to me a sinner.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu roro bea ne titu pakaj'èu ètu kabodho nèi. na bani boe boti kètu ho ladhe sa dedha. nèngu dhoka pacud'u di, dhu dènge d'ara ma'ète mae-mae. na sabaj'a, peka na, ‘ama lamatua! sue ku ja'a, dhèu dhu pènu dènge sasala-sasigo ne! abho eele ku sasala ja'a! '

source_text: i say unto you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be humbled; but he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
target_text: lod'o dhèu dua se lèpa lasi asa èmu ra, cee ka dhu pabe'a dènge ama lamatua? dhèu parisi dhu pamone, do dhèu roro bea ne? tatu na sèmi dènge be'a, dhèu roro bea dhu pahaha iisi ne. te ngaa na pusi boe dènge dhèu parisi ne. te ama lamatua pahaha dhèu dhu pamone-pabhèni, te ngaa na padedha dhèu dhu re'a pahaha iisi.

source_text: and they were bringing unto him also their babes, that he should touch them: but when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu sa'u rèti ana ra dhu rara iisi hiu asa yesus, sèna ka na tao ai na mi ana iiki se, aa padhai lii hia si mamèngi. ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ana-ana madhutu yesus kai dhèu se'e.

source_text: but jesus called them unto him, saying, suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for to such belongeth the kingdom of god. verily i say unto you, whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of god as a little child, he shall in no wise enter therein.
target_text: te ngaa yesus soru mamai ra dènge be'a. hèia na kai ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa ana iiki sèra mai asa ja'a. miu baku bhabhae si. sanèd'e paie! dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua, nèngu hud'i sanao-maena dhoka mi ama lamatua, nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu sanao-maena dhoka mi ina-ama na.

source_text: and a certain ruler asked him, saying, good teacher, what shall i do to inherit eternal life?
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu kapai yahudi èci, mai karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, ama mese dhu hua iia! ja'a ne hud'i tao ku tasamia, sèna ka ja'a ke'a tare'a, na, ja'a maso sorga, aa mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: and jesus said unto him, why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, even god.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, tasamia ka èu ne peka na, ja'a ‘dhu hua iia'? dhodhoka èci di dhu hua iia, nuka ama lamatua.

source_text: thou knowest the commandments, do not commit adultery, do not kill, do not steal, do not bear false witness, honor thy father and mother.
target_text: èu me'a le atora ama lamatua karèi nèti uru ka, dhu peka na: baku j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu boe èu; baku pamadhe dhèu; baku mana'u; baku j'aj'i sakasii dhu leko-monya; aa pakab'ua ina dènge ama mu.

source_text: and he said, all these things have i observed from my youth up.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, na, tare'a, ama! ja'a dhu madhutu le atora sèra, karèi nèti ja'a ana iiki era.

source_text: and when jesus heard it, he said unto him, one thing thou lackest yet: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yesus peka, na, be'a! te ngaa èu kura ca madha j'ara era. nuka, lamu ho pahie mèdha-panyau èu aa'i-aa'i. kab'ua ra, lamu pabagi hia dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa sèra. èle na, èu lèpa hari mai sèna ka madhutu ja'a. te èèna na, ama lamatua b'ala hari mèdha-panyau èu ètu sorga.

source_text: but when he heard these things, he became exceeding sorrowful; for he was very rich.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu ne d'ara na susa, te nèngu kaja d'ai seli.

source_text: and jesus seeing him said, how hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of god!
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi dhèu ne lèpa dènge d'ara na laho mae-mae, hèia na padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, peka na, dhèu kaja mema carui titu kèna maso sorga.

source_text: for it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of god.
target_text: èdhi pasèku ku dènge j'ara leo. mema bisa boe badha unta dhu kapai bisa maso asa d'ara oka na re ro'a j'aj'au. nuka sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu dhu maena dhoka mèdha-panyau na, te ngaa maena boe lamatua, tatu nèngu bisa boe maso sorga.

source_text: and they that heard it said, then who can be saved?
target_text: dhèu dhu tadèngi yesus padhai lii sèmi sèra, karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ladhe dhèu kaja carui maso sorga, dhèu sèmi mia ka dhu bisa abhu mamuri taa-taa?

source_text: but he said, the things which are impossible with men are possible with god.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, mi dhèu rai-haha, j'ara ae-ae mema carui. te ngaa bagi ama lamatua, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i.

source_text: and peter said, lo, we have left our own, and followed thee.
target_text: hèia petrus tuhu lii, peka na, ama! ji'i tèke eele aa'i mèdha-panyau ji'i, ka mai madhutu ama. bèli-camèd'a ji'i abhu ngaa?

source_text: and he said unto them, verily i say unto you, there is no man that hath left house, or wife, or brethren, or parents, or children, for the kingdom of god's sake,
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, petrus! nanene paie-iie. dhèu dhu tèke eele èmu na, dhèu èmu-kamali na, a'ari na, ina-ama na, do ana-ana na, lula nèngu pakako sasab'a ama lamatua,

source_text: who shall not receive manifold more in this time, and in the world to come eternal life.
target_text: tatu na abhu hari ae risi ètu rai-haha ne. aa ladhe èle rai-haha ne, nèngu abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: and he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, behold, we go up to jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets shall be accomplished unto the son of man.
target_text: ka yesus gale nèti ana madhutu na canguru dua dhèu sèra, ho lasi padhue-padhai mesa ra. hèia yesus peka dènge ra, miu se aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, èdhi kako ne, lati asa kota yerusalem. d'ai nèi, j'ara aa'i-aa'i nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra dhu suri tèke le, lula-nèti dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a, pe j'aj'i nuka sèmi dhu ra suri.

source_text: for he shall be delivered up unto the gentiles, and shall be mocked, and shamefully treated, and spit upon:
target_text: èèna na, ra soro ja'a asa dhèu leo dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. aa ra padhai lii pamakae ja'a, pahahe ja'a rupa-rupa, paru'e ilu ra mi ja'a,

source_text: and they shall scourge and kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
target_text: ra hake kalabhe ja'a. èle èèna ka, ra pamadhe ja'a. te ngaa asa camèd'a èèna, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: and they understood none of these things; and this saying was hid from them, and they perceived not the things that were said.
target_text: ropa tadèngi yesus peka sèmi èèna, ana madhutu na bingu, lula rèngu dhane rare mèka sasoa nèti lii padhai yesus.

source_text: and it came to pass, as he drew nigh unto jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
target_text: lod'o yesus si oe maso kota jeriko, abhu dhèu bèdhu ca dhèu dhu madhèdi kanata ai ètu sebhe j'ara.

source_text: and hearing a multitude going by, he inquired what this meant.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu ae kako re èèna, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, ngaa ne?

source_text: and they told him, that jesus of nazareth passeth by.
target_text: ka dhèu peka dènge ne, na, yesus nèti nasaret dhu kako re ne'e.

source_text: and he cried, saying, jesus, thou son of david, have mercy on me.
target_text: hèia dhèu bèdhu ne rodhe pamèdhu-mèdhu, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu dhèu aae daud, ee! sue ku ja'a!

source_text: and they that went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried out the more a great deal, thou son of david, have mercy on me.
target_text: hèia dhèu dhu kako uuru nèti yesus kai ne, sèna ka na mau-mau. te ngaa asa na hino dènge lii rodhe, peka na, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud, ee! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: and jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi, ka na titu. hèia na pua dhèu lasi pakako rèti dhèu bèdhu ne. d'ai madha na, ka yesus karèi ne,

source_text: what wilt thou that i should do unto thee? and he said, lord, that i may receive my sight.
target_text: èu neo ja'a tao ngaa hia èu? ka na dhaa, ama! ja'a manèngi sèna ka ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: and jesus said unto him, receive thy sight: thy faith hath made thee whole.
target_text: yesus b'ala ne, peka na, be'a. lula èu lèka na ja'a bisa pa'èle èu, de èu bisa mèdhi dènge kèna.

source_text: and immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying god: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto god.
target_text: kaca'a laa, musi madha dhèu ne be'a dènge ka. ka la'e madhutu yesus dènge koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ladhe rèdhi ne, koa-kio kolongara lamatua kahèi.

source_text: and he entered and was passing through jericho.
target_text: ka yesus si maso re kota jeriko, ho neo lasi taruu.

source_text: and behold, a man called by name zacchæus; and he was a chief publican, and he was rich.
target_text: ètu ne'e, abhu ca dhèu kapala roro bea dhu roro doi hia dhèu paredha roma. ngara na sakeos, aa nèngu ne dhèu kaja.

source_text: and he sought to see jesus who he was; and could not for the crowd, because he was little of stature.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi yesus kako re èèna, ka nèngu neo nèdhi. te ngaa bisa boe nèdhi dènge be'a, lula katitu na bab'a d'ai seli, aa dhèu ae dhu kalibhu rare yesus.

source_text: and he ran on before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na rai uru, ka na ca'e asa kolo aj'u ca kapua ètu sebhe j'ara, dhu yesus neo re èèna.

source_text: and when jesus came to the place, he looked up, and said unto him, zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to-day i must abide at thy house.
target_text: ropa d'ai kapua aj'u ne, yesus ladhe asa dedha. hèia na paroa, peka na, sakeos! puru ka! karohe, te deo ne'e kahèi, ja'a neo manubha ètu d'ara èmu èu.

source_text: and he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
target_text: ka sakeos malaa. hèia na puru pamèri-pamèri, la'e dènge yesus asa èmu na. d'ara na karej'e-karae.

source_text: and when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, he is gone in to lodge with a man that is a sinner.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae dhu ka'ugu, peka na, hmm! sakeos ne, dhèu karehe! nga tao ka yesus manubha ètu d'ara èmu na? ! dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a le!

source_text: and zacchæus stood, and said unto the lord, behold, lord, the half of my goods i give to the poor; and if i have wrongfully exacted aught of any man, i restore fourfold.
target_text: d'ai d'ara èmu, sakeos titu ètu madha yesus, ka lii, peka na, ama mese! nèti deo ne'e ne, ja'a bagi mèdha-panyau ja'a mi dua, capala hia mi dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. ladhe ja'a roro bea parisi, ja'a b'ae hari mi rèngu èpa kali lipat.

source_text: and jesus said unto him, to-day is salvation come to this house, forasmuch as he also is a son of abraham.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala ne, peka na, be'a. deo ne'e kahèi, ama lamatua pala-bagi sod'a-mole mi èu dènge isi èmu èu aa'i-aa'i, lula èu parcaya lamatua kahèi, nuka sèmi baki abraham.

source_text: for the son of man came to seek and to save that which was lost.
target_text: te ama lamatua pua ja'a mai j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ètu rai-haha ne. mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka tenge dhèu dhu sero nèti j'ara lamatua, ho hia si sod'a-mole.

source_text: and as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to jerusalem, and because they supposed that the kingdom of god was immediately to appear.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae nanene lii padhai yesus. rèngu oe dètu dènge kota yerusalem. rèngu pangee, na, yesus neo pakako paredha ama lamatua ètu èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu aae. hèia yesus lolo dènge si lii pakasame èci.

source_text: he said therefore, a certain nobleman went into a far country, to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
target_text: na peka na, abhu dhèu kapai èci. neo la'e asa rai kaj'èu, ho dhèu ded'e ne j'aj'i dhèu aae ètu nèi. ladhe èle, nèngu neo lèpa hari mai ho j'aj'i dhèu aae ètu d'ara kabarai na.

source_text: and he called ten servants of his, and gave them ten pounds, and said unto them, trade ye herewith till i come.
target_text: lod'o nèngu pa'èra neo pakèd'i, paroa nare dhèu sab'a na canguru dhèu, ka na bagi hia si ca dhèu, juru cue. na paredha si, peka na, ‘miu pake doi se j'aj'i mi poko. te lod'o d'ai ja'a lèpa, miu hud'i peka ku leto na ca ngaa. ' èle èèna ka, na pakèd'i.

source_text: but his citizens hated him, and sent an ambassage after him, saying, we will not that this man reign over us.
target_text: te ngaa kabarai na d'èi boe ne. ka ra hia dhèu lasi peka, na, ‘ji'i ngo'o boe dhèu ne paredha ji'i. '

source_text: and it came to pass, when he was come back again, having received the kingdom, that he commanded these servants, unto whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by trading.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, ra ded'e ne j'aj'i dhèu aae. hèia na lèpa hari ka. d'ai èmu na, ka na paroa dhèu sab'a na, dhèu canguru sèra, ka karèi si, peka na, ‘miu se leto ca ngaa nèti juru dhu ja'a hia miu sèra? '

source_text: and the first came before him, saying, lord, thy pound hath made ten pounds more.
target_text: dhèu sab'a dhu uru, peka na, ‘ama dhèu aae! ja'a leto juru canguru bua nèti poko dhu ja'a abhu! '

source_text: and he said unto him, well done, thou good servant: because thou wast found faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka dènge ne, ‘be'a! èu ne dhèu sab'a dhu maj'èni. lula ja'a bisa lèka èu nèti j'ara dhu ana iiki, nèti èèna ka karèi nèti deo ne'e, ja'a ded'e èu ho paredha canguru kota. '

source_text: and the second came, saying, thy pound, lord, hath made five pounds.
target_text: èle ka dhèu sab'a ka dua, peka na, ‘ama dhèu aae! ja'a abhu leto juru lèmi bua nèti poko dhu ja'a sèmi. '

source_text: and he said unto him also, be thou also over five cities.
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka, na, ‘be'a! ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ded'e èu ho paredha lèmi kota. '

source_text: and another came, saying, lord, behold, here is thy pound, which i kept laid up in a napkin:
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a ka tèlu nèti hari juru na. ka na peka, ‘doi ama ka ne'e! ja'a rapi ka pahuni ne, mage ele.

source_text: for i feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that which thou layedst not down, and reapest that which thou didst not sow.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi èèna, lula madha'u. ja'a ke'a ama, dhèu nasa. te ama d'èi more ngaa dhu unu boe ama, aa d'èi puu hua dhu ama sèle boe! '

source_text: he saith unto him, out of thine own mouth will i judge thee, thou wicked servant. thou knewest that i am an austere man, taking up that which i laid not down, and reaping that which i did not sow;
target_text: ropa dhèu aae tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka na jèke ne, ‘èu ne, dhèu goa d'ara! lii padhai èu ne pabia ngi'u èu mesa mu. èu me'a, na, ja'a dhèu nasa, ho kore ngaa dhu unu boe ja'a, aa puu ngaa dhu ja'a sèle boe.

source_text: then wherefore gavest thou not my money into the bank, and i at my coming should have required it with interest?
target_text: de ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka lamu boe tèke ne asa bank? ho sèna ka lod'o ja'a lèpa, ja'a bisa abhu leto. masi ka ciki di. '

source_text: and he said unto them that stood by, take away from him the pound, and give it unto him that hath the ten pounds.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae ne pua dhèu leo ètu sèra, peka na, ‘mere doi nèngu ne, sèna ka hia mi dhèu sab'a dhu abhu leto canguru deo na. '

source_text: and they said unto him, lord, he hath ten pounds.
target_text: te ngaa ra pasisu, peka na, ‘ama! dhèu ne abhu ae le. nga tao ka neo more nèti dhèu dhu unu ciki, ho patabha sa nèngu hari? '

source_text: i say unto you, that unto every one that hath shall be given; but from him that hath not, even that which he hath shall be taken away from him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aae b'ala, peka na, ‘pangee paie-iie ku! ladhe dhèu dhu mèu uri ngaa dhu dhèu hia ne, èèna na nèngu abhu tabha hari. te ngaa dhèu dhu bai-eed'a, èèna na rare aa'i ngaa dhu na unu.

source_text: but these mine enemies, that would not that i should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
target_text: de lami kèpe mere musu ja'a, dhu ro'o boe ja'a j'aj'i dhèu aae. mèti si mai sa ne'e, sèna ka pamadhe si ètu madha ja'a. lami ka! '

source_text: and when he had thus spoken, he went on before, going up to jerusalem.
target_text: ropa yesus lolo èle, hèia lasi taruu ka asa yerusalem. yesus dhu kako uru.

source_text: and it came to pass, when he drew nigh unto bethphage and bethany, at the mount that is called olivet, he sent two of the disciples,
target_text: ropa oe dètu dènge dua rae, nuka betfage dènge betania, dhu ètu karasa ledhe saitun, ka na pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua lasi uru.

source_text: saying, go your way into the village over against you; in which as ye enter ye shall find a colt tied, whereon no man ever yet sat: loose him, and bring him.
target_text: na pua si peka na, miu dua mi lami asa rae dhu ètu madha nèi. pe miu mèdhi keled'ei ngèru ci'u dhu èki tèke ètu èèna. keled'ei ne, dhèu manya'e rèdhi mèka. mi lècu dhari na, pakako mèti mai.

source_text: and if any one ask you, why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say, the lord hath need of him.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu karèi, ‘tasamia ka mi lècu eele dhari keled'ei èèna? ' mi peka dènge si, na, ‘lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. '

source_text: and they that were sent went away, and found even as he had said unto them.
target_text: dua ra lasi ka, hèia ra rage keled'ei ngèru nuka sèmi dhu yesus peka.

source_text: and as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, why loose ye the colt?
target_text: ropa ra lècu dhari keled'ei ne, ka lamatua badha ne karèi si, na, nga tao ka miu patabuli badha ne?

source_text: and they said, the lord hath need of him.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, lamatua ji'i neo pake ne.

source_text: and they brought him to jesus: and they threw their garments upon the colt, and set jesus thereon.
target_text: lamatua badha ne d'èi kahèi, ka dua ra nuni rèti keled'ei asa yesus. ra hèle sig'i-kalolo ra mi dedha kabodho keled'ei ne. èle èèna ka, ra paca'e yesus asa dedha na.

source_text: and as he went, they spread their garments in the way.
target_text: dhèu ae kahèi hèle sig'i-kalolo dènge salalu ra mi j'ara, ho soru yesus nuka sèmi soru dhèu kapai.

source_text: and as he was now drawing nigh, even at the descent of the mount of olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise god with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen;
target_text: ropa na puru nèti ledhe saitun, ka dhèu se dènge ana-ana madhutu na, mulai pa'oo koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua, lula rèngu rèdhi le tadha-tadha koasa.

source_text: saying, blessed is the king that cometh in the name of the lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
target_text: ra pa'oo peka na, nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhu ama lamatua pua mai! ama lamatua hia ne berkat! dhèu rai-haha limuri ne, bisa padame le dènge lamatua ètu sorga. koa-kio kolongara lamatua dhu madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu dedha-liru dhu dedha risi.

source_text: and some of the pharisees from the multitude said unto him, teacher, rebuke thy disciples.
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu parisi ètu talora aae dhèu ae sèra. ka ra peka dènge yesus, ama mese! kai ku dhèu se, ho baku ra pakii-pakèce sèmi ne'e, te seli-kolane!

source_text: and he answered and said, i tell you that, if these shall hold their peace, the stones will cry out.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, ja'a pasanèd'e mema! ladhe dhèu se'e kutu hèb'a ra, èèna na, hadhu se ka dhu koa-kio kolongara lamatua!

source_text: and when he drew nigh, he saw the city and wept over it,
target_text: ropa rèngu oe dètu yerusalem, yesus ladhe nèdhi kota ne, hèia na tangi,

source_text: saying, if thou hadst known in this day, even thou, the things which belong unto peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
target_text: peka na, ira ii! dhèu yerusalem, ee! dad'èi ja'a deo ne'e, miu abhu dame dhu ja'a kèti mai. te ngaa lula miu pahae boe lamatua, ka miu unu heka. dame ne pakaj'èu le nèti miu.

source_text: for the days shall come upon thee, when thine enemies shall cast up a bank about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
target_text: bèli-camèd'a musu miu mai udhu padedha rai palème li'u tedhe miu ne, hèia ra maso sa d'ara, musu dènge miu.

source_text: and shall dash thee to the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
target_text: ra dhedhe palaho kota miu, toke pamera dènge rai, hèia ra pamadhe aa'i miu dènge ana-ana mi. ra tèke eele boe hadhu cue sa dhu titu, lula miu mo'o boe tadhe lamatua lod'o na mai hia miu mamuri!

source_text: and he entered into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus maso asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu madha èmu ne, dhèu tao sèmi pasa sa, ho ra pahia badha korban. ropa nèdhi, hèia yesus babège si nèti era èèna.

source_text: saying unto them, it is written, and my house shall be a house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of robbers.
target_text: ka na jèke si, peka na, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘ja'a patitu èmu ne, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa mai manèngi-mangaj'i ètu era ne'e. ' te ngaa mi tao ne nuka sèmi era pakaboko dhèu parapo.

source_text: and he was teaching daily in the temple. but the chief priests and the scribes and the principal men of the people sought to destroy him:
target_text: èle èèna ka, bèli-bèli yesus la'e aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, patangi-tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: and they could not find what they might do; for the people all hung upon him, listening.
target_text: te ngaa ra abhu boe j'ara, lula dhèu ae dhu d'èi titu kèna, nanene lii padhai yesus.

source_text: and it came to pass, on one of the days, as he was teaching the people in the temple, and preaching the gospel, there came upon him the chief priests and the scribes with the elders;
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus la'e asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na aj'a-nori lii lolo be'a lamatua ètu èèna. hèia kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, mai karèi ne.

source_text: and they spake, saying unto him, tell us: by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
target_text: ra peka na, mu peka ku laa! cee ka dhu hia èu hak sèna ka ad'u-ue maruru ètu ne'e med'a na?

source_text: and he answered and said unto them, i also will ask you a question; and tell me:
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, ja'a neo karèi miu ca madha j'ara kahèi, heka ja'a dhaa lii karèi miu kèna.

source_text: the baptism of john, was it from heaven, or from men?
target_text: sèmi ne'e: miu se tadhe yohanis tuka sarani dhèu, do? cee ka dhu hia ne koasa ho sarani dhèu? ama lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha?

source_text: and they reasoned with themselves, saying, if we shall say, from heaven; he will say, why did ye not believe him?
target_text: hèia ra papeka èci dènge èci, ira ee! èdhi sèmi tare le pala ti ngaa. ladhe èdhi peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka pua', èèna na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka miu lèka boe yohanis? '

source_text: but if we shall say, from men; all the people will stone us: for they are persuaded that john was a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘dhèu rai-haha ka pua', na dhèu ae sèra pèci pamadhe èdhi. te dhèu sèra parcaya, na, yohanis ne dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua.

source_text: and they answered, that they knew not whence it was.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i nge'a boe.

source_text: and jesus said unto them, neither tell i you by what authority i do these things.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ra, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ko'o boe peka kahèi, cee ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: and he began to speak unto the people this parable: a man planted a vineyard, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into another country for a long time.
target_text: hèia yesus lolo dènge dhèu ae sèra, pake lii pakasame, peka na, abhu dhèu èci dhu sèle anggor ètu d'ara oka na. na hia dhèu seb'a oka anggor ne, sèna ka rèngu pabagi isi rai nèti oka-tedhe ne. ka na pidha la'e pea panèbhu asa rai kaj'èu.

source_text: and at the season he sent unto the husbandmen a servant, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
target_text: d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu, hèia lamatua oka anggor ne pua ana paleha na ca dhèu, la'e nare pala nèngu. te ngaa dhèu sab'a oka anggor se, game ana paleha ne, ka ra hia ne lèpa dènge ai hua.

source_text: and he sent yet another servant: and him also they beat, and handled him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua oka ne pua ana paleha na ca dhèu hari. te ngaa dhèu sab'a oka se game, ka ra pamakae ne. hèia ra babège ne lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: and he sent yet a third: and him also they wounded, and cast him forth.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua oka ne pua hari ana paleha na ka tèlu, te ngaa ra game ne, toke diu raa, ka ra core ne asa li'u oka.

source_text: and the lord of the vineyard said, what shall i do? i will send my beloved son; it may be they will reverence him.
target_text: hèia lamatua oka ne pangee ka, ‘ja'a tao hari ku tasamia? be'a risi ja'a pua ana pasue ja'a ka la'e. ele boe ra pakab'ua ne, de ra sèmi ne dènge be'a. ' de na pua ana d'èlu na la'e.

source_text: but when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned one with another, saying, this is the heir; let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu sab'a oka anggor se ladhe rèdhi ne, hèia ra papeka èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, ‘mi ladhe ku laa! te lamatua oka ne hia ana d'èlu na nuka mai nèi. nèngu ne ka dhu bèli-camèd'a unu pusaka ama na aa'i-aa'i ra. de ta pamadhe ne! sèna ka èdhi ka dhu unu oka anggor ne. '

source_text: and they cast him forth out of the vineyard, and killed him. what therefore will the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
target_text: ropa ana ne d'ai, hèia dhèu se nuni pa'oro ne rèti asa li'u oka, ka ra pamadhe ne. de ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: miu pangee, na, lamatua oka ne tao dhèu sab'a oka sèra tasamia?

source_text: he will come and destroy these husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others. and when they heard it, they said, god forbid.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, tatu na mai pamadhe aa'i si, ka na hia hari dhèu leo seb'a oka ne. ropa dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai yesus, rèngu peka na, ladhe bisa, na, ji'i baku abhu huku nèti ama lamatua sèmi èèna!

source_text: but he looked upon them, and said, what then is this that is written, the stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner?
target_text: hèia yesus laladhe patae si, ka na karèi, ladhe huku boe si sèmi èèna, nga tao ka dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua suri, na: ‘hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu core eele le, te ngaa limuri ne dhu j'aj'i le era padhèdi agarii talora? '

source_text: every one that falleth on that stone shall be broken to pieces; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will scatter him as dust.
target_text: dhèu dhu kadhunu lèke hadhu ne, nèngu tatu laho teb'o-teb'o, lula abhu huku. aa ladhe hadhu ne bèbhe lèke dhèu cee, nèngu laho kao-kao, lula lèke huku.

source_text: and the scribes and the chief priests sought to lay hands on him in that very hour; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he spake this parable against them.
target_text: ropa mese agama dènge kètu agama yahudi se tadèngi lii lolo ne, rèngu re'a, na, yesus padhai lii padhèto dènge rèngu pake lii pakasame. rèngu se cakaraa dènge dhèu seb'a oka anggor deo sa. de ra nasa titu kèna. ka ra tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe ne. te ngaa rèngu madha'u dènge dhèu ae sèra, dhu d'èi nanene lii aj'a yesus. ka lasi tèke eele ne.

source_text: and they watched him, and sent forth spies, who feigned themselves to be righteous, that they might take hold of his speech, so as to deliver him up to the rule and to the authority of the governor.
target_text: èle ka, musu-musu yesus ma'u ne. rèngu tenge dhèu j'aj'i mata-mata dhu bisa tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu mola, sèna ka ra kèpe ne. rèngu sanao sèna ka yesus padhai lii dhu palab'a dènge dhèu paredha roma, ho èèna na lasi peka dènge gubernur, sèna ka ra pua dhèu lasi kèpe yesus.

source_text: and they asked him, saying, teacher, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, and acceptest not the person of any, but of a truth teachest the way of god:
target_text: ka ra pua mata-mata, sèna ka pakarèi dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a ama ca dhèu dhu d'ara mola. ama me'a boe kapod'e-kabèli, aa hag'e boe dhèu. ama aj'a-nori dhèu madhutu lii lolo be'a ama lamatua dènge mola.

source_text: is it lawful for us to give tribute unto cæsar, or not?
target_text: de ji'i neo karèi ca j'ara: madhutu atora agama èdhi dhèu yahudi, hud'i ji'i b'ae ku doi bea mi dhèu aae kapai paredha roma, do aad'o?

source_text: but he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them,
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le ngangee kaj'alu rèngu ho neo pamanahu ne. ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na,

source_text: show me a denarius. whose image and superscription hath it? and they said, cæsar's.
target_text: pad'elo sèku ja'a doi iia cue. hèia ra pad'elo dènge ne doi èci. ka yesus karèi si, ne'e ne, rupa cee ka ne? aa ngara cee, ne? ra dhaa, peka na, èèna, dhèu aae kapai, keser.

source_text: and he said unto them, then render unto cæsar the things that are cæsar's, and unto god the things that are god's.
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, hia asa dhèu paredha, ngaa dhu unu rèngu. aa hia mi ama lamatua ngaa dhu j'aj'i hak ama lamatua.

source_text: and they were not able to take hold of the saying before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, dhèu se malaa, lula rèngu bisa boe sii pamanahu rare ne ètu madha dhèu ae. ka hèb'a ra kutu mèno.

source_text: and there came to him certain of the sadducees, they that say that there is no resurrection;
target_text: èle èèna ka, pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama saduki mai ho neo kèpe yesus. dhèu saduki aj'a, na, dhèu madhe mamuri heka ètu lod'o èle rai-haha ne. rèngu mai pakarèi dènge yesus, na,

source_text: and they asked him, saying, teacher, moses wrote unto us, that if a man's brother die, having a wife, and he be childless, his brother should take the wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
target_text: ama mese! atora musa dhu suri tèke hia èdhi, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone madhe, aa dhu dènge mèka kolo, na, ari nèti dhèu madhe ne madhèdi nare hari bhèni balu ne, sèna ka abhu kolo hia a'a dhu madhe ne.

source_text: there were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died childless;
target_text: mema uru èèna baki musa aj'a sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ana mone dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. dhu uru leo-èmu, te ngaa madhe dènge boe ana.

source_text: and the second:
target_text: hèia ari na todhe nare hari bhèni balu ne. nèbhu boe ka, na madhe, dhu dènge mèka kolo kahèi.

source_text: and the third took her; and likewise the seven also left no children, and died.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ana ka tèlu. na leo dènge bhèni balu ne, te ngaa madhe kahèi dènge boe ana. toke ari ra limuri tèka, madhe kahèi dènge boe kolo.

source_text: afterward the woman also died.
target_text: hèia bhèni balu ne madhe.

source_text: in the resurrection therefore whose wife of them shall she be? for the seven had her to wife.
target_text: de ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: bhèni ne leo nèdhi le dènge ana mone dhèu pidhu sèra. ladhe d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe sèra, bhèni ne j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu cee?

source_text: and jesus said unto them, the sons of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, dhèu dhodhoka paleo èmu ètu rai-haha ne di.

source_text: but they that are accounted worthy to attain to that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage: for neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are sons of god, being sons of the resurrection.
target_text: te ngaa ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. aa ètu era nèi, dhèu madhe heka. rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ana pajuu nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga. te, lod'o ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, na hag'e nare si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ana na.

source_text: but that the dead are raised, even moses showed, in the place concerning the bush, when he calleth the lord the god of abraham, and the god of isaac, and the god of jacob.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri baki musa, dhu lole aj'u iiki ca kapua dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. nèti lii lolo ne, èdhi te'a, na, dhèu madhe bisa mamuri hari. ètu èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti baki èu dhu uru-uru sèra. nuka baki abraham, isak dènge yakob. rèngu se mangaj'i taa-taa mi ja'a toke d'ai sange ne'e ne. '

source_text: now he is not the god of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
target_text: masi ka baki mu se madhe karèi jahi ali. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua ka dhu peka na, nèngu j'aj'i mi lamatua rèngu era, de èdhi te'a le, na, rèngu se mamuri era. de masi ka dhèu madhe le, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. te dhoka dhèu dhu mamuri di, dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua; dhèu madhe, aad'o si!

source_text: and certain of the scribes answering said, teacher, thou hast well said.
target_text: tadèngi yesus dhaa sèmi èèna, ka mese agama padhai lii, peka na, lii dhaa ama mese èèna, lèke kèna.

source_text: for they durst not any more ask him any question.
target_text: nèti lod'o èèna, abhu heka ca dhèu sa dhu bani karèi yesus, lula abhu boe j'ara dhu bisa pamanahu rare ne.

source_text: and he said unto them, how say they that the christ is david's son?
target_text: yesus aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i era. ka na karèi dhèu sèra, peka na, madhutu a'abhu miu, tasamia? mese agama sèra, aj'a peka na, kristus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru-uru ka. madhutu a'aj'a rèngu, nèngu ne dhodhoka ana-èpu dhèu aae daud di. te ngaa èèna dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: for david himself saith in the book of psalms, the lord said unto my lord, sit thou on my right hand,
target_text: lula uru èèna, dhèu aae daud mesa na dhu suri le, ètu d'ara lii sod'a koa-kio, na, ‘ama lamatua peka le dènge lamatua ja'a, na, mai madhèdi mi era dhu kab'ua ètu babo g'ana ja'a ne.

source_text: till i make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a ja'a tao musu-musu èu, toke ra pahaha iisi mi èu. '

source_text: david therefore calleth him lord, and how is he his son?
target_text: de nèti sasuri ne, èdhi te'a, na, dhèu aae daud mesa na paroa kristus ne, ‘lamatua'. sasoa na, ladhe dhèu peka na kristus ne dhoka ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud di, èèna dhae d'ai mèka! lula nèngu ne j'aj'i lamatua nèti dhèu aae daud kahèi!

source_text: and in the hearing of all the people he said unto his disciples,
target_text: ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i taru kira mi lii padhai yesus, hèia na peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: beware of the scribes, who desire to walk in long robes, and love salutations in the marketplaces, and chief seats in the synagogues, and chief places at feasts;
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge mese agama sèra. te rèngu d'èi kako pake kodho robho rai, lasi paraga dènge dhèu ae, ho dhèu koa si, peka na, ‘rèngu se dhèu kapai! ' rèngu d'èi tenge era re madha ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, ètu d'ara pesta, aa ètu era-era dhèu ae pakaboko.

source_text: who devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater condemnation.
target_text: de miu baku pamud'e, lula rèngu d'èi kapod'e-kabèli bhèni balu ho parame rare èmu ra. te ngaa ètu madha dhèu ae, rèngu pahuni bhabhelu ra dènge titu ho sabaj'a panèbhu-nèbhu. rèngu d'èi dhèu koa ra, peka na, rèngu dhèu mola. te ngaa lamatua ne'a sasala ra, de èèna na nèngu huku si bia risi.

source_text: and he looked up, and saw the rich men that were casting their gifts into the treasury.
target_text: lod'o yesus aj'a ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ladhe nèdhi dhèu kaja mai pamaso doi asa d'ara boaraka derma.

source_text: and he saw a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
target_text: ladhe nèdhi kahèi bhèni balu ca dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa mai madhutu sabaj'a. na pamaso kahèi doi dua sen asa d'ara boaraka ne. doi na se'e, kab'ua ciki oo'e di.

source_text: and he said, of a truth i say unto you, this poor widow cast in more than they all:
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ana madhutu na, peka na, nanene pabe'a-be'a! bhèni balu ne, dhoka pamaso doi dua sen di, te ngaa na hia risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for all these did of their superfluity cast in unto the gifts; but she of her want did cast in all the living that she had.
target_text: dhèu leo se pamaso doi kolete nèti doi karisi rèngu. te ngaa bhèni balu ne hia aa'i mèu-mèu doi na tao mi doi kolete. masi ka nèti doi ne'e, nèngu ako taha mamuri.

source_text: and as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and offerings, he said,
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus dhu koa-kad'iri èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, ama! ladhe ku laa, èmu ne be'a titu kèna! ra pake hadhu cetak dhu kapai hua, ka ra paca'e mera titu kèna. aa dhèu hia kahèi mèdha ra dhu kab'ua, sèna ka pasaraga èmu lamatua ne! te ngaa yesus b'ala, na,

source_text: as for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in which there shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
target_text: èmu ne mema saraga. te ngaa nèbhu heka, dhèu paguri eela hadhu se, toke mera dènge rai.

source_text: and they asked him, saying, teacher, when therefore shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when these things are about to come to pass?
target_text: hèia ana madhutu yesus se karèi, peka na, ama mese! ngaa dhu ama peka-padhai deo na, j'aj'aj'i na pèri lod'o? ladhe lod'o na dètu le, tadha-tadha na sèmi ngaa sa?

source_text: and he said, take heed that ye be not led astray: for many shall come in my name, saying, i am he; and, the time is at hand: go ye not after them.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sad'i miu j'aga paie-iie, ho baku lèke tipu. te èèna na rupa-rupa dhèu mai tèb'a kakara ra, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus. ' abhu kahèi dhu peka na, ‘lod'o a'èle rai-haha dètu kèna! ' te ngaa baku mi parcaya kahèi!

source_text: and when ye shall hear of wars and tumults, be not terrified: for these things must needs come to pass first; but the end is not immediately.
target_text: ladhe miu tadèngi ka dhèu palolo, peka na: dhèu patao-palaha, dènge papara-pakèj'i ètu mia-mia, baku mi cag'ag'a. sèra sa hud'i j'aj'i uru ku. te ngaa d'ai mèka lod'o èle rai-haha ne.

source_text: then said he unto them, nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom;
target_text: bèli-camèd'a suku èci pamusu dènge suku leo. negara èci papara-pakèj'i dènge negara leo.

source_text: and there shall be great earthquakes, and in divers places famines and pestilences; and there shall be terrors and great signs from heaven.
target_text: èèna na, j'aj'i rai opo dhu kapai aae. ètu mia-mia, manganga-mad'èu dhu seli eele, aa èi papèd'a pad'ai cèu palème era. bèli-camèd'a dhèu ladhe rèdhi kahèi tadha dhu pamadha'u dhèu, aa tadha-tadha dhu kapai aae ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: but before all these things, they shall lay their hands on you, and shall persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name's sake.
target_text: j'ara se'e se j'aj'i aa'i mèka, te ngaa èèna na dhèu mai kèpe rare miu, aa paj'èra miu, lula miu parcaya ja'a. hèia ra soro miu asa dhèu dhu uri lii langu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a, aa ra taha miu ètu d'ara bèdho. ra rèti miu asa madha dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu paredha leo. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i, lula miu madhutu ja'a.

source_text: it shall turn out unto you for a testimony.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i pake lod'o ne'e, sèna ka peka dènge rèngu lii lolo be'a ja'a.

source_text: settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate beforehand how to answer:
target_text: de mage pangee tasamia miu siri iisi.

source_text: for i will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to withstand or to gainsay.
target_text: te lod'o èèna, ja'a hia miu lii-lii dhu pamèci dènge lii dhaa. dènge sèmi èèna, musu miu sèra, re'a heka peka-padhai sèmi ngaa hari.

source_text: but ye shall be delivered up even by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolk, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death. and ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a dhèu tèka d'ara dènge miu, lula miu madhutu ja'a. abhu nèti a'ari miu unu mi, sèmi ina-ama, a'ari, kera ba'i, rae lesa dènge mone anga-aangalai. èèna na nèti rèngu se'e ka, tenge j'ara ho pahie eele miu, toke ra pamadhe miu cahag'e.

source_text: and not a hair of your head shall perish.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku madha'u, te lamatua bhèlu boe miu. rèu kètu miu ca loa sa kabhui eele boe, ladhe dènge boe dad'èi na.

source_text: in your patience ye shall win your souls.
target_text: ladhe miu taha mere taruu, tatu ama lamatua pala-bagi mamuri hia miu.

source_text: but when ye see jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that her desolation is at hand.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu mèdhi ka sordad'u mai pamusu reo rare yerusalem, miu me'a le, na, d'ai lod'o ele iie yerusalem kèna.

source_text: then let them that are in judæa flee unto the mountains; and let them that are in the midst of her depart out; and let not them that are in the country enter therein.
target_text: ropa ladhe mèdhi sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu propensi yudea rai dènge ka asa ledhe-ledhe. dhèu ètu d'ara kota kèd'i kahèi, sèna ka rai. aa dhèu ètu rae, mai ia ka asa d'ara kota.

source_text: for these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
target_text: te lamatua hia lod'o-lod'o sasusa sèra, ho huku dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe nanene nèngu. se'e se lèke nuka sèmi lii padhai nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: woe unto them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days! for there shall be great distress upon the land, and wrath unto this people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu dhu j'èra risi, nuka, dhèu bhèni dhu dènge babia, aa ina-ina dhu dènge ana susu. lod'o èèna, abhu susa palème rai-haha, aa dhèu yahudi j'èra bia, lula ama lamatua nasa dènge rèngu sèra.

source_text: and they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led captive into all the nations: and jerusalem shall be trodden down of the gentiles, until the times of the gentiles be fulfilled.
target_text: èèna na musu mai pamadhe si cahag'e, aa taha cahag'e ho j'aj'i ènu ètu mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne. ka dhèu leo rai kara dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua, mai j'aj'èli pakaj'alu kota yerusalem, aa koasa rare kabarai na, toke èle lod'o ra.

source_text: and there shall be signs in sun and moon and stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the billows;
target_text: èle ka yesus lole mamai hari na, aku nèngu na, bèli-camèd'a ladhe dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a neo mai hari, abhu tadha ètu madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua hètu-hua hètu. ètu rai-haha ne abhu tadha kahèi, sèmi uli sea, dhasi ko'a dhu loe boe, aa naha aae lalulu mai. se'e se tao dhèu rai-haha ne, madha'u dènge ele ngangee, toke re'a heka tao ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens shall be shaken.
target_text: koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru loe boe karèbha. ropa ladhe rèdhi aa'i-aa'i, hèia ra madha'u titu kèna, lula rai-haha ne oe ele iie kèna!

source_text: and then shall they see the son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
target_text: èle ku heka dhèu ladhe rèdhi ja'a kèna, ‘dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne puru mai ètu d'ara ra'i-liru'. ja'a mai dènge koasa, aa dènge dadedha dhu kapai risi eele.

source_text: but when these things begin to come to pass, look up, and lift up your heads; because your redemption draweth nigh.
target_text: ladhe mulai j'aj'i ka tadha sèra, na, miu boti ka kètu miu, te lod'o d'ai kèna, lamatua hia mamuri mi miu.

source_text: and he spake to them a parable: behold the fig tree, and all the trees:
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lolo pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, miu taru kira pabe'a-be'a ku mi aj'u sèra.

source_text: when they now shoot forth, ye see it and know of your own selves that the summer is now nigh.
target_text: ladhe d'ai ka hèru rèu ra karara, èèna tadha na hèru hadhu dètu le.

source_text: even so ye also, when ye see these things coming to pass, know ye that the kingdom of god is nigh.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge lod'o-lod'o sasusa. ladhe cèu, èèna tadha na paredha ama lamatua dhu dètu iiki le.

source_text: verily i say unto you, this generation shall not pass away, till all things be accomplished.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e mema miu! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri limuri ne, bèli-camèd'a cahag'e dhae madhe mèka, te lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra se mai le.

source_text: heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
target_text: masi ka liru dènge rai-haha ele, te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a taha taa-taa.

source_text: but take heed to yourselves, lest haply your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day come on you suddenly as a snare:
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mi j'aga-j'aga, te cag'ag'a laa ja'a mai hari sahèka! mage dhoka miu taru kira heka, hèia miu mamuri dènge minu mahu, aa bhute dhoka tenge mamuri karej'e di. mage dhoka miu me'a boe tadha ne, lula miu bhute dènge j'ara dhu leo.

source_text: for so shall it come upon all them that dwell on the face of all the earth.
target_text: ladhe ja'a lèpa hari mai, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pahuni iisi ra nèti madha ja'a.

source_text: but watch ye at every season, making supplication, that ye may prevail to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the son of man.
target_text: de miu hud'i mate tatae ku. baku ma'ète manèngi-mangaj'i, sèna ka miu bisa taha ètu talora aae sasusa sèra. dènge sèmi èèna, ropa ja'a lèpa hari mai, miu makae boe titu ètu madha dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: and every day he was teaching in the temple; and every night he went out, and lodged in the mount that is called olivet.
target_text: bèli-bèli, ladhe re mèu, yesus la'e aj'a lii holo-nori lamatua ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa ladhe re mèda, kalua nèti yerusalem ho la'e bhèj'i asa rae ètu ledhe saitun.

source_text: and all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, to hear him.
target_text: mad'ae aae era, dhèu ae-ae dhu mai le pakaboko ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho nanene lii aj'a-nori na.

source_text: now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the passover.
target_text: lod'o èèna, oe d'ai lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi, nuka pesta roti dhu dènge boe ragi. ètu d'ara lod'o hua iia se, ra roro kahib'i-kalèbho tao kalela paska kahèi. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, sèna ka pasanèd'e uru èèna, lod'o bèi-baki rèngu kalua nèti masir.

source_text: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death; for they feared the people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tenge j'ara ho pamadhe yesus. te ngaa ra mage dhèu ae sèra maruru, lula dhèu se d'èi nanene ne.

source_text: and satan entered into judas who was called iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
target_text: nèti dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus, dhèu canguru dua sèra, èci ngara na yudas iskariot. lod'o kètu agama yahudi sèra tenge j'ara ho pamadhe yesus, dhèu aae nidhu maso asa d'ara yudas iskariot.

source_text: and he went away, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might deliver him unto them.
target_text: hèia la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi se dènge kètu nèti dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. la'e neo pane'a dènge ra, sèna ka pahie yesus dènge rèngu.

source_text: and they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yudas, hèia ra karej'e titu kèna. ra pamoa, peka na, la'a, ma! ladhe èu neo pahie yesus dènge ji'i, na ji'i b'ae.

source_text: and he consented, and sought opportunity to deliver him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
target_text: ka yudas d'èi, hèia na mulai tenge lod'o dhu lake nare, sèna ka dhèu ae baku re'a nèngu pahie eele yesus.

source_text: and the day of unleavened bread came, on which the passover must be sacrificed.
target_text: hèia d'ai ka lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi, dhu rèngu biasa roro ana kahib'i-kalèbho sèna ka tao kalela paska.

source_text: and he sent peter and john, saying, go and make ready for us the passover, that we may eat.
target_text: ka yesus pua petrus dènge yohanis, aku nèngu na, dua mi lami uuru, sèna ka sadia tèke nganga'a kalela paska ho ta'a sama-sama.

source_text: and they said unto him, where wilt thou that we make ready?
target_text: ka dua ra karèi, ama! ji'i la'a sadia nganga'a asa mia?

source_text: and he said unto them, behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house whereinto he goeth.
target_text: hèia na b'ala, ladhe miu maso asa d'ara kota yerusalem, pe miu paraga dènge dhèu mone ca dhèu dhu pasae g'ala èi cue. madhutu ne toke d'ai èmu na.

source_text: and ye shall say unto the master of the house, the teacher saith unto thee, where is the guest-chamber, where i shall eat the passover with my disciples?
target_text: peka dènge lamatua èmu ne, ‘ama mese ji'i manèngi ca kama, ho neo pake tao kalela paska dènge ana-ana madhutu na. abhu, do? '

source_text: and he will show you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
target_text: èèna na lamatua èmu ne pad'elo dènge miu kama èci dhu taleo ètu èmu dedha. nèngu lalau pamèci nare aa'i le kama èèna. ate dhoka miu dua mi lami sadia nganga'a ètu èèna.

source_text: and they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
target_text: ka dua ra lasi. hèia ra paraga ka nuka sèmi ngaa dhu yesus peka le. ka dua ra sadia nganga'a-nganginu kalela paska ètu nèi.

source_text: and when the hour was come, he sat down, and the apostles with him.
target_text: ropa lalau rare aa'i, yesus si mai. yesus madhèdi ètu mei, aa ana-ana pajuu-paleha na madhèdi kahèi ra'a pesta.

source_text: and he said unto them, with desire i have desired to eat this passover with you before i suffer:
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, ja'a d'èi titu kèna madhèdi ku'a kalela paska dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi, uru nèti ja'a abhu j'aj'èra.

source_text: for i say unto you, i shall not eat it, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of god.
target_text: patadhe pabe'a-be'a. te èle ne'e ne, ja'a madhèdi heka ku'a kalela paska dènge miu. ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu ku, peka na, ama ku nèd'u paredha, ja'a heka ku'a hari kèna.

source_text: and he received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, take this, and divide it among yourselves:
target_text: hèia na kèpe nare galaa cue dhu isi èi anggor. ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, èle ka na soro galaa ne asa rèngu. hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, sèmi mere galaa ne, ho èci-èci minu.

source_text: for i say unto you, i shall not drink from henceforth of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of god shall come.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! karèi nèti mèda ne'e ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu ka, peka na, ama ku nèd'u paredha, ja'a heka kinu hari kèna.

source_text: and he took bread, and when he had given thanks, he brake it, and gave to them, saying, this is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
target_text: hèia na kèpe nare roti cue, ka manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia na soro sa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. ka na peka, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u aae ja'a dhu ja'a hia sa miu aa'i-aa'i mi. lod'o-lod'o dhu miu mi'e ne, pasanèd'e taruu miu, lula tatao ja'a.

source_text: and the cup in like manner after supper, saying, this cup is the new covenant in my blood, even that which is poured out for you.
target_text: ropa ra'a rare, ka na ded'e nare galaa dhu isi èi anggor. hèia na lii, peka na, èi anggor ne'e ne, raa ja'a ka ne, dhu bhori mai sèna ka hia sod'a-mole mi miu. nèti raa ne'e ka, ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dhu hiu dènge miu.

source_text: but behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
target_text: mage pamud'e, te abhu dhèu dhu madhèdi sama-sama dènge èdhi ètu mei ne, èèna na, nèngu pahie eele ja'a.

source_text: for the son of man indeed goeth, as it hath been determined: but woe unto that man through whom he is betrayed!
target_text: mema ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe ku madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu pahie eele ja'a, sanèd'e, ee! te bèli-camèd'a, nèngu pasae nare mamadhe-mamopo!

source_text: and they began to question among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii ne, ana-ana pajuu-paleha se pakarèi, peka na, cee ka dhu ad'u-ue madha j'ara bhelu ne mi dedha na?

source_text: and there arose also a contention among them, which of them was accounted to be greatest.
target_text: ka ana madhutu yesus se pasisu, peka na, nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, cee ka dhu dhèu re madha.

source_text: and he said unto them, the kings of the gentiles have lordship over them; and they that have authority over them are called benefactors.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kai si, peka na, ètu rai-rai dhu kabarai ra tadhe boe lamatua, dhèu aae ra hia paredha dhu bia risi mi kabarai rèngu. te ngaa rèngu neo sèna ka kabarai paroa rèngu, peka na, ‘ama dhu taru kira kabarai'.

source_text: but ye shall not be so: but he that is the greater among you, let him become as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku madhutu j'ara sèra. cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, mamuri na hud'i tare'a-re'a sama sèmi dhèu haha ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. dhu neo j'aj'i kètu, hud'i ladhe-leru ku sama sèmi ana pua-paleha.

source_text: for which is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but i am in the midst of you as he that serveth.
target_text: miu pangee sèku, dhèu kapai sèra nuka mia? dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu mei, do, dhu lalau mei? tatu dhèu dhu madhèdi ne, dhèu kapai, si? te ngaa ja'a ne, tao boe ngi'u sèmi sèra. ja'a mai lalau-lalo'o miu.

source_text: but ye are they that have continued with me in my temptations;
target_text: miu se'e ka dhu bera-bera dènge ja'a, lod'o ja'a paraga dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: and i appoint unto you a kingdom, even as my father appointed unto me,
target_text: ama ku ded'e le ja'a, sèna ka kèd'u paredha ètu era paredha na. ka limuri ne, ja'a ded'e miu kahèi,

source_text: that ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom; and ye shall sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of israel.
target_text: ho miu bèli-camèd'a madhèdi mi'a dènge ja'a ca mei ètu sorga. ja'a hia koasa kahèi, sèna ka miu paredha canguru dua suku dhèu isra'el.

source_text: simon, simon, behold, satan asked to have you, that he might sift you as wheat:
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge petrus, peka na, petrus. dhèu aae nidhu neo hia miu pacèri nèti ja'a, nuka sèmi dhèu tatai ho hag'e eele èto nèti laludhu.

source_text: but i made supplication for thee, that thy faith fail not; and do thou, when once thou hast turned again, establish thy brethren.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a sabaj'a hia èu, petrus, ho èu lèka ja'a taruu. ladhe èu lèpa hari mai asa ja'a, na, èu hud'i pa'èra ku d'ara a'ari èu, nuka dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: and he said unto him, lord, with thee i am ready to go both to prison and to death.
target_text: hèia petrus b'ala, aku nèngu na, aad'o, ama! masi ka tasamia èèna ka, ja'a bisa boe tèke eele ama. te ja'a pa'èra maso bui sama-sama dènge ama. masi ka ja'a madhe palere-lere dènge ama, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: and he said, i tell thee, peter, the cock shall not crow this day, until thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka na, petrus! nanene paie. mèda ne'e kahèi, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, èu pasili le tèlu hari, na, èu tadhe boe ja'a.

source_text: and he said unto them, when i sent you forth without purse, and wallet, and shoes, lacked ye anything? and they said, nothing.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ca hari na, ja'a pua miu lami lole lii lolo be'a ja'a asa mia-mia, ja'a peka dènge miu, ho baku mèti doi, tas, dènge salapa. lod'o èèna, miu kura ngaa? ka aa'i-aa'i ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ca hari na, ji'i kura boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa!

source_text: and he said unto them, but now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise a wallet; and he that hath none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.
target_text: hèia yesus peka tabha hari, na, te ngaa limuri ne, leo. ladhe miu dènge doi, na todhe mèti. ladhe dènge tas, na mèti kahèi. ladhe dènge boe samala, pahia kodho miu, sèna ka hèli.

source_text: for i say unto you, that this which is written must be fulfilled in me, and he was reckoned with transgressors: for that which concerneth me hath fulfilment.
target_text: te dhèu yahudi pangee na, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu. hèia nèbhu heka, rèngu mai kèpe ja'a. j'ara ne, nuka sèmi dhu baki yesaya suri tèke le: ‘ra tao ne sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a! '

source_text: and they said, lord, behold, here are two swords. and he said unto them, it is enough.
target_text: ka ra peka na, ama! ji'i ngèti hela dua. hèia yesus peka, d'ai le. ale ia ka sèra!

source_text: and he came out, and went, as his custom was, unto the mount of olives; and the disciples also followed him.
target_text: ra'a rare paska, ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa ledhe saitun, sèmi biasa.

source_text: and when he was at the place, he said unto them, pray that ye enter not into temptation.
target_text: d'ai nèi, yesus peka dènge si, miu hud'i sabaj'a ku, ho baku lèke dadugu-rariu.

source_text: and he was parted from them about a stone's cast; and he kneeled down and prayed,
target_text: hèia na tèke eele si, la'e kaj'èu boe. ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, ho sabaj'a, peka na,

source_text: saying, father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
target_text: ama! ladhe ama d'èi na, pakaj'èu ku j'aj'èra ne nèti ja'a. te ngaa mage madhutu dad'èi ja'a; hud'i laa madhutu dhoka dad'èi ama di.

source_text: and there appeared unto him an angel from heaven, strengthening him.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ama lamatua èci mai nèti sorga pa'èra d'ara na.

source_text: and being in an agony he prayed more earnestly; and his sweat became as it were great drops of blood falling down upon the ground.
target_text: lula d'ara na j'èra titu kèna, toke èi kabhèsu na suti sèmi raa sa.

source_text: and when he rose up from his prayer, he came unto the disciples, and found them sleeping for sorrow,
target_text: ropa sabaj'a nare, na kèd'i la'e paraga dènge ana madhutu na. te ngaa rèngu dhu bhèj'i, lula ngi'u roe aa d'ara susa.

source_text: and said unto them, why sleep ye? rise and pray, that ye enter not into temptation.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ra, tasamia ka miu se bhèj'i? be'a risi miu sabaj'a, ho ladhe paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, miu baku manahu.

source_text: while he yet spake, behold, a multitude, and he that was called judas, one of the twelve, went before them; and he drew near unto jesus to kiss him.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, yudas ca dhèu nèti canguru dua ana madhutu na, mai dènge dhèu ae-ae. na mai padètu-dètu dènge yesus, neo kèpe ho uu ne.

source_text: but jesus said unto him, judas, betrayest thou the son of man with a kiss?
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, yudas! èu neo pahie eele dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a dènge a'uu, do?

source_text: and when they that were about him saw what would follow, they said, lord, shall we smite with the sword?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu leo sèra re'a tatao bhelu nèti yudas ne, ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, ama! ji'i lab'a si, do? te ji'i dhu ngèti hela.

source_text: and a certain one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and struck off his right ear.
target_text: ka ca dhèu nèti rèngu se, bete hela na, ka na pare pama'ète rèu dhilu g'ana nèti dhèu èci. dhèu ne, ènu nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: but jesus answered and said, suffer ye them thus far. and he touched his ear, and healed him.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa si, peka na, sange èèna ka! baku lab'a si. hèia na g'ag'e dhilu dhèu ne, ka pa'èle.

source_text: and jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and elders, that were come against him, are ye come out, as against a robber, with swords and staves?
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu mai kèpe yesus, nuka: kètu agama yahudi sèra, dhèu heka d'ara rae, kètu nèti dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, dènge dhèu leo hari kahèi. yesus karèi si, tasamia? miu se ngee, na, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu, ka mai kèpe ja'a mèti samala dènge aj'u cèki, do?

source_text: when i was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched not forth your hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, ja'a aj'a miu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, te ngaa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu mai kèpe ja'a. de hud'i laa! ne'e d'ai lod'o miu. ne'e ne mai nèti koasa dhèu aae nidhu!

source_text: and they seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest's house. but peter followed afar off.
target_text: hèia ra kèpe rare lamatua yesus, ka nuni rèti ne asa èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. petrus kako mau-mau re kabodho.

source_text: and when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the court, and had sat down together, peter sat in the midst of them.
target_text: ètu madha èmu ne, dhèu tao ai raci. hèia petrus la'e manyiru ai kahèi.

source_text: and a certain maid seeing him as he sat in the light of the fire, and looking stedfastly upon him, said, this man also was with him.
target_text: ka bhèni sab'a ca dhèu ladhe nèdhi petrus dhu manyiru ai. na ladhe patae rèhu petrus, ka peka dènge dhèu leo ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, dhèu ne'e ne dhu madhutu yesus kahèi!

source_text: but he denied, saying, woman, i know him not.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili, ka na peka, aad'o! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne. èu me'a ngaa?

source_text: and after a little while another saw him, and said, thou also art one of them. but peter said, man, i am not.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ca dhèu ladhe sa petrus, èle ka na lii, aku nèngu na, tare'a. èu ne, mema ca dhèu nèti dhèu yesus sèra, si? te ngaa petrus pasili, ka na peka, aad'o! èu peka leli na!

source_text: and after the space of about one hour another confidently affirmed, saying, of a truth this man also was with him; for he is a galilæan.
target_text: pe d'ai ca jam sa, ca dhèu leo hari, peka na, ja'a ke'a dhèu ne'e ne, ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu yesus. te nèngu ne, dhèu galilea kahèi.

source_text: but peter said, man, i know not what thou sayest. and immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili hari kahèi, aku nèngu na, èu monya èèna! ropa petrus padhai lii sèmi èèna, kaca'a laa manu kokotoo.

source_text: and the lord turned, and looked upon peter. and peter remembered the word of the lord, how that he said unto him, before the cock crow this day thou shalt deny me thrice.
target_text: hèia yesus kabib'a sa nèngu. ka petrus sanèd'e lii yesus deo na, dhu peka na, mèda ne'e ne kahèi, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te èu pasili le ja'a tèlu hari kèna.

source_text: and he went out, and wept bitterly.
target_text: ngee nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia petrus kalua nèti madha èmu ne, dènge tangi dhu d'ara laho mae-mae.

source_text: and the men that held jesus mocked him, and beat him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu dhu j'aga yesus, padhai lii pahaha ne, dènge game pa'oke ne.

source_text: and they blindfolded him, and asked him, saying, prophesy: who is he that struck thee?
target_text: ra pahutu rèhu na pake bèla, ka ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, wee! ladhe èu ne dhèu mèti lii padhai lamatua, na, èu peka sèku! cee ka dhu j'ubhu èu?

source_text: and many other things spake they against him, reviling him.
target_text: èle ka, ra padhèd'a aape ne.

source_text: and as soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people was gathered together, both chief priests and scribes; and they led him away into their council, saying,
target_text: mad'ae aae era, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, pakaboko le uri lii langu yesus. ka ra pua dhèu lasi nuni rèti yesus asa era pama'ète lii langu agama.

source_text: if thou art the christ, tell us. but he said unto them, if i tell you, ye will not believe:
target_text: ropa yesus maso, ka ra karèi ne, èu peka ku laa! èu ne, tare'a kristus, do? hèia na b'ala, peka na, masi ka ja'a dhaa na tare'a, miu se lèka boe.

source_text: and if i ask you, ye will not answer.
target_text: aa ladhe ja'a bari miu ca madha j'ara, tatu miu dhaa boe.

source_text: but from henceforth shall the son of man be seated at the right hand of the power of god.
target_text: nèbhu heka ama lamatua pake koasa na dhu kapai èèna, ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. ho èèna na, ja'a madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana na, sèna ka paredha sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: and they all said, art thou then the son of god? and he said unto them, ye say that i am.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka aa'i-aa'i ra karèi, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, èu ngee, na, èu ne ana ama lamatua, do? ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a, sèmi dhu miu peka na.

source_text: and they said, what further need have we of witness? for we ourselves have heard from his own mouth.
target_text: hèia dhèu dhu uri lii langu se, aa'i-aa'i peka, na, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti tadèngi le, si? na ded'e iisi na, j'aj'i ana ama lamatua. ne'e ne lii pahahe kolongara ama lamatua! madhutu atora agama èdhi, ladhe dhèu tao iisi ra nuka sèmi lamatua, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku. de tasamia? èdhi parluu heka sakasii. huku pamadhe ne!

source_text: and the whole company of them rose up, and brought him before pilate.
target_text: masi ka dhèu uri lii langu agama yahudi sèra pama'ète rare le sèna ka huku pamadhe yesus, te ngaa rèngu dènge boe hak ho huku pamadhe dhèu. nèti èèna ka, lere rèti yesus asa madha gubernur nèti paredha roma, dhu ètu èèna nuka pilatus. rèngu d'èi ladhe gubernur ka dhu huku ne.

source_text: and they began to accuse him, saying, we found this man perverting our nation, and forbidding to give tribute to cæsar, and saying that he himself is christ a king.
target_text: de ropa d'ai madha gubernur, ra lole sasala yesus èci-èci, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, tuka lab'a paredha roma. na aj'a peka na, dhèu baku b'ae bea sa dhèu paredha. na ded'e iisi na, peka na, nèngu ne, kristus, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and pilate asked him, saying, art thou the king of the jews? and he answered him and said, thou sayest.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka gubernur karèi ne, peka na, tare'a, do? èu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, do? hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a. sèmi lii padhai ama.

source_text: and pilate said unto the chief priests and the multitudes, i find no fault in this man.
target_text: parisa èle ka, gubernur ladhe sa kètu agama yahudi, dènge dhèu ae sèra. ka na lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a abhu boe sasala dhèu ne ciki sa hèi.
