source_text: but they were the more urgent, saying, he stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all judæa, and beginning from galilee even unto this place.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se pakadhii taruu, aku rèngu na, aad'o, ama gubernur. dhèu ne la'e aj'a sa mia-mia, ho kakèj'i kabarai, sèna ka palab'a dènge dhèu paredha. na tao maruru mulai nèti propensi galilea toke d'ai kota yerusalem ne'e.

source_text: but when pilate heard it, he asked whether the man were a galilæan.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia gubernur karèi si, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, nèngu ne dhèu galilea, do? ka dhèu se dhaa, tare'a. nèngu nèti galilea.

source_text: and when he knew that he was of herod's jurisdiction, he sent him unto herod, who himself also was at jerusalem in these days.
target_text: ropa ne'a nare sèmi èèna, hèia gubernur pua lere rèti yesus asa dhèu aae herodes, dhu paredha propensi galilea. lod'o èèna, nèngu ètu kota yerusalem.

source_text: now when herod saw jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was of a long time desirous to see him, because he had heard concerning him; and he hoped to see some miracle done by him.
target_text: herodes ne, dhu tadèngi ae le, dhèu palolo tatao yesus, aa nèbhu le neo paraga dènge ne kahèi. nèngu dhu sanao-maena bisa nèdhi dènge madha na tadha malaa èci-dua sa nèti yesus. nèti èèna ka, lod'o lere rèti yesus asa nèngu, d'ara na karej'e.

source_text: and he questioned him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
target_text: hèia na karèi yesus rupa-rupa j'ara, te ngaa yesus dhaa boe ca hèb'a sa.

source_text: and the chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.
target_text: ropa herodes padhai lii era dènge yesus, te ngaa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra galaa hari yesus dènge rupa-rupa sasala.

source_text: and herod with his soldiers set him at nought, and mocked him, and arraying him in gorgeous apparel sent him back to pilate.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae herodes dènge sordad'u na padhai lii pahahe ne. ka ra papake yesus kodho saraga dhu madhera robho d'ai rai èci, sèmi dhèu aae tema pake, hèia ra padhai lii pahahe ne taruu. ka rèti hari ne la'e asa gubernur pilatus.

source_text: and herod and pilate became friends with each other that very day: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
target_text: uru nèti èèna, gubernur dènge dhèu aae herodes dhu pamusu. te ngaa nèti lod'o èèna, dua ra pa'angalai.

source_text: and pilate called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
target_text: èle èèna ka, gubernur pilatus paroa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi, sama-sama dènge dhèu ae sèra, mai pakaboko ho nanene lii pama'ète.

source_text: and said unto them, ye brought unto me this man, as one that perverteth the people: and behold, i, having examined him before you, found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
target_text: aku nèngu na, miu mèti le yesus asa ja'a, aa mi galaa ne, peka na, nèngu d'èi kakèj'i kabarai ho lab'a paredha roma. ja'a parisa le toke lutu ètu madha miu, te ngaa ja'a abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: no, nor yet herod: for he sent him back unto us; and behold, nothing worthy of death hath been done by him.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes parisa le kahèi. te ngaa na abhu boe sasala ngaa-ngaa kahèi. nèti èèna ka, na hia hari ne mai sa ja'a. dhèu ne dènge boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. de ja'a bisa boe huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: i will therefore chastise him, and release him.
target_text: ja'a neo pama'ète sèmi ne'e: ja'a pua kalabhe ne pake gui, èle na ja'a patabuli eele ne.

source_text: but they cried out all together, saying, away with this man, and release unto us barabbas: -
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, bisa boe! pamadhe ne! patabuli barabas. ra pa'oo-parodha sèmi èèna, lula tèu mai-tèu mai, dhu tema le, ladhe d'ai lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi, gubernur patabuli ca dhèu nèti d'ara bèdho madhutu dad'èi rèngu.

source_text: one who for a certain insurrection made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.
target_text: barabas ne maso bèdho, lula na kakèj'i dhèu lab'a paredha roma ètu kota yerusalem, aa na pamadhe dhèu kahèi.

source_text: and pilate spake unto them again, desiring to release jesus;
target_text: te ngaa gubernur neo patabuli yesus. ka na karèi hari dhèu ae sèra, tasamia ladhe ja'a patabuli yesus?

source_text: but they shouted, saying, crucify, crucify him.
target_text: te ngaa asa ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, aad'o! paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha! paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: and he said unto them the third time, why, what evil hath this man done? i have found no cause of death in him: i will therefore chastise him and release him.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur ngee na j'ara ne lèke boe, ka na karèi d'ai tèlu hari, peka na, nga tao ka ja'a madhutu miu ho paku pamadhe ne? bhabhelu na ngaa? ja'a parisa le nèngu ne, te ngaa abhu boe j'ara èci sa kahèi, ho huku pamadhe ne. de ja'a neo dhoka kalabhe ne, èle ku, heka patabuli ne.

source_text: but they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. and their voices prevailed.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha hari pamèdhu-mèdhu, sèna ka laka-seti ne ho paku pamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia gubernur taha nare heka,

source_text: and pilate gave sentence that what they asked for should be done.
target_text: ka na pama'ète madhutu dad'èi dhèu sèra.

source_text: and he released him that for insurrection and murder had been cast into prison, whom they asked for; but jesus he delivered up to their will.
target_text: hèia na patabuli barabas, ca dhèu dhu d'èi palab'a, dènge pamadhe dhèu. te ngaa na soro yesus la'e asa adhe-aai dhèu se'e, sèna ka ra tao ne madhutu dad'èi rèngu.

source_text: and when they led him away, they laid hold upon one simon of cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to bear it after jesus.
target_text: èle ka, sordad'u roma sèra nuni rèti yesus asa li'u kota yerusalem. ètu talora j'ara, ra paraga dènge dhèu èci nèti kota kirene, dhu ngara na simon, dhu neo maso asa d'ara kota yerusalem. ka ra laka-seti ne, sèna ka pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha ne gati yesus. ka na kako re limuri madhutu yesus.

source_text: and there followed him a great multitude of the people, and of women who bewailed and lamented him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai laladhe yesus. abhu kahèi ina-ina dhu pasuti èi madha, lula d'ara pèd'a ropa rèdhi ne.

source_text: but jesus turning unto them said, daughters of jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe bhèni se tangi, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ina-ina nèti yerusalem. baku tangi ja'a ne. tangi hiu ngi'u miu mesa mi, dènge ana niki miu.

source_text: for behold, the days are coming, in which they shall say, blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the breasts that never gave suck.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a, sasusa dhu kapai risi mai, hèia dhèu peka na, ‘bhèni dhu kalua hua iia, nuka, bhèni dhu rara iisi rèdhi boe, aa dhu pasusu rèdhi boe ana. '

source_text: then shall they begin to say to the mountains, fall on us; and to the hills, cover us.
target_text: lod'o sasusa aae na mai, dhèu j'èra titu kèna, toke ra manèngi, peka na, ‘be'a risi, ledhe guri mai ho kabhie ka ji'i! ' aa ra peka kahèi, ‘dènge j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne, be'a risi kabhuku dhènu eele ka ji'i. '

source_text: for if they do these things in the green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
target_text: ladhe dhèu bisa paj'èra dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala, tasamia hari mi dhèu bhelu?

source_text: and there were also two others, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
target_text: ropa sordad'u se rèti yesus, ra nuni rèti kahèi dhèu bhelu dhèu dua, ho huku pamadhe palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: and when they came unto the place which is called the skull, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand and the other on the left.
target_text: rèngu d'ai era èci, dhu ngara na ‘rui kètu. ' hèia ra paku yesus dènge dhèu bhelu dhèu dua se, mi aj'u palolo-palèbha ra èci-èci. ka ra sèle patitu aj'u palolo-palèbha sèra. ra hia dhèu bhelu èci ètu karasa g'ana yesus, aa èci hari ètu karasa kariu na.

source_text: and jesus said, father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. and parting his garments among them, they cast lots.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus sabaj'a peka na, ama! bhèlu eele sasala dhèu se, te rèngu re'a boe ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue. èle ka sordad'u se ère lot, sèna ka neo re'a cee ka dhu abhu mèdha-papake na.

source_text: and the people stood beholding. and the rulers also scoffed at him, saying, he saved others; let him save himself, if this is the christ of god, his chosen.
target_text: dhèu ae mai laladhe ètu era èèna. dhèu aae-dhèu kapai yahudi sèra, peka pa-aape yesus, aku rèngu na, nèngu dhu patabuli nare le dhèu leo nèti mamadhe-mamopo, te ngaa bisa boe patabuli ngi'u nèngu mesa na. ladhe nèngu ne, tare'a-re'a kristus, dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare, hud'i laa na puru unu na nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha ne.

source_text: and the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, offering him vinegar,
target_text: sordad'u se padhai lii pa-aape ne kahèi. ra hia ne ninu èi anggor manyilu,

source_text: and saying, if thou art the king of the jews, save thyself.
target_text: aa ra parodha pahaha ne, peka na, ladhe èu ne tare'a-re'a dhèu aae yahudi, na, patabuli eele ka ngi'u mu nèti mamadhe!

source_text: and there was also a superscription over him, this is the king of the jews.
target_text: ra suri ètu papa èci, peka na, ne'e ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi. ka ra paku papa ne re dedha kètu yesus, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, ra huku ne lula j'ara ne'e ka.

source_text: and one of the malefactors that were hanged railed on him, saying, art not thou the christ? save thyself and us.
target_text: ca dhèu bhelu dhu paku ètu karasa yesus padhai lii pa-aape ne kahèi, aku nèngu na, èu ne tare'a kristus, do? ladhe tare'a, na, patabuli eele ka èdhi!

source_text: but the other answered, and rebuking him said, dost thou not even fear god, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
target_text: te ngaa dhèu bhelu èci hari kai ne, aku nèngu na, weh! èu ne me'a boe madha'u dènge ama lamatua, hèi? te èu ne abhu huku madhe èci èèna ka dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
target_text: èdhi dua ti pasae tare huku madhe ne, lèke dènge tatao èdhi. te ngaa dhèu ne, tao boe sasala ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and he said, jesus, remember me when thou comest in thy kingdom.
target_text: ka dhèu ne, peka hari, aku nèngu na, yesus! ladhe ama maso ka asa era paredha ama, na baku bhèlu ja'a.

source_text: and he said unto him, verily i say unto thee, to-day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, ja'a peka tare'a-re'a dènge èu kèna, na, lod'o deo ne'e kahèi, èu lamu asa sorga palere-lere dènge ja'a.

source_text: and it was now about the sixth hour, and a darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour, the sun's light failing: and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhu lod'o nètu le. te ngaa madha lod'o saraa boe, aa maroga kiu-kiu abhe nare era èèna, toke d'ai hake tèlu lod'o nihia. ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu bèla bhèla aae èci dhu ra kadhoe pa'abhe kama luri mola-mèci ama lamatua. kaca'a laa, bèla ne mae bagi mi dua.

source_text: and jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, father, into thy hands i commend my spirit: and having said this, he gave up the ghost.
target_text: ètu era dhu ngara na ‘rui kètu' èèna, yesus pa'oo, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a pangèd'u samanga ja'a mi d'ara adhe-aai ama. ropa padhai lii èle, hèia yesus ma'ète a'ae.

source_text: and when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified god, saying, certainly this was a righteous man.
target_text: abhu komedhaa sordad'u roma titu ètu era èèna, dhu padètu dènge aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus. ropa ladhe nèdhi yesus madhe, ka na koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ira ii! dhèu ne'e ne, tare'a re'a dhèu d'ara mola!

source_text: and all the multitudes that came together to this sight, when they beheld the things that were done, returned smiting their breasts.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae sèra rèdhi mamadhe yesus, ra manyasa, dènge d'ara ra roe bhilu, ka ra lèpa dènge d'ara susa.

source_text: and all his acquaintance, and the women that followed with him from galilee, stood afar off, seeing these things.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu-dhèu yesus titu ètu kaj'èu, rèdhi na madhe. ina-ina dhu madhutu ne nèti galilea toke yerusalem, ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and behold, a man named joseph, who was a councillor, a good and righteous man he had not consented to their counsel and deed, a man of arimathæa, a city of the jews, who was looking for the kingdom of god:
target_text: ropa yesus madhe, dhèu èci tenge j'ara, sèna ka papuru ngi'u aae na nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. dhèu ne, ngara na yusuf nèti kota arimatea. nèngu ne, dhèu d'ara mola, tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. yusuf ne dhu tatae ama lamatua pad'elo, na, nèngu nèd'u paredha na. yusuf kahèi ca dhèu nèti dhèu dhu uri lii langu agama yahudi. te ngaa nèngu d'èi boe dènge lii pama'ète huku madhe mi yesus.

source_text: this man went to pilate, and asked for the body of jesus.
target_text: lula na neo papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha, ka la'e asa gubernur pilatus, manèngi sèna ka nèngu uri ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: and he took it down, and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was hewn in stone, where never man had yet lain.
target_text: ka pilatus d'èi, hèia yusuf la'e papuru ngi'u aae yesus. èle ka na pahutu ngi'u aae dènge bèla alus. ka ded'e rèti asa d'ara ro'a hadhu èci, dhu heka pae rare kèna. ètu ro'a ne, padhane rèdhi mèka ca dhèu sa.

source_text: and it was the day of the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
target_text: mamadhe yesus lèke dènge hari jumat. lod'o yusuf si padhane rare ne, lod'o nihia le. ladhe lod'o cèna, d'ai lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and the women, who had come with him out of galilee, followed after, and beheld the tomb, and how his body was laid.
target_text: ina-ina dhu mai palere dènge yesus nèti galilea, lasi madhutu yusuf nèti limuri, sèna ka neo re'a era padhane yesus ètu ro'a mia.

source_text: and they returned, and prepared spices and ointments. and on the sabbath they rested according to the commandment.
target_text: ropa rèdhi era ne, ka ina se lèpa lasi sadia bunga dènge èi hèu mèngi. d'ai lod'o cèna, rèngu ae nèti sasab'a ra, madhutu atora lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi. rèngu mate èle ku lod'o sabaj'a, heka neo lasi tao bunga mi ngi'u aae yesus kèna.

source_text: but on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they came unto the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.
target_text: lod'o hari migu oe mèu sa, ina se rèti bunga dènge èi hèu mèngi, ho lasi ro'a yesus.

source_text: and they found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai nèi, ladhe rèdhi hadhu aae dhu yusuf pake katange ro'a yesus, dhu bhaloli le sa karasa na.

source_text: and they entered in, and found not the body of the lord jesus.
target_text: hèia lasi dènge ka asa d'ara, te ngaa abhu boe ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: and it came to pass, while they were perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling apparel:
target_text: ka rèngu ele ngangee. cag'ag'a laa dhèu dua dhu pake mèdha kale'e, mai titu ka ètu sebhe rèngu.

source_text: and as they were affrighted and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, why seek ye the living among the dead?
target_text: ina se madha'u bia, ka ra pacud'u d'ai rai. ka dhèu se karèi si, peka na, nga tao ka miu mai tenge dhèu mamuri ètu era dhèu madhe?

source_text: he is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in galilee,
target_text: yesus aad'o heka ètu era ne'e! te na mamuri hari le. ele boe miu bhèlu eele le, ngaa dhu peka nare, lod'o na ètu galilea era, sina ma?

source_text: saying that the son of man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
target_text: te nèngu peka mema le, na, bèli-camèd'a ra pahie eele dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, asa d'ara adhe-aai dhèu bhelu-katub'a. hèia ra paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ngaa asa camèd'a èèna, nèngu mamuri hari.

source_text: and they remembered his words,
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, heka rèngu sanèd'e lii padhai yesus uru èèna.

source_text: and returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven, and to all the rest.
target_text: hèia ra lèpa dènge ka, lasi peka dènge ana madhutu yesus dhèu canguru èci sèra, dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu madhutu ne.

source_text: now they were mary magdalene, and joanna, and mary the mother of james: and the other women with them told these things unto the apostles.
target_text: ina-ina dhu ètu ro'a èèna, nuka maria ina yakobis, dènge maria nèti rae magdala. abhu kahèi yohana dènge ina-ina dhèu pèri dhu leo. rèngu se'e ka dhu lasi peka aa'i-aa'i dènge ana-ana pajuu-paleha yesus sèra.

source_text: and these words appeared in their sight as idle talk; and they disbelieved them.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ana madhutu sèra tadèngi lii lolo ne, ra pangee na ina se monya.

source_text: but peter arose, and ran unto the tomb; and stooping and looking in, he seeth the linen cloths by themselves; and he departed to his home, wondering at that which was come to pass.
target_text: hèia petrus kèd'i dènge ka, rai la'e asa ro'a. d'ai nèi, na patigi sa d'ara ro'a, te ngaa nèdhi dhoka bèla hutu di. hèia na lèpa, ka na pangee, sa mia ka ne?

source_text: and behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named emmaus, which was threescore furlongs from jerusalem.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, ana madhutu yesus dhèu dua lasi asa rae cue, ngara na emaus. kaj'èu na pe d'ai canguru ca kilo nèti kota yerusalem.

source_text: and they communed with each other of all these things which had happened.
target_text: ètu j'ara, ra palolo nèti mamadhe yesus.

source_text: and it came to pass, while they communed and questioned together, that jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, yesus padètu-dètu le dènge rèngu dua ra, ka kako palere-lere dènge ra.

source_text: but their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
target_text: te ngaa dua ra tadhe boe, dhèu ne, yesus, te lamatua ka dhu tao si, sèna ka baku ra tadhe.

source_text: and he said unto them, what communications are these that ye have one with another, as ye walk? and they stood still, looking sad.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, aku nèngu na, miu dua mi se, padhue-padhai ngaa? ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka ra titu. rèhu ra sèmi dhèu susa titu kèna.

source_text: and one of them, named cleopas, answering said unto him, dost thou alone sojourn in jerusalem and not know the things which are come to pass there in these days?
target_text: ka dhu ngara na kleopas, karèi ne, ama ne sèmi dhèu hiu sa, dhu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa dhu lai-lai ne j'aj'i ètu yerusalem, do?

source_text: and he said unto them, what things? and they said unto him, the things concerning jesus the nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before god and all the people:
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, peka na, tasamia? ka ra b'ala, peka na, yesus nèti nasaret èèna! nèngu na tare'a dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. aa lamatua pangèd'u na koasa, ka na tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa. nèngu d'èlu-mèu kahèi aj'a-nori dhèu. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e dènge ne. aa lamatua karej'e dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.
target_text: te ngaa te'a boe, na, kètu agama èdhi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, kèpe rare ne. ka ra hia ne asa gubernur sèna ka huku pamadhe ne. de ra paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha toke madhe.

source_text: but we hoped that it was he who should redeem israel. yea and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things came to pass.
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i sanao nèngu ne'e ka kristus, dhu mai patabuli dhèu-dhèu èdhi nèti paredha roma, dhu paj'èra èdhi. te ngaa ètu d'ara hari jumat lai-lai ne, ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: moreover certain women of our company amazed us, having been early at the tomb;
target_text: limuri ne, ji'i asa ele ngangee. te deo na, ina-ina ji'i mai peka, na, mad'ae aae era rèngu lasi asa ro'a.

source_text: and when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.
target_text: te ngaa ra palolo, peka na, ngi'u aae yesus ele le. hèia ladhe rèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu peka dènge rèngu, na, yesus mamuri hari le!

source_text: and certain of them that were with us went to the tomb, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
target_text: ropa tadèngi ngare, hèia angalai ji'i dhèu pèri-pèri, rai lasi asa ro'a. ka rèdhi sèmi dhu ina-ina sa peka. rèngu rèdhi boe ngi'u aae yesus hèi.

source_text: and he said unto them, o foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
target_text: ropa lolo rare, yesus lii dènge si, peka na, gagoa miu se! nga tao ka miu mo'o boe parcaya ngaa dhu uru èèna dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra peka tèke!

source_text: behooved it not the christ to suffer these things, and to enter into his glory?
target_text: te rèngu suri le, na, kristus ne hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra rupa-rupa, heka na abhu pakab'ua dènge dadedha kèna.

source_text: and beginning from moses and from all the prophets, he interpreted to them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
target_text: ka yesus aj'a si, aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua suri tèke lula-nèti kristus ne. karèi nèti sasuri baki musa toke dhèu rèti lii padhai dhu leo sèra.

source_text: and they drew nigh unto the village, whither they were going: and he made as though he would go further.
target_text: ropa rèngu oe d'ai emaus, ka yesus pasabhe eele neo kako taruu.

source_text: and they constrained him, saying, abide with us; for it is toward evening, and the day is now far spent. and he went in to abide with them.
target_text: te ngaa ra manèngi, peka na, ama! j'unu taha ku dènge ji'i mèda ne'e, te lod'o oe cèna kèna. ka yesus maso palere-lere dènge rèngu asa d'ara èmu.

source_text: and it came to pass, when he had sat down with them to meat, he took the bread and blessed; and breaking it he gave to them.
target_text: ropa rèngu madhèdi neo ra'a, hèia yesus nare roti ca balok. ka na sabaj'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, hèia na pamae roti ne. ropa na j'ole roti ne sa rèngu dua ra,

source_text: and their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
target_text: heka ra tadhe, na, nèngu ne yesus. te ngaa kabèdhi laa, na ele nèti madha rèngu dua ra!

source_text: and they said one to another, was not our heart burning within us, while he spake to us in the way, while he opened to us the scriptures?
target_text: hèia dua ra padhue, peka na, waa! deo na ropa na peka paled'a lii padhai nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, d'ara èdhi taleo moro-moro sange rai-haha.

source_text: and they rose up that very hour, and returned to jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dua ra kèd'i dènge ka, lèpa asa yerusalem. lasi paraga dènge canguru ca dhèu ana madhutu yesus sèra, dènge dhèu leo dhu pakaboko ètu era èèna.

source_text: saying, the lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to simon.
target_text: hèia ana madhutu se peka dènge rèngu dua ra, na, mema tare'a! lamatua yesus mamuri hari le! deo na pad'elo iisi na dènge petrus.

source_text: and they rehearsed the things that happened in the way, and how he was known of them in the breaking of the bread.
target_text: èle ka dhèu dua se lole aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i ètu j'ara, toke rèngu dua ra tadhe yesus ropa na pamae roti.

source_text: and as they spake these things, he himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, peace be unto you.
target_text: lod'o rèngu palolo era, kaca'a laa, yesus titu ètu talora aae rèngu. na hia maho'o mi rèngu, peka na, saloom!

source_text: but they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they beheld a spirit.
target_text: ka ra cag'ag'a aa madha'u, lula ra ngee na nidhu.

source_text: and he said unto them, why are ye troubled? and wherefore do questionings arise in your heart?
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii, peka na, nga tao ka miu madha'u? miu parcaya boe, na, ja'a ne mamuri hari le, do?

source_text: see my hands and my feet, that it is i myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye behold me having.
target_text: miu ladhe sèku ai dènge haga ja'a ne. ja'a ka ne'e ne. j'ole ai miu ho g'ag'e unu mi! sèna ka mi lèka, na, ja'a ka ne'e ne, nidhu boe. te nidhu dènge boe ngi'u, te ngaa miu mèdhi ngi'u ja'a ne, si? !

source_text: and when he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
target_text: ropa na padhai lii era, na pad'elo dènge si era nu'a dhu ètu adhe-aai dènge haga na.

source_text: and while they still disbelieved for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, have ye here anything to eat?
target_text: rèngu karej'e titu kèna, lula yesus mamuri hari le. dhoka ra bingu, te re'a boe tasamia ka bisa j'aj'i sèmi èèna. hèia yesus karèi si, miu mi'a ngaa?

source_text: and they gave him a piece of a broiled fish.
target_text: ka ra j'ole hia ne i'a paga ca kadhèli.

source_text: and he took it, and ate before them.
target_text: yesus sèmi nare i'a ne, hèia na'e dènge ka ètu madha rèngu.

source_text: and he said unto them, these are my words which i spake unto you, while i was yet with you, that all things must needs be fulfilled, which are written in the law of moses, and the prophets, and the psalms, concerning me.
target_text: èle ka, na lii dènge rèngu, peka na, tasamia? miu sanèd'e era lod'o ja'a uru èèna dhu bera-bera dènge miu? ja'a peka dènge miu ca hari ni, hud'i j'aj'i ku aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra suri tèke lula-nèti ja'a ne. nuka nèti baki musa, aa nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo sèra, aa nèti sasuri lii sod'a koa-kio.

source_text: then opened he their mind, that they might understand the scriptures;
target_text: èle ka, na bhoke paled'a, sèna ka re'a mèu sasoa nèti isi sasuri lamatua.

source_text: and he said unto them, thus it is written, that the christ should suffer, and rise again from the dead the third day;
target_text: na peka tabha hari, na, dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua se dhu suri le, na, kristus dhu lamatua hia mai èèna, hud'i abhu ku rupa-rupa j'aj'èra, heka na madhe kèna. te ngaa ladhe d'ai camèd'a, na mamuri hari. te dhu suri aa'i le j'ara se'e!

source_text: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name unto all the nations, beginning from jerusalem.
target_text: nèti deo ne'e, ja'a hia miu koasa, ho lami mèti lii lolo be'a mi suku aa'i-aa'i, mulai nèti yerusalem ne. peka dènge rèngu, na, dhèu dhu mangaku sasala ra, aa lèpa hari asa lamatua, pe lamatua saku pamèu sasala ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: ye are witnesses of these things.
target_text: miu hud'i j'aj'i ku sakasii, sèna ka miu lolo, peka na, ja'a dui j'aj'èra, ka madhe, hèia mamuri hari.

source_text: and behold, i send forth the promise of my father upon you: but tarry ye in the city, until ye be clothed with power from on high.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia roh dhu mola-mèci, dhu ama ku pajaji nare le. te ngaa miu hud'i tatae ku nèngu ètu kota yerusalem ne, toke abhu koasa nèti sorga.

source_text: and he led them out until they were over against bethany: and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus nèti si asa li'u kota. ropa rèngu dètu dènge rae betania, na baa ai sèna ka hia ra berkat.

source_text: and it came to pass, while he blessed them, he parted from them, and was carried up into heaven.
target_text: yesus padhai lii hia berkat era, hèia ded'e ne ca'e la'e asa sorga.

source_text: and they worshipped him, and returned to jerusalem with great joy:
target_text: ladhe rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra patitu kètu urutuu ho pahaha iisi mi yesus. ka ra lèpa asa yerusalem dènge d'ara dhu karej'e-karae.

source_text: and were continually in the temple, blessing god.
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu pakaboko ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ho koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. ama teofilus! lii lolo ja'a ne, d'ai sange ne'e ka. salam, lukas

source_text: in the beginning was the word, and the word was with god, and the word was god.
target_text: dhu uru tèka, abhu mema le lii holo-nori ama lamatua. lii holo-nori ama lamatua ne'e, nuka dhèu èci. dhèu ne'e bera-bera dènge ama lamatua. aa nèngu ne, ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: the same was in the beginning with god.
target_text: lod'o liru dènge rai-haha dhae j'aj'i mèka, dhèu ne'e abhu mema le sama-sama dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: all things were made through him; and without him was not anything made that hath been made.
target_text: lamatua paj'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu, pake lii holo-nori nèngu ne'e ka. abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu j'aj'i, ladhe dhèu ne'e tao boe.

source_text: in him was life; and the life was the light of men.
target_text: nèngu ne, kapua mamuri. de dhèu dhu abhu mamuri dhu lèke, rèngu mamuri nèti nèngu ka. nèngu èci èèna ka dènge saraa dhu pasaraa, sèna ka dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa ne'e, bisa rèdhi dènge mèu.

source_text: and the light shineth in the darkness; and the darkness apprehended it not.
target_text: saraa ne, heo madhore maroga; aa maroga bisa boe pa'abhe saraa ne. te saraa ne heo taruu.

source_text: there came a man, sent from god, whose name was john.
target_text: abhu dhèu leo èci, ngara na yohanis. ama lamatua pua-paleha ne kahèi,

source_text: the same came for witness, that he might bear witness of the light, that all might believe through him.
target_text: sèna ka j'aj'i sakasii ho lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti saraa ne. ho sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parcaya lamatua, lula lii padhai yohanis ne.

source_text: he was not the light, but came that he might bear witness of the light.
target_text: yohanis ne, bukan saraa èèna. te ngaa lamatua pua ne ho la'e peka-padhai dènge dhèu lula-nèti saraa ne.

source_text: there was the true light, even the light which lighteth every man, coming into the world.
target_text: te dhèu dhu j'aj'i saraa tare'a-re'a èèna, neo mai asa rai-haha ne. saraa ne'e ka dhu d'elo pamèu-mèu j'ara-j'ara hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: he was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world knew him not.
target_text: masi ka nèngu tao nare aa'i mèu-mèu ngaa-ngaa ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa dhèu ètu rai-haha tadhe boe ne, lod'o na pea ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: he came unto his own, and they that were his own received him not.
target_text: masi ka nèngu mai pea dènge dhèu unu na, te ngaa dhèu se'e ro'o boe sèmi rare ne.

source_text: but as many as received him, to them gave he the right to become children of god, even to them that believe on his name:
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ladhe dhèu sèmi rare aa parcaya ne, nèngu hia si hak sèna ka j'aj'i ana-ana ama lamatua.

source_text: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of god.
target_text: èèna nuka sèmi rara iisi hari rèngu. te ngaa rara iisi hiu ne, sama boe dènge bhèni rara iisi ana. aa nèti boe dad'èi dhèu mone dhu neo abhu kolo. te rèngu j'aj'i ana-ana ama lamatua, lula lamatua pangèd'u si mamuri hiu.

source_text: and the word became flesh, and dwelt among us and we beheld his glory, glory as of the only begotten from the father, full of grace and truth.
target_text: hèia, ‘lii holo-nori lamatua' ne, rara iisi ne j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha. nèngu mamuri ètu talora aae èdhi. èdhi ladhe tèdhi dadedha na. dadedha na sèmi èèna, lula nèngu ne ana mesa ama lamatua. nèngu d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, lula d'ara na sèmi èèna ka. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu na peka-padhai lula-nèti ama lamatua, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: john beareth witness of him, and crieth, saying, this was he of whom i said, he that cometh after me is become before me: for he was before me.
target_text: yohanis ne, lole lula-nèti dhèu ne'e ka. na rodhe, peka na, nanene, ee! nèngu ne'e ka dhu ja'a lole èèna, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a dhèu èci mai. nèngu ne, kapai risi eele nèti ja'a. lod'o dhu dhae rara iisi mèka ja'a ne, nèngu dhu mema-mema le! '

source_text: for of his fulness we all received, and grace for grace.
target_text: yohanis padhai lii sèmi èèna, lula dhèu ne d'èi titu kèna pad'elo d'ara hua iia na. aa na tao taruu-taruu sèmi èèna hia mi èdhi.

source_text: for the law was given through moses; grace and truth came through jesus christ.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, musa ka dhu papuru atora ama lamatua mi bèi-baki èdhi. te ngaa lod'o limuri ne, dhèu ne, nuka yesus kristus ka dhu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ama lamatua mi èdhi. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu na lole lula-nèti ama lamatua, lèke mola-mola.

source_text: no man hath seen god at any time; the only begotten son, who is in the bosom of the father, he hath declared him.
target_text: abhu mèka ca dhèu sa hèi dhu rèdhi ama lamatua. te ngaa ana pasue mone mesa na èèna ka dhu pad'elo mi èdhi, d'ara ama lamatua. ana ne, ètu baboa ama na. te nèngu ne, nuka ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: and this is the witness of john, when the jews sent unto him from jerusalem priests and levites to ask him, who art thou?
target_text: ca tèka, ama-ama dhèu yahudi ètu kota yerusalem pua pèri-pèri ama agama, dènge pèri-pèri dhèu nèti suku lewi dhu tema lalau-lalo'o ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. hèia rèngu lasi asa cabèka loko yarden sèna ka karèi yohanis tuka sarani, na, èu ne'e ka, kristus dhu ama lamatua padhadha tèke neo hia mai èèna, do? hèia na peka dènge dhèu se, nèngu ne, cee.

source_text: and he confessed, and denied not; and he confessed, i am not the christ.
target_text: yohanis peka mola-mola, aku nèngu na, aad'o. ja'a ne, kristus boe.

source_text: and they asked him, what then? art thou elijah? and he saith, i am not. art thou the prophet? and he answered, no.
target_text: ka ra karèi hari, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, èu ne, cee? elia, do? na dhaa, peka na, aad'o kahèi. hèia ra tatu'i hari, aku rèngu na, tao-tao èu ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu na padhadha tèka èèna, do? na dhaa, peka na, aad'o kahèi.

source_text: they said therefore unto him, who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. what sayest thou of thyself?
target_text: ka dhèu se karèi hari, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, èu ne, cee? peka ku laa! te ji'i lèpa, aa hud'i peka ku dènge ama-ama dhu pua ji'i mai!

source_text: he said, i am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, make straight the way of the lord, as said isaiah the prophet.
target_text: hèia na peka madhutu ngaa dhu yesaya suri tèke, na, ja'a ne, nuka dhèu dhu pa'oo-parodha ètu d'ara mamoo, dhu peka na, ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i pa'èra mema, sèna ka pabe'a j'ara, ho sèmi mere mamai lamatua! pamera j'ara ho soru ne. '

source_text: and they had been sent from the pharisees.
target_text: ètu talora aae dhèu dhu mai nèti yerusalem se'e, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi.

source_text: and they asked him, and said unto him, why then baptizest thou, if thou art not the christ, neither elijah, neither the prophet?
target_text: dhèu se karèi yohanis, na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe èu ne kristus boe, elia boe, aa dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua èèna boe, nga tao ka èu sarani dhèu? èu abhu hak nèti mia?

source_text: john answered them, saying, i baptize in water: in the midst of you standeth one whom ye know not,
target_text: ka yohanis b'ala, peka na, ja'a ne, sarani dhèu dhoka pake èi di. te ngaa abhu le ca dhèu ètu talora aae miu dhu miu tadhe boe.

source_text: even he that cometh after me, the latchet of whose shoe i am not worthy to unloose.
target_text: nèngu èèna kapai risi nèti ja'a, masi ka ja'a aj'a-nori uuru dhèu. j'aj'i ènu na, ja'a nia boe sa hèi.

source_text: these things were done in bethany beyond the jordan, where john was baptizing.
target_text: j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i ètu betania, ètu cabèka loko yarden. yohanis dènge ana-ana madhutu na aa'i-aa'i, sarani dhèu ètu era èèna.

source_text: on the morrow he seeth jesus coming unto him, and saith, behold, the lamb of god, that taketh away the sin of the world!
target_text: asa bèli èèna, yohanis ladhe nèdhi yesus kako mai asa nèngu. hèia na padhai lii, peka na, ladhe ku dhèu nèi! nèngu èèna ka, ana kahib'i-kalèbho ama lamatua dhu j'aj'i korban, sèna ka saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: this is he of whom i said, after me cometh a man who is become before me: for he was before me.
target_text: dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu ja'a peka le dènge miu med'a, na, ‘bèli-camèd'a abhu ca dhèu dhu cèu mai. nèngu kapai risi nèti ja'a, lula nèngu karèi uru j'ara nèti ja'a. '

source_text: and i knew him not; but that he should be made manifest to israel, for this cause came i baptizing in water.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a ke'a mèka, na, nèngu ne, kristus. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a ke'a le, na, ja'a hud'i patadhe ne dènge dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, ja'a mai ho sarani dhèu pake èi.

source_text: and john bare witness, saying, i have beheld the spirit descending as a dove out of heaven; and it abode upon him. and i knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize in water, he said unto me, upon whomsoever thou shalt see the spirit descending, and abiding upon him, the same is he that baptizeth in the holy spirit.
target_text: ama lamatua pua ja'a sèna ka sarani dhèu pake èi. na peka dènge ja'a kahèi, na, ‘èèna na dhèu èci mai asa èu. èle èèna, roh ja'a puru mai asa nèngu. dhèu èèna ka dhu bèli-camèd'a nèti roh ja'a dhu mola-mèci, sèna ka pangèd'u koasa mi dhèu ja'a. ' lod'o dhèu ne mai, ja'a tadhe mèka ne. te ngaa ropa ladhe kèdhi roh lamatua puru mai nèti sorga nuka sèmi koro j'aha, hèia pea ètu nèngu, ka ja'a heka tadhe nèngu, na, ‘nèngu èèna, kèna! '

source_text: and i have seen, and have borne witness that this is the son of god.
target_text: ja'a kèdhi j'ara se dènge musi madha ja'a unu ku. ka ja'a lole dènge miu, na, ‘dhèu dhu mai èèna, ana ama lamatua! '

source_text: again on the morrow john was standing, and two of his disciples;
target_text: asa bèli èèna, yohanis dhu titu dènge ana madhutu na, dhèu dua.

source_text: and he looked upon jesus as he walked, and saith, behold, the lamb of god!
target_text: ropa yohanis ladhe nèdhi yesus kako re era èèna, ka na peka, ladhe ku laa! te nèngu ne ka ana kahib'i-kalèbho ama lamatua dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i korban!

source_text: and the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed jesus.
target_text: hèia ana madhutu yohanis dhèu dua dhu tadèngi lii padhai na, tèke eele ne, ho lasi madhutu yesus.

source_text: and jesus turned, and beheld them following, and saith unto them, what seek ye? and they said unto him, rabbi which is to say, being interpreted, teacher, where abidest thou?
target_text: ka yesus kabib'a asa kabodho, hèia ladhe nèdhi si, na, rèngu madhutu ne. hèia na karèi si, aku nèngu na, tasamia? parluu, do? te ngaa dua ra karèi ne, rabi pea ètu mia? ètu d'ara lii aram rèngu, ‘rabi' sasoa na, ‘ama mese'.

source_text: he saith unto them, come, and ye shall see. they came therefore and saw where he abode; and they abode with him that day: it was about the tenth hour.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, mai sèna ka mèdhi unu mi. hèia lasi madhutu ne, ka rèdhi era pea na. rèngu d'ai nèi, pe d'ara hake èpa nihia sa. ka ra pea dènge ne toke d'ai lod'o cèna.

source_text: one of the two that heard john speak, and followed him, was andrew, simon peter's brother.
target_text: nèti rèngu dua ra dhu tadèngi lii padhai yohanis, ka lasi dènge madhutu yesus, èci ngara na anderias. nèngu ne, ari simon petrus.

source_text: he findeth first his own brother simon, and saith unto him, we have found the messiah which is, being interpreted, christ.
target_text: ropa d'ai èmu, ka anderias la'e dènge tenge a'a na simon, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, a'a, ee! ji'i paraga le dènge mesias! madhutu lii rèngu, ‘mesias' sasoa na, ‘kristus, nuka dhèu dhu lamatua padhadha tèke karèi nèti uru ka, ho neo hia mai. '

source_text: he brought him unto jesus. jesus looked upon him, and said, thou art simon the son of john: thou shalt be called cephas which is by interpretation, peter.
target_text: ka anderias lere nèti a'a na asa yesus. hèia yesus ladhe nèdhi ne, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, èu ne, simon. ama mu, ka yohanis. mulai nèti doe ne'e dhèu paroa èu, ‘kefas' ‘kefas', èci èèna ka dènge ‘petrus', sasoa na ‘hadhu'.

source_text: on the morrow he was minded to go forth into galilee, and he findeth philip: and jesus saith unto him, follow me. now philip was from bethsaida, of the city of andrew and peter.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu leo èci, ngara na pelipus. rae èta-èsu na betsaida. petrus dènge anderias nèti rae èèna kahèi. asa bèli èèna, yesus neo la'e asa propensi galilea. hèia na la'e paraga dènge pelipus, ka na gale ne, aku nèngu na, mai madhutu ja'a sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu ja'a!

source_text: philip findeth nathanael, and saith unto him, we have found him, of whom moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote, jesus of nazareth, the son of joseph.
target_text: ka pelipus la'e tenge natanel, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, angalai, ee! ji'i paraga le dènge dhèu dhu musa suri tèke ètu d'ara atora lamatua. dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua uru-uru sèra suri kahèi lula-nèti dhèu ne'e ne. dhèu ne, ngara na yesus, nèti rae nasaret. ama na, ngara na yusuf.

source_text: and nathanael said unto him, can any good thing come out of nazareth? philip saith unto him, come and see.
target_text: te ngaa natanel dhaa, na, dhèu nasaret! ? abhu boe j'ara hua iia èci sa dhu cèu nèti nèi, nga! ka pelipus lii, peka na, wee! baku sèmi èèna. lati ho mèdhi unu mu!

source_text: jesus saw nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, behold, an israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
target_text: ropa natanel kako mai, yesus ladhe nèdhi le, ka na peka, nèngu ne dhèu d'ara mola! te d'ara na dhu ne'a boe pakapod'e. nèngu ne, dhèu isra'el tare'a-re'a!

source_text: nathanael saith unto him, whence knowest thou me? jesus answered and said unto him, before philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, i saw thee.
target_text: ka natanel karèi, tasamia ka ama tadhe ja'a? hèia yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a kèdhi le èu, ropa èu dhu ae ètu mamaho aj'u èèna. lod'o èèna, pelipus dhae dhiu mèka paroa èu.

source_text: nathanael answered him, rabbi, thou art the son of god; thou art king of israel.
target_text: hèia natanel dhaa, peka na, ama mese ne, tatu ana ama lamatua! aa tatu ama dhèu aae ji'i dhèu isra'el kahèi!

source_text: jesus answered and said unto him, because i said unto thee, i saw thee underneath the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
target_text: yesus karèi ne, peka na, tao-tao èu ne lèka ja'a, lula deo na ja'a peka na, ‘ja'a ladhe kèdhi èu, ropa èu dhu ae ètu mamaho aj'u èèna, ' si? sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a pe èu mèdhi j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi eele hari!

source_text: and he saith unto him, verily, verily, i say unto you, ye shall see the heaven opened, and the angels of god ascending and descending upon the son of man.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka mema. bèli-camèd'a miu ladhe mèdhi liru bhoke tèke. hèia ana-ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga ca'e-puru re baboa ja'a. te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a.

source_text: and the third day there was a marriage in cana of galilee; and the mother of jesus was there:
target_text: asa camèd'a èèna, dhèu tao pesta kab'i ètu rae kana, propensi galilea. aa ina yesus ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and jesus also was bidden, and his disciples, to the marriage.
target_text: ra nèru yesus dènge ana madhutu na kahèi, ka rèngu lasi.

source_text: and when the wine failed, the mother of jesus saith unto him, they have no wine.
target_text: ètu d'ara pesta kab'i ne, nèbhu boe ka èi anggor èle. hèia ina yesus la'e peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, soru-bara si ku laa! te èi anggor rèngu èle le.

source_text: and jesus saith unto her, woman, what have i to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ina. nga tao ka ina ku neo sèna ka ja'a ka ator? te lod'o ja'a dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: his mother saith unto the servants, whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
target_text: te ngaa ina na peka dènge dhèu sab'a ètu sèra, na, nanene! ladhe na pua miu tao ngaa, na, mi tao madhutu laa.

source_text: now there were six waterpots of stone set there after the jews' manner of purifying, containing two or three firkins apiece.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu g'ala èna bua dhu dhèu tao nèti hadhu. g'ala cue, isi na pe d'ai pidhu nguru lèmi toke cangasu canguru lèmi liter èi. dhèu yahudi tema dhui èi nèti g'ala se ho pamèu ngi'u ra madhutu atora agama ra.

source_text: jesus saith unto them, fill the waterpots with water. and they filled them up to the brim.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge dhèu sab'a se, peka na, lami mere èi, ho isi papènu g'ala se. ka ra isi toke pènu oe bua eele.

source_text: and he saith unto them, draw out now, and bear unto the ruler of the feast. and they bare it.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ra, dhui mere ciki, ho mèti asa lamatua tatao. hèia dhèu sab'a se madhutu kahèi.

source_text: and when the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and knew not whence it was but the servants that had drawn the water knew, the ruler of the feast calleth the bridegroom,
target_text: ropa lamatua pesta sèmi nare, ka na ngao. te ngaa re'a rare boe, èi ne dhu j'aj'i le anggor! dhèu ne malaa, te ne'a boe, na, dhèu se abhu anggor ne nèti mia. te ngaa dhèu sab'a se re'a. ka na paroa nare pengantin dhèu mone.

source_text: and saith unto him, every man setteth on first the good wine; and when men have drunk freely, then that which is worse: thou hast kept the good wine until now.
target_text: hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. dhu tema le, lamatua èmu hia uuru ku anggor dhu be'a risi. ladhe dhèu rinu ae ku, heka hia anggor dhu ako karehe kèna. te ngaa èu tao leo. èu hia uuru anggor dhu ako karehe, heka limuri dhu be'a risi!

source_text: this beginning of his signs did jesus in cana of galilee, and manifested his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
target_text: j'ara ne j'aj'i ètu rae kana, propensi galilea. ne'e ne heka hiu-hiu kèna yesus tao tadha malaa dhu dhèu bisa rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. na pad'elo dadedha na sèmi èèna, ka ana madhutu na parcaya ne.

source_text: after this he went down to capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples; and there they abode not many days.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus, ina na, ari dènge ana madhutu na sèra, puru lasi asa kota kapernaum. te ngaa rèngu pea dhoka pèri lod'o di ètu èèna.

source_text: and the passover of the jews was at hand, and jesus went up to jerusalem.
target_text: ropa oe dètu dènge lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi, yesus ca'e la'e asa kota yerusalem.

source_text: and he found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
target_text: ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu pahia sapi, kahib'i-kalèbho, dènge koro j'aha dhu dhèu hèli ho j'aj'i korban. ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu mei ho pasilu doi dhu ra pake hia mi ama lamatua ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i èèna.

source_text: and he made a scourge of cords, and cast all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers' money, and overthrew their tables;
target_text: hèia yesus nare dhari pèri-pèri loa ho na èpi j'aj'i sèmi gui sa. ka na babège-lalèta dhèu se'e aa'i-aa'i ra nèti madha èmu èèna. nèngu bhabhoo eele sapi, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho sèra kahèi. na lege eele mei, aa na ceb'e eele doi sèra kahèi.

source_text: and to them that sold the doves he said, take these things hence; make not my father's house a house of merchandise.
target_text: hèia na pua dhèu pahia koro j'aha sèra, aku nèngu na, mèti sa li'u manu-bhui dènge karogo ra sèra nèti ne'e! ne'e, era pahia-pahèli boe! baku tao èmu ama ku, j'aj'i mi era d'aga!

source_text: his disciples remembered that it was written, zeal for thy house shall eat me up.
target_text: ka ana madhutu na ngee rèdhi sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri, peka na, ja'a sue èmu ama ku titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, d'ara ja'a èra ho j'aga ngara be'a èmu èèna.

source_text: the jews therefore answered and said unto him, what sign showest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
target_text: hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi peka dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ladhe èu dènge hak ho babège-lalèta dhèu sèmi ne'e, na, mu pad'elo tadha malaa èci hia ji'i, sèna ka j'aj'i mi bukti!

source_text: jesus answered and said unto them, destroy this temple, and in three days i will raise it up.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, ladhe miu paguri era mola-mèci ne, pe camèd'a èèna, ja'a patitu kore hari le èèna.

source_text: the jews therefore said, forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou raise it up in three days?
target_text: te ngaa ra pab'ala, peka na, abhu ètu mia? te dhèu patitu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne èpa nguru èna tèu. tasamia ka, èu peka na, èu parluu dhoka tèlu lod'o di, sèna ka patitu more hari? !

source_text: but he spake of the temple of his body.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se'e re'a rare boe, yesus peka lula-nèti ngi'u nèngu unu na, dhu nuka sèmi era mola-mèci.

source_text: when therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he spake this; and they believed the scripture, and the word which jesus had said.
target_text: de d'ai lèpa lod'o limuri, ropa yesus madhe, hèia mamuri hari, heka ana-ana madhutu na sanèd'e kèna, ngaa dhu na peka tèke dènge rèngu. ka ra parcaya ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua karèi nèti uru-uru ka, dènge ngaa dhu yesus peka mema dènge rèngu.

source_text: now when he was in jerusalem at the passover, during the feast, many believed on his name, beholding his signs which he did.
target_text: ka yesus pea taha ètu kota yerusalem, ho madhutu kalela paska ètu èèna. hèia dhèu ae rèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu na tao, ka ra parcaya ne.

source_text: but jesus did not trust himself unto them, for that he knew all men, and because he needed not that any one should bear witness concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lèka boe rèngu, lula ne'a mèu d'ara dhèu aa'i-aa'i. nèngu parluu boe dhèu ho peka dènge ne, lula na ne'a mema le mamuri dènge tatao dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: now there was a man of the pharisees, named nicodemus, a ruler of the jews:
target_text: abhu ca dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, ngara na nikodemus. nèngu ne, mese aae nèti dhèu yahudi.

source_text: the same came unto him by night, and said to him, rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from god; for no one can do these signs that thou doest, except god be with him.
target_text: ca tèka, na mai paraga dènge yesus re mèda. hèia na padhai lii dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a, na, lamatua ka dhu pua ama ho aj'a-nori ji'i. te tadha-tadha malaa dhu ama tao sèra, pad'elo, na, lamatua ka dhu pangèd'u koasa mi ama. ladhe sèmi boe èèna, tatu tadha malaa se'e bisa boe j'aj'i.

source_text: jesus answered and said unto him, verily, verily, i say unto thee, except one be born anew, he cannot see the kingdom of god.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a! aa ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e ku: ladhe dhèu rara iisi hari boe ne, nèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: nicodemus saith unto him, how can a man be born when he is old? can he enter a second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
target_text: hèia nikodemus karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia dhèu dhu kapai le bisa rara iisi hari ne! ? nèngu tatu bisa boe maso hari asa d'ara kabake ina na, sèna ka ina na nara iisi hari ne. bisa boe, sina ma! ?

source_text: jesus answered, verily, verily, i say unto thee, except one be born of water and the spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of god.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a! te ngaa ja'a peka dènge èu sèmi ne'e: dhèu hud'i rara iisi ku re èi sèna ka j'aj'i mèu, aa re roh ho j'aj'i dhèu hiu. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu heka bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua kèna.

source_text: that which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the spirit is spirit.
target_text: te dhèu rai-haha ne rara iisi nèti dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa roh dhèu rara iisi hiu nèti roh ama lamatua.

source_text: marvel not that i said unto thee, ye must be born anew.
target_text: baku malaa ladhe ja'a peka, na, ‘miu hud'i rara iisi hiu ku, ho abhu mamuri hiu. '

source_text: the wind bloweth where it will, and thou hearest the voice thereof, but knowest not whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the spirit.
target_text: èdhi pasoro ku dènge lai ngèlu. te lai ngèlu g'oro madhutu dad'èi na. èdhi bisa tadèngi lii na, te ngaa te'a boe mai nèti mia, aa la'e asa mia. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu rara iisi hiu nèti roh lamatua sama sèmi èèna kahèi. te èdhi bisa ladhe tèdhi roh lamatua tao dhèu j'aj'i hiu, masi ka te'a boe tasa mera mia j'ara èèna bisa j'aj'i.

source_text: nicodemus answered and said unto him, how can these things be?
target_text: ka nikodemus karèi, na, tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna?

source_text: jesus answered and said unto him, art thou the teacher of israel, and understandest not these things?
target_text: yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, èu ne mese aae dhèu isra'el. tasamia ka èu me'a boe j'ara se'e?

source_text: verily, verily, i say unto thee, we speak that which we know, and bear witness of that which we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
target_text: ja'a peka j'ara dhu lèke mola-mola. ja'a dènge dhèu-dhèu ja'a, nge'a j'ara se'e. te ji'i j'aj'i sakasii lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu ngèdhi unu mi. te ngaa miu sèmi boe lii padhai ji'i.

source_text: if i told you earthly things and ye believe not, how shall ye believe if i tell you heavenly things?
target_text: miu mo'o boe lèka, ropa ja'a lole lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu j'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne. ngaa hari ladhe ja'a lole j'ara-j'ara dhu j'aj'i ètu dedha-liru nèi. tatu miu asa lèka boe!

source_text: and no one hath ascended into heaven, but he that descended out of heaven, even the son of man, who is in heaven.
target_text: abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu ca'e la'e paraga dènge ama lamatua ètu dedha-liru nèi. dhodhoka ja'a di, nuka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, dhu puru mai nèti nèngu.

source_text: and as moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the son of man be lifted up;
target_text: uru-uru sèra ètu d'ara mamoo, musa kadhoe mege tabaga ci'u ètu kolo aj'u, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu laladhe ne, rèngu abhu mamuri. j'ara sèmi èèna hud'i j'aj'i ku mi dedha ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. bèli-camèd'a ra kadhoe ja'a ètu aj'u,

source_text: that whosoever believeth may in him have eternal life.
target_text: sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: for god so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten son, that whosoever believeth on him should not perish, but have eternal life.
target_text: te ama lamatua sue seli dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. nèti èèna ka, na pua ja'a, ana mesa na mai, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a, cèri eele boe nèti lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: for god sent not the son into the world to judge the world; but that the world should be saved through him.
target_text: lamatua pua boe ja'a, ana na, mai asa rai-haha ne ho pama'ète hahuku dhèu. te ngaa na hia ja'a mai, sèna ka patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: he that believeth on him is not judged: he that believeth not hath been judged already, because he hath not believed on the name of the only begotten son of god.
target_text: ama lamatua huku boe dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a. te ngaa nèngu dhu pama'ète nare le hahuku mi dedha dhèu dhu parcaya boe, lula rèngu parcaya boe ja'a, nuka ana mesa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and this is the judgment, that the light is come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.
target_text: nuka sèmi ne'e: lamatua hia le saraa ho pasaraa rai-haha ne. te ngaa dhèu d'èi risi mamuri ètu d'ara maroga. rèngu ro'o boe mamuri ètu d'ara saraa lula tatao rèngu dhu lèke boe. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua neo huku si.

source_text: for every one that doeth evil hateth the light, and cometh not to the light, lest his works should be reproved.
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tatao ra lèke boe, d'èi boe saraa èèna. rèngu d'èi boe saraa ne d'elo rèngu, sèna ka saraa ne baku pasabhoka bhabhelu-katub'a ra.

source_text: but he that doeth the truth cometh to the light, that his works may be made manifest, that they have been wrought in god.
target_text: te ngaa dhu tao lèke, rèngu ara mai sèna ka saraa ne d'elo si. te saraa ne'e ka dhu pad'elo, na, rèngu dhu tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: after these things came jesus and his disciples into the land of judæa; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
target_text: ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra kalua nèti kota yerusalem, te ngaa rèngu pea taha ètu rai yudea. ètu era ne'e rèngu sarani dhèu.

source_text: and john also was baptizing in ænon near to salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized. for john was not yet cast into prison.
target_text: lod'o èèna, herodes si dhae pamaso mèka yohanis tuka sarani asa d'ara bèdho. aa yohanis sarani dhèu ètu rae ainon, padètu dènge rae salim, lula abhu èi ae ètu era èèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae mai asa yohanis ho na sarani si.

source_text: there arose therefore a questioning on the part of john's disciples with a jew about purifying.
target_text: madhutu ad'a agama yahudi, ladhe neo sabaj'a, hud'i pamèu uuru ku iisi. ètu era ne'e abhu dhèu yahudi ca dhèu dhu patao-palaha dènge ana-ana madhutu yohanis, lula j'ara èèna.

source_text: and they came unto john, and said to him, rabbi, he that was with thee beyond the jordan, to whom thou hast borne witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
target_text: ka dhèu se mai asa yohanis, hèia ra peka na, ama mese! sanèd'e era, do aad'o? dhèu dhu uru èèna tenge ama ètu sebhe loko yarden, dhu ama peka na, nèngu èèna, kristus. nèngu sarani dhèu kahèi! nèti èèna ka, abhu heka dhèu dhu mai asa ji'i! te lasi aa'i asa nèngu!

source_text: john answered and said, a man can receive nothing, except it have been given him from heaven.
target_text: hèia yohanis dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! dhèu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa, ladhe ama lamatua bhoke boe j'ara hia ne.

source_text: ye yourselves bear me witness, that i said, i am not the christ, but, that i am sent before him.
target_text: miu tadèngi dhu ja'a peka le mola-mola dènge miu, na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus boe, dhu èdhi tatae. te ngaa lamatua pua uuru ja'a mai, ho oti j'ara hia kristus. j'ara na sèmi èèna ka! '

source_text: he that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, that standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is made full.
target_text: ladhe abhu pengantin dhèu mone, tatu abhu pengantin dhèu bhèni kahèi. te ngaa sakasii na, dhu titu dènge ne, d'ara na karej'e, ladhe tadèngi lii padhai lii pengantin dhèu mone. yesus ne, sama sèmi pengantin dhèu mone. aa ja'a ne, sama sèmi sakasii na. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae.

source_text: he must increase, but i must decrease.
target_text: dhu lèke ka, nèngu hud'i asa tabha kapai, aa hud'i laa ja'a asa kura j'aj'i dhèu haha.

source_text: he that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is of the earth, and of the earth he speaketh: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
target_text: yohanis tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, nèngu ne mai nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga, nèti èèna ka nèngu kapai risi aa'i. te ngaa ja'a ne dhoka mai nèti rai-haha, nèti èèna ka ja'a èci èèna ka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ja'a padhai lii lula-nèti j'ara dhu biasa j'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa dhu mai nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga, tatu nèngu kapai risi nèti ngaa aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: what he hath seen and heard, of that he beareth witness; and no man receiveth his witness.
target_text: nèngu peka lula-nèti ngaa dhu nèdhi, dènge ngaa dhu na tadèngi le. te ngaa dhèu sèmi boe lii padhai na.

source_text: he that hath received his witness hath set his seal to this, that god is true.
target_text: ladhe dhèu sèmi rare ngaa dhu dhèu nèti dedha-liru ne peka, èèna pad'elo bukti kahèi, na, nèngu parcaya lii padhai ama lamatua èèna, lèke tare'a.

source_text: for he whom god hath sent speaketh the words of god: for he giveth not the spirit by measure.
target_text: dhèu dhu lamatua pua mai èèna, lole lii moa ama lamatua. te ama lamatua hia le nèngu roh na dhu dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: the father loveth the son, and hath given all things into his hand.
target_text: te ama ètu sorga sue ana na titu kèna. aa na pangèd'u aa'i mèu-mèu mi d'ara adhe-aai ana na.

source_text: he that believeth on the son hath eternal life; but he that obeyeth not the son shall not see life, but the wrath of god abideth on him.
target_text: ka dhèu dhu parcaya ana ne, rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu parcaya boe ne, aa tao boe madhutu lii moa na, rèngu abhu boe mamuri èèna. tatu ama lamatua nasa ka huku si.

source_text: when therefore the lord knew that the pharisees had heard that jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than john although jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,
target_text: ladhe pasoro yohanis dènge yesus, ana-ana madhutu yesus mulai sarani dhèu dhu madhutu ne ae risi nèti yohanis. yesus sarani boe dhèu, dhodhoka ana madhutu na ka dhu sarani si. ka ropa yesus ne'a, na, dhèu nèti partei agama parisi re'a, na, yesus si sarani dhèu ae risi,

source_text: he left judæa, and departed again into galilee.
target_text: hèia nèngu dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele rai yudea, lèpa hari asa propensi galilea.

source_text: and he must needs pass through samaria.
target_text: te ngaa kakako rèngu èèna re propensi samaria asa propensi galilea.

source_text: so he cometh to a city of samaria, called sychar, near to the parcel of ground that jacob gave to his son joseph:
target_text: ètu d'ara kakako ra, rèngu d'ai kota èci ètu samaria, ngara na sikar, padètu dènge rai dhu yakob hia ana na yusuf.

source_text: and jacob's well was there. jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus by the well. it was about the sixth hour. there cometh a woman of samaria to draw water: jesus saith unto her, give me to drink. for his disciples were gone away into the city to buy food.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu madha èi èci, ngara na ‘madha èi yakob'. d'ai loo nètu ku, yesus si d'ai era ne'e. lula j'èra nèti kakako deo na, ka yesus madhèdi taha ètu madha èi ne'e. ka ana madhutu na sèra tèke eele mesa na, lasi hèli nganga'a ètu d'ara kota. hèia bhèni ca dhèu nèti kota èèna, mai usu èi. ka yesus manèngi ne èi, aku nèngu na, ja'a bisa kinu èi ciki, do?

source_text: the samaritan woman therefore saith unto him, how is it that thou, being a jew, askest drink of me, who am a samaritan woman? for jews have no dealings with samaritans.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni ne cag'ag'a, lula dhèu yahudi tema boe padhai lii dènge dhèu samaria. ka bhèni ne karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, èu dhèu yahudi. ja'a ne dhèu samaria. sala boe ne, ladhe èu manèngi ja'a èi ho minu?

source_text: jesus answered and said unto her, if thou knewest the gift of god, and who it is that saith to thee, give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe èu me'a ngaa dhu ama lamatua neo hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i, aa ladhe èu tadhe ja'a ne cee, dhu manèngi èu èi ne, na, tatu èu manèngi hari èi nèti ja'a. pe ja'a hia èu èi dhu nèti mamuri.

source_text: the woman saith unto him, sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: whence then hast thou that living water?
target_text: ka bhèni ne b'ala, peka na, èu dènge boe sabha uusu. aa madha èi ne marèma. nèti mia èu abhu èi dhu nèti mamuri èèna? èi èèna abhu ètu mia hari?

source_text: art thou greater than our father jacob, who gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his sons, and his cattle?
target_text: abhu ètu mia èu kapai risi nèti baki èdhi yakob! nèngu ka dhu tèke eele madha èi ne hia ji'i. aa nèngu, ana-ana na, dènge badha-manu na rinu nèti èi ne'e kahèi.

source_text: jesus answered and said unto her, every one that drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, sanèd'e, ee! dhèu dhu tema rinu nèti madha èi ne, èèna na koko-kamango hari.

source_text: but whosoever drinketh of the water that i shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that i shall give him shall become in him a well of water springing up unto eternal life.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu rinu èi dhu ja'a hia, èèna na koko-kamango heka. te èi dhu ja'a hia èèna, nuka sèmi èi madha dhu sabhoka asa li'u. èi ne, nèti mamuri dhu lèke, dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: the woman saith unto him, sir, give me this water, that i thirst not, neither come all the way hither to draw.
target_text: ka aku dhèu bhèni ne, na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, èu hia ku ja'a èi èèna, sèna ka ja'a koko-kamango ia ka! dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a mai heka pahari-pahari asa ne'e ho usu èi.

source_text: jesus saith unto her, go, call thy husband, and come hither.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ne, sèmi ne'e. èu lèpa, lamu paroa ku dhèu èmu mu, mai asa ne'e.

source_text: the woman answered and said unto him, i have no husband. jesus saith unto her, thou saidst well, i have no husband: for thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: this hast thou said truly.
target_text: ka bhèni ne dhaa, peka na, te ngaa ja'a dènge boe dhèu èmu. hèia yesus peka na, tare'a. èu peka mola-mola èèna. te èu leo mèdhi le èmu lèmi hari. aa mone dhu limuri ne, dhèu èmu èu boe.

source_text: the woman saith unto him, sir, i perceive that thou art a prophet.
target_text: ka bhèni ne lii, peka na, ira ii! ja'a heka ke'a kèna, ama ne ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua.

source_text: our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi. bèi-baki ji'i dhèu samaria pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua ètu ledhe gerisim. te ngaa miu dhèu yahudi peka na, ladhe neo sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i lasi ku asa kota yerusalem. madhutu ama, mia ka dhu lèke?

source_text: jesus saith unto her, woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when neither in this mountain, nor in jerusalem, shall ye worship the father.
target_text: yesus dhaa, na, èu parcaya ku lii ja'a ne, te dhu lèke sèmi ne'e ku. dhèu neo pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua ètu ledhe ne'e, do, ètu yerusalem, pe d'ai lod'o na, dua era se guna heka.

source_text: ye worship that which ye know not: we worship that which we know; for salvation is from the jews.
target_text: miu dhèu samaria me'a mèu boe, mi cee ka miu pahaha iisi. te ngaa ji'i dhèu yahudi nge'a mèu, lula-nèti ama lamatua dhu ji'i pahaha iisi mi nèngu. te nèngu neo pake ji'i ho bhoke j'ara, sèna ka dhèu bisa abhu mamuri nèti koasa sasala-sasigo rèngu.

source_text: but the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the father in spirit and truth: for such doth the father seek to be his worshippers.
target_text: pe d'ai lod'o na, nuka mulai ne'e ne, dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a pahaha iisi mi ama èdhi ètu sorga, na, rèngu pahaha iisi mi nèngu madhutu roh na, aa madhutu ngaa dhu lèke. te ama ètu sorga d'èi dhèu sèmi sèra dhu pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: god is a spirit: and they that worship him must worship in spirit and truth.
target_text: te lamatua èèna, roh. de dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi nèngu hud'i pahaha iisi madhutu ku roh na, aa madhutu ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: the woman saith unto him, i know that messiah cometh he that is called christ: when he is come, he will declare unto us all things.
target_text: ka dhèu bhèni ne lii, peka na, ja'a ke'a le mesias neo mai èèna, dhu dhèu peka na, ‘kristus'. ama lamatua padhadha tèke neo hia mai. ladhe na mai ka, tatu nèngu bhoke paled'a aa'i-aa'i mi ji'i.

source_text: jesus saith unto her, i that speak unto thee am he.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, na, nèngu èèna, nuka ja'a dhu padhai lii dènge èu ne.

source_text: and upon this came his disciples; and they marvelled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no man said, what seekest thou? or, why speakest thou with her?
target_text: ropa nèngu padhai lii era, ana madhutu na sèra lèpa nèti d'ara kota. rèngu malaa, lula rèngu rèdhi yesus dhu padhai lii dènge bhèni samaria ca dhèu. te ngaa ca dhèu sa bani boe karèi dhèu bhèni, na, èu parluu ngaa? aa èci sa bani boe karèi yesus kahèi, peka na, nga tao ka ama padhai lii dènge dhèu bhèni ne?

source_text: so the woman left her waterpot, and went away into the city, and saith to the people,
target_text: ka bhèni ne tèke eele g'ala na ètu era èèna, la'e asa d'ara kota. hèia na lolo dènge dhèu ètu sèra, peka na,

source_text: come, see a man, who told me all things that ever i did: can this be the christ?
target_text: mai lati ladhe ku dhèu nèi laa! te na bhoke patalele aa'i le ngaa-ngaa dhu ja'a ad'u-ue kèdhi. tao-tao nèngu ne'e ka, kristus, dhu ama lamatua pamoa hia mai!

source_text: they went out of the city, and were coming to him.
target_text: hèia dhèu ae kalua nèti d'ara kota, lasi laladhe ne.

source_text: in the mean while the disciples prayed him, saying, rabbi, eat.
target_text: lod'o bhèni ne la'e asa kota, hèia ana madhutu na peka dènge ne, ama mese! mai ka ta'a!

source_text: but he said unto them, i have meat to eat that ye know not.
target_text: te ngaa na dhaa, peka na, ja'a abhu le nganga'a dhu miu me'a boe.

source_text: the disciples therefore said one to another, hath any man brought him aught to eat?
target_text: ka ana madhutu na pakarèi èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, tasamia, ne? cee ka dhu rèti nganga'a hia ne?

source_text: jesus saith unto them, my meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to accomplish his work.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge rèngu, na, sèmi ne'e. ama lamatua pua ja'a mai, sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi na, aa pakako sasab'a-la'a na toke d'ai èle. ne'e ne, nuka sèmi nganga'a-nginu dhu ja'a abhu.

source_text: say not ye, there are yet four months, and then cometh the harvest? behold, i say unto you, lift up your eyes, and look on the fields, that they are white already unto harvest.
target_text: miu ladhe ku asa d'ara oka-tedhe, aa mi kasere sèku, ele boe miu peka na, ‘di èpa hèru ka, heka bisa puru are kèna. ' nanene, ee! ja'a pasanèd'e miu. ladhe miu laladhe paie-iie, are ètu d'ara oka-tedhe d'ai le lod'o puu-g'ètu. oka-tedhe sèra nuka sèmi dhèu-dhèu dhu mai asa èdhi. te rèngu se'e ka dhu sadia le parcaya ja'a.

source_text: he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal; that he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
target_text: mesa boe sèmi se'e di, te dhèu dhu puu-g'ètu sèra pakaboko hua-hela ètu d'ara gud'a, rèngu mulai sèmi rare rui-j'aj'èra ra. rèngu se'e, nuka sèmi dhèu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka dhèu parcaya mi ama lamatua, ho abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, dhèu sèle hini dènge dhèu puu-g'ètu, bisa sama-sama karej'e-karae.

source_text: for herein is the saying true, one soweth, and another reapeth.
target_text: dhèu peka na, ‘dhèu èci sèle hini; dhèu leo ka dhu kaboko isi rai. ' èèna, lèke kèna.

source_text: i sent you to reap that whereon ye have not labored: others have labored, and ye are entered into their labor.
target_text: ja'a pua-paleha miu ho lami kaboko isi rai nèti sasab'a dhèu leo. mema sasab'a miu boe, te ngaa miu abhu leto nèti rui-j'aj'èra rèngu.

source_text: and from that city many of the samaritans believed on him because of the word of the woman, who testified, he told me all things that ever i did.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu d'ara kota samaria ae ka dhu parcaya yesus, lula lii padhai bhèni ne, dhu peka na, na bhoke patalele aa'i le ngaa-ngaa dhu ja'a ad'u-ue kèdhi.

source_text: so when the samaritans came unto him, they besought him to abide with them: and he abode there two days.
target_text: ka ropa dhèu se'e mai d'ai madha yesus, ra pamako ne, peka na, ama pea ku laa dènge ji'i mi ne'e! hèia yesus pea dènge dhèu se, dua lod'o.

source_text: and many more believed because of his word;
target_text: aa dhèu leo ae kahèi dhu parcaya ne, lula lii padhai na.

source_text: and they said to the woman, now we believe, not because of thy speaking: for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the saviour of the world.
target_text: hèia dhèu se peka dènge dhèu bhèni ne, aku rèngu na, med'a na, ji'i nanene dhoka lii èu di. te ngaa ne'e ne ji'i parcaya ne, lula ji'i nanene lii padhai na patoo madha dènge madha. ji'i nge'a tare'a, na, dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu bisa patalale èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, ètu rai-haha ne nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: and after the two days he went forth from thence into galilee.
target_text: hèia yesus si tèke eele era èèna, pakèd'i lasi asa propensi galilea.

source_text: for jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honor in his own country.
target_text: ca tèka yesus dhu peka nèdhi, na, dhèu d'èi boe pakab'ua dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti rae èta-èsu na.

source_text: so when he came into galilee, the galilæans received him, having seen all the things that he did in jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o dhèu dhae tao mèka kalela paska, dhèu galilea ae ka dhu lasi asa yerusalem, sèna ka tao lod'o hua iia ètu nèi. ka rèdhi aa'i-aa'i kahèi dhu yesus tao ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, lod'o na lèpa asa galilea, dhèu sèmi ne dènge be'a.

source_text: he came therefore again unto cana of galilee, where he made the water wine. and there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at capernaum.
target_text: ka yesus si lasi hari asa rae kana ètu propensi galilea. ètu era ne'e ka dhu yesus tao nèdhi èi j'aj'i anggor. lod'o èèna, abhu pegawi ca dhèu dhu pea ètu kota kapernaum. ana mone na dhu pèd'a.

source_text: when he heard that jesus was come out of judæa into galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son; for he was at the point of death.
target_text: ropa pegawi ne tadèngi, yesus lèpa le asa galilea nèti propensi yudea, hèia ca'e la'e asa rae kana ho tenge yesus. ropa paraga dènge ne, ka na pamako, sèna ka yesus puru la'e ho puri-pa'èle ana na nèti papèd'a-tarègu. te ana ne dhu pèd'a oe madhe.

source_text: jesus therefore said unto him, except ye see signs and wonders, ye will in no wise believe.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge pegawi ne, ladhe miu mèdhi boe tadha-tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao, na, miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a!

source_text: the nobleman saith unto him, sir, come down ere my child die.
target_text: te ngaa pegawi ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, lati ku laa. te aad'o, na, ana ja'a madhe.

source_text: jesus saith unto him, go thy way; thy son liveth. the man believed the word that jesus spake unto him, and he went his way.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, lèpa ka. te ana mu mamuri. ka na lèpa dènge ka, lula nèngu parcaya lii padhai yesus.

source_text: and as he was now going down, his servants met him, saying, that his son lived.
target_text: ropa pegawi ne ètu talora j'ara era, dhèu-dhèu sab'a na mai paraga dènge ne, ka ra peka na, ama susa ia ka, te ana ama èle le nèti papèd'a.

source_text: so he inquired of them the hour when he began to amend. they said therefore unto him, yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
target_text: ka na karèi si, na èle, d'ara hake pèri sa? ka dhèu se dhaa, peka na, karèi med'a, lod'o titu mera d'ara hake èci sa, maringi-sagoro na èle dènge ka.

source_text: so the father knew that it was at that hour in which jesus said unto him, thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
target_text: hèia pegawi ne ngee nèdhi dènge, na, ana na be'a le, ropa yesus peka na, ana ama èle le nèti papèd'a. ka pegawi ne, dènge isi èmu na aa'i-aa'i parcaya yesus.

source_text: this is again the second sign that jesus did, having come out of judæa into galilee.
target_text: de ne'e ne, tadha malaa ka dua dhu yesus tao, lod'o na kalua nèti yudea la'e asa galilea.

source_text: after these things there was a feast of the jews; and jesus went up to jerusalem.
target_text: nèbhu boe nèti èèna, abhu lod'o hua iia agama yahudi. ka yesus si lasi asa kota yerusalem.

source_text: now there is in jerusalem by the sheep gate a pool, which is called in hebrew bethesda, having five porches.
target_text: ètu nèi, abhu kolam cue dhu dènge lèmi teras dhu padètu dènge hèb'a babèdho èci, dhu dhèu peka na, babèdho kahib'i-kalèbho. dènge lii aram kolam ne, ngara na ‘batesda'.

source_text: in these lay a multitude of them that were sick, blind, halt, withered.
target_text: dhèu pèd'a ae-ae dhu tema mate ètu teras se'e. dhèu pèd'a se nuka sèmi: dhèu bèdhu, dhèu karuku, dènge dhèu bisa boe eso. rèngu se mate, ladhe pèri lod'o èi ne mulai dènge gagèb'o.

source_text: and a certain man was there, who had been thirty and eight years in his infirmity.
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu ca dhèu dhu pèd'a tèlu nguru aru tèu le.

source_text: when jesus saw him lying, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, wouldest thou be made whole?
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ne j'unu ètu èèna. nèngu ne'a dhèu ne dhu pèd'a nèbhu le, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu neo èle nèti papèd'a, do?

source_text: the sick man answered him, sir, i have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while i am coming, another steppeth down before me.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne dhaa, na, ko'o, ama. te ngaa ako carui ka, ladhe èi ne mulai gagèb'o, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ded'e ja'a ho pamaso asa d'ara èi ne. ladhe ja'a sèku maso, na, abhu le dhèu leo dhu maso uuru nèti ja'a.

source_text: jesus saith unto him, arise, take up thy bed, and walk.
target_text: ka yesus pua ne, aku nèngu na, titu ka! lulu dhèpi èu, ho lèpa ka.

source_text: and straightway the man was made whole, and took up his bed and walked. now it was the sabbath on that day.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia dhèu ne èle dènge ka nèti karuku na. ka na kèd'i, ded'e nèti dhèpi na, hèia la'e dènge ka. j'ara ne j'aj'i, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi.

source_text: so the jews said unto him that was cured, it is the sabbath, and it is not lawful for thee to take up thy bed.
target_text: ka ama-ama dhèu yahudi jèke dhèu dhu heka èle nèti papèd'a ne, aku rèngu na, weh! èu me'a, do aad'o? doe ne'e ne, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu bisa boe nedhe dhèpi na, te èèna ngara na, sasab'a!

source_text: but he answered them, he that made me whole, the same said unto me, take up thy bed, and walk.
target_text: ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama-ama! baku nasa dènge ja'a. te dhèu dhu puri-pa'èle ja'a, dhu paredha ja'a peka na, ‘lulu dhèpi èu, ho lèpa ka. '

source_text: they asked him, who is the man that said unto thee, take up thy bed, and walk?
