target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi ne, cee ka dhu pua èu nedhe dhèpi èèna?

source_text: but he that was healed knew not who it was; for jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in the place.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu èle nèti pèd'a ne, tadhe boe, na, yesus ne, cee. te yesus dhu kalua le mau-mau, lula dhèu ae ètu èèna.

source_text: afterward jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing befall thee.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka yesus paraga dènge dhèu ne ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka yesus peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, nanene! èu èle le nèti papèd'a èu. baku ad'u-ue hari sasala, sèna ka èu baku abhu hari j'aj'èra dhu bia risi.

source_text: the man went away, and told the jews that it was jesus who had made him whole.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne la'e asa ama-ama dhèu yahudi se, ka na lolo, peka na, dhu puri-pa'èle ja'a nèti papèd'a èèna, ngara na yesus.

source_text: and for this cause the jews persecuted jesus, because he did these things on the sabbath.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra mulai paj'èra yesus, lula nèngu pa'èle dhèu pèd'a lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: but jesus answered them, my father worketh even until now, and i work.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, sèmi ne'e. ama ku ae boe nèti sasab'a-la'a na. de ja'a sab'a taruu kahèi.

source_text: for this cause therefore the jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only brake the sabbath, but also called god his own father, making himself equal with god.
target_text: lula ama-ama dhèu yahudi se cap le, peka na, yesus sisu atora lod'o ae sasab'a rèngu, nèti èèna ka ra tenge-tenge j'ara tasamia, ho pamadhe ne. risi-risi hari, na peka na, ama lamatua èèna, ama nèngu. dènge lii padhai sèmi ne'e, nèngu tao iisi na sama sèmi ama lamatua.

source_text: jesus therefore answered and said unto them, verily, verily, i say unto you, the son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the father doing: for what things soever he doeth, these the son also doeth in like manner.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, tare'a! ja'a peka mema, na, ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa madhutu d'ara ja'a unu ku. te ja'a ne, ana ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa sab'a dhodhoka madhutu ngaa dhu ja'a kèdhi ama ku sab'a. ja'a kèdhi ama ku tao ngaa, na, ja'a tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: for the father loveth the son, and showeth him all things that himself doeth: and greater works than these will he show him, that ye may marvel.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga sue ja'a, nuka ana na. na pad'elo dènge ja'a kahèi aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu tao. na neo pad'elo dènge ja'a j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi hari, sèna ka miu mèdhi aa asa tabha malaa!

source_text: for as the father raiseth the dead and giveth them life, even so the son also giveth life to whom he will.
target_text: ama ku pamamuri hari dhèu madhe. sèmi èèna kahèi, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mamuri dhu lèke mi cee èèna ka dhu madhutu dad'èi ja'a.

source_text: for neither doth the father judge any man, but he hath given all judgment unto the son;
target_text: dhu mola-mola, sèmi ne'e ka: ama ku mesa na pama'ète boe hahuku mi dhèu. te ngaa na pangèd'u aa'i hak èèna mi ja'a, te ja'a ne, ana na. hèia ja'a ka dhu pama'ète, na, tatao dhèu lèke, do aad'o.

source_text: that all may honor the son, even as they honor the father. he that honoreth not the son honoreth not the father that sent him.
target_text: ama ku d'èi sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i pakab'ua ja'a, sama sèmi rèngu pakab'ua nèngu kahèi. te dhèu dhu pakab'ua boe ja'a, ana nèngu ne, èci èèna ka rèngu pakab'ua boe ama ku dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: verily, verily, i say unto you, he that heareth my word, and believeth him that sent me, hath eternal life, and cometh not into judgment, but hath passed out of death into life.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka mema. dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a nanene lii padhai ja'a, aa parcaya ama lamatua dhu pua ja'a mai, na, nèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. lamatua huku heka nèngu. te dhèu èèna abhu heka hahuku madhe, te ngaa nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu dhu mamuri taruu dènge lamatua.

source_text: verily, verily, i say unto you, the hour cometh, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the son of god; and they that hear shall live.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka mema dènge miu kèna. lod'o na dètu le, limuri ne dhu j'aj'i le, nuka dhèu-dhèu madhe nanene lii ja'a, ana ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu nanene dènge sèmi nare lii padhai ja'a, nèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: for as the father hath life in himself, even so gave he to the son also to have life in himself:
target_text: mamuri aa'i-aa'i kapua na nèti ama ku. nèngu hia ja'a mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. te ja'a ne, ana na.

source_text: and he gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
target_text: ama ku pangèd'u koasa dènge hak mi ja'a kahèi, sèna ka pama'ète hahuku mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, lula ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a.

source_text: marvel not at this: for the hour cometh, in which all that are in the tombs shall hear his voice,
target_text: miu baku malaa, te ciki oo'e hari dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i ra tadèngi lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: and shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of judgment.
target_text: hèia ra mamuri hari. ka rèngu kalua nèti d'ara ro'a ra. dhèu dhu uru sèra tao be'a, abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu uru sèra ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a, pasae hahuku taruu.

source_text: i can of myself do nothing: as i hear, i judge: and my judgment is righteous; because i seek not mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa ladhe dhae tadèngi mèka nèti ama ku. ladhe ja'a tadèngi kore ku, heka ja'a pama'ète lii langu dhèu kèna. nèti èèna ka, ngaa dhu ja'a pama'ète sèra, lèke mola-mola. te ja'a ko'o boe madhutu dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa ja'a madhutu dad'èi ama ku. lula nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a mai!

source_text: if i bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
target_text: lèke iia boe, ladhe ja'a mesa ku dhu padhue-padhai lula-nèti ngi'u ja'a.

source_text: it is another that beareth witness of me; and i know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu leo kahèi dhu j'aj'i sakasii lula-nèti ja'a. aa ja'a ke'a lii padhai nèngu lula-nèti ja'a, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: ye have sent unto john, and he hath borne witness unto the truth.
target_text: miu dhu pua mèdhi dhèu lasi pakarèi dènge yohanis tuka sarani. ka na peka lèke lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: but the witness which i receive is not from man: howbeit i say these things, that ye may be saved.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a parluu boe lii sakasii nèti dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e lii se'e, sèna ka miu bisa pakaj'èu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu.

source_text: he was the lamp that burneth and shineth; and ye were willing to rejoice for a season in his light.
target_text: lii padhai yohanis ne, nuka sèmi labhu èci dhu heo pasaraa miu. ropa heo na d'elo miu era, d'ara miu karej'e-karae.

source_text: but the witness which i have is greater than that of john; for the works which the father hath given me to accomplish, the very works that i do, bear witness of me, that the father hath sent me.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a abhu dhèu èci dhu kapai risi eele nèti yohanis dhu peka mola-mola lula-nèti ja'a ne. nèngu, nuka ama ku ètu sorga, dhu pangèd'u mi ja'a sasab'a ae-ae, sèna ka sab'a toke pa'èle. sasab'a ae se'e ka dhu j'aj'i mi tadha, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: and the father that sent me, he hath borne witness of me. ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
target_text: lula nèngu ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a, nèngu ka dhu peka mola-mola lula-nèti ja'a kahèi. miu mesa mi tadèngi mèdhi mèka lii nèngu, do, patoo madha dènge madha, aa ladhe mèdhi mèka rèhu na.

source_text: and ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he sent, him ye believe not.
target_text: lii holo-nori lamatua mamuri boe ètu d'ara miu, lula miu parcaya boe ja'a dhu nèngu pua mai.

source_text: ye search the scriptures, because ye think that in them ye have eternal life; and these are they which bear witness of me;
target_text: miu d'èi parisa toke lutu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, lula miu pangee, na, bèli-camèd'a miu abhu j'ara ho abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. aa te ngaa sasuri sèra ka dhu lole lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: and ye will not come to me, that ye may have life.
target_text: te ngaa miu mo'o boe ara mai asa ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a, sèna ka abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: i receive not glory from men.
target_text: ja'a parluu boe dhèu ded'e kolongara ja'a padedha-dedha.

source_text: but i know you, that ye have not the love of god in yourselves.
target_text: lula ja'a ke'a mèu d'ara iiki miu. nèti èèna ka ja'a ke'a, na, miu sue boe ama lamatua.

source_text: i am come in my father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
target_text: ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, lula ama ku dhu nèd'u koasa ka pua ja'a mai. te ngaa miu mo'o boe sèmi mere ja'a. aa te ngaa ladhe dhèu leo dhu mai pake koasa nèngu, miu sèmi mere ne dènge be'a.

source_text: how can ye believe, who receive glory one of another, and the glory that cometh from the only god ye seek not?
target_text: miu èci dènge èci d'èi sèna ka abhu koa-kad'iri. te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe, ladhe ama lamatua koa miu, do aad'o. aa te ngaa nèngu èèna, ama lamatua! abhu boe dhu leo. de ladhe miu pahae boe ne, na, tasamia miu bisa parcaya nèngu?

source_text: think not that i will accuse you to the father: there is one that accuseth you, even moses, on whom ye have set your hope.
target_text: baku pangee, na, ja'a pèci sasala mi dedha miu ètu katanga madha ama ku. aad'o. dhu pèci sasala sa dedha miu nuka musa. aa te ngaa, era maena miu ka nèngu, lula nèngu ka dhu hia miu atora ama lamatua.

source_text: for if ye believed moses, ye would believe me; for he wrote of me.
target_text: de ladhe miu lèka musa, tatu miu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a. te nèngu ka dhu suri lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: but if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
target_text: te ngaa lula miu parcaya èra boe mi ngaa dhu na suri, tasamia ka miu bisa lèka ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai? aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: after these things jesus went away to the other side of the sea of galilee, which is the sea of tiberias. and a great multitude followed him, because they beheld the signs which he did on them that were sick. and jesus went up into the mountain, and there he sat with his disciples. now the passover, the feast of the jews, was at hand.
target_text: lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi oe dètu. hèia yesus si lasi asa cabèka dano galilea. ngara leo dano ne, ‘dano tiberias'. dhèu ae dhu madhutu ne, lula rèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu na tao, lod'o puri-pa'èle dhèu-dhèu pèd'a. d'ai cabèka dano, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na ca'e asa ledhe iiki èci. hèia ra madhèdi ètu era èèna.

source_text: jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude cometh unto him, saith unto philip, whence are we to buy bread, that these may eat?
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ae mai pakaboko, hèia na karèi ana madhutu na ca dhèu, ngara na pelipus, aku nèngu na, ètu era mia èdhi bisa hèli nganga'a, ho hia dhèu se ra'a?

source_text: and this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
target_text: yesus ne'a le ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. te ngaa na peka sèmi èèna, sèna ka neo sèku pelipus.

source_text: philip answered him, two hundred shillings' worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one may take a little.
target_text: ka pelipus dhaa, na, waa! masi ka gaji tuka ca dhèu dua ngasu lod'o èèna ka, d'ai mèka hèli roti ho panga'a dhèu udhu sobhu-sobhu se! masi ka ca dhèu abhu roti ciki oo'e èèna ka, pad'ai boe hèi!

source_text: one of his disciples, andrew, simon peter's brother, saith unto him,
target_text: hèia, ca dhèu hari nèti ana madhutu na, ngara na anderias, ari simon petrus, peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na,

source_text: there is a lad here, who hath five barley loaves, and two fishes: but what are these among so many?
target_text: ama! ana iiki èci ètu ne'e nèti roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u. te ngaa d'ai dhèu ae-ae se ra'a, do aad'o?

source_text: jesus said, make the people sit down. now there was much grass in the place. so the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, j'u'u muri ae-ae. ka yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, ator si madhèdi. hèia dhèu se madhèdi ka. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae titu kèna. dhèu mone di, pe d'ai lèmi riho dhèu sa.

source_text: jesus therefore took the loaves; and having given thanks, he distributed to them that were set down; likewise also of the fishes as much as they would.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti se, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pangèd'u mi ana madhutu na sèra. sèna ka rèngu bagi hia dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra. na tao sèmi èèna kahèi dènge i'a sèra. dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: and when they were filled, he saith unto his disciples, gather up the broken pieces which remain over, that nothing be lost.
target_text: ropa ra'a toke bècu, hèia yesus peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, pakaboko mere nganga'a dhu sisa se'e, sèna ka baku core eele iia d'ara.

source_text: so they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which remained over unto them that had eaten.
target_text: ka ra pakaboko nganga'a dhu sisa nèti roti lèmi bua deo sa, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: when therefore the people saw the sign which he did, they said, this is of a truth the prophet that cometh into the world.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae-ae se ladhe rèdhi tadha malaa dhu yesus tao ne, hèia ra peka na, ira ii! nèngu ne, tatu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu na jaji le neo hia mai.

source_text: jesus therefore perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force, to make him king, withdrew again into the mountain himself alone.
target_text: yesus ne'a, na, dhèu se neo laka-seti ne sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu aae. hèia la'e tèke eele si, ka na ca'e asa era kaj'èu ètu ledhe iiki èci, sèna ka nèngu mesa na ètu era èèna.

source_text: and when evening came, his disciples went down unto the sea;
target_text: ropa lod'o heka cèna, ana-ana madhutu yesus puru lasi asa sebhe dano.

source_text: and they entered into a boat, and were going over the sea unto capernaum. and it was now dark, and jesus had not yet come to them.
target_text: yesus mai mèka pa'èci dènge rèngu. ka ra ca'e koha cue, hèia ra tuku lasi asa kota kapernaum ètu cabèka dano. ropa rèngu pakèd'i, lod'o dhu maroga le.

source_text: and the sea was rising by reason of a great wind that blew.
target_text: lula ngèlu aae, ka naha mulai kapai.

source_text: when therefore they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they behold jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the boat: and they were afraid.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yesus se'e tuku kaj'èu pe d'ai lèmi kilometer sa, hèia ladhe rèdhi yesus dhu kako re dedha èi. na mai padètu-dètu dènge koha rèngu, ka ra madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: but he saith unto them, it is i; be not afraid.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ra, aku nèngu na, baku madha'u! te ja'a ne.

source_text: they were willing therefore to receive him into the boat: and straightway the boat was at the land whither they were going.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, rèngu madha'u heka. aa ra neo sèna ka yesus ca'e sama-sama dènge rèngu. cag'ag'a laa, koha ne d'ai le dae dhu rèngu neo lasi.

source_text: on the morrow the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, save one, and that jesus entered not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples went away alone howbeit there came boats from tiberias nigh unto the place where they ate the bread after the lord had given thanks: when the multitude therefore saw that jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they themselves got into the boats, and came to capernaum, seeking jesus.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhèu ae sèra ètu cabèka dano era. rèngu padètu iiki dènge era dhu med'a na yesus manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, ropa hia si ra'a. hèia dhèu se re'a, na, med'a na koha dhoka cue di ètu era èèna. te ngaa ana madhutu yesus se pake koha ne, lasi tèke eele era ne'e, aa yesus dhu ca'e boe dènge rèngu. te ngaa abhu pèri-pèri koha leo nèti kota tiberias dhu lasi-mai ètu era èèna. hèia, ropa dhèu ae se re'a, na, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu aad'o heka, ka ra ca'e koha leo sèra lasi tenge yesus asa kapernaum, ètu cabèka dano.

source_text: and when they found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, rabbi, when camest thou hither?
target_text: ka ra paraga dènge yesus ètu cabèka dano. hèia ra karèi yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ama d'ai era ne'e sange mera mia sa?

source_text: jesus answered them and said, verily, verily, i say unto you, ye seek me, not because ye saw signs, but because ye ate of the loaves, and were filled.
target_text: yesus dhaa, na, dhu lèke sèmi ne'e: miu se tenge ja'a lula boe miu mèdhi le tadha-tadha malaa, te ngaa lula ja'a panga'a miu toke bècu.

source_text: work not for the food which perisheth, but for the food which abideth unto eternal life, which the son of man shall give unto you: for him the father, even god, hath sealed.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! baku sab'a tenge dhoka nganga'a di dhu bèli-camèd'a ele iie d'ara. te ngaa be'a risi miu sab'a sèna ka abhu nganga'a dhu taha taruu, dhu nèti mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a ka dhu bisa hia miu mamuri èèna. te ama ètu sorga pangèd'u le hak mi ja'a ne.

source_text: they said therefore unto him, what must we do, that we may work the works of god?
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi, aku rèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, ji'i hud'i tao tasamia, sèna ka bisa pakako sasab'a ama lamatua?

source_text: jesus answered and said unto them, this is the work of god, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
target_text: yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sasab'a lamatua, sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i parcaya ku ja'a ne. te ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: they said therefore unto him, what then doest thou for a sign, that we may see, and believe thee? what workest thou?
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi hari, peka na, ama neo pad'elo tadha malaa sèmi ngaa, ho ji'i ngèdhi aa parcaya ama? aa ama neo tao ngaa hari hia ji'i?

source_text: our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written, he gave them bread out of heaven to eat.
target_text: nuka sèmi uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki ji'i ra'a roti manna ètu d'ara mamoo. èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, ‘nèngu hia si roti dhu mai nèti dedha-liru, sèna ka ra'a. '

source_text: jesus therefore said unto them, verily, verily, i say unto you, it was not moses that gave you the bread out of heaven; but my father giveth you the true bread out of heaven.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, ja'a peka dhu lèke sèmi ne'e: uru èèna, musa boe ka dhu papuru roti èèna nèti dedha-liru hia mi bèi-baki miu. te dhu papuru mai roti èèna, nuka ama ku ètu sorga. limuri ne na sadia hia miu roti nèti liru kahèi. te ngaa roti ne'e ne, roti dhu tare'a-re'a taha toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: for the bread of god is that which cometh down out of heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
target_text: te roti nèti lamatua ne, nuka, dhu puru mai nèti sorga aa nèti mamuri hia mi dhèu ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: they said therefore unto him, lord, evermore give us this bread.
target_text: hèia dhèu se manèngi, aku rèngu na, ama! hia taruu ji'i roti èèna!

source_text: jesus said unto them, i am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall not hunger, and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne'e ka, roti èèna. te ja'a ka dhu kèti mamuri dhu lèke. de dhèu dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a, manganga heka! aa dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, koko-kamango heka!

source_text: but i said unto you, that ye have seen me, and yet believe not.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka kèdhi le dènge miu, na, masi ka miu mèdhi le ja'a, te ngaa miu parcaya mèka ja'a.

source_text: all that which the father giveth me shall come unto me; and him that cometh to me i will in no wise cast out.
target_text: aa te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama ku hag'e nare le ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a rèngu mai asa ja'a. aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu mai asa ja'a, tatu ja'a babège eele boe ne!

source_text: for i am come down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
target_text: te ja'a mai nèti dedha-liru. ja'a mai sèna ka sab'a madhutu dad'èi ama ku, lula nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a. ja'a ko'o boe madhutu dhoka dad'èi ja'a mesa ku.

source_text: and this is the will of him that sent me, that of all that which he hath given me i should lose nothing, but should raise it up at the last day.
target_text: dad'èi ama lamatua sèmi ne'e: nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu hag'e nare le ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a, nèngu d'èi ja'a oru-kaboko si aa'i-aa'i. ja'a bisa boe soro tèke ca dhèu sa ele. te ngaa ladhe lod'o d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ja'a pamamuri hari si.

source_text: for this is the will of my father, that every one that beholdeth the son, and believeth on him, should have eternal life; and i will raise him up at the last day.
target_text: nuka sèmi dhu ja'a peka deo na, ama ku d'èi sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadhe aa parcaya ja'a, nuka ana na, èèna na rèngu bisa abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. hèia ètu lod'o èle rai-haha, ja'a pamamuri hari si.

source_text: the jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, i am the bread which came down out of heaven.
target_text: ka ama-ama dhèu yahudi se mulai ka'uu-kamuki, lula yesus peka na, roti dhu mai nèti lamatua èèna, nuka ja'a dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: and they said, is not this jesus, the son of joseph, whose father and mother we know? how doth he now say, i am come down out of heaven?
target_text: ra padhai lii, peka na, tasamia ka sèmi ne'e? dhèu ne'e ne, yesus ana yusuf, si? ji'i tadhe ina-ama na. de tasamia ka nèngu ne peka na, ‘ja'a mai nèti sorga? ' abhu ètu mia?

source_text: jesus answered and said unto them, murmur not among yourselves.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, eee! loe eele ku ka'uu-kamuki!

source_text: no man can come to me, except the father that sent me draw him: and i will raise him up in the last day.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga ka pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa mai asa ja'a, ladhe ama ku lere boe ne mai. aa d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha, ja'a pamamuri hari si.

source_text: it is written in the prophets, and they shall all be taught of god. every one that hath heard from the father, and hath learned, cometh unto me.
target_text: dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra suri rèdhi le, peka na, ‘ama lamatua neo aj'a-nori dhèu aa'i-aa'i. ' de dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu nanene ama ètu sorga, aa rèngu abhu aj'a-nori nèti nèngu, rèngu mai sa ja'a, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: not that any man hath seen the father, save he that is from god, he hath seen the father.
target_text: ja'a ne ka dhu puru mai nèti ama lamatua. de dhoka ja'a mesa-mesa ku kèdhi ne. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu patoo madha dènge ama ètu sorga.

source_text: verily, verily, i say unto you, he that believeth hath eternal life.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka dènge miu kèna! dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, bèli-camèd'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: i am the bread of life.
target_text: te ja'a ne, nuka roti dhu nèti mamuri èèna.

source_text: your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki miu ra'a roti manna lod'o ra kako rai-reo d'ara mamoo. masi ka ra'a le roti èèna, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu madhe kahèi.

source_text: this is the bread which cometh down out of heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
target_text: te ngaa roti dhu limuri ne puru mai nèti sorga, leko-leo. te dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa ra'a. sasoa na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a, rèngu cèri eele heka nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: i am the living bread which came down out of heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: yea and the bread which i will give is my flesh, for the life of the world.
target_text: lula ja'a ne, roti dhu nèti mamuri, dhu mai nèti sorga. pe ladhe ja'a madhe, ja'a soro ngi'u ja'a sèna ka madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, ho ra bisa mamuri. aa dhèu dhu ra'a roti ne, rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: the jews therefore strove one with another, saying, how can this man give us his flesh to eat?
target_text: ropa ama-ama dhèu yahudi se tadèngi rare lii padhai yesus ne, hèia ra pab'ala èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, na padhai lii sèmi ngaa ka nèi? tasamia ka dhèu ne bisa hia ngi'u na, èdhi ta'e?

source_text: jesus therefore said unto them, verily, verily, i say unto you, except ye eat the flesh of the son of man and drink his blood, ye have not life in yourselves.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ja'a padhai lii dhu mola-mola dènge miu kèna. ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. dhèu dhu neo mamuri lèke, hud'i pa'èki ku dènge ja'a. de ladhe miu mi'a boe ngi'u ja'a, aa minu boe raa ja'a, na, miu abhu boe mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: he that eateth my flesh and drinketh my blood hath eternal life; and i will raise him up at the last day.
target_text: te dhèu dhu ra'e ngi'u ja'a, aa rinu raa ja'a, rèngu abhu le mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha, ja'a pamamuri hari ne.

source_text: for my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
target_text: te nganga'a dhu lèke, nuka ngi'u ja'a. aa nganginu dhu lèke, nuka raa ja'a.

source_text: he that eateth my flesh and drinketh my blood abideth in me, and i in him.
target_text: de dhèu dhu ra'a ngi'u ja'a, dènge rinu raa ja'a, mamuri ra dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. aa ja'a pa'èki dènge rèngu.

source_text: as the living father sent me, and i live because of the father; so he that eateth me, he also shall live because of me.
target_text: ama ètu sorga dhu pua ja'a, nèngu mamuri tare'a-re'a. aa ja'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke nèti nèngu kahèi. nèti èèna ka dhèu dhu na'e ngi'u ja'a, nèngu unu mamuri dhu lèke nèti ja'a kahèi.

source_text: this is the bread which came down out of heaven: not as the fathers ate, and died; he that eateth this bread shall live for ever.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki miu ra'a roti manna nèti dedha-liru. masi ka rèngu ra'a, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu rèngu madhe kahèi. te ngaa roti dhu mai nèti sorga ne, leko-leo. te dhèu dhu ra'a roti ne, bèli-camèd'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: these things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in capernaum.
target_text: yesus aj'a j'ara se'e ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a dhèu yahudi cue ètu kota kapernaum.

source_text: many therefore of his disciples, when they heard this, said, this is a hard saying; who can hear it?
target_text: dhèu ae dhu madhutu yesus. ropa rèngu tadèngi lii padhai na sèmi èèna, hèia abhu dhu peka na, a'aj'a na, bia! cee ka dhu bisa sèmi rare a'aj'a èèna?

source_text: but jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said unto them, doth this cause you to stumble?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a le lii padhai rèngu se, hèia na karèi si, aku nèngu na, a'aj'a ne tao miu susa, do?

source_text: what then if ye should behold the son of man ascending where he was before?
target_text: tasamia hari, ladhe miu mèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, ca'e hari asa era pea ja'a uru èèna?

source_text: it is the spirit that giveth life; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that i have spoken unto you are spirit, and are life.
target_text: roh lamatua ka dhu nèti mamuri dhu lèke. mamuri dhu lèke mai boe nèti ngi'u dhèu. te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a kapua na nèti roh ama lamatua. de lii holo-nori ne'e bisa hia mamuri dhu lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i kahèi.

source_text: but there are some of you that believe not. for jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who it was that should betray him.
target_text: te ngaa abhu nèti miu cahag'e dhu lèka boe ja'a. yesus peka sèmi ne'e, lula nèngu dhu ne'a le karèi nèti uru j'ara, cee dhu parcaya boe, aa cee ka dhu èèna na pahie eele nèngu.

source_text: and he said, for this cause have i said unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it be given unto him of the father.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka mema le dènge miu, na, ama ku ètu sorga hud'i bhoke uuru ku j'ara hia dhèu, heka dhèu ne bisa mai j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a kèna.

source_text: upon this many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ana madhutu na ae ka dhu tèke eele ne, lula rèngu ro'o heka madhutu nèngu.

source_text: jesus said therefore unto the twelve, would ye also go away?
target_text: ka yesus karèi ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra, aku nèngu na, aa miu tasamia? neo tèke eele ja'a kahèi, do?

source_text: simon peter answered him, lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
target_text: te ngaa simon petrus dhaa, peka na, ama! ji'i patai-patapa mi cee hari? abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa lole dènge ji'i, j'ara tasamia ji'i bisa abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. dhoka èu mesa mu di!

source_text: and we have believed and know that thou art the holy one of god.
target_text: aa ji'i lèka ama. lula ji'i dhu nge'a le, na, èu ne, nuka dhèu mola-mèci nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: jesus answered them, did not i choose you the twelve, and one of you is a devil?
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ja'a hag'e kore le miu dhèu canguru dua. te ngaa sanèd'e! nèti miu se'e, abhu ca dhèu nuka sèmi nidhu!

source_text: now he spake of judas the son of simon iscariot, for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
target_text: dhu na peka ne, nuka yudas, ana simon iskariot. yudas ne, ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra. nèngu ne'e ka dhu èèna na pahie yesus.

source_text: and after these things jesus walked in galilee: for he would not walk in judæa, because the jews sought to kill him.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yesus si kako palème propensi galilea. nèngu neo boe kako palème propensi yudea, lula abhu ama-ama dhèu yahudi dhu neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: now the feast of the jews, the feast of tabernacles, was at hand.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dètu le dènge lod'o kalela puu-g'ètu dhu ra peka na, kalela paleo.

source_text: his brethren therefore said unto him, depart hence, and go into judæa, that thy disciples also may behold thy works which thou doest.
target_text: ka ari yesus sèra peka dènge ne, aku rèngu na, be'a risi, èu pakeso nèti ne'e, lamu asa yudea. sèna ka dhèu dhu madhutu èu ètu nèi, bisa ladhe rèdhi j'ara-j'ara dhu èu tao.

source_text: for no man doeth anything in secret, and himself seeketh to be known openly. if thou doest these things, manifest thyself to the world.
target_text: te ladhe cee dhu neo sèna ka dhèu ae rèdhi kolo-karisi nèngu, na, nèngu baku tao pahuni-pahuni. lula èu dhu tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa, be'a risi hari, ladhe dhèu ae-ae bisa ladhe rèdhi ngaa dhu èu tao sèra!

source_text: for even his brethren did not believe on him.
target_text: ari na sèra peka sèmi èèna, lula rèngu dhu lèka nèngu èra iia boe.

source_text: jesus therefore saith unto them, my time is not yet come; but your time is always ready.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. lod'o ja'a dhae d'ai mèka. te ngaa ladhe miu neo lami, sad'i lake mere.

source_text: the world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because i testify of it, that its works are evil.
target_text: dhèu ètu rai-haha ne tèka boe d'ara dènge miu. te ngaa rèngu tèka d'ara dènge ja'a, lula ja'a bhoke patalele aa'i tatao rèngu. te d'ara ra bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: go ye up unto the feast: i go not up unto this feast; because my time is not yet fulfilled.
target_text: lod'o kalela agama èdhi dètu le. de miu ka laa lami asa yerusalem. ja'a neo mèka laku, te dhae d'ai mèka lod'o.

source_text: and having said these things unto them, he abode still in galilee.
target_text: na peka nare, hèia na pea ètu propensi galilea.

source_text: but when his brethren were gone up unto the feast, then went he also up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ari na si lasi madhutu kalela agama dhèu yahudi ètu yerusalem, yesus madhutu kahèi. te ngaa la'e pahuni-pahuni, sèna ka dhèu baku rèdhi ne.

source_text: the jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, where is he?
target_text: ètu yerusalem, lod'o kalela agama dhèu yahudi, ama-ama dhèu yahudi patangi-tenge yesus. ra pakarèi, aku rèngu na, dhèu èèna, ètu mia?

source_text: and there was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him: some said, he is a good man; others said, not so, but he leadeth the multitude astray.
target_text: dhèu ae dhu paka'uu lula-nèti nèngu. cahag'e peka na, nèngu ne, dhèu be'a. cahag'e hari peka na, aad'o! nèngu ne dhu kapod'e-kabèli dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: yet no man spake openly of him for fear of the jews.
target_text: te ngaa abhu boe dhu pacèu lii padhai lula-nèti yesus, te rèngu madha'u dènge ama-ama se.

source_text: but when it was now the midst of the feast jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
target_text: pas ètu talora kalela ne, yesus maso la'e asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka na aj'a dhèu ètu era èèna.

source_text: the jews therefore marvelled, saying, how knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
target_text: hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi malaa, ka ra peka na, dhèu ne sakola nèdhi boe sèmi èdhi. te ngaa tasamia ka ne'a aa'i mèu j'ara se'e?

source_text: jesus therefore answered them, and said, my teaching is not mine, but his that sent me.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, nanene. j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a lole, kapua boe nèti ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa nèti nèngu dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: if any man willeth to do his will, he shall know of the teaching, whether it is of god, or whether i speak from myself.
target_text: dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a neo madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, nèngu èèna na ne'a mèu, a'aj'a ja'a ne, tare'a-re'a mai nèti ama lamatua, do nèti dhoka ja'a mesa ku.

source_text: he that speaketh from himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh the glory of him that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
target_text: te dhèu dhu padhai lii pake mamèu unu na, nèngu tenge dhoka kolongara di. te ngaa dhèu dhu neo ded'e kolongara nèti dhèu dhu pua-paleha na, tatu lii padhai lèke mola-mola. aa lii padhai nèngu koe-kapengo boe.

source_text: did not moses give you the law, and yet none of you doeth the law? why seek ye to kill me?
target_text: musa pangèd'u le miu atora ama lamatua. te ngaa miu mo'o boe tao madhutu. de tasamia ka miu tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ja'a?

source_text: the multitude answered, thou hast a demon: who seeketh to kill thee?
target_text: hèia dhèu ae se karèi, peka na, èu peka ngaa, ne? ele boe nidhu tao èu, do? cee ka dhu tenge j'ara neo pamadhe èu?

source_text: jesus answered and said unto them, i did one work, and ye all marvel because thereof.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e ka. ja'a heka tao tadha malaa èci ètu lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, te ngaa miu aa'i-aa'i mi kacèki le.

source_text: moses hath given you circumcision not that it is of moses, but of the fathers; and on the sabbath ye circumcise a man.
target_text: te ngaa ca tèka-tèka, miu sab'a kahèi ètu d'ara lod'o sabaj'a, nuka sèmi: musa hia le atora suna, dhu peka na, ladhe dhèu rara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, na, ètu d'ara lod'o ka aru, miu hud'i suna ku ana ne. masi ka lod'o ne, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a, miu hud'i suna ku nèngu. te ngaa madhutu mola-mola na, atora ne uru tèka nèti musa. te ama lamatua dhu hia uru le atora ne mi abraham.

source_text: if a man receiveth circumcision on the sabbath, that the law of moses may not be broken; are ye wroth with me, because i made a man every whit whole on the sabbath?
target_text: de ladhe suna ana iiki èci lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a sisu boe atora musa, nga tao ka miu nasa dènge ja'a, lula ja'a puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a? maso boe d'ara ngangee, sina ma! ?

source_text: judge not according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
target_text: baku pasale dhèu lula j'ara-j'ara dhu miu mèdhi dènge musi madha di. dadoo uuru ku dènge d'ara be'a, heka pama'ète dhu lèke.

source_text: some therefore of them of jerusalem said, is not this he whom they seek to kill?
target_text: hèia pèri-pèri dhèu nèti kota yerusalem pakarèi, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu ra patangi-tenge ho neo pamadhe ne, do?

source_text: and lo, he speaketh openly, and they say nothing unto him. can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is the christ?
target_text: ladhe ku laa! na padhai lii pahuni boe ètu madha dhèu ae-ae. te ngaa abhu boe dhu kai ne ho hutu hèb'a na. madhutu miu, tasamia? ele boe dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa sèra re'a le, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, nuka kristus, dhu lamatua pajaji tèke ho neo pua mai èèna, si?

source_text: howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when the christ cometh, no one knoweth whence he is.
target_text: te ngaa j'aj'i mi lii langu, sèmi ne'e: ladhe lamatua pua ka kristus mai, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re'a nèngu nèti mia. te ngaa èdhi te'a le dhèu ne nèti mia.

source_text: jesus therefore cried in the temple, teaching and saying, ye both know me, and know whence i am; and i am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus aj'a dhèu era ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa tadèngi dhèu se peka sèmi èèna, hèia na karèi si dènge lii mèdhu, aku nèngu na, miu pangee, na, miu se tadhe ja'a, aa me'a mèu ja'a mai nèti mia, do? ja'a ne, mai boe asa ne'e madhutu dad'èi ja'a mesa ku. te dhu pua ja'a èèna, abhu tare'a-re'a. aa miu tadhe boe nèngu.

source_text: i know him; because i am from him, and he sent me.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a tadhe ne, lula ja'a mai nèti nèngu, aa nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: they sought therefore to take him: and no man laid his hand on him, because his hour was not yet come.
target_text: ka dhèu se'e neo kèpe ne. te ngaa abhu boe dhu bisa kèpe ne, te d'ai mèka lod'o na.

source_text: but of the multitude many believed on him; and they said, when the christ shall come, will he do more signs than those which this man hath done?
target_text: nèti dhèu ae-ae dhu ètu èèna, abhu ae kahèi dhu parcaya ne. dhèu se padhai lii, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne tao tadha malaa ae le. pe bèli-camèd'a, ladhe kristus mai, tatu boe na tao tadha malaa risi nèti dhèu ne'e, si?

source_text: the pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him; and the chief priests and the pharisees sent officers to take him.
target_text: ètu talora aae dhèu ae se, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi kahèi. rèngu tadèngi dhèu ae se pakanucu j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti yesus. hèia, dhèu se, dènge kètu agama yahudi se pua pèri-pèri dhèu j'aga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i sèna ka lasi kèpe yesus.

source_text: jesus therefore said, yet a little while am i with you, and i go unto him that sent me.
target_text: ka yesus peka, na, lod'o ja'a pa'èci dènge miu di ciki oo'e ka, nare heka nèbhu. te nèbhu heka, ja'a laku hari asa nèngu dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where i am, ye cannot come.
target_text: pe èèna na, miu tenge ja'a, te ngaa mèdhi boe ja'a. te ja'a neo laku asa era èci dhu miu bisa boe madhutu.

source_text: the jews therefore said among themselves, whither will this man go that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersion among the greeks, and teach the greeks?
target_text: ka ama-ama dhèu yahudi se pakarèi iisi-aanga ra, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne neo la'e mia? la'e asa era mia, dhu èdhi bisa boe paraga dènge ne? nèngu la'e lu'u asa dhèu yahudi dhu bali ètu rai kaj'èu, do? neo la'e aj'a-nori dhèu-dhèu dhu pake lii yunani ètu nèi, do? do, tasamia?

source_text: what is this word that he said, ye shall seek me, and shall not find me; and where i am, ye cannot come?
target_text: a'abhu na tasamia, ka na peka, na, ‘miu neo tenge ja'a, te ngaa paraga boe. ' aa, ‘ja'a laku asa era èci dhu miu bisa boe madhutu. '?

source_text: now on the last day, the great day of the feast, jesus stood and cried, saying, if any man thirst, let him come unto me and drink.
target_text: d'ai lod'o oe èle kalela, dhu j'aj'i lod'o kapai risi èèna, hèia yesus kèd'i titu, ka na rodhe, peka na, nanene, ee! cee ka dhu koko-kamango, na, hud'i laa na mai asa ja'a ho ninu!

source_text: he that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, from within him shall flow rivers of living water.
target_text: cee dhu parcaya ja'a, na, mai sèna ka minu! te ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘èi dhu nèti mamuri, èèna na hae mai nèti d'ara dhèu-dhèu parcaya. ' ka rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu bisa soru-bara dhèu leo, sèna ka ra abhu mamuri dhu lèke kahèi.

source_text: but this spake he of the spirit, which they that believed on him were to receive: for the spirit was not yet given; because jesus was not yet glorified.
target_text: yesus padhai lii lula-nèti roh ama lamatua, lula dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus abhu roh èèna. te ngaa lod'o yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, rèngu dhae sèmi rare mèka roh èèna, lula ama lamatua dhae hia mèka. ama lamatua mema hia mèka, lula na ded'e mèka padedha-dedha yesus.

source_text: some of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, this is of a truth the prophet.
target_text: dhèu ae-ae ètu sèra nanene lii padhai yesus ne. hèia abhu dhu peka, na, tatu dhèu ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu na padhadha mema karèi nèti uru ka!

source_text: others said, this is the christ. but some said, what, doth the christ come out of galilee?
target_text: abhu cahag'e dhu peka na, aad'o! nèngu ne, nuka kristus dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka mai! te ngaa cahag'e hari pab'ala, peka na, bisa boe! te kristus èèna, dhèu galilea boe. tare'a, si?

source_text: hath not the scripture said that the christ cometh of the seed of david, and from bethlehem, the village where david was?
target_text: te sasuri ama lamatua suri, na, kristus èèna, ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud. ètu d'ara sasuri leo kahèi dhu suri, peka na, nèngu ne, dhèu betlehem, rae dhèu aae daud. sèmi èèna ka, si?

source_text: so there arose a division in the multitude because of him.
target_text: ka dhèu se mulai pahag'a lula yesus.

source_text: and some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu neo kèpe ne, te ngaa ca dhèu sa goi boe ne.

source_text: the officers therefore came to the chief priests and pharisees; and they said unto them, why did ye not bring him?
target_text: èle ka, dhèu-dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhu mai neo kèpe yesus, lèpa asa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu parisi sèra. hèia dhèu kapai se karèi, aku rèngu na, nga tao ka miu mèti boe ne mai?

source_text: the officers answered, never man so spake.
target_text: hèia dhèu se dhaa, na, ira ii! ji'i dhae paraga ngèdhi mèka dènge dhèu èci sa dhu padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu nèi!

source_text: the pharisees therefore answered them, are ye also led astray?
target_text: ka dhèu parisi se karèi, aku rèngu na, heh! miu se lèke le tipu, si?

source_text: hath any of the rulers believed on him, or of the pharisees?
target_text: sanèd'e! te nèti ji'i dhèu-dhèu parisi, do, ama-ama abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu lèka ne. tare'a, si? ladhe dhèu kapai parcaya boe, na, tasamia ka miu se lèka nèngu?

source_text: but this multitude that knoweth not the law are accursed.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae dhu neo parcaya ne, re'a boe atora ama lamatua. bèli-camèd'a rèngu dui rare huku dhu bia nèti ama lamatua!

source_text: nicodemus saith unto them he that came to him before, being one of them,
target_text: te ngaa ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu parisi ca dhèu, ngara na nikodemus. nèngu ne'e ka dhu la'e asa yesus re mèda, ho padhai lii dènge ne. ka na karèi dhèu se'e, peka na,

source_text: doth our law judge a man, except it first hear from himself and know what he doeth?
target_text: tasamia? madhutu atora agama, èdhi pama'ète uru ku lii langu dhèu, do? do, èdhi hud'i nanene uuru ku lii lolo na, sèna ka te'a mèu dhèu ne tao ngaa, heka pama'ète lii langu na kèna?

source_text: they answered and said unto him, art thou also of galilee? search, and see that out of galilee ariseth no prophet.
target_text: hèia ra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, èu ne, dhèu galilea èci èèna ka dènge nèngu, do? parisa paie-iie uuru ku sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua! baca paie-iie sèna ka me'a mèu, na, abhu boe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti galilea!

source_text: and they went every man unto his own house:
target_text: ka ra pacèri, èci-èci lèpa asa èmu ra.

source_text: but jesus went unto the mount of olives.
target_text: te ngaa yesus la'e asa ledhe saitun.

source_text: and early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, nèngu la'e asa madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. dhèu ae mai pakaboko ètu madha nèngu. ka na madhèdi aj'a-nori si.

source_text: and the scribes and the pharisees bring a woman taken in adultery; and having set her in the midst,
target_text: lod'o èèna, kèpe rare bhèni ca dhèu dhu talora na ad'u-ue j'ara makae. ka pèri-pèri mese agama dènge dhèu parisi ère rèti bhèni ne asa yesus. hèia ra laka-seti bhèni ne titu ètu madha rèngu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: they say unto him, teacher, this woman hath been taken in adultery, in the very act.
target_text: ka ra peka dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese. kèpe ngare bhèni ne dhu talora nèngu dhu ad'u-ue j'ara makae.

source_text: now in the law moses commanded us to stone such: what then sayest thou of her?
target_text: ètu d'ara atora musa, abhu paredha èci dhu peka na, ‘dhèu dhu ad'u-ue j'ara makae dènge dhèu èmu na boe, hud'i abhu hahuku pèci toke madhe. ' de madhutu ama mese, na, tasamia?

source_text: and this they said, trying him, that they might have whereof to accuse him. but jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.
target_text: dhèu se sèku ne, sèna ka abhu j'ara ho pèci sasala asa yesus ho pamanahu ne. yesus lii boe, te ngaa madhèdi pasaboti suri rai, pake suu kolo ai na.

source_text: but when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, he that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
target_text: dhèu se loe boe karèi nèngu. hèia na titu, ka padhai lii, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe nèti miu abhu dhu tao mèdhi mèka sasala, na, nèngu ka dhu bisa pèci uuru ku, sèna ka huku bhèni ne'e.

source_text: and again he stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.
target_text: ka na madhèdi pasaboti hari, hèia suri hari rai.

source_text: and they, when they heard it, went out one by one, beginning from the eldest, even unto the last: and jesus was left alone, and the woman, where she was, in the midst.
target_text: ropa dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai na, rèngu j'aj'i makae. lula rèngu re'a ètu d'ara ra, rèngu ad'u-ue sasala kahèi. ka lasi ka èci-èci, mulai nèti dhèu heka toke d'ai ana ngèru, tèke eele dhodhoka yesus dènge bhèni ne ètu era èèna.

source_text: and jesus lifted up himself, and said unto her, woman, where are they? did no man condemn thee?
target_text: hèia yesus titu hari, ka na karèi, eea! mia lasi? abhu heka ca dhèu sa ètu ne'e ho pèci sasala mi èu, do?

source_text: and she said, no man, lord. and jesus said, neither do i condemn thee: go thy way; from henceforth sin no more.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o, ama. ka yesus lii dènge dhèu ne, peka na, ja'a neo boe huku èu kahèi. lèpa ka, te ngaa sanèd'e. tao ia ka sasala!

source_text: again therefore jesus spake unto them, saying, i am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in the darkness, but shall have the light of life.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai dènge dhèu ae se, peka na, ja'a ne, nuka sèmi saraa hia dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a mamuri boe ètu d'ara maroga, te ngaa na pea ètu d'ara saraa dhu nèti mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: the pharisees therefore said unto him, thou bearest witness of thyself; thy witness is not true.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dhu pab'ala, peka na, weh! èu mesa mu neo j'aj'i sakasii nèti ngi'u èu unu mu, do? bisa boe sèmi èèna! te madhutu atora èdhi, hud'i dhèu leo ku dhu j'aj'i sakasii hia dhèu èci, bisa boe nèngu unu na. de ji'i ngo'o boe sèmi, aa ngo'o boe parcaya.

source_text: jesus answered and said unto them, even if i bear witness of myself, my witness is true; for i know whence i came, and whither i go; but ye know not whence i come, or whither i go.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e. hud'i laa ja'a j'aj'i sakasii mi ngi'u ja'a mesa ku, te lii padhai ja'a ne, lèke. lula ja'a mesa ku ke'a mola-mola ja'a ne mai nèti mia, aa neo laku asa mia. miu me'a boe ja'a mai nèti mia, aa me'a boe neo laku asa mia kahèi.

source_text: ye judge after the flesh; i judge no man.
target_text: miu nile dhèu madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ja'a madhutu boe a'abhu dhèu rai-haha ho nile dhèu èci sa.

source_text: yea and if i judge, my judgment is true; for i am not alone, but i and the father that sent me.
target_text: ladhe ja'a nile dhèu, a'uku dhu ja'a pake, lèke mola-mola. te ja'a mesa ku boe dhu nile dhèu, te ngaa ja'a tao aa'i-aa'i sama-sama dènge ama ku dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: yea and in your law it is written, that the witness of two men is true.
target_text: baku bhèlu. te dhu suri tèke ètu atora agama miu, peka na, ‘ladhe abhu dhèu dua j'aj'i sakasii dhu padhue j'ara dhu sama, èèna lèke tare'a. '

source_text: i am he that beareth witness of myself, and the father that sent me beareth witness of me.
target_text: de ja'a mesa ku boe dhu j'aj'i sakasii mi ngi'u ja'a unu ku. te ama ku dhu pua ja'a, j'aj'i sakasii kahèi dhu padhai lii lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: they said therefore unto him, where is thy father? jesus answered, ye know neither me, nor my father: if ye knew me, ye would know my father also.
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi, aku rèngu na, te ama èu èèna, ètu mia? ka yesus b'ala, peka na, miu se tadhe iie boe ja'a. miu tadhe boe kahèi ama ku. te ladhe miu tadhe iie ja'a, tatu miu tadhe ne kahèi.

source_text: these words spake he in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man took him; because his hour was not yet come.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, yesus peka-padhai lod'o nèngu aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, padètu dènge era rèngu kaboko doi kolete. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kèpe ne, lula d'ai mèka lod'o na.

source_text: he said therefore again unto them, i go away, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sin: whither i go, ye cannot come.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, bèli-camèd'a ja'a tèke eele miu, ho laku asa era leo. miu èèna na patangi-tenge ja'a, te ngaa mèdhi boe, te miu dhu dènge boe hak sèna ka lami asa era èèna. aa ladhe miu madhe, miu pasae sasala miu era.

source_text: the jews therefore said, will he kill himself, that he saith, whither i go, ye cannot come?
target_text: hèia ama dhèu yahudi sèra pakarèi iisi-aanga ra, peka na, na padhai lii ngaa, nèi? neo pamadhe iisi na, do? te na peka, na, ‘miu bisa boe lami asa era èèna. '

source_text: and he said unto them, ye are from beneath; i am from above: ye are of this world; i am not of this world.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, miu nèti rai-haha. te ngaa ja'a mai nèti dedha-liru. miu dhèu nèti rai-haha ne, te ngaa ja'a nèti boe rai-haha ne.

source_text: i said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for except ye believe that i am he, ye shall die in your sins.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a peka dènge miu, na, bèli-camèd'a ladhe miu madhe, miu pasae sasala-sasigo miu era. de ladhe miu parcaya boe, na, ja'a ne, kristus, dhu ama lamatua pua mai, ladhe miu madhe, tatu miu pasae sasala miu era.

source_text: they said therefore unto him, who art thou? jesus said unto them, even that which i have also spoken unto you from the beginning.
target_text: ka ra karèi, peka na, weeh! te èu ne, cee? yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu peka mema karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: i have many things to speak and to judge concerning you: howbeit he that sent me is true; and the things which i heard from him, these speak i unto the world.
target_text: abhu j'ara ae dhu ja'a bisa peka lula-nèti miu. sasala miu ae kahèi. te ngaa ja'a pad'elo boe j'ara sèra. te dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, ladhe na padhai lii, ne'a dhoka peka dhu mola di. aa ja'a peka dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tadèngi nèti nèngu di.

source_text: they perceived not that he spake to them of the father.
target_text: dhu nèngu padhue-padhai, nuka ama na ètu sorga. te ngaa dhèu se re'a rare boe sasoa lii padhai na.

source_text: jesus therefore said, when ye have lifted up the son of man, then shall ye know that i am he, and that i do nothing of myself, but as the father taught me, i speak these things.
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, pe ladhe miu ded'e ka ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, heka miu me'a kèna, na, ja'a ne, kristus. aa ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa madhutu dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa ja'a aj'a-nori dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu ama ètu sorga aj'a-nori le ja'a.

source_text: and he that sent me is with me; he hath not left me alone; for i do always the things that are pleasing to him.
target_text: dhu pua-paleha ja'a bera-bera dènge ja'a taruu. nèngu tèke eele nèdhi boe ja'a mesa-mesa ku, lula ja'a loe boe sab'a madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: as he spake these things, many believed on him.
target_text: ropa yesus peka j'ara se'e, dhèu ae parcaya nèngu.

source_text: jesus therefore said to those jews that had believed him, if ye abide in my word, then are ye truly my disciples;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu yahudi dhu parcaya nèngu, na, ladhe miu mamuri pa'èki taruu dènge lii holo-nori ja'a, aa aj'a taruu nèti ja'a, na, miu bisa j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a dhu lèke.

source_text: and ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
target_text: miu bisa me'a mèu j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke. dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke sèra ka dhu patabuli miu, sèna ka miu j'aj'i ia ka ènu.

source_text: they answered unto him, we are abraham's seed, and have never yet been in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, ye shall be made free?
target_text: ka dhèu se pab'ala, aku rèngu na, hee! ji'i se, j'aj'i boe ènu dhèu! te ji'i se, ana-èpu abraham! de, nga tao ka èu peka, na, èèna na ji'i bebas?

source_text: jesus answered them, verily, verily, i say unto you, every one that committeth sin is the bondservant of sin.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke. te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu d'ara sasala, j'aj'i sama sèmi ènu dhu dhoka madhutu dad'èi sasala di.

source_text: and the bondservant abideth not in the house for ever: the son abideth for ever.
target_text: te ngaa dhu tema, sèmi ne'e: ènu se abhu boe pala nèti lamatua èmu na. te dhoka ana lamatua èmu di dhu abhu pala taruu ètu èèna.

source_text: if therefore the son shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
target_text: de ja'a, nuka ana ama lamatua ne, ladhe saku eele sasala-sasigo miu, na, miu bebas, aa j'aj'i heka ènu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo. dènge j'ara ne, miu madhutu heka dad'èi sasala, aa tare'a-re'a bebas!

source_text: i know that ye are abraham's seed; yet ye seek to kill me, because my word hath not free course in you.
target_text: ja'a ke'a le miu se, ana-èpu abraham. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu loe boe patangi-tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ja'a, lula mo'o boe sèmi mere a'aj'a ja'a. te ètu d'ara miu, abhu heka era tatèka lii holo-nori ja'a.

source_text: i speak the things which i have seen with my father: and ye also do the things which ye heard from your father.
target_text: ja'a peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a kèdhi le, dhu ama ku paj'uj'u le dènge ja'a. aa miu tao madhutu j'ara-j'ara dhu miu tadèngi le nèti ama-ama miu.

source_text: they answered and said unto him, our father is abraham. jesus saith unto them, if ye were abraham's children, ye would do the works of abraham.
target_text: dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ji'i se, ana-èpu abraham! ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu j'aj'i tare'a-re'a ana-èpu abraham, miu hud'i madhutu j'ara mamuri nèngu.

source_text: but now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which i heard from god: this did not abraham.
target_text: te ngaa abraham tao boe bhabhelu sama sèmi dhu miu tao! te miu loe boe tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ja'a. aa te ngaa ja'a ne, dhu peka dènge miu j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, dhu ja'a tadèngi nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: ye do the works of your father. they said unto him, we were not born of fornication; we have one father, even god.
target_text: tatao miu se mema beda boe nèti tatao ama miu. te ngaa rèngu pab'ala, aku rèngu na, heh! ji'i se, ana d'èlu! baku peka na ji'i se, ana ama aad'o! te ama ji'i, èci di, nuka ama lamatua!

source_text: jesus said unto them, if god were your father, ye would love me: for i came forth and am come from god; for neither have i come of myself, but he sent me.
target_text: hèia, aku yesus na, ladhe ama lamatua tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ama miu, tatu miu sue ja'a. te ja'a mai nèti nèngu, nèti èèna ka ja'a ka ne'e ne. ja'a mai ne madhutu boe dad'èi ja'a mesa ku. te ngaa ja'a mai, lula nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
target_text: nga tao ka miu dhane mere boe lii padhai ja'a? ele boe, lula miu mema mo'o boe nanene!

source_text: ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father it is your will to do. he was a murderer from the beginning, and standeth not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. when he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father thereof.
target_text: miu se, ca ropa dènge dhèu aae nidhu. te miu d'èi madhutu dad'èi na! karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, nèngu d'èi dhoka pamadhe dhèu. nèngu lab'a j'ara dhu lèke, lula na tule eele j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke! ladhe na kapod'e-kabèli, mema sasab'a na kèna. te nèngu ne, tuka kapod'e-kabèli, aa baki nèti leko-monya!

source_text: but because i say the truth, ye believe me not.
target_text: ja'a ne'e ka dhu lole j'ara dhu lèke. te ngaa miu parcaya boe ja'a.

source_text: which of you convicteth me of sin? if i say truth, why do ye not believe me?
target_text: pangee sèku! nèti miu se, cee ka dhu bisa pad'elo bukti, peka na, ja'a ne ad'u-ue sasala? malaa, nga! ladhe ja'a peka lèke, nga tao ka miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a?

source_text: he that is of god heareth the words of god: for this cause ye hear them not, because ye are not of god.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i nèti ama lamatua nanene lii holo-nori na. te ngaa miu se j'aj'i boe nèti ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka miu mo'o boe nanene ja'a.

source_text: the jews answered and said unto him, say we not well that thou art a samaritan, and hast a demon?
target_text: ama-ama dhèu yahudi b'ala, peka na, lii padhai ji'i lèke tare'a-re'a. te ji'i dhu peka le, na, èu ne, dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa dhèu samaria. èu ne nidhu tao!

source_text: jesus answered, i have not a demon; but i honor my father, and ye dishonor me.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a nidhu tao boe. ja'a pakab'ua ama ku ètu sorga, te ngaa miu mo'o boe pakab'ua ja'a.

source_text: but i seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
target_text: ja'a padedha boe iisi ho pad'elo kolo-karisi ja'a. te ngaa abhu èci dhu neo pad'elo dadedha ja'a. hud'i laa nèngu ka dhu pama'ète, na, lii padhai ja'a ne lèke, do aad'o.

source_text: verily, verily, i say unto you, if a man keep my word, he shall never see death.
target_text: lii holo-nori ja'a, lèke tare'a. de dhèu dhu nanene aa tao madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, madhe boe.

source_text: the jews said unto him, now we know that thou hast a demon. abraham died, and the prophets; and thou sayest, if a man keep my word, he shall never taste of death.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii ne, hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se peka dènge ne, aku rèngu na, limuri ne ji'i nge'a le èu dhèu huj'u, lula nidhu tao le èu. te abraham, madhe. dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra, madhe le kahèi. te ngaa aku èu, na, ‘dhèu dhu nanene dènge madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, madhe boe. ' mema èu ne tare'a-re'a huj'u le!

source_text: art thou greater than our father abraham, who died? and the prophets died: whom makest thou thyself?
target_text: do, èu ne pangee, na, èu ne kapai risi nèti abraham dhu madhe le? do, èu kapai risi nèti dhèu-dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu madhe sèra? èu ngee, na, èu ne, cee?

source_text: jesus answered, if i glorify myself, my glory is nothing: it is my father that glorifieth me; of whom ye say, that he is your god;
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ladhe ja'a ka dhu padedha iisi, dhèu ro'o boe sèmi rare. madhutu iia-iia, na, ja'a boe ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha iisi, te ngaa dhu ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha nuka ama ku. nèngu ne'e ka dhu miu mangaku, na, nèngu j'aj'i ama lamatua miu.

source_text: and ye have not known him: but i know him; and if i should say, i know him not, i shall be like unto you, a liar: but i know him, and keep his word.
target_text: te ngaa miu tadhe boe ne. dhu tadhe mèu ka ja'a ne. ladhe ja'a peka na ja'a tadhe boe ne, ja'a leko-monya, sama sèmi miu. te ngaa ja'a tadhe mèu ne, aa ja'a tao madhutu lii holo-nori na kahèi.

source_text: your father abraham rejoiced to see my day; and he saw it, and was glad.
target_text: d'ara baki miu abraham karej'e titu kèna, lod'o na tatae neo nèdhi mamai ja'a. nèngu mema nèdhi le, ka na karej'e-karae.

source_text: the jews therefore said unto him, thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen abraham?
target_text: ama-ama dhèu yahudi se b'ala ne, aku rèngu na, umur èu dhae d'ai mèka lèmi nguru tèu sa hèi! te ngaa èu peka na, mèdhi le abraham. tare'a, do?

source_text: jesus said unto them, verily, verily, i say unto you, before abraham was born, i am.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a! te dhae rara iisi mèka abraham, ja'a dhu mema-mema le.

source_text: they took up stones therefore to cast at him: but jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple.
target_text: ka dhèu se rare hadhu ho neo pèci ne, lula na tao iisi sama sèmi ama lamatua. te ngaa yesus kako mau-mau kalua nèti madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and as he passed by, he saw a man blind from his birth.
target_text: hèia yesus si kako taruu. ka na ladhe nèdhi dhèu bèdhu ca dhèu, dhu bèdhu karèi nèti ina na nara iisi nèngu.

source_text: and his disciples asked him, saying, rabbi, who sinned, this man, or his parents, that he should be born blind?
target_text: hèia ana-ana madhutu na karèi, aku rèngu na, ama mese! cee ka tao sasala, ka dhèu ne bèdhu? nèti nèngu mesa na, do, nèti ina-ama na?

source_text: jesus answered, neither did this man sin, nor his parents: but that the works of god should be made manifest in him.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, dhèu bèdhu ne tao boe sala. aa ina-ama na aad'o kahèi. rara iisi na sèmi ne'e, ho hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ladhe rèdhi tatao ama lamatua dhu be'a mi dedha nèngu.

source_text: we must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a. de èdhi hud'i tenge j'ara, sèna ka pakako sasab'a na, lod'o saraa era. te ladhe maroga mai, dhèu bisa heka sab'a.

source_text: when i am in the world, i am the light of the world.
target_text: ropa ja'a ètu rai-haha ne era, ja'a nuka sèmi saraa dhu d'elo hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: when he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and anointed his eyes with the clay,
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, ka na paru'e ilu mi rai. hèia na madhèdi pasaboti, ho pakihu rai ne j'aj'i kabheca. ka na lame musi madha dhèu ne dènge kabheca deo na.

source_text: and said unto him, go, wash in the pool of siloam which is by interpretation, sent. he went away therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
target_text: hèia na peka, na, lamu asa kolam siloam, sèna ka riu rèhu èu. ètu d'ara lii ibrani, siloam, sasoa na, ‘nèti mai'. ka dhèu bèdhu ne la'e, ka riu rèhu na. ropa na lèpa hari mai, nèngu bisa nèdhi le!

source_text: the neighbors therefore, and they that saw him aforetime, that he was a beggar, said, is not this he that sat and begged?
target_text: hèia rae lesa dènge dhèu dhu rèdhi ne, dhu tema manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu, ra pakarèi èci dènge èci, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, dhèu bèdhu dhu tema madhèdi ho kanata ai manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu, sina ma?

source_text: others said, it is he: others said, no, but he is like him. he said, i am he.
target_text: dhèu cahag'e dhaa, peka na, oo! nèngu ka! dhèu cahag'e hari, peka na, aad'o! nèngu ne, rèhu na oe sèmi dhèu èèna! te ngaa dhèu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o! ja'a èèna ka, ne'e ne! dhu uru èèna bèdhu!

source_text: they said therefore unto him, how then were thine eyes opened?
target_text: ka dhèu se karèi ne, peka na, tasamia ka èu bisa ladhe mèdhi?

source_text: he answered, the man that is called jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, go to siloam, and wash: so i went away and washed, and i received sight.
target_text: hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! dhèu dhu ngara yesus èèna, pakihu kabheca ka lame mi musi madha ja'a. ka na pua ja'a, aku nèngu na, ‘lamu asa kolam siloam, ho riu rèhu èu ètu nèi. ' hèia ja'a tao madhutu sèmi èèna. nèti èèna ka, ja'a bisa ladhe kèdhi le!

source_text: and they said unto him, where is he? he saith, i know not.
target_text: èle ka dhèu se karèi ne, peka na, dhèu èèna, ètu mia? ka na dhaa, ke'a boe, mia la'e!

source_text: they bring to the pharisees him that aforetime was blind. now it was the sabbath on the day when jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ropa yesus pakihu rai j'aj'i kabheca, ka puri-pa'èle dhèu bèdhu ho bisa ladhe nèdhi èèna, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi. ka lere rèti dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu, asa madha dhèu-dhèu partei agama parisi.

source_text: again therefore the pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. and he said unto them, he put clay upon mine eyes, and i washed, and i see.
target_text: ka dhèu parisi se karèi ne, èu lolo ku laa! tasamia ka èu bisa ladhe mèdhi? dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e. dhèu èèna tao kabheca mi musi madha ja'a. ka laku riu rèhu. hèia limuri ne, ja'a bisa kèdhi le.

source_text: some therefore of the pharisees said, this man is not from god, because he keepeth not the sabbath. but others said, how can a man that is a sinner do such signs? and there was a division among them.
target_text: ka abhu dhèu parisi cahag'e, peka na, dhèu dhu puri-pa'èle èu èèna, mai boe nèti ama lamatua. ji'i nge'a, lula nèngu sisu atora nèti lod'o a'ae sasab'a. aa abhu cahag'e hari, peka na, tasamia ka dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala bisa tao tadha-tadha malaa sèmi sèra? ka rèngu patao-palaha èci dènge èci toke ra pahag'a.

source_text: they say therefore unto the blind man again, what sayest thou of him, in that he opened thine eyes? and he said, he is a prophet.
target_text: hèia ra karèi hari dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu, aku rèngu na, madhutu a'abhu èu, dhèu dhu puri-pabe'a musi madha èu ne, dhèu sèmi ngaa sa? dhèu ne b'ala, peka na, madhutu a'abhu ja'a, dhèu èèna ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: the jews therefore did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight,
target_text: te ngaa ama-ama dhèu yahudi se ro'o boe lèka, na, dhèu ne uru èèna bèdhu, ka limuri ne bisa nèdhi le. hèia ra pua dhèu lasi paroa ina-ama na mai.

source_text: and asked them, saying, is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
target_text: ropa ina-ama na mai d'ai madha si, hèia ama-ama se karèi, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne, ana miu, do? tare'a, do aad'o, nèngu ne dhu bèdhu mema karèi nèti mera iisi ne? tasamia ka limuri ne nèngu bisa ladhe nèdhi?

source_text: his parents answered and said, we know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
target_text: ka ina-ama dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu ne, mema ana ji'i. aa na bèdhu karèi nèti ngara iisi ne.

source_text: but how he now seeth, we know not; or who opened his eyes, we know not: ask him; he is of age; he shall speak for himself.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i nge'a boe, na pake ngaa ka musi madha na bisa nèdhi sèmi ne'e. cee ka dhu puri-pa'èle musi madha na, ji'i nge'a boe kahèi. nèngu kapai le, de karèi ne, te nèngu bisa lolo unu na!

source_text: these things said his parents, because they feared the jews: for the jews had agreed already, that if any man should confess him to be christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
target_text: dua ra padhai lii sèmi èèna, lula rèngu madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. lula re'a, na, ama-ama dhèu yahudi se dhu rare le lii èci, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu mangaku, na, yesus ne, nuka kristus, na, babège eele dhèu sèra nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a èdhi dhèu yahudi.

source_text: therefore said his parents, he is of age; ask him.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ina-ama dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu kapai le. de karèi ne.

source_text: so they called a second time the man that was blind, and said unto him, give glory to god: we know that this man is a sinner.
target_text: hèia ra paroa hari dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu. ka ra karèi ne, sèmi ne'e! èu hud'i peka ku mola-mola ètu madha ama lamatua, sèna ka j'aga paie kolongara na. te ji'i nge'a, na, yesus ne, dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: he therefore answered, whether he is a sinner, i know not: one thing i know, that, whereas i was blind, now i see.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, ama si baku nasa! te ja'a ke'a boe, na, nèngu èèna, dhèu bhelu, do aad'o. dhu ja'a ke'a mola-mola, nuka, uru èèna ja'a bèdhu, te ngaa limuri ne ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: they said therefore unto him, what did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, te na tao èu tasamia? tasamia na bhoke musi madha èu?

source_text: he answered them, i told you even now, and ye did not hear; wherefore would ye hear it again? would ye also become his disciples?
target_text: dhèu ne dhaa, na, eee! te deo na ja'a lole le, te ngaa miu mo'o boe nanene. tasamia ka miu neo ja'a lolo hari? ele boe ama si neo j'aj'i ana madhutu na, do?

source_text: and they reviled him, and said, thou art his disciple; but we are disciples of moses.
target_text: ka ra padhai pa-aape ne, hèia ra peka, hud'i laa èu ka j'aj'i ana madhutu na! te ji'i se, ana madhutu musa.

source_text: we know that god hath spoken unto moses: but as for this man, we know not whence he is.
target_text: ji'i nge'a ama lamatua ka dhu padhai lii dènge musa. te ngaa nge'a boe dhèu èèna bhodho nèti ro'a mia.

source_text: the man answered and said unto them, why, herein is the marvel, that ye know not whence he is, and yet he opened mine eyes.
target_text: ka dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu na, dhaa, ja'a malaa, nga! miu me'a boe nèngu mai nèti mia. aa te ngaa nèngu ka dhu bhoke pamèu musi madha ja'a, ka ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: we know that god heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of god, and do his will, him he heareth.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti te'a, na, ama lamatua parluu boe nanene lii dhèu bhelu, si? te ngaa ama lamatua nanene dhèu d'ara mola, dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: since the world began it was never heard that any one opened the eyes of a man born blind.
target_text: karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha toke d'ai sange ne'e, abhu mèka lii lolo èci sa hèi, lula-nèti dhèu dhu puri-pabe'a dhèu bèdhu karèi rara iisi ne, ho nèngu bisa nèdhi.

source_text: if this man were not from god, he could do nothing.
target_text: de ladhe yesus mai boe nèti ama lamatua, tatu nèngu bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa, sina ma?

source_text: they answered and said unto him, thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? and they cast him out.
target_text: hèia ra b'ala, aku rèngu na, wee! èu ne, dhèu bhelu karèi ina mu nara iisi èu! èu ngee, na, èu bisa aj'a hari ji'i, do? ka ra babège eele dhèu ne nèti èmu sabaj'a rèngu.

source_text: jesus heard that they had cast him out; and finding him, he said, dost thou believe on the son of god?
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi rèngu babège eele dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu nèti èmu sabaj'a ra, hèia na la'e tenge dhèu ne, toke abhu. ka na peka, tasamia! èu parcaya dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, do?

source_text: he answered and said, and who is he, lord, that i may believe on him?
target_text: ka dhèu ne karèi hari ne, aku nèngu na, ama, te nèngu èèna cee? peka ku laa, sèna ka ja'a bisa parcaya ne.

source_text: jesus said unto him, thou hast both seen him, and he it is that speaketh with thee.
target_text: hèia yesus peka, na, èu paraga le dènge ne. nèngu èèna, nuka ja'a ne, dhu padhai lii dènge èu ne.

source_text: and he said, lord, i believe. and he worshipped him.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, ja'a parcaya! hèia na patitu kètu urutuu pahaha iisi mi yesus.

source_text: and jesus said, for judgment came i into this world, that they that see not may see; and that they that see may become blind.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, mamai ja'a asa rai-haha ne, sèna ka pad'elo sasala-sasigo dhèu, ho dhèu bèdhu bisa ladhe rèdhi, aa dhèu dhu rèdhi bisa j'aj'i bèdhu.

source_text: those of the pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said unto him, are we also blind?
target_text: ètu era èèna abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri, dhu tadèngi lii padhai yesus. hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, tasamia! ji'i se bèdhu boe, sina ma?

source_text: jesus said unto them, if ye were blind, ye would have no sin: but now ye say, we see: your sin remaineth.
target_text: yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe musi madha miu bèdhu, abhu boe dhu pasala miu. te ngaa lula miu peka, na, miu bisa mèdhi, nèti èèna ka miu pasae sasala miu era.

source_text: verily, verily, i say unto you, he that entereth not by the door into the fold of the sheep, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
target_text: yesus padhai lii pake lii pakasame, peka na, dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. abhu kahib'i-kalèbho dènge oka ra. ladhe dhèu maso boe re hèb'a oka, te ngaa ca'e re kolo oka, na, te'a le, nèngu ne, dhèu mana'u.

source_text: but he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe maso re hèb'a oka, nuka dhèu madhenga dhu piara kahib'i-kalèbho sèra.

source_text: to him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
target_text: dhèu j'aga hèb'a oka, tadhe dhèu madhenga kahib'i-kalèbho, hèia na bhoke babèdho hia nèngu. kahib'i-kalèbho se tadhe lii dhèu madhenga badha kahèi. ka ropa dhèu madhenga ne paroa ngara ra èci-èci, kahib'i-kalèbho se madhutu ne asa li'u.

source_text: when he hath put forth all his own, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
target_text: ladhe dhèu madhenga ne neo nèti si asa mia, nèngu kako uuru. kahib'i-kalèbho se madhutu ne re limuri, lula ra tadhe lii na.

source_text: and a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu kahib'i-kalèbho tadhe boe, na, rèngu madhutu boe ne. te ngaa ra rai pakaj'èu, lula rèngu tadhe boe lii dhèu leo.

source_text: this parable spake jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
target_text: masi ka yesus lole lii pakasame ne hia dhèu se'e, te ngaa re'a boe sasoa na.

source_text: jesus therefore said unto them again, verily, verily, i say unto you, i am the door of the sheep.
target_text: ka yesus peka tabha hari dènge dhèu sèra, aku nèngu na, dhu ja'a lole dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. ja'a ne nuka sèmi hèb'a oka kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: all that came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mai uuru nèti ja'a, rèngu sama sèmi dhèu mana'u. masi ka rèngu loe boe paroa, te ngaa kahib'i-kalèbho se nanene boe lii rèngu.

source_text: i am the door; by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and go out, and shall find pasture.
target_text: aa ja'a ne èci èèna ka dènge hèb'a oka èèna. ladhe abhu dhèu neo maso re ja'a, ama lamatua neo patabuli ne nèti koasa sasala-sasigo na. èèna sama sèmi nèngu la'e asa era ama lamatua, maso re ja'a dhu j'aj'i hèb'a oka. aa dhèu dhu maso re ja'a, nèngu neo asa mia èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe, dènge abhu na'a-ninu dhu be'a.

source_text: the thief cometh not, but that he may steal, and kill, and destroy: i came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
target_text: dhèu mana'u re'a dhoka tao maruru di, te rèngu mai ho mana'u, pamadhe dhèu, aa pa'ele iie mamuri dhèu. te ngaa ja'a kèti mamuri dhu hua iia titu kèna, te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri mera-milu, aa unu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: i am the good shepherd: the good shepherd layeth down his life for the sheep.
target_text: ja'a kahèi nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu be'a. te dhèu madhenga dhu be'a, sadia saraka ngi'u na toke madhe, sèna ka kahib'i-kalèbho na bisa mamuri.

source_text: he that is a hireling, and not a shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, beholdeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth, and the wolf snatcheth them, and scattereth them:
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a dhu lamatua boe nèti kahib'i-kalèbho sèra, ropa nèdhi busa hui mai, na rai pakaj'èu, tèke eele kahib'i-kalèbho se. hèia busa hui ne kadhi nare kahib'i-kalèbho, ka rèngu cahag'e rai paceb'a.

source_text: he fleeth because he is a hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
target_text: dhèu sab'a èèna rai, lula nèngu dhoka sab'a tenge doi di. na pusi-pahae boe j'aga paie-iie kahib'i-kalèbho sèra.

source_text: i am the good shepherd; and i know mine own, and mine own know me,
target_text: lèke tare'a! ja'a ne nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu be'a. ja'a tadhe hua iia kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a sèra. aa rèngu tadhe ja'a kahèi.

source_text: even as the father knoweth me, and i know the father; and i lay down my life for the sheep.
target_text: èèna, èci èèna ka dènge ama ku ètu sorga tadhe ja'a, aa ja'a tadhe nèngu kahèi. ja'a sadia kore le ho soro iisi ja'a toke madhe, sèna ka kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a bisa mamuri.

source_text: and other sheep i have, which are not of this fold: them also i must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and they shall become one flock, one shepherd.
target_text: abhu kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu leo era, dhu dhae kaboko kore mèka sèna ka pa'èci dènge kahib'i-kalèbho ètu se'e se. ja'a hud'i eo pa'oru kore si mi ca era kahèi. ropa rèngu tadèngi lii ja'a, rèngu tadhe dènge. hèia ra mai pa'èci, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ca kaboko dhu dènge dhèu madhenga èci.

source_text: therefore doth the father love me, because i lay down my life, that i may take it again.
