target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama ku ètu sorga sue ja'a. te ja'a dhu sadia le soro iisi ja'a toke madhe, sèna ka ja'a bisa mamuri hari.

source_text: no one taketh it away from me, but i lay it down of myself. i have power to lay it down, and i have power to take it again. this commandment received i from my father.
target_text: abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu laka-seti ja'a ho madhe, te ngaa ja'a mesa ku soro iisi la'a toke madhe. ja'a dènge hak ho soro ngi'u ja'a, aa dènge hak kahèi sèna ka kore hari. paredha ne, dhu ja'a sèmi kore le nèti ama ku ètu sorga.

source_text: there arose a division again among the jews because of these words.
target_text: lula dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai yesus sèmi èèna, ka dhèu yahudi se pab'ala hari isi-aanga ra.

source_text: and many of them said, he hath a demon, and is mad; why hear ye him?
target_text: abhu dhèu ae nèti rèngu dhu peka na, dhèu ne, huj'u! aa nidhu tao ne! nga tao ka miu d'èi nanene ne?

source_text: others said, these are not the sayings of one possessed with a demon. can a demon open the eyes of the blind?
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e peka na, ne'e ne nèti boe lii padhai dhèu huj'u, sina ma? lii padhai sèmi se'e se, kalua boe nèti d'ara hèb'a nidhu! aa nidhu sèra bisa boe kahèi puri-pa'èle musi madha dhèu bèdhu, si?

source_text: and it was the feast of the dedication at jerusalem:
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu yahudi neo tao kalela agama rèngu. lod'o be'a ne, lèke dènge hèru pacuhi. pesta ne, pasanèd'e dhèu yahudi lod'o dhu dhèu leo mai pakaj'alu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua ètu kota yerusalem, ka ra pamèu ne sèna ka ringi hari ca tèka.

source_text: it was winter; and jesus was walking in the temple in solomon's porch.
target_text: yesus kako palème ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne, ètu era dhu ra pangare na, ‘paleo dhèu aae soleman'.

source_text: the jews therefore came round about him, and said unto him, how long dost thou hold us in suspense? if thou art the christ, tell us plainly.
target_text: hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi mai lingu rare ne, ka ra peka, eeh! ji'i se mate toke d'ai pèri lod'o hari, ho nge'a? ladhe èu ne, nuka kristus, na, peka mola-mola.

source_text: jesus answered them, i told you, and ye believe not: the works that i do in my father's name, these bear witness of me.
target_text: yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu peka mema le, te ngaa miu mo'o boe lèka. aa te ngaa j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao, aa'i-aa'i madhutu paredha ama ku di. j'ara se'e se ka dhu pad'elo, na, ja'a ne, cee.

source_text: but ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep.
target_text: te ngaa miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a, lula miu se kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a boe.

source_text: my sheep hear my voice, and i know them, and they follow me:
target_text: te kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu tare'a sèra, tadhe lii ja'a. rèngu madhutu ja'a, aa ja'a tadhe rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and i give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, and no one shall snatch them out of my hand.
target_text: ja'a hia si mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, aa rèngu cèri eele boe nèti ama lamatua kahèi. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa parame rare si nèti ja'a.

source_text: my father, who hath given them unto me, is greater than all; and no one is able to snatch them out of the father's hand.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga ka dhu pangèd'u rèngu mi ja'a. nèngu èra risi aa'i mèu-mèu. nèti èèna ka, abhu boe ca dhèu sa hèi, dhu bisa parame rare si nèti nèngu.

source_text: i and the father are one.
target_text: te ama ku dènge ja'a ne, èci.

source_text: the jews took up stones again to stone him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se rare hari hadhu, neo pèci pamadhe yesus.

source_text: jesus answered them, many good works have i showed you from the father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a pad'elo le j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae nèti ama ku. miu pake j'ara be'a mia, ho neo pèci pamadhe ja'a?

source_text: the jews answered him, for a good work we stone thee not, but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself god.
target_text: hèia dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ji'i pèci boe èu lula èu tao j'ara be'a. te ngaa ji'i huku èu dènge j'ara pèci pake hadhu, lula èu pahahe ama lamatua. te èu dhoka dhèu rai-haha di, te ngaa tao iisi mu nuka sèmi ama lamatua! seli-kolane, nga!

source_text: jesus answered them, is it not written in your law, i said, ye are gods?
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, tasamia? ètu d'ara atora agama dhu miu mèd'u, dhu suri na, ‘ja'a peka mema, na, miu ama-ama se, dewa'.

source_text: if he called them gods, unto whom the word of god came and the scripture cannot be broken,
target_text: èdhi te'a le, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, lèke, aa bisa boe core eele. ama lamatua mesa na dhu peka le dhèu sèra, na, rèngu se, ‘dewa'.

source_text: say ye of him, whom the father sanctified and sent into the world, thou blasphemest; because i said, i am the son of god?
target_text: de tasamia ka miu bisa peka, na, ja'a ne pahahe ama lamatua lula ja'a peka, na, ja'a ne ana ama lamatua? maso boe asa d'ara kahadhu, si! te ama ètu sorga ka dhu paj'uj'u ja'a aa pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: if i do not the works of my father, believe me not.
target_text: sèmi ne'e. ladhe ja'a pakako boe sasab'a-la'a ama ku, na, miu baku parcaya ja'a.

source_text: but if i do them, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know and understand that the father is in me, and i in the father.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a pakako taruu sasab'a ama ku. de masi ka miu lèka boe ja'a, te ngaa miu hud'i sèmi mere ku tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao. dènge sèmi èèna, miu bisa me'a kahèi, na, ama ku dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. aa ja'a pa'èki dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: they sought again to take him: and he went forth out of their hand.
target_text: ka dhèu se sèku kèpe ne hari, te ngaa na tabhèli eele nèti kacui-aai rèngu.

source_text: and he went away again beyond the jordan into the place where john was at the first baptizing; and there he abode.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e hari asa cabèka loko yarden, ètu era dhu uru èèna yohanis sarani dhèu. ka na pea taha ètu nèi.

source_text: and many came unto him; and they said, john indeed did no sign: but all things whatsoever john spake of this man were true.
target_text: dhèu ae mai tenge ne. hèia ra peka, aku rèngu na, yohanis tao nèdhi boe tadha malaa. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu lole lula-nèti yesus ne, lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: and many believed on him there.
target_text: ka dhèu ae ètu nèi parcaya yesus.

source_text: now a certain man was sick, lazarus of bethany, of the village of mary and her sister martha. and it was that mary who anointed the lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother lazarus was sick.
target_text: abhu dhèu èci, ngara na lasarus. nèngu pea ètu rae betania, sama-sama dènge a'a na bhèni dhèu dua, maria dènge marta. maria ne'e, ka dhu pakose haga lamatua yesus dènge èi hèu mèngi, ka pamèu pake rèu kètu na. ca lod'o, ka lasarus pèd'a aae.

source_text: the sisters therefore sent unto him, saying, lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
target_text: ka ana hèni na dhèu dua se pa'adhu lii moa hia yesus, aku rèngu na, lasarus, angalai ama èèna, pèd'a aae.

source_text: but when jesus heard it, he said, this sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of god, that the son of god may be glorified thereby.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii moa ne, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, èi papèd'a ne nèti boe mamadhe. ama lamatua neo pake j'ara ne'e ho pad'elo dadedha na. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a, nuka ana ama lamatua ne.

source_text: now jesus loved martha, and her sister, and lazarus.
target_text: yesus sue marta, maria, dènge ari ra lasarus.

source_text: when therefore he heard that he was sick, he abode at that time two days in the place where he was.
target_text: lod'o na tadèngi, na, lasarus dhu pèd'a, yesus pea dua lod'o era ètu cabèka loko yarden.

source_text: then after this he saith to the disciples, let us go into judæa again.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mai lati hari asa era pea lasarus ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: the disciples say unto him, rabbi, the jews were but now seeking to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu na pab'ala, peka na, ama mese. lai-lai ne, ama-ama dhèu yahudi sèra neo pèci pamadhe ama ètu nèi. te ngaa ama neo lamu hari asa nèi?

source_text: jesus answered, are there not twelve hours in the day? if a man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, baku madha'u! bèli-bèli, nèti lod'o rea toke lod'o cèna, canguru dua jam, si? ladhe kako ètu d'ara saraa, dhèu kadhunu boe. te saraa pasaraa rai-haha ho dhèu bisa ladhe rèdhi dènge be'a.

source_text: but if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because the light is not in him.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu kako ètu d'ara maroga, na kadhunu pahari-pahari, te dènge boe saraa.

source_text: these things spake he: and after this he saith unto them, our friend lazarus is fallen asleep; but i go, that i may awake him out of sleep.
target_text: yesus padhai lii èle, ka na peka, angalai èdhi lasarus bhèj'i le. te ngaa pe ja'a laku parèi ne.

source_text: the disciples therefore said unto him, lord, if he is fallen asleep, he will recover.
target_text: hèia ana madhutu na peka, na, ama, ladhe nèngu bhèj'i di, sasoa na, èèna na nèngu èle nèti papèd'a, si?

source_text: now jesus had spoken of his death: but they thought that he spake of taking rest in sleep.
target_text: ra peka sèmi èèna, lula rèngu ngee, na, yesus padhai lii lula-nèti bhèj'i dhu biasa di. aa te ngaa, yesus lole lula-nèti mamadhe lasarus.

source_text: then jesus therefore said unto them plainly, lazarus is dead.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mola-mola dènge ra, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. lasarus madhe le.

source_text: and i am glad for your sakes that i was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a karej'e lula ja'a aad'o ètu nèi lod'o dhu na madhe mèka, sèna ka miu baku susa. te, ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne'e, èèna ka dhu tao miu bisa parcaya ja'a. mai lati ka!

source_text: thomas therefore, who is called didymus, said unto his fellow-disciples, let us also go, that we may die with him.
target_text: hèia tomas, dhu dhèu paroa, na, ana kembar, peka dènge ana madhutu dhu leo sèra, aku nèngu na, mai ka! be'a risi aa'i-aa'i ti lati, sèna ka madhe palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: so when jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already. now bethany was nigh unto jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off; and many of the jews had come to martha and mary, to console them concerning their brother.
target_text: ka yesus si lasi asa rae betania. rae ne, kaj'èu nèti yerusalem tèlu kilometer di. ka dhèu yahudi nèti nèi, ae ka dhu mai beke, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara marta dènge maria. ropa yesus si d'ai nèi, heka re'a, na, dhèu padhane le lasarus èpa lod'o kèna.

source_text: martha therefore, when she heard that jesus was coming, went and met him: but mary still sat in the house.
target_text: ka lod'o marta tadèngi, na, yesus mai le, hèia la'e paraga dènge yesus. te ngaa maria mate ètu èmu.

source_text: martha therefore said unto jesus, lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
target_text: hèia marta lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama, ee! ladhe ama ètu ne'e, tatu ari ja'a madhe boe.

source_text: and even now i know that, whatsoever thou shalt ask of god, god will give thee.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a parcaya kahèi, sad'i ama manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti ama lamatua, tatu abhu.

source_text: jesus saith unto her, thy brother shall rise again.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, marta! èèna na, ari mu mamuri hari.

source_text: martha saith unto him, i know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
target_text: marta padhai lii, peka na, ja'a ke'a, pe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ladhe ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i, nèngu pamamuri hari kahèi ari ja'a.

source_text: jesus said unto her, i am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth on me, though he die, yet shall he live;
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, ja'a ka dhu hia dhèu madhe mamuri hari. ja'a ka dhu hia dhèu, mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. de dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, abhu mamuri èèna, masi ka nèngu madhe.

source_text: and whosoever liveth and believeth on me shall never die. believest thou this?
target_text: ka dhèu dhu unu mamuri dhu lèke èèna, aa parcaya ja'a, bèli-camèd'a madhe boe, te ngaa mamuri taruu. marta, èu parcaya lii padhai ja'a ne, do?

source_text: she saith unto him, yea, lord: i have believed that thou art the christ, the son of god, even he that cometh into the world.
target_text: hèia marta dhaa, na, oo, ama! ja'a parcaya, na, èu ne, nuka kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u mema karèi nèti uru ka. aa èu ne, ana ama lamatua dhu na padhadha tèke hia mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: and when she had said this, she went away, and called mary her sister secretly, saying, the teacher is here, and calleth thee.
target_text: ropa marta padhai lii nare, hèia na lèpa asa èmu na. ka na paroa ari na maria, sèna ka dua ra mesa-mesa ra. ka na peka, na, ama mese mai le. nèngu neo paraga dènge èu.

source_text: and she, when she heard it, arose quickly, and went unto him. now jesus was not yet come into the village, but was still in the place where martha met him. the jews then who were with her in the house, and were consoling her, when they saw mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, supposing that she was going unto the tomb to weep there.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia maria la'e dènge ka tenge yesus. ropa dhèu yahudi dhu beke dènge maria ètu d'ara èmu, rèdhi nèngu kèd'i sahèka, ka rai li'u la'e, hèia lasi madhutu ne re limuri. te rèngu pangee, na, maria la'e tangi asa ro'a lasarus. lod'o èèna, yesus si d'ai mèka d'ara rae. nèngu ètu era dhu marta paraga dènge ne.

source_text: mary therefore, when she came where jesus was, and saw him, fell down at his feet, saying unto him, lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
target_text: ropa maria la'e d'ai era èèna, ka ladhe nèdhi yesus. hèia na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, ama! sèmi ama ètu ne'e, tatu ari ja'a madhe boe.

source_text: when jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the jews also weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi maria tangi, aa dhèu yahudi dhu madhutu ne tangi kahèi, ka yesus nasa aa d'ara na susa.

source_text: and said, where have ye laid him? they say unto him, lord, come and see.
target_text: hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu padhane ne ètu mia? ra dhaa, peka na, mai, ama! sèna ka mèdhi unu mu.

source_text: jesus wept.
target_text: hèia yesus tangi.

source_text: the jews therefore said, behold how he loved him!
target_text: ka dhèu yahudi se papeka, aku rèngu na, ladhe ku laa. na sue lasarus titu kèna!

source_text: but some of them said, could not this man, who opened the eyes of him that was blind, have caused that this man also should not die?
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e dhu papeka na, dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu hia dhèu bèdhu bisa nèdhi. nga tao ka nèngu bisa boe tenge j'ara, sèna ka lasarus baku madhe?

source_text: jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the tomb. now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
target_text: ka d'ara yesus susa. hèia la'e padètu-dètu asa ro'a dhu ra padhane lasarus. ro'a ne dhu ra katange le dènge hadhu aae cue.

source_text: jesus saith, take ye away the stone. martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, lord, by this time the body decayeth; for he hath been dead four days.
target_text: hèia yesus pua dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, loli eele ku hadhu nèti hèb'a ro'a ne! te ngaa marta, ana hèni dhèu madhe ne, peka, aku nèngu na, irii, ama! na madhe èpa lod'o kèna! tatu hèu le.

source_text: jesus saith unto her, said i not unto thee, that, if thou believedst, thou shouldest see the glory of god?
target_text: ka yesus pasanèd'e ne, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e lii ja'a deo na, si? ja'a dhu peka mema le, na, ladhe èu tare'a-re'a parcaya ja'a, pe mèdhi dadedha ama lamatua.

source_text: so they took away the stone. and jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, father, i thank thee that thou heardest me.
target_text: hèia pèri-pèri dhèu loli eele hadhu nèti hèb'a ro'a ne. ka yesus ladhe asa dedha-liru, hèia na peka, ama! ja'a manèngi makasi, lula ama nanene ja'a.

source_text: and i knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the multitude that standeth around i said it, that they may believe that thou didst send me.
target_text: ja'a ke'a karèi nèti uru ka, na, ama nanene taruu ja'a. te ngaa doe ne ja'a peka sèmi ne'e, sèna ka dhèu-dhèu dhu titu ètu ne'e, bisa re'a, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: and when he had thus spoken, he cried with a loud voice, lazarus, come forth.
target_text: ropa peka nare, hèia na paroa dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, lasarus! kalua ka!

source_text: he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with grave-clothes; and his face was bound about with a napkin. jesus saith unto them, loose him, and let him go.
target_text: ka dhèu madhe ne kalua nèti d'ara ro'a. kacui-aai dènge haga na pa'èki era dènge bèla hutu dhèu madhe. aa abhu bèla dhu pahutu rèhu na kahèi. yesus pua dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, bhoke eele bèla hutu se, sèna ka na kako!

source_text: many therefore of the jews, who came to mary and beheld that which he did, believed on him.
target_text: ropa laladhe rèdhi tatao yesus ne, dhèu yahudi dhu beke dènge maria, ae ka dhu parcaya yesus.

source_text: but some of them went away to the pharisees, and told them the things which jesus had done.
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e kahèi dhu lasi paraga dènge dhèu nèti partei parisi, sèna ka peka tatao yesus ne dènge rèngu.

source_text: the chief priests therefore and the pharisees gathered a council, and said, what do we? for this man doeth many signs.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra, dènge dhèu parisi pakaboko ho padhue. ra pakarèi, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa! de èdhi tao ne tasamia hari?

source_text: if we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi soro tèke ne, bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanao-maena nèngu j'aj'i dhèu aae rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, èèna na sordad'u roma sèra mai paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i èdhi dènge palaho isi kabarai èdhi.

source_text: but a certain one of them, caiaphas, being high priest that year, said unto them, ye know nothing at all,
target_text: tèu èèna, kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. na peka, na, goa, ee! miu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: nor do ye take account that it is expedient for you that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu èci madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i, èèna be'a risi hia miu. te ladhe aad'o, na, sordad'u roma mai, pamadhe aa'i mèu-mèu isi kabarai èdhi dhèu yahudi ne!

source_text: now this he said not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that jesus should die for the nation;
target_text: lii kayafas ne mai boe nèti d'ara nèngu unu na. te ama lamatua pake hèb'a na, lula nèngu ka kètu kapai risi agama d'ara tèu èèna. nèti èèna ka, kayafas peka tèke, na, bèli-camèd'a yesus madhe pala dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of god that are scattered abroad.
target_text: aa te ngaa, dhu lèke ka, yesus madhe boe hia dhèu yahudi mesa ra di, te ngaa pala dhèu unu ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i dhu pale-lème ètu rai-haha ne. nèngu èèna na oru nare si j'aj'i mi suku ca nau-ca nadha.

source_text: so from that day forth they took counsel that they might put him to death.
target_text: lula lii padhai kayafas ne'e ka, karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ama-ama dhèu yahudi tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe yesus.

source_text: jesus therefore walked no more openly among the jews, but departed thence into the country near to the wilderness, into a city called ephraim; and there he tarried with the disciples.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus la'e heka asa madha dhèu ae ètu talora ama-ama dhèu yahudi. nèngu dènge ana-ana madhutu na lasi asa d'ara kota èci, ngara na efraim, padètu dènge d'ara mamoo. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna.

source_text: now the passover of the jews was at hand: and many went up to jerusalem out of the country before the passover, to purify themselves.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dètu le dènge lod'o kalela paska agama yahudi. dhu tema le, d'ai lod'o sèmi èèna, dhèu ae nèti rae-rae mai pakaboko ètu kota yerusalem ho madhutu kalela paska ètu èèna. dhèu se d'ai uru, ho pamèu iisi madhutu atora agama.

source_text: they sought therefore for jesus, and spake one with another, as they stood in the temple, what think ye? that he will not come to the feast?
target_text: ae ka nèti rèngu patangi-tenge yesus ètu èèna. ropa ra titu ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka ra pakarèi, peka na, madhutu a'abhu miu, tasamia? yesus mai madhutu pesta kalela paska ne, do aad'o?

source_text: now the chief priests and the pharisees had given commandment, that, if any man knew where he was, he should show it, that they might take him.
target_text: te ngaa kètu agama yahudi sèra, dènge dhèu parisi paredha, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu re'a yesus ètu mia, na, peka dènge ji'i! aa te ngaa rèngu neo kèpe ne.

source_text: jesus therefore six days before the passover came to bethany, where lazarus was, whom jesus raised from the dead.
target_text: di èna lod'o ka, d'ai lod'o kalela paska, ka yesus si mai hari asa rae betania. lasarus si pea ètu èèna. nèngu ka dhu madhe, dhu yesus pamamuri hari le.

source_text: so they made him a supper there: and martha served; but lazarus was one of them that sat at meat with him.
target_text: hèia rèngu pananasu, sèna ka mèda none yesus na'a-ninu dènge rèngu. marta lalau mei. aa lasarus madhèdi na'a-ninu mei èci dènge yesus.

source_text: mary therefore took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odor of the ointment.
target_text: hèia maria nare èi hèu mèngi asli ca boto dhu kab'ua. ka na pasuti mi haga yesus. hèia na roso haga yesus pake rèu kètu nèngu. ka hèu mèngi ne pale-lème aa'i d'ara èmu èèna.

source_text: but judas iscariot, one of his disciples, that should betray him, saith,
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu yesus èci, ngara na yudas iskariot, dhu èèna na pahie yesus, ka'ugu aku nèngu na,

source_text: why was not this ointment sold for three hundred shillings, and given to the poor?
target_text: wee! nga tao ka nèngu pahie boe èi hèu mèngi ne? te kab'ua na nuka sèmi gaji dhèu èci d'ara ca tèu. be'a risi pahie, sèna ka kab'ua na pabagi mi dhèu unu aad'o sèra!

source_text: now this he said, not because he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and having the bag took away what was put therein.
target_text: aa te ngaa yudas peka sèmi ne'e ne lula boe nèti nèngu sue dhèu-dhèu unu aad'o. te ngaa lula nèngu, dhèu mana'u. nèngu ne dhu tèke doi yesus si, te ngaa ae ka dhu huni nare nèti d'ara kas.

source_text: jesus therefore said, suffer her to keep it against the day of my burying.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa bhèni ne tao sèmi ne'e. te nèngu dhu tèke èi hèu mèngi ne, sèna ka lalau ngi'u aae ja'a ho ra padhane ja'a.

source_text: for the poor ye have always with you; but me ye have not always.
target_text: dhèu unu aad'o dhu bera-bera dènge miu. te ngaa ja'a ne bèli-camèd'a aad'o heka ètu talora miu.

source_text: the common people therefore of the jews learned that he was there: and they came, not for jesus' sake only, but that they might see lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
target_text: èle èèna, dhèu yahudi ae ka dhu re'a, na, yesus ètu rae betania. ka dhèu se mai neo rèdhi ne, aa neo rèdhi lasarus kahèi. te rèngu tadèngi le, na, yesus pamamuri hari le lasarus nèti mamadhe.

source_text: but the chief priests took counsel that they might put lazarus also to death;
target_text: te ngaa kètu-kètu agama padhue ho neo pamadhe lasarus.

source_text: because that by reason of him many of the jews went away, and believed on jesus.
target_text: te dhèu yahudi ae dhu tadèngi le lii palolo lula-nèti lasarus ne, ka dhèu se parcaya yesus. rèngu se ro'o heka nanene ama-ama dhèu yahudi.

source_text: on the morrow a great multitude that had come to the feast, when they heard that jesus was coming to jerusalem,
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhèu ae dhu mai madhutu kalela paska ètu kota yerusalem, tadèngi, na, yesus neo mai asa era ne'e kahèi.

source_text: took the branches of the palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried out, hosanna: blessed is he that cometh in the name of the lord, even the king of israel.
target_text: ka lasi pare rèu palam ho pake soru mamai yesus, sama sèmi nèngu ne, dhèu aae-dhèu kapai. hèia ra pa'oo aa'i-aa'i ra, aku rèngu na, hosana! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! te lamatua paj'uj'u d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu aae isra'el, dhu nèti kolongara lamatua!

source_text: and jesus, having found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
target_text: ka yesus abhu badha keled'ei èni ci'u, hèia na manya'e. se'e se j'aj'i nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na,

source_text: fear not, daughter of zion: behold, thy king cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
target_text: miu dhèu kota yerusalem, baku madha'u! miu dhèu kota ‘sion' se, ladhe ku asa nèi! te dhèu aae miu nuka mai nèi! nèngu mai manya'e keled'ei èni ci'u.

source_text: these things understood not his disciples at the first: but when jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus re'a mèka sasoa nèti j'ara se'e se. te ngaa bèli-camèd'a, ropa yesus mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na, aa ama lamatua ded'e ne padedha-dedha, rèngu heka sanèd'e j'ara-j'ara dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lula-nèti nèngu ne. rèngu sanèd'e kahèi tatao dhèu ae se mi dedha yesus.

source_text: the multitude therefore that was with him when he called lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, bare witness.
target_text: lod'o yesus pamamuri hari lasarus nèti mamadhe, hèia na paroa ne kalua nèti ro'a dhèu madhe èèna, abhu dhèu ae dhu sama-sama dènge yesus. de limuri ne rèngu lolo palème lula-nèti ngaa dhu uru èèna rèngu rèdhi dènge musi madha ra.

source_text: for this cause also the multitude went and met him, for that they heard that he had done this sign.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ropa yesus padètu dènge yerusalem, dhèu ae mai soru ne lula rèngu tadèngi le, na, nèngu ka dhu tao tadha malaa èèna.

source_text: the pharisees therefore said among themselves, behold how ye prevail nothing; lo, the world is gone after him.
target_text: ka dhèu-dhèu parisi peka, na, peeh! ladhe ku laa! dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, parai-oru ho neo madhutu ne! bèli-camèd'a èdhi ka dhu j'èra! ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, èdhi tao tasamia hari?

source_text: now there were certain greeks among those that went up to worship at the feast:
target_text: abhu dhèu yunani pèri-pèri dhu mai asa kota yerusalem palere-lere dènge dhèu leo, ho neo madhutu kalela paska ètu èèna. ètu èèna, rèngu neo pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: these therefore came to philip, who was of bethsaida of galilee, and asked him, saying, sir, we would see jesus.
target_text: hèia dhèu se mai paraga dènge pelipus, dhu rae nèngu ka betsaida ètu propensi galilea. ra manèngi, aku rèngu na, ji'i neo paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: philip cometh and telleth andrew: andrew cometh, and philip, and they tell jesus.
target_text: ka pelipus la'e peka dènge anderias. hèia dua ra lasi peka dènge yesus.

source_text: and jesus answereth them, saying, the hour is come, that the son of man should be glorified. verily, verily, i say unto you, except a grain of wheat fall into the earth and die, it abideth by itself alone; but if it die, it beareth much fruit.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, lod'o ja'a d'ai kèna. ja'a hud'i madhe ku, heka ama lamatua neo ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a kèna. tare'a sèmi èèna! èdhi pakasame ku dènge hini èci. ladhe èdhi sèle hini ca lamusi, na, hini ne ele iie uuru ku dènge j'ara boho ètu d'ara rai, heka na muri mai, hèia na hia hua-hela ae-ae kèna. ladhe sèmi boe èèna, hini èèna cue dhoo-dhoo di.

source_text: he that loveth his life loseth it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
target_text: dhèu dhu pahae boe dad'èi ama lamatua, lula nèngu sue ae mamuri na ètu rai-haha ne, èèna na mamuri na ele iie d'ara. te ngaa dhèu dhu sadia tèke eele mamuri rai-haha na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: if any man serve me, let him follow me; and where i am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will the father honor.
target_text: dhèu dhu neo sab'a hia ja'a, nèngu hud'i madhutu ja'a taruu. ja'a ètu mia, na, dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a ètu èèna kahèi. te ladhe abhu dhèu dhu sab'a hia ja'a, èèna na ama ku ètu sorga pakab'ua nèngu.

source_text: now is my soul troubled; and what shall i say? father, save me from this hour. but for this cause came i unto this hour.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, d'ara ja'a susa titu kèna. te ngaa ja'a neo peka ngaa hari? ja'a hud'i manèngi ku, peka na, ‘ama! patabuli ja'a, sèna ka ja'a baku madhe ku d'ara lai-lai ne, ' do? bisa boe! ja'a manèngi boe sèmi èèna, lula nèngu pua ja'a mai sèna ka madhe.

source_text: father, glorify thy name. there came therefore a voice out of heaven, saying, i have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
target_text: de dhu ja'a manèngi ka, ‘ama. hud'i laa ja'a madhutu dad'èi ama ku, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama. ' hèia lii èci nèti dedha-liru peka na, ja'a ded'e padedha-dedha le kolongara ja'a. aa ja'a neo ded'e padedha-dedha hari kolongara ja'a.

source_text: the multitude therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it had thundered: others said, an angel hath spoken to him.
target_text: ka dhèu ae dhu titu ètu sèra sa, tadèngi lii ne'e kahèi, hèia ra peka na, ira ii! d'oro nga! cahag'e hari peka na, aad'o! ana pajuu lamatua èci nèti sorga padhai lii dènge ne.

source_text: jesus answered and said, this voice hath not come for my sake, but for your sakes.
target_text: te ngaa yesus padhai lii dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, lii deo na, lii hia miu, hia boe ja'a.

source_text: now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
target_text: limuri ne, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne hud'i lasi asa madha ama lamatua, sèna ka na pama'ète lii langu rèngu. lamatua neo babège eele kahèi dhèu bhelu dhu paredha ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and i, if i be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto myself.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ded'e ka ja'a ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, pe ja'a ère kore dhèu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka ra parcaya ja'a.

source_text: but this he said, signifying by what manner of death he should die.
target_text: na padhai lii sèmi ne'e, ho peka j'ara mamadhe na.

source_text: the multitude therefore answered him, we have heard out of the law that the christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, the son of man must be lifted up? who is this son of man?
target_text: ka dhèu ètu sèra karèi, aku rèngu na, ji'i tadèngi ngèdhi le nèti atora lamatua, dhu peka na, èèna na kristus mamuri taruu. kristus dènge dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a, èci èèna ka, do? de, nga tao ka èu peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a dhèu neo paca'e dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha? ' te nèngu ne, cee?

source_text: jesus therefore said unto them, yet a little while is the light among you. walk while ye have the light, that darkness overtake you not: and he that walketh in the darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, na, nèbhu heka saraa ja'a, d'elo heka miu. de lod'o ja'a dènge miu era, miu hud'i mamuri mola ku, sèna ka bhabhelu-katub'a baku hutu nare saraa dhu ètu d'ara miu. te dhèu dhu kako ètu d'ara maroga, ne'a boe la'e asa mia.

source_text: while ye have the light, believe on the light, that ye may become sons of light. these things spake jesus, and he departed and hid himself from them.
target_text: lod'o saraa ja'a ne era, miu hud'i parcaya ku ja'a, sèna ka miu j'aj'i mi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa, ho me'a, na, miu neo lami mia. ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia la'e tèke eele dhèu se'e, sèna ka nèngu mesa-mesa na.

source_text: but though he had done so many signs before them, yet they believed not on him:
target_text: masi ka yesus tao le tadha malaa ae-ae ètu madha dhèu ae, te ngaa ro'o boe parcaya ne.

source_text: that the word of isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the lord been revealed?
target_text: ne'e ne palèke dènge lii yesaya, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua, dhu suri peka na, lamatua! abhu boe dhèu dhu parcaya lii padhai ji'i! te masi ka lamatua pad'elo le koasa, te ngaa dhèu sèra ladhe rèdhi boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: for this cause they could not believe, for that isaiah said again,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, limuri ne dhèu yahudi cahag'e parcaya boe lamatua, lèke sèmi dhu yesaya suri tèke ètu era leo d'ara sasuri na, peka na,

source_text: he hath blinded their eyes, and he hardened their heart; lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and should turn, and i should heal them.
target_text: ama lamatua pabèdhu le d'ara ra, sèna ka baku rèdhi ngaa-ngaa. na soro tèke d'ara ra adhu sèmi hadhu, sèna ka baku re'a mèu. soro tèke si sèmi èèna, sèna ka baku ra lèpa tenge ja'a, aa ja'a tao boe pabe'a si.

source_text: these things said isaiah, because he saw his glory; and he spake of him.
target_text: yesaya peka sèmi ne'e, lula nèdhi le dadedha yesus, ka na lole mema lula-nèti yesus ne.

source_text: nevertheless even of the rulers many believed on him; but because of the pharisees they did not confess it, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu ae dhu parcaya yesus. mesa boe dhèu biasa di, te abhu kahèi ama-ama dhèu yahudi dhu parcaya ne. te ngaa rèngu mangaku boe yesus ètu madha dhèu ae, lula ra madha'u, mage dhèu parisi babège eele si nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra.

source_text: for they loved the glory that is of men more than the glory that is of god.
target_text: ama-ama yahudi se pusi-pahae boe ho lamatua koa si, lula rèngu d'èi risi abhu koa-kad'iri nèti dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: and jesus cried and said, he that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii dènge lii mèdhu, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, nèngu parcaya boe ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa nèngu parcaya kahèi dhèu dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: and he that beholdeth me beholdeth him that sent me.
target_text: te dhèu dhu ladhe nèdhi ja'a, na, nèngu ladhe nèdhi kahèi dhèu dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: i am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me may not abide in the darkness.
target_text: ja'a mai sèna ka j'aj'i nuka sèmi saraa ètu rai-haha ne. ho hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a mamuri boe ètu d'ara maroga.

source_text: and if any man hear my sayings, and keep them not, i judge him not: for i came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ja'a, te ngaa madhutu boe, na, ja'a pama'ète boe hahuku na. te mamai ja'a asa rai-haha ne, neo boe pama'ète hahuku dhèu, te ngaa ja'a neo patabuli si nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: he that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my sayings, hath one that judgeth him: the word that i spake, the same shall judge him in the last day.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tule eele ja'a, aa d'èi boe sèmi lii holo-nori ja'a, pe na paraga dènge hakim. te d'ai èle rai-haha ne, lii holo-nori dhu ja'a lole kèdhi sèra, ka dhu pama'ète hahuku mi dedha rèngu èci-èci.

source_text: for i spake not from myself; but the father that sent me, he hath given me a commandment, what i should say, and what i should speak.
target_text: lula ja'a dhae padhai lii kèdhi mèka pake kolongara ja'a mesa ku. te ngaa ja'a padhai lii kèti kolongara ama ku ètu sorga. te nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a. aa nèngu ka dhu paredha ja'a, sèna ka ja'a padhai lii ngaa.

source_text: and i know that his commandment is life eternal; the things therefore which i speak, even as the father hath said unto me, so i speak.
target_text: ja'a ke'a kahèi, na, lii paredha na hia mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. nèti èèna ka, lii padhai ja'a madhutu mola-mola ngaa dhu ama ku pua ja'a padhai lii.

source_text: now before the feast of the passover, jesus knowing that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the father, having loved his own that were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
target_text: lod'o kalela paska dhae d'ai mèka, yesus ne'a le, na, d'ai le lod'o ho nèngu tèke eele rai-haha ne, aa la'e hari asa ama na ètu sorga. nèngu sue titu kèna dhèu unu na ètu rai-haha ne, toke na saraka mamuri na kateme aae hia mi rèngu.

source_text: and during supper, the devil having already put into the heart of judas iscariot, simon's son, to betray him,
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae nidhu dadugu-rariu le yudas, ana simon iskariot, sèna ka pahie eele yesus. ka yudas dhu pama'ète le, sèna ka ad'u-ue madha j'ara èèna, ropa yesus si madhèdi ra'a-rinu ètu d'ara kalela paska.

source_text: jesus, knowing that the father had given all things into his hands, and that he came forth from god, and goeth unto god,
target_text: yesus ne'a mema le, na, ama lamatua pua-paleha nèngu mai asa rai-haha ne, de nèbhu heka nèngu lèpa hari la'e asa ama lamatua. aa nèngu ne'a kahèi, na, ama na ètu sorga pangèd'u aa'i le ngaa-ngaa mi nèngu.

source_text: riseth from supper, and layeth aside his garments; and he took a towel, and girded himself.
target_text: hèia yesus kèd'i nèti mei, ka na tao eele kodho li'u na. nare bèla èci, ho èki mi lalole na.

source_text: then he poureth water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
target_text: ka na bhori èi asa d'ara bokor iiki cue. hèia na rase haga ana madhutu na sèra. ropa na rase pamèu nare haga dhèu èci, na seka pamango pake bèla dhu pa'èki ètu lalole na.

source_text: so he cometh to simon peter. he saith unto him, lord, dost thou wash my feet?
target_text: na rase haga si èci-èci. ropa d'ai simon petrus, ka simon petrus karèi, aku nèngu na, ama neo rase haga ja'a kahèi, do?

source_text: jesus answered and said unto him, what i do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt understand hereafter.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, deo ne'e ne, èu dhae me'a mèka ngaa dhu ja'a tao ne. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, èu heka me'a kèna.

source_text: peter saith unto him, thou shalt never wash my feet. jesus answered him, if i wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasisu, aku nèngu na, ama baku tao sèmi èèna! ja'a ko'o boe ama rase haga ja'a. hèia yesus peka na, ladhe ja'a rase pamèu boe haga èu, na, èu bisa boe pa'èki dènge ja'a.

source_text: simon peter saith unto him, lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
target_text: ka simon petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, mesa boe haga di. te ngaa ama rase kacui-aai dènge kètu ja'a kahèi!

source_text: jesus saith to him, he that is bathed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu diu le èi, parluu dhoka rase haga di. te ngi'u na mèu le. mema tare'a d'ara miu mèu le, te ngaa miu aa'i mi boe.

source_text: for he knew him that should betray him; therefore said he, ye are not all clean.
target_text: yesus peka sèmi ne'e, lula ne'a le cee ka dhu neo pahie ne. nèti èèna ka, na peka na, miu aa'i mi boe dhu mèu.

source_text: so when he had washed their feet, and taken his garments, and sat down again, he said unto them, know ye what i have done to you?
target_text: ropa yesus pamèu nare haga si, hèia na silu hari kodho na, ka madhèdi hari asa mei. ka na karèi ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, tasamia? ropa ja'a rase haga miu, miu me'a sasoa nèti dhu ja'a tao ne, do aad'o?

source_text: ye call me, teacher, and, lord: and ye say well; for so i am.
target_text: miu tema paroa ja'a ne, ‘ama mese' aa ‘lamatua'. èèna lèke kèna, lula mema hud'i sèmi èèna ku.

source_text: if i then, the lord and the teacher, have washed your feet, ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe mese dènge lamatua miu ne, rase le haga miu nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha sa, na, tasamia hari dènge miu? miu hud'i lalau-lalo'o isi-aanga mi èci dènge èci; conto nuka: miu hud'i èci dènge èci rase haga mi.

source_text: for i have given you an example, that ye also should do as i have done to you.
target_text: te ja'a tao le j'ara ne, sèna ka miu madhutu. ladhe ja'a tao tasamia, na, miu hud'i tao sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: verily, verily, i say unto you, a servant is not greater than his lord; neither one that is sent greater than he that sent him.
target_text: ja'a peka tare'a-re'a dènge miu. ca dhèu ènu bisa boe risi nèti lamatua na. aa ca dhèu pajuu-paleha bisa boe risi nèti dhèu dhu pua nèngu.

source_text: if ye know these things, blessed are ye if ye do them.
target_text: lula miu dhu me'a le j'ara se'e, miu oto ladhe miu tao madhutu.

source_text: i speak not of you all: i know whom i have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, he that eateth my bread lifted up his heel against me.
target_text: ja'a padhai lii boe lula-nèti miu aa'i-aa'i mi. ja'a tadhe mèu dhèu dhu ja'a hag'e kore. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa j'ara ne hud'i j'aj'i ku, sama sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, ‘dhèu dhu madhèdi na'a-ninu pa'èci dènge ja'a, soro kabodho mi ja'a le. '

source_text: from henceforth i tell you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that i am he.
target_text: ja'a peka mema dènge miu, ho ladhe abhu dhèu dhu la'e tèke eele ja'a, na, miu bisa parcaya kèna, na, ja'a ne, kristus.

source_text: verily, verily, i say unto you, he that receiveth whomsoever i send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
target_text: ja'a peka dènge miu tare'a-re'a kèna, dhèu cee dhu bhoke d'ara na ho sèmi nare dhèu dhu ja'a pua, na, nèngu kahèi sèmi nare ja'a. aa cee ka dhu sèmi nare ja'a dènge be'a, na, nèngu sèmi nare kahèi dhèu dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: when jesus had thus said, he was troubled in the spirit, and testified, and said, verily, verily, i say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
target_text: yesus padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, hèia d'ara na mulai susa. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke tare'a. ca dhèu nèti miu, èèna na pahie eele ja'a.

source_text: the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia ana-ana madhutu na palaladha èci dènge èci, te rèngu malaa. re'a boe na, cee ka dhu nèngu peka.

source_text: there was at the table reclining in jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom jesus loved.
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu ca dhèu dhu yesus sue nuka ja'a, yohanis dhu suri sasuri ne. ja'a dhu madhèdi ètu baboa yesus.

source_text: simon peter therefore beckoneth to him, and saith unto him, tell us who it is of whom he speaketh.
target_text: hèia simon petrus pangètu kètu, ho ja'a karèi yesus, cee ka dhu na peka èèna.

source_text: he leaning back, as he was, on jesus' breast saith unto him, lord, who is it?
target_text: ka ja'a eso padètu dènge yesus, ho karèi ne, dhèu dhu ama peka ne, cee?

source_text: jesus therefore answereth, he it is, for whom i shall dip the sop, and give it him. so when he had dipped the sop, he taketh and giveth it to judas, the son of simon iscariot.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo kore roti ca'èta, ho cèb'u asa d'ara mago ne. èèna na ja'a hia mi dhèu dhu ja'a peka deo na. ka yesus cèb'u nare roti ne asa d'ara mago, hèia na j'ole asa yudas, ana simon iskariot.

source_text: and after the sop, then entered satan into him. jesus therefore saith unto him, what thou doest, do quickly.
target_text: ropa sèmi nare roti ne, hèia dhèu aae nidhu maso asa d'ara yudas. ka yesus peka dènge ne, èu neo tao ngaa, na, tao ka lai-lai. pamata ia ka.

source_text: now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo dhu madhèdi ètu sèra re'a rare boe, nga tao ka yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: for some thought, because judas had the bag, that jesus said unto him, buy what things we have need of for the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
target_text: lula yudas dhu tèke doi-dhari, ka abhu dhu pangee, na, yesus pua yudas, peka na, lamu hèli ngaa dhu èdhi parluu, sèna ka tao pesta paska. aa abhu kahèi dhu pangee, na, yesus pua yudas, lamu hia doi d'ai ciki sa, mi dhèu unu boe ngaa-ngaa sèra.

source_text: he then having received the sop went out straightway: and it was night.
target_text: ropa yudas sèmi nare roti ne, hèia la'e dènge ka. lod'o nèngu kalua èèna, dhu mèda le.

source_text: when therefore he was gone out, jesus saith, now is the son of man glorified, and god is glorified in him;
target_text: ropa yudas la'e, hèia yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. d'ai lod'o kèna, ho ama lamatua ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. aa nèti j'ara ne'e, dhèu rèdhi dadedha ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: and god shall glorify him in himself, and straightway shall he glorify him.
target_text: lula ja'a pa'èki dènge ama lamatua, aa pad'elo dadedha na, nèti èèna ka na ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a. na pamata heka.

source_text: little children, yet a little while i am with you. ye shall seek me: and as i said unto the jews, whither i go, ye cannot come; so now i say unto you.
target_text: ana aa'i-aa'i! masi ka ja'a sue miu titu kèna, te ngaa nèbhu heka ja'a pa'ana-lalu eele miu. èèna na miu patangi-tenge ja'a, te ngaa mèdhi boe. lii dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, èci èèna ka dènge dhu ja'a lole dènge ama dhèu yahudi sèra, na, ‘ja'a laku asa era èci dhu miu bisa mèka madhutu. '

source_text: a new commandment i give unto you, that ye love one another; even as i have loved you, that ye also love one another.
target_text: ja'a hia miu lii paredha hiu èci, nuka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi ja'a sue miu. de miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci kahèi.

source_text: by this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
target_text: ladhe miu pasue sèmi èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa re'a, na, miu se, ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: simon peter saith unto him, lord, whither goest thou? jesus answered, whither i go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow afterwards.
target_text: ka simon petrus karèi, peka na, te ama neo lamu mia? hèia yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ja'a laku asa era èci dhu èu bisa mèka lamu. te ngaa lod'o limuri ku, heka èu lamu kèna.

source_text: peter saith unto him, lord, why cannot i follow thee even now? i will lay down my life for thee.
target_text: petrus karèi hari, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ja'a bisa mèka laku hèi? te ja'a dhu pa'èra iisi le ho madhe pala ama!

source_text: jesus answereth, wilt thou lay down thy life for me? verily, verily, i say unto thee, the cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a, do? èu neo soro mamuri èu sèna ka madhe pala ja'a? dhu lèke ka sèmi ne'e: manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te ngaa èu pasili le tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a.

source_text: let not your heart be troubled: believe in god, believe also in me.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, d'ara miu baku susa. parcaya mi ama lamatua, aa parcaya mi ja'a kahèi.

source_text: in my father's house are many mansions; if it were not so, i would have told you; for i go to prepare a place for you.
target_text: ètu èmu ama ku abhu kama ae-ae. ladhe era d'ai boe, tatu ja'a peka le dènge miu. ne'e ne, ja'a neo laku sadia tèke era hia miu ètu nèi.

source_text: and if i go and prepare a place for you, i come again, and will receive you unto myself; that where i am, there ye may be also.
target_text: ladhe ja'a laku aa sadia kore era pea hia miu, pe ja'a lèpa hari mai kore miu ho lati pea asa nèi. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe ja'a ètu mia, na, miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and whither i go, ye know the way.
target_text: miu me'a le j'ara asa era dhu ja'a neo laku.

source_text: thomas saith unto him, lord, we know not whither thou goest; how know we the way?
target_text: te ngaa tomas karèi, peka na, ama! ji'i nge'a boe ama neo lamu mia. de tasamia ka ji'i nge'a j'ara ho la'a asa nèi?

source_text: jesus saith unto him, i am the way, and the truth, and the life: no one cometh unto the father, but by me.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, abhu boe j'ara leo dhu bisa nèti dhèu asa ama ètu sorga. dhodhoka re ja'a mesa-mesa ku. te ja'a ne ka j'ara asa ama lamatua. ja'a ne ka kapua mamola. aa ja'a ne'e ka dhu hia dhèu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: if ye had known me, ye would have known my father also: from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
target_text: ladhe miu tadhe mèu ja'a, na, miu tadhe ama ku kahèi. de karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, miu tadhe nèngu le, dènge mèdhi ne kahèi.

source_text: philip saith unto him, lord, show us the father, and it sufficeth us.
target_text: pelipus manèngi, peka na, ama mese! pad'elo ku ama mu dènge ji'i! te èèna d'ai le.

source_text: jesus saith unto him, have i been so long time with you, and dost thou not know me, philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the father; how sayest thou, show us the father?
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, pelipus. ja'a sama-sama dènge miu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, te ngaa miu tadhe iia mèka ja'a, do? te dhèu dhu nèdhi le ja'a, èèna sama sèmi nèngu nèdhi le ama ku. de, nga tao ka deo na èu peka na, ‘pad'elo ku ama mu dènge ji'i'?

source_text: believest thou not that i am in the father, and the father in me? the words that i say unto you i speak not from myself: but the father abiding in me doeth his works.
target_text: tasamia kèna? lod'o ja'a peka na, ja'a pa'èki dènge ama, aa ama pa'èki dènge ja'a, èu parcaya ja'a, do aad'o? lii padhai dhu ja'a peka dènge miu sèra, mai boe nèti ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa mai nèti ama ku. aa na pake ja'a sèna ka sab'a taruu sasab'a-la'a na.

source_text: believe me that i am in the father, and the father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
target_text: parcaya la mi ja'a ropa ja'a peka na, ja'a dhu pa'èki dènge ama ku, aa nèngu pa'èki dènge ja'a kahèi. te ngaa ladhe miu bisa boe parcaya sèmi èèna, na, parcaya la ja'a, lula miu mèdhi le j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao.

source_text: verily, verily, i say unto you, he that believeth on me, the works that i do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because i go unto the father.
target_text: lii padhai ja'a se, lèke! te dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na nèngu bisa tao j'ara dhu ja'a tao kahèi. te ngaa, lula ja'a laku asa ama ku, ka ngaa dhu dhèu tao sèra, kapai risi nèti dhu ja'a tao.

source_text: and whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will i do, that the father may be glorified in the son.
target_text: miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a, unu hak pake kolongara ja'a. de ladhe miu sabaj'a sad'i manèngi ngaa èèna ka, pake la kolongara ja'a, pe èèna na ja'a tao hia miu. dènge j'ara ne, ja'a ded'e ama ku padedha-dedha, sèna ka hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a.

source_text: if ye shall ask anything in my name, that will i do.
target_text: ja'a peka hari ca tèka: miu sabaj'a ho sad'i manèngi ngaa èèna ka, pake kolongara ja'a, èèna na ja'a tao hia miu.

source_text: if ye love me, ye will keep my commandments.
target_text: yesus peka tabha hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu sue ja'a, na, miu tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra.

source_text: and i will pray the father, and he shall give you another comforter, that he may be with you for ever, even the spirit of truth: whom the world cannot receive; for it beholdeth him not, neither knoweth him: ye know him; for he abideth with you, and shall be in you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ama ku, sèna ka, lod'o ja'a dènge heka miu, na, nèngu hia miu ca dhèu era sarai-maena, sèna ka pad'elo j'ara hia miu. nèngu ne, nuka roh lamatua, dhu aj'a-nori miu ngaa dhu lèke. dhèu cahag'e ètu rai-haha ne ro'o boe sèmi rare ne, lula rèngu bisa boe ladhe rèdhi nèngu, aa tadhe boe nèngu. te ngaa miu tadhe ne, lula na pa'èki dènge miu. aa na muri ètu d'ara miu. èèna na, nèngu dènge miu taa-taa.

source_text: i will not leave you desolate: i come unto you.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a tèke eele boe miu mesa mi, nuka sèmi ana lalu-eela. te ngaa sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a ja'a lèpa hari mai asa miu.

source_text: yet a little while, and the world beholdeth me no more; but ye behold me: because i live, ye shall live also.
target_text: nèbhu heka, dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne rèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa miu mèdhi ja'a. lula ja'a mamuri hari, miu abhu mamuri dhu lèke kahèi.

source_text: in that day ye shall know that i am in my father, and ye in me, and i in you.
target_text: aa ladhe lod'o ja'a mamuri hari, miu me'a mèu, na, ja'a pa'èki dènge ama ku; miu pa'èki dènge ja'a; aa ja'a pa'èki dènge miu kahèi.

source_text: he that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my father, and i will love him, and will manifest myself unto him.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi rare, aa tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra, na, nèngu ka dhu sue ja'a. aa ama ku sue kahèi dhèu dhu sue ja'a. ja'a sue dhèu èèna kahèi, aa pad'elo iisi ja'a dènge ne.

source_text: judas not iscariot saith unto him, lord, what is come to pass that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
target_text: ètu era ne, abhu dhèu èci, ngara na yudas. nèngu ne, yudas iskariot boe. ropa na tadèngi lii padhai yesus, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ama neo pad'elo iisi mi ji'i. te ngaa tasamia ka ama pad'elo boe iisi mi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne?

source_text: jesus answered and said unto him, if a man love me, he will keep my word: and my father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
target_text: yesus dhaa, na, sèmi ne'e. dhèu dhu sue ja'a, nuka dhèu dhu tao madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a. ama ku sue nèngu kahèi. ka ja'a dènge ama ku mamuri d'ara èci dènge ne.

source_text: he that loveth me not keepeth not my words: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the father's who sent me.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu sue boe ja'a, nèngu madhutu boe lii holo-nori ja'a kahèi. aa'i-aa'i dhu miu tadèngi nèti ja'a, mai boe nèti ja'a, te ngaa mai nèti ama ku dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: these things have i spoken unto you, while yet abiding with you.
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka tèke j'ara se'e dènge miu.

source_text: but the comforter, even the holy spirit, whom the father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all that i said unto you.
target_text: te ngaa èèna na, ama ku pua mai ca dhèu era sarai-maena, nuka roh mola-mèci na. roh ne'e ka dhu gati ja'a ètu rai-haha ne. sasab'a na, nuka: aj'a-nori miu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra, dènge pasanèd'e miu j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a padhue-padhai le dènge miu.

source_text: peace i leave with you; my peace i give unto you: not as the world giveth, give i unto you. let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
target_text: pe, ladhe d'ai lod'o ja'a laku, ja'a tao d'ara miu ho mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. dhoka ja'a mesa ku dhu bisa tao d'ara mera-milu sèmi èèna. aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu rai-haha ne bisa boe tao rare d'ara miu mera-milu sèmi èèna. de miu baku susa, aa baku madha'u.

source_text: ye heard how i said to you, i go away, and i come unto you. if ye loved me, ye would have rejoiced, because i go unto the father: for the father is greater than i.
target_text: miu tadèngi mèdhi le, dhu ja'a peka dènge miu, na, ‘ja'a tèke eele miu, te ngaa èèna na mai hari. ' d'ara miu baku susa. te ladhe miu sue ja'a, na, d'ara miu karej'e-karae, lula ja'a laku asa ama ku. ama ku kapai risi nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: and now i have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe.
target_text: sanèd'e, te ja'a dhu peka mema le dènge miu. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe j'ara se j'aj'i ku, na, miu bisa parcaya ja'a.

source_text: i will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world cometh: and he hath nothing in me;
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a padhai lii heka dènge miu. te dhèu aae nidhu dhu mai le. nèngu nèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa koasa na lèke boe ja'a.

source_text: but that the world may know that i love the father, and as the father gave me commandment, even so i do. arise, let us go hence.
target_text: masi ka nidhu ne mai, te ngaa ja'a sab'a taruu madhutu paredha ama ku. ne'e ne ka dhu pad'elo dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, na, ja'a sue ama ku titu kèna. de mai lati ka!

source_text: i am the true vine, and my father is the husbandman.
target_text: yesus padhai lii, peka na, nanene! miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. ja'a ne sama sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua. te ngaa ja'a ne, aj'u anggor dhu lèke! aa ama ku nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a oka.

source_text: every branch in me that beareth not fruit, he taketh it away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he cleanseth it, that it may bear more fruit.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu peka na, nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a, te ngaa sab'a boe ngaa-ngaa, ama ku core eele ne, sama sèmi dhèu sab'a oka dhu pare eele aa'i dadana dhu hua boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu pa'èki pa'èra dènge ja'a, ama ku pamèu kaj'alu ètu d'ara dhèu èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a oka poro pabab'a dadana, sèna ka hua na asa ae.

source_text: already ye are clean because of the word which i have spoken unto you.
target_text: lii holo-nori ja'a se'e, bisa le pamèu d'ara miu, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu sab'a oka dhu pamèu dadana anggor.

source_text: abide in me, and i in you. as the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; so neither can ye, except ye abide in me.
target_text: miu hud'i pa'èki taruu ku dènge ja'a, sama sèmi ja'a pa'èki dènge miu. te dadana dhu pare eele le nèti laa na, bisa boe hua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. miu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa dhu be'a, ladhe miu pa'èki taruu boe dènge ja'a.

source_text: i am the vine, ye are the branches: he that abideth in me, and i in him, the same beareth much fruit: for apart from me ye can do nothing.
target_text: ja'a sama sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua. miu nuka sèmi dadana nèngu. de dhèu dhu pa'èki taruu dènge ja'a, aa ja'a pa'èki dènge nèngu kahèi, na, nèngu èci èèna ka dènge dadana dhu hua ae-ae. te, ladhe miu pa'èki taruu boe dènge ja'a, miu bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a.

source_text: if a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'èki boe taruu dènge ja'a, nèngu cakaraa dadana èci dhu guna heka. dadana sèmi èèna, dhèu poro eele, sèna ka pamango eele ne. hèia pakaboko ho core asa d'ara ai, tunu pakèpu si.

source_text: if ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ask whatsoever ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu pa'èki pa'èra-èra dènge ja'a taruu, aa lii holo-nori ja'a pea taruu ètu d'ara miu, na, ngaa dhu miu manèngi mi ama lamatua, na tao hia miu.

source_text: herein is my father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; and so shall ye be my disciples.
target_text: ladhe miu tao j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae, sama sèmi dadana èci dhu hua ae-ae, èèna ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pad'elo kahèi, na, miu ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: even as the father hath loved me, i also have loved you: abide ye in my love.
target_text: sèmi mia ama sue ja'a, sèmi èèna kahèi ja'a sue miu. miu hud'i pa'èki ku pa'èra-èra dènge ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa pad'elo dènge miu sasue ja'a.

source_text: if ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as i have kept my father's commandments, and abide in his love.
target_text: ladhe miu tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra, na, miu pa'èki taruu dènge ja'a, hèia ja'a bisa pad'elo sasue ja'a mi dedha miu. èèna nuka sèmi ja'a tao madhutu lii paredha ama ku, hèia na pad'elo sasue na taruu mi dedha ja'a.

source_text: these things have i spoken unto you, that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be made full.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, ja'a peka dènge miu j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka d'ara miu karej'e-karae, sama sèmi d'ara ja'a. te madhutu dad'èi ja'a, d'ara miu hud'i karej'e dhu dènge boe too-lane!

source_text: this is my commandment, that ye love one another, even as i have loved you.
target_text: lii paredha ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi ja'a sue miu.

source_text: greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sadia madhe sèna ka angalai na bisa mamuri, nèngu tatu sue tare'a-re'a angalai na. abhu boe sasue dhu risi eele hari sèmi èèna.

source_text: ye are my friends, if ye do the things which i command you.
target_text: ladhe miu madhutu paredha ja'a taruu, miu j'aj'i angalai ja'a.

source_text: no longer do i call you servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but i have called you friends; for all things that i heard from my father i have made known unto you.
target_text: ja'a paroa heka miu, na, ‘ana pua-paleha' ja'a. te ana pua-paleha èci, ne'a iia boe dad'èi lamatua na. te ngaa ja'a paroa miu, na, ‘angalai' ja'a, lula ja'a bhoke patalele le aa'i-aa'i dhu ama ku peka le dènge ja'a.

source_text: ye did not choose me, but i chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the father in my name, he may give it you.
target_text: miu pili boe ja'a. te ngaa ja'a ka dhu pili kore aa ded'e miu ho pakako sasab'a ne. de miu hud'i lami tao j'ara be'a ae-ae dhu taha nare nèbhu. èèna nuka sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua dhu hua na be'a taruu. ladhe miu tao ka sèmi èèna, na, ngaa dhu miu manèngi mi ama ku, tatu na tao hia miu.

source_text: these things i command you, that ye may love one another.
target_text: de dhu ja'a paredha miu sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci.

source_text: if the world hateth you, ye know that it hath hated me before it hated you.
target_text: yesus lii tabha hari, na, ladhe dhèu ètu rai-haha ne d'èi boe miu, na, sanèd'e, te karèi nèti uru ka rèngu d'èi boe ja'a.

source_text: if ye were of the world, the world would love its own: but because ye are not of the world, but i chose you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
target_text: ladhe miu sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, tatu ra sue miu. te ngaa miu sama boe dènge rèngu. te ja'a dhu hag'e kore le miu, sèna ka cèri eele miu nèti rèngu. nèti èèna ka rèngu d'èi boe miu.

source_text: remember the word that i said unto you, a servant is not greater than his lord. if they persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they kept my word, they will keep yours also.
target_text: baku bhèlu dhu ja'a peka kore le dènge miu, na, ‘ca dhèu ana pua-paleha risi boe nèti lamatua na. ' de ladhe rèngu paj'èra ja'a, tatu ra paj'èra miu kahèi. ladhe rèngu nanene ka lii holo-nori ja'a, na, rèngu nanene miu kahèi.

source_text: but all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
target_text: èèna na ra paj'èra miu, lula miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. te rèngu tadhe boe nèngu dhu pua ja'a kahèi.

source_text: if i had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no excuse for their sin.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhae padhai lii kèdhi mèka dènge rèngu, aa pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke mi rèngu, na, ra pangee taruu, na, rèngu dènge boe sala ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa ja'a mai le, aa padhai dènge rèngu sèmi èèna. de ladhe rèngu tao sala, na, rèngu abhu boe j'ara ho peka na, ‘wee! ji'i se nge'a boe, na, dhu ji'i tao sèra, sala. '

source_text: he that hateth me hateth my father also.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi boe ja'a, nèngu d'èi boe ama ku kahèi.

source_text: if i had not done among them the works which none other did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my father.
target_text: ja'a tao kèdhi le tadha malaa rupa-rupa ètu katanga madha ra, dhu dhèu leo tao rèdhi mèka. ladhe ja'a tao boe j'ara sèra sa, rèngu sala boe kahèi ladhe ro'o boe sèmi rare ja'a. aa te ngaa rèngu dhu rèdhi le tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao sèra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu d'èi boe ja'a, aa d'èi boe ama ku ètu sorga kahèi.

source_text: but this cometh to pass, that the word may be fulfilled that is written in their law, they hated me without a cause.
target_text: te ngaa j'ara se'e se dhu j'aj'i le, sèna ka madhutu ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara atora ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ‘rèngu d'èi boe ja'a. aa te ngaa nanasa rèngu se'e dènge boe kolo-kapua. '

source_text: but when the comforter is come, whom i will send unto you from the father, even the spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the father, he shall bear witness of me:
target_text: te ngaa dhèu era sarai-maena èèna neo mai. nèngu èèna, nuka roh dhu tao miu me'a mèu ngaa dhu lèke. na mai nèti ama ku. ladhe ja'a laku le asa ama ku, pe ja'a hia roh na mai asa miu. na lole dènge miu lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: and ye also bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
target_text: èèna na miu peka dènge dhèu lula-nèti ja'a kahèi, lula miu bera-bera dènge ja'a karèi nèti uru j'ara ka.

source_text: these things have i spoken unto you, that ye should not be caused to stumble.
target_text: ja'a peka le j'ara se'e dènge miu, sèna ka miu baku pakaj'èu nèti ja'a.

source_text: they shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the hour cometh, that whosoever killeth you shall think that he offereth service unto god.
target_text: èèna na dhèu yahudi sèra babège eele miu nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra. mesa boe j'ara ne'e di, te bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o na, ladhe dhèu pamadhe miu, ra pangee, na, rèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke hia ama lamatua.

source_text: and these things will they do, because they have not known the father, nor me.
target_text: rèngu tao miu sèmi èèna, lula rèngu tadhe iia boe ja'a. aa rèngu tadhe boe ama ku kahèi.

source_text: but these things have i spoken unto you, that when their hour is come, ye may remember them, how that i told you. and these things i said not unto you from the beginning, because i was with you.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka le j'ara se'e dènge miu, sèna ka lèpa lod'o limuri ladhe j'aj'i, miu bisa sanèd'e, na, ja'a dhu peka mema le. te ngaa ja'a peka uuru mèka dènge miu, lula ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era.

source_text: but now i go unto him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, whither goest thou?
target_text: yesus aj'a tabha hari, peka na, limuri ne, ja'a neo lèpa asa nèngu dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. te ngaa abhu boe nèti miu ca dhèu sa dhu karèi, na, ‘ama neo lamu mia? '

source_text: but because i have spoken these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu peka le dènge miu, nèti èèna ka d'ara miu susa.

source_text: nevertheless i tell you the truth: it is expedient for you that i go away; for if i go not away, the comforter will not come unto you; but if i go, i will send him unto you.
target_text: te ngaa, ngaa dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. ladhe ja'a laku, na, miu abhu babe'a na. te ladhe ja'a laku boe, dhèu era sarai-maena èèna mai boe pad'elo j'ara hia miu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a laku, na, ja'a hia ne mai dènge miu.

source_text: and he, when he is come, will convict the world in respect of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
target_text: pe ladhe na mai, na bhoke ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, ka re'a, na, d'ara dènge tatao ra, sala. na pamako si, sèna ka rèngu madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. aa na pasanèd'e rèngu, na, ladhe lamatua pama'ète lii langu ra, peka na, rèngu se sala, do sala boe.

source_text: of sin, because they believe not on me;
target_text: dhèu era sarai-maena èèna pad'elo sasala ra, lula rèngu lèka boe ja'a.

source_text: of righteousness, because i go to the father, and ye behold me no more;
target_text: nèngu pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. lula ja'a lèpa asa ama ku, èèna na miu mèdhi heka ja'a. nèti èèna ka, dhèu era sarai-maena ne mai gati ja'a.

source_text: of judgment, because the prince of this world hath been judged.
target_text: nèngu peka kahèi, na, ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu dènge mola, lula lamatua dhu pama'ète nare le lii langu dhèu aae nidhu, dhu paredha rai-haha ne.

source_text: i have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
target_text: abhu j'ara ae era dhu ja'a neo peka dènge miu, te ngaa ne'e ne miu dhae bisa mèka me'a.

source_text: howbeit when he, the spirit of truth, is come, he shall guide you into all the truth: for he shall not speak from himself; but what things soever he shall hear, these shall he speak: and he shall declare unto you the things that are to come.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe roh dhu pad'elo j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke èèna mai ka, nèngu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka miu bisa me'a j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke. nèngu padhai lii boe nèti d'ara na mesa, te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu na tadèngi sèra mai nèti ama ku. nèngu neo peka dènge miu kahèi, ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i.

source_text: he shall glorify me: for he shall take of mine, and shall declare it unto you.
target_text: nèngu neo ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha, lula na neo bhoke patalele aa'i hia miu, j'ara dhu lèke lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: all things whatsoever the father hath are mine: therefore said i, that he taketh of mine, and shall declare it unto you.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu unu ama ku, unu ja'a kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka deo na, roh lamatua èèna na bhoke patalele aa'i mèu-mèu j'ara dhu lèke lula-nèti ja'a, aa pad'elo dènge miu.

source_text: a little while, and ye behold me no more; and again a little while, and ye shall see me.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai, peka na, nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe kahèi, miu mèdhi hari ja'a.

source_text: some of his disciples therefore said one to another, what is this that he saith unto us, a little while, and ye behold me not; and again a little while, and ye shall see me: and, because i go to the father?
target_text: ka ana madhutu na cahag'e papeka èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, a'abhu ama èèna, ngaa kèna? ka peka na, ‘nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe kahèi, miu mèdhi hari ja'a. ' aa, nga tao ka na padhai lii, na, ‘lula ja'a neo laku asa ama ku'?

source_text: they said therefore, what is this that he saith, a little while? we know not what he saith.
target_text: hèia ra pakarèi, peka na, a'abhu na ngaa, dhu peka na, ‘nèbhu heka'? èdhi te'a boe sasoa na.

source_text: jesus perceived that they were desirous to ask him, and he said unto them, do ye inquire among yourselves concerning this, that i said, a little while, and ye behold me not, and again a little while, and ye shall see me?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a rèngu neo karèi ne ca j'ara. hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, deo na ja'a peka na, ‘nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe, miu mèdhi hari ja'a kahèi. ' miu pakarèi sèmi èèna, si?

source_text: verily, verily, i say unto you, that ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
target_text: be'a kahèi, ladhe miu neo me'a sèmi èèna. ja'a neo peka dènge miu kahèi sèmi ne'e: èèna na miu tangi dènge d'ara susa, te ngaa dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne karej'e-karae. masi ka d'ara miu susa, te ngaa èèna na d'ara miu karej'e-karae hari.

source_text: a woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but when she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for the joy that a man is born into the world.
target_text: j'ara ne sama sèmi bhèni ca dhèu kabake pèd'a d'ai lod'o neo nara iisi. d'ara na rasa bia, lula d'ai lod'o j'aj'èra na kèna. te ngaa ladhe nara iisi nare, na, j'aj'èra na ele. te d'ara na karej'e, lula abhu dhèu hiu èci dhu mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: and ye therefore now have sorrow: but i will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no one taketh away from you.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. ne'e ne miu tangi dènge d'ara susa. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ja'a mai paraga hari dènge miu, ka d'ara miu j'aj'i hari karej'e-karae. aa ladhe j'ara ne j'aj'i, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa bhabhae rare d'ara karae miu.

source_text: and in that day ye shall ask me no question. verily, verily, i say unto you, if ye shall ask anything of the father, he will give it you in my name.
target_text: aa ladhe j'ara sèmi sèra j'aj'i, miu pakarèi heka ngaa-ngaa dènge ja'a. tare'a! ja'a peka hari dènge miu kèna, na, sad'i miu manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti ama ku, pake kolongara ja'a, èèna na nèngu tao sèmi èèna hia miu.

source_text: hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be made full.
target_text: toke d'ai sange ne'e, miu dhae manèngi mèka ngaa-ngaa pake kolongara ja'a. de manèngi la, sèna ka miu abhu. dènge j'ara ne, d'ara miu bisa karej'e tare'a-re'a.

source_text: these things have i spoken unto you in dark sayings: the hour cometh, when i shall no more speak unto you in dark sayings, but shall tell you plainly of the father.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, toke d'ai sange ne'e, ja'a tema aj'a-nori miu pake lii pakasame. te ngaa bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o na, ja'a aj'a miu pake heka lii pakasame. te ja'a neo peka mola-mola lula-nèti ama ku.

source_text: in that day ye shall ask in my name: and i say not unto you, that i will pray the father for you;
target_text: ladhe lod'o èèna d'ai, na, miu mesa mi dhu sabaj'a ho manèngi mi ama ku pake kolongara ja'a. baku dhoka ja'a mesa ku di dhu sabaj'a hia miu.

source_text: for the father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that i came forth from the father.
target_text: te ama ku sue miu, lula miu sue ja'a. aa miu me'a mèu, na, ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: i came out from the father, and am come into the world: again, i leave the world, and go unto the father.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a tèke eele ama ku, ho mai pea taha ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a neo tèke eele rai-haha ne, ho laku pea pa'èci hari dènge ne.

source_text: his disciples say, lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no dark saying.
target_text: tadèngi rare sèmi ne'e, hèia ana madhutu yesus se lii, aku rèngu na, de ne'e ne, ama padhai lii mola-mola kèna, aa aj'a-nori pake heka lii pakasame.

source_text: now know we that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from god.
target_text: ji'i nge'a, na, ama dhu me'a aa'i mèu j'ara-j'ara. dhèu parluu heka sèku ama dènge karèi ngaa-ngaa, lula ama dhu me'a uru le ngaa dhu ra neo karèi, aa lii dhaa na tasa mera mia. j'ara ne peka dènge ji'i, na, ama mai nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: jesus answered them, do ye now believe?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi, aku nèngu na, tare'a, do? limuri ne, miu lèka ja'a, do?

source_text: behold, the hour cometh, yea, is come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet i am not alone, because the father is with me.
target_text: sèmi ne'e. nèbhu boe, mulai ciki-diki ne, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai paceb'a. ca dhèu-dhèu ka rai tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku, ho la'e lu'u. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a mesa ku boe, lula ama ku bera-bera dènge ja'a.

source_text: these things have i spoken unto you, that in me ye may have peace. in the world ye have tribulation: but be of good cheer; i have overcome the world.
target_text: ja'a peka tèke le j'ara se dènge miu, sèna ka d'ara miu mera-milu, lula miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. te bèli-camèd'a dhèu ètu rai-haha ne pasusa dènge paj'èra miu. te ngaa pa'èra d'ara miu, lula ja'a segi aa'i le koasa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne!

source_text: these things spake jesus; and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, father, the hour is come; glorify thy son, that the son may glorify thee: even as thou gavest him authority over all flesh, that to all whom thou hast given him, he should give eternal life.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia na ladhe asa dedha-liru, ka sabaj'a, peka na: ama pasue. lod'o d'ai kèna ho ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. ja'a ne, ana ama. ama dhu pangèd'u ja'a hak, sèna ka lalau-lalo'o dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ama hia hak ne, sèna ka ja'a hia mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u mai ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. de ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha ho pad'elo dadedha ama.

source_text: and this is life eternal, that they should know thee the only true god, and him whom thou didst send, even jesus christ.
target_text: j'ara abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, sèmi ne'e: dhèu hud'i tadhe ama ku, nuka ama lamatua dhu lèke. dhu leo aad'o. aa rèngu hud'i tadhe ku ja'a kahèi, nuka yesus kristus, dhu ama pua mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i glorified thee on the earth, having accomplished the work which thou hast given me to do.
target_text: ja'a pad'elo le dadedha ama ètu rai-haha ne. ja'a pa'èle le sasab'a dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a.

source_text: and now, father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which i had with thee before the world was.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o èdhi paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, ja'a bera-bera le dènge ama. lod'o èèna, dadedha ja'a èci èèna ka dènge dadedha ama. ne'e ne ja'a neo lèpa hari asa ama. de ja'a manèngi ho ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha, sèna ka dadedha ja'a sama sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: i manifested thy name unto the men whom thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them to me; and they have kept thy word.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii sabaj'a, peka na, ama hia le dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. ja'a aj'a-nori si, ho rèngu tadhe ama. rèngu j'aj'i dhèu ama, hèia ama pangèd'u si j'aj'i unu ja'a kahèi. ka ra tao madhutu lii holo-nori ama.

source_text: now they know that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are from thee:
target_text: limuri ne re'a le, na, j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a sèra, kapua ra nèti ama.

source_text: for the words which thou gavest me i have given unto them; and they received them, and knew of a truth that i came forth from thee, and they believed that thou didst send me.
target_text: te ja'a aj'a kore le rèngu lii holo-nori dhu ama hia mi ja'a. rèngu sèmi rare kahèi lii holo-nori se'e. re'a kahèi, na, ja'a mai nèti ama. ka ra parcaya, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i pray for them: i pray not for the world, but for those whom thou hast given me; for they are thine:
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a hia rèngu. ne'e ne, ja'a sabaj'a boe hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa ja'a sabaj'a hia dhèu-dhèu dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a, te rèngu se unu ama.
