source_text: and all things that are mine are thine, and thine are mine: and i am glorified in them.
target_text: te aa'i-aa'i unu ja'a, sèra sa unu ama kahèi. aa aa'i-aa'i unu ama, sèra sa unu ja'a kahèi. ka dhèu unu ja'a se, dhu ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha.

source_text: and i am no more in the world, and these are in the world, and i come to thee. holy father, keep them in thy name which thou hast given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
target_text: ja'a pea boe taruu ètu rai-haha ne, lula nèbhu heka ja'a lèpa hari asa ama ku. te ngaa dhèu se hud'i pea taruu ètu rai-haha ne. ama dhu mola-mèci. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama ladhe-leru si pake koasa dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a. ja'a manèngi kahèi ho rèngu pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, nuka sèmi ja'a pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci dènge ama.

source_text: while i was with them, i kept them in thy name which thou hast given me: and i guarded them, and not one of them perished, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
target_text: karèi nèti ja'a ètu rai-haha ne bera-bera dènge rèngu, ja'a leru si, lula rèngu j'aj'i le dhèu ama. ja'a j'aga aa sanoro si, sèna ka rèngu pa'èki taruu dènge ama. abhu boe dhu ele. dhodhoka yudas di dhu cèri eele, madhutu ngaa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua karèi nèti uru èèna.

source_text: but now i come to thee; and these things i speak in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
target_text: limuri ne, ja'a neo lèpa hari asa ama. ja'a peka le j'ara se'e lod'o ja'a ètu rai-haha ne era. dènge sèmi ne'e, dhèu unu ja'a se d'ara rèngu bisa karej'e-karae taruu, sama sèmi d'ara ja'a.

source_text: i have given them thy word; and the world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as i am not of the world.
target_text: ja'a dhu peka-padhai le dènge rèngu lii holo-nori ama. dhèu leo ètu rai-haha tèka d'ara dènge dhèu unu ja'a, lula mamuri dhèu ja'a, sama boe dènge mamuri rèngu. ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi, te ja'a sama boe sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: i pray not that thou shouldest take them from the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil one.
target_text: ladhe ja'a sabaj'a, ja'a manèngi boe ho ama more si nèti rai-haha ne. aad'o! te ngaa ja'a manèngi, ho ama j'aga si, sèna ka ra pakaj'èu nèti bhabhelu.

source_text: they are not of the world, even as i am not of the world.
target_text: rèngu sama boe dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, èci èèna ka dènge ja'a dhu sama boe kahèi dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: sanctify them in the truth: thy word is truth.
target_text: pake ngaa dhu lèke, sèna ka pamèu d'ara ra. te dhu lèke ka, lii holo-nori ama.

source_text: as thou didst send me into the world, even so sent i them into the world.
target_text: ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. ka ja'a pua-paleha rèngu kahèi sèmi èèna, sèna ka rèngu mamuri pale-lème ètu talora aae dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: and for their sakes i sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
target_text: ja'a j'aga ngi'u ja'a ho mola-mèci taruu hia mi ama. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu unu ja'a j'aga mamuri ra kahèi sèna ka mola-mèci hia mi ama. te lii holo-nori ama dhu lèke, dhu tao si ho ra saraka mamuri rèngu kateme mi ama.

source_text: neither for these only do i pray, but for them also that believe on me through their word;
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii manèngi-mangaj'i na, aku nèngu na, ja'a sabaj'a, mesa boe hia mi dhèu limuri ne'e di, te ngaa hia rèngu dhu lod'o limuri dhu parcaya ja'a kahèi, lula lii padhai dhèu se'e.

source_text: that they may all be one; even as thou, father, art in me, and i in thee, that they also may be in us: that the world may believe that thou didst send me.
target_text: ama, ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, sama sèmi èdhi pa'èki j'aj'i èci. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu j'aj'i èci dènge èdhi, ho hud'i laa dhèu rai-haha ne bisa parcaya, na, ama ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: and the glory which thou hast given me i have given unto them; that they may be one, even as we are one;
target_text: ama pad'elo le dadedha ja'a mi dhèu sèra. ka ja'a ded'e le rèngu padedha-dedha sama sèmi ja'a. dènge jara ne'e, rèngu pa'èki j'aj'i èci, sama sèmi èdhi kahèi j'aj'i èci.

source_text: i in them, and thou in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that thou didst send me, and lovedst them, even as thou lovedst me.
target_text: ja'a pa'èki dènge rèngu. ama kahèi pa'èki dènge ja'a. rèngu hud'i pa'èki j'aj'i èci sèmi èèna ku, toke ra mamuri d'ara èci dènge be'a. te ladhe rèngu mamuri d'ara èci sèmi èèna, dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne re'a, na, ama dhu sue si, nuka sèmi ama sue ja'a. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu re'a kahèi, na, ama ku dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: father, i desire that they also whom thou hast given me be with me where i am, that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
target_text: ama, ja'a d'èi sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a, bera-bera dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo, sèna ka rèngu bisa ladhe rèdhi ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. te ama sue ja'a mema-mema le, lod'o èdhi dhae paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne.

source_text: o righteous father, the world knew thee not, but i knew thee; and these knew that thou didst send me;
target_text: ama pasue dhu d'ara mola. te ngaa dhèu ètu rai-haha ne tadhe boe ama. ja'a tadhe ama. aa dhèu unu ja'a re'a kahèi, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: and i made known unto them thy name, and will make it known; that the love wherewith thou lovedst me may be in them, and i in them.
target_text: ja'a dhu peka le dènge rèngu, ama ne, cee. aa èèna na ja'a loe boe peka dènge rèngu sèmi èèna, lula ja'a d'èi ho rèngu re'a mèu sasue ama. te sasue dhu rèngu re'a rèdhi ne'e ne, èci èèna ka dènge sasue ama mi dedha ja'a, sèna ka hud'i laa ja'a pa'èki taruu dènge rèngu.

source_text: when jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook kidron, where was a garden, into which he entered, himself and his disciples.
target_text: ropa yesus manèngi-mangaj'i nare, hèia la'e palere-lere dènge ana madhutu na. lasi asa d'ara oka cue ètu sebhe loko kidron.

source_text: now judas also, who betrayed him, knew the place: for jesus oft-times resorted thither with his disciples. judas then, having received the band of soldiers, and officers from the chief priests and the pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi sèra dènge dhèu-dhèu nèti partei agama parisi saraka mi yudas, sordad'u dènge dhèu j'aga pèri-pèri. te nèngu neo pahie eele yesus. yudas ne'a oka ne kahèi, lula yesus pakaboko dènge ana madhutu na ètu era ne'e pèri-pèri hari le. ka yudas si lasi asa oka ne rèti dènge ob'o, labhu lantera dènge rèka.

source_text: jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were coming upon him, went forth, and saith unto them, whom seek ye?
target_text: aa te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a uru le aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na j'aj'i. hèia ara la'e asa madha rèngu, ka na lii, peka na, miu tenge cee?

source_text: they answered him, jesus of nazareth. jesus saith unto them, i am he. and judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
target_text: ka ra b'ala, na, ji'i tenge dhèu èci, ngara na yesus, nèti rae nasaret. ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka ne'e. lod'o èèna, yudas dhu titu dènge dhèu se'e. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pahie yesus.

source_text: when therefore he said unto them, i am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
target_text: ropa yesus peka na, ja'a ka ne'e, hèia dhèu se hari kabodho, ka ra bèbha.

source_text: again therefore he asked them, whom seek ye? and they said, jesus of nazareth.
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari, na, miu tenge cee? hèia dhèu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, yesus, dhèu nasaret.

source_text: jesus answered, i told you that i am he; if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, deo na ja'a peka kore le, na, nèngu ka ja'a ne. de ladhe miu tenge ja'a, na, baku kèpe dhèu leo. hud'i si lasi.

source_text: that the word might be fulfilled which he spake, of those whom thou hast given me i lost not one.
target_text: nèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, sèna ka pamèci dènge ngaa dhu nèngu peka nèdhi le, na, ama. aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a, abhu boe èci sa dhu ele.

source_text: simon peter therefore having a sword drew it, and struck the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. now the servant's name was malchus.
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon petrus nèti dènge samala iiki èci. ka na bete ho neo pare dhèu. kabèdhi laa, na pare pama'ète rèu dhilu g'ana nèti dhèu èci. dhèu ne ngara na malkus. nèngu ne, ana pua-paleha nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: jesus therefore said unto peter, put up the sword into the sheath: the cup which the father hath given me, shall i not drink it?
target_text: ka yesus pua petrus, aku nèngu na, we, petrus! pasaluu hari samala èu èèna asa d'ara sope la'e. te ama ku dhu peka le, na, ja'a hud'i paraga ku dènge j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne. de hud'i laa! èèna nuka sèmi nèngu hia ja'a galaa èci dhu isi na pèd'u-èd'u. hud'i laa ja'a kinu toke èle.

source_text: so the band and the chief captain, and the officers of the jews, seized jesus and bound him,
target_text: hèia komedhaa, sordad'u dènge dhèu j'aga aa'i-aa'i ra kèpe yesus, ka ra èki ne.

source_text: and led him to annas first; for he was father in law to caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
target_text: ka lere rèti uuru ne asa anas. anas ne, ama dhèu èmu kayafas. tèu èèna, kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: now caiaphas was he that gave counsel to the jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
target_text: kayafas ne'e ka dhu peka nèdhi le dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi, aku nèngu na, be'a risi hia miu, ladhe dhèu èci madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and simon peter followed jesus, and so did another disciple. now that disciple was known unto the high priest, and entered in with jesus into the court of the high priest;
target_text: simon petrus dhu madhutu yesus re limuri palere-lere dènge ana madhutu yesus èci, nuka ja'a, yohanis ne. lula kètu kapai risi agama yahudi tadhe ja'a, nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa maso kahèi palere-lere dènge yesus asa madha èmu na.

source_text: but peter was standing at the door without. so the other disciple, who was known unto the high priest, went out and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in peter.
target_text: te ngaa petrus titu ètu li'u, padètu dènge hèb'a tedhe. hèia ja'a laku asa li'u, ho peka dènge dhèu bhèni èci dhu j'aga hèb'a tedhe ne, sèna ka kèti petrus asa d'ara.

source_text: the maid therefore that kept the door saith unto peter, art thou also one of this man's disciples? he saith, i am not.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne karèi petrus, aku nèngu na, wee! èu ne, ca dhèu ana madhutu dhèu nèi, si? te ngaa petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o!

source_text: now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals; for it was cold; and they were warming themselves: and peter also was with them, standing and warming himself.
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke dènge hèru pacuhi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu madhenga dènge ana pua-paleha sèra dhu titu manyiru ai. ka petrus la'e manyiru ai sama-sama dènge rèngu kahèi.

source_text: the high priest therefore asked jesus of his disciples, and of his teaching.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu kapai risi dhui nèti agama yahudi parisa yesus lula-nèti a'aj'a na, aa lula-nèti ana madhutu na.

source_text: jesus answered him, i have spoken openly to the world; i ever taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where all the jews come together; and in secret spake i nothing.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge nèngu, aku nèngu na, ja'a peka paled'a, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa tadèngi. ja'a tema aj'a ètu era dhu biasa dhèu yahudi èdhi pakaboko, nuka ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a èdhi, dènge ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ja'a padhai lii pahuni kèdhi boe.

source_text: why askest thou me? ask them that have heard me, what i spake unto them: behold, these know the things which i said.
target_text: nga tao ka èu karèi ja'a? karèi la dhèu-dhèu dhu nanene lii padhai ja'a. te, tatu re'a ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai.

source_text: and when he had said this, one of the officers standing by struck jesus with his hand, saying, answerest thou the high priest so?
target_text: ropa na padhai lii sèmi èèna, dhèu j'aga èci dhu titu ètu èèna, tèb'e yesus, ka na peka na, èu baku padhai lii sèmi èèna dènge kètu kapai risi.

source_text: jesus answered him, if i have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ladhe ja'a padhai lii sale, na, pad'elo mia dhu sale nèti lii padhai deo na. te ngaa ladhe ja'a peka lèke, nga tao ka èu tèb'e ja'a?

source_text: annas therefore sent him bound unto caiaphas the high priest.
target_text: èle ka, anas pua dhèu lere ne asa kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. lod'o lere rèti ne, yesus dhu ra èki era.

source_text: now simon peter was standing and warming himself. they said therefore unto him, art thou also one of his disciples? he denied, and said, i am not.
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon petrus titu manyiru ai era. ka dhèu leo dhu ètu èèna, karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu ne, ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu dhèu nèi, si? te ngaa petrus pasili, peka na, aad'o!

source_text: one of the servants of the high priest, being a kinsman of him whose ear peter cut off, saith, did not i see thee in the garden with him?
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu sab'a èci nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. nèngu ne, pa'a'ari kahèi dènge dhèu dhu petrus pare pama'ète rèu dhilu na. hèia dhèu ne karèi petrus, peka na, waa! deo na, èu ne ètu d'ara oka nèi, si? te ja'a kèdhi èu ètu nèi!

source_text: peter therefore denied again: and straightway the cock crew.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili hari, hèia manu kokotoo dènge.

source_text: they lead jesus therefore from caiaphas into the prætorium: and it was early; and they themselves entered not into the prætorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the passover.
target_text: d'ara mad'ae aae era, lere rèti yesus nèti kayafas asa èmu jabatan gubernur ètu benteng sordad'u roma. dhèu yahudi se maso boe asa èmu dhèu roma, te èèna pakaj'alu rèngu. te ladhe ra maso, na, rèngu bisa boe ra'a pesta paska.

source_text: pilate therefore went out unto them, and saith, what accusation bring ye against this man?
target_text: hèia gubernur pilatus la'e asa li'u paraga dènge dhèu yahudi se. ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu pèci sasala ngaa mi dedha dhèu ne'e?

source_text: they answered and said unto him, if this man were not an evil-doer, we should not have delivered him up unto thee.
target_text: hèia ra b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama. ladhe nèngu ne dhèu bhelu-katub'a boe, na, tatu ji'i mai boe asa madha ama. ngaa hari ji'i mai saraka ne asa kacui-aai ama.

source_text: pilate therefore said unto them, take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law. the jews said unto him, it is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
target_text: ka gubernur peka dènge dhèu se, na, sèmi ne'e. hud'i laa miu ka dhu uri lii langu na, madhutu atora miu dhèu yahudi. hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se, peka na, bisa boe ama. ji'i dhèu yahudi dènge heka hak ho pama'ète hahuku madhe. dhoka miu dhèu paredha roma di dhu dènge hak èèna.

source_text: that the word of jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying by what manner of death he should die.
target_text: lii padhai lii rèngu èèna, palèke dènge lii padhai dhu uru èèna yesus peka nèdhi le. te nèngu dhu peka le dènge dhèu unu na sèra, na, nèngu madhe madhutu j'ara paredha roma, nuka ra paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: pilate therefore entered again into the prætorium, and called jesus, and said unto him, art thou the king of the jews?
target_text: hèia gubernur maso hari asa d'ara benteng sordad'u. ka na paroa yesus, hèia na karèi, peka na, èu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, do?

source_text: jesus answered, sayest thou this of thyself, or did others tell it thee concerning me?
target_text: te ngaa yesus karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ama ka peka sèmi èèna, do abhu dhèu leo ka dhu peka dènge ama lula-nèti ja'a?

source_text: pilate answered, am i a jew? thine own nation and the chief priests delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
target_text: hèia gubernur dhaa, na, eee! ja'a ne dhèu yahudi boe. ana kabarai èu mesa mu ka dhu saraka èu. ngaa hari kètu agama yahudi sèra. èu ne, tao sala ngaa? èu peka sèku!

source_text: jesus answered, my kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that i should not be delivered to the jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
target_text: ka yesus peka na, ja'a ne, dhèu aae boe nèti rai-haha ne. te ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhèu aae sama sèmi èèna, tatu dhèu-dhèu ja'a palab'a le, ka dhèu yahudi kèpe boe ja'a. tare'a, ja'a ne dhèu aae. te ngaa ca dhèu sa ètu rai-haha ne ded'e boe ja'a.

source_text: pilate therefore said unto him, art thou a king then? jesus answered, thou sayest that i am a king. to this end have i been born, and to this end am i come into the world, that i should bear witness unto the truth. every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
target_text: hèia gubernur karèi hari, peka na, de èu ne, dhèu aae, do? ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama unu mu ka dhu peka, na, ja'a ne dhèu aae. dhu lèke ka, rara iisi ja'a ne, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu aae. ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne ho j'aj'i dhèu aae, sèna ka ja'a peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu kèpe pa'èra j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, rèngu sèra ka dhu nanene ja'a.

source_text: pilate saith unto him, what is truth? and when he had said this, he went out again unto the jews, and saith unto them, i find no crime in him.
target_text: ka gubernur karèi, peka na, dhu lèke èèna, sèmi ngaa sa? ropa gubernur pilatus padhai lii nare, hèia kalua hari la'e asa dhèu yahudi sèra. ka na peka, ja'a parisa le nèngu, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: but ye have a custom, that i should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that i release unto you the king of the jews?
target_text: te ngaa miu dhu tema le, tèu mai-tèu mai lod'o d'ai pesta paska sèmi ne'e, ja'a patabuli ana bèdho ca dhèu hia miu. de tèu ne'e mo'o sèna ka ja'a patabuli dhèu aae yahudi miu, do tasamia?

source_text: they cried out therefore again, saying, not this man, but barabbas. now barabbas was a robber.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, baku patabuli dhèu èèna! patabuli barabas di! barabas ne, ca dhèu dhu bhelu titu kèna.

source_text: then pilate therefore took jesus, and scourged him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, gubernur pilatus pua sordad'u na lasi kalabhe yesus pake gui.

source_text: and the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and arrayed him in a purple garment; and they came unto him, and said, hail, king of the jews! and they struck him with their hands.
target_text: aa sordad'u se'e rare kalai aj'u padhudhu kahèi, ho ènyu tao solo. ka ra lalilu solo ne mi kètu yesus, nuka sèmi rèngu neo ded'e dhèu aae hiu dhu pake solo dhèu aae. aa te ngaa sasoa na, ra neo pahahe ne di. hèia ra papake yesus kodho madhera èci dhu mea sanama mangèru, nuka sèmi dhèu aae biasa pake. aa ra sasei ne, peka na, tabea, dhèu aae yahudi! sordad'u se tèb'e ne g'ana-kariu kahèi.

source_text: and pilate went out again, and saith unto them, behold, i bring him out to you, that ye may know that i find no crime in him.
target_text: ka gubernur la'e hari catèka peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! ja'a kèti ne asa li'u hia miu. te ngaa miu hud'i me'a ku, na, ja'a parisa kore le, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. and pilate saith unto them, behold, the man!
target_text: ropa rèti yesus asa li'u, nèngu dhu pake era solo padhudhu dènge kodho madhera dhu mea sanama mangèru. hèia gubernur lii dènge dhèu ae se, peka na, ladhe ku, dhèu ne.

source_text: when therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they cried out, saying, crucify him, crucify him! pilate saith unto them, take him yourselves, and crucify him: for i find no crime in him.
target_text: ropa kètu agama dènge dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i sèra ladhe rèdhi yesus, hèia ra pa'oo-parodha palere-lere, peka na, pamadhe ne! paku ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha! te ngaa gubernur peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa miu ka dhu mèti ne, lami pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ja'a abhu boe sasala na èci sa, dhu palèke dènge hahuku madhe.

source_text: the jews answered him, we have a law, and by that law he ought to die, because he made himself the son of god.
target_text: dhèu yahudi dhaa, aku rèngu na, ji'i dènge atora nèti ama lamatua. madhutu atora ne, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku, lula na ded'e iisi na j'aj'i ana ama lamatua.

source_text: when pilate therefore heard this saying, he was the more afraid;
target_text: ropa gubernur tadèngi lii padhai ra, hèia asa na madha'u.

source_text: and he entered into the prætorium again, and saith unto jesus, whence art thou? but jesus gave him no answer.
target_text: ka la'e hari asa d'ara benteng, hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, èu ne, dhèu mia? te ngaa yesus bhoka boe hèb'a.

source_text: pilate therefore saith unto him, speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that i have power to release thee, and have power to crucify thee?
target_text: ka gubernur jèke yesus, peka na, eeh! nga tao ka èu b'ala boe ja'a? èu dhu me'a, si? ja'a ne, dènge koasa pamadhe èu, do, patabuli èu.

source_text: jesus answered him, thou wouldest have no power against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath greater sin.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama. ladhe ama dhu dènge koasa sèmi èèna, na, lula ama abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga. te dhodhoka nèngu di dhu hia ama koasa èèna, sèna ka tao ngaa èci sa hia mi ja'a ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu saraka ja'a asa ama, rèngu sèra ka dhu pasae sasala bia risi.

source_text: upon this pilate sought to release him: but the jews cried out, saying, if thou release this man, thou art not cæsar's friend: every one that maketh himself a king speaketh against cæsar.
target_text: karèi nèti èèna ka, gubernur tenge j'ara ho patabuli yesus. te ngaa dhèu yahudi se pa'oo palere-lere, aku rèngu na, ladhe ama patabuli dhèu ne, tatu ama dhu pa'angalai boe dènge dhèu aae kapai, keser. te dhèu dhu ded'e ngi'u na j'aj'i dhèu aae, nèngu èèna lab'a keser.

source_text: when pilate therefore heard these words, he brought jesus out, and sat down on the judgment-seat at a place called the pavement, but in hebrew, gabbatha.
target_text: ka ropa gubernur tadèngi lii padhai dhèu se, hèia na pua rèti yesus asa li'u. ka gubernur madhèdi ètu kadera pama'ète lii, ètu era èci dhu ra pangare na, tana lapang nèti hadhu kabela. madhutu lii aram, ngara na gabata.

source_text: now it was the preparation of the passover: it was about the sixth hour. and he saith unto the jews, behold, your king!
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge lod'o sadia kalela paska. pe d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, gubernur peka dènge dhèu yahudi sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe ku laa! nèngu ne, dhèu aae miu!

source_text: they therefore cried out, away with him, away with him, crucify him! pilate saith unto them, shall i crucify your king? the chief priests answered, we have no king but cæsar.
target_text: te ngaa rèngu asa hoe pa'oo-parodha peka na, mèti ne, asa li'u mai! pamadhe ne! paku ne asa aj'u palolo-palèbha! hèia gubernur papane si, peka na, de tasamia? miu d'èi, ladhe ja'a pamadhe dhèu aae miu ne, do? ka kètu agama yahudi se b'ala, peka na, dhèu aae ji'i dhodhoka ca dhèu di, nuka keser! dhèu leo aad'o!

source_text: then therefore he delivered him unto them to be crucified.
target_text: hèia gubernur hia yesus asa sordad'u sèra, sèna ka ra paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia sordad'u se sèmi rare yesus.

source_text: they took jesus therefore: and he went out, bearing the cross for himself, unto the place called the place of a skull, which is called in hebrew golgotha:
target_text: ka yesus pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha na la'e asa li'u kota. lasi asa era èci dhu ngara na, era rui kètu. madhutu lii aram, era ne ngara na, golgota.

source_text: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and jesus in the midst.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, ra paku yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èci. dhèu se paku kahèi dhèu leo dhèu dua. èci re sebhe g'ana, aa ca dhèu hari re sebhe kariu yesus. ka yesus ètu talora rèngu dua ra.

source_text: and pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. and there was written, jesus of nazareth, the king of the jews.
target_text: ka gubernur paredha sordad'u na sèra, suri ètu papa èci, ho paku re dedha kètu yesus. ètu papa ne ra suri, peka na, yesus, dhèu nasaret. nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi

source_text: this title therefore read many of the jews, for the place where jesus was crucified was nigh to the city; and it was written in hebrew, and in latin, and in greek.
target_text: rèngu suri ètu papa ne pake tèlu lii, nuka: lii aram, lii yunani, dènge lii latin. dhèu yahudi ae ka dhu baca sasuri ne, lula era mamadhe yesus ne, padètu dènge kota yerusalem.

source_text: the chief priests of the jews therefore said to pilate, write not, the king of the jews; but, that he said, i am king of the jews.
target_text: te ngaa kètu agama yahudi sèra ro'o boe. ka lasi peka dènge gubernur, aku rèngu na, ama! baku suri ‘dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi'! be'a risi suri laa peka na, ‘dhèu ne peka na, nèngu dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi. '

source_text: pilate answered, what i have written i have written.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka dhu pua si suri sèmi èèna. de hud'i ka laa!

source_text: the soldiers therefore, when they had crucified jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
target_text: ropa sordad'u paku rare yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, hèia ra pabagi mèdha-papake na mi èpa pala. ca dhèu sordad'u abhu ca pala. hèia rare kodho li'u na, dhu j'au boe, dhu manènu kateme nèti dedha.

source_text: they said therefore one to another, let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, they parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
target_text: ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, èdhi baku ciu eele kodho na. be'a risi ère lot, sèna ka te'a, na, cee ka dhu abhu. èèna j'aj'i madhutu sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu peka na, rèngu pabagi mèdha-papake ja'a, ka ra ère lot ho abhu kodho ja'a. hèia sordad'u se tao madhutu sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: these things therefore the soldiers did. but there were standing by the cross of jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, mary the wife of clopas, and mary magdalene.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu bhèni pèri-pèri dhu titu. rèngu se, nuka: ina yesus, ina iiki yesus, maria dhèu èmu klopas, dènge maria nèti rae magdala.

source_text: when jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, woman, behold, thy son!
target_text: yesus ladhe nèdhi ina na dhu titu ètu èèna, sama-sama dènge ja'a, yohanis, nuka ana madhutu dhu nèngu sue. ka yesus lii dènge ina na, aku nèngu na, ina. nèngu ne, ana mu.

source_text: then saith he to the disciple, behold, thy mother! and from that hour the disciple took her unto his own home.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ja'a, peka na, yohanis. nèti deo ne'e, tao laa nèngu sèmi ina èu! ka karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ina yesus pea dènge ja'a.

source_text: after this jesus, knowing that all things are now finished, that the scripture might be accomplished, saith, i thirst.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus ne'a le, na, nèngu sab'a nare aa'i le sasab'a-la'a na. se'e se pamèci dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua karèi nèti uru ka. hèia yesus peka, na, ja'a koko-kamango.

source_text: there was set there a vessel full of vinegar: so they put a sponge full of the vinegar upon hyssop, and brought it to his mouth.
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu èi anggor manyilu ètu d'ara g'ala iiki cue. ka sordad'u sèra rare ula ho cèb'u asa èi anggor, hèia èki mi suu aj'u ca laa, ka j'ole asa hèb'a na.

source_text: when jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, it is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.
target_text: ropa yesus camuci nare, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, èle kèna. hèia kètu na loe, ka ma'ète a'ae.

source_text: the jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain on the cross upon the sabbath for the day of that sabbath was a high day, asked of pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke hari jumat. madhutu atora agama, dhèu yahudi hud'i sadia mema d'ara lod'o èèna, sèna ka bèli èèna rèngu soru lod'o sabaj'a ra. nèti èèna ka, ro'o boe tèke eele ngi'u aae dhèu madhe, kadhoe tèke ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a. te lod'o sabaj'a èèna, lod'o be'a. de ama-ama dhèu yahudi manèngi gubernur, sèna ka pua dhèu lasi hake papadhe haga dhèu ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, rèngu madhe malai, ho dhèu bisa papuru ngi'u aae ra nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha ako lod'o aae era.

source_text: the soldiers therefore came, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other that was crucified with him:
target_text: hèia sordad'u se lasi asa era èèna. ka ra hake papadhe uru haga dhèu dua sèra, dhu paku sama-sama dènge yesus.

source_text: but when they came to jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
target_text: te ngaa ropa ra d'ai yesus, rèdhi, na, yesus dhu madhe le. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hake papadhe boe haga na.

source_text: howbeit one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and straightway there came out blood and water.
target_text: te ngaa sordad'u ca dhèu nare kapoke na, hèia kèj'i d'ara karasa yesus. ka raa kalua, aa èi kalua kahèi.

source_text: and he that hath seen hath borne witness, and his witness is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye also may believe.
target_text: ja'a ne'e ka dhu ladhe kèdhi dènge musi madha ku. ja'a kèdhi aa'i, aa dhu ja'a suri ne lèke tare'a-re'a. te ja'a ke'a mèu ngaa dhu ja'a lolo ne lèke mola-mola, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: for these things came to pass, that the scripture might be fulfilled, a bone of him shall not be broken.
target_text: j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i, lula sasuri ama lamatua dhu suri, na, rui na ca laa sa, padhe boe.

source_text: and again another scripture saith, they shall look on him whom they pierced.
target_text: ètu era leo d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ne, suri kahèi, peka na, èèna rèngu ladhe rèdhi dhèu dhu ra kèj'i ne.

source_text: and after these things joseph of arimathæa, being a disciple of jesus, but secretly for fear of the jews, asked of pilate that he might take away the body of jesus: and pilate gave him leave. he came therefore, and took away his body.
target_text: abhu dhèu èci ngara na yusuf, nèti rae arimatea. nèngu ana madhutu yesus kahèi. te ngaa na madhutu pahuni-pahuni, lula madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. yusuf la'e asa gubernur pilatus, manèngi ijin sèna ka bisa nèti ngi'u aae yesus. gubernur d'èi kahèi. ka yusuf la'e papuru ngi'u aae yesus, hèia ded'e nèti.

source_text: and there came also nicodemus, he who at the first came to him by night, bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pounds.
target_text: nikodemus la'e sama-sama dènge yusuf kahèi. nikodemus ne'e ka dhu uru èèna la'e paraga dènge yesus re mèda. na hèli rampe ae titu kèna, pe d'ai tèlu nguru tèlu kilo sa, sèna ka tao mi ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: so they took the body of jesus, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the jews is to bury.
target_text: hèia ra hèlu ngi'u aae yesus dènge bèla halus. ladhe hèlu ca tèka, ra tao rampe la'a. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, madhutu ad'a dhèu yahudi ladhe padhane dhèu madhe.

source_text: now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new tomb wherein was never man yet laid.
target_text: kaj'èu boe nèti era yesus madhe ne, abhu oka bunga cue. ètu d'ara oka ne, dhèu heka pae rare ro'a dhèu madhe kèna. ra padhane rèdhi mèka dhèu èci sa ètu d'ara ro'a èèna.

source_text: there then because of the jews' preparation for the tomb was nigh at hand they laid jesus.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lod'o sadia dhèu yahudi ho soru lod'o sabaj'a ra, oe èle kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se tèke ngi'u aae yesus ètu d'ara ro'a èèna, te era èèna kaj'èu boe.

source_text: now on the first day of the week cometh mary magdalene early, while it was yet dark, unto the tomb, and seeth the stone taken away from the tomb.
target_text: hari migu, nuka lod'o partama ètu d'ara migu èèna. mad'ae aae era, maria nèti rae magdala la'e asa ro'a yesus. d'ai era èèna, ladhe nèdhi hadhu aae dhu pake katange ro'a, hari eele nèti era na.

source_text: she runneth therefore, and cometh to simon peter, and to the other disciple whom jesus loved, and saith unto them, they have taken away the lord out of the tomb, and we know not where they have laid him.
target_text: hèia na rai lèpa hari la'e paraga dènge simon petrus aa dènge ja'a, nuka ana madhutu dhu yesus sue, ka na peka, dhèu mana'u rèti le lamatua èdhi nèti ro'a na! te'a boe rèngu tèke ne ètu mia!

source_text: peter therefore went forth, and the other disciple, and they went toward the tomb.
target_text: ka ja'a dènge petrus rai la'a asa era ro'a èèna.

source_text: and they ran both together: and the other disciple outran peter, and came first to the tomb;
target_text: ji'i rai palere-lere, te ngaa ja'a malai risi, ka d'ai uuru ro'a èèna.

source_text: and stooping and looking in, he seeth the linen cloths lying; yet entered he not in.
target_text: te ngaa laku boe asa d'ara ro'a, dhoka patigi nèti li'u di. ètu d'ara ro'a, ja'a ladhe kèdhi bèla halus dhu ra pake hèlu mi ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: simon peter therefore also cometh, following him, and entered into the tomb; and he beholdeth the linen cloths lying,
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus d'ai, la'e dènge asa d'ara. nèdhi bèla halus dhu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and the napkin, that was upon his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.
target_text: nèdhi kahèi lesu dhu ra pahutu kètu yesus. te ngaa lesu ne dhu lèpe ètu era leo nèti bèla halus ne.

source_text: then entered in therefore the other disciple also, who came first to the tomb, and he saw, and believed.
target_text: hèia ja'a, dhu d'ai uuru ro'a, maso madhutu kahèi asa d'ara. ropa ladhe kèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, ka ja'a parcaya lii padhadha dhu uru èèna yesus peka mema, na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: for as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
target_text: te lod'o èèna, ji'i dhu j'aj'i ana madhutu na, dhae nge'a mèka sasoa nèti isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri mema, peka na, kristus hud'i mamuri hari ku nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: so the disciples went away again unto their own home.
target_text: èle ka, ji'i dua mi lèpa.

source_text: but mary was standing without at the tomb weeping: so, as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb;
target_text: te ngaa maria titu era ètu li'u ro'a èèna. nèngu tangi taruu. ka na patigi asa d'ara ro'a ne, aa na tangi era.

source_text: and she beholdeth two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of jesus had lain.
target_text: ladhe nèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhèu dua. ana pajuu se, pake mèdha-papake pudhi. dua ra madhèdi ètu era dhu ca lod'o ni dhèu paj'unu ngi'u aae yesus. ca dhèu madhèdi re era kètu, aa èci hari dhu madhèdi re era haga.

source_text: and they say unto her, woman, why weepest thou? she saith unto them, because they have taken away my lord, and i know not where they have laid him.
target_text: ana pajuu se karèi maria, aku rèngu na, nga tao ka èu tangi? hèia maria dhaa, peka na, ja'a tangi, lula dhèu ded'e rèti ngi'u aae lamatua ja'a. te ngaa ke'a boe ra tèke ne ètu mia.

source_text: when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and beholdeth jesus standing, and knew not that it was jesus.
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare, nèngu kabib'a asa li'u. ka ladhe nèdhi ca dhèu dhu titu ètu èèna, te ngaa ne'a boe, na, dhèu ne, nuka yesus.

source_text: jesus saith unto her, woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? she, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, sir, if thou hast borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and i will take him away.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi ne, peka na, nga tao ka èu tangi? te èu tenge cee? maria pangee, na, nèngu ne dhèu madhenga oka. ka maria pamako dhèu ne, aku nèngu na, ama. ladhe ama ka ded'e mèti ngi'u aae na, peka ku laa, ama tèke ne ètu mia. hud'i laa laku ded'e kèti ne asa era leo, sèna ka padhane ne pabe'a-be'a. sue laa, ama!

source_text: jesus saith unto her, mary. she turneth herself, and saith unto him in hebrew, rabboni; which is to say, teacher.
target_text: ka yesus paroa ne, peka na, maria. hèia na kabèli ladhe asa yesus, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, raboni! lii aram, sasoa na, mese ja'a!

source_text: jesus saith to her, touch me not; for i am not yet ascended unto the father: but go unto my brethren, and say to them, i ascend unto my father and your father, and my god and your god.
target_text: yesus peka dènge ne, baku g'ag'e ku ja'a, te ja'a dhae ca'e mèka laku asa ama ku ètu sorga. te ngaa lamu uuru ku peka dènge angalai ja'a sèra, na, ‘ja'a neo ca'e laku asa ama ku. nèngu èèna, ama miu kahèi. nèngu èèna, ama lamatua ja'a. de nèngu, ama lamatua miu kahèi. '

source_text: mary magdalene cometh and telleth the disciples, i have seen the lord; and that he had said these things unto her.
target_text: èle ka, maria, dhèu magdala èèna, la'e lolo dènge ana madhutu yesus sèra, peka na, ja'a paraga le dènge lamatua èdhi, yesus! ka na peka dènge rèngu lii moa yesus.

source_text: when therefore it was evening, on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were shut where the disciples were, for fear of the jews, jesus came and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, peace be unto you.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge hari migu, nuka lod'o partama ètu d'ara migu èèna. lod'o heka cèna kèna, ka ana madhutu yesus pakaboko. rèngu patèke babèdho èmu ne pa'èra-èra, lula rèngu madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. re'a rare boe, na, yesus titu ètu talora aae rèngu, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, saloom!

source_text: and when he had said this, he showed unto them his hands and his side. the disciples therefore were glad, when they saw the lord.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare dènge rèngu sèmi èèna, hèia na pad'elo nu'a dhu ètu kacui-aai dènge karasa na. ana madhutu na karej'e titu kèna, ropa ladhe rèdhi lamatua rèngu.

source_text: jesus therefore said to them again, peace be unto you: as the father hath sent me, even so send i you.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge rèngu, na, hud'i laa miu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. sanèd'e, te ama ku pua-paleha ja'a tasamia, na, ja'a pua-paleha miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, receive ye the holy spirit:
target_text: padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka na ara padètu la'e asa rèngu, hèia na tiu a'ae na mi rèngu èci-èci. hèia na padhai lii, peka na, ja'a pangèd'u miu roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. sèmi mere ne.

source_text: whose soever sins ye forgive, they are forgiven unto them; whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
target_text: de, ladhe miu pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, na, sasala ne ele le, te ama lamatua saku eele sasala èèna kahèi. te ngaa ladhe miu mo'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, na, lamatua saku eele boe sasala sèra kahèi.

source_text: but thomas, one of the twelve, called didymus, was not with them when jesus came.
target_text: ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu yesus canguru dua sèra, ngara na tomas. ra pangare na, ‘ana kembar' kahèi. ropa yesus pad'elo iisi na dènge ana madhutu dhu leo sèra, tomas aad'o.

source_text: the other disciples therefore said unto him, we have seen the lord. but he said unto them, except i shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, i will not believe.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ropa angalai na sèra peka dènge ne, ji'i paraga le dènge lamatua èdhi, hèia tomas dhaa, na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a hud'i ladhe kèdhi ku nu'a era paku sèra ètu kacui-aai na, aa pamaso ai ja'a asa nu'a ètu d'ara karasa na. ladhe ja'a tao mèka sèmi èèna, ja'a bisa mèka parcaya, na, nèngu mamuri hari le.

source_text: and after eight days again his disciples were within, and thomas with them. jesus cometh, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, peace be unto you.
target_text: ca migu hari, ka ana madhutu yesus sama-sama dènge tomas ètu d'ara èmu cue. masi ka babèdho dhu patèke, te ngaa yesus maso asa d'ara, titu ètu talora aae rèngu. ka na hia lii maho'o dènge ra, peka na, saloom!

source_text: then saith he to thomas, reach hither thy finger, and see my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and put it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii dènge tomas, aku nèngu na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai, ho g'ag'e kacui-aai ja'a ne. aa mai g'ag'e nu'a ètu d'ara karasa ja'a ne. parcaya ka, na, ja'a ne mamuri hari le! core eele ka d'ara parcaya boe èu èèna.

source_text: thomas answered and said unto him, my lord and my god.
target_text: tomas dhaa, peka na, ira ii, ama, ee! ja'a heka lèka tare'a-re'a kèna! ama ne, kètu ja'a, aa ama lamatua ja'a kahèi!

source_text: jesus saith unto him, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ne, tomas! èu parcaya, na, ja'a mamuri hari le, lula èu mèdhi le ja'a dènge musi madha èu unu mu. te ngaa dhu oto risi ka, nuka dhèu dhu rèdhi boe ja'a, te ngaa ra parcaya.

source_text: many other signs therefore did jesus in the presence of the disciples, which are not written in this book:
target_text: yesus tao tadha malaa dhu leo ae-ae kahèi, dhu ja'a suri boe ètu d'ara sasuri ne. ana madhutu na ladhe rèdhi tadha malaa se'e dènge musi madha rèngu unu ra.

source_text: but these are written, that ye may believe that jesus is the christ, the son of god; and that believing ye may have life in his name.
target_text: te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne, sèna ka miu parcaya, na, yesus ne, kristus dhu ama lamatua padhadha tèke hia mai. yesus ne, ana ama lamatua kahèi. aa ropa miu parcaya ne, miu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, lula miu j'aj'i dhèu unu nèngu.

source_text: after these things jesus manifested himself again to the disciples at the sea of tiberias; and he manifested himself on this wise.
target_text: èle pèri-pèri lod'o, ka yesus pad'elo hari iisi na ètu sebhe dano tiberias. lii lolo na, sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: there were together simon peter, and thomas called didymus, and nathanael of cana in galilee, and the sons of zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus, dhèu pidhu dhu pakaboko. rèngu se, nuka: simon petrus, tomas, dhu ra pangare ne, ‘ana kembar', natanel, nèti rae kana ètu propensi galilea, ana dhèu dua nèti sabadeus, dènge ana madhutu yesus dhu leo dhèu dua.

source_text: simon peter saith unto them, i go a fishing. they say unto him, we also come with thee. they went forth, and entered into the boat; and that night they took nothing.
target_text: simon petrus peka dènge angalai na se'e, ja'a neo laku pèku i'a. hèia angalai na se'e dhaa, aku rèngu na, oo! ji'i la'a kahèi. ka lasi asa sebhe dano. hèia ca'e koha lasi tenge i'a. te ngaa mèda èèna rèngu rara boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: but when day was now breaking, jesus stood on the beach: yet the disciples knew not that it was jesus.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, yesus titu ètu sebhe dano ne. te ngaa ana madhutu na sèra re'a boe, na, nèngu ne, yesus.

source_text: jesus therefore saith unto them, children, have ye aught to eat? they answered him, no.
target_text: ka na pa'oo, peka na, mera i'a, do? hèia ra dhaa, peka na, mola-mèu lao! ci'u sa, aad'o hèi.

source_text: and he said unto them, cast the net on the right side of the boat, and ye shall find. they cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, lolo sèku pèku miu asa cabèka koha èèna. pe miu abhu. ka rèngu tao madhutu kahèi. ka ra abhu i'a ae titu kèna, toke rèngu bisa boe ère rare pèku ne asa dedha koha.

source_text: that disciple therefore whom jesus loved saith unto peter, it is the lord. so when simon peter heard that it was the lord, he girt his coat about him for he was naked, and cast himself into the sea.
target_text: aa ja'a ètu èèna kahèi. ja'a ne, ana madhutu dhu yesus sue. ka ja'a peka dènge petrus, na, ira ii! nèngu nèi, lamatua èdhi! ropa tadèngi nare lii ja'a deo na, hèia simon petrus pake hari kodho na, ka ridhu asa d'ara dano, sèna ka nangi asa dae.

source_text: but the other disciples came in the little boat for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits off, dragging the net full of fishes.
target_text: te koha ne kaj'èu nèti dae pe d'ai cangasu meter sa. hèia angalai na kao koha asa dae, todhe dènge pèku dhu pènu dènge i'a deo sa.

source_text: so when they got out upon the land, they see a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai dae, hèia rèdhi ai karoo, dènge i'a dhu ra paga. aa abhu roti kahèi.

source_text: jesus saith unto them, bring of the fish which ye have now taken.
target_text: yesus lii dènge ra, mèti ku i'a osa miu d'ai ciki sa, dhu miu heka pèku mere deo na.

source_text: simon peter therefore went up, and drew the net to land, full of great fishes, a hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, the net was not rent.
target_text: ka simon petrus ca'e hari asa dedha koha, ho ère pa'eta pèku ne asa dae. pèku ne dhu pènu dènge i'a aae, cangasu lèmi nguru tèlu ngi'u. masi ka i'a ae sèmi èèna, te ngaa pèku ne mae boe ciki sa hèi.

source_text: jesus saith unto them, come and break your fast. and none of the disciples durst inquire of him, who art thou? knowing that it was the lord.
target_text: ka yesus paroa si, aku nèngu na, mai mi'a ka! rèngu dhu re'a le, na, nèngu ne lamatua rèngu, ka ra bani boe karèi ne, na, ama ne, cee?

source_text: jesus cometh, and taketh the bread, and giveth them, and the fish likewise.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti dènge i'a, nèti hia si.

source_text: this is now the third time that jesus was manifested to the disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
target_text: ne'e ne, ka tèlu hari kèna yesus pad'elo iisi na mi ana madhutu na sèra, ropa na mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: so when they had broken their fast, jesus saith to simon peter, simon, son of john, lovest thou me more than these? he saith unto him, yea, lord; thou knowest that i love thee. he saith unto him, feed my lambs.
target_text: ropa ra'a-rinu rare, yesus karèi simon petrus, aku nèngu na, hee, simon ana yohanis. tasamia? èu sue ja'a risi nèti angalai se sue ja'a, do? ka petrus dhaa, na, tare'a ama! èu dhu me'a ja'a sue èu. hèia yesus peka, na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, madhenga paie ana kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a, sèna ka rèngu abhu ra'a-rinu.

source_text: he saith to him again a second time, simon, son of john, lovest thou me? he saith unto him, yea, lord; thou knowest that i love thee. he saith unto him, tend my sheep.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi hari, aku nèngu na, simon, ana yohanis. tasamia? èu sue ja'a, do? ka na dhaa, na, tare'a ama! èu dhu me'a ja'a sue èu. ka yesus peka hari dènge ne, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, ladhe-leru paie-iie kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a.

source_text: he saith unto him the third time, simon, son of john, lovest thou me? peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, lovest thou me? and he said unto him, lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that i love thee. jesus saith unto him, feed my sheep.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus karèi hari petrus, peka na, simon, ana yohanis. tasamia? èu ne, angalai ja'a, do? hèia d'ara petrus susa titu kèna, lula yesus karèi ne d'ai tèlu hari, peka na, èu sue ja'a, do? ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama dhu me'a aa'i j'ara. de ama dhu me'a le, na, ja'a ne angalai ama. hèia yesus peka dènge ne, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, ladhe-leru paie kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a se, sèna ka rèngu abhu ra'a-rinu.

source_text: verily, verily, i say unto thee, when thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
target_text: èu dhane more le naneo ja'a, do? ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e: uru èèna lod'o èu ngèru era, èu tema pake unu mu kodho dènge dhara hake, ho lamu asa mia-mia madhutu dad'èi èu. te ngaa ètu d'ara heka, èu j'ole kacui-aai ho dhèu èki, pake dhara hake èu unu mu. hèia ra ère rèti èu asa era dhu èu d'èi boe.

source_text: now this he spake, signifying by what manner of death he should glorify god. and when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, follow me.
target_text: lii padhai yesus ne, peka mi petrus, lula-nèti ngaa dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a mi dedha nèngu. te èèna na mamadhe petrus pad'elo dadedha ama lamatua. hèia yesus lii dènge petrus, aku nèngu na, mai sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu ja'a!

source_text: peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom jesus loved following; who also leaned back on his breast at the supper, and said, lord, who is he that betrayeth thee?
target_text: lod'o èèna, petrus kabib'a asa kabodho. ka ladhe nèdhi ja'a dhu re limuri madhutu rèngu dua ra. ja'a ne, nuka ana madhutu dhu yesus sue. ja'a dhu madhèdi ètu baboa yesus, lod'o ji'i nga'a kalela paska. ja'a ne ka dhu karèi yesus, peka na, ama! cee ka dhu neo pahie ama?

source_text: peter therefore seeing him saith to jesus, lord, and what shall this man do?
target_text: ropa petrus ladhe nèdhi ja'a, hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, ama! deo na ama peka-padhai le lula-nèti ja'a ne. te ngaa tasamia dènge nèngu hari?

source_text: jesus saith unto him, if i will that he tarry till i come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
target_text: yesus b'ala lii petrus, na, urusan èu aad'o ètu èèna. ladhe ja'a neo sèna ka nèngu mate mi era ne'e toke ja'a mai hari, na, sala ngaa? dhu lèke ka èu hud'i sanèd'e ku lii moa dhu ja'a peka deo na, nuka: mai sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu ja'a.

source_text: this saying therefore went forth among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet jesus said not unto him, that he should not die; but, if i will that he tarry till i come, what is that to thee?
target_text: lula yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka ana madhutu na dhu leo sèra papeka, na, yohanis ne, bèli-camèd'a madhe boe. aa te ngaa yesus padhai lii boe sèmi èèna. dhu na peka, na, urusan èu aad'o ètu èèna. ladhe ja'a neo sèna ka nèngu mate mi era ne'e toke ja'a mai hari, na, sala ngaa?

source_text: this is the disciple that beareth witness of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his witness is true.
target_text: ana madhutu dhu yesus peka èèna, nuka ja'a ne, yohanis. ja'a ka lole se aa'i-aa'i hia miu. ja'a ka dhu kèdhi dènge musi madha ja'a unu ku. ja'a ka suri aa'i-aa'i se. ka èdhi te'a, na, ngaa dhu ja'a lole hia miu se, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: and there are also many other things which jesus did, the which if they should be written every one, i suppose that even the world itself would not contain the books that should be written.
target_text: abhu j'ara leo ae era dhu yesus tao. ladhe dhèu neo suri aa'i mèu-mèu, karèi nèti yesus pakako sasab'a-la'a na toke èle, ja'a ngee na buku se pènu risi rai-haha ne. d'ai sange ne'e ka, yohanis

source_text: the former treatise i made, o theophilus, concerning all that jesus began both to do and to teach, until the day in which he was received up, after that he had given commandment through the holy spirit unto the apostles whom he had chosen: to whom he also showed himself alive after his passion by many proofs, appearing unto them by the space of forty days, and speaking the things concerning the kingdom of god:
target_text: ama teofilus dhu be'a. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, lukas. ètu d'ara sasuri ja'a dhu uru èèna, ja'a suri aa'i mèu-mèu lula-nèti mamuri lamatua yesus. nuka, ngaa dhu na tao, dènge ngaa dhu na aj'a-nori, karèi nèti uru tèka. na hag'e nare dhèu pajuu-paleha na. masi ka dhèu paj'èra ne, aa ra pamadhe ne, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. ropa na kèd'i nèti mamadhe, na pad'elo iisi mi dhèu pajuu-paleha na. ra rèdhi ne padhutu-dhutu toke d'ai èpa nguru lod'o, ka ra re'a, na mamuri hari tare'a. nèngu peka dènge rèngu, na, ama lamatua sama sèmi dhèu aae dhu nèd'u paredha. ka na pua rèngu kahèi pake koasa nèti roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci. lii dhu ja'a suri ne, lole ngaa-ngaa dhu na tao nèti uru, toke d'ai na ca'e hari asa sorga. se'e se ka dhu ja'a suri kèdhi le.

source_text: and, being assembled together with them, he charged them not to depart from jerusalem, but to wait for the promise of the father, which, said he, ye heard from me: for john indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized in the holy spirit not many days hence.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, ropa yesus pa'èci dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha na ètu dedha ledhe saitun, na hia si paredha peka na, sanèd'e! uru èèna, yohanis sarani dhèu pake dhoka èi di, te ngaa ladhe miu mate hari pèri-pèri lod'o, èèna na lamatua tao ngaa dhu kapai risi eele hia miu. lula na hia miu roh na dhu mola-mèci. de baku tèke eele kota yerusalem kahèi. te ngaa miu mate mi ne'e, toke d'ai ama ku papuru roh na mi dedha miu, sèmi dhu na moa le uru èèna. aa miu tadèngi le nèti ja'a kahèi.

source_text: they therefore, when they were come together, asked him, saying, lord, dost thou at this time restore the kingdom to israel?
target_text: ropa yesus pakaboko dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha na era, ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama! ji'i neo karèi: ama sanèd'e era, sina ma, dhu uru èèna, kabarai èdhi isra'el paredha unu na? de ama neo patabuli èdhi nèti dhèu leo deo ne'e, do, mate hari lod'o leo?

source_text: and he said unto them, it is not for you to know times or seasons, which the father hath set within his own authority.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, miu pakarèi ia ka lod'o èèna! dhoka ama ku di, dhu pama'ète j'aj'aj'i lod'o èèna na.

source_text: but ye shall receive power, when the holy spirit is come upon you: and ye shall be my witnesses both in jerusalem, and in all judæa and samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci mai maso asa d'ara miu, heka miu abhu koasa kèna. hèia miu hud'i lami palolo dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra lula-nèti ja'a. miu peka dènge dhèu ètu kota yerusalem, ètu rae aa'i-aa'i ètu propensi yudea dènge propensi samaria, taruu toke d'ai suu-suu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and when he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ama lamatua paca'e yesus asa dedha-liru la'e ètu katanga madha rèngu. ra ladhe taruu, toke d'ai ra'i-liru hutu nare ne, ka rèngu rèdhi heka.

source_text: and while they were looking stedfastly into heaven as he went, behold two men stood by them in white apparel;
target_text: ropa rèngu ladhe asa dedha-liru era, cag'ag'a laa, dhèu dua titu ètu karasa rèngu, dhu pake mèdha-papake pudhi lao-lao.

source_text: who also said, ye men of galilee, why stand ye looking into heaven? this jesus, who was received up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye beheld him going into heaven.
target_text: dhèu dua sèra peka dènge rèngu, na, wee! miu dhèu galilea! nga tao ka miu tangare taruu asa dedha-liru? deo na miu mèdhi le yesus ca'e toke d'ai ra'i-liru hutu nare ne. miu mèdhi unu mi dènge musi madha miu, na ca'e la'e deo na. sèmi mia dhu miu ladhe mèdhi na ca'e la'e èèna, sèmi èèna kahèi èèna na nèngu mai hari.

source_text: then returned they unto jerusalem from the mount called olivet, which is nigh unto jerusalem, a sabbath day's journey off.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus sèra puru nèti ledhe saitun lèpa lasi asa kota yerusalem. ledhe saitun èèna, ele boe kaj'èu nèngu d'ai ca kilo di nèti d'ara kota.

source_text: and when they were come in, they went up into the upper chamber, where they were abiding; both peter and john and james and andrew, philip and thomas, bartholomew and matthew, james the son of alphæus, and simon the zealot, and judas the son of james.
target_text: d'ai nèi, ka ra lasi asa d'ara èmu dhu rèngu pea. ka ra ca'e asa kama èci ètu èmu dedha. ngara dhèu pajuu-paleha sèra, nuka: petrus, yohanis, yakobis, anderias, pelipus, tomas, bertolomeos, mateos, yakobis ana alpius, simon dhu madhutu partei selot, dènge yudas ana yakobis.

source_text: these all with one accord continued stedfastly in prayer, with the women, and mary the mother of jesus, and with his brethren.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra dhu tema pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i dènge d'ara èci. maria, ina yesus, aa dhèu bhèni-dhèu bhèni leo, dènge a'ari yesus sèra pakaboko dènge rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and in these days peter stood up in the midst of the brethren, and said and there was a multitude of persons gathered together, about a hundred and twenty,
target_text: ca tèka hari, rèngu pakaboko, ele boe dhèu d'ai cangasu dua nguru dhèu sa. ka petrus kèd'i titu, ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na,

source_text: brethren, it was needful that the scripture should be fulfilled, which the holy spirit spake before by the mouth of david concerning judas, who was guide to them that took jesus.
target_text: ina-ama, a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! èle boe miu sanèd'e yudas era, dhu uru èèna nèti anga na canau, ho lasi kèpe yesus. ngaa dhu yudas tao, mema hud'i j'aj'i sèmi èèna ku. te nèti uru ka, roh ama lamatua peka le, dènge dhèu aae daud, ho suri tatao yudas.

source_text: for he was numbered among us, and received his portion in this ministry.
target_text: te yudas èèna, dhèu èdhi dhu sab'a pa'èci dènge èdhi.

source_text: now this man obtained a field with the reward of his iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yudas pahie eele yesus, ka rare doi papana èèna, lasi hèli rare rai cue. rai èèna ka dhu j'aj'i era mamadhe nèngu. na bèbhe sagèb'a ètu era èèna, ka masèke eele kabake na, hèia tanèi na talala.

source_text: and it became known to all the dwellers at jerusalem; insomuch that in their language that field was called akeldama, that is, the field of blood.
target_text: ka dhèu palolo lème, toke d'ai isi kabarai kota yerusalem re'a aa'i mèu-mèu mamadhe yudas èèna. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare rai èèna madhutu lii aram, ngara na ‘akeldama', sasoa na, ‘rai raa'.

source_text: for it is written in the book of psalms, let his habitation be made desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and, his office let another take.
target_text: petrus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, uru-uru sèra, dhèu aae daud suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri lii sod'a koa-kio, peka na, ‘hud'i sène era pea nèngu, j'aj'i mi era dhu pa'ela eele; bisa heka dhèu èci sa pea ètu èèna. ' aa na suri kahèi, aku nèngu na, ‘hud'i sène, sasab'a nèngu ra hia asa dhèu leo la'e. '

source_text: of the men therefore that have companied with us all the time that the lord jesus went in and went out among us, beginning from the baptism of john, unto the day that he was received up from us, of these must one become a witness with us of his resurrection.
target_text: de èdhi hud'i tenge dhèu èci ho gati yudas. èdhi tenge dhèu dhu bera-bera dènge èdhi nèti uru ka mai. dhèu èèna, hud'i dhèu dhu nèbhu le madhutu yesus la'e-mai, mulai nèti yohanis sarani yesus. aa nèngu èèna, hud'i dhèu dhu nèdhi dènge musi madha, na, yesus kèd'i hari nèti mamadhe na, toke d'ai lod'o yesus ca'e hari asa dedha-liru ètu talora èdhi.

source_text: and they put forward two, joseph called barsabbas, who was surnamed justus, and matthias.
target_text: ropa petrus peka nare sèmi èèna, ka dhèu dhu pakaboko sèra, pamaso ngara dhèu dua. èci ngara na matias, aa èci hari ngara na yusuf dhu tema le ra paroa na barsabas; ngara na leo èci hari, na, yustus.

source_text: and they prayed, and said, thou, lord, who knowest the hearts of all men, show of these two the one whom thou hast chosen, to take the place in this ministry and apostleship from which judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.
target_text: hèia ra sabaj'a, aku rèngu na, ama ètu dedha-liru! ama dhu me'a iie d'ara dhèu aa'i-aa'i. yudas madhe le, tèke eele sasab'a na. de ama paj'uj'u hia ji'i dhèu èci nèti rèngu dua se, mia dhu ama d'èi, ho ji'i ded'e ne j'aj'i mi dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus.

source_text: and they gave lots for them; and the lot fell upon matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
target_text: ka ra ère lot, pake ngara dhèu dua sèra. hèia dhu lèke ka matias. ka ra ded'e ne j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus, ho na pa'èci dènge rèngu dhèu canguru èci sèra.

source_text: and when the day of pentecost was now come, they were all together in one place. and suddenly there came from heaven a sound as of the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
target_text: lèke lod'o babe'a dhèu yahudi, dhu ra pangare na ‘lod'o pantekosta', dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu lamatua yesus pakaboko ètu d'ara èmu cue. cag'ag'a laa, ra tadèngi lii dhu mai nèti dedha-liru, sama sèmi bohe. lii èèna mèdhu titu kèna, ka rèngu bisa boe tadèngi lii dhèu leo dhu ètu sèra.

source_text: and there appeared unto them tongues parting asunder, like as of fire; and it sat upon each one of them.
target_text: hèia rèngu ladhe rèdhi sèmi heo ai sa, dhu puru mi dedha rèngu èci-èci.

source_text: and they were all filled with the holy spirit, and began to speak with other tongues, as the spirit gave them utterance.
target_text: ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra abhu roh ama lamatua. ka ra padhai lii, pake lii dhèu rai-rai leo, madhutu ngaa dhu roh hia si peka-padhai.

source_text: now there were dwelling at jerusalem jews, devout men, from every nation under heaven.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu yahudi ae titu kèna dhu mai nèti lème rai ètu rai-haha ne, pakaboko ètu yerusalem. d'ara rèngu neo madhutu ama lamatua.

source_text: and when this sound was heard, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speaking in his own language.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare lii èèna, ka ra mai lingu rare era èèna. ka rèngu ca dhèu-dhèu ka, tadèngi lii dhu ana madhutu lamatua yesus sèra padhai, èci èèna ka dènge lii rai rèngu. nèti èèna ka, dhèu sèra malaa-maloha.

source_text: and they were all amazed and marvelled, saying, behold, are not all these that speak galilæans?
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra hèb'a nganga-nganga sène, ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, ira ii! te dhèu se, dhèu galilea, sina ma?

source_text: and how hear we, every man in our own language wherein we were born?
target_text: tasamia ka, rèngu bisa padhai lii, tao lii èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti?

source_text: parthians and medes and elamites, and the dwellers in mesopotamia, in judæa and cappadocia, in pontus and asia,
target_text: èdhi se'e, mai nèti propensi partia, media, elam, mesopotamia, yudea, kapadokia, pontus, asia,

source_text: in phrygia and pamphylia, in egypt and the parts of libya about cyrene, and sojourners from rome, both jews and proselytes, cretans and arabians, we hear them speaking in our tongues the mighty works of god.
target_text: frigia, pamfilia, masir, nèti libia dhu dètu dènge kota kirene, aa èdhi cahag'e mai nèti kota roma. aa cahag'e kahèi mai nèti pulu kreta, dènge nèti rai arab. èdhi cahag'e dhèu yahudi, cahag'e dhèu rai leo dhu maso agama yahudi. te ngaa èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti tadèngi rèngu padhai lii, pake lii èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara kapai titu kèna, dhu ama lamatua tao. te aa'i-aa'i se pamalaa èdhi, nga!

source_text: and they were all amazed, and were perplexed, saying one to another, what meaneth this?
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra hèb'a nganga-nganga sène, ka ra pakarèi isi aanga ra, aku rèngu na, tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi ne'e? sasoa na, ngaa ka ne?

source_text: but others mocking said, they are filled with new wine.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu leo dhu mari si, peka na, weeh! baku pusi dènge dhèu sèi! te ra mahu nèi!

source_text: but peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and spake forth unto them, saying, ye men of judæa, and all ye that dwell at jerusalem, be this known unto you, and give ear unto my words.
target_text: ètu era èèna, petrus dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus dhèu canguru èci leo sèra. ka nèngu kako la'e asa madha, hèia na mulai padhai lii mi dhèu ae dhu lingu ètu èèna. na padhai lii mèdhu bia, peka na, ina-ama, a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! miu dhèu yahudi, dènge miu dhu mai nèti mia-mia pea ètu kota yerusalem! pasa dhilu paie, ho mi nanene lii padhai lii ja'a ne, te ja'a neo peka j'ara hua iia mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: for these are not drunken, as ye suppose; seeing it is but the third hour of the day;
target_text: mage mi pangee, na, dhèu se mahu. sèmi boe èèna! mad'ae aae era, dhèu mahu boe. ngaa hari, heka hake ceo kèna.

source_text: but this is that which hath been spoken through the prophet joel:
target_text: deo na miu tadèngi, na, dhèu se padhai lii pake lii miu aa'i-aa'i mi. dhu lèke, sèmi ne'e ka: uru èèna, ama lamatua moa tèke le j'ara ne'e re dhèu nèti lii padhai lii nèngu, ngara na yoel, peka na:

source_text: and it shall be in the last days, saith god, i will pour forth of my spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
target_text: ‘ama lamatua peka na, ladhe lod'o rai-haha oe èle, ja'a neo hia roh ja'a mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. ana ngèru miu sèra, bhèni-mone, ja'a ded'e si, j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai ja'a. ana ngèru miu sèra, bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèdhi ngaa dhu ja'a neo pad'elo mi rèngu. sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu heka miu sèra, bèli-camèd'a ra abhu nii, ngaa dhu ja'a neo pad'elo hia ra rèdhi.

source_text: yea and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days will i pour forth of my spirit; and they shall prophesy.
target_text: ladhe lod'o rai-haha oe èle, ja'a hia roh ja'a mi ana pua-paleha ja'a sèra. hia dhèu mone, aa dhèu bhèni kahèi. sèna ka ra peka-padhai ngaa dhu ja'a peka le dènge rèngu.

source_text: and i will show wonders in the heaven above, and signs on the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapor of smoke: the sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the day of the lord come, that great and notable day: and it shall be, that whosoever shall call on the name of the lord shall be saved.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, d'ai lod'o lamatua. masi ka lod'o èèna dhae d'ai mèka, te ngaa ja'a tao uru tadha-tadha malaa ètu dedha-liru. tadha malaa sèmi madha lod'o j'aj'i maroga kiu-kiu, dènge hèru mea sèmi raa sa kahèi. ja'a neo tao j'ara-j'ara kapai seli eele kahèi, ètu dedha-rai. j'ara sèra sa, sama sèmi raa, ai, dènge sèb'u poka-poka ca'e la'e asa dedha. ladhe d'ai lod'o lamatua dhu kapai seli èèna, dhèu cee dhu manèngi ama lamatua soru-bara ne, nèngu èèna ka dhu abhu mamuri. ' sèmi èèna ka, dhu uru èèna, yoel suri le.

source_text: ye men of israel, hear these words: jesus of nazareth, a man approved of god unto you by mighty works and wonders and signs which god did by him in the midst of you, even as ye yourselves know;
target_text: a'ari dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i ti! mai pasa dhilu miu, ho nanene paie ngaa dhu ja'a neo padhai lii dènge miu. ama lamatua paj'uj'u nare le yesus, dhèu nasaret. ji'i nge'a le j'ara èèna j'aj'i tare'a, lula ji'i ka dhu ladhe ngèdhi unu mi, na, ama lamatua pake yesus ho tao tadha malaa dènge tatao kapai seli eele. miu me'a le j'ara ne'e kahèi, lula yesus tao le tadha malaa sèra ètu talora miu.

source_text: him, being delivered up by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of god, ye by the hand of lawless men did crucify and slay:
target_text: te ngaa miu pamadhe ne, dènge j'ara miu dadugu-rariu dhèu bhelu-katub'a, ho paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. aa te ngaa, sèra sa pamèci dènge naneo ama lamatua nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: whom god raised up, having loosed the pangs of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
target_text: lula tatao miu, ka nèngu madhe tare'a. te ngaa ama lamatua d'èi boe ho yesus madhe taruu. nèti èèna ka, lamatua patalale eele nèngu nèti koasa mamadhe, ka pamamuri hari ne. te koasa mamadhe bisa boe segi ne.

source_text: for david saith concerning him, i beheld the lord always before my face; for he is on my right hand, that i should not be moved:
target_text: nèti uru ka mai, dhèu aae daud suri tèke le lula-nèti yesus ne, peka na: ‘ja'a ke'a, na, lamatua sama-sama taruu dènge ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ngaa èci sa bisa boe pamanahu ja'a, lula ama lamatua ètu baboa ja'a taruu.

source_text: therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced; moreover my flesh also shall dwell in hope:
target_text: nèti èèna ka, d'ara ja'a karej'e, ka ja'a koa-kio ne taruu, aa ja'a mate lamatua dènge d'ara mera-milu.

source_text: because thou wilt not leave my soul unto hades, neither wilt thou give thy holy one to see corruption.
target_text: te nèngu soro tèke boe samanga ja'a pea taruu ètu era dhèu madhe sèra. aa ama lamatua tèke eele boe ngi'u aae dhèu nèngu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, ele iie ètu d'ara rai.

source_text: thou madest known unto me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of gladness with thy countenance.
target_text: lamatua pad'elo le ja'a j'ara mamuri dhu mola. nèti èèna ka d'ara ja'a karej'e d'ai seli, lula lamatua bera-bera dènge ja'a. ' ne'e ne ka dhu dhèu aae daud suri tèke nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: brethren, i may say unto you freely of the patriarch david, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us unto this day.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu mata ku ho ja'a lole paie ku dènge miu lula-nèti dhèu aae daud. na peka sèmi èèna, te ngaa na lole boe ngi'u nèngu. èdhi te'a, lula nèngu madhe le, aa ra padhane ne. ro'a na abhu ètu talora èdhi toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: being therefore a prophet, and knowing that god had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins he would set one upon his throne;
target_text: dhèu aae daud ne j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. aa na ne'a, na, ama lamatua dhu moa le pake lii subha, ho limuri mai èci nèti ana-èpu daud nèd'u paredha. nèngu èèna ka dhu lamatua paj'uj'u mema nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: he foreseeing this spake of the resurrection of the christ, that neither was he left unto hades, nor did his flesh see corruption.
target_text: lod'o èèna, daud pangee madhera. aa na peka uuru lula-nèti dhèu dhu lamatua paj'uj'u tèke le. èena na dhèu èèna madhe, te ngaa mamuri hari kahèi. aa daud peka kahèi, na, dhèu èèna pea taruu boe ètu era dhèu madhe, aa ngi'u na ele iie boe kahèi.

source_text: this jesus did god raise up, whereof we all are witnesses.
target_text: dhèu dhu daud peka-padhai ne, nuka yesus! ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne nèti mamadhe na. ka ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi ngèdhi le dènge musi madha ji'i!

source_text: being therefore by the right hand of god exalted, and having received of the father the promise of the holy spirit, he hath poured forth this, which ye see and hear.
target_text: ka limuri ne, ama lamatua ded'e le yesus, ho nèd'u paredha dhu dedha risi eele. aa na madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua, ètu era dhu lamatua sadia tèke le. aa ama na hia le roh na dhu mola-mèci, sama sèmi dhu na moa tèke nèti uru ka. aa na moa neo hia roh mola-mèci na mi èdhi kahèi. èèna ka dhu miu tadèngi dènge laladhe mèdhi deo na, nuka ama lamatua hia roh na.

source_text: for david ascended not into the heavens: but he saith himself, the lord said unto my lord, sit thou on my right hand,
target_text: daud mesa na ca'e boe la'e asa sorga, te ngaa na suri, peka na, ‘ama lamatua padhai lii dènge lamatua ja'a, peka na, madhèdi mi sebhe g'ana ja'a, ètu era dhu ja'a sadia mema,

source_text: till i make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet.
target_text: toke ja'a tao musu èu sèra, pahaha iisi mi èu. '

source_text: let all the house of israel therefore know assuredly, that god hath made him both lord and christ, this jesus whom ye crucified.
target_text: nèti èèna ka dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i re'a ku tare'a-re'a, lula-nèti yesus dhu miu paku pamadhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. nèngu, nuka kristus dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le. aa nèngu ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i kètu èdhi.

source_text: now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto peter and the rest of the apostles, brethren, what shall we do?
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii petrus ne, d'ara dhèu sèra roe. ka ra karèi petrus dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha leo sèra, peka na, a'ari! ji'i hud'i tao tasamia ku?

source_text: and peter said unto them, repent ye, and be baptized every one of you in the name of jesus christ unto the remission of your sins; and ye shall receive the gift of the holy spirit.
target_text: hèia petrus dhaa, peka na, miu èci-èci hud'i ele-ho'a ku, aa tèke eele ku sasala-sasigo miu aa'i-aa'i mi, ho miu lèpa hari madhutu lamatua. hèia soro iisi mi ho sarani, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, miu lèpa hari le madhutu j'ara mamuri yesus kristus. aa èèna j'aj'i tadha kahèi, peka na, lamatua saku eele le sasala-sasigo miu. èle èèna, miu sèmi mere roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: for to you is the promise, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the lord our god shall call unto him.
target_text: te ama lamatua moa le hia roh na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na. dènge j'ara ne'e, lii mamoa lula-nèti roh na, j'aj'i hia miu dènge ana-èpu miu kahèi. na moa hia mi dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: and with many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, save yourselves from this crooked generation.
target_text: aa petrus padhai lii ae hari mi rèngu, aku nèngu na, limuri ne, dhèu ae sero le nèti j'ara mamuri dhu mola. de miu mage-mage, sèna ka miu baku madhutu tatao dhèu bhelu sèra. te ngaa miu hud'i madhutu dhoka j'ara mola nèti ama lamatua di. dènge j'ara èèna, miu abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ne.

source_text: they then that received his word were baptized: and there were added unto them in that day about three thousand souls.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu ae sèra sèmi rare lii padhai lii petrus èèna dènge d'ara kateme. ka ra madhutu j'ara mamuri yesus, hèia ra soro iisi ra sèna ka abhu sarani. lod'o èèna, pe d'ai tèlu riho dhèu mai pa'èci dènge dhèu-dhèu unu yesus sèra.

source_text: and they continued stedfastly in the apostles' teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread and the prayers.
target_text: rèngu d'èi pa'èci dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu madhutu yesus. aa rèngu mamuri mera-milu èci dènge èci. bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu maj'èni nanene lii holo-nori nèti dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus. rèngu d'èi manèngi-mangaj'i sama-sama kahèi. aa rèngu d'èi ra'a-rinu mei èci.

source_text: and fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua sèra tao tadha malaa ae-ae, ka dhèu dhu ètu sèra sa malaa dènge madha'u.

source_text: and all that believed were together, and had all things common;
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus, aa'i-aa'i ra mamuri pakaboko dènge d'ara èci, ka ngaa dhu unu dhèu èci, j'aj'i unu rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ho ra pake sama-sama.

source_text: and they sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all, according as any man had need.
target_text: abhu cahag'e pahia mèdha-panyau ra, ho ra pala-bagi doi kab'ua na mi dhèu parcaya sèra, madhutu èci-èci dhu parluu.

source_text: and day by day, continuing stedfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu pa'èci ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. rèngu ra'a-rinu boko-boko mue-mue dènge d'ara karej'e-karae, nèti èmu èci asa èmu èci, dènge boe ka'uu-kamuki. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra mamuri èci tulu èci, dènge boe kire-kome.

source_text: praising god, and having favor with all the people. and the lord added to them day by day those that were saved.
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra ma'ète boe koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme. dhèu leo sèra d'èi rèngu titu kèna. nèti ca lod'o asa ca lod'o ama lamatua hia mamuri mi dhèu sèra, ho ra pa'èci dènge dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua yesus. ka rèngu asa ka ae.

source_text: now peter and john were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.
target_text: ca lod'o, pe d'ara hake tèlu nihia sa, petrus dènge yohanis lasi asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho neo sabaj'a dènge dhèu leo sèra.

source_text: and a certain man that was lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
target_text: rèngu neo maso re hèb'a oka, dhu ngara na ‘hèb'a saraga'. ètu èèna, rèngu rèdhi dhèu mone karuku èci, dhu karuku nèti ina na nara iisi ne. bèli-bèli mai, na, dhèu nedhe rèti ne asa era èèna, ho na kanata kacui-aai manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu cee dhu neo maso asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i re èèna.

source_text: who seeing peter and john about to go into the temple, asked to receive an alms.
target_text: ropa na ladhe nèdhi petrus dènge yohanis oe maso asa d'ara, ka na kanata kacui-aai, manèngi, peka na, ama-ama, ee! sue ku ja'a laa. hia ku ja'a ngaa, do?

source_text: and peter, fastening his eyes upon him, with john, said, look on us.
target_text: ka dua ra ladhe kaloo ka dhèu ne'e, hèia petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe ku mai!

source_text: and he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something from them.
target_text: hèia nèngu boti kètu na, ladhe asa rèngu dua ra, ka na pangee, na, waa! ele boe dua ra neo hia ja'a ngaa-ngaa ne.

source_text: but peter said, silver and gold have i none; but what i have, that give i thee. in the name of jesus christ of nazareth, walk.
target_text: te ngaa petrus peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a dènge boe doi hualaa ho hia mi èu! te, ngaa dhu ja'a unu, èèna ka dhu ja'a neo hia mi èu. de nanene paie-iie! dènge koasa yesus kristus, dhèu nasaret, ja'a pua èu kèd'i titu, ho kako!

source_text: and he took him by the right hand, and raised him up: and immediately his feet and his ankle-bones received strength.
target_text: hèia petrus kèpe ai g'ana dhèu karuku èèna, ka na pakèd'i patitu ne. kaca'a laa, haga dhèu ne'e be'a dènge ka, ètu d'ara ciki ood'e èèna kahèi.

source_text: and leaping up, he stood, and began to walk; and he entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising god.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, na pasoka titu, hèia na kako la'e-mai neo ne'a, haga nèngu be'a le, do dhae. èle èèna ka, na la'e palere dènge rèngu dua ra asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. na kako pasoa-pasoka dènge koa-kio ama lamatua.
