target_text: ropa padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka paulus nare roti. ka na sabaj'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua ètu madha rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. hèia nare ca'èta, ka na'a.

source_text: then were they all of good cheer, and themselves also took food. and we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.
target_text: ladhe rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka d'ara rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i èra hari. aa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra ra'a kahèi. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi ètu dedha kapa ne, dua ngasu pidhu nguru èna dhèu. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi nga'a-nginu.

source_text: and when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.
target_text: ropa bècu ngare, ana mataroo kapa se core eele karo-karo are-gandum asa d'ara dhasi, sèna ka ngi'u kapa abhu samaa hari.

source_text: and when it was day, they knew not the land: but they perceived a certain bay with a beach, and they took counsel whether they could drive the ship upon it.
target_text: ropa d'ara mèu te'e sa, ana mataroo kapa se ladhe rèdhi rai-dedha. te ngaa rèngu re'a boe rai mia èèna. rèngu ladhe rèdhi kahèi sai èci, dhu dènge salae. ka rèngu sanao ka, teko-teko rèngu bisa rèti kapa ne, maso asa hèb'a, ladhe oro-oro ku re sebhe lia ètu d'ara dhasi èèna, heka ra d'ai era salae èèna kèna.

source_text: and casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time loosing the bands of the rudders; and hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.
target_text: hèia ra ète eele tangad'a sèra, hud'i sène ètu d'ara dhasi. ka ra papuru uli, sèna ka hia kapa ne asa dae la'e. hèia ra ère paca'e lai cika, sèna ka ngèlu tiu kapa ne asa era salae èèna.

source_text: but lighting upon a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground; and the foreship struck and remained unmoveable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.
target_text: te ngaa, lula kapa ne rage oto, ka eta dènge ètu èèna, bisa heka kalau ciki sa. hèia naha aae mai, hake pamae hui kapa ne.

source_text: and the soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.
target_text: ropa sordad'u se ladhe rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka ra neo pamadhe aa'i ana bèdho sèra. lula ra pangee, mage dhoka ana bèdho sèra nangi lasi asa dae, ho ra rai.

source_text: but the centurion, desiring to save paul, stayed them from their purpose; and commanded that they who could swim should cast themselves overboard, and get first to the land;
target_text: te ngaa komedhaa yulius kai sordad'u nèngu sèra, lula na neo sèna ka paulus bisa mamuri. ka na paredha ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a nangi ridhu asa d'ara dhasi, sèna ka nangi asa dae.

source_text: and the rest, some on planks, and some on other things from the ship. and so it came to pass, that they all escaped safe to the land.
target_text: aa dhèu dhu re'a boe nangi, na pua si kèpe papa, do sad'i rage ngaa sa, sèna ka madhutu naha hae asa dae. ka ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi d'ai dae dènge sod'a.

source_text: and when we were escaped, then we knew that the island was called melita.
target_text: ropa ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi d'ai dae dènge sod'a, heka nge'a kèna, na, rai èèna, pulu malta.

source_text: and the barbarians showed us no common kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us all, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu ètu kabarai èèna, sèmi rare ji'i dènge be'a. lula èj'i mai, ka pacuhi titu kèna, nèti èèna ka, ra bhubhu ai ètu kètu nebhe èèna, ka ra gale ji'i la'a manyiru ai.

source_text: but when paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out by reason of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
target_text: paulus madhutu kabhili aj'u kahèi, ho palake asa d'ara ai. te ngaa ropa na tao aj'u asa d'ara ai, cag'ag'a laa, mege ci'u dhu dènge raco kalua asa li'u mai, lula taha boe dènge ai pana. ka na kadhi kacui-aai paulus.

source_text: and when the barbarians saw the venomous creature hanging from his hand, they said one to another, no doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped from the sea, yet justice hath not suffered to live.
target_text: ropa dhèu malta sèra ladhe rèdhi mege dhu dhone-dhone ètu kacui-aai paulus, ka ra paka'uu èci dènge èci, peka na, èle boe dhèu ne, tuka pamadhe dhèu. ka masi ka nèngu madhe boe dhasi, te ngaa ne'e ne d'ai unu nèngu kèna. nèti èèna ka, nèngu bisa heka mamuri! lula cee dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu, nèngu ka dhu sèmi nare babia na.

source_text: howbeit he shook off the creature into the fire, and took no harm. but they expected that he would have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but when they were long in expectation and beheld nothing amiss come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.
target_text: dhèu se pangee, na, tatu ciki oo'e hari, kacui-aai paulus bai, ho na madhe dènge ka. te ngaa paulus pici mege ne asa d'ara ai la'e. aa na rasa boe pèd'a ciki sa. ka dhèu se'e tatae ku nèbhu j'oo aae, te ngaa paulus ngaa-ngaa tao boe. hèia ra pangee, na, èle boe dhèu ne, dewa!

source_text: now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named publius; who received us, and entertained us three days courteously.
target_text: kaj'èu boe nèti era èèna, abhu èmu-èmu gubernur ètu rai dhu taleo. gubernur èèna, ngara na publius. na mai soru ji'i ètu nebhe dhasi, ka gale nèti ji'i la'a pea ètu èmu na. ètu èèna, na ladhe-leru ji'i tèlu lod'o.

source_text: and it was so, that the father of publius lay sick of fever and dysentery: unto whom paul entered in, and prayed, and laying his hands on him healed him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama d'èlu gubernur pèd'a maringi sagoro, dènge pèd'a po'e taruu. ka paulus la'e ladhe ne asa d'ara kama na. hèia na soro kacui-aai na g'ag'e dhèu pèd'a ne, ho na sabaj'a hia ne. ka na èle dènge ka.

source_text: and when this was done, the rest also that had diseases in the island came, and were cured:
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi ama d'èlu gubernur èle le, ka dhèu pèd'a dhu leo sèra mai asa paulus. ra manèngi tulu nèti nèngu, ka na puri-pa'èle si.

source_text: who also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board such things as we needed.
target_text: hèia dhèu se pad'elo tadha makasi rèngu, dènge rèti mèdha ae titu kèna hia ji'i.

source_text: and after three months we set sail in a ship of alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose sign was the twin brothers.
target_text: ji'i pea ètu malta tèlu hèru, toke pa'èle hèru dhasi-ngèlu aae. lod'o èèna, abhu kapa cue nèti alexandria dhu karèi nèti hèru dhasi aae ngèlu aae panahu le ètu èèna. ngara kapa na, ana kembar, lula ètu kaduru kapa ne, ra tao patung dewa kembar. ka ji'i neo ca'e kapa èèna, ho la'a taruu asa roma. de lod'o ji'i neo ca'e asa dedha kapa, dhèu malta sèra hia ji'i parèko j'ara dènge mèdha leo dhu ji'i parluu ètu d'ara kakako.

source_text: and touching at syracuse, we tarried there three days.
target_text: ji'i kako mau-mau, ka ji'i d'ai kota sirakusa, ètu pulu sisilia. hèia ji'i panahu ètu èèna, tèlu lod'o.

source_text: and from thence we made a circuit, and arrived at rhegium: and after one day a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to puteoli;
target_text: nèti èèna, ji'i kako oro-oro re sebhe pulu sisilia, ka ji'i d'ai kota regium. asa bèli èèna, ngèlu balèu mèdhu aae, hèia ji'i kako taruu, ka d'ai malai. asa camèd'a èèna, ji'i d'ai kota hèb'a-namo cue, ngara na putioli.

source_text: where we found brethren, and were entreated to tarry with them seven days: and so we came to rome.
target_text: ètu èèna, ji'i puru tèke eele kapa èèna. hèia ji'i la'a tenge dhèu sarani dhu ètu era sèra. ropa paraga dènge ra, ka ra manèngi sèna ka ji'i pea dènge rèngu. ka ji'i manubha ètu èèna, ca migu. èle èèna ka, ji'i kako haga la'a asa roma.

source_text: and from thence the brethren, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as the market of appius and the three taverns; whom when paul saw, he thanked god, and took courage.
target_text: ropa dhèu sarani ètu roma sèra tadèngi, na, ji'i neo la'a asa nèi, hèia rèngu mai soru ji'i ètu talora j'ara. cahag'e paraga dènge ji'i ètu pasa apius; aa cahag'e hari paraga dènge ji'i ètu era èci, ngara na pasanggrahan tèlu. lod'o paulus ladhe nèdhi si, ka na manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua, ka d'ara na èra dènge.

source_text: and when we entered into rome, paul was suffered to abide by himself with the soldier that guarded him.
target_text: ropa d'ai roma, sordad'u sèra pamaso dhèu bèdho sèra asa d'ara bèdho. te ngaa ra pamaso boe paulus. ra hud'i ne sène, ho bisa seb'a èmu cue. ètu èmu èèna, na pea dènge sordad'u dhèu èci dhu j'aga ne. kacui-aai rèngu dua ra, dhu èki pake rate.

source_text: and it came to pass, that after three days he called together those that were the chief of the jews: and when they were come together, he said unto them, i, brethren, though i had done nothing against the people, or the customs of our fathers, yet was delivered prisoner from jerusalem into the hands of the romans:
target_text: èle tèlu lod'o, hèia paulus paroa dhèu heka-dhèu heka dhèu yahudi ètu sèra, ho mai paraga dènge ne. ropa ra pakaboko, hèia paulus padhai lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a ètu ne'e ne, lula a'ari èdhi dhèu yahudi sèra kèpe rare ja'a ètu yerusalem. ka ra soro ja'a asa d'ara kacui-aai dhèu paredha roma. te ngaa ja'a tao sala boe ngaa-ngaa! ja'a tao boe ngaa-ngaa dhu lab'a isi kabarai èdhi. aa ja'a lab'a boe kahèi atora ad'a dhu èdhi sèmi tare nèti bèi-baki èdhi sèra.

source_text: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me at liberty, because there was no cause of death in me.
target_text: dhèu paredha parisa le lii ja'a ne ètu nèi. te ngaa ra abhu boe sasala ja'a èci sa dhu bisa abhu huku madhe. nèti èèna ka, ra neo patalale eele ja'a.

source_text: but when the jews spake against it, i was constrained to appeal unto cæsar; not that i had aught whereof to accuse my nation.
target_text: te ngaa, lula ama-ama dhèu yahudi sèmi boe lii pama'ète nèti dhèu paredha ho patalale ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ko'o do ko'o boe, ja'a hud'i ca'e banding ku mai asa roma. masi ka ja'a tao sèmi ne'e, te ngaa dènge boe d'ara neo galaa dhèu ja'a unu ku.

source_text: for this cause therefore did i entreat you to see and to speak with me: for because of the hope of israel i am bound with this chain.
target_text: nèti lii langu ne'e ka, ja'a pakaboko a'ari aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e. madhutu dad'èi ja'a, èdhi bisa padhue-padhai ngaa dhu èdhi dhèu yahudi sanao-maena: nuka, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti sanao mi dhèu aae dhu ama lamatua neo hia mai, sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi dhèu isra'el. nèti j'ara se'e ka, ra èki ja'a dènge rate ne.

source_text: and they said unto him, we neither received letters from judæa concerning thee, nor did any of the brethren come hither and report or speak any harm of thee.
target_text: hèia dhèu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, toke d'ai lod'o deo ne'e ne, ji'i sèmi mèka sasuri èci sa nèti yudea, dhu peka lii langu èu ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, a'ari dhu mai nèti nèi, lolo boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa lula-nèti èu.

source_text: but we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i neo nanene ngaa dhu èu parcaya, lula ji'i tadèngi le ètu mia-mia, peka na, dhèu sèmi boe ngaa dhu partei kristen sèra aj'a-nori si. de mamèci na, tasamia? ji'i dhae nge'a mèka. de lolo ku dènge ji'i laa.

source_text: and when they had appointed him a day, they came to him into his lodging in great number; to whom he expounded the matter, testifying the kingdom of god, and persuading them concerning jesus, both from the law of moses and from the prophets, from morning till evening.
target_text: ka rèngu rare lii èci ho pili ca lod'o dhu leo, sèna ka ra paraga hari. ropa d'ai lod'o pamoa èèna, dhèu ae titu kèna mai pakaboko ètu era pea paulus. hèia paulus mulai lole ka dènge rèngu, dad'èi ama lamatua mi dhèu unu na. na pake isi nèti sasuri musa, dènge sasuri dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua dhu leo sèra, sèna ka rèngu bisa parcaya yesus. na padhai lii nèti mad'ae toke d'ai lod'o nihia.

source_text: and some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai lii paulus ne, abhu ka cahag'e dhu parcaya. te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu parcaya boe.

source_text: and when they agreed not among themselves, they departed after that paul had spoken one word, well spake the holy spirit through isaiah the prophet unto your fathers,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, rèngu pab'ala èci dènge èci, toke cahag'e neo lèpa. te ngaa paulus peka, aku nèngu na, mema lii pasisu miu ne, lèke sama sèmi ngaa dhu uru èèna roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka le dènge yesaya,

source_text: saying, go thou unto this people, and say, by hearing ye shall hear, and shall in no wise understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall in no wise perceive:
target_text: peka na, ‘lamu peka dènge dhèu se'e se, na, èèna na, miu nanene taruu lii ja'a, te ngaa me'a boe ciki sa! miu laladhe taruu ngaa dhu ja'a tao, te ngaa miu pusi boe ciki sa.

source_text: for this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest haply they should perceive with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should turn again, and i should heal them.
target_text: lula d'ara dhèu se'e se adhu sèmi hadhu. dhilu rèngu d'èi heka nanene! aa musi madha rèngu, bèdho mèno le! hud'i rèngu sène, ra tadèngi ia ka; aa hud'i laa, sèna ka musi madha ra ladhe rèdhi ia ka. aa hud'i laa, sèna ka d'ara ra adhu sèmi hadhu taruu. toke d'ai rèngu sèra re'a heka j'ara ho lèpa mai asa ja'a, de j'ara tasamia ka ja'a bisa tao pabe'a hari rèngu? '

source_text: be it known therefore unto you, that this salvation of god is sent unto the gentiles: they will also hear.
target_text: hèia paulus katange lii padhai lii na, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, a'ari! sèna ka miu se me'a, na, ama lamatua sadia tèke le mamuri hia dhèu yahudi boe, lula rèngu dhu d'èi nanene ne.

source_text: and he abode two whole years in his own hired dwelling, and received all that went in unto him,
target_text: paulus pea ka ètu èmu dhu na seb'a èèna, d'ai dua tèu. na sèmi dènge karej'e dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mai tenge paraga dènge ne.

source_text: preaching the kingdom of god, and teaching the things concerning the lord jesus christ with all boldness, none forbidding him.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, nèngu abhu j'ara sèna ka na aj'a-nori si lula-nèti paredha ama lamatua, aa j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus kahèi. na lole dènge pahuni boe, aa na abhu boe dhu pahèb'e ne. ama teofilus dhu be'a. lii lolo ja'a d'ai sange ne'e ka. makasi. nèti ja'a, lukas

source_text: paul, a servant of jesus christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of god,
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua pili nare le ja'a ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. ka na ded'e ja'a j'aj'i ana pua-paleha kristus, ho laku lole lii lolo be'a na dènge dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: which he promised afore through his prophets in the holy scriptures, concerning his son, who was born of the seed of david according to the flesh,
target_text: uru èèna, ama lamatua dhu ator tèke le, ho dhèu rèti lii padhai na suri j'ara-j'ara nèti lii lolo be'a èèna ètu sasuri mola-mèci na. te, ètu d'ara sasuri ne, lamatua pajaji neo hia mai ana na yesus, ho j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha. de limuri ne, lii moa na èèna j'aj'i le, lula yesus dhu mai le nèti ana-èpu dhèu aae daud.

source_text: who was declared to be the son of god with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead; even jesus christ our lord,
target_text: te ngaa re èci hari, ama lamatua pad'elo tadha, peka na, yesus kristus èèna, ana nèngu kahèi. te roh yesus èèna, mola-mèci tare'a-re'a, sama sèmi ama lamatua. aa lamatua pake koasa na, sèna ka pamamuri hari yesus nèti mamadhe na. nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a, na, ana ama lamatua èèna, nuka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: through whom we received grace and apostleship, unto obedience of faith among all the nations, for his name's sake;
target_text: yesus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a, te na pili nare le ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na, ho lole lii aj'a-nori na buli mia-mia. dad'èi na, dhèu dhu yahudi boe parcaya ne kahèi, aa mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. ja'a neo kahèi, sèna ka dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i lèka kristus, aa mamuri madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: among whom are ye also, called to be jesus christ's:
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu ètu kota roma. miu j'aj'i nèti suku ae-ae nèti mia-mia, yesus kristus dhu hag'e nare le miu, peka na, mai ka! mai j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a!

source_text: to all that are in rome, beloved of god, called to be saints: grace to you and peace from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'adhu sasuri ne hia miu ètu roma, dènge pasanèd'e, peka na, ama lamatua sue miu. nèngu manèngi kahèi ho miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu mamuri mola-mèci. ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka ama èdhi, ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra, aa hia miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: first, i thank my god through jesus christ for you all, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.
target_text: ja'a bhoke sasuri ja'a ne, dènge manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua, lula yesus kristus sab'a ètu d'ara miu. ja'a manèngi makasi kahèi, lula dhèu dhu pea ètu rae-rae d'ara paredha roma, ra palolo lula-nèti parcaya miu mi yesus.

source_text: for god is my witness, whom i serve in my spirit in the gospel of his son, how unceasingly i make mention of you, always in my prayers
target_text: ja'a loe boe sabaj'a hia miu. tare'a! lamatua mesa na ne'a, na, ngaa dhu ja'a padhai ne, lèke. nèngu ne'a kahèi, na, ja'a ne sab'a dènge d'ara kateme ho lole dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a nèti ana na.

source_text: making request, if by any means now at length i may be prospered by the will of god to come unto you.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i, ja'a peka sèmi ne'e ka: lamatua, ja'a mesa ku ke'a boe j'ara na tasamia. te ngaa, ladhe madhutu dad'èi lamatua, na, bhoke la j'ara, sèna ka ja'a bisa laku pangad'o dènge angalai ja'a sèra ètu roma.

source_text: for i long to see you, that i may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a sèmi èèna, te ja'a neo titu kèna kèdhi miu, sèna ka ja'a bisa bagi hia miu koasa nèti roh lamatua, ho hud'i laa miu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua dhu taha pa'èra-èra.

source_text: that is, that i with you may be comforted in you, each of us by the other's faith, both yours and mine.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhiu pea dènge miu, ja'a neo pa'èra d'ara miu, ho sèna ka parcaya miu asa èra. aa ja'a neo kahèi ho miu pa'èra d'ara ja'a.

source_text: and i would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes i purposed to come unto you and was hindered hitherto, that i might have some fruit in you also, even as in the rest of the gentiles.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a d'èi ladhe miu me'a, na, ja'a neo ae le ho dhiu pangad'o dènge miu ètu roma. te ngaa toke sange ne'e, dhodhoka tao nelu di. de ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhiu, ja'a sanao sèna ka abhu dhèu ae era dhu lèka èra kristus, sama sèmi dhu ja'a abhu ètu era-era leo. ladhe sèmi èèna, na, rui-j'aj'èra ja'a abhu hua-hela dhu be'a.

source_text: i am debtor both to greeks and to barbarians, both to the wise and to the foolish. so, as much as in me is, i am ready to preach the gospel to you also that are in rome.
target_text: masi ka, tasamia èèna ka, ja'a hud'i lole ku lii lolo be'a lamatua mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. mi dhèu dhu pake lii yunani do, dhèu dintiu dhu pake lii leo, dhèu kapai do, dhèu haha do, dhèu sakola do, dhèu sakola boe. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'èra neo dhiu sa roma, sèna ka paraga dènge miu.

source_text: for i am not ashamed of the gospel: for it is the power of god unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the jew first, and also to the greek.
target_text: ja'a makae boe ciki sa, dènge lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. te ladhe abhu dhèu dhu parcaya ama lamatua, lii lolo be'a ne dènge koasa nèti lamatua, ho patabuli dhèu ne'e nèti koasa sasala-sasigo na. dhèu yahudi ka dhu re'a uuru j'ara ne'e ne, heka dhèu suku leo sèra kèna.

source_text: for therein is revealed a righteousness of god from faith unto faith: as it is written, but the righteous shall live by faith.
target_text: lii lolo be'a ne pad'elo kahèi j'ara lamatua ho pamola dhèu nèti sasala ra. aa'i-aa'i sèra sa bisa j'aj'i, sad'i dhèu parcaya ne. te dhu suri le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, dhèu hud'i parcaya uuru ku ama lamatua, heka bisa pabe'a dènge nèngu kèna. te ladhe ra mamuri dènge parcaya ne, heka abhu mamuri dhu lèke kèna.

source_text: for the wrath of god is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hinder the truth in unrighteousness;
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka le, na, abhu dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe nèngu. aa abhu dhu ad'u-ue rupa-rupa j'ara bhelu-katub'a. te ngaa lamatua sèmi nare boe tatao rèngu sèra. lula ètu d'ara iiki rèngu, dhu re'a le, mia ka dhu lèke. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu loe boe tao j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe sèra. ra kakèj'i dhèu, toke dhèu re'a heka mia ka dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua papuru hahuku nèti dedha-liru, sèna ka paj'èra si.

source_text: because that which is known of god is manifest in them; for god manifested it unto them. for the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity; that they may be without excuse:
target_text: dhèu se'e se, abhu boe alasan ho siri iisi ra, lula j'ara-j'ara dhu pahuni boe dhu dhèu bisa re'a mèu nèti lamatua. te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu pad'elo! a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: mulai nèti na paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, toke d'ai sange ne'e ne, ladhe dhèu neo re'a mèu nèti ngi'u lamatua, aa dènge koasa na dhu dènge boe too-lane èèna, bisa kahèi! masi ka ladhe tèdhi boe ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu bisa tadhe ne nèti ngaa-ngaa dhu na ad'u-ue. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka, na, dhèu bhelu sèra abhu boe alasan ho siri iisi ra, peka na, ja'a ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: because that, knowing god, they glorified him not as god, neither gave thanks; but became vain in their reasonings, and their senseless heart was darkened.
target_text: de masi ka rèngu re'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua, te ngaa ro'o boe mangaku, na, lamatua èèna, ama lamatua èdhi! rèngu se ro'o boe, manèngi makasi mi lamatua kahèi. ka ngangee ra j'aj'i kahèlu, toke ra re'a heka ngaa dhu lèke. rèngu j'aj'i bingu aa padhai lii rupa-rupa dhu kolo-kapua aad'o lula-nèti ama lamatua. aa d'ara ra maroga aatu-aatu.

source_text: professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
target_text: rèngu èci-èci padedha iisi ra, peka na, ja'a ke'a mèu madha j'ara ae-ae! masi ka ngangee ra sèmi èèna, te ngaa madhutu mola-mola na, rèngu goa titu kèna.

source_text: and changed the glory of the incorruptible god for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, and four-footed beasts, and creeping things.
target_text: ka dhèu se pahaha boe iisi ra mi ama lamatua dhu kapai risi eele èèna, te rèngu peka na, ji'i pusi boe lamatua sèmi èèna! te ngaa ra sogo-tagu mi rupa-rupa patung, raropa sèmi dhèu rai-haha, sèmi manu-bhui sa, do sèmi badha leo sèra, toke d'ai patung dhu rupa sèmi mege sa. dènge ra sogo-tagu sèmi èèna, rèngu tule eele ama lamatua dhu mamuri taa-taa, ho ra gati eele dènge mèdha-panyau dhu bisa madhe!

source_text: wherefore god gave them up in the lusts of their hearts unto uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves:
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lamatua soro tèke si, sèna ka ra ad'u-ue madhutu dad'èi rèngu. na soro tèke si, ho ra tao j'ara bhelu-katub'a rupa-rupa, dhu amo le ètu d'ara rèngu. toke rèngu se re'a heka makae sa hèi. hèia dènge ngi'u aae ra, rèngu ad'u-ue madha j'ara kaj'alu rupa-rupa, aa ra tao sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu leo.

source_text: for that they exchanged the truth of god for a lie, and worshipped and served the creature rather than the creator, who is blessed for ever. amen.
target_text: ètu d'ara iiki ra dhu re'a le j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke nèti ama lamatua, te ngaa ro'o boe madhutu. ngangee rèngu dhu moca le, hèia ra pangee, na, be'a risi èdhi tao rupa-rupa. masi ka pakarehe aa'i-aa'i, ngaa-ngaa tao boe! ra koa-kad'iri mèdha dhu lamatua paj'aj'i, te ngaa rèngu pahaha boe iisi mi lamatua dhu paj'aj'i mèdha se. ra tao iisi sèmi dhèu dhu mola-mèci, te ngaa dhu mola-mèu lao di! dhu lèke ka, ladhe èdhi dhèu rai-haha ne koa-kio taruu ama lamatua! èèna ka dhu mèci!

source_text: for this cause god gave them up unto vile passions: for their women changed the natural use into that which is against nature:
target_text: nèti bhabhelu-katub'a rèngu sèra ka, lamatua soro tèke si, ho rèngu tao karehe sèmi èèna madhutu dad'èi ra. hèia ra tao rupa-rupa j'ara makae, dhu dènge heka d'ara makae. bhèni ra, ro'o heka pa'èci dènge mone dhèu èmu ra, te ngaa d'èi tao dhu lèke boe. te bhèni j'unu tao j'ara makae dènge bhèni.

source_text: and likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another, men with men working unseemliness, and receiving in themselves that recompense of their error which was due.
target_text: dhèu mone sèmi èèna kahèi! ra d'èi heka j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu èmu ra, te ngaa d'èi j'unu dènge dhèu mone leo! rèngu se, dhu dènge heka d'ara makae! nèti èèna ka, pe rèngu dui rare j'aj'èra pamèci dènge tatao rèngu sèra! te rèngu se dhu sigo eele kaj'èu le, nèti j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: and even as they refused to have god in their knowledge, god gave them up unto a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;
target_text: ra pangee, na, be'a risi baku patai-patapa dènge lamatua. nèti èèna ka, lamatua soro tèke si, sèna ka ra tao madhutu dad'èi ra! de rèngu ngee dhoka dhu karehe di! ka ra tao j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe!

source_text: being filled with all unrighteousness, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
target_text: mamuri ra pènu dènge rupa-rupa bhabhelu-katub'a. ka re'a heka tao dhu be'a, te ngaa dhoka dhu bhelu di. rèngu manga'a. èci tèke d'ara dènge èci. èci d'èi boe karisi èci. èci pamadhe èci. ra d'èi patao-palaha. ra kapod'e-kabèli. ra leko-monya. ra d'èi padhai-kakoli dhèu.

source_text: backbiters, hateful to god, insolent, haughty, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
target_text: rèngu d'èi pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. ra palab'a dènge ama lamatua. ra kurang ajar, d'èi pahahe dhèu, d'èi padedha iisi, d'èi tenge j'ara-j'ara karehe, aa d'èi palab'a dènge ina-ama ra.

source_text: without understanding, covenant-breakers, without natural affection, unmerciful:
target_text: ro'o boe re'a dènge j'ara dhu mola. ro'o boe re'a dènge lii pamoa unu ra, ka dhèu lèka heka rèngu. re'a boe sue dhèu. dènge boe d'ara kasia ciki sa mi dedha dhèu.

source_text: who, knowing the ordinance of god, that they that practise such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also consent with them that practise them.
target_text: rèngu re'a le atora ama lamatua dhu peka na, dhèu dhu tao rupa-rupa bhabhelu, hud'i abhu huku madhe. masi ka re'a le atora ne, te ngaa loe boe tao rupa-rupa bhabhelu. mesa boe se'e se di, te ngaa ra dadugu-rariu dhèu leo, sèna ka tao bhelu kahèi. ne'e ne seli-kolane!

source_text: wherefore thou art without excuse, o man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest dost practise the same things.
target_text: èu dhu tadèngi le rupa-rupa j'ara bhabhelu-katub'a deo na, si? hèia èu pangee, na, bhabhelu dhèu se'e seli-kolane! ladhe èu pangee le sèmi èèna, na, mu mage-mage, ee! te èu mesa mu bhelu sèmi èèna kahèi. nèti èèna ka, èu dènge boe alasan ho siri iisi èu, masi ka èu ne cee èèna ka. ladhe èu peka, na, lèke tare'a dhèu dhu bhelu sèra abhu huku, te ngaa baku bhèlu, na, èu mesa mu ka pèci sasala mi ngi'u èu unu mu. te èu tao sala sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: and we know that the judgment of god is according to truth against them that practise such things.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi te'a, peka na, ladhe ama lamatua hia huku mi dhèu bhelu sèra, tatu nèngu pama'ète lii langu ra dènge mola.

source_text: and reckonest thou this, o man, who judgest them that practise such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of god?
target_text: do, tasamia? ele boe èu pangee, na, lèke tare'a ladhe dhèu dhu tao bhelu-katub'a sèra abhu hahuku nèti lamatua. aa te ngaa èu kahèi dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu sama sèmi rèngu. te èu pangee, na, ja'a abhu boe hahuku nèti lamatua. ngangee èèna mai nèti mia?

source_text: or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering, not knowing that the goodness of god leadeth thee to repentance?
target_text: ama lamatua dhu pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èu. aa na mau-mau era, nèti tatao èu sèra. te ngaa tasamia ka èu pahahe ne? ele boe èu me'a boe, na, lamatua dhu pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èu ne, sèna ka èu tèke eele sasala èu, aa lèpa hari asa nèngu.

source_text: but after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up for thyself wrath in the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of god;
target_text: te ngaa èu ne kètu hadhu, aa mo'o boe nanene! aa mo'o boe core eele sasala èu, ciki sa hèi! de èu mesa mu ka dhu ad'u ho abhu huku dhu bia risi hari. te ropa d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, lamatua tai-dadoo mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i. aa èèna na dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, na, lamatua pama'ète lii langu dènge mola. pe na huku èu bia, lula na sèmi nare boe tatao èu sèra.

source_text: who will render to every man according to his works:
target_text: mamuri èu tasamia èèna ka, pe lamatua ka dhu b'ala madhutu tatao èu.

source_text: to them that by patience in well-doing seek for glory and honor and incorruption, eternal life:
target_text: te dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a taruu-taruu, lamatua hia ne mamuri dhu mola d'ai mia-mia. rèngu abhu pakab'ua nèti dhèu kahèi, kolongara hua iia, dènge mamuri taruu dènge ne toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: but unto them that are factious, and obey not the truth, but obey unrighteousness, shall be wrath and indignation,
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua sèmi nare boe dhèu dhu tao bhelu-katub'a. nèngu nasa titu kèna dènge si, te re'a dhoka palab'a di. dhèu se tao boe madhutu j'ara dhu lèke, te re'a dhoka tao madhutu j'ara dhu bhelu di.

source_text: tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that worketh evil, of the jew first, and also of the greek;
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao bhelu, bèli-camèd'a abhu j'aj'èra. masi ka dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe èèna ka, aa'i-aa'i ra pasae rare.

source_text: but glory and honor and peace to every man that worketh good, to the jew first, and also to the greek:
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao j'ara dhu be'a, bèli-camèd'a lamatua ded'e padedha-dedha, aa pakab'ua si, sèna ka ra abhu mamuri mera-milu. masi ka dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe èèna ka, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra abhu.

source_text: for there is no respect of persons with god.
target_text: te lamatua dhu hag'e boe rèhu dhèu!

source_text: for as many as have sinned without the law shall also perish without the law: and as many as have sinned under the law shall be judged by the law;
target_text: atora lamatua lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu re'a boe atora ne, dhu tao sala, èèna na cèri eele nèngu nèti lamatua. aa ladhe dhèu dhu re'a le atora ne, te ngaa na tao sala, pe lamatua pake hari atora ne, ho pama'ète hahuku na. rèngu cèri eele nèti lamatua kahèi, lula ra sisu le atora na.

source_text: for not the hearers of the law are just before god, but the doers of the law shall be justified;
target_text: neo pabe'a dènge ama lamatua, ladhe nanene dhoka atora di, èèna d'ai mèka. te hud'i tao madhutu ku atora na, heka na sèmi nare si kèna. de baku dhoka nanene di!

source_text: for when gentiles that have not the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are the law unto themselves;
target_text: masi ka dhèu yahudi boe sèra, re'a boe isi nèti atora lamatua, te ngaa abhu kahèi nèti rèngu dhu tao madhutu atora ne. lula d'ara iiki rèngu unu ra ka dhu peka, mia ka dhu lèke, aa mia ka dhu sale.

source_text: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience bearing witness therewith, and their thoughts one with another accusing or else excusing them;
target_text: dènge j'ara ne rèngu pad'elo, na, atora lamatua dhu suri ètu d'ara ra, nuka sèmi loa hèngu dhu lamatua manènu ètu d'ara ra. d'ara rèngu mesa ra, ka dhu tai-dadoo ngaa dhu rèngu ad'u-ue. hèia ngangee rèngu unu ra ka dhu galaa, na, rèngu dhu tao sale, aa peka na abhu dhu tao lèke.

source_text: in the day when god shall judge the secrets of men, according to my gospel, by jesus christ.
target_text: de lod'o ama lamatua ded'e yesus kristus j'aj'i dhèu pama'ète lii langu, na parisa toke lutu j'ara-j'ara dhu pahuni ètu d'ara dhèu. ja'a aj'a sèmi ne'e, sama sèmi dhu suri le ètu d'ara lii lolo be'a lamatua.

source_text: but if thou bearest the name of a jew, and restest upon the law, and gloriest in god,
target_text: de miu dhèu yahudi, tasamia? miu d'èi padedha iisi, peka na, dhoka miu di dhu kèpe atora lamatua, dhu na papuru mai re musa, sina ma? miu kahèi d'èi koa iisi, lula pa'èci miu dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: and knowest his will, and approvest the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
target_text: tare'a! miu dhu me'a le, dad'èi lamatua. miu dhu me'a kahèi, mia ka dhu be'a risi. miu me'a mèu le j'ara se aa'i-aa'i, lula mese agama ka dhu aj'a-nori miu nèti atora lamatua.

source_text: and art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them that are in darkness,
target_text: miu padedha iisi, peka na, miu bisa paj'uj'u j'ara hia dhèu dhu re'a boe lasi sa mia. miu tao iisi nuka sèmi saraa dhu pasaraa dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga.

source_text: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babes, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth;
target_text: lula miu kèpe pa'èra atora lamatua, ka miu pangee, na, miu me'a aa'i mèu-mèu, aa miu kèpe pa'èra-èra aa'i dhu lèke, sina ma? nèti èèna ka, miu pangee, na, miu bisa nori dhèu goa dènge ana iiki dhu re'a boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: thou therefore that teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: miu d'èi aj'a dhèu leo, te ngaa tasamia ka miu mo'o boe nori ngi'u mi? ! miu d'èi ca'e mimbar, ho peka na, dhèu baku mana'u. te ngaa, nga tao ka miu unu mi mana'u? !

source_text: thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou rob temples?
target_text: miu aj'a, na, baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali mu. te ngaa, nga tao ka miu mesa mi tao j'ara makae sèmi èèna? ! miu mesa mi d'èi boe mèdha sogo-tagu, te ngaa nga tao ka miu mana'u pahuni mèdha nèti d'ara èmu nidhu?

source_text: thou who gloriest in the law, through thy transgression of the law dishonorest thou god?
target_text: miu d'èi lole pakapai atora lamatua, te ngaa nga tao ka miu mesa mi sisu atora ne, aa pamakae lamatua? !

source_text: for the name of god is blasphemed among the gentiles because of you, even as it is written.
target_text: te karèi nèti uru ka, dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, na, lula bhabhelu miu dhèu yahudi, nèti èèna ka dhèu leo kara pahahe kolongara lamatua.

source_text: for circumcision indeed profiteth, if thou be a doer of the law: but if thou be a transgressor of the law, thy circumcision is become uncircumcision.
target_text: miu dhèu yahudi hud'i suna ku madhutu atora lamatua, sina ma? èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, miu dhèu yahudi dhu unu hak, ho sèmi mere lii padhadha lamatua. te ngaa ladhe miu sisu atora lamatua, na, lamatua sèmi nare boe miu. miu j'aj'i èci èèna ka dènge dhèu yahudi boe, aa sama sèmi dhèu dhu suna rèdhi mèka.

source_text: if therefore the uncircumcision keep the ordinances of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be reckoned for circumcision?
target_text: pangee paie-iie! te ladhe dhèu dhu suna boe, tao madhutu atora lamatua, èèna na lamatua sèmi nare ne, nuka sèmi dhèu yahudi dhu suna, si?

source_text: and shall not the uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who with the letter and circumcision art a transgressor of the law?
target_text: te ngaa baku pamud'e! te ladhe dhèu yahudi boe, dhu suna boe, tao madhutu atora lamatua, èèna na ra pad'elo ngaa? ra pad'elo sasala miu, peka na, dhèu yahudi dhu suna, sisu atora lamatua, masi ka miu dhu unu le atora ne karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: for he is not a jew who is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh:
target_text: baku pangee, na, dhèu dhu j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham, aa dhu suna ètu ka'uri, èèna ka dhu tao ne j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua dhu lèke. aad'o!

source_text: but he is a jew who is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of god.
target_text: dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua dhu lèke, nuka dhèu dhu pabe'a dènge lamatua. te suna dhu lèke, èèna ka hia dhèu j'aj'i ana ama lamatua, dhu tao boe tadha ètu ka'uri, te ngaa tadha ètu d'ara dhèu, dhu roh lamatua tao. dhèu rai-haha koa boe dhèu sèmi sèra, te ngaa lamatua ka dhu ded'e padedha si.

source_text: what advantage then hath the jew? or what is the profit of circumcision?
target_text: ladhe sèmi èèna, dhèu yahudi dhu suna sèra, a'oto na ngaa? ele boe miu pangee, na, dhèu yahudi abhu ae dènge dhu be'a risi nèti dhèu yahudi boe, do?

source_text: much every way: first of all, that they were intrusted with the oracles of god.
target_text: tare'a! de dhèu yahudi abhu oto ètu j'ara ae-ae. ka èci, lula lamatua pangèd'u sasab'a sa dhèu yahudi, ho suri aa j'aga paie-iie lii holo-nori na.

source_text: for what if some were without faith? shall their want of faith make of none effect the faithfulness of god?
target_text: de tasamia? miu dhu pangee, na, ama lamatua bisa boe tao madhutu ngaa dhu na padhai le, lula abhu dhèu yahudi cahag'e dhu parcaya boe nèngu, do?

source_text: god forbid: yea, let god be found true, but every man a liar; as it is written, that thou mightest be justified in thy words, and mightest prevail when thou comest into judgment.
target_text: bisa boe! masi ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne kapod'e-kabèli, te ngaa ama lamatua padhai lii dhu mola taruu! sanèd'e, te dhu suri tèke ètu sasuri mola-mèci lula-nèti ngi'u lamatua, peka na, abhu dhèu dhu pèci sasala, peka na, nèngu pama'ète lii langu dhu bia cabèka. te ngaa pe rèngu re'a, na, ngaa dhu na peka-padhai èèna lèke tare'a. nèngu tatu segi, lula na bisa boe padhai lii sale.

source_text: but if our unrighteousness commendeth the righteousness of god, what shall we say? is god unrighteous who visiteth with wrath? i speak after the manner of men.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi tao sala, èèna ka dhu peka paled'a mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ngaa dhu lamatua tao èèna mema lèke tare'a. ladhe sèmi èèna, èdhi peka ngaa hari? neo peka, na, lamatua adil boe ladhe na huku èdhi, do? te abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu padhai lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: god forbid: for then how shall god judge the world?
target_text: bisa boe! lamatua sala boe ladhe na huku èdhi. lula na dènge hak ho huku dhèu dhu tao sala ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: but if the truth of god through my lie abounded unto his glory, why am i also still judged as a sinner?
target_text: de ladhe ja'a padhai lii monya, èèna peka na, hahuku lamatua lèke tare'a. ladhe ja'a pad'elo dadedha na sèmi èèna, nga tao ka nèngu parisa mamuri ja'a, ka pama'ète lii langu ja'a, na, ngaa dhu ja'a ad'u-ue ne, sala?

source_text: and why not as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say, let us do evil, that good may come? whose condemnation is just.
target_text: baku sèmi èèna! ladhe madhutu ka ngangee sèmi èèna, miu madhutu dhèu dhu peka, na, hud'i laa èdhi tao bhelu-katub'a ae risi hari, sèna ka j'ara be'a asa tabha ae kahèi! dhèu dhu peka sèmi èèna, pantas abhu huku. te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu pa'ele iie kolongara ja'a, peka na, ja'a ka aj'a dhèu sèmi èèna.

source_text: what then? are we better than they? no, in no wise: for we before laid to the charge both of jews and greeks, that they are all under sin;
target_text: de tasamia? miu pangee, na, èdhi dhèu yahudi be'a risi nèti dhèu yahudi boe, do? aad'o! te ja'a peka le dènge miu, na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu manahu le asa d'ara sasala, masi ka dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe.

source_text: as it is written, there is none righteous, no, not one;
target_text: te dhu suri mema ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, na, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu mamuri mola taruu. èci sa aad'o!

source_text: there is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after god;
target_text: abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re'a mèu j'ara-j'ara ama lamatua. abhu boe èci sa dhu neo patadha dènge lamatua.

source_text: they have all turned aside, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not so much as one:
target_text: rèngu pakaj'èu le nèti j'ara mamuri dhu mola. ka rèngu se guna heka mi ngaa èci sa. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu pad'elo d'ara be'a. èci sa aad'o hèi!

source_text: their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit: the poison of asps is under their lips:
target_text: lii padhai ra dhu hèu bhob'o, nuka sèmi ro'a dhèu madhe dhu ra kèi hari. nèti d'ara hèb'a ra kalua dhoka lii kapod'e-kabèli di. lii dhu kalua nèti d'ara hèb'a ra, nuka sèmi raco mege.

source_text: whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
target_text: hèb'a ra re'a dhoka padhèd'a di, aa lii padhai ra karehe, dhu papèd'a d'ara dhèu, te èèna ka dhu mai nèti d'ara rèngu dhu karehe.

source_text: their feet are swift to shed blood;
target_text: re'a boe madha'u ladhe pamadhe dhèu.

source_text: destruction and misery are in their ways;
target_text: sad'i rèngu ètu mia èèna ka, na, lii langu, muri ètu èèna, aa pasusa rupa-rupa mi dedha dhèu.

source_text: and the way of peace have they not known:
target_text: mamuri ra dhu re'a boe padame, aa re'a boe mamuri dènge d'ara dhu mau.

source_text: there is no fear of god before their eyes.
target_text: rèngu se bisa boe taha rare d'ara ra, lula dènge boe d'ara madha'u ciki sa mi ama lamatua.

source_text: now we know that what things soever the law saith, it speaketh to them that are under the law; that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of god:
target_text: de èdhi te'a, na, lamatua hia atora na mi dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi atora sèra. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu abhu boe alasan ho siri iisi, peka na, rèngu se, dhèu d'ara mola. ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne hud'i paraga ku dènge ama lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu j'ue lii langu dhu peka na, sala do aad'o.

source_text: because by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified in his sight; for through the law cometh the knowledge of sin.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa peka, na, ama lamatua cap ja'a, dhèu d'ara mola, lula ja'a tao madhutu aa'i atora lamatua. bisa boe! te atora lamatua ka dhu pad'elo, na, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti tao sala.

source_text: but now apart from the law a righteousness of god hath been manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
target_text: baku malaa dènge naneo lamatua dhu paj'uj'u j'ara, ho èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge nèngu. dhu lèke, ladhe èdhi bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua, te ngaa lula boe nèti èdhi tao madhutu atora na. te atora na dhu suri le sèmi èèna, aa dhèu rèti lii padhai na uru-uru sèra, peka sèmi èèna kahèi ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na.

source_text: even the righteousness of god through faith in jesus christ unto all them that believe; for there is no distinction;
target_text: ama lamatua peka, na, èdhi dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne, ropa èdhi parcaya yesus kristus. nèngu dhu hag'e boe rèhu dhèu, te na tao sèmi èèna mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus.

source_text: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of god;
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i tao sala. nèti èèna ka, dhèu dhu tenge-tenge j'ara ho neo pabe'a ngi'u rèngu dènge ama lamatua, bisa boe pamèci dènge dadedha lamatua.

source_text: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in christ jesus:
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa pama'ète, peka na, èdhi dènge heka sasala. na sèmi nare èdhi, lula yesus kristus sui nare le èdhi nèti sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: whom god set forth to be a propitiation, through faith, in his blood, to show his righteousness because of the passing over of the sins done aforetime, in the forbearance of god; for the showing, i say, of his righteousness at this present season: that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him that hath faith in jesus.
target_text: ama lamatua paj'uj'u le yesus, sèna ka j'aj'i korban papo makae ho saku eele sasala-sigo èdhi. te ngaa èdhi hud'i parcaya ne, na, nèngu ka dhu tago nare hahuku èdhi. ka na pasuti raa na, aa madhe gati èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, ama lamatua peka na, ngaa dhu na pama'ète ne, lèke tare'a. uru èèna, d'ara lamatua taleo titu kèna, hèia na pama'ète ho pabhèlu eele sasala-sasigo dhu dhèu ad'u-ue le. te ngaa ladhe na huku boe dhèu dhu tao sala, nèngu adil boe. de na bhoke j'ara, sèna ka yesus kristus dui nare hahuku nèti dhèu sala. limuri ne, lamatua pad'elo mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i, peka na, nèngu tao dhu be'a taruu. ka dhèu sala aa'i-aa'i ra dhu parcaya yesus, na cap si dhèu mola.

source_text: where then is the glorying? it is excluded. by what manner of law? of works? nay: but by a law of faith.
target_text: de tasamia? ele boe miu pangee, na, miu bisa padhai lii lela dedha, lula ama lamatua sèmi nare miu, do? bisa boe! miu neo pad'elo atora èci dhu tao pabe'a miu dènge lamatua, do? miu pangee, na, lamatua sèmi nare miu lula miu tao dhu be'a, do? bisa boe! èdhi te'a dhoka paj'uj'u mi atora dhu peka na, ama lamatua sèmi nare èdhi, lula èdhi parcaya yesus. nèngu na, kèna!

source_text: we reckon therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a sèmi ne'e: dhèu bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua, nèti ra parcaya yesus, nèti boe rèngu tao madhutu atora di.

source_text: or is god the god of jews only? is he not the god of gentiles also? yea, of gentiles also:
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ama lamatua sèmi nare dhoka dhèu yahudi di, do nèngu sèmi nare dhèu leo kahèi? lèke! na sèmi nare aa'i!

source_text: if so be that god is one, and he shall justify the circumcision by faith, and the uncircumcision through faith.
target_text: te ama lamatua ne, dhoka èci di. aa dhoka j'ara èci di, dhu na sèmi nare sèna ka èdhi dhèu rai-haha ne bisa pabe'a dènge ne. nuka èdhi hud'i parcaya kristus. j'ara ne pala mi dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu yahudi boe kahèi.

source_text: do we then make the law of none effect through faith? god forbid: nay, we establish the law.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ladhe èdhi parcaya lamatua, èèna na tao atora na j'aj'i heka ngaa-ngaa, do? aad'o! dhu lèke ka, parcaya èdhi èèna ka dhu tao pamèci atora na.

source_text: what then shall we say that abraham, our forefather, hath found according to the flesh?
target_text: èdhi tare conto nèti abraham, baki ji'i dhèu yahudi. èdhi bisa te'a ngaa nèti nèngu lula-nèti dhèu bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua, lula parcaya kristus?

source_text: for if abraham was justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not toward god.
target_text: èdhi bisa te'a sèmi ne'e: ladhe abraham bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua, lula na tao j'ara be'a, nèngu kahèi abhu hak ho koa iisi ètu madha dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ètu madha lamatua, nèngu bisa boe bhoka hèb'a.

source_text: for what saith the scripture? and abraham believed god, and it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.
target_text: te dhu suri ètu sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci, peka na, lula abraham parcaya ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka, lamatua peka na, abraham ne dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge nèngu.

source_text: now to him that worketh, the reward is not reckoned as of grace, but as of debt.
target_text: dhèu sab'a, tatu abhu gaji. èèna na doi iia d'ara boe, te ngaa doi dhu lamatua na b'ae ne gati rui-j'aj'èra. te sèra sa hak nèti dhèu sab'a.

source_text: but to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is reckoned for righteousness.
target_text: lamatua ka dhu unu hak, ho peka na, dhèu cee dhu parcaya yesus kristus bisa pabe'a hari dènge ne, masi ka uru èèna, dhèu ne tao sala aa pahae boe lamatua. abhu boe j'ara èci sa, dhu dhèu bisa ad'u-ue, ho pabe'a ngi'u nèngu dènge lamatua. te dhèu hud'i parcaya uuru ku yesus kristus, heka lamatua peka na, nèngu dhèu d'ara mola, aa lamatua sèmi nare ne.

source_text: even as david also pronounceth blessing upon the man, unto whom god reckoneth righteousness apart from works,
target_text: dhèu aae daud peka kahèi, na, d'ara dhèu karèj'e-karae, ropa ama lamatua peka na, dhèu se dhu d'ara mola, masi ka rèngu tao boe ngaa-ngaa. te daud suri, na,

source_text: saying, blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
target_text: masi ka dhèu se sisu atora lamatua, te ngaa na saku eele sasala-sasigo si. nèti èèna ka, rèngu oto titu kèna! dhèu dhu tao bhabhelu, lamatua pabhèlu eele sasala si.

source_text: blessed is the man to whom the lord will not reckon sin.
target_text: te ladhe lamatua pa'iga heka sasala dhèu, na, dhèu sèra oto tare'a!

source_text: is this blessing then pronounced upon the circumcision, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say, to abraham his faith was reckoned for righteousness.
target_text: de ele boe miu pangee, na, dhodhoka dhèu yahudi dhu suna di, dhu bisa oto, ho ra pabe'a dènge lamatua, si? aa dhèu suku leo dhu suna boe, bisa boe, si? aad'o! ngangee sèmi sèra sala! nèti èèna ka, ji'i dhu peka mema-mema le, lula abraham parcaya lamatua, ka lamatua cap ne, dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge nèngu.

source_text: how then was it reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision:
target_text: lod'o mia lamatua cap abraham sèmi èèna? lod'o dhu na suna le, do dhae? dhu mola-mola, nuka lèke lod'o dhu na suna mèka.

source_text: and he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might be reckoned unto them;
target_text: tare'a! lod'o abraham suna mèka, ama lamatua cap nare le nèngu dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge lamatua. nèbhu ku, heka na suna kèna, ho j'aj'i tadha, na, nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu dhu lèka lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna ka, abraham j'aj'i dhèu oti j'ara hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua. te lamatua sèmi nare dhèu dhu parcaya, ho ra pabe'a dènge lamatua, masi ka ra suna, do aad'o.

source_text: and the father of circumcision to them who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father abraham which he had in uncircumcision.
target_text: abraham bhoke j'ara kahèi hia èdhi dhèu yahudi dhu suna le. lula boe nèti èdhi suna, te ngaa lula èdhi parcaya kristus sama sèmi abraham parcaya lamatua lod'o dhu na suna mèka.

source_text: for not through the law was the promise to abraham or to his seed that he should be heir of the world, but through the righteousness of faith.
target_text: ama lamatua dhu pa'èki pajaji dènge abraham, dènge ana-èpu na, peka na, nèbhu-nèbhu rai-haha kateme j'aj'i mi pusaka rèngu. lamatua pajaji sèmi èèna, lula abraham parcaya ne, aa lamatua cap ne dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne. te ngaa lamatua pajaji boe sèmi èèna, ladhe dhoka abraham tao madhutu atora lamatua.

source_text: for if they that are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of none effect:
target_text: te ladhe dhèu dhu madhutu dhoka atora lamatua di, bisa sèmi rare pusaka dhu lamatua moa, sasoa na, parcaya mi lamatua parcuma di. aa lii pajaji lamatua èèna guna boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: for the law worketh wrath; but where there is no law, neither is there transgression.
target_text: ètu era mia abhu atora lamatua, ètu èèna kahèi dhèu sisu atora èèna. aa ladhe dhèu sisu atora lamatua, na, lamatua nasa, hèia na huku si. aa ladhe atora lamatua aad'o, tatu dhèu sisu boe.

source_text: for this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace; to the end that the promise may be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of abraham, who is the father of us all
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i parcaya ku lamatua. èèna ka dhu risi eele nèti aa'i-aa'i. te lamatua d'èi pad'elo dènge mola-mola d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu dhu parcaya ne. aa ladhe èdhi lèka ne, sama sèmi abraham, tatu èdhi abhu ngaa dhu na moa, masi ka èdhi dhèu yahudi dhu tao madhutu atora na, do aad'o. de èdhi aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ne, sama sèmi ana-èpu abraham.

source_text: as it is written, a father of many nations have i made thee before him whom he believed, even god, who giveth life to the dead, and calleth the things that are not, as though they were.
target_text: lamatua dhu peka tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na, aku nèngu na, ja'a ad'u-ue sèna ka èu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae. abraham parcaya ama lamatua. nèbhu-nèbhu ka ama lamatua tao paj'aj'i lii moa na. nèngu kahèi dhu pamamuri hari dhèu madhe. lamatua dhoka padhai lii di, ka ngaa-ngaa dhu aad'o, j'aj'i dènge.

source_text: who in hope believed against hope, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, so shall thy seed be.
target_text: masi ka abraham dènge mèka ana, te ngaa na lèka ama lamatua, aa tatae lamatua tao madhutu lii pajaji na. nèti parcaya èèna ka, lamatua tao ne j'aj'i mi bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae. èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, na, ana-èpu ae-ae bèli-camèd'a mai nèti èu.

source_text: and without being weakened in faith he considered his own body now as good as dead he being about a hundred years old, and the deadness of sarah's womb;
target_text: abraham lèka èra lamatua, masi ka ne'a nèngu dhu heka bhora le, umur dhu cangasu tèu kèna. era ana nèti sara dhu bèdho mèno le, aa na heka d'ai seli le.

source_text: yet, looking unto the promise of god, he wavered not through unbelief, but waxed strong through faith, giving glory to god,
target_text: te ngaa lalèka abraham kura boe, ho pangee na, lamatua bisa boe tao madhutu lii padadha na. parcaya na asa tabha èra mi lamatua, aa na ded'e padedha kolongara lamatua.

source_text: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
target_text: abraham lèka tare'a-re'a, ngaa dhu lamatua padhadha le, nèngu bisa tao.

source_text: wherefore also it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua cap abraham, peka na, dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge nèngu.

source_text: now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was reckoned unto him;
target_text: sasuri mola-mèci lamatua peka na, lamatua ige boe sèmi èèna hia abraham mesa na,

source_text: but for our sake also, unto whom it shall be reckoned, who believe on him that raised jesus our lord from the dead,
target_text: te ngaa mi èdhi kahèi! te ladhe èdhi parcaya lamatua, na cap èdhi kahèi dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne. lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari kètu èdhi, yesus nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
target_text: yesus madhe, lula èdhi ad'u-ue sasala-sasigo. hèia na mamuri hari, ho bhoke j'ara, sèna ka èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with god through our lord jesus christ;
target_text: de, lula èdhi parcaya ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka na cap èdhi dhèu d'ara mola. hèia d'ara èdhi j'aj'i mola-mèci hia lamatua, lula kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua mai, bhoke j'ara ho èdhi bisa padame dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: through whom also we have had our access by faith into this grace wherein we stand; and we rejoice in hope of the glory of god.
target_text: kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, lula èdhi parcaya le nèngu. nèti èèna ka, d'ara èdhi j'aj'i èra. aa d'ara èdhi karae kahèi, lula te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo ded'e èdhi, sèna ka te'a mèu dadedha na.

source_text: and not only so, but we also rejoice in our tribulations: knowing that tribulation worketh stedfastness;
target_text: masi ka èdhi abhu rupa-rupa sasusa, te ngaa d'ara èdhi karej'e-karae taruu. te èdhi te'a, na, j'èra uuru ku heka bisa taha dènge èra risi hari.

source_text: and stedfastness, approvedness; and approvedness, hope:
target_text: ladhe èdhi èra ka ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, èèna ka dhu tao èdhi manahu boe, aa mamuri èdhi pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. ladhe èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna, èèna ka dhu pa'èra parcaya èdhi, peka na, pe lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi.

source_text: and hope putteth not to shame; because the love of god hath been shed abroad in our hearts through the holy spirit which was given unto us.
target_text: ladhe lalèka èdhi asa èra sèmi èèna, èdhi makae boe. te lamatua dhu bagi le hia èdhi, roh na dhu mola-mèci, sèna ka èdhi te'a mèu, na, nèngu dhu sue èdhi titu kèna.

source_text: for while we were yet weak, in due season christ died for the ungodly.
target_text: nèngu pad'elo sasue na sèmi ne'e ka: ropa èdhi mampu boe pabe'a dènge lamatua, te'a boe, na, lamatua dhu pua kristus madhe pala èdhi. te ngaa èdhi dhu mamuri pusi-pahae boe lamatua. lamatua pili lod'o dhu lèke sèna ka tao aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: for scarcely for a righteous man will one die: for peradventure for the good man some one would even dare to die.
target_text: pangee paie-iie ku! te cadhui ku abhu dhèu dhu sadia madhe hia angalai na dhu d'ara mola. ele boe abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu sadia madhe, ho soru dhèu d'ara be'a.

source_text: but god commendeth his own love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, christ died for us.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua pad'elo le sasue na ae-ae mi dedha èdhi. lula, lod'o èdhi mamuri ètu d'ara sasala era, kristus madhe le gati èdhi.

source_text: much more then, being now justified by his blood, shall we be saved from the wrath of god through him.
target_text: ama lamatua cap èdhi, dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne, lula kristus pasuti raa na, sèna ka madhe gati èdhi. aa te ngaa, ladhe dhèu ue sasala, lamatua nasa. te ngaa nèti mamadhe kristus, èdhi dhu tao sala abhu heka huku.

source_text: for if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to god through the death of his son, much more, being reconciled, shall we be saved by his life;
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi pamusu dènge lamatua. te ngaa ana ama lamatua mesa na madhe, ho cuhi d'ara lamatua, sèna ka èdhi bisa padame dènge lamatua. de limuri ne, èdhi pamusu heka, te ngaa pabe'a hari le. risi-risi hari, kristus dhu mamuri hari le, pe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, na hia èdhi mamuri, sèna ka èdhi baku lèke hahuku.

source_text: and not only so, but we also rejoice in god through our lord jesus christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
target_text: mesa boe èèna di! d'ara èdhi bisa karae, peka na, lamatua ne, dedha risi eele! lula èdhi pa'èki dènge ne. èdhi bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lula kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, madhe le pala èdhi, sèna ka èdhi padame dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: therefore, as through one man sin entered into the world, and death through sin; and so death passed unto all men, for that all sinned: -
target_text: de karèi nèti uuru èèna ka, adam ka dhu tao uru sasala-sasigo. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua hia boe ne mamuri taruu. hèia karèi nèti lod'o èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne madhutu ad'u-ue sasala kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge nèngu. aa, lula rèngu tao sala sama sèmi adam, ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i madhe ku nuka sèmi nèngu kahèi.

source_text: for until the law sin was in the world; but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, lod'o ama lamatua papuru mèka atora na, dhèu tao le sasala dhu pale-lème le rai-haha ne. te ngaa, lula dènge mèka atora, ka abhu boe dhu ige sasala-sasigo dhèu sèra.

source_text: nevertheless death reigned from adam until moses, even over them that had not sinned after the likeness of adam's transgression, who is a figure of him that was to come.
target_text: mulai nèti adam toke d'ai musa sèmi rare atora lamatua èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i tatu madhe. masi ka rèngu sisu boe paredha lamatua dhu pangèd'u mi adam, te ngaa ra tao rupa-rupa sasala. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hud'i madhe ku, nuka sèmi adam. ladhe èdhi pasoro adam dènge lamatua yesus, abhu dhu sama, aa abhu dhu sama boe. te adam èci èèna ka dènge rupa dhu paj'uj'u asa raropa yesus, dhu bèli-camèd'a èèna cèu mai.

source_text: but not as the trespass, so also is the free gift. for if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of god, and the gift by the grace of the one man, jesus christ, abound unto the many.
target_text: te ngaa sasala adam, sama boe dènge babe'a dhu yesus hia èdhi. te dhèu èci, nuka adam, sisu paredha lamatua. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i madhe ku. te ngaa dhèu èci hari, nuka yesus kristus, tao rupa-rupa babe'a hia mi èdhi, aa pamata boe dhèu b'ala babe'a na. nèti tatao ca dhèu ne'e ka, pad'ai mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, te ama lamatua d'èi tao be'a hia èdhi.

source_text: and not as through one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment came of one unto condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses unto justification.
target_text: dhu ama lamatua pangèd'u mi èdhi, sama boe dènge sasala dhu adam tao èèna. ropa adam tao sasala, ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu, peka na èu sala. de èu hud'i abhu huku! te ngaa masi ka dhèu ue sasala ae titu kèna, ama lamatua, dhu parisa mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i, neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na era, aa pama'ète, na, èu sala boe. de èu bebas le, aa mu abhu heka huku. mai, sèna ka pabe'a hari dènge ja'a!

source_text: for if, by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; much more shall they that receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, even jesus christ.
target_text: de ca dhèu nuka adam dhu tao sala, aa sisu paredha lamatua. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i madhe ku. te ngaa dhèu èci hari, nuka yesus kristus dhu tao be'a. lula tatao na dhu be'a èèna ka, èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge lamatua. èèna nuka sèmi mèdha èci dhu na hia iia d'ara mi èdhi. na neo hia èdhi mamuri dhu lèke, sama sèmi èdhi j'aj'i angalai dhèu aae.

source_text: so then as through one trespass the judgment came unto all men to condemnation; even so through one act of righteousness the free gift came unto all men to justification of life.
target_text: de nèti ca dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala, na bhoke j'ara ho ama lamatua babège eele dhèu aa'i-aa'i nèti madha na. aa nèti ca dhèu leo hari dhu tao j'ara dhu lèke, na bhoke j'ara ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa pabe'a hari dènge lamatua, sèna ka mamuri mola dènge ne.

source_text: for as through the one man's disobedience the many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one shall the many be made righteous.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e: adam ne, ca dhèu dhu d'èi boe nanene lamatua, ka sisu paredha lamatua. aa dhèu ae kahèi madhutu tao sasala, sama sèmi adam. aa yesus ne, ca dhèu dhu nanene lamatua, ka tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, sèna ka dhèu ae bisa pabe'a hari dènge lamatua.

source_text: and the law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace did abound more exceedingly:
target_text: ama lamatua papuru atora na re musa, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu, mia dhu sala. te ngaa ètu mia-mia sasala dhèu asa tabha ae. ètu èèna kahèi, lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na ae risi hari.

source_text: that, as sin reigned in death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life through jesus christ our lord.
target_text: uru èèna, bhabhelu ètu d'ara dhèu abhu koasa dhu uri rèngu, toke ra tao sasala dhu nèti mamadhe. te ngaa limuri ne, j'ara be'a dhu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus tao èèna, ama lamatua pake ho pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi. aa j'ara be'a ne dènge koasa sèna ka ator èdhi kahèi, hèia èdhi bisa pabe'a dènge ama lamatua, aa mamuri mola taruu dènge ne.

source_text: what shall we say then? shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
target_text: de èdhi peka ngaa hari? ele boe miu pangee, na, ama lamatua pabhèlu eele le sasala èdhi, lula d'ara hua iia na. nèti èèna ka, hud'i laa èdhi tino tao sala, sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na risi hari mi èdhi.

source_text: god forbid. we who died to sin, how shall we any longer live therein?
target_text: aad'o sèmi èèna! lèke boe ladhe èdhi tao sala taruu. te èdhi dhu pama'ète tare le, peka na, èdhi tèke eele aa'i le sasala-sasigo èdhi. lula èdhi pa'èki heka dènge bhabhelu-katub'a, èèna nuka sèmi èdhi dhu madhe le! te dhèu dhu madhe le bisa heka tao sala, si? ladhe èdhi madhe le, tasamia hari èdhi bisa mamuri ad'u-ue sasala? bisa boe, sina ma?

source_text: or are ye ignorant that all we who were baptized into christ jesus were baptized into his death?
target_text: ele boe miu me'a boe, na, ropa sarani èdhi, èèna j'aj'i tadha, na, èdhi tèke eele le mamuri dhui, ho abhu mamuri hiu, nuka dhu pa'èki dènge yesus kristus. èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhe le palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: we were buried therefore with him through baptism into death: that like as christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the father, so we also might walk in newness of life.
target_text: lod'o kristus madhe, ra padhane ne. aa lod'o ra sarani èdhi, èèna nuka sèmi èdhi madhe kahèi, tèke eele mamuri dhui, hèia ra padhane èdhi. de ama lamatua pake koasa na dhu kapai aae èèna, ho pamamuri hari kristus nèti mamadhe na. ama lamatua d'èi ladhe èdhi sèmi tare koasa na kahèi, ho mamuri hari j'aj'i dhèu dhu hiu.

source_text: for if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection;
target_text: te èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhe palere dènge yesus. de èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge ne, tatu bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri hari nèti mamadhe, sama sèmi nèngu mamuri hari.

source_text: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away, that so we should no longer be in bondage to sin;
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu dhu tao rupa-rupa sasala. te ngaa mamuri èdhi dhu dhui èèna, madhe le, èci èèna ka dènge paku pamadhe èdhi ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha palere-lere dènge kristus. limuri ne, bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi dènge heka koasa ho uri èdhi. limuri ne, èdhi aad'o heka ètu d'ara a'èki sèna ka tao hari sasala. te èdhi sèmi heka ènu dhu dènge boe hak ho pili neo tao ngaa.

source_text: for he that hath died is justified from sin.
target_text: ladhe dhèu dhu madhe le, nèngu bebas le, si? abhu heka ngaa èci sa laka-seti ne, ho ad'u-ue hari sasala.

source_text: but if we died with christ, we believe that we shall also live with him;
target_text: de, lula èèna nuka sèmi èdhi madhe le palere-lere dènge kristus, na, èdhi parcaya, peka na, bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri taruu dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: knowing that christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death no more hath dominion over him.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, lula yesus kristus mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na, de nèngu bisa heka madhe hari. te abhu boe èci sa dhu dènge koasa ho pamadhe hari ne.

source_text: for the death that he died, he died unto sin once: but the life that he liveth, he liveth unto god.
target_text: na madhe ca tèka èèna ka, ho segi koasa nèti sasala. te ngaa limuri ne na mamuri ho pakab'ua ama lamatua.

source_text: even so reckon ye also yourselves to be dead unto sin, but alive unto god in christ jesus.
target_text: miu hud'i tao ku iisi sèmi èèna. nuka sèmi miu dhu madhe le, nèti èèna ka sasala dènge heka koasa mi dedha miu. de limuri ne, miu hud'i mamuri ku ho pakab'ua ama lamatua, lula miu dhu pa'èki le dènge yesus kristus.

source_text: let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey the lusts thereof:
target_text: bhabhelu ètu d'ara èu dhu dènge koasa. baku soro tèke bhabhelu èèna ator èu, ka èu dhoka madhutu dad'èi ngi'u aae sèna ka èu tao bhabhelu-katub'a. te èèna na ngi'u aae èu madhe.

source_text: neither present your members unto sin as instruments of unrighteousness; but present yourselves unto god, as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto god.
target_text: aa baku soro isi èu sèna ka tao j'ara dhu lèke boe, te èèna sala kahèi. te ngaa pangèd'u mamuri èu mi ama lamatua di, sèna ka nèngu ka dhu uri mamuri èu. sama sèmi èu dhu madhe le, ka mamuri hari. de pake la mamuri èu kateme aa'i, sèna ka tao j'ara dhu lèke sèra, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: for sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under law, but under grace.
target_text: baku soro tèke sèna ka sasala ator miu, sama sèmi sasala ka dhu j'aj'i lamatua miu. de limuri ne miu hud'i mamuri madhutu ia ka atora musa, sèna ka pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. te miu dhu mamuri mola le, lula lamatua dhu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi miu. de limuri ne d'ara hua iia lamatua ka dhu uri mamuri miu.

source_text: what then? shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? god forbid.
target_text: de tasamia? ele boe miu ngee, na, èdhi madhutu ia ka atora musa, ho pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. de hud'i laa èdhi tao sala taruu di. te lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na era mi èdhi! miu pangee sèmi èèna ka, si? ja'a pasanèd'e, èèna na sale!

source_text: know ye not, that to whom ye present yourselves as servants unto obedience, his servants ye are whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
target_text: ja'a kore upama nèti ènu dènge lamatua na. ladhe miu soro ngi'u mi ho sab'a hia dhèu èci, na, miu hud'i nanene, aa sab'a madhutu dad'èi na. te nèngu èèna kètu miu, aa miu j'aj'i ènu na. sèmi èèna kahèi, miu bisa pili neo madhutu mia. te miu bisa pili, sèna ka ad'u-ue sasala, hèia miu j'aj'i mi ènu nèti sasala ne. te ngaa ladhe miu pili sèmi èèna, miu tao iisi mi pacèri nèti ama lamatua. do, miu bisa pili tao dhu lèke, dènge j'aj'i ènu dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua pua mi. ladhe pili sèmi èèna, miu bisa pabe'a dènge ne!

source_text: but thanks be to god, that, whereas ye were servants of sin, ye became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching whereunto ye were delivered;
target_text: uru èèna, miu soro tèke sèna ka sasala uri miu, te ngaa limuri ne miu nanene d'ara iiki miu, sèna ka tao madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu sarani aj'a-nori miu. nèti èèna ka ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and being made free from sin, ye became servants of righteousness.
target_text: te lamatua dhu patalale le miu nèti koasa sasala, toke sasala sèra uri heka miu. de limuri ne, j'ara dhu lèke ka dhu uri miu.

source_text: i speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness unto sanctification.
target_text: ja'a peka ne'e, pake conto dhu j'aj'i bèli-bèli, nèti lamatua dènge ènu, sèna ka miu me'a malai ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai. uru èèna, miu hia ngi'u miu j'aj'i ènu sèna ka tao sala, dhu pakaj'alu miu madhutu atora musa. te ngaa limuri ne, miu hud'i hia ngi'u miu j'aj'i ènu dhu me'a dhoka tao dhu be'a di, dhu hia miu j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: for when ye were servants of sin, ye were free in regard of righteousness.
target_text: uru èèna, ropa miu dhoka nanene aa tao madhutu dad'èi sasala, miu mo'o boe nanene aa tao dhu lèke.

source_text: what fruit then had ye at that time in the things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: miu abhu ngaa dhu be'a nèti tatao miu sèra? aad'o, sina ma? aa te ngaa, ngaa dhu miu abhu sèra tao miu mi'e makae di. lula miu tao sala sèmi èèna, ka dhu miu abhu, nuka lamatua soro kabodho mi miu.

source_text: but now being made free from sin and become servants to god, ye have your fruit unto sanctification, and the end eternal life.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ama lamatua patalale eele le miu nèti lamatua uru èèna, de miu parluu ia ka tao sasala. de ne'e ne miu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu sab'a nèti ama lamatua. lèpa lod'o limuri, pe miu j'aj'i mola-mèci hia ne, aa abhu mamuri mola-mèci dhu d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: for the wages of sin is death; but the free gift of god is eternal life in christ jesus our lord.
target_text: te ropa èdhi tao sasala, lamatua tule eele èdhi toke d'ai mia-mia. èèna ka dhu èdhi abhu. èdhi madhe kèna! te ngaa ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara èci hia èdhi. te na neo hia iia èdhi mamuri mola dhu ma'ète boe. èdhi abhu mamuri èèna, ladhe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: or are ye ignorant, brethren for i speak to men who know the law, that the law hath dominion over a man for so long time as he liveth?
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a neo padhai lii dènge miu dhu me'a mèu atora huku sèra. sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe miu mamuri era, atora huku dènge hak ho ator miu. te ngaa ladhe miu madhe le, atora huku dènge heka hak mi miu.

source_text: for the woman that hath a husband is bound by law to the husband while he liveth; but if the husband die, she is discharged from the law of the husband.
target_text: ja'a kore pakasame nèti atora dhèu èmu-kamali. ladhe dhèu bhèni èci leo le èmu dènge mone èci, na, madhutu atora huku, dua ra j'aj'i dhèu èmu-kamali toke madhe. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mone madhe uuru, bhèni balu ne pa'èki heka dènge atora deo na. nèngu bisa hari leo-èmu.

source_text: so then if, while the husband liveth, she be joined to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if the husband die, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she be joined to another man.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe bhèni ne leo hari èmu lod'o dhèu èmu na mamuri era, nèngu bersina. te ngaa ladhe dhèu èmu na madhe le, atora nèti laleo èmu lèke heka nèngu. bhèni ne j'aj'i dhèu kalora iisi. de ladhe na madhèdi hari dènge dhèu leo, madhutu atora, nèngu bersina boe.

source_text: wherefore, my brethren, ye also were made dead to the law through the body of christ; that ye should be joined to another, even to him who was raised from the dead, that we might bring forth fruit unto god.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu dhèu parcaya! sèmi ne'e: kristus madhe le. èèna nuka sèmi miu madhutu madhe dènge ne kahèi, hèia tèke eele mamuri miu dhu dhui. ka atora huku lèke heka mi miu. limuri ne atora huku lèke heka miu, te ngaa mamuri miu pa'èki dènge kristus, dhu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na. èèna cakaraa dènge bhèni balu dhu leo hari èmu. ngaa-ngaa tao boe. de limuri ne aa'i-aa'i dhu miu ad'u-ue sèra, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: for when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions, which were through the law, wrought in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
target_text: te uru èèna, èdhi tao dhoka madhutu dad'èi ngi'u aae èdhi di. lula èdhi te'a atora, èèna ka dhu hia èdhi sisu atora sèra, ho tao j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe. de sasala èdhi sèra ka dhu tao ama lamatua soro kabodho mi èdhi.

source_text: but now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that wherein we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi hud'i tao madhutu ku atora. te ngaa limuri ne, atora ne lèke heka èdhi, dhu tèke eele le mamuri dhu dhui. madhutu dad'èi j'ara dhui, na, atora musa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci èèna, dhu èki tèke èdhi. te ngaa madhutu dad'èi j'ara hiu, na, èdhi pa'èki heka dènge atora èèna. te roh lamatua ka dhu uri èdhi! nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi sab'a dhoka hia lamatua.

source_text: what shall we say then? is the law sin? god forbid. howbeit, i had not known sin, except through the law: for i had not known coveting, except the law had said, thou shalt not covet:
target_text: de èdhi neo peka ngaa? neo peka, na, atora dhu lamatua hia re musa ne, sala! aad'o! te ladhe ja'a ke'a mèu boe atora ne, tatu ja'a bisa boe ke'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe ètu d'ara ja'a. nuka sèmi, abhu atora dhu peka na, mage d'ara neo mere mèdha-panyau dhèu. te ngaa dènge j'ara tasamia ka, ja'a bisa ke'a, na, d'ara neo sèmi èèna, sala, ladhe ke'a boe atora èèna? bisa boe!

source_text: but sin, finding occasion, wrought in me through the commandment all manner of coveting: for apart from the law sin is dead.
target_text: te ngaa lula abhu atora dhu peka sèmi èèna, èèna nuka sèmi j'ara-j'ara bhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, sèna ka ja'a neo kore rupa-rupa mèdha-panyau dhèu. ladhe dènge boe atora dhu kai, sasala na abhu boe koasa ho ator dhèu.

source_text: and i was alive apart from the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and i died;
target_text: ètu mamuri ja'a uru èèna, ja'a ke'a mèu mèka dad'èi nèti atora lamatua. nèbhu-nèbhu ku, heka ke'a kèna. nèti èèna ka, ja'a mulai mase'a, na, ja'a sisu le atora sèra ka ad'u-ue sasala. de hua nèti sasala èèna ka, ja'a hud'i madhe ku.

source_text: and the commandment, which was unto life, this i found to be unto death:
target_text: hèia d'ara ja'a roe bhilu, te ke'a na, ja'a mesa ku bisa boe pabe'a ja'a dènge lamatua, ladhe tao madhutu dhoka atora na. de pantas ladhe ja'a abhu nanasa nèti lamatua, nuka huku madhe èèna, lula ja'a sisu le atora na. aa te ngaa lamatua hia atora ne, sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri dhu lèke. te ngaa bagi ja'a, atora ne ka dhu pa'ele iie ja'a, ka lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a.

source_text: for sin, finding occasion, through the commandment beguiled me, and through it slew me.
target_text: atora ne mema pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu mola. te ngaa abhu bhabhelu dhu sub'u ètu d'ara ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a tipu hari ngi'u ja'a mesa ku, ho pangee na, ja'a bisa pabe'a ja'a dènge ama lamatua, sad'i ja'a tao madhutu atora na. hèia èèna nuka sèmi atora mesa èèna ka dhu tao toke lamatua mad'enge dènge ja'a.

source_text: so that the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
target_text: de ladhe deo na dhèu peka na, atora dhu lamatua hia re musa èèna, sala, na, ja'a dhaa na, aad'o! atora lamatua ne, mola-mèci! aa paredha aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara atora ne mola-mèci, lèke, aa be'a kahèi.

source_text: did then that which is good become death unto me? god forbid. but sin, that it might be shown to be sin, by working death to me through that which is good; -that through the commandment sin might become exceeding sinful.
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, atora ne ka dhu tao lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a, do? aad'o! te masi ka ja'a ke'a atora sèra, te ngaa ja'a nanene taruu bhabhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, nèti èèna ka ja'a tao sala. de nèti sasala ja'a èèna ka lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a. atora ne mema be'a, te èèna ka dhu pad'elo j'ara-j'ara bhelu-katub'a dhu tao èdhi pacèri nèti ama lamatua. de ropa lamatua pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke, atora èèna ka dhu peka paled'a, na, bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi èèna, be'a boe.

source_text: for we know that the law is spiritual: but i am carnal, sold under sin.
