source_text: or did i commit a sin in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because i preached to you the gospel of god for nought?
target_text: lod'o ja'a aj'a miu lii holo-nori ama lamatua, ja'a manèngi boe miu ogo-oru hia ja'a. ja'a tao iisi nuka sèmi ana iiki sa, sèna ka bisa ded'e padedha miu. teko-teko nèti j'ara ne'e ka miu neo pasala ja'a, do?

source_text: i robbed other churches, taking wages of them that i might minister unto you;
target_text: te dhèu parcaya nèti juma'at era leo sèra ka dhu tago ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa ladhe-leru miu. ne'e èci èèna ka dènge ja'a kore nèti rèngu ho soru-bara miu.

source_text: and when i was present with you and was in want, i was not a burden on any man; for the brethren, when they came from macedonia, supplied the measure of my want; and in everything i kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will i keep myself.
target_text: lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ladhe ja'a parluu ngaa-ngaa, na, ja'a manèngi boe miu, aa pabia boe miu. a'ari èdhi dhu mai nèti propensi makedonia ka dhu soru-bara ja'a. te ngaa ja'a pabia kèdhi mèka miu, aa bèli-camèd'a ja'a pabia boe miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: as the truth of christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this glorying in the regions of achaia.
target_text: lii holo-nori kristus ne lèke tare'a-re'a. ja'a lèka mèu, na, lii padhai ja'a lèke kahèi, lula ja'a pa'èki dènge kristus. abhu boe ca dhèu sa ètu propensi akaya dhu bisa kutu hèb'a ja'a, aa kai ja'a sèna ka baku padhai lii padedha, peka na, ja'a pabia boe miu sèmi èèna.

source_text: wherefore? because i love you not? god knoweth.
target_text: nga tao ka ja'a peka sèmi ne'e? ele boe, lula ja'a sue boe miu, do? masi ka miu pangee sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua ne'a, na, ja'a sue miu.

source_text: but what i do, that i will do, that i may cut off occasion from them that desire an occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
target_text: j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao kèdhi le, ja'a tao taruu. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu dhu tema padedha iisi, peka na, tatao rèngu sèra èci èèna ka dènge tatao ji'i, na, padhai lii rèngu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: for such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, fashioning themselves into apostles of christ.
target_text: rèngu peka, na, lamatua ka dhu pajuu-paleha rèngu. rèngu se, dhèu sab'a dhu d'èi leko-monya dhèu! dhèu se tao iisi ra nuka sèmi dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu lèke nèti kristus. aa te ngaa rèngu se dhoka padhai lii hèb'a-hua!

source_text: and no marvel; for even satan fashioneth himself into an angel of light.
target_text: miu baku cag'ag'a! te dhèu aae nidhu kahèi tao iisi na sama sèmi ana-ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu nèti saraa aa d'ara be'a.

source_text: it is no great thing therefore if his ministers also fashion themselves as ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu baku malaa ladhe dhèu sab'a na neo tao iisi ra nuka sèmi dhèu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara mola. sanèd'e, te èèna na ama lamatua b'ala bhabhelu-katub'a rèngu.

source_text: i say again, let no man think me foolish; but if ye do, yet as foolish receive me, that i also may glory a little.
target_text: ladhe mo'o, na, ja'a padhai lii hari ciki sama sèmi dhèu goa. te ja'a neo padhai lii padedha iisi ciki.

source_text: that which i speak, i speak not after the lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of glorying.
target_text: dhu ja'a suri padedha iisi ne, dhoka neo padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu goa sa. te lii padhai ja'a ne kapua na nèti boe lamatua èdhi.

source_text: seeing that many glory after the flesh, i will glory also.
target_text: abhu dhèu ae dhu d'èi ded'e padedha ngi'u ra madhutu tatao dhèu rai-haha ne. de ja'a neo padhai lii padedha iisi kahèi sama sèmi rèngu.

source_text: for ye bear with the foolish gladly, being wise yourselves.
target_text: te miu dhu pangee, na, ngangee miu mola ladhe paraga dènge ca dhèu dhu kahadhu bia, na, miu soro tèke ne, si?

source_text: for ye bear with a man, if he bringeth you into bondage, if he devoureth you, if he taketh you captive, if he exalteth himself, if he smiteth you on the face.
target_text: ladhe dhèu leo tao miu madhutu dad'èi rèngu, na, miu soro tèke si. nuka sèmi: ladhe dhèu tao miu sèmi ènu sa, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe abhu dhu mana'u mèdha miu, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe abhu dhèu tipu miu, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe dhèu tao iisi nuka sèmi dhèu kapai, aa pahahe miu nuka sèmi ana iiki sa, na, miu soro tèke ne, do? sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tèb'e miu, na, miu soro tèke ne sène.

source_text: i speak by way of disparagement, as though we had been weak. yet whereinsoever any is bold i speak in foolishness, i am bold also.
target_text: te ngaa baku nasa! te ja'a makae, lula ji'i roe aala-aala. te ji'i lake ngare boe tao sèmi èèna, sama sèmi dhèu sèra tao mi dedha miu. te ngaa ladhe rèngu neo padedha iisi lula ngaa sa, ja'a bani padedha iisi sèmi èèna kahèi. te ngaa baku bhèlu, te ja'a padhai lii sèmi dhèu goa na!

source_text: are they hebrews? so am i. are they israelites? so am i. are they the seed of abraham? so am i.
target_text: rèngu se dhèu ibrani tare'a-re'a, do? oo! ja'a kahèi dhèu ibrani. rèngu dhèu isra'el, do? oo! ja'a kahèi. rèngu sèra ana-èpu abraham, do? oo! ja'a kahèi.

source_text: are they ministers of christ? i speak as one beside himself i more; in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in deaths oft.
target_text: rèngu sèra dhèu sab'a hia kristus, do? oo! ja'a kahèi sèmi èèna. baku bhèlu, te ja'a padhai lii paleko ne! mema, ja'a peka na, ja'a sama sèmi rèngu. aa te ngaa ja'a risi nèti rèngu. te ja'a sab'a bia risi. ra bèdho ja'a ae risi. ra game ja'a ae risi. ja'a kahèi oe madhe pahari-pahari ae risi nèti rèngu.

source_text: of the jews five times received i forty stripes save one.
target_text: ètu d'ara adhe-aai dhèu ja'a, dhèu yahudi, ra hake paparu ja'a lèmi hari. lod'o-lod'o ra hake paparu ja'a, na, ra hake tèlu nguru ceo hari pake gui.

source_text: thrice was i beaten with rods, once was i stoned, thrice i suffered shipwreck, a night and a day have i been in the deep;
target_text: tèlu hari, dhèu hake ja'a pake aj'u. ca tèka dhèu pèci neo pamadhe ja'a. ja'a molo dènge kapa tèlu hari. d'ara ca mèu ca mèda, ja'a leb'o-leb'o ètu d'ara dhasi.

source_text: in journeyings often, in perils of rivers, in perils of robbers, in perils from my countrymen, in perils from the gentiles, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
target_text: ja'a laku kaj'èu asa mia-mia pahari-pahari. ètu d'ara kakako ne, ja'a paraga dènge j'aj'èra rupa-rupa, dhu tao ja'a oe madhe. nuka sèmi: nèti èi aae lala ètu d'ara loko aae, nèti parapo, nèti dhèu ja'a dhèu yahudi, nèti dhèu yahudi boe, aa nèti dhèu dhu tao ngi'u ra sama sèmi a'ari dhèu parcaya, aa te ngaa rèngu leko-monya. ja'a oe madhe kahèi ètu talora lèu, ètu d'ara kota, dènge era dhèu pea boe.

source_text: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
target_text: ja'a sab'a bia, aa paraga dènge sasusa ae-ae. lod'o ae ka dhu ja'a bisa boe bhèj'i. ja'a manganga dènge koko-kamango kahèi. pahari-pahari ku'a boe ngaa-ngaa. abhu kahèi lod'o dhu ja'a unu boe mèdha-papake, ka maringi oe madhe.

source_text: besides those things that are without, there is that which presseth upon me daily, anxiety for all the churches.
target_text: aa ladhe mo'o boe ige j'ara se'e, na, ige sèmi ne'e ka: te bèli-bèli ja'a j'aj'i ngangee kapai, lula ngee kèdhi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya dhu pakaboko ètu mia-mia.

source_text: who is weak, and i am not weak? who is caused to stumble, and i burn not?
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu rasa roe-bhilu dhu bisa boe sab'a ngaa-ngaa, na, sanèd'e ja'a. te ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu dadugu dhèu-dhèu parcaya sèna ka tao j'ara karehe sama-sama dènge rèngu, na, ja'a makae, aa nasa.

source_text: if i must needs glory, i will glory of the things that concern my weakness.
target_text: ladhe ja'a neo padedha iisi, na, be'a risi ja'a padedha iisi lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu pad'elo raroe ja'a. tare'a!

source_text: the god and father of the lord jesus, he who is blessed for evermore knoweth that i lie not.
target_text: kètu èdhi yesus, dènge ama na, ama lamatua re'a, na, ja'a monya boe. dhu lèke, ladhe dhèu koa-kio ne toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: in damascus the governor under aretas the king guarded the city of the damascenes in order to take me:
target_text: conto nuka sèmi, uru èèna ètu kota damsik, gubernur nèti dhèu aae aretas pua dhèu mate ho kèpe ja'a ètu hèb'a tedhe kota.

source_text: and through a window was i let down in a basket by the wall, and escaped his hands.
target_text: te ngaa angalai ja'a pamaso ja'a asa d'ara karogo èci. ka ra dulu ja'a dènge dhari re li'u tembok kota. hèia gubernur kèpe nare boe ja'a. de sanèd'e, ladhe ja'a mesa-mesa ku, tatu bisa boe, si?

source_text: i must needs glory, though it is not expedient; but i will come to visions and revelations of the lord.
target_text: ladhe miu mo'o, na, ja'a padedha iisi hari ciki, masi ka gaguna aad'o. te ngaa ja'a neo peka dènge miu j'ara-j'ara dhu lamatua èdhi pad'elo le dènge ja'a ètu d'ara tanila.

source_text: i know a man in christ, fourteen years ago whether in the body, i know not; or whether out of the body, i know not; god knoweth, such a one caught up even to the third heaven. and i know such a man whether in the body, or apart from the body, i know not; god knoweth, how that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
target_text: ja'a tadhe ca dhèu unu kristus. canguru èpa tèu dhu la'e, abhu dhu ded'e ne asa dedha-liru dhu dedha aae. te ngaa ja'a ke'a boe, na ca'e dènge ngi'u aae, do dhoka roh nèngu di. dhodhoka lamatua di ne'a. ja'a ke'a kahèi, na, ropa ded'e ne asa era hua iia lamatua èèna, nèngu tadèngi lii padhai dhu be'a titu kèna, dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa boe peka-padhai.

source_text: on behalf of such a one will i glory: but on mine own behalf i will not glory, save in my weaknesses.
target_text: de mi dhèu sèmi èèna, ja'a neo padhai lii padedha. te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe padedha iisi lula-nèti ngi'u ja'a unu ku. ja'a ded'e dhoka raroe-bhilu ja'a, aa j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a bisa boe tao kore.

source_text: for if i should desire to glory, i shall not be foolish; for i shall speak the truth: but i forbear, lest any man should account of me above that which he seeth me to be, or heareth from me.
target_text: ladhe ja'a neo padedha iisi, na, ja'a parluu boe monya, te ja'a dhu dènge j'ara ae dhu lèke, dhu ja'a bisa peka-padhai. te ngaa ja'a mau-mau, sèna ka dhèu baku pangee, na, ja'a dènge kolo-karisi nèti ngaa dhu rèngu tadèngi aa ladhe rèdhi nèti ja'a.

source_text: and by reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that i should not be exalted overmuch, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of satan to buffet me, that i should not be exalted overmuch.
target_text: risi-risi hari, lamatua dhu pad'elo le dènge ja'a j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai titu kèna. te ngaa ja'a abhu susa kahèi, sèna ka ja'a baku pamone. te dhèu aae nidhu pua ana pajuu na èci, ho mai kakèj'i taruu ja'a, nuka sèmi dhudhu dhu pakèj'i ètu d'ara isi ja'a ne. waa! ja'a j'èra titu kèna!

source_text: concerning this thing i besought the lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
target_text: tèlu hari kèna, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pakaj'èu eele j'aj'èra ne nèti ja'a.

source_text: and he hath said unto me, my grace is sufficient for thee: for my power is made perfect in weakness. most gladly therefore will i rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of christ may rest upon me.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua peka na, ja'a pad'elo le d'ara hua iia ja'a mi èu, de èèna d'ai le, sèna ka èu me'a, na, nèti d'ara raroe ka koasa ja'a asa tabha. nèti èèna ka ja'a d'èi padedha iisi ètu d'ara raroe ja'a, sèna ka ja'a ke'a, na, koasa kristus ètu d'ara mamuri ja'a.

source_text: wherefore i take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for christ's sake: for when i am weak, then am i strong.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe a'èra ja'a mesa ku bisa boe sab'a ngaa èci sa, na, d'ara ja'a mau-mau sène. de ropa dhèu pahahe ja'a, do pasusa ja'a, do paj'èra ja'a, do game ja'a, lula ja'a j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, na, d'ara ja'a mau-mau sène. te ladhe ja'a mesa ku bisa boe, na, ja'a abhu koasa nèti kristus, ho bisa èra tao j'ara sèra.

source_text: i am become foolish: ye compelled me; for i ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing was i behind the very chiefest apostles, though i am nothing.
target_text: miu mamuri nuka sèmi me'a boe, na, lamatua pua nèdhi mèka ja'a dhiu peka-padhai dènge miu. nèti èèna ka, mo'o do mo'o boe, ja'a ako padhai lii ciki sèmi dhèu goa. madhutu iia-iia na, miu se'e ka dhu padhai lii padedha ja'a. ja'a ne mema dènge boe kab'ua, te ngaa ladhe pasoro ja'a dènge dhèu kapai sèra dhu peka na, lamatua pua-paleha rèngu, na, rèngu sèra risi boe ja'a.

source_text: truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, by signs and wonders and mighty works.
target_text: ladhe lamatua pua dhèu ho lole lula-nèti nèngu, dhèu ne tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa pake koasa, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, na, lamatua ka dhu pua-paleha nèngu. te ngaa baku bhèlu, te lod'o ja'a ètu talora aae miu, ja'a tao tadha malaa kahèi sèmi sèra. aa ja'a sab'a mau-mau.

source_text: for what is there wherein ye were made inferior to the rest of the churches, except it be that i myself was not a burden to you? forgive me this wrong.
target_text: te ngaa baku nasa! dhodhoka ca j'ara di, dhu ja'a tao boe ètu talora miu, dhu dhèu leo tao ètu juma'at leo. nuka ja'a manèngi boe miu ogo ja'a.

source_text: behold, this is the third time i am ready to come to you; and i will not be a burden to you: for i seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
target_text: sèmi ne'e! ja'a dhu tèlu hari kèna pa'èra kore le ho dhiu ngad'o miu. ja'a parluu boe miu ogo mamuri ja'a. ja'a ko'o boe mèdha-panyau miu kahèi. te madhutu ad'a èdhi, lèke boe ladhe ana iiki tèka mèdha-panyau hia ina-ama ra. dhu lèke nuka ina-ama ka dhu sadia tèke mèdha-panyau hia ana niki ra. de ja'a parluu boe ladhe miu sadia tèke mèdha-panyau hia ja'a, te miu se sama sèmi ana-ana ja'a! dhu ja'a parluu, dhoka mamuri dènge sasue miu.

source_text: and i will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. if i love you more abundantly, am i loved the less?
target_text: ja'a d'èi hèli mèdha hia miu. ja'a d'èi sab'a bia kahèi, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. ladhe ja'a sue miu d'ai seli, na, miu hud'i sue ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. nga tao ka miu papènyi sasue miu? lèke boe, sina ma?

source_text: but be it so, i did not myself burden you; but, being crafty, i caught you with guile.
target_text: ètu talora miu, abhu dhu peka na, ja'a pabia boe miu. te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu peka na, ja'a dhèu dhu mèu pakapod'e miu, sèna ka miu madhutu dad'èi ja'a.

source_text: did i take advantage of you by any one of them whom i have sent unto you?
target_text: de tasamia? ele boe dhèu dhu ja'a pua dhiu asa miu sèra, tipu rare miu, do? aad'o!

source_text: i exhorted titus, and i sent the brother with him. did titus take any advantage of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
target_text: te ja'a dhu pamako titus ho dhiu asa miu. ja'a pua a'ari dhèu parcaya èci sèna ka dhiu palere dènge titus kahèi. titus pakapod'e miu, do? aad'o, si? te titus dènge ja'a ne, ca ropa. ji'i sab'a j'ara dhu sama, te ngangee ji'i dua mi sama kahèi.

source_text: ye think all this time that we are excusing ourselves unto you. in the sight of god speak we in christ. but all things, beloved, are for your edifying.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! tao-tao miu dhu pangee, na, ji'i siri iisi ji'i ètu madha miu, do? aad'o! te aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i peka-padhai se, ama lamatua dhu ne'a le. de ji'i bisa boe pahuni ngaa-ngaa nèti nèngu. ji'i pa'èki kahèi dènge kristus. lula ji'i sue miu, nèti èèna ka aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i tao sèra, sèna ka bisa pa'èra miu.

source_text: for i fear, lest by any means, when i come, i should find you not such as i would, and should myself be found of you such as ye would not; lest by any means there should be strife, jealousy, wraths, factions, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults;
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhiu ngad'o miu, ja'a pangee mage dhoka miu j'aj'i boe sama sèmi dad'èi ja'a. te mage dhoka abhu dhu patao-palaha, d'èi boe dhèu karisi nèngu, tèka d'ara, abhu dhu pangee dhoka mamuri nèngu mesa na, abhu dhu pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu, abhu dhu padhai-kakoli dhèu, abhu dhu padedha iisi, aa abhu dhu maruru jahu lulu-lulu. mage dhoka ja'a kahèi j'aj'i boe sama sèmi dad'èi miu.

source_text: lest again when i come my god should humble me before you, and i should mourn for many of them that have sinned heretofore, and repented not of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they committed.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhiu ka asa miu, ja'a j'aj'i ngangee, lula tatao-tatao miu. mage dhoka ama lamatua neo pamakae ja'a ètu madha miu. mage dhoka ja'a pabia dhèu, lula, nèti miu abhu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara bhelu-katub'a era, te ngaa ele-ho'a boe, sèna ka madhutu j'ara mola nèti lamatua. rèngu se dhèu kaj'alu! te abhu dhu ad'u j'ara makae dènge mone do bhèni dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe. ra ad'u-ue j'ara makae rupa-rupa dhu re'a heka makae d'ara.

source_text: this is the third time i am coming to you. at the mouth of two witnesses or three shall every word be established.
target_text: de ne'e ne kali ka tèlu kèna ja'a neo dhiu ngad'o miu. ladhe abhu dhu neo galaa dhèu, na, baku bhèlu atora na. te sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua dhu suri, peka na, ladhe abhu dhu neo galaa dhèu èci, hud'i dènge ku dua do tèlu sakasii dhu lii èci, heka sèmi mere kèna. te ladhe abhu boe lii èci sèmi èèna, baku sèmi mere lii galaa èèna.

source_text: i have said beforehand, and i do say beforehand, as when i was present the second time, so now, being absent, to them that have sinned heretofore, and to all the rest, that, if i come again, i will not spare;
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a dhiu kali ka dua asa miu uru èèna, ja'a pasanèd'e le dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara bhabhelu-katub'a sèra. limuri ne, ja'a pasanèd'e hari rèngu sama-sama dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu d'ara bhelu-katub'a sèra. nuka sèmi uru èèna, dhu ja'a peka kore le, na, ladhe ja'a j'aj'i mai hari, ja'a soro tèke boe rèngu sèra.

source_text: seeing that ye seek a proof of christ that speaketh in me; who to you-ward is not weak, but is powerful in you:
target_text: miu tenge bukti, dhu peka na, kristus padhai lii re ja'a. ladhe kristus neo ator miu, na tao dènge koasa kapai ètu talora aae miu. te nèngu sab'a boe dènge roe.

source_text: for he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth through the power of god. for we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him through the power of god toward you.
target_text: lod'o dhèu pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, mema na roe aala-aala, lula na patalale eele koasa na. te ngaa ama lamatua pangèd'u le kristus koasa, hèia na mamuri hari le. ka masi ka ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu na, dhu rasa na, ji'i ètu d'ara raroe era, te ngaa ama lamatua hia le ji'i mamuri hiu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i bisa ladhe-leru miu pake koasa nèngu.

source_text: try your own selves, whether ye are in the faith; prove your own selves. or know ye not as to your own selves, that jesus christ is in you? unless indeed ye be reprobate.
target_text: parisa d'ara miu unu mi dhu peka na, miu parcaya tare'a mi kristus, do aad'o. koasa na bisa tèdhi ètu d'ara mamuri miu, do aad'o? uji mamuri miu sèmi èèna. te ladhe kristus pa'èki boe dènge miu, miu j'aj'i boe dhèu unu na.

source_text: but i hope that ye shall know that we are not reprobate.
target_text: ladhe miu parisa ji'i, na, miu bisa ladhe mèdhi koasa kristus ètu d'ara mamuri ji'i. dènge j'ara ne'e, ji'i lolos.

source_text: now we pray to god that ye do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that ye may do that which is honorable, though we be as reprobate.
target_text: ji'i sabaj'a kahèi manèngi ama lamatua, sèna ka miu baku manahu asa d'ara sasala ngaa-ngaa. ji'i pusi-pahae boe dhèu d'èi, do d'èi boe, nèti sasab'a-la'a ji'i. te ngaa ji'i d'èi ladhe miu tao dhu lèke, masi ka dhèu cahag'e tule eele ji'i. masi ka dhèu tule eele ji'i sèmi èèna, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: for we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
target_text: te ji'i bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa, ho lab'a j'ara dhu lèke. ji'i nge'a dhoka tao dhu lèke di.

source_text: for we rejoice, when we are weak, and ye are strong: this we also pray for, even your perfecting.
target_text: ladhe miu j'aj'i èra, aa ji'i j'aj'i roe èèna ka, ji'i karej'e-karae. te ji'i sabaj'a, ho manèngi lamatua tao pamèci miu.

source_text: for this cause i write these things while absent, that i may not when present deal sharply, according to the authority which the lord gave me for building up, and not for casting down.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, masi ka ja'a pakaj'èu dènge miu, ja'a suri tèke le j'ara se'e se, ho ladhe d'ai ka lod'o ja'a dhiu, ja'a tao heka lii sakaa dènge miu. ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua èdhi. te ngaa na pangèd'u hak dènge koasa mi ja'a, sèna ka pa'ele iie boe miu, te ngaa pa'èra miu.

source_text: finally, brethren, farewell. be perfected; be comforted; be of the same mind; live in peace: and the god of love and peace shall be with you.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue aa'i-aa'i! lii ja'a dhu limuri tèka ne, dhoka lii maho'o di. pamola j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. nanene paie-iie lii holo-nori ja'a. mamuri d'ara èci. miu èci dènge èci hud'i pabe'a-be'a. kapua sasue nèti ama lamatua. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua bera-bera taruu dènge miu, aa na soru-bara miu, ho miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: salute one another with a holy kiss.
target_text: miu hud'i pamaho'o aa pa'uu dhu pantas dènge dhèu mola-mèci unu ama lamatua. dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua ètu se'e, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi hia miu.

source_text: all the saints salute you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu. ja'a manèngi ho ama lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi dedha miu. ja'a manèngi kahèi sèna ka roh mola-mèci lamatua pad'elo d'ara be'a na, ho hud'i laa miu mamuri d'ara èci. sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: paul, an apostle not from men, neither through man, but through jesus christ, and god the father, who raised him from the dead, and all the brethren that are with me, unto the churches of galatia:
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ja'a pa'adhu sasuri ne asa a'ari aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus ètu juma'at-juma'at ètu propensi galati. a'ari dhu sama-sama dènge ja'a ètu ne'e, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi hia miu. ja'a pasanèd'e miu, na, ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a. nèti boe dhèu rai-haha ne. yesus kristus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua pua mai le. kristus madhe, te ngaa lamatua pamamuri hari ne. hèia ra pua-paleha ja'a, ho laku peka-padhai lii lolo be'a dènge dhèu-dhèu.

source_text: grace to you and peace from god the father, and our lord jesus christ,
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a mi ama èdhi, ama lamatua, aa kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi ho rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, sèna ka miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil world, according to the will of our god and father:
target_text: kristus madhe, sèna ka saku eele aa'i sasala èdhi aa pakaj'èu èdhi nèti bhabhelu-katub'a rai-haha ne. aa'i-aa'i dhu kristus ad'u-ue sèra, madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: to whom be the glory for ever and ever. amen.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i koa-kio ne taruu! dhu lèke kèna!

source_text: i marvel that ye are so quickly removing from him that called you in the grace of christ unto a different gospel;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a ke'a heka tao miu sa mia! ama lamatua hag'e nare le miu, lula na neo ho miu me'a d'ara hua iia na. te ngaa tasamia ka miu malai titu kèna lami madhutu lii lolo leo

source_text: which is not another gospel: only there are some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of christ.
target_text: dhu lèke boe? uuru èèna, ja'a aj'a le dhu mola-mola lii lolo be'a nèti yesus kristus. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra mai pakapod'e lii lolo be'a èèna, toke miu malaa-maloha.

source_text: but though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach unto you any gospel other than that which we preached unto you, let him be anathema.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! te bèli-camèd'a lamatua huku dhèu dhu aj'a lii lolo be'a dhu sama boe dènge dhu ji'i aj'a-nori uru èèna. masi ka dhèu nèti ji'i do, ana pajuu nèti sorga do, hud'i laa lamatua hia ne mamadhe-mamopo!

source_text: as we have said before, so say i now again, if any man preacheth unto you any gospel other than that which ye received, let him be anathema.
target_text: ji'i dhu peka le karèi nèti uru ka. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a neo hari pasanèd'e sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu aj'a leo nèti lii lolo be'a dhu miu abhu le uru èèna, hud'i laa lamatua hia ne mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: for am i now seeking the favor of men, or of god? or am i striving to please men? if i were still pleasing men, i should not be a servant of christ.
target_text: ja'a bani peka sèmi èèna, lula ja'a neo pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, neo boe pakarej'e dhèu rai-haha ne. miu ngee, na, ja'a tenge kolongara nèti dhèu rai-haha, do? aad'o! te ladhe ja'a tao sèmi èèna, ja'a pantas boe j'aj'i ana pua-paleha nèti kristus.

source_text: for i make known to you, brethren, as touching the gospel which was preached by me, that it is not after man.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a peka paled'a dènge miu, na, lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a aj'a-nori miu, nèti boe tatao dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: for neither did i receive it from man, nor was i taught it, but it came to me through revelation of jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a abhu boe nèti dhèu rai-haha, aa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu aj'a-nori ja'a. te yesus kristus mesa na ka dhu bhoke sasoa na mi ja'a.

source_text: for ye have heard of my manner of life in time past in the jews' religion, how that beyond measure i persecuted the church of god, and made havoc of it:
target_text: tatu miu tadèngi le lii lolo nèti j'ara mamuri ja'a, lod'o ja'a madhutu agama yahudi era, si? lod'o èèna, ja'a paj'èra titu kèna dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua, aa neo pa'ele iie aa'i si.

source_text: and i advanced in the jews' religion beyond many of mine own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
target_text: aa lod'o èèna kahèi, d'ara ja'a neo titu kèna aj'a j'ara-j'ara agama yahudi, risi nèti dhèu yahudi dhu leo dhu ca dadena dènge ja'a. aa ja'a ne maj'èni risi pakako ad'a bèi-baki èdhi dènge atora agama aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but when it was the good pleasure of god, who separated me, even from my mother's womb, and called me through his grace, to reveal his son in me, that i might preach him among the gentiles; straightway i conferred not with flesh and blood:
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, ama lamatua dhu pama'ète nare le ho patadhe ana na mi ja'a. ina ku dhae nara iisi mèka ja'a, te nèngu dhu hag'e mema le ja'a, lula na neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. nèngu kahèi pua ja'a ho laku peka-padhai dènge dhèu yahudi boe sèra. lod'o na pua ja'a èèna, laku boe manèngi a'abhu nèti dhèu leo.

source_text: neither went i up to jerusalem to them that were apostles before me: but i went away into arabia; and again i returned unto damascus.
target_text: aa laku boe paraga dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka kristen dhu j'aj'i mema le dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus ètu kota yerusalem. te ngaa laku dènge ka asa rai arab. èle ka, ja'a lèpa hari asa kota damsik.

source_text: then after three years i went up to jerusalem to visit cephas, and tarried with him fifteen days.
target_text: hèia lalu eele tèlu tèu ku, heka laku paraga dènge petrus ètu yerusalem, ho pakarèi j'ara-j'ara nèti nèngu. ka ja'a manubha taha canguru lèmi lod'o ètu nèi.

source_text: but other of the apostles saw i none, save james the lord's brother.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ja'a paraga kahèi dènge yakobis, ari d'èlu lamatua yesus. te ngaa ja'a paraga boe dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu leo sèra. dhoka dua ra di.

source_text: now touching the things which i write unto you, behold, before god, i lie not.
target_text: ngaa dhu ja'a suri ne, mema tare'a sèmi èèna! ja'a kapod'e boe! lamatua ne'a aa'i!

source_text: then i came into the regions of syria and cilicia.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia ja'a laku asa propensi siria dènge propensi kilikia.

source_text: and i was still unknown by face unto the churches of judæa which were in christ:
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu-dhèu unu kristus ètu propensi yudea, dhae tadhe mèka ja'a.

source_text: but they only heard say, he that once persecuted us now preacheth the faith of which he once made havoc;
target_text: dhèu se'e dhoka tadèngi lii palolo, dhu peka na, dhèu dhu uru èèna paj'èra èdhi, limuri ne nuka aj'a lii lolo be'a kristus. nèngu ka dhu uru èèna, neo pa'ele iie aa'i èdhi.

source_text: and they glorified god in me.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, aa'i-aa'i ra koa-kio ama lamatua, lula ja'a parcaya le yesus kristus.

source_text: then after the space of fourteen years i went up again to jerusalem with barnabas, taking titus also with me.
target_text: d'ai èle canguru èpa tèu, hèia ja'a lèpa asa kota yerusalem sama-sama dènge barnabas. aa ji'i ngèti dènge titus, ca dhèu parcaya dhu yahudi boe.

source_text: and i went up by revelation; and i laid before them the gospel which i preach among the gentiles but privately before them who were of repute, lest by any means i should be running, or had run, in vain.
target_text: ja'a laku asa nèi, lula lii paredha ama lamatua. d'ai nèi, ka ja'a lole mi dhèu heka-dhèu heka kristen, lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a aj'a-nori le mi dhèu yahudi boe sèra. lod'o èèna, ja'a peka unu ku mi rèngu se, ho ra parisa pabe'a-be'a ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a le sèra, lèke do aad'o. te ladhe ra pama'ète, peka na, a'aj'a ja'a èèna sala, na, dhèu bisa ngee, na, ja'a sab'a iia d'ara di!

source_text: but not even titus who was with me, being a greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
target_text: ropa dhèu se'e tadèngi rare lii ja'a sèmi èèna, hèia ra sèmi rare dènge be'a. aa ra d'èi sèmi rare titus dènge be'a kahèi. masi ka titus dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa ra laka-seti boe sèna ka na suna.

source_text: and that because of the false brethren privily brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in christ jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
target_text: te ngaa lod'o èèna, abhu a'ari dhèu pèri dhu d'èi boe a'aj'a ja'a, lula rèngu se aj'a dhu leo. rèngu se, dhèu kristen kapod'e-kabèli. ka rèngu mau-mau mai laka-seti dhèu unu kristus sèra dhu dhèu yahudi boe, ho madhutu aa'i atora agama yahudi. te ngaa, lula yesus kristus patalale eele le èdhi, nèti èèna ka atora sèra èki heka èdhi, sèmi ènu sa.

source_text: to whom we gave place in the way of subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
target_text: masi ka ra laka-seti sèmi èèna, te ngaa ciki sa ji'i ngo'o boe sèmi ngare. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu bisa parcaya taruu lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a nori le. te dhu mola-mola na kèna!

source_text: but from those who were reputed to be somewhat whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: god accepteth not man's person-they, i say, who were of repute imparted nothing to me:
target_text: dhèu heka-dhèu heka se sèmi rare lii a'aj'a ja'a ne, aa ra patabha heka ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa ama lamatua hag'e boe dhèu. de masi ka rèngu dhèu kapai do ana iiki, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: but contrariwise, when they saw that i had been intrusted with the gospel of the uncircumcision, even as peter with the gospel of the circumcision
target_text: te dhu lèke, nuka: rèngu re'a, na, ama lamatua pili nare le ja'a, ho kèti lii lolo be'a mi dhèu-dhèu yahudi boe. nuka sèmi dhu na paredha mi petrus kahèi, sèna ka nèti lii lolo be'a asa dhèu yahudi.

source_text: for he that wrought for peter unto the apostleship of the circumcision wrought for me also unto the gentiles;
target_text: te ama lamatua pangèd'u koasa mi petrus ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha mi dhèu yahudi. sèmi èèna kahèi, na hia ja'a koasa sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha mi dhèu-dhèu dhu yahudi boe.

source_text: and when they perceived the grace that was given unto me, james and cephas and john, they who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and barnabas the right hands of fellowship, that we should go unto the gentiles, and they unto the circumcision;
target_text: lod'o èèna, madhutu ngangee dhèu sèra, yakobis, petrus, dènge yohanis, dhu j'aj'i le ama-ama gareja. ropa rèngu tèlu ra re'a, na, ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a, hèia ra kèd'i paj'ola ai dènge ja'a, aa dènge barnabas, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi d'ara èci le. rèngu ro'o kahèi, ji'i ngèti lii lolo be'a asa dhèu yahudi boe, aa rèngu rèti asa dhèu yahudi.

source_text: only they would that we should remember the poor; which very thing i was also zealous to do.
target_text: dhoka ca j'ara di, dhu ra pasanèd'e ji'i, nuka ji'i baku bhèlu soru-bara dhèu dhu unu aad'o sèra. mema j'ara ne'e ka dhu ja'a neo tao.

source_text: but when cephas came to antioch, i resisted him to the face, because he stood condemned.
target_text: ka ca tèka, petrus mai asa kota antiokia. hèia ja'a kai ne patoo madha dènge madha, lula nèngu tao sala.

source_text: for before that certain came from james, he ate with the gentiles; but when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing them that were of the circumcision.
target_text: lod'o na heka mai, nèngu karèj'e madhèdi na'a dènge dhèu-dhèu unu kristus dhu dhèu yahudi boe. te ngaa ropa angalai yakobis dhèu yahudi sèra mai, hèia petrus mulai pakaj'èu nèti a'ari dhèu yahudi boe, ka na na'a pa'èci heka dènge rèngu. te lula na madha'u dènge a'aj'a nèti dhèu yahudi dhu peka na, dhèu unu kristus hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra atora agama yahudi aa'i-aa'i, aa hud'i pakaj'èu ku dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu yahudi boe.

source_text: and the rest of the jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that even barnabas was carried away with their dissimulation.
target_text: ropa rèdhi tatao petrus ne, ka dhèu yahudi dhu leo sèra tao madhutu kahèi. toke barnabas kahèi madhutu tatao ra dhu peka leo, tao leo.

source_text: but when i saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, i said unto cephas before them all, if thou, being a jew, livest as do the gentiles, and not as do the jews, how compellest thou the gentiles to live as do the jews?
target_text: te ngaa ropa ja'a patigi kèdhi, rèngu madhutu be'a heka dad'èi lii lolo be'a, hèia ja'a kai dènge ka petrus ètu katanga madha rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na, eee, petrus! èu ne, mema dhèu yahudi. te ngaa ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara, ho dhèu dhu parcaya yesus kristus pa'èki heka madhutu atora agama yahudi sèra. aa èu dhu sèmi more le j'ara ne'e, nga tasamia ka, èu laka-seti dhèu yahudi boe, sèna ka tao iisi ra sama sèmi dhèu yahudi?

source_text: we being jews by nature, and not sinners of the gentiles,
target_text: ja'a kai petrus sèmi èèna, lula ji'i dua mi dhèu yahudi. suku ji'i dua mi se dhèu yahudi, sama boe dènge suku leo sèra, lula suku ji'i dhu nèbhu le tadhe ama lamatua.

source_text: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in jesus christ, even we believed on christ jesus, that we might be justified by faith in christ, and not by the works of the law: because by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ji'i nge'a kahèi, na, lamatua sèmi nare boe ca dhèu sa j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, lula nèngu tao madhutu atora agama dènge be'a. te ngaa lamatua sèmi nare dhèu, ladhe nèngu parcaya yesus kristus, lula boe nèti nèngu madhutu atora agama. sèmi èèna ku, heka lamatua peka na, dhèu ne dènge heka sasala-sasigo.

source_text: but if, while we sought to be justified in christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is christ a minister of sin? god forbid.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ji'i aj'a, na, lamatua sèmi nare dhèu j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, lula na parcaya yesus kristus. te ngaa abhu dhèu yahudi dhu pasala ji'i. ra peka na, ji'i parcaya yesus kristus, te ngaa kèpe heka atora agama yahudi. miu neo pèci sasala sèmi èèna mi ji'i kahèi, do?

source_text: for if i build up again those things which i destroyed, i prove myself a transgressor.
target_text: te ladhe ja'a kèpe kore hari atora agama dhu ja'a patabuli eele le, èèna heka peka na ja'a sala kèna!

source_text: for i through the law died unto the law, that i might live unto god. i have been crucified with christ; and it is no longer i that live, but christ liveth in me: and that life which i now live in the flesh i live in faith, the faith which is in the son of god, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.
target_text: mema uru èèna, ja'a tenge j'ara ho madhutu dènge be'a atora agama yahudi, sèna ka ja'a pabe'a dènge lamatua. te ngaa bisa boe kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a tèke eele le atora agama sèra, ho mamuri pa'èki dènge kristus. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, heka ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a j'aj'i mi dhèu mola. peka sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a madhe lèke paku ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha sama-sama dènge kristus. de limuri ne, ja'a boe ka dhu mamuri, te ngaa kristus ka dhu mamuri ètu d'ara ngi'u ja'a. ja'a abhu mamuri dhu hiu ne, lula parcaya ana nèti lamatua. te nèngu sue ja'a titu kèna, toke na madhe gati ja'a.

source_text: i do not make void the grace of god: for if righteousness is through the law, then christ died for nought.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a, lula d'ara hua iia na, lula boe nèti ja'a madhutu atora agama sèra. te ladhe dhèu bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua lula madhutu atora agama, èèna sasoa na, mamadhe kristus iia-iia d'ara di. sèra sa ka dhu ja'a peka dènge petrus si ètu antiokia.

source_text: o foolish galatians, who did bewitch you, before whose eyes jesus christ was openly set forth crucified?
target_text: heh! dhèu galati sèra! uru èèna, ja'a unu ku lole dènge miu patoo madha dènge madha, lula-nèti mamadhe yesus kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ngaa limuri ne dhèu monya miu mamadha iia-iia! miu se, goa titu kèna!

source_text: this only would i learn from you, received ye the spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
target_text: ja'a neo dhoka karèi ca j'ara di. miu sèmi mere le roh lamatua èèna, lula miu madhutu atora agama, do? aad'o, si! roh na mai asa miu, lula miu lèka lii lolo be'a dhu miu nanene èèna.

source_text: are ye so foolish? having begun in the spirit, are ye now perfected in the flesh?
target_text: de, nga tao ka miu goa sèmi èèna, ee? uru èèna, miu mamuri le madhutu dad'èi roh mola-mèci. te ngaa limuri ne, miu kabèli hari, mamuri madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: did ye suffer so many things in vain? if it be indeed in vain.
target_text: lod'o hiu-hiu dhu miu parcaya kristus èèna, miu abhu j'aj'èra ae titu kèna. mage dhoka j'ara sèra ele iia d'ara di! te ngaa madhutu mola-mola na, parcaya mi kristus ele boe iia d'ara.

source_text: he therefore that supplieth to you the spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua hia roh na, aa pad'elo rupa-rupa tadha malaa ètu madha miu, miu ngee, na, lamatua tao sèmi èèna, lula miu madhutu atora agama, do? aad'o, si! na tao sèmi èèna, lula miu lèka lii lolo be'a dhu miu nanene èèna.

source_text: even as abraham believed god, and it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.
target_text: sanèd'e mèdhi era sina ma, bèi-baki dhèu yahudi, nuka abraham. te sasuri mola-mèci lamatua suri, peka na, lula na parcaya ama lamatua, ka lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola.

source_text: know therefore that they that are of faith, the same are sons of abraham.
target_text: de miu hud'i me'a pabe'a-be'a ku j'ara ne'e! dhèu dhu parcaya sama sèmi abraham, rèngu j'aj'i mi dhèu unu ama lamatua dhu tare'a-re'a.

source_text: and the scripture, foreseeing that god would justify the gentiles by faith, preached the gospel beforehand unto abraham, saying, in thee shall all the nations be blessed.
target_text: lamatua dhu peka tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na, peka na, nèngu sèmi nare kahèi dhèu nèti suku leo j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, ladhe ra parcaya ne. te uru èèna, na peka mema le mi abraham lii lolo be'a, na, bèli-camèd'a suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, abhu mèngi-nale lula èu ne.

source_text: so then they that are of faith are blessed with the faithful abraham.
target_text: lula lii moa ama lamatua èèna, ka na papuru kahèi berkat mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ne, nuka sèmi dhu na hia mi abraham.

source_text: for as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse: for it is written, cursed is every one who continueth not in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhutu atora agama, sèna ka lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, nèngu hud'i pasae nare ku babia nèti atora sèra aa'i-aa'i, nuka sèmi nèngu lèke le dhoo. te dhu suri ètu sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, dhèu dhu madhutu boe taruu atora agama d'ai lutu, nèngu lèke le dhoo èèna!

source_text: now that no man is justified by the law before god, is evident: for, the righteous shall live by faith;
target_text: te ngaa te'a, na, ama lamatua sèmi nare boe ca dhèu sa, lula na madhutu atora agama. te dhu suri tèke, peka na, dhèu hud'i parcaya ku ja'a, heka sèmi kore ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, ho na abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: and the law is not of faith; but, he that doeth them shall live in them.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu neo mamuri madhutu dad'èi atora agama, nèngu hud'i tao madhutu ku aa'i-aa'i toke lutu! te lamatua dhu peka mema le ètu sasuri mola-mèci, na, dhèu dhu neo mamuri madhutu atora, èèna na nèngu bhute dhoka dènge atora sèra di.

source_text: christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us; for it is written, cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
target_text: te ngaa kristus b'ae pama'ète le, ho patabuli èdhi nèti atora agama dhu èki èdhi. uru èèna, èdhi mamuri oe madhe, dènge pasae babia atora agama, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu lèke dhoo. te ngaa limuri ne lamatua yesus ded'e eele le babia èèna nèti èdhi. te dhu suri tèke ètu sasuri mola-mèci, na, ladhe dhèu madhe lèke kadhoe ètu agarii, sasoa na, nèngu madhe aapa.

source_text: that upon the gentiles might come the blessing of abraham in christ jesus; that we might receive the promise of the spirit through faith.
target_text: ropa yesus kristus madhe, sèna ka pala-bagi mamuri mi èdhi, berkat èèna ka dhu ama lamatua pangèd'u mi abraham, aa hia kahèi mi suku leo. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya kristus, bisa abhu roh ama lamatua dhu na jaji le.

source_text: brethren, i speak after the manner of men: though it be but a man's covenant, yet when it hath been confirmed, no one maketh it void, or addeth thereto.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! doe ne'e ja'a neo kore pakasame nèti mamuri èdhi bèli-mai bèli-mai. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu suri sasuri lii padhadha nèti pusaka, ka dhu ènyi le ngara na ètu sasuri ne, sasoa na, sasuri ne lèke tare'a. dhèu leo bisa boe ère eele ngaa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri èèna, aa bisa boe suri tabha hari ngaa-ngaa asa d'ara sasuri èèna.

source_text: now to abraham were the promises spoken, and to his seed. he saith not, and to seeds, as of many; but as of one, and to thy seed, which is christ.
target_text: sama sèmi èèna kahèi, lod'o ama lamatua patari lii padhadha dènge abraham, aa dènge ana-èpu na. ama lamatua peka boe, na, ja'a patari lii padhadha ne dènge ana-èpu èu sèra, lula na padhadha boe dènge dhèu ae-ae. te ngaa na padhadha dhoka dènge ana-èpu abraham ca dhèu di, nuka kristus.

source_text: now this i say: a covenant confirmed beforehand by god, the law, which came four hundred and thirty years after, doth not disannul, so as to make the promise of none effect.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ama lamatua paj'ari uru lii padhadha dènge abraham. hèia èpa ngasu tèlu nguru tèu ku, heka na papuru atora agama hia dhèu yahudi kèna, re baki ra musa. te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, lamatua ère heka lii padhadha dhu na tao uru èèna.

source_text: for if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise: but god hath granted it to abraham by promise.
target_text: te lamatua hia boe mèngi-nale mi abraham, lula na tao madhutu atora ne. te ngaa lamatua hia berkat lula na moa tèke le, karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia hadia mi abraham. èèna nuka sèmi ana ca dhèu abhu pusaka nèti ama na. ana ne abhu pusaka na, lula ama na dhu padhadha uru le, lula boe nèti ana ne tao madhutu atora.

source_text: what then is the law? it was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise hath been made; and it was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ama lamatua sèmi nare abraham j'aj'i mi dhèu mola lula lalèka na, nga tao ka lamatua tabha hari atora agama re musa? lamatua tabha atora agama sèra, sèna ka aj'a dhèu rai-haha lula-nèti sasala-sasigo ra. dad'èi na sèna ka dhèu rai-haha mamuri madhutu dad'èi atora sèra, toke ana-èpu abraham ca dhèu mai. hèia ladhe dhèu ne mai ka, nuka kristus èèna, na, atora ne parluu heka. lod'o lamatua papuru atora agama yahudi, nèngu j'ole mema boe mi dhèu yahudi sèra. te ngaa na hia re ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai pangèd'u mi adhe-aai musa, heka musa hia asa dhèu yahudi kèna. dènge j'ara ne'e, musa j'aj'i nuka sèmi kalete sa nèti lamatua dènge dhèu-dhèu unu na.

source_text: now a mediator is not a mediator of one; but god is one.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ama lamatua tao lii pajaji dènge abraham, na pake boe kalete. te lamatua peka unu na dènge abraham! dènge sèmi èèna, èdhi te'a, na, lii pajaji lamatua ne kab'ua risi eele nèti atora sèra.

source_text: is the law then against the promises of god? god forbid: for if there had been a law given which could make alive, verily righteousness would have been of the law.
target_text: lod'o lamatua hia atora agama asa musa èèna, pasala dènge lii-lii pajaji na, do? aad'o! te ladhe abhu atora dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa tao madhutu ne, ho lamatua sèmi nare ne sèna ka na bisa mamuri, tatu atora dhèu yahudi bisa tao sèmi èèna kahèi. madhutu iia-iia na, abhu boe atora èci sa dhu dhèu bisa tao madhutu ne, sèna ka cuhi d'ara lamatua ho lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola.

source_text: but the scripture shut up all things under sin, that the promise by faith in jesus christ might be given to them that believe.
target_text: te ètu sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, suri peka na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra pa'èki madhe dènge rupa-rupa sasala ra. nèti èèna ka, dhodhoka dhèu dhu parcaya yesus kristus di, bisa abhu ngaa dhu ama lamatua moa tèke èèna.

source_text: but before faith came, we were kept in ward under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
target_text: lod'o kristus dhae mai mèka, ji'i dhèu yahudi pa'èki madhe dènge atora sèra, toke bisa boe kalau. te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o na, lamatua bhoke j'ara ho ji'i kalua nèti atora sèra, ladhe ji'i parcaya kristus.

source_text: so that the law is become our tutor to bring us unto christ, that we might be justified by faith. but now that faith is come, we are no longer under a tutor.
target_text: de atora agama sèra, sama sèmi dhèu madhenge dhu aj'a paie-iie èdhi toke kristus mai. te ngaa ropa na mai ku, heka èdhi bisa parcaya ne, sèna ka èdhi mamuri pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi parluu heka dhèu madhenge èèna.

source_text: for ye are all sons of god, through faith, in christ jesus.
target_text: limuri ne, miu j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua, lula miu parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: for as many of you as were baptized into christ did put on christ.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu sarani èle le, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu pa'èki madhe dènge ne.

source_text: there can be neither jew nor greek, there can be neither bond nor free, there can be no male and female; for ye all are one man in christ jesus.
target_text: dhèu dhu lèka kristus, aa'i-aa'i ra èci èèna ka, beda boe. de masi ka miu dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe, ènu do ènu boe, dhèu mone do dhèu bhèni, aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pa'èki le dènge yesus kristus, ca ropa èèna ka.

source_text: and if ye are christ's, then are ye abraham's seed, heirs according to promise.
target_text: kristus ne, ana-èpu abraham dhu ama lamatua padhadha karèi nèti uru ka. lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus, nèti èèna ka miu j'aj'i le tare'a-re'a ana-èpu abraham. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, miu bisa kahèi abhu berkat dhu ama lamatua moa tèke le mi abraham.

source_text: but i say that so long as the heir is a child, he differeth nothing from a bondservant though he is lord of all;
target_text: ja'a pakasame dhu leo hari. ca dhèu ana dhu dènge hak ho abhu pusaka nèti ama na, ladhe ama na madhe. te ngaa ladhe ana ne ana iiki ae era, nèngu bisa mèka abhu pusaka èèna, masi ka èèna na aa'i-aa'i se unu nèngu. lula nèngu d'ai mèka umur, nèngu ne nuka sèmi ènu dhu dènge boe hak, sèna ka nare mèdha-panyau lamatua na.

source_text: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed of the father.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, hud'i dènge ku dhèu dhu pa'uri ana ne dènge pusaka na. ana ne hud'i madhutu ku dad'èi nèti dhèu madhenge nèngu, toke d'ai lod'o dhu ama na pama'ète nare èèna, heka na sèmi nare pusaka na kèna.

source_text: so we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the rudiments of the world:
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge èdhi. lod'o yesus kristus dhae mai mèka, èdhi nuka sèmi ana iiki èèna. te èdhi dhu pa'èki madhe dènge dad'èi rai-haha, nuka sèmi ènu ca dhèu.

source_text: but when the fulness of the time came, god sent forth his son, born of a woman, born under the law, that he might redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
target_text: te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o na, ama lamatua pua mai ana d'èlu na dhu j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha èèna, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha bisa kahèi j'aj'i dhèu dhu ama lamatua ded'e nare j'aj'i ana-ana na. ana d'èlu na èèna mamuri madhutu atora agama dhèu yahudi, sèna ka nèngu bisa patabuli dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna pa'èki dènge atora se.

source_text: and because ye are sons, god sent forth the spirit of his son into our hearts, crying, abba, father.
target_text: lula miu j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka na hia le roh ana na mai asa d'ara miu. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu dènge hak paroa ama lamatua, na, ama pasue.

source_text: so that thou art no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir through god.
target_text: de limuri ne miu j'aj'i heka ènu dhu dènge boe hak ho abhu pusaka. te ngaa miu j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua dhu dènge hak, sèna ka abhu pusaka aa'i-aa'i dhu na pajaji tèke le.

source_text: howbeit at that time, not knowing god, ye were in bondage to them that by nature are no gods:
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o miu tadhe mèka ama lamatua, miu tao iisi mi j'aj'i ènu, ho sogo-tagu ngaa-ngaa dhu lèke boe.

source_text: but now that ye have come to know god, or rather to be known by god, how turn ye back again to the weak and beggarly rudiments, whereunto ye desire to be in bondage over again?
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, miu tadhe le ama lamatua. be'a risi, ja'a peka, na, ama lamatua ka dhu tadhe miu. de tasamia ka miu neo lèpa hari asa sogo-tagu ngaa dhu guna boe, aa dhu dènge boe koasa ngaa-ngaa sèra? miu neo tao iisi mi pa'èki dènge j'ara-j'ara sèra, sèna ka j'aj'i hari ènu ra, do?

source_text: ye observe days, and months, and seasons, and years.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi, na, miu kèpe atora ho pakab'ua risi lod'o-lod'o hua iia madhutu lod'o, hèru, èj'i lai, hèru hadhu, dènge tèu, ho neo pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: i am afraid of you, lest by any means i have bestowed labor upon you in vain.
target_text: ne'e ne ka dhu pa'ele iie ngangee ja'a! mage dhoka j'aj'èra ja'a aj'a-nori miu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ele iie d'ara di.

source_text: i beseech you, brethren, become as i am, for i also am become as ye are. ye did me no wrong:
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu mamuri pa'èki ia ka dènge madha j'ara sèra, sèmi ja'a ne. te mamuri ja'a ne pa'èki heka le dènge atora agama, èci èèna ka dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe. uru èèna, lod'o èdhi bera-bera era, miu pasusa boe ja'a.

source_text: but ye know that because of an infirmity of the flesh i preached the gospel unto you the first time:
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, ca hari ni, lod'o ja'a mai hiu-hiu èèna, ho peka-padhai lii lolo be'a dènge miu, ngi'u aae ja'a ne roe-bhilu.

source_text: and that which was a temptation to you in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but ye received me as an angel of god, even as christ jesus.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu tule eele boe ja'a, lula miu sèmi mere ja'a nuka sèmi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga. risi-risi hari, miu sèmi mere ja'a ne, nuka sèmi yesus kristus mesa na.

source_text: where then is that gratulation of yourselves? for i bear you witness, that, if possible, ye would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.
target_text: lod'o èèna, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti karej'e titu kèna. te ngaa, nga tao ka limuri ne, sèmi heka èèna? uru èèna, miu sue ja'a titu kèna, ka miu toke neo ed'o eele ana madha miu ho hia ja'a.

source_text: so then am i become your enemy, by telling you the truth?
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, miu ngee, na, ja'a j'aj'i le musu miu, lula ja'a padhai dhu mola dènge miu, do?

source_text: they zealously seek you in no good way; nay, they desire to shut you out, that ye may seek them.
target_text: dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra, ro'o boe ja'a pa'angalai dènge miu, ka ra dadugu miu ho madhutu aa'i atora agama yahudi. dad'èi d'ara ra, sèna ka miu bhute madhutu dad'èi rèngu di.

source_text: but it is good to be zealously sought in a good matter at all times, and not only when i am present with you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu maj'èni tao j'ara dhu be'a, èèna be'a kahèi! masi ka ja'a sama-sama dènge miu, do aad'o, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. sad'i miu tao j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: my little children, of whom i am again in travail until christ be formed in you-
target_text: ana-ana pasue! ne'e ne, ja'a sab'a bia risi hari hia miu, nuka sèmi bhèni dhu kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi. te ja'a ae kora boe ciki sa nèti sasab'a, toke d'ara miu èci èèna ka dènge d'ara kristus.

source_text: but i could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone; for i am perplexed about you.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a ke'a heka neo tao miu tasamia hari! ja'a d'èi titu kèna, dhiu padhai lii patoo madha dènge miu, sèna ka ja'a baku padhai lii taka sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
target_text: ladhe miu neo mamuri madhutu atora agama dhèu yahudi, be'a risi miu me'a uuru ku dad'èi nèti atora sèra.

source_text: for it is written, that abraham had two sons, one by the handmaid, and one by the freewoman.
target_text: ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua abhu lii lolo dhu lole, peka na, ana mone abraham, dhèu dua. nèngu abhu ana ca dhèu nèti bhèni dhu ènu na, aa ca dhèu hari nèti dhèu èmu-kamali na, dhu ènu boe.

source_text: howbeit the son by the handmaid is born after the flesh; but the son by the freewoman is born through promise.
target_text: ènu ne nara iisi ana na, lula madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa dhèu èmu abraham nara iisi ana na, lula madhutu lii moa dhu ama lamatua peka mema le.

source_text: which things contain an allegory: for these women are two covenants; one from mount sinai, bearing children unto bondage, which is hagar.
target_text: bhèni dhèu dua se, nuka sèmi tadha dhu pad'elo dua lii pajaji dhu ama lamatua padhadha dènge dhèu rai-haha. lii pajaji èci, lamatua pangèd'u mi musa ètu ledhe sinai, lod'o nèngu papuru atora agama dhèu yahudi. dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge atora agama sèra, rèngu j'aj'i ènu sama sèmi hagar kahèi.

source_text: now this hagar is mount sinai in arabia and answereth to the jerusalem that now is: for she is in bondage with her children.
target_text: era ètu ledhe sinai ètu rae arab èèna, nuka sèmi hagar ne kahèi. dhèu yerusalem aa'i-aa'i lod'o limuri ne, dhu pa'èki era dènge atora agama yahudi, rèngu sèra ènu kahèi nuka sèmi hagar.

source_text: but the jerusalem that is above is free, which is our mother.
target_text: te ngaa lii pajaji dhu leo hari, paj'uj'u asa kota yerusalem dhu leo èci ètu sorga. ana-ana unu ama lamatua dhu pea ètu èèna, ènu boe. te rèngu dhèu bebas dhu pa'èki boe dènge atora agama èèna. nèti èèna ka, rèngu se èci èèna ka dènge ina ji'i sara, dhèu èmu abraham.

source_text: for it is written, rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for more are the children of the desolate than of her that hath the husband.
target_text: ètu sasuri mola-mèci, dhu suri tèke, peka na, wee! bhèni dhu nara iisi nèdhi boe! pakarej'e d'ara mu! wee! bhèni dhu rasa nèdhi boe kabake pèd'a nara iisi! sod'a pakarej'e d'ara mu! bhèni dhu d'ara roe-bhilu, lula dhèu èmu na pusi-pahae heka ne, pe na abhu ana ae risi nèti bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu-kamali.

source_text: now we, brethren, as isaac was, are children of promise.
target_text: de a'ari aa'i-aa'i! uru èèna ama lamatua dhu padhadha le hia ana mi abraham. te ngaa nèbhu ku, heka lamatua tao madhutu lii pajaji na kèna, hèia sara nara iisi isak hia abraham. èdhi sama sèmi isak kahèi, lula ama lamatua pajaji hia abraham ana-èpu dhu leo kahèi.

source_text: but as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the spirit, so also it is now.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana ènu dhu j'aj'i madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha èèna, ropa na kapai, na paj'èra isak, dhu j'aj'i madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua. èèna sama kahèi dènge ngaa dhu j'aj'i limuri ne.

source_text: howbeit what saith the scripture? cast out the handmaid and her son: for the son of the handmaid shall not inherit with the son of the freewoman.
target_text: sasuri mola-mèci lamatua suri kahèi, peka na, babège eele ènu dènge ana na. te ana nèti ènu ne dènge boe hak ho abhu pusaka. dhodhoka ana nèti dhèu èmu kab'i na dhu dènge hak.

source_text: wherefore, brethren, we are not children of a handmaid, but of the freewoman.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e a'ari aa'i-aa'i! èdhi sama boe dènge ana nèti ènu, lula èdhi pa'èki heka dènge atora agama dhèu yahudi. te èdhi nuka sèmi ana nèti dhèu èmu kab'i abraham, lula èdhi parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: for freedom did christ set us free: stand fast therefore, and be not entangled again in a yoke of bondage.
target_text: uru èèna dhèu yahudi j'èra bia pasae atora agama ra. te ngaa limuri ne, kristus ded'e eele le babia èèna nèti dhèu dhu parcaya ne. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi pasae heka babia. de miu baku lèke kapod'e-kabèli, ho pasae hari atora sèra, tao nuka sèmi ènu sa!

source_text: behold, i paul say unto you, that, if ye receive circumcision, christ will profit you nothing.
target_text: de nanene, ee! ja'a ne, paulus, ka dhu peka lii ne'e. ladhe miu suna ho madhutu atora agama dhèu yahudi, na, mamadhe kristus dhu hia miu bebas èèna, gaguna na aad'o!

source_text: yea, i testify again to every man that receiveth circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
target_text: ladhe dhèu suna ho madhutu atora agama sèmi èèna, nèngu hud'i pasae hari ku atora sèra aa'i-aa'i ra. miu sanèd'e era, do aad'o? te uru èèna, ja'a dhu peka mema le.

source_text: ye are severed from christ, ye who would be justified by the law; ye are fallen away from grace.
target_text: dhèu dhu neo pake atora, sèna ka ama lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, nèngu tao iisi na pakaj'èu nèti kristus. te dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu core eele d'ara hua iia ama lamatua.

source_text: for we through the spirit by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
target_text: te ngaa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci ka dhu bhoke j'ara hia èdhi, ho èdhi parcaya yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka èdhi sanao, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua pama'ète, na, èdhi dhèu mola.

source_text: for in christ jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision; but faith working through love.
target_text: masi ka dhèu suna, do aad'o, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te ngaa dhu hua iia risi, nuka dhèu dhu parcaya kristus aa sue dhèu leo.

source_text: ye were running well; who hindered you that ye should not obey the truth?
target_text: uru èèna, miu mamuri le madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu cee ka dhu kapod'e-kabèli miu, ka miu madhutu heka j'ara èèna?

source_text: this persuasion came not of him that calleth you.
target_text: te a'aj'a-nanori kapod'e-kabèli dhu miu nanene èèna, mai boe nèti ama lamatua. madhutu iia-iia na, nèngu ka dhu paroa nare miu ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
target_text: ngaa dhu ra aj'a, hiu-hiu èèna dhoka ca hèb'a-dua hèb'a di. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, lii a'aj'a ne tao ngangee miu ele iie. nuka sèmi ragi ciki dhu dhèu pakihu dènge tarigu ho neo tao roti. nèbhu-nèbhu hèia ragi ne'e ka paca'e tarigu dhu pakihu èèna.

source_text: i have confidence to you-ward in the lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
target_text: lula èdhi j'aj'i le èci dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, nèti èèna ka ja'a ke'a mèu, nèngu èèna hia miu parcaya hari mi ngaa dhu ja'a nori le sèra. aa ama lamatua mesa na, pe huku dhèu cee dhu pa'ele iie lalèka miu.

source_text: but i, brethren, if i still preach circumcision, why am i still persecuted? then hath the stumbling-block of the cross been done away.
target_text: sèmi ne'e a'ari! ladhe ja'a aj'a, peka na, dhèu hud'i suna ku, tatu ja'a abhu boe j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne. aa dhèu yahudi tule eele boe a'aj'a ja'a lula-nèti mamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: i would that they that unsettle you would even go beyond circumcision.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu kapod'e-kabèli miu sèra lula j'ara suna, na soro tèke si sèna ka rèngu unu ra pake tud'i ho ari eele mèdha nèti isi ra!

source_text: for ye, brethren, were called for freedom; only use not your freedom for an occasion to the flesh, but through love be servants one to another.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! lamatua patabuli le miu, ho miu mamuri pa'èki heka dènge dad'èi atora agama. te ngaa mage pangee, na, miu bisa tao leli ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi miu di! te dhu lèke, nuka miu hud'i mamuri pasue ku, aa paladha-leru èci dènge èci, sèmi ènu lalau-lalo'o lamatua na.

source_text: for the whole law is fulfilled in one word, even in this: thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
target_text: ètu sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. ladhe miu tao madhutu dhoka atora sasue ne di, na, miu tao aa'i le madhutu dad'èi atora agama dhèu yahudi.

source_text: but if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu èci patao-palaha dènge èci, do, èci pakèji dènge èci, pe mèdhi unu mi! nèbhu boe, te miu palaho ngi'u miu unu mi.

source_text: but i say, walk by the spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe miu mamuri madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua, miu madhutu heka dad'èi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: for the flesh lusteth against the spirit, and the spirit against the flesh; for these are contrary the one to the other; that ye may not do the things that ye would.
target_text: te dad'èi dhèu rai-haha madhutu boe dad'èi roh. aa dad'èi roh madhutu boe dad'èi dhèu rai-haha. dua ra bisa boe pa'èci, te ngaa palab'a taruu! nèti èèna ka, miu bisa heka tao hari madhutu dad'èi d'ara mi!

source_text: but if ye are led by the spirit, ye are not under the law.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe roh lamatua ator miu, na, miu pa'èki heka dènge atora sèra.

source_text: now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these: fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
target_text: dhèu dhu loe boe madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha, nuka sèmi: dhèu dhu ad'u-ue j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali na, dhèu dhu ngangee kaj'alu, dhu re'a boe d'ara makae,

source_text: idolatry, sorcery, enmities, strife, jealousies, wraths, factions, divisions, parties,
target_text: dhu sogo-tagu nidhu ho suagi dhèu, dhu pamusu, dhu d'èi pasibha d'ara lii, dhu tèka d'ara, dhu nasa leli, dhu ngee dhoka ngi'u na, dhu d'èi kakèj'i dhèu, dhu d'èi tao maruru,

source_text: envyings, drunkenness, revellings, and such like; of which i forewarn you, even as i did forewarn you, that they who practise such things shall not inherit the kingdom of god.
target_text: dhu d'èi boe dhèu leo risi ne, dhu d'èi mahu paa-paa, dhu d'èi madhutu pesta toke re'a heka makae, aa d'èi tao sasala dhu leo hari. uru èèna, dhu ja'a pasanèd'e le, na, dhèu dhu tema tao j'ara-j'ara sèmi sèra, rèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: but the fruit of the spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua, èèna na roh tao ne ho j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'èi pasue, d'ara dhu karej'e-karae, dhu d'èi padame, taha nare d'ara, d'ara be'a dènge dhèu leo, dhu d'èi soru-bara dhèu, dhu d'èi kèpe pa'èra-èra lii pajaji,

source_text: meekness, self-control; against such there is no law.
target_text: dhu lii mako dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, aa bisa j'aga paie-iie mamuri na. abhu boe atora èci sa dhu magee j'ara se'e se.

source_text: and they that are of christ jesus have crucified the flesh with the passions and the lusts thereof.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu yesus kristus, nèngu dhu pakaj'èu le nèti dad'èi dhèu rai-haha. te d'ara dhu d'èi tao bhelu èèna, dhu na paku pamadhe le ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha palere-lere dènge yesus.

source_text: if we live by the spirit, by the spirit let us also walk.
target_text: de ladhe roh lamatua hia le mamuri hiu mi èdhi, na, èdhi hud'i madhutu taruu ku dad'èi nèngu.

source_text: let us not become vainglorious, provoking one another, envying one another.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, baku padedha iisi, baku d'èi èci kakèj'i èci, aa baku patèka d'ara èci dènge èci.

source_text: brethren, even if a man be overtaken in any trespass, ye who are spiritual, restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ladhe abhu dhèu parcaya ca dhèu dhu tao sala, na, miu dhu me'a tare'a-re'a dad'èi roh lamatua, lami padhai lii mako-mako dènge ne dènge d'ara mola. hèia mèti hari ne, sèna ka madhutu j'ara dhu lèke nèti lamatua. te ngaa j'aga ngi'u mi, sèna ka baku manahu asa sasala na èèna.

source_text: bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of christ.
target_text: ladhe dhèu paraga dènge sasusa, na, miu dhu leo lami soru-bara ne. te dènge sèmi èèna, miu tao le madhutu atora nèti kristus.

source_text: for if a man thinketh himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu padedha iisi, peka na, nèngu risi nèti dhèu leo, aa te ngaa aad'o sèmi èèna, na, nèngu tipu ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: but let each man prove his own work, and then shall he have his glorying in regard of himself alone, and not of his neighbor.
target_text: de ca dhèu-dhèu ka hud'i parisa ku ngaa dhu nèngu ad'u-ue. ladhe ngaa dhu nèngu tao ne be'a le, pe ne'a unu na. mage pasèku dènge tatao dhèu leo.

source_text: for each man shall bear his own burden.
target_text: ja'a peka sèmi èèna, lula ca dhèu-dhèu ka dhu tago nare unu na, ngaa dhu nèngu tao.

source_text: but let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu sèmi nare le lii holo-nori lamatua, nèngu hud'i pabagi ku rui-j'aj'èra na, ho soru-bara dhèu dhu aj'a-nori nèngu.

source_text: be not deceived; god is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ama lamatua ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu. de baku tipu ngi'u miu unu mi, aa baku neo tipu lamatua. lula, ngaa dhu dhèu sèle ètu d'ara oka-tedhe, pe nèngu abhu hari hua-hela na.

source_text: for he that soweth unto his own flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth unto the spirit shall of the spirit reap eternal life.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe dhèu ad'u-ue j'ara bhelu-katub'a madhutu dad'èi na, pe na dui nare hari mamuri dhu ele iie. te ngaa ladhe dhèu tao j'ara be'a madhutu dad'èi roh mola-mèci, pe nèngu abhu hari mamuri dhu lèke toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and let us not be weary in well-doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu baku roca tao j'ara dhu be'a. te ropa d'ai lod'o na, èdhi abhu hari j'ara dhu be'a, sad'i èdhi taha taruu.

source_text: so then, as we have opportunity, let us work that which is good toward all men, and especially toward them that are of the household of the faith.
target_text: de ropa èdhi abhu lod'o dhu taleo, na, èdhi tao mema ka j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, risi-risi mi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: see with how large letters i write unto you with mine own hand.
target_text: sasuri ne'e, ja'a ka suri unu ku, pake huruf dhu kapai aae hua.

source_text: as many as desire to make a fair show in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of christ.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra lèka kahèi mi yesus kristus dhu madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ngaa rèngu laka-seti miu ho suna, lula ra madha'u dènge dhèu yahudi leo, rèngu mage dhèu se paj'èra si, ladhe rèngu aj'a, peka na, ama lamatua sèmi nare kahèi dhèu dhu madhutu boe atora suna. nèti èèna ka, rèngu se d'èi solo-mako dhèu yahudi sèra.

source_text: for not even they who receive circumcision do themselves keep the law; but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
target_text: masi ka rèngu dhu suna le, te ngaa rèngu unu ra madhutu aa'i boe atora agama sèra. rèngu d'èi ho miu madhutu suna, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, partei ra ded'e padedha-dedha rèngu.

source_text: but far be it from me to glory, save in the cross of our lord jesus christ, through which the world hath been crucified unto me, and i unto the world.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a ne d'èi dhoka ded'e padedha-dedha kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. nèngu madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, sèna ka pamadhe aa'i bhabhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu ad'u-ue madhutu dad'èi rai-haha ne. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pusi-pahae heka dènge dad'èi rai-haha. aa dad'èi rai-haha ne èki heka ja'a.

source_text: for neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
target_text: suna, do aad'o, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te ngaa dhu karisi, nuka èdhi abhu mamuri hiu nèti lamatua.

source_text: and as many as shall walk by this rule, peace be upon them, and mercy, and upon the israel of god.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu a'aj'a ja'a ne, ho rèngu mamuri padame, aa pad'elo rasa kasia èci dènge èci. te rèngu j'aj'i le suku dhu hiu nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: henceforth let no man trouble me; for i bear branded on my body the marks of jesus.
target_text: ja'a peka mola-mola kèna, na, ja'a d'èi sèna ka dhèu sèku ia ka ja'a dènge lii langu suna ne. te ètu ngi'u ja'a ne dènge tadha nu'a era, lula ja'a sab'a hia yesus kristus.

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ be with your spirit, brethren. amen.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na asa miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus

source_text: paul, an apostle of christ jesus through the will of god, to the saints that are at ephesus, and the faithful in christ jesus:
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ja'a suri sasuri ne, hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi, dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu yesus kristus ètu kota epesus, aa dhu taha ètu d'ara mamuri mola-mèci madhutu dad'èi na. nèngu mesa na ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: grace to you and peace from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ama lamatua ne, ama èdhi. aa yesus kristus, kètu èdhi. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra ho miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: blessed be the god and father of our lord jesus christ, who hath blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in christ:
target_text: koa-kio mi ama lamatua! nèngu ka ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te ama lamatua pala-bagi le mi èdhi mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i nèti sorga, lula èdhi j'aj'i le dhèu unu yesus kristus.

source_text: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blemish before him in love:
target_text: te lod'o rai-haha dhae j'aj'i mèka, ama lamatua sue aa hag'e nare le èdhi, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus kristus. na d'èi sèna ka èdhi mamuri mola-mèci. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa boe pasala èdhi.

source_text: having foreordained us unto adoption as sons through jesus christ unto himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
target_text: nèngu ka dhu pama'ète mema karèi nèti uru ka, ho ded'e èdhi j'aj'i ana na, lula yesus kristus. ne'e ne ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: to the praise of the glory of his grace, which he freely bestowed on us in the beloved:
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi koa-kio ne. te nèngu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, ho èdhi bisa mamuri pa'èci dènge ana pasue na.

source_text: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,
target_text: masi ka èdhi uru èèna mamuri mola-mèci boe madhutu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua, te ngaa na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa hia ana na mai, sèna ka pasuti raa na toke madhe. dènge j'ara ne'e, ana na sui nare èdhi nèti sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
target_text: lula na dutu-bhori sasue na mi èdhi, nèngu pasaraa d'ara èdhi kahèi, ka bisa te'a mèu dad'èi d'ara na.

source_text: making known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
target_text: uru èèna, ama lamatua dhae peka aa'i mèka dad'èi d'ara na mi dhèu rai-haha ne. te ngaa limuri ne, madhutu dad'èi na, na hia le èdhi te'a, peka na, karèi nèti uru ka, na pama'ète nare le ho neo pake yesus kristus sèna ka padame dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: unto a dispensation of the fulness of the times, to sum up all things in christ, the things in the heavens, and the things upon the earth; in him, i say,
target_text: aa, pe d'ai lod'o na, yesus kristus j'aj'i kètu ho uri aa'i ngaa-ngaa ètu rai-haha dènge ètu sorga.

source_text: in whom also we were made a heritage, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his will; to the end that we should be unto the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in christ:
target_text: lula èdhi dhu pa'èki le dènge kristus, nèti èèna ka èdhi abhu pusaka kahèi nèti ama lamatua. te karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, na hag'e nare ji'i dhèu yahudi, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. dad'èi nèngu ka, neo pake ji'i ho bhoke j'ara hia dhèu-dhèu leo, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parcaya kristus. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i, madhutu ngaa dhu na pama'ète nare le. dènge j'ara ne, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti bisa ded'e padedha-dedha risi hari, kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: in whom ye also, having heard the word of the truth, the gospel of your salvation, -in whom, having also believed, ye were sealed with the holy spirit of promise,
target_text: lula ji'i bhoke le j'ara, nèti èèna ka miu nèti suku leo bisa mai j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, sad'i miu parcaya lii lolo be'a na dhu mola. te lii lolo be'a èèna ka dhu pamamuri miu. ladhe miu parcaya sèmi èèna, miu sèmi mere kahèi roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci dhu na moa mema le. te roh lamatua mola-mèci ne, nuka sèmi cap ho patadha, peka na, miu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: which is an earnest of our inheritance, unto the redemption of god's own possession, unto the praise of his glory.
target_text: roh mola-mèci ne'e j'aj'i mi jaminan kahèi, dhu peka na, pe ama lamatua hia aa'i mèu-mèu dhu na moa mema sèra, toke na sui nare èdhi, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na. nèti èèna ka, èdhi koa-kio dadedha na.

source_text: for this cause i also, having heard of the faith in the lord jesus which is among you, and the love which ye show toward all the saints,
target_text: ja'a tadèngi ae le, j'ara-j'ara lalèka miu mi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, aa nèti sasue miu mi dhèu parcaya sèra. nèti èèna ka,

source_text: cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
target_text: ja'a loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: that the god of our lord jesus christ, the father of glory, may give unto you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a, peka na, ama pasue! ama ku, ama lamatua nèti kètu ja'a, yesus kristus. aa ama ku ka dhu kapai risi aa'i. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama hia roh ama mi dhèu epesus, ho re'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, aa bisa tadhe ama mèu risi hari.

source_text: having the eyes of your heart enlightened, that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho ama lamatua bhoke ngangee dènge pasaraa d'ara ra, sèna ka bisa re'a aa'i ngaa dhu ama padhadha neo hia si. ja'a neo kahèi sèna ka rèngu re'a pusaka dhu ama moa neo hia si bèli-camèd'a. te pusaka èèna kab'ua titu kèna.

source_text: and what the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
target_text: ja'a manèngi kahèi, ho ama bhoke j'ara hia si, sèna ka bisa re'a mèu koasa ama dhu dedha risi èèna. te ama pake koasa èèna, ho soru-bara dhèu parcaya dhu unu ama sèra.

source_text: which he wrought in christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,
target_text: te koasa ama lamatua èèna, risi aa'i mèu-mèu. nèti koasa ne'e ka na pamamuri kristus nèti mamadhe na. hèia ama lamatua ded'e kristus asa sorga, ka hia ne madhèdi ètu era dhu kab'ua risi eele, ètu baboa g'ana na.

source_text: far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
target_text: nèngu dedha risi nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu rai-haha dènge ètu sorga. te nèngu dedha risi nèti koasa aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge dhu rèd'u paredha aa'i-aa'i ra. na kèpe koasa na dhu risi nèti aa'i-aa'i sèra, mesa boe doe ne'e ne di. te na nèd'u koasa ne taruu toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and he put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things to the church,
target_text: ama lamatua unu na ka dhu tao sèna ka aa'i-aa'i se pahaha iisi mi kristus. aa nèngu kahèi ded'e kristus j'aj'i kètu, sèna ka uri aa'i-aa'i dhu pa'èki dènge dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
