source_text: and they say to the mountains and to the rocks, fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the lamb:
target_text: dhèu sèra pua ledhe-ledhe aa hadhu aae sèra, peka na, saguru mere ka ji'i laa! pahuni ji'i sèna ka nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha aae èèna, baku nèdhi ji'i. aa ana kalèbho èèna huku ia ka ji'i.

source_text: for the great day of their wrath is come; and who is able to stand?
target_text: ira ii! ji'i laho mae-mae le, te lod'o d'ai mamadhe-mamopo kèna! ama lamatua dènge ana kalèbho èèna, neo dutu nanasa rèngu mi dedha ji'i. te ngaa èci sa bisa boe sili rare, hèia tatu madhe aa'i mèu-mèu!

source_text: after this i saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that no wind should blow on the earth, or on the sea, or upon any tree.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu lamatua dhèu èpa puru mai nèti sorga, titu ètu èpa madha ngèlu ètu rai-haha ne, ho taha ngèlu. ka ngèlu bisa boe tiu asa d'ara dhasi, rai-dedha, dènge aj'u-aj'u.

source_text: and i saw another angel ascend from the sunrising, having the seal of the living god: and he cried with a great voice to the four angels to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
target_text: lamatua hia si koasa, ho ra pa'ele iie rai-dedha dènge d'ara dhasi. ka ja'a kèdhi hari ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai nèti dhimu. na mai nèti dènge cap ama lamatua dhu mamuri taa-taa. hèia na rodhe mi ana pajuu dhèu èpa sèra, peka na,

source_text: saying, hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we shall have sealed the servants of our god on their foreheads.
target_text: mate ku! baku pa'ele iie ku rai-dedha, do d'ara dhasi, do aj'u sèra. mate toke ji'i tao ngare ku cap mi katangarèi dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: and i heard the number of them that were sealed, a hundred and forty and four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of israel:
target_text: èle èèna ka, rèngu peka dènge ja'a, na, ana pajuu ne tao le tadha mi dhèu unu lamatua sèra. dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra 144. cangasu èpa nguru èpa riho dhèu, dhu mai nèti suku isra'el. nuka:

source_text: of the tribe of judah were sealed twelve thousand; of the tribe of reuben twelve thousand; of the tribe of gad twelve thousand;
target_text: nèti suku yahuda, 12. canguru dua riho dhèu; suku ruben, 12. 000 dhèu; suku gad, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: of the tribe of asher twelve thousand; of the tribe of naphtali twelve thousand; of the tribe of manasseh twelve thousand;
target_text: suku aser, 12. 000 dhèu; suku naftali, 12. 000 dhèu; suku manase, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: of the tribe of simeon twelve thousand; of the tribe of levi twelve thousand; of the tribe of issachar twelve thousand;
target_text: suku simeon, 12. 000 dhèu; suku lewi, 12. 000 dhèu; suku isaskar, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: of the tribe of zebulun twelve thousand; of the tribe of joseph twelve thousand; of the tribe of benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
target_text: suku sebulon, 12. 000 dhèu; suku yusuf, 12. 000 dhèu; aa nèti suku benyamin, 12. 000 dhèu.

source_text: after these things i saw, and behold, a great multitude, which no man could number, out of every nation and of all tribes and peoples and tongues, standing before the throne and before the lamb, arrayed in white robes, and palms in their hands;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi dhèu ae titu kèna, dhu ige kore boe. rèngu mai nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, nèti kabarai aa'i-aa'i, aa nèti lii aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. rèngu pakaboko tangara asa kadera paredha, aa asa ana kalèbho kahèi. dhèu sèra pake kodho pudhi, aa ra kèpe dènge rèu palam.

source_text: and they cry with a great voice, saying, salvation unto our god who sitteth on the throne, and unto the lamb.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra koa-kio, aku rèngu na, ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua ji'i, dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha na. ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha ana kalèbho ne kahèi! rèngu se'e ka dhu pala mamuri hia ji'i. rèngu se'e ka dhu bhoke j'ara mamuri hia ji'i.

source_text: and all the angels were standing round about the throne, and about the elders and the four living creatures; and they fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped god,
target_text: ropa padhai lii rare sèmi èèna, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga dhu rai-reo rare kadera paredha ne, patitu kètu urutuu ra, toke rèhu d'ai rai, tangare asa kadera paredha aae ne. katua-katua dènge èpa badha aae sèra, tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua,

source_text: saying, amen: blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honor, and power, and might, be unto our god for ever and ever. amen.
target_text: aa ra peka na, tare'a! èèna tare'a-re'a! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua kahèi! ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua kahèi! ngangee dènge lii padhai lamatua, dhu lèke mola-mola. koasa lamatua dhu kapai risi eele. a'èra lamatua seli eele. ji'i loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ji'i loe boe pakab'ua lamatua. lèke! tare'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: and one of the elders answered, saying unto me, these that are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and whence came they?
target_text: ropa rèngu koa-kio rare sèmi èèna, hèia nèti dua nguru èpa katua se, èci karèi ja'a, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae-ae dhu pake kodho pudhi se, èu tadha si, do? rèngu se mai nèti mia?

source_text: and i say unto him, my lord, thou knowest. and he said to me, these are they that come out of the great tribulation, and they washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the lamb.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a dhaa, peka na, aad'o, ama. ja'a tadhe boe rèngu se, cee. ama ka dhu tadhe risi. ka na peka dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, rèngu se, dhèu dhu bhodho nèti d'ara j'aj'èra aae. rèngu se, dhèu dhu pake le raa ana kalèbho ne, sèna ka rase mèdha-papake ra, aa tao papudhi kodho ra.

source_text: therefore are they before the throne of god; and they serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall spread his tabernacle over them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, rèngu titu ètu madha kadera paredha ama lamatua. mèu-mèda rèngu lalau-lalo'o lamatua ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i na. lamatua dènge si taa-taa. lamatua madhenge si taa-taa.

source_text: they shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun strike upon them, nor any heat:
target_text: pe rèngu re'a heka manganga. pe rèngu koko-kamango heka. pe madha lod'o pakèpu heka si. pe ka'uri rèngu carici heka lèke lod'o pana.

source_text: for the lamb that is in the midst of the throne shall be their shepherd, and shall guide them unto fountains of waters of life: and god shall wipe away every tear from their eyes.
target_text: ana kalèbho dhu padètu dènge kadera paredha èèna, pe nèngu ka j'aj'i dhèu bata-magee kètu rèngu. èèna na nèngu ka eo nèti si, lasi rinu asa madha èi dhu nèti mamuri hia dhèu. pe lamatua saku eele sasusa ra, sèna ka ra tangi ia ka.

source_text: and when he opened the seventh seal, there followed a silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka pidhu. kabèdhi laa, aa'i-aa'i ètu sorga kalau-karèto boe. abhu boe lii èci sa, pe d'ai catenga jam sa.

source_text: and i saw the seven angels that stand before god; and there were given unto them seven trumpets.
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga, titu taruu ètu madha ama lamatua, dhu pa'èra lalau ne. rèngu èci-èci ka sèmi rare tèbhe ra.

source_text: and another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should add it unto the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu, titu ètu madha mei era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi. nèngu dhu nèd'u dènge mago hualaa cue, era isi raa aj'u hèu mèngi. hèia ra hia ne raa aj'u hèu mèngi ae-ae, sèna ka na pab'ali dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i nèti dhèu unu ama lamatua. ka na nèti mago hualaa, ho tao sèmi korban dhu hèu mèngi, sèna ka la'e tèke asa dedha mei hualaa ètu madha kadera paredha aae.

source_text: and the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before god out of the angel's hand.
target_text: ka na tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi ne. hèia hèu mèngi na ca'e asa madha ama lamatua, palere-lere dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i nèti dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: and the angel taketh the censer; and he filled it with the fire of the altar, and cast it upon the earth: and there followed thunders, and voices, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu ne nare ai nèti dedha mei ne, la'e tao asa d'ara mago hualaa èèna. hèia na pèci mago ne asa rai-haha. kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi bela kacèb'a lolo aae nèti g'ana-kariu ètu rai-haha. ka lii tea ma'ète boe, aa rai opo kapai titu kèna.

source_text: and the seven angels that had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
target_text: èle ka, ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga sèra, pa'èra ho tiu tèbhe ra.

source_text: and the first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of the earth was burnt up, and the third part of the trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

source_text: and the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of god, that there they may nourish her a thousand two hundred and threescore days.

source_text: and i heard a great voice in heaven, saying, now is come the salvation, and the power, and the kingdom of our god, and the authority of his christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, who accuseth them before our god day and night.

source_text: and they overcame him because of the blood of the lamb, and because of the word of their testimony; and they loved not their life even unto death.

source_text: therefore rejoice, o heavens, and ye that dwell in them. woe for the earth and for the sea: because the devil is gone down unto you, having great wrath, knowing that he hath but a short time.

source_text: and when the dragon saw that he was cast down to the earth, he persecuted the woman that brought forth the man child.

source_text: and there were given to the woman the two wings of the great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness unto her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

source_text: and the serpent cast out of his mouth after the woman water as a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

source_text: and he stood upon the sand of the sea. and i saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads, and on his horns ten diadems, and upon his heads names of blasphemy.

source_text: and all that dwell on the earth shall worship him, every one whose name hath not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the lamb that hath been slain.
