target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi hari ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai madhutu ana pajuu ka dua deo na. na pa'oo-parodha, peka na, mata unu mi! dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sogo-tagu badha bhelu dènge mèdha sogo-tagu na, do abhu cap ètu katangarèi, do ètu kacui-aai, pe rèngu pasae rare nanasa lamatua!

source_text: he also shall drink of the wine of the wrath of god, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the lamb:
target_text: bèli-camèd'a lamatua mesa na sabhori mai nanasa na mi dedha rèngu, nuka sèmi na panginu si èi uuru nèti èi anggor pèd'u. èèna na core si asa d'ara èi nasu dhu heo robhe-robhe dhu loe boe ciki sa. ana pajuu na nèti sorga sèra, aa ana kalèbho èèna kahèi ladhe rèdhi j'ara ne'e.

source_text: and the smoke of their torment goeth up for ever and ever; and they have no rest day and night, they that worship the beast and his image, and whoso receiveth the mark of his name.
target_text: peka ka laa, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sogo-tagu badha bhelu dènge mèdha sogo-tagu na, do rèngu dhu lèke le cap na, pe dui rare j'aj'èra taa-taa. sèb'u nèti j'aj'èra rèngu bhodho mai loe boe mèu-mèda.

source_text: here is the patience of the saints, they that keep the commandments of god, and the faith of jesus. and i heard a voice from heaven saying, write, blessed are the dead who die in the lord from henceforth: yea, saith the spirit, that they may rest from their labors; for their works follow with them.
target_text: de se'e se, sasoa na, dhèu unu ama lamatua, hud'i nanene ku paie-iie lii paredha na, aa parcaya taruu mi yesus, aa baku hari kabodho. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii èci nèti dedha-liru, peka na, yohanis! èu hud'i suri ku sèmi ne'e: karèi nèti deo ne'e, dhèu dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, ladhe ra madhe, rèngu abhu oto. hèia roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci dhaa, peka na, tare'a! bèli-camèd'a rèngu sèra oto tare'a-re'a! lula rèngu j'èra le ètu rai-haha, te ngaa ra taha ho madhutu taruu lamatua. de èèna na, lamatua b'ala j'aj'èra rèngu, ka rèngu mamuri j'èra heka ètu sorga.

source_text: and i saw, and behold, a white cloud; and on the cloud i saw one sitting like unto a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a padoa kètu. kaca'a laa, kèdhi ra'i-liru dhu pudhi lao-lao, aa ca dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha na. dhèu ne, oe sèmi dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. na pake dènge solo juara dhu tao nèti hualaa, aa nèd'u dènge hela pare j'u'u madèka èci.

source_text: and another angel came out from the temple, crying with a great voice to him that sat on the cloud, send forth thy sickle, and reap: for the hour to reap is come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu dhèu èci hari nèti sorga, kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. na rodhe dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha ra'i-liru èèna, peka na, pake hela èu èèna ho lamu puu-g'ètu ka! te d'ai le hèru pakaboko isi rai.

source_text: and he that sat on the cloud cast his sickle upon the earth; and the earth was reaped.
target_text: ka dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha ra'i-liru ne, kèpe nare hela na, ka na la'e puu-g'ètu. hèia na oru kaboko isi rai nèti rai-haha.

source_text: and another angel came out from the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu leo hari ca dhèu kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu sorga. nèngu nèd'u dènge hela pare j'u'u madèka èci, ho neo g'ètu hua aj'u.

source_text: and another angel came out from the altar, he that hath power over fire; and he called with a great voice to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, send forth thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu dhu leo hari èci kalua nèti era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu sorga. sasab'a ana pajuu ne, nuka j'aga ai ètu era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi. na pa'oo pua ana pajuu dhu nèd'u hela pare j'u'u deo na, aku nèngu na, pake ka hela èu èèna, ho lamu ka g'ètu hua aj'u ètu rai-haha! te ètu nèi, hua anggor dhu madhasa aa'i le.

source_text: and the angel cast his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth, and cast it into the winepress, the great winepress, of the wrath of god.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ne kèpe nare ka hela pare j'u'u na la'e asa rai-haha, ho na g'ètu hua anggor, j'ue dènge ii kateme. hèia na pamaso hua anggor se asa d'ara bak pacèli anggor. ka ra j'èli marèu anggor se, sèna ka rare èi. j'èli marèu hua anggor ètu d'ara bak pacèli ne, sasoa na, nanasa lamatua.

source_text: and the winepress was trodden without the city, and there came out blood from the winepress, even unto the bridles of the horses, as far as a thousand and six hundred furlongs.
target_text: bak pacèli ne ètu li'u kota. ropa ra j'èli marèu anggor se, hèia raa kalua ae-ae. raa ne hae sama sèmi loko cue, dhu madhera na tèlu ngasu kilo, aa marèma na d'ai ca meter ca èta.

source_text: and i saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having seven plagues, which are the last, for in them is finished the wrath of god.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi tadha èci ètu dedha-liru, dhu kapai titu kèna, toke ja'a malaa bia. abhu ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga, èci-èci ka dènge koasa ra, ho hia calaka kapai asa rai-haha. pidhu calaka se, nuka j'aj'èra dhu limuri tèka. ladhe j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i ka, d'ara ama lamatua pacuhi, ka nasa heka dènge dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: and i saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire; and them that come off victorious from the beast, and from his image, and from the number of his name, standing by the sea of glass, having harps of god.
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi dhasi dhu ha'a-ha'a, nuka sèmi tèru dhu pab'ali dènge ai. ja'a kèdhi kahèi dhèu ae dhu titu ètu sebhe dhasi èèna. dhèu se'e ka dhu madhutu boe badha bhelu èèna, aa ra sogo-tagu boe mèdha sogo-tagu na, aa dhu sèmi boe cap na hèi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu kèpe dènge mèdha lii sod'a èci nuka sèmi sasadhu, dhu ra abhu nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and they sing the song of moses the servant of god, and the song of the lamb, saying, great and marvellous are thy works, o lord god, the almighty; righteous and true are thy ways, thou king of the ages.
target_text: ka ra sod'a lii sod'a èci dhu musa suri. musa ne, ana pua-paleha ama lamatua uru-uru sèra. dhèu se'e se sod'a kahèi lii sod'a èci dhu koa-kio yesus. te uru èèna, dhèu pamadhe ne, sama sèmi dhèu roro pamadhe ana kalèbho ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, sèna ka pamaringi d'ara na. dhèu se sod'a, peka na, ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na! lula koasa lamatua kapai risi eele. dènge a'èra na kapai titu kèna. lamatua ka dhu nèd'u le paredha mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu aae mi udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. tatao lamatua mola sèmi isi pupu. sasab'a lamatua be'a seli eele! j'ara lamatua mèu rèd'e-rèd'e. mamuri lamatua lèke mola-mola!

source_text: who shall not fear, o lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy; for all the nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy righteous acts have been made manifest.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra koa-kio babe'a lamatua. lula lamatua mesa na dhu mola-mèci. aa lamatua mesa na di, dènge boe sasala. pe suku aa'i-aa'i mai pahaha iisi mi lamatua. pe udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i mai manèngi makasi mi lamatua. lula dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a rèdhi le tatao lamatua dhu be'a. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a le mamola d'ara lamatua.

source_text: and after these things i saw, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
target_text: ropa dhèu se èle sod'a, ja'a kèdhi kama luri mola-mèci ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua ètu sorga, dènge bhèla bhabhiri dhu bhoke pataleo tèke.

source_text: and there came out from the temple the seven angels that had the seven plagues, arrayed with precious stone, pure and bright, and girt about their breasts with golden girdles.
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga dhu rèti dènge pidhu calaka sèra. rèngu kalua mai nèti èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. rèngu pake mèdha-papake dhu kale'e pudhi mèu, aa pake salalu dhu tao nèti poe dènge pai.

source_text: and one of the four living creatures gave unto the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of god, who liveth for ever and ever.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi badha aae èci nèti èpa ngi'u sèra ètu sebhe kadera paredha lamatua, dhu papala pidhu bokor hualaa mi ana pajuu dhèu pidhu sèra. pidhu bokor se, èci-èci ka dhu isi ra hahuku nèti ama lamatua dhu taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia. te na pa'èra le, ho sabhori nanasa na asa rai-haha.

source_text: and the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of god, and from his power; and none was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels should be finished.
target_text: nèbhu boe, hèia èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ne pènu dènge sèb'u dhu bodho mai nèti dadedha dènge koasa ama lamatua. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa maso asa era èèna. ana pajuu dhèu pidhu se hud'i sabhori pa'èle ku pidhu calaka asa rai-haha ne, heka dhèu bisa maso asa era èèna kèna.

source_text: and i heard a great voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, go ye, and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of god into the earth.
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi lii parodha èci kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, ho peka dènge ana pajuu dhèu pidhu se, na, lami ka! nedhe mèti ka bokor se'e, ho bhori ka nanasa lamatua asa rai-haha.

source_text: and the first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth; and it became a noisome and grievous sore upon the men that had the mark of the beast, and that worshipped his image.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia ana pajuu ka èci la'e bhori isi bokor na asa rai-haha. kaca'a laa, papèd'a-tarègu lèke dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru sèra abhu cap nèti badha bhelu, dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu sogo-tagu mèdha sogo-tagu na. rèngu se lèke èi papèd'a hisu huu dhu rarii titu kèna.

source_text: and the second poured out his bowl into the sea; and it became blood as of a dead man; and every living soul died, even the things that were in the sea.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu ka dua la'e bhori isi bokor na asa d'ara dhasi. kaca'a laa, èi ètu d'ara dhasi j'aj'i raa dhu hèu mau, cakaraa hèu raa dhèu madhe. ka aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu d'ara dhasi madhe aa'i si.

source_text: and the third poured out his bowl into the rivers and the fountains of the waters; and it became blood.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka tèlu la'e bhori isi bokor na asa d'ara loko dènge madha èi. ka èi aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i raa.

source_text: and i heard the angel of the waters saying, righteous art thou, who art and who wast, thou holy one, because thou didst thus judge:
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi ana pajuu ca dhèu nèti sorga, dhu uri èi aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. na koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, oo lamatua! lamatua dhu mola-mèci! lamatua dhu sala nèdhi boe! lamatua mema-mema karèi nèti uru ka. aa lamatua taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia. lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhu mola isi pupu. lamatua hia le huku dhu kasii-kasore boe.

source_text: for they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and blood hast thou given them to drink: they are worthy.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu pasuti le, raa nèti dhèu unu lamatua. dhèu-dhèu pamadhe le, dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. nèti èèna ka, lamatua laka-seti si, ho rinu raa kahèi. nèti èèna ka, lamatua b'ala si, dènge huku dhu lèke.

source_text: and i heard the altar saying, yea, o lord god, the almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.
target_text: èle ka, ja'a tadèngi lii èci kalua nèti mei sogo-tagu, peka na, tare'a! ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi eele. tare'a! ama lamatua dhu èra risi aa'i. lamatua dhu pama'ète lii langu dhu koe boe kapengo boe. lamatua dhu pamanahu huku dhu lèke mola-mola.

source_text: and the fourth poured out his bowl upon the sun; and it was given unto it to scorch men with fire.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka èpa la'e bhori isi bokor na asa madha lod'o. kaca'a laa, lod'o pana titu kèna, ka dhèu ètu rai-haha ne kèpu-ladhu ai.

source_text: and men were scorched with great heat: and they blasphemed the name of god who hath the power over these plagues; and they repented not to give him glory.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke tunu se, dhoo kolongara ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu papuru calaka ne hia mai asa rèngu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ele-ho'a, ka lèpa asa lamatua ho koa-kio kolongara na.

source_text: and the fifth poured out his bowl upon the throne of the beast; and his kingdom was darkened; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,
target_text: ka ana pajuu ka lèmi la'e bhori isi bokor na asa kadera paredha badha bhelu se. kaca'a laa, maroga kiu-kiu saguru nare dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sogo-tagu ne, toke j'èra titu kèna hèia ra gègu-ria.

source_text: and they blasphemed the god of heaven because of their pains and their sores; and they repented not of their works.
target_text: dhèu se'e kahèi dhoo ama lamatua ètu sorga, lula hisu ra rarii titu kèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ae eele nèti bhabhelu ra, ka lèpa asa ama lamatua.

source_text: and the sixth poured out his bowl upon the great river, the river euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way might be made ready for the kings that come from the sunrising.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka èna bhori isi bokor na asa loko aae, dhu ngara na efrat. ka loko ne mango-meto dènge ka. hèia ra tao j'ara ètu d'ara loko ne, hia dhèu aae-dhèu aae dènge sordad'u-sordad'u dhu bèli-camèd'a mai nèti cabèka dhimu.

source_text: and i saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, as it were frogs:
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi nidhu bhelu tèlu. rupa ra sama sèmi ana gaged'e. ci'u bhodho nèti d'ara hèb'a mege naga. ci'u kalua nèti d'ara hèb'a badha bhelu. aa ci'u hari bhodho nèti hèb'a dhèu kapod'e-kabèli, dhu nèti lii padhai mege naga èèna.

source_text: for they are spirits of demons, working signs; which go forth unto the kings of the whole world, to gather them together unto the war of the great day of god, the almighty.
target_text: nidhu tèlu se dènge koasa ho tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa. ra kalua, lasi paraga dènge dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, ka ra pajaji ho ètu d'ara ca lod'o sa lasi pamusu, lab'a ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi eele èèna. te ngaa lod'o dhu ra pajaji èèna, lèke dènge lod'o dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le, ho na segi musu na aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: behold, i come as a thief. blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame. and they gathered them together into the place which is called in hebrew har-magedon.
target_text: era dhu ra pakaboko ho pamusu èèna, lii ibrani peka na, armagedon. yesus kristus peka kahèi, na, sanèd'e paie-iie! te kaca'a laa, ja'a mai nuka sèmi dhèu mana'u, dhu dhèu èci sa re'a boe. dhèu dhu oto, nuka rèngu dhu beke dènge dhu bori mema dhari. te ladhe ja'a mai, nèngu na'e boe makae, lula dhèu rèdhi boe era makae na.

source_text: and the seventh poured out his bowl upon the air; and there came forth a great voice out of the temple, from the throne, saying, it is done:
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka pidhu la'e bhori isi bokor na asa madha ngèlu. ka ama lamatua padhai lii mèdhu nèti kadera paredha na ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, èle le! nanasa ja'a bhori aa'i mèu-mèu le!

source_text: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since there were men upon the earth, so great an earthquake, so mighty.
target_text: hèia bela heo ha'a-ha'a, dènge d'oro lii gasi-gasi. aa rai opo dhu kapai titu kèna, dhu j'aj'i nèdhi mèka karèi nèti rai-haha ne j'aj'i.

source_text: and the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and babylon the great was remembered in the sight of god, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua bhèlu boe bhabhelu dhèu ètu kota babel. ka na pake rai opo dhu kapai aae, sèna ka tao kota kapai ne masèke mi tèlu. ama lamatua ad'u-ue sèmi èèna, sèna ka dhèu babel re'a nanasa na. kota-kota leo ètu rai-haha ne, laho eele aa'i si kahèi.

source_text: and every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
target_text: lod'o èèna pulu-pulu cène aa'i si, aa ledhe-ledhe ela aa'i kahèi.

source_text: and great hail, every stone about the weight of a talent, cometh down out of heaven upon men: and men blasphemed god because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof is exceeding great.
target_text: abhu kahèi èj'i es hadhu dhu kapai, bèbhe nèti dedha-liru, kabhie nare dhèu-dhèu ètu rai-haha. es hadhu se, babia ra abhu kahèi d'ai èpa nguru kilo. lula èj'i es ne dhu paj'èra dhèu, ka ra dhoo ama lamatua.

source_text: and there came one of the seven angels that had the seven bowls, and spake with me, saying, come hither, i will show thee the judgment of the great harlot that sitteth upon many waters;
target_text: èle ka, ana pajuu èci nèti rèngu dhèu pidhu dhu rèd'u bokor dhu dènge heka isi, mai peka dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, mai ku sa ne'e! ja'a neo pad'elo dènge èu, j'ara tasamia ama lamatua huku bhèni kajeo dhu bhelu aae èèna. nèngu ne, nuka kota kapai èèna, dhu ra patitu padètu dènge èi ae-ae.

source_text: with whom the kings of the earth committed fornication, and they that dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her fornication.
target_text: uru èèna, dhèu aae-dhèu aae nèti mia-mia, mai ad'u-ue j'ara makae dènge ana kabarai d'ara kota ne. dhèu leo kahèi mai rinu mahu, aa madhutu tatao j'ara makae ra.

source_text: and he carried me away in the spirit into a wilderness: and i saw a woman sitting upon a scarlet-colored beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
target_text: èle èèna ka, roh ama lamatua maso asa ja'a, hèia ana pajuu nèti sorga ded'e nèti ja'a asa d'ara mamoo èci. d'ai nèi, ja'a ladhe kèdhi dhèu bhèni ca dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kabodho badha bhelu mea ci'u. kètu badha ne pidhu, dènge tadhu na canguru. palème ètu ngi'u na dhu suri lii-lii dhu pakarehe ama lamatua.

source_text: and the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stone and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations, even the unclean things of her fornication,
target_text: bhèni ne pake bèla manii mea dènge mea sanama mangèru. na pagaa ngi'u na dènge nèu mèdha hualaa, hadhu kale'e dhu kab'ua, dènge mutiara. ètu ai g'ana na, nèd'u dènge cangkir hualaa èci dhu pènu dènge èi anggor. anggor ne, sasoa na, j'ara makae, aa bhabhelu dènge tatao kaj'alu aa'i-aa'i dhu leo, dhu na ad'u-ue.

source_text: and upon her forehead a name written, mystery, babylon the great, the mother of the harlots and of the abominations of the earth.
target_text: ètu katangarèi na, dhu suri ngara èci, dhu dhèu re'a boe. lii dhu ra suri èèna, sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a ne, babel! ja'a ne, kota dhu kapai risi! rupa-rupa bhabhelu ètu rai-haha, j'aj'aj'i ra nèti ja'a ka. j'ara makae aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne, kapua ra nèti ja'a.

source_text: and i saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of jesus. and when i saw her, i wondered with a great wonder.
target_text: ja'a laladhe, na, bhèni ne dhu mahu bia, lula nèngu dhu ninu le raa dhèu unu ama lamatua sèra. sasoa na, na pamadhe le dhèu unu ama lamatua, lula rèngu loe boe peka j'ara mamuri yesus. ropa ja'a kèdhi tatao bhèni ne sèmi èèna, hèia hèb'a ja'a nganga-nganga sène, lula malaa bia.

source_text: and the angel said unto me, wherefore didst thou wonder? i will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and the ten horns.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ne karèi ja'a, peka na, nga tao ka èu naa-naa, aa malaa sèmi èèna? mai ho ja'a peka dènge èu sasoa na nèti bhèni kajeo ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge sasoa nèti badha bhelu dhu nèngu manya'e èèna. badha ne'e ka dhu kètu pidhu dènge tadhu canguru.

source_text: the beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss, and to go into perdition. and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, they whose name hath not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast, how that he was, and is not, and shall come.
target_text: uru èèna, badha bhelu ne dhu mamuri le ètu rai-haha, te ngaa limuri ne aad'o heka. te ngaa nèbhu heka, na kalua hari mai nèti ro'a j'aj'èra dhu dènge boe too-lane èèna. lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha, dhu ngara ra dhae suri mèka ètu d'ara sasuri ana kalèbho, dhu ama lamatua suri tèke le karèi uru ka, nèti na paj'aj'i rai-haha ne. bèli-camèd'a, dhèu se'e se malaa-maloha, lula rèdhi badha bhelu ne lèpa hari mai. te ngaa ladhe na mai hari, pe ama lamatua pèci ne asa d'ara dhasi ai èi nasu dhu heo na taa-taa.

source_text: here is the mind that hath wisdom. the seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth:
target_text: dhèu cee dhu d'èlu-mèu, na, nèngu bisa ne'a sasoa j'ara se'e. badha bhelu dhu kètu pidhu, sasoa na, nuka ledhe pidhu bua. bhèni kajeo èèna, dhu madhèdi ètu dedha ledhe sèra. aa sasoa nèti kètu pidhu sèra, nuka dhèu aae dhèu pidhu.

source_text: and they are seven kings; the five are fallen, the one is, the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a little while.
target_text: lèmi nèti dhèu aae pidhu se, madhe le. ca dhèu dhu nèd'u paredha limuri ne. aa ca dhèu hari dhae mai mèka. te ngaa ladhe mai, nèngu nèd'u paredha nèbhu boe.

source_text: and the beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goeth into perdition.
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a lole dènge èu, nèti badha bhelu dhu uru èèna mamuri, te ngaa limuri ne madhe le. lod'o èèna, nèngu ne ca dhèu nèti pidhu dhèu aae sèra, te ngaa èèna na mai hari nèd'u paredha, ho j'aj'i dhèu aae ka aru. pe na laho mae-mae kahèi.

source_text: and the ten horns that thou sawest are ten kings, who have received no kingdom as yet; but they receive authority as kings, with the beast, for one hour.
target_text: canguru tadhu se, sasoa na, nuka canguru dhèu aae. rèngu se dhae rèd'u mèka paredha. bèli-camèd'a rèngu abhu koasa, ho rèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge badha bhelu ne, te ngaa dhoka ciki-diki di.

source_text: these have one mind, and they give their power and authority unto the beast.
target_text: te rare lii èci, ho pangèd'u koasa ra mi badha bhelu èèna.

source_text: these shall war against the lamb, and the lamb shall overcome them, for he is lord of lords, and king of kings; and they also shall overcome that are with him, called and chosen and faithful.
target_text: dhèu aae sèra, bèli-camèd'a lasi pamusu, lab'a ana kalèbho. te ngaa ana kalèbho dènge dhèu unu na segi aa'i si. dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu ana kalèbho ne, nuka rèngu dhu na hag'e nare le, aa na paroa si ho madhutu ne taa-taa. pe rèngu segi, lula ana kalèbho ne èra titu kèna. dhodhoka nèngu di dhu j'aj'i dhèu aae nèti dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ra, aa lamatua nèti lamatua aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and he saith unto me, the waters which thou sawest, where the harlot sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.
target_text: aa èi ae-ae dhu padètu dènge bhèni kajeo ne, nuka dhèu-dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge dhèu ae-ae nèti lii aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and the ten horns which thou sawest, and the beast, these shall hate the harlot, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and shall burn her utterly with fire.
target_text: canguru dhèu aae dènge badha bhelu se, èèna na ra tèka d'ara dènge bhèni kajeo dhu ne'a boe makae ne. èèna na parame rare mèdha-papake dènge mèdha-panyau na aa'i-aa'i, ka tèke eele ne dènge boe mèdha-papake ètu ua na. èle èèna ka, ra'e sisi bhèni ne kahèi. aa ngi'u na dhu ate, core asa d'ara ai.

source_text: for god did put in their hearts to do his mind, and to come to one mind, and to give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of god should be accomplished.
target_text: ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu tao, toke canguru dhèu aae se rare lii èci, ho pangèd'u koasa ra mi badha bhelu ne, toke na palaho bhèni ne. dènge j'ara ne'e, ngaa dhu ama lamatua neo ad'u-ue, bèli-camèd'a aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i.

source_text: and the woman whom thou sawest is the great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.
target_text: bhèni kajeo dhu èu mèdhi èèna, nuka dhèu aae-dhèu kapai nèti kota kapai dhu paredha dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha.

source_text: after these things i saw another angel coming down out of heaven, having great authority; and the earth was lightened with his glory.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu, mai nèti sorga. nèngu ne dhu dènge koasa aa saraa dhu kapai, ho pasaraa palème rai-haha.

source_text: and he cried with a mighty voice, saying, fallen, fallen is babylon the great, and is become a habitation of demons, and a hold of every unclean spirit, and a hold of every unclean and hateful bird.
target_text: dènge lii aae, na peka, laho le! laho le! kota babel laho mae-mae le! guri le! guri le! kota kapai ne, guri dolu-dolu le! nèngu j'aj'i le era pea nidhu. nèngu j'aj'i le rai èta-èsu roh bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i. nèngu j'aj'i le era pakaboko nèti manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i dhu ra'a sisi hèu. nèngu j'aj'i le oka nèti badha aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu madenge.

source_text: for by the wine of the wrath of her fornication all the nations are fallen; and the kings of the earth committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth waxed rich by the power of her wantonness.
target_text: nèngu guri le, lula suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, loe boe mai rinu mahu èi anggor na. nèngu laho le, lula udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, loe boe mai ad'u-ue j'ara makae dènge ana kabarai kota ne. dhèu aae-dhèu aae nèti negara aa'i-aa'i, mai j'unu pa'èci ètu èèna. dhèu d'aga nèti kota aa'i-aa'i, mai pahia toke rèngu j'aj'i kaja. lula kota ne nuka sèmi dhèu bhèni dhu d'èi hèli mèdha dhu kab'ua aae. lula kota ne sama sèmi bhèni kajeo dhu d'èi dhoka tenge ngaa-ngaa dhu hua iia di.

source_text: and i heard another voice from heaven, saying, come forth, my people, out of her, that ye have no fellowship with her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues:
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi hari lii leo èci, paroa nèti dedha-liru, peka na, wee! dhèu ja'a aa'i-aa'i! rai eele ka era èèna! tèke eele ka kota èèna! baku tao madhutu bhabhelu ana kabarai kota ne, sèna ka baku lèke hahuku ra kahèi.

source_text: for her sins have reached even unto heaven, and god hath remembered her iniquities.
target_text: lula bhabhelu ra, ae seli eele. aa sasala ra, tanga-tanga d'ai dedha-liru. limuri ne ama lamatua bhèlu heka, j'ara mamuri ra dhu bhelu-katub'a èèna. limuri ne ama lamatua dhu pa'èra le, ho neo huku si.

source_text: render unto her even as she rendered, and double unto her the double according to her works: in the cup which she mingled, mingle unto her double.
target_text: de miu hud'i b'ala ku bhabhelu ra, sama sèmi rèngu tao le bhabhelu mi dhèu leo. te ngaa miu hud'i b'ala si, toke d'ai babia na dua-dua hari. uru èèna, rèngu tipu le dhèu, ho rinu nèti d'ara cangkir hualaa ra, dhu pènu dènge èi anggor j'aj'èra. te ngaa limuri ne rèngu mesa ra hud'i rinu ku anggor j'aj'èra èèna, toke dua-dua hari.

source_text: how much soever she glorified herself, and waxed wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning: for she saith in her heart, i sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall in no wise see mourning.
target_text: rèngu se tao ngi'u ra kapai. aa ra padedha-dedha ngi'u unu ra. rèngu d'èi dhoka mamuri karej'e-karae di. rèngu d'èi dhoka dhu be'a-be'a di. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hud'i abhu ku sasusa dhu bia. de rèngu hud'i mamuri j'èra bia ku. te uru èèna, ra padhai lii padedha iisi sama sèmi bhèni kajeo, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, ina bhèni aae! ja'a ne, èèna na j'aj'i boe bhèni balu! ja'a èèna na roma iisi boe. ja'a èèna na silu boe mèdha balu dhèu madhe. '

source_text: therefore in one day shall her plagues come, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire; for strong is the lord god who judged her.
target_text: ra padhai lii sèmi èèna, toke ama lamatua nasa le dènge ra. ka ama lamatua neo huku si. èèna na, d'ara ca lod'o di, rèngu manganga titu kèna, rèngu tangi roma iisi, aa ra madhe aapa. toke dhèu core eele si asa d'ara ai. toke ai na'e pakèpu ngi'u aae si. te lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi, ka dhu papuru huku ne. aa lamatua dhu èra risi eele, dhu pama'ète lii langu ne.

source_text: and the kings of the earth, who committed fornication and lived wantonly with her, shall weep and wail over her, when they look upon the smoke of her burning,
target_text: dhèu aae-dhèu aae uru sa, mai j'unu pa'èci dènge ana kabarai kota ne, aa mamuri karej'e-karae ètu èèna. pe ladhe rèdhi sèb'u dhu ca'e nèti d'ara ai, pe re'a, na, kota ne dhu ai na'e aa'i le. ka ra tangi ne dènge d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, woe, woe, the great city, babylon, the strong city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.
target_text: ka ra mangingi, ladhe j'aj'èra dhèu sèra. te ngaa ra bani dhoka titu ètu kaj'èu di. aa rèngu bani dhoka laladhe nèti nèi di. hèia ra padhai lii, peka na, ‘ira ii! kasian èu babel! ira ii! kasian kota kapai! te dhoka d'ara ca jam di, èu abhu huku le. te dhoka d'ara ciki oo'e di, èu laho le. '

source_text: and the merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no man buyeth their merchandise any more;
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, dhèu-dhèu dhu uru sèra, mai nèti mia-mia ho d'aga ètu èèna, rèngu tangi roma iisi kahèi. te abhu boe ca dhèu sa, dhu neo lasi hèli mèdha d'aga ra.

source_text: merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stone, and pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet; and all thyine wood, and every vessel of ivory, and every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;
target_text: abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli mèdha ra dhu tao nèti hualaa, doi pudhi, hadhu kale'e, do mutiara. abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli bèla lenan, do bèla sutra rèngu, do bèla alus dhu leo, dhu mea oe sèmi mangèru sa. abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli mèdha ra dhu tao nèti aj'u hèu mèngi, aa mèdha dhu d'ule nèti èli gajah, do aj'u dhu d'ule dhu leo sèra. abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli mèdha ra dhu tao nèti tabaga, bèsi, do hadhu marmar.

source_text: and cinnamon, and spice, and incense, and ointment, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and cattle, and sheep; and merchandise of horses and chariots and slaves; and souls of men.
target_text: abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli kayu manis, do bubhu lara dhu leo sèra. abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli raa aj'u hèu mèngi ra, do èi hèu mèngi dhu leo sèra. abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli èi anggor ra, èi mènyi saitun ra, tarigu, do are-gandum ra. abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli sapi ra, kahib'i-kalèbho ra, do jara ra. abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli kareta mèdha ra, do ènu ra sèra.

source_text: and the fruits which thy soul lusted after are gone from thee, and all things that were dainty and sumptuous are perished from thee, and men shall find them no more at all.
target_text: èèna na dhèu d'aga sèra manyasa, ka ra peka na, ‘ira ii, babel, ee! ira ii, kota kapai, ee! mèdha-panyau èu dhu hua iia sèra, dhu kabarai èu d'èi risi, aad'o heka èci sa. aa'i-aa'i ra ela aa'i mèu-mèu, toke kabarai èu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, toke rod'o kakara d'ai rai. '

source_text: the merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning;
target_text: uru èèna, dhèu d'aga se j'aj'i kaja, lula kota ne dhu nuka sèmi bhèni kajeo. te ngaa limuri ne, ra loe boe manyasa. rèngu j'aj'i madha'u titu kèna, laladhe j'aj'èra ana kabarai kota ne. rèngu j'aj'i mangingi titu kèna, laladhe hahuku ra. te ngaa rèngu dhoka bani laladhe nèti kaj'èu di. rèngu bani dhoka titu nèti era nèi di.

source_text: saying, woe, woe, the great city, she that was arrayed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stone and pearl!
target_text: hèia ra padhai lii, peka na, ‘ira ii! kasian èu babel, ee! ira ii! kasian kota kapai, ee! uru èèna, ana kabarai èu pake mèdha bèla alus, dhu mea oe sèmi mangèru sa, nèti bèla dhu kab'ua titu kèna. uru èèna, ana kabarai èu d'èi panèu mèdha hualaa, mutiara, dènge hadhu kale'e dhu kab'ua titu kèna.

source_text: for in one hour so great riches is made desolate. and every shipmaster, and every one that saileth any whither, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood afar off,
target_text: te ngaa d'ara ca jam di, mèdha-panyau èu sèra èla aa'i mèu-mèu si. dhodhoka d'ara ciki oo'e èèna di, kakaja èu saku hani-hani! ' uru èèna juraga kapa, dènge mataroo sèra, kako lasi-mai nèti kota èèna. te ngaa limuri ne, rèngu bani dhodhoka panahu nèti kaj'èu di. te ngaa limuri ne rèngu bani dhoka laladhe nèti nèi di.

source_text: and cried out as they looked upon the smoke of her burning, saying, what city is like the great city?
target_text: rèngu ladhe sèb'u kalua nèti d'ara ai èèna. ka re'a, na, ai na'e aa'i le. hèia ra manyasa, ka peka na, ‘ira ii, kasian! abhu heka kota leo dhu kapai sèmi kota babel ne. aduu, kasian! abhu heka kota dhu leo, dhu babe'a na sama sèmi nèngu ne. '

source_text: and they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, woe, woe, the great city, wherein all that had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.
target_text: rèngu soke ahu ho ceb'e mi kètu ra, lula d'ara ra susa. rèngu tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula d'ara ra laho mae-mae. ka ra peka na, ‘ira ii! kasian èu babel, ee! ira ii! kasian kota kapai! ji'i dènge kapa la'a-mai ngèti mèdha hia kabarai èu, toke ji'i d'ai kaja-su'i kahèi. ji'i hua ngèti le mèdha kabarai èu, toke ji'i mamuri hua iia kahèi. te ngaa dhoka d'ara ca jam di, aa'i-aa'i se saku hani-hani. te ngaa dhoka ètu d'ara ciki oo'e di, laho aa'i si mèu-mèu. '

source_text: rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye saints, and ye apostles, and ye prophets; for god hath judged your judgment on her.
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi lii aae èci peka tabha hari, sèmi ne'e ka: ‘he, miu dhu mamuri ètu sorga! miu parluu heka d'ara pèd'a. he, miu dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua! d'ara miu parluu heka susa. miu dhu j'aj'i le dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, hud'i laa d'ara miu karae. miu dhu j'aj'i le dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, hud'i laa d'ara miu maho'o. uru èèna, babel pasusa le miu. uru èèna, kabarai kota ne paj'èra miu. te ngaa limuri ne lamatua pama'ète le lii langu miu dènge mola. te limuri ne na b'ala le bhabhelu-katub'a kabarai kota èèna. '

source_text: and a strong angel took up a stone as it were a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, thus with a mighty fall shall babylon, the great city, be cast down, and shall be found no more at all.
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu èci nèti sorga dhu èra titu kèna. na mai ded'e nare hadhu aae cue, dhu kapai na sange dhèu èci. hèia na pèci hadhu ne asa d'ara dhasi. ka na peka, pe ra palaho eele babel sèmi èèna kahèi. pe ra pa'ele kota kapai èèna, sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and the voice of harpers and minstrels and flute-players and trumpeters shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft, shall be found any more at all in thee; and the voice of a mill shall be heard no more at all in thee;
target_text: abhu heka ca dhèu sa, dhu karihu musiik ètu d'ara kota èèna. abhu heka dhèu, dhu tadèngi lii gai sasadhu, tiu sakino, aa lii tiu tèbhe ètu d'ara kota èèna. abhu heka tuka èci sa, dhu sab'a ètu d'ara sab'a-la'a ra. abhu heka dhèu, dhu gili are ètu kota èèna.

source_text: and the light of a lamp shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the princes of the earth; for with thy sorcery were all the nations deceived.
target_text: abhu heka dhèu, dhu paheo labhu ètu d'ara kota èèna. abhu heka dhèu, dhu tao pesta kab'i ètu èèna. uru èèna, ètu kota ne, dhèu pahia-pahèli mèdha ra, toke j'aj'i kaja-su'i. uru èèna, dhèu d'aga ètu babel, mamuri hua iia. te ngaa rèngu pake na'i nidhu, ho leko-monya dhèu ètu rai-haha. rèngu pake seher, ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and in her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all that have been slain upon the earth.
target_text: babel abhu le huku dhu bia, lula kabarai na loe boe pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. kota kapai ne laho le, lula kabarai na paj'èra toke madhe dhèu unu lamatua. abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu lamatua dhu ra pamadhe ètu era-era leo. te ngaa babel ka dhu hud'i dui nare sasala sèra. kota kapai èèna ka dhu hud'i tago nare aa'i.

source_text: after these things i heard as it were a great voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, hallelujah; salvation, and glory, and power, belong to our god:
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ne padhai lii nare, ka ja'a tadèngi lii dhèu ae-ae sod'a ètu sorga. ra sod'a, peka na, haleluya! haleluya! èdhi koa-kio ama lamatua èdhi, lula nèngu ka dhu dedha risi eele. haleluya! haleluya! èdhi koa-kio ama lamatua èdhi, lula nèngu ka dhu koasa kapai risi. lamatua ka dhu patabuli èdhi, nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. lamatua ka dhu pamèci èdhi, nèti sasala-sasala èdhi.

source_text: for true and righteous are his judgments; for he hath judged the great harlot, her that corrupted the earth with her fornication, and he hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.
target_text: èdhi koa-kio ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu pama'ète lii langu dènge mola. èdhi koa-kio ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu hia hahuku dhu lèke. lamatua dhu huku le bhèni kajeo èèna, lula nèngu ka dhu dadugu dhèu ètu rai-haha, sèna ka madhutu tao j'ara makae sama-sama dènge ne, aa madhutu bhabhelu na. lamatua b'ala le bhèni aapa èèna, lula nèngu loe boe pamadhe ana pua-paleha lamatua.

source_text: and a second time they say, hallelujah. and her smoke goeth up for ever and ever.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra sod'a lii sod'a leo hari ètu sorga, peka na, haleluya! koa-kio lamatua! haleluya! j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na! lula sèb'u ai dhu tunu pakèpu ngi'u aae bhèni èèna, ca'e taruu dhu loe boe ciki sa. aa sèb'u nèti ai dhu tunu eele kota kapai èèna, ca'e taruu dhu loe boe ciki sa.

source_text: and the four and twenty elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshipped god that sitteth on the throne, saying, amen; hallelujah.
target_text: hèia dua nguru èpa katua, dènge badha aae èpa ngi'u sèra, patitu kètu urutuu, ho pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha na. ra pakab'ua ne, peka na, tare'a sèmi èèna! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! haleluya! mai ti j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na!

source_text: and a voice came forth from the throne, saying, give praise to our god, all ye his servants, ye that fear him, the small and the great.
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi hari lii èci dhu mai nèti kadera paredha èèna, peka na, he, miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu j'aj'i le ana pua-paleha ama lamatua! he, miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua! mai sèna ka ti j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua. mai aa'i-aa'i, ana iiki-dhèu kapai, koa-kio ne.

source_text: and i heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunders, saying, hallelujah: for the lord our god, the almighty, reigneth.
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi oe sèmi dhèu ae-ae dhu padhai lii. lii ra mèdhu nuka sèmi lii èi dhu hae nèti kolo ledhe, aa dou sèmi lii d'oro, ra peka na, haleluya! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua. haleluya! ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na. lula nèngu ka dhu koasa kapai risi. aa nèngu ka dhu paredha aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: let us rejoice and be exceeding glad, and let us give the glory unto him: for the marriage of the lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
target_text: limuri ne, d'ara èdhi karej'e le. limuri ne, d'ara èdhi kea rae-rae. èdhi koa-kio ne. lula d'ai le lod'o kab'i ana kalèbho kèna. èdhi j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na, lula bhèni dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu èmu ana kalèbho, dhu pa'èra le.

source_text: and it was given unto her that she should array herself in fine linen, bright and pure: for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.
target_text: ama lamatua hia ne kodho kab'i na nèti bèla alus. ama lamatua pangèd'u na mèdha-papake dhu pudhi kale'e. mèdha-papake dhu pudhi kale'e èèna, sasoa na, tatao dhu be'a nèti dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: and he saith unto me, write, blessed are they that are bidden to the marriage supper of the lamb. and he saith unto me, these are true words of god.
target_text: ka ana pajuu nèti sorga èèna, peka dènge ja'a, na, yohanis! èu hud'i suri more ku, sèmi ne'e: ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu abhu nèru ho mai asa pesta kab'i ana kalèbho ne, rèngu oto tare'a-re'a! ' hèia na peka hari dènge ja'a, lii holo-nori ama lamatua ne, lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: and i fell down before his feet to worship him. and he saith unto me, see thou do it not: i am a fellow-servant with thee and with thy brethren that hold the testimony of jesus: worship god: for the testimony of jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
target_text: ka ja'a patitu kètu urutuu ho neo pahaha iisi mi ana pajuu ne. te ngaa na kai, peka na, èu baku tao sèmi ne'e! te ja'a ne ènu ama lamatua, èci èèna dènge èu ne, aa sama sèmi a'ari èu dhu lasi peka-padhai lii aj'a-nori yesus. te dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua peka-padhai lula-nèti yesus kahèi, sèna ka dhèu pahaha iisi mi nèngu. te naneo roh ama lamatua sèmi èèna. de baku pahaha iisi mi ja'a ne. te ngaa pahaha iisi dhoka mi ama lamatua di.

source_text: and i saw the heaven opened; and behold, a white horse, and he that sat thereon called faithful and true; and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.
target_text: hèia ja'a doa kètu, ka ladhe kèdhi babèdho sorga dhu bhoke tèke. cag'ag'a laa, ja'a kèdhi jara pudhi ci'u kalua mai. dhèu dhu manya'e na, ngara na dhèu dhu kèpe pa'èra lii pajaji aa dhèu dhu mola. lod'o na parisa lii langu, na pama'ète dènge mola. ladhe nèngu la'e pamusu, la'e dènge d'ara mola.

source_text: and his eyes are a flame of fire, and upon his head are many diadems; and he hath a name written which no one knoweth but he himself.
target_text: musi madha na heo sama sèmi ai. na pake solo dhèu aae dhu ae, ètu kètu na. ngara na dhu suri ètu ngi'u na, te ngaa nèngu mesa na di, dhu ne'a sasoa ngara èèna.

source_text: and he is arrayed in a garment sprinkled with blood: and his name is called the word of god.
target_text: mèdha-papake na, dhu cèb'u le asa d'ara raa. dhèu paroa ne, lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: and the armies which are in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and pure.
target_text: ja'a kèdhi kahèi sordad'u-sordad'u nèti sorga dhu manya'e jara pudhi, dhu madhutu ne. sordad'u se pake mèdha alus dhu pudhi mèu kahèi.

source_text: and out of his mouth proceedeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness of the wrath of god, the almighty.
target_text: abhu samala èci dhu madèka, kalua nèti d'ara hèb'a na. na pake samala ne, ho la'e pamusu, lab'a suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. hèia na segi si. ka na j'aj'i dhèu aae rèngu. na paredha si dènge ai bèsi, toke rèngu re'a nanasa lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi. j'ara ne'e ne, sama sèmi dhèu j'èli marèu hua anggor, ho pacèli rare èi na.

source_text: and he hath on his garment and on his thigh a name written, king of kings, and lord of lords.
target_text: aa ètu kodho dènge ètu haree na, dhu suri sèmi ne'e: dhèu aae nèti dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ra, lamatua nèti lamatua aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and i saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in mid heaven, come and be gathered together unto the great supper of god;
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu ca dhèu nèti sorga dhu titu ètu dedha madha lod'o. hèia na rodhe manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i dhu lela re talora liru, peka na, mai aa'i-aa'i mi pakaboko mi era ne'e, ho mi'a pesta kapai dhu ama lamatua tao!

source_text: that ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of them that sit thereon, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, and small and great.
target_text: sisi dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i ra, miu bisa mi'a. nuka sisi nèti: dhèu aae-dhèu aae, komedhaa, dènge sordad'u sèra. miu mi'a kahèi sisi jara dènge sisi sordad'u dhu manya'e si. miu mi'a kahèi sisi ènu-ènu, do dhèu mardeka, do ana iiki-dhèu kapai. peka ka laa, ngara na ngaa dhu dènge sisi, mi'e si.

source_text: and i saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat upon the horse, and against his army.
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi badha bhelu dhu uru èèna bodho nèti d'ara dhasi. la'e pane'a lii dènge dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, dènge sordad'u ra. ka lasi pamusu, lab'a dhèu dhu manya'e jara pudhi èèna, dènge sordad'u dhu palere-lere dènge ne nèti sorga.

source_text: and the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought the signs in his sight, wherewith he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast and them that worshipped his image: they two were cast alive into the lake of fire that burneth with brimstone:
target_text: te ngaa dhèu manya'e jara pudhi ne, kèpe nare badha bhelu dènge dhèu nèti lii padhai na dhu kapod'e-kabèli sèra. dhèu dhu nèti padhai lii na, nuka dhèu dhu tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa ho leko-monya dhèu, dhu ra sèmi rare cap nèti badha bhelu ne, aa sogo-tagu mèdha sogo-tagu na. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu dhu manya'e jara pudhi ne, pèci eele le badha bhelu dènge dhèu dhu nèti lii padhai na, asa d'ara dhasi ai èi nasu dhu heo na madhe boe.

source_text: and the rest were killed with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, even the sword which came forth out of his mouth: and all the birds were filled with their flesh.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu dhu manya'e jara pudhi ne, la'e pamadhe aa'i sordad'u dhu leo sèra, pake dènge samala dhu kalua nèti d'ara hèb'a na. hèia manu-bhui dhu ra'a sisi hèu, mai ra'e aa'i ngi'u aae dhèu madhe sèra.

source_text: and i saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu èci nèti sorga puru mai nèti dedha-liru. na kèpe dènge rate aae èci, aa nèd'u dènge gagoe nèti ro'a j'aj'èra dhu dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: and he laid hold on the dragon, the old serpent, which is the devil and satan, and bound him for a thousand years,
target_text: ka na la'e kèpe mege naga, nuka dhèu aae nidhu, dhu ra peka na, lamatua nidhu. nèngu ne'e ka dhu leko-monya dhèu rai-haha karèi nèti uru ka mai. hèia ana pajuu ne èki mege naga ne dènge rate, ho taha ne ètu d'ara ro'a j'aj'èra dhu dènge boe lane èèna, toke ca riho tèu.

source_text: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it, and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more, until the thousand years should be finished: after this he must be loosed for a little time.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ne tule eele mege naga na asa d'ara ro'a j'aj'èra èèna. ka na segel pamadhe hèb'a ro'a èèna, sèna ka taha mege naga ne ètu d'ara ro'a, toke èle ca riho tèu. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, mege naga ne bisa heka leko-monya suku-suku ètu rai-haha ne, ètu d'ara ca riho tèu. èle èèna ka, heka patabuli ne kèna, te ngaa nare boe nèbhu.

source_text: and i saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and i saw the souls of them that had been beheaded for the testimony of jesus, and for the word of god, and such as worshipped not the beast, neither his image, and received not the mark upon their forehead and upon their hand; and they lived, and reigned with christ a thousand years.
target_text: èle ka, ja'a kèdhi kadera paredha ae-ae, dènge dhèu madhèdi ètu dedha. ama lamatua dhu ded'e si j'aj'i hakim. rèngu se dhu uru èèna lasi lole lii lolo be'a nèti yesus, dènge lii holo-nori ama lamatua, toke dhèu pamadhe si. rèngu se ka dhu sogo-tagu boe badha bhelu dènge mèdha sogo-tagu na. rèngu se dhu ro'o boe sèmi cap nèti badha bhelu ne ètu katangarèi ra, do ètu kacui-aai ra. dhèu pamadhe si, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari si, sèna ka ra rèd'u paredha bera-bera dènge kristus toke ca riho tèu.

source_text: the rest of the dead lived not until the thousand years should be finished. this is the first resurrection. blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: over these the second death hath no power; but they shall be priests of god and of christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
target_text: dènge sèmi ne'e, rèngu se'e ka dhu uru j'ara ama lamatua pamamuri hari si nèti mamadhe. de rèngu oto titu kèna, te rèngu j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua. ra core boe si asa era j'aj'èra èèna, ka ra abhu boe mamadhe ka dua. te rèngu se nuka sèmi ama agama dhu bèli-camèd'a lalau-lalo'o ama lamatua dènge kristus. aa rèngu rèd'u paredha kahèi bera-bera dènge kristus toke d'ai ca riho tèu. te ngaa dhèu madhe dhu leo sèra, hud'i mate ku d'ai ca riho tèu, heka ama lamatua pamamuri hari si kèna.

source_text: and when the thousand years are finished, satan shall be loosed out of his prison,
target_text: ropa èle ca riho tèu ku, pe lamatua pua patalale mege naga nèti d'ara ro'a j'aj'èra.

source_text: and shall come forth to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, gog and magog, to gather them together to the war: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.
target_text: hèia la'e leko-monya dhèu nèti suku-suku dhu ra peka na, gog dènge magog, dhu mai nèti mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne. pe na pakaboko dhèu ra ho lasi pamusu. dhèu se ae titu kèna, sama sèmi salae ètu nebhe dhasi.

source_text: and they went up over the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down out of heaven, and devoured them.
target_text: hèia sordad'u gog dènge magog kako lasi kaj'èu d'ai rae-rae ètu d'ara rai-haha. ka ra reo rare kota lamatua dènge dhèu dhu na sue sèra. te ngaa ama lamatua papuru ai nèti dedha-liru ka na'a pakèpu aa'i sordad'u se'e.

source_text: and the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where are also the beast and the false prophet; and they shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
target_text: ka dhèu unu lamatua sèra kèpe rare dhèu aae nidhu dhu kapod'e nare le dhèu ae. hèia ra core ne asa d'ara dhasi ai èi nasu, dhu heo na loe boe. èèna na, ra bèdho tèke ne sama-sama dènge badha bhelu, aa dènge dhèu nèti lii padhai kapod'e-kabèli èèna. ètu era ne'e, rèngu abhu j'aj'èra loe boe mèu-mèda toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and i saw a great white throne, and him that sat upon it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a ladhe kèdhi kadera paredha pudhi aae cue. aa ama lamatua ka dhu madhèdi ètu kadera èèna. cag'ag'a laa, rai-haha dènge liru, rai pakaj'èu ka ele aa'i si toke tèdhi heka senu-salao sa hèi.

source_text: and i saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne; and books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.
target_text: ka ladhe kèdhi dhèu dhu madhe sèra. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ana iiki-dhèu kapai, titu tangara asa kadera paredha. hèia ana pajuu nèti sorga mai, ka bhoke sasuri-sasuri dhu suri tatao aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu rai-haha ad'u-ue. ka ra bhoke hari sasuri leo èci, dhu suri ngara-ngara dhèu dhu bèli-camèd'a mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua. hèia na pama'ète lii langu nèti dhèu madhe, madhutu ngaa dhu rèngu èci-èci ad'u-ue, nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri sèra.

source_text: and the sea gave up the dead that were in it; and death and hades gave up the dead that were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.
target_text: ka dhèu madhe sèra mai titu patangara dènge kadera paredha èèna. rèngu se aa'i-aa'i dhu madhe le ètu rai-dedha dènge ètu d'ara dhasi. hèia ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu rèngu èci-èci, madhutu tatao ra.

source_text: and death and hades were cast into the lake of fire. this is the second death, even the lake of fire.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua pèci eele mamadhe asa d'ara dhasi ai. aa na core eele kahèi era pea samanga dhèu madhe asa d'ara dhasi ai. te dhasi ai ne, era mamadhe ka dua.

source_text: and if any was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.
target_text: dhèu dhu ngara ra suri boe ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e, lèke core kahèi asa d'ara dhasi ai. te sasuri èèna, nuka dhu suri ngara-ngara dhèu dhu mamuri dènge ama lamatua taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: and i saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth are passed away; and the sea is no more.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi liru dènge rai-haha rupa hiu, te liru dènge rai-haha dhu dhui ele aa'i le. dhasi aad'o heka kahèi.

source_text: and i saw the holy city, new jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from god, made ready as a bride adorned for her husband.
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi kota mola-mèci unu ama lamatua, nuka yerusalem hiu, puru mai nèti sorga. kota ne, dhu pa'èra mema, sama sèmi bhèni dhu neo leo-èmu hiu, dhu lalau nare le iisi, ho la'e soru mone dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu èmu na.

source_text: and i heard a great voice out of the throne saying, behold, the tabernacle of god is with men, and he shall dwell with them, and they shall be his peoples, and god himself shall be with them, and be their god:
target_text: ka ja'a tadèngi lii dhu kapai èci mai nèti kadera paredha ne, peka na, ladhe paie-iie! karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, èmu ama lamatua ètu talora aae dhèu rai-haha. karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, lamatua mamuri pa'èci dènge dhèu unu na. te nèngu j'aj'i le ama lamatua ra. aa rèngu j'aj'i le ana-ana na. bèli-camèd'a nèngu bera-bera dènge ra. aa na palere-lere dènge rèngu taa-taa.

source_text: and he shall wipe away every tear from their eyes; and death shall be no more; neither shall there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more: the first things are passed away.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a na seka pamango èi madha aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka rèngu roma iisi heka. lula ètu era èèna, abhu heka papèd'a-tarègu. aa ètu era èèna, abhu heka mamadhe. ngaa-ngaa dhu uru èèna rèti sasusa, aad'o heka èci sa. ngaa-ngaa dhu uru èèna rèti j'aj'èra, ele aa'i si le.

source_text: and he that sitteth on the throne said, behold, i make all things new. and he saith, write: for these words are faithful and true.
target_text: hèia nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha èèna, peka na, ladhe paie-iie, te ja'a tao pahiu aa'i le. ka na padhai lii hari dènge ja'a, peka na, suri ka! dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parcaya lii holo-nori ja'a ne, te aa'i-aa'i se mema lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: and he said unto me, they are come to pass. i am the alpha and the omega, the beginning and the end. i will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
target_text: ka na peka hari dènge ja'a, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a pajaji sèra, j'aj'i aa'i le. te ja'a ne, alpa toke omega, aa ja'a ne, a toke z, aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru ka, toke d'ai èle. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu koko-kamango, pe ja'a hia ra rinu iia-iia d'ara, nèti madha èi dhu nèti mamuri hia dhèu, sèna ka dhèu sèra bisa mamuri dènge tare'a.

source_text: he that overcometh shall inherit these things; and i will be his god, and he shall be my son.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu taha madhutu j'ara lamatua dhu mola, bèli-camèd'a rèngu unu mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i ra. pe ja'a j'aj'i ama lamatua ra, aa rèngu j'aj'i ana-ana ja'a.

source_text: but for the fearful, and unbelieving, and abominable, and murderers, and fornicators, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, their part shall be in the lake that burneth with fire and brimstone; which is the second death.
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu dhu èèna na lèke core si, asa d'ara dhasi ai èi nasu dhu heo na ma'ète boe ciki sa. nuka sèmi: dhèu dhu madha'u leli, dhèu dhu soro kabodho mi lamatua yesus, dhèu d'ara kaj'alu, dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, dhèu pamadhe dhèu, dhèu sogo-tagu nidhu, dhèu suagi, aa dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. bèli-camèd'a rèngu aa'i-aa'i lèke pèci asa d'ara dhasi ai, dhu ra peka na, ‘era mamadhe ka dua. '

source_text: and there came one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls, who were laden with the seven last plagues; and he spake with me, saying, come hither, i will show thee the bride, the wife of the lamb.
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi ca dhèu nèti ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga, dhu uru èèna rèd'u bokor dhu isi dènge nanasa lamatua. na mai paraga dènge ja'a, ka na lii, peka na, mai ku sa ne'e! te ja'a neo pad'elo dènge èu bhèni dhu neo kab'i dènge ana kalèbho.

source_text: and he carried me away in the spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the holy city jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from god,
target_text: hèia ja'a abhu roh lamatua, ka ana pajuu ca dhèu nèti sorga mai nedhe nèti ja'a asa kolo ledhe dhu dedha aae èci. nèti era ne'e, na pad'elo ja'a kota yerusalem, nuka kota ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, dhu puru mai nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: having the glory of god: her light was like unto a stone most precious, as it were a jasper stone, clear as crystal:
target_text: kota ne saraga titu kèna! abhu saraa dhu kalua nèti dadedha ama lamatua sèmi hadhu intan dhu kale'e, toke kota aa'i-aa'i heo lo'a-lo'a.

source_text: having a wall great and high; having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels; and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of israel:
target_text: abhu tedhe dhu dedha aae oke nare kota ne, dènge canguru dua babèdho. abhu kahèi canguru dua ana pajuu nèti sorga dhu madhenge babèdho kapai se. ètu canguru dua babèdho se, dhu suri ngara-ngara nèti canguru dua udhu-rasa isra'el.

source_text: on the east were three gates; and on the north three gates; and on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
target_text: tèlu babèdho tangara asa dhimu. tèlu tangara asa haa. tèlu tangara asa badae. aa tèlu hari tangara asa balèu.

source_text: and the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve apostles of the lamb.
target_text: tedhe ne dhu patitu ètu canguru dua hadhu fanderen dhu kapai. ètu hadhu se èci-èci dhu suri ngara nèti canguru dua dhèu pajuu-paleha ana kalèbho dhu lalau-lalo'o ne ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and he that spake with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu padhai lii dènge ja'a, kèpe nare tatea a'uku nèti hualaa èci, ho neo uku kota ne dènge hèb'a babèdho kapai, aa dènge tedhe na.

source_text: and the city lieth foursquare, and the length thereof is as great as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs: the length and the breadth and the height thereof are equal.
target_text: na uku uru tedhe kota. madhera, bhabhèla dènge katitu na, èci èèna ka. nuka, aa'i-aa'i ra, 2. dua riho dua ngasu dua nguru kilometer.

source_text: and he measured the wall thereof, a hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.
target_text: hèia na uku ma'aa tedhe, madhutu a'uku dhèu rai-haha. ma'aa na, èna nguru lèmi meter.

source_text: and the building of the wall thereof was jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto pure glass.
target_text: tedhe ne, tao nèti hadhu kale'e, ngara na yaspis. aa aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara kota ne, tao nèti poe dènge pai, dhu mèu aadha-aadha nuka sèmi tèru.

source_text: the foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with all manner of precious stones. the first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;
target_text: canguru dua hadhu fanderen sèra, tao nèti rupa-rupa hadhu kale'e dhu kab'ua. fanderen ka èci, tao nèti hadhu yaspis, dhu mangèru kale'e. ka dua, nèti hadhu nilam dhu kale'e mangèru bhidhu-bhidhu. ka tèlu, tao nèti hadhu mirah dhu mea kale'e. ka èpa, tao nèti hadhu samrud, dhu mangèru kale'e.

source_text: the fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprase; the eleventh, jacinth; the twelfth, amethyst.
target_text: ka lèmi, tao nèti hadhu unam dhu pakatanga dènge karara mea sanama pudhi. ka èna, dhu tao nèti hadhu sardius, dhu mea kale'e. ka pidhu, tao nèti ratna cempaka dhu karara hualaa. ka aru, dhu tao nèti hadhu beril, dhu kale'e mangèru aae. ka ceo, tao nèti hadhu krisolit, dhu karara moce-moce. ka canguru, tao nèti hadhu krisopras dhu mangèru mud'a. ka canguru èci, tao nèti hadhu lasuardi, dhu mangèru dhasi. aa ka canguru dua, tao nèti hadhu kecubung, dhu kale'e mea sanama mangèru.

source_text: and the twelve gates were twelve pearls; each one of the several gates was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
target_text: aa babèdho kapai canguru dua bua sèra, tao nèti canguru bua mutiara. babèdho èci tao nèti mutiara cue. j'ara oka-hoo ètu d'ara kota ne, tao nèti poe-pai dhu kale'e sèmi tèru.

source_text: and i saw no temple therein: for the lord god the almighty, and the lamb, are the temple thereof.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a kèdhi boe èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara kota ne. lula ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi dènge ana kalèbho pea taa-taa ètu d'ara kota ne. nèti èèna ka, dhèu pahaha iisi mema mi rèngu.

source_text: and the city hath no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine upon it: for the glory of god did lighten it, and the lamp thereof is the lamb.
target_text: kota èèna, parluu boe madha lod'o dènge hèru ho pasaraa ne, lula saraa ama lamatua ka dhu pasaraa ne. aa ana kalèbho ne j'aj'i nuka sèmi labhu dhu heo.

source_text: and the nations shall walk amidst the light thereof: and the kings of the earth bring their glory into it.
target_text: dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, èèna na kako lasi mai ètu d'ara saraa èèna. dhèu aae-dhèu aae nèti rai-haha, rèti kakaja-sasu'i ra asa nèi kahèi.

source_text: and the gates thereof shall in no wise be shut by day for there shall be no night there:
target_text: ètu era nèi, abhu boe mèda. nèti èèna ka, parluu boe bèdho hèb'a tedhe.

source_text: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it:
target_text: pe asa d'ara kota ne, dhèu rèti aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a kahèi, dènge hormat aa'i-aa'i nèti rai-rai ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and there shall in no wise enter into it anything unclean, or he that maketh an abomination and a lie: but only they that are written in the lamb's book of life.
target_text: te ngaa dhu bisa boe maso asa nèi, nuka aa'i-aa'i dhu karehe, nuka sèmi: dhèu sogo-tagu nidhu, dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae, dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. dhu bisa maso, nuka rèngu dhu ngara ra abhu ètu d'ara sasuri ana kalèbho. rèngu se'e ka dhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: and he showed me a river of water of life, bright as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of god and of the lamb,
target_text: èle ka ana pajuu nèti sorga pad'elo dènge ja'a loko èci, dhu èi ne nèti mamuri. èi ne mèu aadha-aadha nuka sèmi tèru. na hae mai nèti kadera paredha ama lamatua dènge ana kalèbho.

source_text: in the midst of the street thereof. and on this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve manner of fruits, yielding its fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
target_text: hèia hae la'e asa talora aae j'ara oka-hoo ètu d'ara kota ne. nèti sebhe-sebhe loko ne, abhu aj'u dhu hua na nèti mamuri. aj'u ne d'ara ca tèu, hua canguru dua hari; ca hèru, ca tèka. rèu na bisa j'aj'i èi na'i ho puri-pa'èle suku-suku ètu rai-haha nèti papèd'a ra.

source_text: and there shall be no curse any more: and the throne of god and of the lamb shall be therein: and his servants shall serve him;
target_text: te ngaa rèngu dhu ama lamatua tule eele aa dhoo si, abhu boe ètu d'ara kota ne. dhu ètu ne'e, nuka ama lamatua dènge ana kalèbho dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha, aa dènge ana pua-paleha ra dhu pahaha iisi mi rèngu.

source_text: and they shall see his face; and his name shall be on their foreheads.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i bisa ladhe rèdhi rèhu ama lamatua. ètu katangarèi dhèu se'e, dhu suri ngara lamatua.

source_text: and there shall be night no more; and they need no light of lamp, neither light of sun; for the lord god shall give them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
target_text: mèda abhu boe ètu kota ne'e. de dhèu unu lamatua parluu boe madha lod'o, do labhu, lula ama lamatua ka dhu pasaraa kota ne. bèli-camèd'a rèngu sama-sama rèd'u paredha toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: and he said unto me, these words are faithful and true: and the lord, the god of the spirits of the prophets, sent his angel to show unto his servants the things which must shortly come to pass.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ne peka dènge ja'a, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a peka kore dènge èu se'e, lèke tare'a-re'a. dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parcaya lii ja'a se. uru èèna, ama lamatua pake roh na ho peka-padhai lii holo-nori na mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na. te ngaa limuri ne, na pake ana pajuu na nèti sorga ho lole mi dhèu unu na, lula-nèti j'ara aa'i-aa'i se dhu nèbhu heka hud'i j'aj'i ku.

source_text: and behold, i come quickly. blessed is he that keepeth the words of the prophecy of this book.
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii, peka na, sanèd'e paie-iie! nèbhu heka, te ja'a neo mai. ètu d'ara sasuri ne, dhu suri aa'i mèu-mèu le, ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu isi sasuri ne, pe rèngu abhu a'oto.

source_text: and i john am he that heard and saw these things. and when i heard and saw, i fell down to worship before the feet of the angel that showed me these things.
target_text: dhu suri sasuri ne, nuka ja'a, yohanis. aa'i-aa'i se ja'a nanene dènge ro'a dhilu ja'a, aa kèdhi dènge musi madha ja'a. ropa tadèngi kore, hèia ja'a patitu kètu urutuu ho pahaha iisi ètu madha ana pajuu nèti sorga ne, dhu pad'elo le aa'i-aa'i se mi ja'a.

source_text: and he saith unto me, see thou do it not: i am a fellow-servant with thee and with thy brethren the prophets, and with them that keep the words of this book: worship god.
target_text: te ngaa na kai ja'a, peka na, ee! èu baku tao sèmi èèna! èu dhodhoka pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua di! baku mi ja'a ne. te ja'a ne ènu lamatua kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge èu dènge a'ari èu dhu j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai na, aa dènge dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i ra dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e.

source_text: and he saith unto me, seal not up the words of the prophecy of this book; for the time is at hand.
target_text: èu baku pahuni isi sasuri ne dènge dhèu leo. te nèbhu heka, aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne, hud'i j'aj'i ku.

source_text: he that is unrighteous, let him do unrighteousness still: and he that is filthy, let him be made filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him do righteousness still: and he that is holy, let him be made holy still.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu, na, hud'i rèngu sène ra tao kaj'alu taruu. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri mola-mèci, hud'i laa ra mamuri mola taruu. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao karehe, hud'i rèngu sène ra tao bhelu taruu. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu tao be'a, hud'i laa ra tao taruu dhu be'a.

source_text: behold, i come quickly; and my reward is with me, to render to each man according as his work is.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lii hari, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e paie! te nèbhu heka, ja'a dhiu. pe ja'a b'ala hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i, madhutu ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue.

source_text: i am the alpha and the omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
target_text: ja'a ne, alpa toke omega. ja'a ne, a toke z. aa'i-aa'i j'aj'aj'i ra nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru, toke d'ai èle.

source_text: blessed are they that wash their robes, that they may have the right to come to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.
target_text: dhèu dhu rase pamèu le mèdha-papake ra, rèngu ka dhu oto. te rèngu ka abhu hak ho maso re babèdho kapai dhu la'e asa d'ara kota ne. dhèu dhu mamuri mola, rèngu ka dhu oto. te bèli-camèd'a rèngu abhu ijin ho ra'a hua dhu hia dhèu mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: without are the dogs, and the sorcerers, and the fornicators, and the murderers, and the idolaters, and every one that loveth and maketh a lie.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo bisa boe maso asa era èèna. dhèu dhu unu boe lamatua, bisa boe pea ètu era èèna. nuka rèngu dhu parcaya boe lamatua, dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, tuka sogo-tagu, tuka pamadhe dhèu, tuka suagi, dènge rèngu dhu leko-monya. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa boe ara asa d'ara. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pea dhoka mi li'u di.

source_text: i jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things for the churches. i am the root and the offspring of david, the bright, the morning star.
target_text: ja'a ne, yesus. ja'a ka dhu paleha ana pajuu ja'a nèti sorga, ho bhoke j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka pe miu lami lole peka lii pajaji ja'a se'e mi pidhu juma'at sèra. ja'a ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. ja'a ne, dhèu aae dhu kèd'u paredha. saraa nèti ja'a heo lo'a-lo'a, nuka sèmi hua-hètu oe mèu. saraa nèti ja'a madèka titu kèna, nuka sèmi hua-hètu èèna.

source_text: and the spirit and the bride say, come. and he that heareth, let him say, come. and he that is athirst, let him come: he that will, let him take the water of life freely.
target_text: roh ama lamatua mai paroa, peka na, mai asa ne'e! bhèni dhu neo kab'i paroa kahèi, peka na, mai ka! aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi peka kahèi, mai ka! dhèu cee dhu koko-kamango, mai ho minu! dhèu cee dhu neo ninu èi dhu nèti mamuri, mai mere ka! dhèu bisa rare èi ne dhu iia-iia d'ara. dhèu bisa rinu èi ne dhu b'ae boe.

source_text: i testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, if any man shall add unto them, god shall add unto him the plagues which are written in this book:
target_text: ja'a, yohanis, pasanèd'e dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na tadèngi ngaa dhu ama lamatua bhoke mema hia ja'a ètu d'ara sasuri ne: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu patabha hari ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara sasuri ne, èèna na ama lamatua pabie hari hahuku na mi nèngu dènge pidhu calaka sèra dhu na dutu mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: and if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, god shall take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhu pakura hari isi sasuri ne, pe ama lamatua tao eele hak nèngu, sèna ka bisa boe maso asa d'ara kota dhu mola-mèci, aa bisa boe na'a hua aj'u dhu hia dhèu mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: he who testifieth these things saith, yea: i come quickly. amen: come, lord jesus.
target_text: yesus mesa na ka dhu bhoke j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra. na moa le, peka na, tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna! nèbhu heka, ja'a neo dhiu. de mai ka, lamatua yesus!

source_text: the grace of the lord jesus be with the saints. amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka lamatua yesus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu unu na aa'i-aa'i. lèke tare'a sèmi èèna! amin! nèti ja'a, yohanis
